contents.text: agnim īl̥e puraḥ-hitam yajñasya devam r̥tvijam hotāram ratna-dhātamam
agniḥ pūrvebhiḥ r̥ṣi-bhiḥ īḍyaḥ nūtanaiḥ uta saḥ devān ā iha vakṣati
agninā rayim aśnavat poṣam eva dive--dive yaśasam vīravat-tamam
agne yam yajñam adhvaram viśvataḥ pari-bhūḥ asi saḥ it deveṣu gacchati
agniḥ hotā kavi-kratuḥ satyaḥ citraśravaḥ-tamaḥ devaḥ devebhiḥ ā gamat
yat aṅga dāśuṣe tvam agne bhadram kariṣyasi tava it tat satyam aṅgiraḥ
upa tvā agne dive--dive doṣāvastaḥ dhiyā vayam namaḥ bharantaḥ ā imasi
rājantam adhvarāṇām gopām r̥tasya dīdivim vardhamānam sve dame
saḥ naḥ pitāiva sūnave agne su-upāyanaḥ bhava sacasva naḥ svastaye
vāyo iti ā yāhi darśata ime somāḥ araṁ-kr̥tāḥ teṣām pāhi śrudhi havam
vāyo iti ukthebhiḥ jarante tvām accha jaritāraḥ suta-somāḥ ahaḥ-vidaḥ
vāyo iti tava pra-pr̥ñcatī dhenā jigāti dāśuṣe urūcī soma-pītaye
indravāyūiti ime sutāḥ upa prayaḥ-bhiḥ ā gatam indavaḥ vām uśanti hi
vāyo iti indraḥ ca cetathaḥ sutānām vājinīvasūitivājinī-vasū tau ā yātam upa dravat
vāyo iti indraḥ ca sunvataḥ ā yātam upa niḥ-kr̥tam makṣu itthā dhiyā narā
mitram huve pūta-dakṣam varuṇam ca riśādasam dhiyam ghr̥tācīm sādhantā
r̥tena mitrāvaruṇau r̥tāvr̥dhau r̥ta-spr̥śā kratum br̥hantam āśātheiti
kavī iti naḥ mitrāvaruṇā tuvi-jātau uru-kṣayā dakṣam dadhāteiti apasam
aśvinā yajvarīḥ iṣaḥ dravatpāṇī itidravat-pāṇī śubhaḥ patī iti puru-bhujā canasyatam
aśvinā puru-daṁsasā narā śavīrayā dhiyā dhiṣṇyā vanatam giraḥ
dasrā yuvākavaḥ sutāḥ nāsatyā vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ ā yātam rudravartanī itirudra-vartanī
indra ā yāhi citrabhāno iticitra-bhāno sutāḥ ime tvāyavaḥ aṇvībhiḥ tanā pūtāsaḥ
indra ā yāhi dhiyā iṣitaḥ vipra-jūtaḥ suta-vataḥ upa brahmāṇi vāghataḥ
indra ā yāhi tūtujānaḥ upa brahmāṇi hari-vaḥ sute dadhiṣva naḥ canaḥ
omāsaḥ carṣaṇi-dhr̥taḥ viśve devāsaḥ ā gata dāśvāṁsaḥ dāśuṣaḥ sutam
viśve devāsaḥ ap-turaḥ sutam ā ganta tūrṇayaḥ usrāḥ-iva svasarāṇi
viśve devāsaḥ asridhaḥ ehi-māyāsaḥ adruhaḥ medham juṣanta vahnayaḥ
pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī vājebhiḥ vājinī-vatī yajñam vaṣṭu dhiyāvasuḥ
codayitrī sūnr̥tānām cetantī su-matīnām yajñam dadhe sarasvatī
mahaḥ arṇaḥ sarasvatī pra cetayati ketunā dhiyaḥ viśvāḥ vi rājati
surūpa-kr̥tnum ūtaye sudughām-iva go--duhe juhūmasi dyavi-dyavi
upa naḥ savanā ā gahi somasya soma-pāḥ piba go--dāḥ it revataḥ madaḥ
atha te antamānām vidyāma su-matīnām mā naḥ ati khyaḥ ā gahi
parā ihi vigram astr̥tam indram pr̥ccha vipaḥ-citam yaḥ te sakhi-bhyaḥ ā varam
uta bruvantu naḥ nidaḥ niḥ anyataḥ cit ārata dadhānāḥ indre it duvaḥ
uta naḥ subhagān ariḥ voceyuḥ dasma kr̥ṣṭayaḥ syāma it indrasya śarmaṇi
ā īm āśum āśave bhara yajña-śriyam nr̥-mādanam patayat mandayat-sakham
asya pītvā śatakrato itiśata-krato ghanaḥ vr̥trāṇām abhavaḥ pra āvaḥ vājeṣu vājinam
tam tvā vājeṣu vājinam vājayāmaḥ śatakrato itiśata-krato dhanānām indra sātaye
yaḥ rāyaḥ avaniḥ mahān su-pāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā tasmai indrāya gāyata
ā tu ā ita ni sīdata indram abhi pra gāyata sakhāyaḥ stoma-vāhasaḥ
puru-tamam purūṇām īśānam vāryāṇam indram some sacā sute
saḥ gha naḥ yoge ā bhuvat saḥ rāye saḥ puram-dhyām gamat vājebhiḥ ā saḥ naḥ
yasya sam-sthe na vr̥ṇvate harī iti samat-su śatravaḥ tasmai indrāya gāyata
suta-pāvne sutāḥ ime śucayaḥ yanti vītaye somāsaḥ dadhi-āśiraḥ
tvam sutasya pītaye sadyaḥ vr̥ddhaḥ ajāyathāḥ indra jyaiṣṭhyāya sukrato itisu-krato
ā tvā viśantu āśavaḥ somāsaḥ indra girvaṇaḥ śam te santu pra-cetase
tvām stomāḥ avīvr̥dhan tvām ukthā śatakrato itiśata-krato tvām vardhantu naḥ giraḥ
akṣita-ūtiḥ sanet imam vājam indraḥ sahasriṇam yasmin viśvāni paiṁsyā
mā naḥ martāḥ abhi druhan tanūnām indra girvaṇaḥ īśānaḥ yavaya vadham
yuñjanti bradhnam aruṣam carantam pari tasthuṣaḥ rocante rocanā divi
yuñjanti asya kāmyā harī iti vipakṣasā rathe śoṇā dhr̥ṣṇū iti nr̥-vāhasā
ketum kr̥ṇvan aketave peśaḥ maryāḥ apeśase sam uṣat-bhiḥ ajāyathāḥ
āt aha svadhām anu punaḥ garbha-tvam āīrire dadhānāḥ nāma yajñiyam
vīl̥u cit ārujatnu-bhiḥ guhā cit indra vahni-bhiḥ avindaḥ usriyāḥ anu
deva-yantaḥ yathā matim accha vidat-vasum giraḥ mahām anūṣata śrutam
indreṇa sam hi dr̥kṣase sam-jagmānaḥ abibhyuṣā mandū iti samāna-varcasā
anavadyaiḥ abhidyu-bhiḥ makhaḥ sahasvat arcati gaṇaiḥ indrasya kāmyaiḥ
ataḥ parijman ā gahi divaḥ vā rocanāt adhi sam asmin r̥ñjate giraḥ
itaḥ vā sātim īmahe diva vā pārthivāt adhi indram mahaḥ vā rajasaḥ
indram it gāthinaḥ br̥hat indram arkebhiḥ arkiṇaḥ indram vāṇīḥ anūṣata
indraḥ it haryoḥ sacā sam-miślaḥ ā vacaḥ-yujā indraḥ vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ
indraḥ dīrghāya cakṣase ā sūryam rohayat divi vi gobhiḥ adrim airayat
indraḥ vājeṣu naḥ ava sahasra-pradhaneṣu ca ugraḥ ugrābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ
indram vayam mahādhane indram arbhe havāmahe yujam vr̥treṣu vajriṇam
saḥ naḥ vr̥ṣan amum carum satrādāvan apa vr̥dhi asmabhyam aprati-skutaḥ
tuñje--tuñje ye ut-tare stomāḥ indrasya vajriṇaḥ na vindhe asya su-stutim
vr̥ṣā yūthāiva vaṁsagaḥ kr̥ṣṭīḥ iyarti ojasā īśānaḥ aprati-skutaḥ
yaḥ ekaḥ carṣaṇīnām vasūnām irajyati indraḥ pañca kṣitīnām
indram vaḥ viśvataḥ pari havāmahe janebhyaḥ asmākam astu kevalaḥ
ā indra sānasim rayim sa-jitvānam sadāsaham varṣiṣṭham ūtaye bhara
ni yena muṣṭi-hatyayā ni vr̥trā ruṇadhāmahai tvāūtāsaḥ ni arvatā
indra tvāūtāsaḥ ā vayam vajram ghanā dadīmahi jayema sam yudhi spr̥dhaḥ
vayam śūrebhiḥ astr̥-bhiḥ indra tvayā yujā vayam sāsahyāmapr̥tanyataḥ
mahān indraḥ paraḥ ca nu mahi-tvam astu vajriṇe dyauḥ na prathinā śavaḥ
sam-ohe vā ye āśata naraḥ tokasya sanitau viprāsaḥ vā dhiyāyavaḥ
yaḥ kukṣiḥ soma-pātamaḥ samudraḥ-iva pinvate urvīḥ āpaḥ na kākudaḥ
eva hi asya sūnr̥tā vi-rapśī go--matī mahī pakvā śākhā na dāśuṣe
eva hi te vi-bhūtayaḥ ūtayaḥ indra māvate sadyaḥ cit santi dāśuṣe
eva hi asya kāmyā stomaḥ uktham ca śaṁsyā indrāya soma-pītaye
indra ā ihi matsi andhasaḥ viśvebhiḥ somaparva-bhiḥ mahān abhiṣṭiḥ ojasā
ā īm enam sr̥jata sute mandim indrāya mandine cakrim viśvāni cakraye
matsva su-śipra mandi-bhiḥ stomebhiḥ viśva-carṣaṇe sacā eṣu savaneṣu ā
asr̥gram indra te giraḥ prati tvām ud ahāsata ajoṣāḥ vr̥ṣabham patim
sam codaya citram arvāk rādhaḥ indra vareṇyam asat it te vi-bhu pra-bhu
asmān su tatra codaya indra rāye rabhasvataḥ tuvi-dyumna yaśasvataḥ
sam go--mat indra vāja-vat asme iti pr̥thu śravaḥ br̥hat viśva-āyuḥ dhehi akṣitam
iti dhehi śravaḥ br̥hat dyumnam sahasra-sātamam indra tāḥ rathiniḥ iṣaḥ
vasoḥ indram vasu-patim gīḥ-bhiḥ gr̥ṇantaḥ r̥gmiyam homa gantāram ūtaye
sute--sute ni-okase br̥hat br̥hate ā it ariḥ indrāya śūṣam arcati
gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇaḥ arcanti arkam arkiṇaḥ brahmāṇaḥ tvā śatakrato itiśata-krato ut vaṁśam-iva yemire
yat sānoḥ sānum ā aruhat bhūri aspaṣṭa kartvam tat indraḥ artham cetati yūthena vr̥ṣṇiḥ ejati
yukṣva hi keśinā harī iti vr̥ṣaṇā kakṣya-prā atha naḥ indra soma-pāḥ girām upa-śrutim cara
ā ihi stomān abhi svara abhi gr̥ṇīhi ā ruva brahma ca naḥ vaso iti sacā indra yajñam ca vardhaya
uktham indrāya śaṁsyam vardhanam puruniḥ-sidhe śakraḥ yathā suteṣu naḥ raraṇat sakhyeṣu ca
tam it sakhi-tve īmahe tam rāye tam su-vīrye saḥ śakraḥ uta naḥ śakat indraḥ vasu dayamānaḥ
su-vivr̥tam suniḥ-ajam indra tvādātam it yaśaḥ gavām apa vrajam vr̥dhi kr̥ṇuṣva rādhaḥ adri-vaḥ
nahi tvā rodasī iti ubhe iti r̥ghāyamāṇam invataḥ jeṣaḥ svaḥ-vatīḥ apaḥ sam gāḥ asmabhyam dhūnuhi
āśrut-karṇa śrudhi havam nū cit dadhiṣva me giraḥ indra stomam imam mama kr̥ṣva yujaḥ cit antaram
vidma hi tvā vr̥ṣan-tamam vājeṣu havana-śrutam vr̥ṣan-tamasya hūmahe ūtim sahasra-sātamām
ā tu naḥ indra kauśika mandasānaḥ sutam piba navyam āyuḥ pra su tira kr̥dhi sahasra-sām r̥ṣim
pari tvā girvaṇaḥ giraḥ imāḥ bhavantu viśvataḥ vr̥ddha-āyum anu vr̥ddhayaḥ juṣṭāḥ bhavantu juṣṭayaḥ
indram viśvāḥ avīvr̥dhan samudra-vyacasam giraḥ rathi-tamam rathīnām vājānām sat-patim patim
sakhye te indra vājinaḥ mā bhema śavasaḥ pate tvām abhi pra nonumaḥ jetāram aparājitam
pūrvīḥ indrasya rātayaḥ na vi dasyanti ūtayaḥ yadi vājasya go--mataḥ stotr̥-bhyaḥ maṁhate magham
purām bhinduḥ yuvā kaviḥ amita-ojāḥ ajāyata indraḥ viśvasya kamarṇaḥ dhartā vajrī puru-stutaḥ
tvam valasya go--mataḥ apa avaḥ adri-vaḥ bilam tvām devāḥ abibhyuṣaḥ tujyamānāsaḥ āviṣuḥ
tava aham śūra rāti-bhiḥ prati āyam sindhum āvadan upa atiṣṭhanta girvaṇaḥ viduḥ te tasya kāravaḥ
māyābhiḥ indra māyinam tvam śuṣṇam ava atiraḥ viduḥ te tasya medhirāḥ teṣām śravāṁsi ut tira
indram īśānam ojasā abhi stomāḥ anūṣata sahasram yasya rātayaḥ uta vā santi bhūyasīḥ
agnim dūtam vr̥ṇīmahe hotāram viśva-vedasam asya yajñasya su-kratum
agnim-agnim havīma-bhiḥ sadā havanta viśpatim havya-vāham puru-priyam
agne devān iha ā vaha jajñānaḥ vr̥kta-barhiṣe asi hotā naḥ īḍyaḥ
tān uśataḥ vi bodhaya yat agne yāsi dūtyam devaiḥ ā satsi barhiṣi
ghr̥ta-āhavana dīdi-vaḥ prati sma riṣataḥ daha agne tvam rakṣasvinaḥ
agninā agniḥ sam idhyate kaviḥ gr̥ha-patiḥ yuvā havya-vāṭ juhu-āsyaḥ
kavim agnim upa stuhi satya-dharmāṇam adhvare devam amīva-cātanam
yaḥ tvām agne haviḥ-patiḥ dūtam deva saparyati tasya sma pra-avitā bhava
yaḥ agnim deva-vītaye haviṣmān āvivāsati tasmai pāvaka mr̥l̥aya
saḥ naḥ pāvaka dīdi-vaḥ agne devān iha ā vaha upa yajñam haviḥ ca naḥ
saḥ naḥ stavānaḥ ā bhara gāyatreṇa navīyasā rayim vīra-vatīm iṣam
agne śukreṇa śociṣā viśvābhiḥ devahūti-bhiḥ imam stomam juṣasva naḥ
su-samiddhaḥ naḥ ā vaha devān agne haviṣmate hotariti pāvaka yakṣi ca
madhu-mantam tanū-napāt yajñam deveṣu naḥ kave adya kr̥ṇuhi vītaye
narāśaṁsam iha priyam asmin yajñe upa hvaye madhu-jihvam haviḥ-kr̥tam
agne sukha-tame rathe devān il̥itaḥ ā vaha asi hotā manuḥ-hitaḥ
str̥ṇīta barhiḥ ānuṣak ghr̥ta-pr̥ṣṭham manīṣiṇaḥ yatra amr̥tasya cakṣaṇam
vi śrayantām r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ dvāraḥ devīḥ asaścataḥ adya nūnam ca yaṣṭave
naktoṣāsā su-peśasā asmin yajñe upa hvaye idam naḥ barhiḥ āsade
tā su-jihvau upa hvaye hotārā daivyā kavī iti yajñam naḥ yakṣatām imam
il̥ā sarasvatī mahī tisraḥ devīḥ mayaḥ-bhuvaḥ barhiḥ sīdantu asridhaḥ
iha tvaṣṭāram agriyam viśva-rūpam upa hvaye asmākam astu kevalaḥ
ava sr̥ja vanaspate deva devebhyaḥ haviḥ pra dātuḥ astu cetanam
svāhā yajñam kr̥ṇotana indrāya yajvanaḥ gr̥he tatra devān upa hvaye
ā ebhiḥ agne duvaḥ giraḥ viśvebhiḥ soma-pītaye devebhiḥ yāhi yakṣi ca
ā tvā kaṇvāḥ ahūṣata gr̥ṇanti vipra te dhiyaḥ devebhiḥ agne ā gahi
indravāyū iti br̥haspatim mitrā agnim pūṣaṇam bhagam ādityān mārutam gaṇam
pra vaḥ bhriyante indavaḥ matsarāḥ mādayiṣṇavaḥ drapsāḥ madhvaḥ camū-sadaḥ
īl̥ate tvām avasyavaḥ kaṇvāsaḥ vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ haviṣmantaḥ aram-kr̥taḥ
ghr̥ta-pr̥ṣṭhāḥ manaḥ-yujaḥ ye tvā vahanti vahnayaḥ ā devān soma-pītaye
tān yajatrān r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ agne patnī-vataḥ kr̥dhi madhvaḥ su-jihva pāyaya
ye yajatrāḥ ye īḍyāḥ te te pibantu jihvayā madhoḥ agne vaṣaṭ-kr̥ti
ākīm sūryasya rocanāt viśvān devān uṣaḥ-budhaḥ vipraḥ hotā iha vakṣati
viśvebhiḥ somyam madhu agne indreṇa vāyunā piba mitrasya dhāma-bhiḥ
tvam hotā manuḥ-hitaḥ agne yajñeṣu sīdasi saḥ imam naḥ adhvaram yaja
yukṣva hi aruṣīḥ rathe haritaḥ deva rohitaḥ tābhiḥ devān iha ā vaha
indra somam piba r̥tunā ā tvā viśantu indavaḥ matsarāsaḥ tat-okasaḥ
marutaḥ pibata r̥tunā potrāt yajñam pūnītana yūyam hi stha su-dānavaḥ
abhi yajñam gr̥ṇīhi naḥ grāvaḥ neṣṭariti piba r̥tunā tvam hi ratna-dhā asi
agne devān iha ā vaha sādaya yoniṣu triṣu pari bhūṣa piba r̥tunā
brāhmaṇāt indra rādhasaḥ piba somam r̥tūn anu tava it hi sakhyam astr̥tam
yuvam dakṣam dhr̥ta-vratā mitrāvaruṇā duḥ-dabham r̥tunā yajñam āśātheiti
draviṇaḥ-dāḥ draviṇasaḥ grāva-hastāsaḥ adhvare yajñeṣu devam īl̥ate
draviṇaḥ-dāḥ dadātu naḥ vasūni yāni śr̥ṇvire deveṣu tā vanāmahe
draviṇaḥ-dāḥ pipīṣati juhota pra ca tiṣṭhata neṣṭrāt r̥tu-bhiḥ iṣyata
yat tvā turīyam r̥tu-bhiḥ draviṇaḥ-daḥ yajāmahe adha sma naḥ dadiḥ bhava
aśvinā pibatam madhu dīdyagnī itidīdi-agnī śuci-vratā r̥tunā yajña-vāhasā
gārhapatyena santya r̥tunā yajña-nīḥ asi devān devayate yaja
ā tvā vahantu harayaḥ vr̥ṣaṇam soma-pītaye indra tvā sūra-cakṣasaḥ
imāḥ dhānāḥ ghr̥ta-snuvaḥ harī iti iha upa vakṣataḥ indram sukha-tame rathe
indram prātaḥ havāmahe indram pra-yati adhvare indram somasya pītaye
upa naḥ sutam ā gahi hari-bhiḥ indra keśi-bhiḥ sute hi tvā havāmahe
saḥ imam naḥ stomam ā gahi upa idam savanam sutam gauraḥ na tr̥ṣitaḥ piba
ime somāsaḥ indavaḥ sutāsaḥ adhi barhiṣi tān indra sahase piba
ayam te stomaḥ agriyāḥ hr̥dii-spr̥k astu śam-tamaḥ atha somam sutam piba
viśvam it savanam sutam indraḥ madāya gacchati vr̥tra-hā soma-pītaye
saḥ imam naḥ kāmam ā pr̥ṇa gobhiḥ aśvaiḥ śatakrato itiśatakrato stavāma tvā su-ādhyaḥ
indrāvaruṇayoḥ aham sam-rājoḥ avaḥ ā vr̥ṇe tā naḥ mr̥l̥ātaḥ īdr̥śe
gantārāḥ hi sthaḥ avase havam viprasya māvataḥ dhartārācarṣaṇīnām
anukāmam tarpayethām indrāvaruṇā rāyaḥ ā tā vām nediṣṭham īmahe
yuvāku hi śacīnām yuvāku su-matīnām bhūyāma vājadāvnām
indraḥ sahasra-dāvnām varuṇaḥ śaṁsyānām kratuḥ bhavati ukthyaḥ
tayoḥ it avasā vayam sanema ni ca dhīmahi syāt uta pra-recanam
indrāvaruṇā vām aham huve citrāya rādhase asmān su jigyuṣaḥ kr̥tam
indrāvaruṇā nu nu vām siṣāsantīṣu dhīṣu ā asmabhyam śarma yacchatam
pra vām aśnotu su-stutiḥ indrāvaruṇā yām huve yām r̥dhātheiti sadha-stutim
somānam svaraṇam kr̥ṇuhi brahmaṇaḥ pate kakṣīvantam yaḥ auśijaḥ
yaḥ revān yaḥ amīva-hā vasu-vit puṣṭi-vardhanaḥ saḥ naḥ sisaktu yaḥ turaḥ
mā naḥ śaṁsaḥ araruṣaḥ dhūrtiḥ praṇak martyasya rakṣa naḥ brahmaṇaḥ pate
saḥ gha vīraḥ na riṣyati yam indraḥ brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ somaḥ hinoti martyam
tvam tam brahmaṇaḥ pate somaḥ indraḥ ca martyam dakṣiṇā pātu aṁhasaḥ
sadasaḥ patim adbhutam priyam indrasya kāmyam sanim medhām ayāsiṣam
yasmāt r̥te na sidhyati yajñaḥ vipaḥ-citaḥ cana saḥ dhīnām yogam invati
āt r̥dhnoti haviḥ-kr̥tim prāñcam kr̥ṇoti adhvaram hotrā deveṣu gacchati
narāśaṁsam sudhr̥ṣṭamam apaśyam saprathaḥ-tamam divaḥ na sadma-makhasam
prati tyam cārum adhvaram go--pīthāya pra hūyase marut-bhiḥ agne ā gahi
nahi devaḥ na martyaḥ mahaḥ tava kratum paraḥ marut-bhiḥ agne ā gahi
ye mahaḥ rajasaḥ viduḥ viśve devāsaḥ adruhaḥ marut-bhiḥ agne ā gahi
ye ugrāḥ arkam ānr̥cuḥ anādhr̥ṣṭāsaḥ ojasā marut-bhiḥ agne ā gahi
ye śubhrāḥ ghora-varpasaḥ su-kṣatrāsaḥ riśādasaḥ marut-bhiḥ agne ā gahi
ye nākasya adhi rocane divi devāsaḥ āsate marut-bhiḥ agne ā gahi
ye īṅkhayanti parvatān tiraḥ samudram arṇavam marut-bhiḥ agne ā gahi
ā ye tanvanti raśmi-bhiḥ tiraḥ samudram ojasā marut-bhiḥ agne ā gahi
abhi tvā pūrva-pītaye sr̥jāmi somyam madhu marut-bhiḥ agne ā gahi
ayam devāya janmane stomaḥ viprebhiḥ āsayā akāri ratna-dhātamaḥ
ye indrāya vacaḥ-yujā tatakṣuḥ manasā harī iti śamāībhiḥ yajñam āśata
takṣan nāsatyābhyām pari-jmānam su-kham ratham takṣan dhenum sabaḥ-dughām
yuvānā pitarā punariti satya-mantrāḥ r̥jū-yavaḥ r̥bhavaḥ viṣṭī akrata
sam vaḥ madāsaḥ agmata indreṇa ca marutvatā ādityebhiḥ ca rāja-bhiḥ
uta tyam camasam navam tvaṣṭuḥ devasya niḥ-kr̥tam akarta caturaḥ punariti
te naḥ ratnāni dhattana triḥ ā sāptāni sunvate ekam-ekam suśasti-bhiḥ
adhārayanta vahnayaḥ abhajanta su-kr̥tyayā bhāgam deveṣu yajñiyam
iha indrāgnī iti upa hvaye tayoḥ it stomam uśmasi tā somam soma-pātamā
tā yajñeṣu pra śaṁsata indrāgnī iti śumbhata naraḥ tā gāyatreṣu gāyata
tā mitrasya pra-śastaye indrāgnī iti tā havāmahe soma-pā soma-pītaye
ugrā santā havāmahe upa idam savanam sutam indrāgnī iti ā iha gacchatām
tā mahāntā sadaspatī iti indrāgnī iti rakṣaḥ ubjatam aprajāḥ santu atriṇaḥ
tena satyena jāgr̥tam adhi pra-cetune pade indrāgnī iti śarma yacchatam
prātaḥ-yujā vi bodhaya aśvinau ā iha gacchatām asya somasya pītaye
yā su-rathā rathi-tamā ubhā devā divi-spr̥śā aśvinā tā havāmahe
yā vām kaśā madhu-matī aśvinā sūnr̥tāvatī tayā yajñam mimikṣatam
nahi vām asti dūrake yatra rathena gacchathaḥ aśvinā sominaḥ gr̥ham
hiraṇya-pāṇim ūtaye savitāram upa hvaye saḥ cettā devatā padam
apām napātam avase savitāram upa stuhi tasya vratāni uśmasi
vi-bhaktāram havāmahe vasoḥ citrasya rādhasaḥ savitāram nr̥-cakṣasam
sakhāyaḥ ā ni sīdata savitā stomyaḥ nu naḥ dātā rādhāṁsi śumbhati
agne patnīḥ iha ā vaha devānām uśatīḥ upa tvaṣṭāram soma-pītaye
ā gnāḥ agne iha avase hotrām yaviṣṭha bhāratīm varūtrīm dhiṣaṇām vaha
abhi naḥ devīḥ avasā mahaḥ śarmaṇā nr̥-patnīḥ acchinna-patrāḥ sacantām
iha indrāṇīm upa hvaye varuṇānīm svastaye agnāyīm soma-pītaye
mahī dyauḥ pr̥thivī ca naḥ imam yajñam mimikṣatām pipr̥tām naḥ bharīma-bhiḥ
tayoḥ it ghr̥ta-vat payaḥ viprāḥ rihanti dhīti-bhiḥ gandharvasya dhruve pade
syonā pr̥thivi bhava anr̥kṣarā ni-veśanī yaccha naḥ śarma sa-prathaḥ
ataḥ devāḥ avantu naḥ yataḥ viṣṇuḥ vi-cakrame pr̥thivyāḥ sapta dhāma-bhiḥ
idam viṣṇuḥ vi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padam sam-ūl̥ham asya pāṁsure
trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇuḥ gopāḥ adābhyaḥ ataḥ dharmāṇi dhārayan
viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yataḥ vratāni paspaśe indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā
tat viṣṇoḥ paramam padam sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ divi-iva cakṣuḥ ātatam
tat viprāsaḥ vipanyavaḥ jāgr̥-vāṁsaḥ sam indhate viṣṇoḥ yat paramam padam
tīvrāḥ somāsaḥ ā gahi āśīḥ-vantaḥ sutāḥ ime vāyo iti tān pra-sthitān piba
ubhā devā divi-spr̥śā indravāyū iti havāmahe asya somasya pītaye
indravāyū iti manaḥ-juvā viprāḥ havante ūtaye sahasra-akṣā dhiyaḥ patī iti
mitram vayam havāmahe varuṇam soma-pītaye jajñānā pūta-dakṣasā
r̥tena yau r̥ta-vr̥dhau r̥tasya jyotiṣaḥ patī iti tā mitrāvaruṇā huve
varuṇaḥ pra-avitā bhuvat mitraḥ viśvābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ karatām naḥ su-rādhasaḥ
marutvantam havāmahe indram ā soma-pītaye sa-jūḥ gaṇena tr̥mpatu
indra-jyeṣṭhāḥ marut-gaṇāḥ devāsaḥ pūṣa-rātayaḥ viśve mama śruta havam
hata vr̥tram su-dānava indreṇa sahasā yujā mā naḥ duḥ-śaṁsaḥ īśata
vviśvān devān havāmahe marutaḥ soma-pītaye ugrāḥ hi pr̥śni-mātaraḥ
jayatām-iva tanyatuḥ marutām eti dhr̥ṣṇu-yā yat śubham yāthana naraḥ
haskārāt vi-dyutaḥ pari ataḥ jātāḥ avantu naḥ marutaḥ mr̥l̥ayantu naḥ
ā pūṣan citra-barhiṣam āghr̥ṇe dharuṇam divaḥ ā aja naṣṭam yathā paśum
pūṣā rājānam āghr̥ṇiḥ apa-gūl̥ham guhā hitam avindat citra-barhiṣam
uto iti saḥ mahyam indu-bhiḥ ṣaṭ yuktān anu-sesidhat gobhiḥ yavam na carkr̥ṣat
ambayaḥ yanti adhva-bhiḥ jāmayaḥ adhvari-yatām pr̥ñcatīḥ madhunā payaḥ
amūḥ yāḥ upa sūrye yābhiḥ vā sūryaḥ saha tāḥ naḥ hinvantu adhvaram
apaḥ devīḥ upa hvaye yatra gāvaḥ pibanti naḥ sindhu-bhyaḥ kartvam haviḥ
ap-su antaḥ amr̥tam ap-su bheṣajam apām uta pra-śastaye devāḥ bhavata vājinaḥ
ap-su me somaḥ abravīt antaḥ viśvāni bheṣajā agnim ca viśva-śambhuvam āpaḥ ca viśva-bheṣajīḥ
āpaḥ pr̥ṇīta bheṣajam varūtham tanve mama jyok ca sūryam dr̥śe
idam āpaḥ pra vahata yat kim ca duritam mayi yat vā aham abhi-dudroha yat vā śepe uta anr̥tam
āpaḥ adya anu acāriṣam rasena sam agasmahi payasvān agne ā gahi tam mā sam sr̥ja varcasā
sam mā agne varcasā sr̥ja sam pra-jayā sam āyuṣā vidyuḥ me asya devāḥ indraḥ vidyāt saha r̥ṣi-bhiḥ
kasya nūnam katamasya amr̥tānām manāmahe cāru devasya nāma kaḥ naḥ mahyai aditaye punaḥ dāt pitaram ca dr̥śeyam mātaram ca
agneḥ vayam prathamasya amr̥tānām manāmahe cāru devasya nāma saḥ naḥ mahyai aditaye punaḥ dāt pitaram ca dr̥śeyam mātaram ca
abhi tvā deva savitaḥ īśānam vāryāṇām sadā avan bhāgam īmahe
yaḥ cit hi te itthā bhagaḥ śaśamānaḥ purā nidaḥ adveṣaḥ hastayoḥ dadhe
bhaga-bhaktasya te vayam ut aśema tava avasā mūrdhānam rāyaḥ ārabhe
nahi te kṣatram na sahaḥ na manyum vayaḥ cana amī iti patayantaḥ āpuḥ na imāḥ āpaḥ ani-miṣam carantīḥ na ye vātasya pra-minanti abhvam
abudhne rājā varuṇaḥ vanasya ūrdhvam stūpam dr̥te pūta-dakṣaḥ nīcīnāḥ sthuḥ upari budhnaḥ eṣām asme iti antaḥ ni-hitāḥ ketavaḥ syuritisyuḥ
urum hi rājā varuṇaḥ cakāra sūryāya panthām anu-etavai oṁ iti apade pādā prati-dhātave akaḥ uta apa-vaktā hr̥daya-vidhaḥ cit
śatam te rājan bhiṣajaḥ sahasram urvī gabhīrā su-matiḥ te astu bādhasva dūre niḥ-r̥tim parācaiḥ kr̥tam cit enaḥ pra mumugdhi asmat
amī iti ye r̥kṣāḥ ni-hitāsaḥ uccā naktam dr̥daśre kuha cit divā īyuḥ adabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni vi-cākaśat candramāḥ naktam eti
tat tvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānaḥ tat ā śāste yajamānaḥ haviḥ-bhiḥ ahel̥amānaḥ varuṇa iha bodhi uru-śaṁsa mā naḥ āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ
tat it naktam tat divā mahyam āhuḥ tat ayam ketaḥ hr̥daḥ ā vi caṣṭe śunaḥśepaḥ yam ahvat gr̥bhītaḥ saḥ asmān rājā varuṇaḥ mumoktu
śunaḥśepaḥ hi ahvat gr̥bhītaḥ triṣu ādityam dru-padeṣu baddhaḥ ava enam rājā varuṇaḥ sasr̥jyāt vidvān adabdhaḥ vi mumoktu pāsān
ava te hel̥aḥ varuṇa namaḥ-bhiḥ ava yajñebhiḥ īmahe haviḥ-bhiḥ kṣayan asmabhyam asura pracetaitipra-cetaḥ rājan enāṁsi śiśrathaḥ kr̥tāni
ut ut-tamam varuṇa pāśam asmat ava adhamam vi madhyayamam śrathaya atha vayam āditya vrate tava anāgasaḥ aditaye syāma
yat cit hi te viśaḥ yathā pra deva varuṇa vratam minīmasi dyavi-dyavi
mā naḥ vadhāya hatnave jihīl̥ānasya rīradhaḥ mā hr̥ṇānasyamanyave
vi mr̥l̥īkāya te manaḥ rathīḥ aśvam na sam-ditam gīrbhiḥ varuṇa sīmahi
parā hi me vi-manyavaḥ patanti vasyaḥ-iṣṭaye vayaḥ na vasatīḥ upa
kadā kṣatra-śriyam naram ā varuṇam karāmahe mr̥l̥īkāya uru-cakṣasam
tat it samānam āśāteiti venantā na pra yucchataḥ dhr̥ta-vratāya dāśuṣe
veda yaḥ vīnām padam antarikṣeṇa patatām veda nāvaḥ samudriyaḥ
veda māsaḥ dhr̥ta-vrataḥ dvādaśa prajāvataḥ veda yaḥ upa-jāyate
veda vātasya vartanim uroḥ r̥ṣvasya br̥hataḥ veda ye adhi-āsate
ni sasāda dhr̥ta-vrataḥ varuṇaḥ pastyāsu ā sām-rājyāya su-kratuḥ
ataḥ viśvāni adbhutā cikitvān abhi paśyati kr̥tāni yā ca kartvā
saḥ naḥ viśvāhā su-kratuḥ ādityaḥ su-pathā karat pra naḥ āyūṁṣi tāriṣat
bibhrat drāpim hiraṇyayam varuṇaḥ vasta niḥ-nijam pari spaśaḥ ni sedire
na yam dipsanti dipsavaḥ na druhvāṇaḥ janānām na devam abhi-mātayaḥ
uta yaḥ mānuṣeṣu ā yaśaḥ cakre asāmi ā asmākam udareṣu ā
parāḥ me yanti dhītayaḥ gāvaḥ na gavyūtīḥ anu icchantīḥ uru-cakṣasam
sam nu vocāvahai punaḥ yataḥ me madhu ābhr̥tam hotāiva kṣadase priyam
darśam nu viśva-darśatam darśam ratham adhi kṣami etāḥ juṣata me giraḥ
imam me varuṇa śrudhi havam adya ca mr̥l̥aya tvām avasyuḥ ā cakre
tvam viśvasya medhira divaḥ ca gmaḥ ca rājasi saḥ yāmani prati śrudhi
ut ut-tamam mumugdhi naḥ vi pāśam madhyamañ cr̥ta ava adhamāni jīvase
vasiṣva hi miyedhya vastrāṇi ūrjām pate saḥ imam naḥ adhvaram yaja
ni naḥ hotā vareṇyaḥ sadā yaviṣṭha manma-bhiḥ agne divitmatā vacaḥ
ā hi sma sūnave pitā āpiḥ yajati āpaye sakhā sakhye vareṇyaḥ
ā naḥ barhiḥ riśādasaḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā sīdantu manuṣaḥ yathā
pūrvya hotaḥ asya naḥ mandasva sakhyasya ca imāḥ oṁ iti su śrudhī giraḥ
yat cit hi śaśvatā tanā devam-devam yajāmahe tve iti it hūyate haviḥ
priyaḥ naḥ astu viśpatiḥ hotām mandraḥ vareṇyaḥ priyāḥ su-agnayaḥ vayam
su-agnayaḥ hi vāryam devāsaḥ dadhire ca naḥ su-agnayaḥ manāmahe
atha naḥ ubhayeṣām amr̥ta martyānām mithaḥ santu pra-śastayaḥ
viśvebhiḥ agne agni-bhiḥ imam yajñam idam vacaḥ canaḥ dhāḥ sahasa yaho iti
aśvam na tvā vāra-vantam vandadhyai agnim namobhiḥ sam-rājantam adhvarāṇām
saḥ gha naḥ sūnuḥ śavasā pr̥thu-pragāmā su-śevaḥ mīḍhavān asmākam babhūyāt
saḥ naḥ dūrāt ca āsāt ca ni martyāt agha-yoḥ pāhi sadam it viśva-āyuḥ
imam oṁ iti su tvam asmākam sanim gāyatram navyāṁsam agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ
ā naḥ bhaja parameṣu ā vājeṣu madhyameṣu śikṣā vasvaḥ antamasya
vi-bhaktā asi citrabhāno iticitra-bhāno sindhoḥ ūrmau upāke ā sadyaḥ dāśuṣe kṣarasi
yam agne pr̥t-su martyam avāḥ vājeṣu yam junāḥ saḥ yantā śaśvatīḥ iṣaḥ
nakiḥ asya sahantya pari-etā kayasya cit vājaḥ asti śravāyyaḥ
saḥ vājam viśva-carṣaṇiḥ arvat-bhiḥ astu tarutā viprebhiḥ astu sanitā
jarābodha tat viviḍḍhi viśe--viśe yajñiyāya stomam rudrāya dr̥śīkam
saḥ naḥ mahān ani-mānaḥ dhūma-ketuḥ puru-candraḥ dhiye vājāya hinvatu
saḥ revān-iva viśpatiḥ daivyaḥ ketuḥ śr̥ṇotu naḥ ukthaiḥ agniḥ br̥hat-bhānuḥ
namaḥ mahat-bhyaḥ namaḥ arbhakebhyaḥ namaḥ yuvabhyaḥ namaḥ āśinebhyaḥ yajāma devān yadi śaknavāma mā jyāyasaḥ śaṁsam ā vr̥kṣi devāḥ
yatra grāvā pr̥thu-budhnaḥ ūrdhvaḥ bhavati sotave ulūkhala-sutānām ava it oṁ iti indra jalgulaḥ
yatra dvau-iva jaghanā adhi-savanyā kr̥tā ulūkhala-sutānām ava it oṁ iti indra jalgulaḥ
yatra nārī apa-cyavam upa-cyavam ca śikṣate ulūkhala-sutānām ava it oṁ iti indra jalgulaḥ
yatra manthām vi-badhnate raśmīn yamitavai-iva ulūkhala-sutānām ava it oṁ iti indra jalgulaḥ
yat cit hi tvam gr̥he--gr̥he ulūkhalaka yujyase iha dyumat-tamam vada jayatām-iva dundubhiḥ
uta sma te vanaspate vātaḥ vi vāti agram it atho iti indrāya pātave sunu somam ulūkhala
āyajī ity āyajī vāja-sātamā tā hi uccā vi-jarbhr̥taḥ harīivetiharī-iva andhāṁsi bapsatā
tā naḥ adya vanaspatī iti r̥ṣvau r̥ṣvebhiḥ sotr̥-bhiḥ indrāya madhu-mat sutam
ut śiṣṭam camvoḥ bhara somam pavitre ā sr̥ja ni dhehi goḥ adhi tvaci
yat cit hi satya soma-pā anāśastāḥ-iva smasi ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī-magha
śiprin vājānām pate śacī-vaḥ tava daṁsanā ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī-magha
ni svāpaya mithu-dr̥śā sastām abudhyamāneiti ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī-magha
sasantu tyāḥ arātayaḥ bodhantu śūra rātayaḥ ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī-magha
sam indra gardabham mr̥ṇa nuvantam pāpayā amuyā ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī-magha
patāti kuṇḍr̥ṇācyā dūram vātaḥ vanāt adhi ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī-magha
sarvam pari-krośam jahi jambhaya kr̥kadāśvam ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī-magha
ā vaḥ indram krivim yathā vāja-yantaḥ śata-kratum maṁhiṣṭhaṁsiñce indu-bhiḥ
śatam vā yaḥ śucīnām sahasram vā sam-āśirām ā it oṁ iti nimnam na rīyate
sam yat madāya śuṣmiṇe enā hi asya udare samudraḥ na vyacaḥ dadhe
ayam oṁ iti te sam atasi kapotaḥ-iva garbha-dhim vacaḥ tat cit naḥ ohase
stotram rādhānām pate girvāhaḥ vīra yasya te vi-bhūtiḥ astu sunr̥tā
ūrdhvaḥ tiṣṭha naḥ ūtaye asmin vāje śatakrato itiśata-krato sam anyeṣu bravāvahai
yoge--yoge tavaḥ-taram vāje--vāje havāmahe sakhāyaḥ indram ūtaye
ā gha gamat yadi śravat sahasriṇībhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ vājebhiḥ upa naḥ havam
anu pratnasya okasaḥ huve tuvi-pratim naram yam te pūrvam pitā huve
tam tvā vayam viśva-vāra ā śāsmahe puru-hūta sakhe vaso iti jaritr̥-bhyaḥ
asmākam śipriṇīnām soma-pāḥ soma-pāvnām sakhe vajrin sakhīnām
tathā tat astu soma-pāḥ sakhe vajrin tathā kr̥ṇu yathā te uśmasi iṣṭaye
revatīḥ naḥ sadha-māde indre santu tuvi-vājāḥ kṣu-mantaḥ yābhiḥ madema
ā gha tvāvān tmanā āptaḥ stotr̥-bhyaḥ dhr̥ṣṇo iti iyānaḥ r̥ṇoḥ akṣam na cakryoḥ
ā yat duvaḥ śatakrato itiśata-krato ā kāmam jaritr̥r̥ṇām r̥ṇoḥ akṣam na śacībhiḥ
śaśvat indraḥ popruthat-bhiḥ jagāya nānadat-bhiḥ śāśvasat-bhiḥ dhanāni saḥ naḥ hiraṇya-ratham daṁsanāvān saḥ naḥ sanitā sanaye saḥ naḥ adāt
ā aśvinau aśva-vatyā iṣā yātam śavīrayā go--mat dasrā hiraṇya-vat
samāna-yojanaḥ hi vām rathaḥ dasrau amartyaḥ samudre aśvinā īyate
ni aghnyasya mūrdhani cakram rathasya yemathuḥ pari dyām anyat īyate
kaḥ te uṣaḥ kadha-priye bhuje martaḥ amartye kam nakṣase vibhā-vari
vayam hi te amanmahi ā antāt ā parākāt aśve na citre aruṣi
tvam tyebhiḥ ā gahi vājebhiḥ duhitaḥ divaḥ asme iti rayim ni dhāraya
tvam agne prathamāḥ aṅgirā r̥ṣiḥ devaḥ devānām abhavaḥ śivaḥ sakhā tava vrate kavayaḥ vidmanāapasaḥ ajāyanta marutaḥ bhrājat-r̥ṣṭayaḥ
tvam agne prathamaḥ aṅgiraḥ-tamaḥ kaviḥ devānām pari bhūṣasi vratam vi-bhuḥ viśvasmai bhuvanāya medhiraḥ dvi-mātā śayuḥ katidhā cit āyave
tvam agne prathamaḥ mātariśvane āviḥ bhava sukratū-yā vivasvate arejetām rodasī iti hotr̥-vūrye asaghnoḥ bhāram ayajaḥ mahaḥ vaso iti
tvam agne manave dyām avāśayaḥ purūravase su-kr̥te sukr̥t-taraḥ śvātreṇa yat pitroḥ mucyase pari ā tvā pūrvam anayan ā aparam punariti
tvam agne vr̥ṣabhaḥ puṣṭi-vardhanaḥ udyata-sruce bhavasi śravāyyaḥ yaḥ āhutim pari veda vaṣaṭ-kr̥tim eka-āyuḥ agne viśaḥ āvivāsasi
tvam agne vr̥jina-vartanim naram sakman piparṣi vidathe vi-carṣaṇe yaḥ śūra-sātā pari-takmye dhane dabhrebhiḥ cit sam-r̥tā haṁsi bhūyasaḥ
tvam tam agne amr̥ta-tve ut-tame martam dadhāsi śravase dive--dive yaḥ tatr̥ṣāṇaḥ ubhayāya janmane mayaḥ kr̥ṇoṣi prayaḥ ā ca sūraye
tvam naḥ agne sanaye dhanānām yaśasam kārum kr̥ṇuhi stavānaḥ r̥dhyāma karma apasā navena devaiḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti pra avatam naḥ
tvam naḥ agne pitroḥ upa-sthe ā devaḥ deveṣu anavadya jāgr̥viḥ tanū-kr̥t bodhi pra-matiḥ ca kārave tvam kalyāṇa vasu viśvam ā ūpiṣe
tvam agne pra-matiḥ tvam pitā asi naḥ tvam vayaḥ-kr̥t tavajāmayaḥ vayam sam tvā rāyaḥ śatinaḥ sam sahasriṇaḥ suvīram yanti vrata-pām adābhya
tvām agne prathamam āyum āyave devāḥ akr̥ṇvan nahuṣasya viśpatim il̥ām akr̥ṇvan manuṣasya śāsanīm pituḥ yat putraḥ mamakasya jāyate
tvam naḥ agne tava deva pāyu-bhiḥ maghonaḥ rakṣa tanvaḥ ca vandya trātā tokasya tanaye gavām asi ani-meṣam rakṣamāṇaḥ tava vrate
tvam agne yajyave pāyuḥ antaraḥ aniṣaṅgāya catuḥ-akṣaḥ idhyase yaḥ rāta-havyaḥ avr̥kāya dhāyase kīreḥ cit mantram manasā vanoṣi tam
tvam agne uru-śaṁsāya vāghate spārham yat rekṇaḥ paramam vanoṣi tat ādhrasya cit pra-matiḥ ucyase pitā pra pākam śāssi pra diśaḥ viduḥ-ṭaraḥ
tvam agne prayata-dakṣiṇam naram varma-iva syūtam pari pāsi viśvataḥ svādu-kṣadmā yaḥ vasatau syona-kr̥t jīva-yājam yajate saḥ upa-mā divaḥ
imām agne śaraṇim mīmr̥ṣaḥ naḥ imam adhvānam yam agāma dūrāt āpiḥ pitā pra-matiḥ somyānām bhr̥miḥ asi r̥ṣi-kr̥t martyānām
manuṣvat agne aṅgirasvat aṅgiraḥ yayāti-vat sadane pūrva-vat śuce accha yāhi ā vaha daivyam janam ā sādaya barhiṣi yakṣi ca priyam
etena agne brahmaṇā vavr̥dhasva śaktī vā yat te cakr̥ma vidā vā uta pra neṣi abhi vasyaḥ asmān sam naḥ sr̥ja su-matyā vāja-vatyā
indrasya nu vīryāṇi pra vocam yāni cakāra prathamāni vajrī ahan ahim anu apaḥ tatarda pra vakṣaṇāāḥ abhinat parvatānām
ahan ahim parvate śiśriyāṇam tvaṣṭā asmai vajram svaryam tatakṣa vāśrāḥ-iva dhenavaḥ syandamānāḥ añjaḥ samudram ava jagmuḥ āpaḥ
vr̥ṣa-yamāṇaḥ avr̥ṇīta somam tri-kadrukeṣu apibat sutasya ā sāyakam maghavā adatta vajram ahan enam prathama-jām ahīnām
yat indra ahan prathama-jām ahīnām āt māyinām amināḥ pra uta māyāḥ āt sūryam janayan dyām uṣāsam tādītnā śatrum na kilā vivitse
ahan vr̥tram vr̥tra-taram vi-aṁsam indraḥ vajreṇa mahatā vadhena skandhāṁsi-iva kuliśena vi-vr̥kṇā ahiḥ śayate upa-pr̥k pr̥thivyāḥ
ayoddhāiva duḥ-madaḥ ā hi juhve mahāvīram tuvi-bādham r̥jīṣam na tārīt asya sam-r̥tim vadhānām sam rujānāḥ pipiṣe indra-śatruḥ
apāt ahastaḥ apr̥tanyat indram ā asya vajram adhi sānau jaghāna vr̥ṣṇaḥ vadhriḥ prati-mānam bubhūṣan puru-trā vr̥traḥ aśayat vi-astaḥ
nadam na bhinnam amuyā śayānam manaḥ ruhāṇāḥ ati yanti āpaḥ yāḥ cit vr̥traḥ mahinā pari-atiṣṭhat tāsām ahiḥ patsutaḥśīḥ babhūva
nīcāvayāḥ abhavat vr̥tra-putrā indraḥ asyāḥ ava vadhaḥ jabhāra ut-tarā sūḥ adharaḥ putraḥ āsīt dānuḥ śaye saha-vatsā na dhenuḥ
atiṣṭhantīnām ani-veśanānān kāṣṭhānām madhye ni-hitam śarīram vr̥trasya niṇyam vi caranti āpaḥ dīrgham tamaḥ ā aśayat indra-śatruḥ
dāsa-patnīḥ ahi-gopāḥ atiṣṭhan ni-ruddhāḥ āpaḥ paṇināiva gāvaḥ apām bilam api-hitam yat āsīt vr̥tram jaghanvān apa tat vavāra
aśvyaḥ vāraḥ abhavaḥ tat indra sr̥ke yat tvā prati-ahan devaḥ ekaḥ ajayaḥ gāḥ ajayaḥ śūra somam ava asr̥jaḥ sartave sapta sindhūn
na asmai vidyut na tanyatuḥ sisedha na yām miham akirat hrādunim ca indraḥ ca yat yuyudhāteiti ahiḥ ca uta aparībhyaḥ magha-vā vi jigye
aheḥ yātāram kam apaśyaḥ indra hr̥di yat te jaghnuṣaḥ bhīḥ agacchat nava ca yam navatim ca sravantīḥ śyenaḥ na bhītaḥ ataraḥ rajāṁsi
indraḥ yātaḥ ava-sitasya rājā śamasya ca śr̥ṅgiṇaḥ vajra-bāhuḥ saḥ it oṁ iti rājā kṣayati carṣaṇīnām arān na nemiḥ pari tā babhūva
ā ita ayāma upa gavyantaḥ indram asmākam su pra-matim vavr̥dhāti anāmr̥ṇaḥ kuvit āt asya rāyaḥ gavām ketam param āvarjate naḥ
upa it aham dhana-dām aprati-itam juṣṭām na śyenaḥ vasatim patāmi indram namasyan upa-mebhiḥ arkaiḥ yaḥ stotr̥-bhyaḥ havyaḥ asti yāman
ni sarva-senaḥ iṣu-dhīn asakta sam aryaḥ gāḥ ajati yasya vaṣṭi coṣkūyamāṇaḥ indra bhūri vāmam mā paṇiḥ bhūḥ asmat adhi pra-vr̥ddha
vadhīḥ hi dasyum dhaninam ghanena ekaḥ caran upa-śākebhiḥ indra dhanoḥ adhi viṣuṇak te vi āyan ayajvānaḥ sanakāḥ pra-itim īyuḥ
parā cit śīrṣā vavr̥juḥ te indra ayajvānaḥ yajva-bhiḥ spardhamānāḥ pra yat divaḥ hari-vaḥ sthātaḥ ugra niḥ avratān adhamaḥ rodasyoḥ
ayuyutsan anavadyasya senām ayātayanta kṣitayaḥ nava-gvāḥ vr̥ṣa-yudhaḥ na vadhrayaḥ niḥ-aṣṭāḥ pra-vat-bhiḥ indrāt citayantaḥ āyan
tvam etān rudataḥ jakṣataḥ ca ayodhayaḥ rajasaḥ indra pāre ava adahaḥ divaḥ ā dasyum uccā pra sunvataḥ stuvataḥ śaṁsam āvaḥ
cakāṇāsaḥ pari-naham pr̥thivyāḥ hiraṇyena maṇinā śumbhamānāḥ na hinvānāsaḥ titiruḥ te indram pari spaśaḥ adadhāt sūryeṇa
pari yat indra rodasī iti ubhe iti abubhojīḥ mahinā viśvataḥ sīm amanyamānān abhi manyamānaiḥ niḥ brahma-bhiḥ adhamaḥ dasyum indra
na ye divaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ antam āpuḥ na māyābhiḥ dhana-dām pari-abhūvan yujam vajram vr̥ṣabhaḥ cakre indraḥ niḥ jyotiṣā tamasaḥ gāḥ adhukṣat
anu svadhām akṣaran āpaḥ asya avardhata madhye ā nāvyānām sadhrīcīnena manasā tam indraḥ ojiṣṭhena hanmanā ahan abhi dyūn
ni avidhyat ilībiśasya dr̥l̥hā vi śr̥ṅgiṇam abhinat śuṣṇam indraḥ yāvat taraḥ magha-van yāvat ojaḥ vajreṇa śatrum avadhīḥ pr̥tanyum
abhi sidhmaḥ ajigāt asya śatrūn vi tigmena vr̥ṣabheṇa puraḥ abhet sam vajreṇa asr̥jat vr̥tram indraḥ pra svām matim atirat śāśadānaḥ
āvaḥ kutsam indra yasmin cākan pra āvaḥ yudhyantam vr̥ṣabham daśa-dyum śapha-cyutaḥ reṇuḥ nakṣata dyām ut śvaitreyaḥ nr̥-sahyāya tasthau
āvaḥ śamam vr̥ṣabham tugryāsu kṣetra-jeṣe magha-van śvitryam gām jyok cit atra tasthi-vāṁsaḥ akran śatru-yatām adharā vedanā akar ity akaḥ
triḥ cit naḥ adya bhavatam navedasā vi-bhuḥ vām yāmaḥ uta rātiḥ aśvinā yuvoḥ hi yantram himyāiva vāsasaḥ abhi-āyaṁsenyā bhavatam manīṣi-bhiḥ
trayaḥ pavayaḥ madhu-vāhena rathe somasya venām anu viśve it viduḥ trayaḥ skambhāsaḥ skamitāsaḥ ārabhe triḥ naktam yāthaḥ triḥ oṁ iti aśvinā divā
samāne ahan triḥ avadya-gohanā triḥ adya yajñam madhunā mimikṣatam triḥ vājavatīḥ iṣaḥ aśvinā yuvam doṣā asmabhyam uṣasaḥ ca pinvatam
triḥ vartiḥ yātam triḥ anu-vrate jane triḥ supra-avye tredhāiva śikṣatam triḥ nāndyam vahatam aśvinā yuvam triḥ pr̥kṣaḥ asme iti akṣarāiva pinvatam
triḥ naḥ rayim vahatam aśvinā yuvam triḥ devatātā triḥ uta avatam dhiyaḥ triḥ saubhaga-tvam triḥ uta śravāṁsi naḥ triḥ-stham vām sūre duhitā ruhat ratham
iti
triḥ naḥ asvinā yajatā dive--dive pari tri-dhātu pr̥thivīm aśāyatam tisraḥ nāsatyā rathyā parāvataḥ ātmāiva vātaḥ svasarāṇi gacchatam
triḥ āśvinā sindhu-bhiḥ saptamātr̥-bhiḥ trayaḥ āhāvāḥ tredhā haviḥ kr̥tam tisraḥ pr̥thivīḥ upari pravā divaḥ nākam rakṣetheiti dyu-bhiḥ aktu-bhiḥ hitam
kva trī cakrā tri-vr̥taḥ rathasya kva trayaḥ vandhuraḥ ye sa-nīl̥āḥ kadā yogaḥ vājinaḥ rāsabhasya yena yajñam nāsatyā upa-yāthaḥ
ā nāsatyā gacchatam hūyate haviḥ madhvaḥ pibatam madhu-pebhiḥ āsa-bhiḥ yuvoḥ hi pūrvam savitā uṣasaḥ ratham r̥tāya citram ghr̥ta-vantam iṣyati
ā nāsatyā tribhiḥ ekādaśaiḥ iha devebhiḥ yātam madhu-peyam aśvinā pra āyuḥ tāriṣṭam niḥ rapāṁsi mr̥kṣatam sedhatam dveṣaḥ bhavatam sacābhuvā
ā naḥ aśvinā tri-vr̥tā rathena arvāñcam rayim vahatam su-vīram śr̥ṇvantā vām avase johavīmi vr̥dhe ca naḥ bhavatam vāja-sātau
hvayāmi agnim prathamam svastaye hvayāmi mitrāvaruṇau iha avase hvayāmi rātrīm jagataḥ niveśanīm hvayāmi devam savitāram ūtaye
ā kr̥ṣṇena rajasā vartamānaḥ ni-veśayan amr̥tam martyam ca hiraṇyayena savitā rathena ā devaḥ yāti bhuvanāni paśyan
yāti devaḥ pra-vatā yāti ut-vatā yāti śubhrābhyām yajataḥ hari-bhyām ā devaḥ yāti savitā parāvataḥ apa viśvā duḥ-itā bādhamānaḥ
abhi-vr̥tam kr̥śanaiḥ viśva-rūpam hiraṇya-śamyam yajataḥ br̥hantam ā asthāt ratham savitā citra-bhānuḥ kr̥ṣṇā rajāṁsi taviṣīm dadhānaḥ
vi janān śyāvāḥ śiti-pādaḥ akhyan ratham hiraṇya-pra-ugam vahantaḥ śaśvat viśaḥ savituḥ daivyasya upa-sthe viśvā bhuvanāni tasthuḥ
tisraḥ dyāvaḥ savituḥ dvau upa-sthā ekā yamasya bhuvane virāṣāṭ āṇim na rathyam amr̥tā adhi tasthuḥ iha bravītu yaḥ oṁ iti tat ciketat
vi su-parṇaḥ antarikṣāṇi akhyat gabhīra-vepāḥ asuraḥ su-nīthaḥ kva idānīm sūryaḥ kaḥ ciketa katamām dyām raśmiḥ asya ā tatāna
aṣṭau vi akhyat kakubhaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ trī dhanva yojanā sapta sindhūn hiraṇya-akṣaḥ savitā devaḥ ā agāt dadhat ratnā dāśuṣe vāryāṇi
hiraṇya-pāṇiḥ savitā vi-carṣaṇiḥ ubhe iti dyāvāpr̥thivī iti antaḥ īyate apa amīvām bādhate veti sūryam abhi kr̥ṣṇena rajasā dyām r̥ṇoti
hiraṇya-hastaḥ asuraḥ su-nīthaḥ su-mr̥l̥īkaḥ sva-vān yātu arvāṅ apa-sedham rakṣasaḥ yātu-dhānān asthāt devaḥ prati-doṣam gr̥ṇānaḥ
ye te panthāḥ savitariti pūrvyāsaḥ areṇavaḥ su-kr̥tāḥ antarikṣe tebhiḥ naḥ adya pathi-bhiḥ su-gebhiḥ rakṣa ca naḥ adhi ca brūhi deva
pra vaḥ yahvam purūṇām viśām deva-yatīnām agnim su-uktebhiḥ vacaḥ-bhiḥ īmahe yam sīm it anye īl̥ate
janāsaḥ agnim dadhire sahaḥ-vr̥dham haviṣmantaḥ vidhema te saḥ tvam naḥ adya su-manāḥ iha avitā bhava vājeṣu santya
pra tvā dūtam vr̥ṇīmahe hotāram viśva-vedasam mahaḥ te sataḥ vi caranti arcayaḥ divi spr̥śanti bhānavaḥ
devāsaḥ tvā varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā sam dūtam pratnam indhate viśvam saḥ agne jayati tvayā dhanam yaḥ te dadāśa martyaḥ
mandraḥ hotā gr̥ha-patiḥ agne dūtaḥ viśām asi tve iti viśvā sam-gatāni vratā dhruvā yāni devāḥ akr̥ṇvata
tve it agne subhage yaviṣṭhya viśvam ā hūyate haviḥ saḥ tvam naḥ adya su-manāḥ uta aparam yakṣi devān su-vīryā
tam gha īm itthā namasvinaḥ upa sva-rājam āsate hotrābhiḥ agnim manuṣaḥ sam indhate titirvāṁsaḥ ati sridhaḥ
ghnantaḥ vr̥tram ataran rodasī iti apaḥ uru kṣayāya cakrire bhuvat kaṇve vr̥ṣā dyumnī āhutaḥ krandat aśvaḥ go--iṣṭiṣu
sam sīdasva mahān asi śocasva deva-vītamaḥ vi dhūmam agne aruṣam miyedhya sr̥ja pra-śasta darsatam
yam tvā devāsaḥ manave dadhuḥ iha yajiṣṭham havya-vāhana yam kaṇvaḥ medhya-atithiḥ dhana-spr̥tam yam vr̥ṣā yam upa-stutaḥ
yam agnim medhya-atithiḥ kaṇvaḥ īghe r̥tāt adhi tasya pra iṣaḥ dīdiyuḥ tam imāḥ r̥caḥ tam agnim vardhayāmasi
rāyaḥ pūrdhi svadhā-vaḥ asti hi te agne deveṣu āpyam tvam vājasya śrutyasya rājasi saḥ naḥ mr̥l̥ha mahān asi
ūrdhvaḥ oṁ iti su naḥ ūtaye tiṣṭha devaḥ na savitā ūrdhvaḥ vājasya sanitā yat añji-bhiḥ vāghat-bhiḥ vi-hvayāmahe
ūrdhvaḥ naḥ pāhi aṁhasaḥ ni ketunā viśvam sam itriṇam daha kr̥dhi naḥ ūrdhvān carathāya jīvase vidāḥ deveṣu naḥ duvaḥ
pāhi naḥ agne rakṣasaḥ pāhi dhūrteḥ arāvṇaḥ pāhi riṣataḥ uta vā jighāṁsataḥ br̥hadbhāno itibr̥hat-bhāno yaviṣṭhya
ghanāiva viṣvak vi jahi arāvṇaḥ tapuḥ-jambha yaḥ asma-dhruk yaḥ martyaḥ śiśīte ati aktu-bhiḥ mā naḥ saḥ ripuḥ īśata
agniḥ vavne su-vīryam agniḥ kaṇvāya saubhagam agniḥ pra āvat mitrā uta medhya-atithim agniḥ sātau upa-stutam
agninā turvaśam yadum parāvataḥ ugra-devam havāmahe agniḥ nayat nava-vāstvam br̥hat-ratham turvītim dasyave sahaḥ
ni tvām agne manuḥ dadhe jyotiḥ janāya śaśvate dīdetha kaṇve r̥ta-jātaḥ ukṣitaḥ yam namasyanti kr̥ṣṭayaḥ
tveṣāsaḥ agneḥ ama-vantaḥ arcayaḥ bhīmāsaḥ na prati-itaye rakṣasvinaḥ sadam it yātu-māvataḥ viśvam sam atriṇam daha
krīl̥am vaḥ śardhaḥ mārutam anarvāṇam rathe--śubham kaṇvāḥ abhi pra gāyata
ye pr̥ṣatībhiḥ r̥ṣṭi-bhiḥ sākam vāśībhiḥ añji-bhiḥ ajāyanta sva-bhānavaḥ
iha-iva śr̥ṇva eṣām kaśāḥ hasteṣu yat vadān ni yāman citram r̥ñjate
pra vaḥ śardhāya ghr̥ṣvaye tveṣa-dyumnāya śuṣmiṇe devattam brahma gāyata
pra śaṁsa goṣu aghnyam krīl̥am yat śardhaḥ mārutam jambhe rasasya vavr̥dhe
kaḥ vaḥ varṣiṣṭhaḥ ā naraḥ divaḥ ca gmaḥ ca dhūtayaḥ yat sīm antam na dhūnutha
ni vaḥ yāmāya mānuṣaḥ dadhre ugrāya manyave jihīta parvataḥ giriḥ
yeṣām ajmeṣu pr̥thivī jujurvān-iva viśpatiḥ bhiyā yāmeṣu rejate
sthiram hi jānam eṣām vayaḥ mātuḥ niḥ-etave yat sīm anu dvitā śavaḥ
ut oṁ iti tye sūnavaḥ giraḥ kāṣṭhāḥ ajmeṣu atnata vāśrāḥ abhi-jñu yātave
tyam cit gha dīrgham pr̥thum mihaḥ napātam amr̥dhram pra cyavayanti yāma-bhiḥ
marutaḥ yat ha vaḥ balam janān acucyavītana girīn acucyavītana
yat ha yānti marutaḥ sam ha bruvate adhvan ā śr̥ṇoti kaḥ cit eṣām
pra yāta śībham āśubhiḥ santi kaṇveṣu vaḥ duvaḥ tatro iti su mādayādhvai
asti hi sma madāya vaḥ smasi sma vayam eṣām viśvam cit āyuḥ jīvase
kat ha nūnam kadha-priyaḥ pitā putram na hastayoḥ dadhidhve vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ
kva nūnam kat vaḥ artham gantā divaḥ na pr̥thivyāḥ kva vaḥ gāvaḥ na raṇyanti
kva vaḥ sumnā navyāṁsi marutaḥ kva suvitā kva viśvāni saubhagā
yat yūyam pr̥śni-mātaraḥ martāsaḥ syātana stotā vaḥ amr̥taḥ syāt
mā vaḥ mr̥gaḥ na yavase jaritā bhūt ajoṣyaḥ pathā yamasya gāt upa
mo iti su ṇaḥ parāparā niḥ-r̥tiḥ duḥ-hanā vadhīt padīṣṭa tr̥ṣṇayā saha
satyam tveṣāḥ ama-vantaḥ dhanvam cit ā rudriyāsaḥ miham kr̥ṇvanti avātām
vāśrāiva vi-dyut mimāti vatsam na mātā siṣakti yat eṣām vr̥ṣṭiḥ asarji
divā cit tamaḥ kr̥ṇvanti parjanyena uda-vāhena yat pr̥thivīm vi-undanti
adha svanāt marutām viśvam ā sadma pārthivam arejanta pra mānuṣāḥ
marutaḥ vīl̥upāṇi-bhiḥ citrāḥ rodhasvatīḥ anu yāta īm akhidrayāma-bhiḥ
sthirāḥ vaḥ santu nemayaḥ rathāḥ aśvāsaḥ eṣām su-saṁskr̥tāḥ abhīśavaḥ
accha vada tanā girā jarāyai brahmaṇaḥ patim agnim mitram na darśatam
mimīhi ślokam āsye parjanyaḥ-iva tatanaḥ gāya gāyatram ukthyam
vandasva mārutam gaṇam tveṣam panasyum arkiṇam asme iti vr̥ddhāḥ asan iha
pra yat itthā parāvataḥ śociḥ na mānam asyatha kasya kratvā marutaḥ kasya varpasā kam yātha kam ha dhūtayaḥ
sthirā vaḥ santu āyudhā parānude vīl̥u uta prati-skabhe yuṣmākam astu taviṣī panīyasī mā martyasya māyinaḥ
parā ha yat sthiram hatha naraḥ vartayatha guru vi yāthana vaninaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ vi āśāḥ parvatānām
nahi vaḥ śatruḥ vivide adhi dyavi na bhūmyām riśādasaḥ yuṣmākam astu taviṣī tanā yujā rudrāsaḥ nu cit ādhr̥ṣe
pra vepayanti parvatān vi viñcanti vanaspatīn pro iti ārata marutaḥ durmadāḥ-iva devāsaḥ sarvayā viśā
upo iti ratheṣu pr̥ṣatīḥ ayugdhvam praṣṭiḥ vahati rohitaḥ ā vaḥ yāmāya pr̥thivī cit aśrot abībhayanta mānuṣāḥ
ā vaḥ makṣu tanāya kam rudrāḥ avaḥ vr̥ṇīmahe ganta nūnam naḥ avas yathā purā itthā kaṇvāya bibhyuṣe
yuṣmāiṣitaḥ marutaḥ martya-iṣitaḥ ā yaḥ naḥ abhvaḥ īṣate vi tam yuyota śavasā vi ojasā vi yuṣmākābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ
asāmi hi pra-yajyavaḥ kaṇvam dr̥ pra-cetasaḥ asāmi-bhiḥ marutaḥ ā naḥ ūti-bhiḥ ganta vr̥ṣṭim na vi-dyutaḥ
asāmi ojaḥ bibhr̥tha su-dānavaḥ asāmi dhūtayaḥ śavaḥ r̥ṣi-dviṣe marutaḥ pari-manyave iṣum na sr̥jata dviṣam
ut tiṣṭha brahmaṇaḥ pate deva-yantaḥ tvā īmahe upa pra yantu marutaḥ su-dānavaḥ indra prāsūḥ bhava sacā
tvām it hi sahasaḥ putra martyaḥ upa-brūte dhane hite su-vīryam marutaḥ ā su-aśvyam dadhīta yaḥ vaḥ ācakre
pra etu brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ pra devī etu sūnr̥tā accha vīram naryam paṅkti-rādhasam devāḥ yajñam nayantu naḥ
yaḥ vāghate dadāti sūnaram vasu saḥ dhatte akṣiti śravaḥ tasmai il̥ām su-vīrām ā yajāmahe su-pratūrtim anehasam
pra nūnam brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ mantram vadati ukthyam yasmin indraḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā devāḥ okāṁsi cakrire
tam it vocema vidatheṣu śambhuvam mantram devāḥ anehasam imām ca vācam prati-haryatha naraḥ viśvā it vāmā vaḥ aśnavat
kaḥ deva-yantam aśnavat janam kaḥ vr̥kta-barhiṣam pra-pra dāśvān pastyābhiḥ asthita antaḥ-vāvat kṣayam dadhe
upa kṣatram pr̥ñcīta hanti rāja-bhiḥ bhaye cit su-kṣitim dadhe na asya vartā na tarutā mahādhane na arbhe asti vajriṇaḥ
yam rakṣanti pra-cetasaḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā nu cit saḥ dabhyate janaḥ
yam bāhutāiva piprati pānti martyam riṣaḥ ariṣṭaḥ sarvaḥ edhate
vi duḥ-gā vi dviṣaḥ puraḥ ghnanti rājānaḥ eṣām nayanti duḥ-itā tiraḥ
su-gaḥ panthā anr̥kṣaraḥ ādityāsaḥ r̥tam yate na atra ava-khādaḥ asti vaḥ
yam yajñam nayatha naraḥ ādityāḥ r̥junā pathā pra vaḥ saḥ dhītaye naśat
saḥ ratnam martyaḥ vasu viśvam tokam uta tmanā accha gacchati astr̥taḥ
kathā rādhāma sakhāyaḥ stomam mitrasya aryamṇaḥ mahi psaraḥ varuṇasya
mā vaḥ ghnantam mā śapantam prati voce deva-yantam sumnaiḥ it vaḥ ā vivāse
caturaḥ cit dadamānāt bibhīyāt ā ni-dhātoḥ na duḥ-uktāya spr̥hayet
sam pūṣan adhvanaḥ tira vi aṁhaḥ vi-mucaḥ napāt sakṣva deva pra naḥ puraḥ
yaḥ naḥ pūṣan aghaḥ vr̥kaḥ duḥśeva ādideśati apa sma tam pathaḥ jahi
apa tyam pari-panthinam muṣīvāṇam huraḥ-citam dūram adhi sruteḥ aja
tvam tasya dvayāvinaḥ agha-saṁsasya kasya cit padā abhi tiṣṭha tapuṣim
ā tat te dasra mantu-maḥ pūṣan avaḥ vr̥ṇīmahe yena pitr̥r̥n acodayaḥ
adhaḥ naḥ viśva-saubhaga hiraṇyavāśīmat-tama dhanāni su-sanā kr̥dhi
ati naḥ saścataḥ naya su-gā naḥ su-pathā kr̥ṇu pūṣan iha kratum vidaḥ
abhi su-yavasam naya na nava-jvāraḥ adhvane pūṣan iha kratum vidaḥ
śagdhi pūrdhi pra yaṁsi ca śiśīhi prāsi udaram pūṣan iha kratum vidaḥ
na pūṣaṇam methāmasi sūktaiḥ abhi gr̥ṇīmasi vasūni dasmam īmahe
kat rudrāya pra-cetase mīl̥huḥ-tamāya tavyase vocema śam-tamam hr̥de
yathā naḥ aditiḥ karat paśve nr̥-bhyaḥ yathā gave yathā tokāya rudriyam
yathā naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ yathā rudraḥ ciketati yathā viśve sa-joṣasaḥ
gātha-patim medha-patim rudram jalāṣa-bheṣajam tat śam-yoḥ sumnam īmahe
yaḥ śukraḥ-iva sūryaḥ hiraṇyam-iva rocate śreṣṭhaḥ devānām vasuḥ
śan naḥ karati arvate su-gam meṣāya meṣye nr̥-bhyaḥ nāri-bhyaḥ gave
asme iti soma śriyam adhi ni dhehi śatasya nr̥ṇām mahi śravaḥ tuvi-nr̥mṇam
mā naḥ soma-paribādhaḥ mā arātayaḥ juhuranta ā naḥ indo iti vāje bhaja
yāḥ te pra-jāḥ amr̥tasya parasmin dhāman r̥tasya mūrdhā nābhā soma venaḥ ābhūṣantīḥ soma vedaḥ
agne vivasvat uṣasaḥ citram rādhaḥ amartya ā dāśuṣe jāta-vedaḥ vaha tvam adya devām uṣaḥ-budhaḥ
juṣṭaḥ hi dūtaḥ asi havya-vāhanaḥ agne rathīḥ adhvarāṇām sa-jūḥ aśvi-bhyām uṣasā su-vīryam asme iti dhehi śravaḥ br̥hat
adya dūtam vr̥ṇīmahe vasum agnim puru-priyam dhūma-ketum bhāḥ-r̥jīkam vi-uṣṭiṣu yajñānām adhvara-śriyam
śreṣṭham yaviṣṭham atithim su-āhutam juṣṭam janāya dāśuṣe devān accha yātave jāta-vedasam agnim īl̥e vi-uṣṭiṣu
staviṣyāmi tvām aham viśvasya amr̥ta bhojana agne trātāram amr̥tam miyedhya yajiṣṭham havya-vāhana
suśaṁsaḥ bodhi gr̥ṇate yaviṣṭhya madhu-jihvaḥ su-āhutaḥ praskaṇvasya pra-tiran āyuḥ jīvase namasya daivyam janam
hotāram viśva-vedasam sam hi tvā viśaḥ indhate saḥ ā vaha puru-hūta pra-cetasaḥ agne devān iha dravat
savitāram uṣasam aśvinā bhagam agnim vi-uṣṭiṣu kṣapaḥ kaṇvāsaḥ tvā suta-somāsaḥ indhate havya-vāham su-adhvara
patiḥ hi adhvarāṇām agne dūtaḥ viśām asi uṣaḥ-budhaḥ ā vaha soma-pītaye devān adya svaḥ-dr̥śaḥ
agne pūrvāḥ anu uṣasaḥ vibhāvaso itivibhāvaso dīdetha viśva-darśataḥ asi grāmeṣu avitā puraḥ-hitaḥ asi yajñeṣu mānuṣaḥ
ni tvā yajñasya sādhanam agne hotāram r̥tvijam manuṣvat deva dhīmahi pra-cetasam jīram dūtam amartyam
yat devānām mitra-mahaḥ puraḥ-hitaḥ antaraḥ yāsi dūtyam sindhoḥ-iva pra-svanitāsaḥ ūrmayaḥ agneḥ bhrājante arcayaḥ
śrudhi śrut-karṇa vahni-bhiḥ devaiḥ agne sayāva-bhiḥ ā sīdantu barhiṣi mitraḥ aryamā prātaḥ-yāvānaḥ adhvaram
śr̥ṇvantu somam marutaḥ su-dānavaḥ agni-jihvāḥ r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ pibatu somam varuṇaḥ dhr̥ta-vrataḥ aśvi-bhyām uṣasā sa-jūḥ
tvam agne vasūn iha rudrān ādityān uta yaja su-adhvaram janam manu-jātam ghr̥ta-pruṣam
śruṣṭī-vānaḥ hi dāśuṣe devāḥ agne vicetasaḥ tān rohit-aśva girvaṇaḥ trayaḥ-triṁśatam ā vaha
priyamedha-vat atri-vat jāta-vedaḥ virūpa-vat aṅgirasvat mahi-vrata praskaṇvasya śrudhi havam
mahi-keravaḥ ūtaye priya-medhāḥ ahūṣata rājantam adhvarāṇām agnim śukreṇa śociṣā
ghr̥ta-āhavana santya imāḥ oṁ iti su śrudhi giraḥ yābhiḥ kaṇvasya sūnavaḥ havante avase tvā
tvām citraśravaḥ-tama havante vikṣu jantavaḥ śociḥ-keśam puru-priya agne havyāya vol̥have
ni tvā hotāram r̥tvijam dadhire vasuvit-tamam śrut-karṇam saprathaḥ-tamam viprāḥ agne diviṣṭiṣu
ā tvā viprāḥ acucyavuḥ suta-somāḥ abhi prayaḥ br̥hat bhāḥ bibhrataḥ haviḥ agne martāya dāśuṣe
prātaḥ-yāvnaḥ sahaḥ-kr̥ta soma-peyāya santya iha adya daivyam janam barhiḥ ā sādaya vaso iti
arvāñcam daivyam janam agne yakṣva sahūti-bhiḥ ayam somaḥ su-dānavaḥ tam pāta tiraḥ-ahnyam
eṣo iti uṣāḥ apūrvyā vi ucchati priyā divaḥ stuṣe vām aśvinā br̥hat
yā dasrā sindhu-mātarā manotarā rayīṇām dhiyā devā vasu-vidā
vacyante vām kakuhāsaḥ jūrṇāyām adhi viṣṭapi yat vām rathaḥ vi-bhiḥ patāt
haviṣā jāraḥ apām piparti papuriḥ narā pitā kuṭasya carṣaṇiḥ
ādāraḥ vām matīnām nāsatyā mata-vacasā pātam somasya dhr̥ṣṇu-yā
yā naḥ pīparat aśvinā jyotiṣmatī tamaḥ tiraḥ tām asme iti rāsāthām iṣam
ā naḥ nāvā matīnām yātam pārāya gantave yuñjāthām aśvinā ratham
aritram vām divaḥ pr̥thu tīrthe sindhūnām rathaḥ dhiyā yuyujre indavaḥ
divaḥ kaṇvāsaḥ indavaḥ vasu sindhūnām pade svam vavrim kuha dhitsathaḥ
abhūt oṁ iti bhāḥ oṁ iti aṁśave hiraṇyam prati sūryaḥ vi akhyat jihvayā asitaḥ
abhūt oṁ iti pāram etave panthā r̥tasya sādhu-yā adarśi vi srutiḥ divaḥ
tat-tat it aśvinoḥ avaḥ jaritā prati bhūṣati made somasya pipratoḥ
vāvasānā vivasvati somasya pītyā girā manuṣvat śambhūitiśam-bhū ā gatam
yuvoḥ uṣāḥ anu śriyam pari-jmanoḥ upa-ācarat r̥tā vanathaḥ aktu-bhiḥ
ubhā pibatam aśvinā ubhā naḥ śarma yacchatam avidriyābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ
ayam vām madhumat-tamaḥ sutaḥ somaḥ r̥ta-vr̥dhā tam aśvinā pibatam tiraḥ-ahnyam dhattam ratnāni dāśuṣe
tri-vandhureṇa tri-vr̥tā su-peśasā rathena ā yātam aśvinā kaṇvāsaḥ vām brahma kr̥ṇvanti adhvare teṣām su śr̥ṇutam havam
aśvinā madhumat-tamam pātam somam r̥ta-vr̥dhā atha adya dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe dāsvāṁsam upa gacchatam
triṣ-sadhasthe barhiṣi viśva-vedasā madhvā yajñam mimikṣatam kaṇvāsaḥ vām suta-somāḥ abhi-dyavaḥ yuvām havante aśvinā
yābhiḥ kaṇvam abhiṣṭi-bhiḥ pra āvatam yuvam aśvinā tābhiḥ su asmān avatam śubhaḥ patī iti pātam somam r̥ta-vr̥dhā
su-dāse dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe pr̥kṣaḥ vahatam aśvinā rayim samudrāt uta vā divaḥ pari asme iti dhattam puru-spr̥ham
yat nāsatyā parāvati yat vā sthaḥ adhi turvaśe ataḥ rathena su-vr̥tā naḥ ā gatam sākam sūryasya raśmi-bhiḥ
arvāñcā vām saptayaḥ adhvara-śriyaḥ vahantu savanā it upa iṣam pr̥ñcantā su-kr̥te su-dānave ā barhiḥ sidatam narā
tena nāsatyā ā gatam rathena sūrya-tvacā yena śaśvat ūhathuḥ dāśuṣe vasu madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
ukthebhiḥ arvāk avase puruvasūitipuru-vasū arkaiḥ ca ni hvayāmahe śaśvat kaṇvānām sadasi priye hi kam somam papathuḥ aśvinā
saha vāmena naḥ uṣaḥ vi uccha duhitaḥ divaḥ saha dyumnena br̥hatā vibhāvari rāyā devi dāsvatī
aśva-vatīḥ go--matīḥ viśva-suvidaḥ bhūri cyavanta vastave ut īraya prati mā sūnr̥tāḥ uṣaḥ coda rādhaḥ maghonām
uvāsa uṣāḥ ucchāt ca nu devī jīrā rathānām ye asyāḥ ācaraṇeṣu dadhrire samudre na śravasyavaḥ
uṣaḥ ye te pra yāmeṣu yuñjate manaḥ dānāya sūrayaḥ atra aha tat kaṇvaḥ eṣām kaṇva-tamaḥ nāma gr̥ṇāti nr̥ṇām
ā gha yoṣāiva sūnarī uṣāḥ yāti pra-bhuñjatī jarayantī vr̥janam pat-vat īyate ut pātayati pakṣiṇaḥ
vi yā sr̥jati samanam vi arthinaḥ padam na veti odatī vayaḥ naki ḥ te paptivāṁsaḥ āsatevi-uṣṭau vājinī-vati
eṣā ayukta parāvataḥ sūryasya ut-ayanāt adhi śatam rathebhiḥ su-bhagā uṣāḥ iyam vi yāti abhi mānuṣān
viśvam asyāḥ nanāma cakṣase jagat jyotiḥ kr̥ṇoti sūnarī apa dveṣaḥ maghonī divaḥ uṣāḥ ucchat apa sridhaḥ
uṣaḥ ā bhāhi bhānunā candreṇa duhitaḥ divaḥ āvahantī bhūri asmabhyam saubhagam vi-ucchantī diviṣṭiṣu
viśvasya hi prāṇanam jīvanam tve iti vi yat ucchasi sūnari sā naḥ rathena br̥hatā vibhāvari śrudhi citra-maghe havam
uṣaḥ vājam hi vaṁsva yaḥ citraḥ mānuṣe jane tena ā vaha su-kr̥taḥ adhvarān upa ye tvā gr̥ṇanti vahnayaḥ
viśvān devān ā vaha soma-pītaye antarikṣāt uṣaḥ tvam sā asmāsu ghāḥ go--mat aśva-vat ukthyam uṣaḥ vājam su-vīryam
yasyāḥ ruśantaḥ arcayaḥ prati bhadrāḥ adr̥kṣata sā naḥ rayim v iśva-vāram su-peśasam uṣāḥ dadātu sugmyam
ye cit hi tvām r̥ṣayaḥ pūrve ūtaye juhūre avase mahi sā naḥ stomān abhi gr̥ṇīhi rādhasā uṣaḥ śukreṇa śociṣā
uṣaḥ yat adya bhānunā vi dvārau r̥ṇavaḥ divaḥ pra naḥ yacchatāt avr̥kam pr̥thu chardiḥ pra devi go--matīḥ iṣaḥ
sam naḥ rāyā br̥hatā viśva-peśasā mimikṣva sam il̥ābhiḥ ā sam dyumnena viśva-turā uṣaḥ mahi sam vājaiḥ vājinī-vati
uṣaḥ bhadrebhiḥ ā gahi divaḥ cit rocanāt adhi vahantu aruṇa-psavaḥ upa tvā sominaḥ gr̥ham
su-peśasam sukham ratham yam adhi-asthāḥ uṣaḥ tvam tena su-śravasam janam pra ava adya duhitaḥ divaḥ
vayaḥ cit te patatriṇaḥ dvipat catuḥ-pat arjuni uṣaḥ pra āran r̥tūn anu divaḥ antebhyaḥ pari
vyi-ucchantī hi raśmi-bhiḥ viśvam ābhāsi rocanam tām tvām uṣaḥ vasu-yavaḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ kaṇvāḥ ahūṣata
ut oṁ iti tyam jāta-vedasam devam vahanti ketavaḥ dr̥śe viśvāya sūryam
apa tye tāyavaḥ yathā nakṣatrā yanti aktu-bhiḥ sūrāya viśva-cakṣase
adr̥śram asya ketavaḥ vi raśmayaḥ janān anu bhrājantaḥ agnayaḥ yathā
taraṇiḥ viśva-darśataḥ jyotiḥ-kr̥t asi sūrya viśvam ā bhāsi rocanam
pratyaṅ devānām viśaḥ pratyaṅ ut eṣi mānuṣān pratyaṅ viśvam svaḥ dr̥śe
yena pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantam janān anu tvam varuṇa paśyasi
vi dyām eṣi rajaḥ pr̥thu ahā mimānaḥ aktu-bhiḥ paśyan janmāni sūyar
sapta tvā haritaḥ rathe vahanti deva sūrya śociḥ-keśam vi-cakṣaṇa
ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūraḥ rathasya naptyaḥ tābhiḥ yāti svayukti-bhiḥ
ut vayam tamasaḥ pari jyotiḥ paśyantaḥ ut-taram devam deva-trā sūryam aganma jyotiḥ ut-tamam
ut-yan adya mitra-mahaḥ ārohan ut-tarām divam hr̥t-rogam mama sūrya harimāṇam ca nāśaya
śukeṣu me harimāṇam ropaṇākāsu dadhmasi atho iti hāridraveṣu me harimāṇam ni dadhmasi
ut agāt ayam ādityaḥ viśvena sahasā saha dviṣantam mahyam randhayan mo iti aham dviṣate radham
abhi tyam meṣam puru-hūtam r̥gmiyam indram gīḥ-bhiḥ madata vasvaḥ arṇavam yasya dyāvaḥ na vi-caranti mānuṣā bhuje maṁhiṣṭham abhi vipram arcata
abhi īm avanvan su-abhiṣṭim ūtayaḥ antarikṣa-prām taviṣībhiḥ āvr̥tam indram dakṣāsaḥ r̥bhavaḥ mada-cyutam śata-kratum javanī sūnr̥tā ā aruhat
tvam gotram aṅgiraḥ-bhyaḥ avr̥ṇoḥ apa uta atraye śata-dureṣu gātu-vit sasena cit vi-madāya avahaḥ vasu ājau adrim vavasānasya nataryan
tvam apām api-dhānā avr̥ṇoḥ apa adhāraya parvate dānu-mat vasu vr̥tram yat indra śavasā avadhīḥ ahim āt it sūryam divi ā arohayaḥ dr̥śe
tvam māyābhiḥ apa māyinaḥ adhamaḥ svadhābhiḥ ye adhi śuptau ajuhvata tvam piproḥ nr̥-manaḥ pra arujaḥ puraḥ pra r̥jiścānam dasyu-hatyeṣu āvitha
tvam kutsam śuṣṇa-hatyeṣu āvitha arandhayaḥ atithi-gvāya śambaram mahāntam cit arbudam ni kramīḥ padā sanāt eva dasyu-hatyāya jajñiṣe
tve iti viśvā taviṣī sadhryak hitā tava rādhaḥ soma-pīthāya harṣate tava vajraḥ cikite bāhvoḥ hitaḥ vr̥śca śatroḥ ava viśvāni vr̥ṣṇyā
vi jānīhi āryān ye ca dasyavaḥ barhiṣmate randhaya śāsat avratān śākī bhava yajamānasya coditā viśvā it tā te sadha-mādeṣu cākana
anu-vratāya randhayan apa-vratān ābhūbhiḥ indraḥ śnathayan anābhuvaḥ vr̥ddhasya cit vardhataḥ dyām inakṣataḥ stavānaḥ vamraḥ vi jaghāna sam-dihaḥ
takṣat yat te uśanā sahasā sahaḥ vi rodasī iti majmanā bādhate śavaḥ ā tvā vātasya nr̥-manaḥ manaḥ-yujaḥ ā pūryamāṇam avahan abhi śravaḥ
mandiṣṭa yat uśane kāvye sacā indraḥ vaṅkūiti vaṅku-tarā adhi tiṣṭhat i ugraḥ yayim niḥ apaḥ srotasā asr̥jat vi śuṣṇasya dr̥ṁhitāḥ airayat puraḥ
ā sma ratham vr̥ṣa-pāneṣu tiṣṭhasi śāryātasya pra-bhr̥tāḥ yeṣu mandase indra yathā suta-someṣu cākanaḥ anarvāṇam ślokam ā rohase divi
adadāḥ arbhām mahate vacasyave kakṣīvate vr̥cayām indra sunvate menā abhavaḥ vr̥ṣaṇaśvasya sukrato itisu-krato viśvā it tā te savaneṣu pra-vācyā
indraḥ aśrāyi su-dhyaḥ nireke pajreṣu stomaḥ duryaḥ na yūpaḥ aśva-yuḥ gavyuḥ ratha-yuḥ vasu-yuḥ indraḥ it rāyaḥ kṣayati pra-yantā
idam namaḥ vr̥ṣabhāya sva-rāje satya-śuṣmāya tavase avāci asmin indra vr̥jane sarva-vīrāḥ smat sūri-bhiḥ tava śarman syāma
tyam su meṣam mahaya svaḥ-vidam śatam yasya su-bhvaḥ sākam īrate atyam na vājam havana-syadam ratham ā indram vavr̥tyām avase suvr̥kti-bhiḥ
saḥ parvataḥ na dharuṇeṣu acyutaḥ sahasram-ūtiḥ taviṣīṣu vavr̥dhe indraḥ yat vr̥tram avadhīt nadī-vr̥tam ubjan arṇāṁsi jarhr̥ṣāṇaḥ andhasā
saḥ hi dvaraḥ dvariṣu vavraḥ ūdhani candra-budhnaḥ mada-vr̥ddhaḥ manīṣi-bhiḥ indram tam ahve su-apasyayā dhiyā maṁhiṣṭha-rātim saḥ hi papriḥ andhasaḥ
ā yam pr̥ṇanti divi sadma-barhiṣaḥ samudram na su-bhvaḥ svāḥ abhiṣṭayaḥ tam vr̥tra-hatye anu tasthuḥ ūtayaḥ śuṣmāḥ indram avātāḥ ahruta-psavaḥ
abhi sva-vr̥ṣtim made asya yudhyataḥ raghvīḥ-iva pravaṇe sasruḥ ūtayaḥ indraḥ yat vajrī dhr̥ṣamāṇaḥ andhasā bhinat valasya paridhīn-iva tritaḥ
pari īm ghr̥ṇā carati titviṣe śavaḥ apaḥ vr̥tvī rajasaḥ budhnam ā aśayat vr̥trasya yat pravaṇe duḥ-gr̥bhiśvanaḥ ni-jaghantha hanvoḥ indra tanyatum
hradam na hi tvā ni-r̥ṣanti ūrmayaḥ brahmāṇi indra tava yāni vardhanā tvaṣṭā cit te yujyam vavr̥dhe śavaḥ tatakṣa vajram abhibhūti--ojasam
jaghanvān oṁ iti hari-bhiḥ sambhr̥takrato itisambhr̥ta-krato indra vr̥tram manuṣe gātu-yan apaḥ ayacchathāḥ bāhvoḥ vajram āyasam adhārayaḥ divi ā sūryam dr̥śe
br̥hat sva-candram ama-vat yat ukthyam akr̥ṇvata bhiyasā rohaṇam di vaḥ yat mānuṣa-pradhanāḥ indram ūtayaḥ svaḥ nr̥-ṣācaḥ marutaḥ amadan anu
dyauḥ cit asya ama-vān aheḥ svanāt ayoyavīt bhiyasā vajraḥ indra te vr̥trasya yat badbadhānasya rodasī iti made sutasya śavasā abhinat śiraḥ
yat it nu indra pr̥thivī daśa-bhujiḥ ahāni viśvā tatananta kr̥ṣṭayaḥ atra aha te magha-van vi-śrutam sahaḥ dyām anu śavasā barhaṇā bhuvat
tvam asya pāre rajasaḥ vi-omanaḥ svabhūti-ojāḥ avase dhr̥ṣat-manaḥ cakr̥ṣe bhūmim prati-mānam ojasaḥ apaḥ [svar iti] svaḥ pari-bhūḥ eṣi ā divam
tvam bhuvaḥ prati-mānam pr̥thivyāḥ r̥ṣva-vīrasya br̥hataḥ patiḥ bhūḥ viśvam ā aprāḥ antarikṣam mahi-tvā satyam addhā nakiḥ anyaḥ tvāvān
na yasya dyāvāpr̥thivī iti anu vyacaḥ na sindhavaḥ rajasaḥ antam ānaśuḥ na uta sva-vr̥ṣṭim made asya yudhyataḥ ekaḥ anyat cakr̥ṣe viśvam ānuṣak
ārcan atra marutaḥ sasmin ājau viśve devāsaḥ amadan anu tvā vr̥trasya yat bhr̥ṣṭi-matā vadhena ni tvam indra prati ānam jaghantha
ni oṁ iti su vācam pra mahe bharāmahe giraḥ indrāya sadane vivasvataḥ nu cit hi ratnam sasatām-iva avidat na duḥ-stutiḥ draviṇaḥ-deṣu śasyate
duraḥ aśvasya duraḥ indra goḥ asi duraḥ yavasya vasunaḥ inaḥ patiḥ śikṣānaraḥ pra-divaḥ akāma-karśanaḥ sakhā sakhi-bhyaḥ tam idam gr̥ṇīmasi
śacī-vaḥ indra puru-kr̥t dyumat-tama tava it idam abhitaḥ cekite vasu ataḥ sam-gr̥bhya abhi-bhūte ā bhara mā tvāyataḥ jarituḥ kāmam ūnayīḥ
ebhiḥ dyubhiḥ su-manāḥ ebhiḥ indu-bhiḥ niḥ-undhānaḥ amatim gobhiḥ aśvinā indreṇa dasyum darayantaḥ indu-bhiḥ yuta-dveṣasaḥ sam iṣā rabhemahi
sam indra rāyā sam iṣā rabhemahi sam vājebhiḥ puru-candraiḥ abhidyu-bhiḥ sam devyā pra-matyā vīra-śuṣmayā go--agrayā aśva-vatyā rabhemahi
te tvā madāḥ amadan tāni vr̥ṣṇyā te somāsaḥ vr̥tra-hatyeṣu sat-pate yat kārave daśa vr̥trāṇi aprati barhiṣmate ni sahasrāṇi barhayaḥ
yudhā yudham upa gha it eṣi dhr̥śṇu-yā purā puram sam idam haṁsi ojasā namyā yat indra sakhyā parāvati ni-barhayaḥ namucm nāma māyinam
tvam karañjam uta parṇayam vadhīḥ tejiṣṭhayā atithi-gvasya vartanī tvam śatā varṅgedasya abhinat puraḥ ananu-daḥ pari-sūtāḥ r̥jiśvanā
tvam etān jana-rājñaḥ dviḥ daśa abandhunā su-śravasā upa-jagmuṣaḥ ṣaṣṭim sahasrā navatim nava śrutaḥ ni cakreṇa rathyā duḥ-padā avr̥ṇak
tvam āvitha su-śravasam tava ūti-bhiḥ tava trāma-bhiḥ indra tūrvayāṇam tvam asmai kutsam atithi-gvam āyum mahe rājñe yūne arandhanāyaḥ
ye ut-r̥ci indra deva-gopāḥ sakhāyaḥ te śiva-tamāḥ asāma tvām stoṣāma tvayā su-vīrāḥ drāghīyaḥ āyuḥ pra-taram dadhānāḥ
mā naḥ asmin maghavan pr̥t-su aṁhasi nahi te antaḥ śavasaḥ pari-naśe akrandayaḥ nadyaḥ roruvat vanā kathā na kṣoṇīḥ bhiyasā sam ārata
arca akrāya śākine śacī-vate śr̥ṇvantam indram mahayan abhi stuhi yaḥ dhr̥ṣṇunā śavasā rodasī iti ubhe iti vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣa-tvā vr̥ṣabhaḥ ni-r̥ñjate
arca dive br̥hate śūṣyam vacaḥ sva-kṣatram yasya dhr̥ṣataḥ dhr̥ṣat manaḥ br̥hat-śravāḥ asuraḥ barhaṇā kr̥taḥ puraḥ hari-bhyām vr̥ṣabhaḥ rathaḥ hi saḥ
tvam divaḥ br̥hataḥ sānu kopayaḥ ava tmanā dhr̥ṣatā śambaram bhinat yat māyinaḥ vrandinaḥ mandinā dhr̥ṣat śitām gabhastim aśanim pr̥tanyasi
ni yat vr̥ṇakṣi śvasanasya mūrdhani śuṣṇasya cit vrandinaḥ roruvat vanā prācīnena manasā barhaṇāvatā yat adya cit kr̥ṇavaḥ kaḥ tvā pari
tvam āvitha naryam turvaśam yadum tvam turvītim vayyam śatakrato itiśata-krato tvam ratham etaśam kr̥tvye dhane tvam puraḥ navatim dambhayaḥ nava
saḥ gha rājā sat-patiḥ śūśuvat janaḥ rāta-havyaḥ prati yaḥ śāsam invati ukthā vā yaḥ abhi-gr̥ṇāti rādhasā dānuḥ asmai uparā pinvate d ivaḥ
asamam kṣatram asamā manīṣā pra soma-pāḥ apasā santu neme ye te indra daduṣaḥ vardhayanti mahi kṣatram sthaviram vr̥ṣṇyam ca
tubhya it ete bahulāḥ adri-dugdhāḥ camū-sadaḥ camasāḥ indra-pānāḥ vi aśnuhi tarpaya kāmam eṣām atha manaḥ vasu-deyāya kr̥ṣva
apām atiṣṭhat dharuṇa-hvaram tamaḥ antaḥ vr̥trasya jaṭhareṣu parvataḥ abhi īm indraḥ nadyaḥ vavriṇā hitāḥ viśvāḥ anu-sthāḥ pravaṇeṣu jighnate
saḥ śe--vr̥dham adhi dhāḥ dyumnam asme iti mahi kṣatram janāṣāṭ indra tavyam rakṣa ca naḥ maghonaḥ pāh i sūrīn rāye ca naḥ su-apatyai iṣe dhāḥ
divaḥ cit asya varimā vi papratha indram na mahnā pr̥thivī cana prati bhīmaḥ tuviṣmān carṣaṇi-bhyaḥ ātapaḥ śiśīte vajram tejase na vaṁsagaḥ
saḥ arṇavaḥ na nadyaḥ samudriyaḥ prati gr̥bhṇāti vi-śritāḥ varīma-bhiḥ indraḥ somasya pītaye vr̥ṣa-yate sanāt saḥ yudhmaḥ ojasā panasyate
tvam tam indra parvatam na bhojase mahaḥ nr̥mṇasya dharmaṇām irajyasi pra vīryeṇa devatāti cekite viśvasmai ugraḥ karmaṇe puraḥ-h itaḥ
saḥ it vane namasyu-bhiḥ vacasyate cāru janeṣu pra-bruvāṇaḥ indri yam vr̥ṣā chanduḥ bhavati haryataḥ vr̥ṣā kṣemeṇa dhenām maghavā yat invati
saḥ it mahāni sam-ithāni majmanā kr̥ṇoti yudhmaḥ ojasā janebhyaḥ adha cana śrat dadhati tviṣi-mate indrāya vajram ni-ghanighnate vadham
saḥ hi śravasyuḥ sadanāni kr̥trimā kṣmayā vr̥dhānaḥ ojasā vi-nāśayan jyotīṁṣi kr̥ṇvan avr̥kāṇi yajyave ava su-kratuḥ sartavai apaḥ sr̥jat
dānāya manaḥ soma-pāvan astu te arvāñcā harī iti vandana-śrut ā kr̥dhi yamiṣṭhāsaḥ sārathayaḥ ye indrca te na tvā ketāḥ ā dabhnuvanti bhūrṇayaḥ
apra-kṣitam vasu bibharṣi hastayoḥ aṣāl̥ham sahaḥ tanvi sr̥utaḥ dadhe āvr̥tāsaḥ avatāsaḥ na kartr̥-bhiḥ tanūṣu te kratavaḥ indra bhūrayaḥ
eṣaḥ pra pūrvīḥ ava tasya camriṣaḥ atyaḥ na yoṣām ut ayaṁsta bhurvaṇiḥ dakṣam mahe pāyayate hiraṇyayam ratham āvr̥tya hari-yogam r̥bhvasam
tam gūrtayaḥ neman-iṣaḥ parīṇasaḥ samudram na sam-caraṇe san iṣyavaḥ patim dakṣasya vidathasya nu sahāḥ girim na venāḥ adhi roha tejasā
saḥ turvaṇiḥ mahān areṇu paiṁsye gireḥ bhr̥ṣṭiḥ na bhrājate tujā śavaḥ yena śuṣṇam māyinam āyasaḥ made dudhraḥ ābhūṣu rāmayat ni dāman i
devī yadi taviṣī tvāvr̥dhā ūtaye indram siṣakti uṣasam na sūryaḥ yaḥ dhr̥ṣṇunā śavasā bādhate tamaḥ iyarti reṇum br̥hat arhari-svani ḥ
vi yat tiraḥ dharuṇam acyutam rajaḥ atisthipaḥ divaḥ ātāsu barhaṇā svaḥ-mīl̥he yat made indra harṣyā ahan vr̥tram niḥ apām aubjaḥ arṇavam
tvam divaḥ dharuṇam dhiṣe ojasā pr̥thivyāḥ indra sadaneṣu māhinaḥ tvam sutasya made ariṇāḥ apaḥ vi vr̥trasya samayā pāṣyā arujaḥ
pra maṁhiṣṭhāya br̥hate br̥hat-raye satya-śuṣmāya tavase matim bhare apām-iva pravaṇe yasya duḥ-dharam rādhaḥ viśva-āyu śavase apa-vr̥tam
agha te viśvam anu ha asat iṣṭaye āpaḥ nimnāiva savanā haviṣmataḥ yat parvate na sam-aśīta haryataḥ indrasya vajraḥ śnathitā hiraṇyayaḥ
asmai bhīmāya namasā sam adhvare uṣaḥ na śubhre ā bhara panīyase yasya dhāma śravase nāma indriyam jyotiḥ akāri haritaḥ na ayase
ime te indra te vayam puru-stuta ye tvā ārabhya carāmasi prabhuvaso itiprabhu-vaso nahi tvat anyaḥ girvaṇaḥ giraḥ saghat kṣoṇīḥ-iva prati naḥ harya tat vacaḥ
bhūri te indra vīryam tava smasi asya stotuḥ magha-van kāmam ā pr̥ṇa anu te dyauḥ br̥hatī vīryam mame iyam ca te pr̥thivī neme ojase
tvam tam indra parvatam mahām urum vajreṇa vajrin parva-śaḥ cakartitha ava asr̥jaḥ ni-vr̥tāḥ sartavai apaḥ satrā viśvam dadhiṣe kevalam sahaḥ
nu cit sahaḥ-jāḥ amr̥taḥ ni tundate hotā yat dūtaḥ abhavat vivasvataḥ vi sādhiṣṭhebhiḥ pathi-bhiḥ rajaḥ mame ā deva-tātā haviṣā vivāsati
ā svam adma yuvamānaḥ ajaraḥ tr̥ṣu aviṣyan ataseṣu tiṣṭhati atyaḥ na pr̥ṣṭham pruṣitasya rocate divaḥ na sānu stanayan acikradat
kroṇā rudrebhiḥ vasu-bhiḥ puraḥ-hitaḥ hotā ni-sattaḥ rayiṣāṭ amatyarḥ rathaḥ na vikṣu r̥ñjasānaḥ āyuṣu vi ānuṣak vāryā devaḥ r̥ṇvati
vi vāta-jūtaḥ ataseṣu tiṣṭhate vr̥thā juhūbhiḥ sr̥ṇyā tuvi-svaṇiḥ tr̥ṣu yat agne vaninaḥ vr̥ṣa-yase kr̥ṣṇam te ema ruśat-ūrme ajara
tapuḥ-jambhaḥ vane ā vāta-coditaḥ yūthe na sāhvān ava vāti vaṁsagaḥ abhi-vrajan akṣitam pājasā rajaḥ sthātuḥ caratham bhayate patatri ṇaḥ
dadhuḥ tvā bhr̥gavaḥ mānuṣeṣu ā rayim na cārum su-havam janebhyaḥ hotāram agne atithim vareṇyam mitram na śevam divyāya janmane
hotāram sapta juhvaḥ yajiṣṭham yam vāghataḥ vr̥ṇate adhvareṣu agnim viśveṣām aratim vasūnām saparyāmi prayasā yāmi ratnam
acchidrā sūno iti sahasaḥ naḥ adya stotr̥-bhyaḥ mitra-mahaḥ śarma yaccha agne gr̥ṇantam aṁhasaḥ uruṣya ūrjaḥ napāt pūḥ-bhiḥ āyasībhiḥ
bhava varūtham gr̥ṇate vibhāvaḥ bhava maghavan maghavat-bhyaḥ śarma uruṣya agne aṁhasaḥ gr̥ṇantam prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
vayāḥ it agne agnayaḥ te anye tve iti viśve amr̥tāḥ mādayante vaiśvānara nābhiḥ asi kṣitīnām sthūṇāiva janān upa-mit yayantha
mūrdhā divaḥ nābhiḥ agniḥ pr̥thivyāḥ atha abhavat aratiḥ rodasyoḥ tam tvā devāsaḥ ajanayanta devam vaiśvānara jyotiḥ it āryāya
ā sūrye na raśmayaḥ dhruvāsaḥ vaiśvānare dadhire agnā vasūni yā parvateṣu oṣadhīṣu ap-su yā mānuṣeṣu asi tasya rājā
br̥hatīivetibr̥hatī-iva sūnave rodasī iti giraḥ hotā manuṣyaḥ na dakṣaḥ svaḥ-vate satya-śuṣmāya pūvīrḥ vaiśvānarāya nr̥-tamāya yahvīḥ
divaḥ cit te br̥hataḥ jāta-vedaḥ vaiśvānara pra ririce mahi-tvam rājā kr̥ṣṭīnām asi mānuṣīṇām yudhā devebhyaḥ varivaḥ cakartha
pra nu mahi-tvam vr̥ṣabhasya vocam yam pūravaḥ vr̥tra-hanam sacante vaiśvānaraḥ dasyum agniḥ jaghanvān adhūnot kāṣṭhāḥ ava śambaram bhet
vaiśvānaraḥ mahimnā viśva-kr̥ṣṭiḥ bharat-vājeṣu yajataḥ vibhāvā śāta-vaneye śatinībhiḥ agniḥ puru-nīthe jarate sūnr̥tāvān
vahnim yaśasam vidathasya ketum supra-avyam dūtam sadyaḥ-artham dvi-janmānam rayim-iva pra-śastam rātim bharat bhr̥gave mātariśvā
asya śāsuḥ ubhayāsaḥ sacante haviṣmantaḥ uśijaḥ ye ca martāḥ d ivaḥ cit pūrvaḥ ni asādi hotā āpr̥cchyaḥ viśpatiḥ vikṣu vedhāḥ
tam navyasī hr̥daḥ ā jāyamānam asmat su-kīrtiḥ madhu-jihvam aśyāḥ yam r̥tvijaḥ vr̥jane mānuṣāsaḥ prayasvantaḥ āyavaḥ jījananta
uśik pāvakaḥ vasuḥ mānuṣeṣu vareṇyaḥ hotā adhāyi vikṣu damūnā gr̥ha-patiḥ dame ā agniḥ bhuvat rayi-patiḥ rayīṇām
tam tvā vayam patim agne rayīṇām pra śaṁsāmaḥ mati-bhiḥ gotamāsaḥ āśum na vājam-bharam marjayantaḥ prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
asmai it oṁ iti pra tavase turāya prayaḥ na harmi stomam māhināya r̥cīṣamāya adhri-gave oham indrāya brahmāṇi rāta-tamā
asmai it oṁ iti prayaḥ-iva pra yaṁsi bharāmi āṅgūṣam bādhe su-vr̥kti indrāya hr̥dā manasā manīṣā pratnāya patye dhiyaḥ marjayanta
asmai it oṁ iti tyam upa-mam svaḥ-sām bharāmi āṅgūṣam āsyena maṁhiṣṭham acchokti-bhiḥ matīnām suvr̥kti-bhiḥ sūrim vavr̥dhadhyai
asmai it oṁ iti stomam sam hinomi ratham na taṣṭāiva tat-sināya giraḥ ca girvāhase su-vr̥kti indrāya viśvam-invam medhirāya
asmai it oṁ iti saptim-iva śravasyā indrāya arkam juhvā sam añje vīram dāna-okasam vandadhyai purām gūrta-śravasam darmāṇam
iti tvaṣṭā takṣat vajram svapaḥ-tamam svaryam raṇāya vr̥trasya cit vidat yena marma tujan īśānaḥ tujatā kiyedhāḥ
asya it oṁ iti mātuḥ savaneṣu sadyaḥ mahaḥ pitum papivān cāru annā muṣāyat viṣṇuḥ pacatam sahīyān vidhyat varāham tiraḥ adrim astā
asmai it oṁ iti gnāḥ cit deva-patnīḥ indrāya arkam ahi-hatye ūvur ity ūvuḥ pari dyāvāpr̥thivī iti jabhre urvī iti na asya te iti mahimānam pari staitistaḥ
asya it eva pra ririce mahitvam divaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ pari antarikṣāt sva-rāṭ indraḥ dame ā viśva-gūrtaḥ su-ariḥ amatraḥ vavakṣe raṇāya
asya it eva śavasā śuṣantam vi vr̥ścat vajreṇa vr̥tram indraḥ gāḥ na vrāṇāḥ avanīḥ amuñcat abhi śravaḥ dāvane sa-cetāḥ
asya it oṁ iti tveṣasā ranta sindhavaḥ pari yat vajreṇa sīm ayacchat īśāna-kr̥t dāśuṣe daśasyan turvītaye gādham turvaṇiḥ karitikaḥ
asmai it oṁ iti pra bhara tūtujānaḥ vr̥trāya vajram īśānaḥ kiyedhāḥ goḥ na parva vi rada tiraścā iṣyan arṇāṁsi apām caradhyai
asya it oṁ iti pra brūhi pūrvyāṇi turasya karmāṇi navyaḥ ukthaiḥ yudhe yat iṣṇānaḥ āyudhāni r̥ghāyamāṇaḥ ni-riṇāti śatrūn
asya it oṁ iti bhiyā girayaḥ ca dr̥l̥hāḥ dyāvā ca bhūmā januṣaḥ tujeteiti upo iti venasya joguvānaḥ oṇim sadyaḥ bhuvat vīryāya nodhāḥ
asmai it oṁ iti tyat anu dāyi eṣām ekaḥ yat vavne bhūreḥ īśānaḥ pra etaśam sūrye paspr̥dhānam sauvaśvye suṣvim āvat indraḥ
eva te hāri-yojana su-vr̥kti indra brahmāṇi gotamāsaḥ akran ā eṣu viśva-peśasam dhiyam dhāḥ prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
pra manmahe śavasānāya śūṣam āṅgūṣam girvaṇase aṅgirasvat suvr̥kt i-bhiḥ stuvate r̥gmiyāya arcāma arkam nare vi-śrutāya
pra vaḥ mahe mahi namaḥ bharadhvam āṅgūṣyam śavasānāya sāma yena naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pada-jñāḥ arcantaḥ aṅgirasaḥ gāḥ avindan
indrasya aṅgirasām ca iṣṭau vidat saramā tanayāya dhāsim br̥haspatiḥ bhinat adrim vidat gāḥ sam usriyābhiḥ vāvaśanta naraḥ
saḥ su-stubhā saḥ stubhā sapta vipraiḥ svareṇa adrim svaryaḥ nava-gvaiḥ saraṇyu-bhiḥ phali-gam indra śakra valam raveṇa daśa-gvaiḥ
gr̥ṇānaḥ aṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ dasma vi vaḥ uṣasā sūryeṇa gobhiḥ andhaḥ vi bhūmyāḥ aprathayaḥ indra sānu divaḥ rajaḥ uparam astabhāyaḥ
tat oṁ iti prayakṣa-tamam asya karma dasmasya cāru-tamam asti daṁsaḥ upa-hvare yat uparāḥ apinvat madhu-arṇasaḥ nadyaḥ catasraḥ
dvitā vi vavre sa-najā sanīl̥e itisa-nīl̥e ayāsyaḥ stavamānebhiḥ arkaiḥ bhagaḥ na meneiti parame vi-oman adhārayat rodasī iti su-daṁsāḥ
sanāt divam pari bhūma virūpeitivi-rūpe punaḥ-bhuvā yuvatī iti svebhiḥ evaiḥ kr̥ṣṇebhiḥ aktā uṣāḥ ruśat-bhiḥ vapuḥ-bhiḥ ā carataḥ anyāanyā
sanemi sakhyam su-apasyamānaḥ sūnuḥ dādhāra śavasā su-daṁsāḥ āmāsu cit dadhiṣe pakvam antariti payaḥ kr̥ṣṇāsu ruśat rohiṇīṣu
sanāt sa-nīl̥āḥ avanīḥ avātāḥ vratā rakṣante amr̥tāḥ sahaḥ-bhiḥ puru sahasrā janayaḥ na patnīḥ duvasyanti svasāraḥ ahrayāṇam
sanāyuvaḥ namasā navyaḥ arkaiḥ vasu-yavaḥ matayaḥ dasma dadruḥ patim na patnīḥ uśatīḥ uśantam spr̥śanti tvā śavasāvan manīṣāḥ
sanāt eva tava rāyaḥ gabhastau na kṣīyante na upa dasyanti dasma dyumān asi kratu-mān indra dhīraḥ śikṣa śacī-vaḥ tava naḥ śacībhiḥ
sanāyate gotamaḥ indra navyam atakṣat brahma hari-yojanāya su-nīthāya naḥ śavasāna nodhāḥ prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
tvam mahān indra yaḥ ha śuṣmaiḥ dyāvā jajñānaḥ pr̥thivī iti ame ghāḥ yat ha te viśvā girayaḥ cit abhvā bhiyā dr̥l̥hāsaḥ kiraṇāḥ na aijan
ā yat harī iti indra vi-vratā veḥ ā te vajram jaritā bāhvoḥ dhāt yena aviharyatakrato ity aviharyata-krato amitrān puraḥ iṣṇāsi puru-hūta pūrvīḥ
vr̥jane pr̥kṣe āṇau yūne kutsāya dyumate sacā ahan
tvam ha tyat indra codīḥ sakhā vr̥tram yat vajrin vr̥ṣa-karman ubhnāḥ yat ha śūra vr̥ṣa-maṇaḥ parācaiḥ vi dasyūn yonau akr̥taḥ vr̥thāṣāṭ
tvam ha tyat indra ariṣaṇyan dr̥l̥hasya cit martānām ajuṣṭau vi asmat ā kāṣṭhāḥ arvate vaḥ ghanāiva vajrin śnathihi amitrān
tvām ha tyat indra arṇa-sātau svaḥ-mīl̥he naraḥ ājā havante tava svadhāvaḥ iyam ā sa-marye ūtiḥ vājeṣu atasāyyā bhūt
tvam ha tyat indra sapta yudhyan puraḥ vajrin puru-kutsāya dardaḥ barhiḥ na yat su-dāse vr̥thā varka aṁhoḥ rājan varivaḥ pūrave kaḥ
tvam tyām naḥ indra deva citrām iṣam āpaḥ na pīpayaḥ pari-jman yayā śūra prati asmabhyam yaṁsi tmanam ūrjam na viśvadha kṣaradhyai
akāri te indra gotamebhiḥ brahmāṇi āuktā namasā hari-bhyām su-peśasam vājam ā bhara naḥ prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
vr̥ṣṇe śardhāya su-makhāya vedhase nodhaḥ su-vr̥ktim pra bhara marut-bhyaḥ apaḥ na dhīraḥ manasā su-hastyaḥ giraḥ sam añje vidatheṣu ābhuvaḥ
te jajñire divaḥ r̥ṣvāsaḥ ukṣaṇaḥ rudrasya maryā asurāḥ arepasaḥ pāvakāsaḥ śucayaḥ sūryāḥ-iva satvānaḥ na drapsinaḥ ghora-varpasaḥ
yuvānaḥ rudrāḥ ajarāḥ abhok-hanaḥ vavakṣuḥ adhri-gāvaḥ parvatāḥ-iva dr̥l̥hā cit viśvā bhuvanāni pārthivā pra cyāvayanti divyāni majmanā
citraiḥ añji-bhiḥ vapuṣe vi añjate vakṣaḥ-su rukmān adhi yetire śubhe aṁseṣu eṣām ni mimr̥kṣuḥ r̥ṣṭayaḥ sākam jajñire svadhayā divaḥ naraḥ
īśāna-kr̥taḥ dhunayaḥ riśādasaḥ vātān vi-dyutaḥ taviṣībhiḥ akrata duhanti ūdhaḥ divyāni dhūtayaḥ bhūmim pinvanti payasā pari-jrayaḥ
pinvanti apaḥ marutaḥ su-dānavaḥ payaḥ ghr̥ta-vat vidatheṣu ābhuvaḥ atyam na mihe vi nayanti vājinam utsam duhanti stanayantam akṣitam
mahiṣāsaḥ māyinaḥ citra-bhānavaḥ girayaḥ na sva-tavasaḥ raghu-syadaḥ mr̥gāḥ-iva hastinaḥ svādatha vanā yat āruṇīṣu taviṣīḥ ayugdhvam
siṁhāḥ-iva nānadati pra-cetasaḥ piśāḥ-iva su-piśaḥ viśva-vedasaḥ kṣapaḥ jinvantaḥ pr̥ṣatībhiḥ r̥ṣṭi-bhiḥ sam it sa-bādhaḥ śavasā ahi-manyavaḥ
rodasī iti ā vadata gaṇa-śriyaḥ nr̥-sācaḥ śūrāḥ śavasā ahi-manyavaḥ ā vandhureṣu amatiḥ na darśatā vidyut na tasthau marutaḥ ratheṣu vaḥ
viśva-vedasaḥ rayi-bhiḥ sam-okasaḥ sam-miślāsaḥ taviṣībhiḥ vi-rapśinaḥ astāraḥ iṣum dadhire gabhastyoḥ ananta-śuṣmāḥ vr̥ṣa-khādayaḥ naraḥ
hiraṇyayebhiḥ pavi-bhiḥ payaḥ-vr̥dhaḥ ut jighnante āpathyaḥ na parvatān makhāḥ ayāsaḥ sva-sr̥taḥ dhruva-cyutaḥ dudhra-kr̥taḥ marutaḥ bhrājat-r̥ṣṭayaḥ
ghr̥ṣum pāvakam vaninam vi-carṣaṇim rudrasya sūnum havasā gr̥ṇīmas i rajaḥ-turam tavasam mārutam gaṇam r̥jīṣiṇam vr̥ṣaṇam saścata śriye
pra nu saḥ martaḥ śavasā janān ati tasthau vaḥ ūtī marutaḥ yam āvata arvat-bhiḥ vājam bharate dhanā nr̥-bhiḥ āpr̥cchyam kratum ā kṣeti puṣyati
carkr̥tyam marutaḥ pr̥t-su dustaram dyu-mantam śuṣmam maghavat-su dhattana dhana-spr̥tam ukthyam viśva-carṣaṇim tokam puṣyema tanayam śatam himāḥ
nu sthiram marutaḥ vīra-vantam r̥ti-saham rayim asmāsu dhatta sahasriṇam śatinam śūśu-vāṁsam prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
paśvā na tāyum guhā catantam namaḥ yujānam namaḥ vahantam
sajoṣāḥ dhīrāḥ padaiḥ anu gman upa tvā sīdan viśve yajatrāḥ
r̥tasya devāḥ anu vratā guḥ bhuvat pariṣṭiḥ dyauḥ na bhūma
vardhanti īm āpaḥ panvā su-śiśvim r̥tasya yonā garbhe su-jātam
puṣṭiḥ na raṇvā kṣitiḥ na pr̥thvī giriḥ na bhujma kṣodaḥ na śam-bhu
atyaḥ na ajman sarga-prataktaḥ sindhuḥ na kṣodaḥ kaḥ im varāte
jāmiḥ sindhūnām bhrātāiva svasrām ibhyān na rājā vanāni atti
yat vāta-jūtaḥ vanā vi asthāt agniḥ ha dāti roma pr̥thivyāḥ
śvasiti ap-su haṁsaḥ na sīdan kratvā cetiṣṭhaḥ viśām uṣaḥ-bhut
somaḥ na vedhāḥ r̥ta-prajātaḥ paśuḥ na śiśvā vi-bhuḥ dūre--bhāḥ
rayiḥ na citrā sūraḥ na sam-dr̥k āyuḥ na prāṇaḥ nityaḥ na sūnuḥ
takvā na bhūrṇiḥ vanā saisakti payaḥ na dhenuḥ śuciḥ vibhāvā
dādhāra kṣemam okaḥ na raṇvaḥ yavaḥ na pakvaḥ jetā janānām
r̥ṣiḥ na stubhvā vikṣu pra-śastaḥ vājī na prītaḥ vayaḥ dadhāti
duroka-śociḥ kratuḥ na nityaḥ jāyāiva yonau aram viśvasmai
citraḥ yat abhrāṭ śvetaḥ na vikṣu rathaḥ na rukmī tveṣaḥ samat-su
senāiva sr̥ṣṭā amam dadhāti astuḥ na didyut tveṣa-pratīkā
yamaḥ ha jātaḥ yamaḥ jani-tvam jāraḥ kanīnām patiḥ janīnām
tam vaḥ carāthā vayam vasatyā astam na gāvaḥ nakṣante iddham
sindhuḥ na kṣodaḥ pra nīcīḥ ainot navante gāvaḥ svaḥ dr̥śīke
vaneṣu jāyuḥ marteṣu mitraḥ vr̥ṇīte śruṣtim rājāiva ajuryam
kṣemaḥ na sādhuḥ kratuḥ na bhadraḥ bhuvat su-ādhīḥ hotā havya-vāṭ
haste dadhānaḥ nr̥mṇā viśvāni ame devān dhāt guhā ni-sīdan
vidanti īm atra naraḥ dhiyam-dhāḥ hr̥dā yat taṣṭān mantrān aśaṁsan
ajaḥ na kṣām dādhāra pr̥thivīm tastambha dyām mantrebhiḥ satyaiḥ
priyā padāni paśvaḥ ni pāhi viśva-āyuḥ agne guhā guham gāḥ
yaḥ īm ciketa guhā bhavantam ā yaḥ sasāda dhārām r̥tasya
vi ye cr̥tanti r̥tā sapantaḥ āt it vasūni pra vavāca asmai
vi yaḥ vīrut-su rodhat mahi-tvā uta pra-jāḥ uta pra-sūṣu antarit i
cittiḥ apām dame viśva-āyuḥ sadma-iva dhīrāḥ sam-māya cakruḥ
śrīṇan upa sthāt divam bhuraṇyuḥ sthātuḥ caratham aktūn vi ūrṇot
pari yat eṣām ekaḥ viśveṣām bhuvat devaḥ devānām mahi-tvā
āt it te viśve kratum juṣanta śuṣkāt yat deva jīvaḥ janiṣṭhāḥ
bhajanta viśve deva-tvam nāma r̥tam sapantaḥ amr̥tam evaiḥ
r̥tasya preṣāḥ r̥tasya dhītiḥ viśva-āyuḥ viśve apāṁsi cakruḥ
yaḥ tubhyam dāśāt yaḥ vā te śikṣāt tasmai cikitvān rayim dayasva
hotā ni-sattaḥ manoḥ apatye saḥ cit nu āsām patiḥ rayīṇām
icchanta retaḥ mithaḥ tanūṣu sam jānata svaiḥ dakṣaiḥ amūrāḥ
pituḥ na putrāḥ kratum juṣanta śroṣan ye asya śāsam turāsaḥ
vi rāyaḥ aurṇot duraḥ puru-kṣuḥ pipeśa nākam str̥-bhiḥ damūnāḥ
śukraḥ śuśukvān uṣaḥ na jāraḥ paprā samīcī itisam-īcī divaḥ na jyotiḥ
pari pra-jātaḥ kratvā babhūtha bhuvaḥ devānām pitā putraḥ san
vedhāḥ adr̥ptaḥ agniḥ vi-janan ūdhaḥ na gonām svādma pitūnām
jane na śeva āhūryaḥ san madhye ni-sattaḥ raṇvaḥ duroṇe
putraḥ na jātaḥ raṇvaḥ duroṇe vājī na prītaḥ viśaḥ vi tārīt
viśaḥ yat ahve nr̥-bhiḥ sa-nīl̥āḥ agniḥ deva-tvā viśvāni aśyāḥ
nakiḥ te etā vratā minanti nr̥-bhyaḥ yat ebhyaḥ śruṣṭim cakartha
tat tu te daṁsaḥ yat ahan samānaiḥ nr̥-bhiḥ yat yuktaḥ viveḥ rapāṁsi
uṣaḥ na jāraḥ vibhāvā usraḥ sañjñāta-rūpaḥ ciketat asmai
tmanā vahantaḥ duraḥ vi r̥ṇvan navanta viśve svaḥ dr̥śīke
vanema pūrvīḥ aryaḥ manīṣā agniḥ suśokaḥ viśvāni aśyāḥ
ā daivyāni vratā cikitvān ā mānuṣasya janasya janma
garbhaḥ yaḥ apām garbhaḥ vanānām garbhaḥ ca sthātām garbhaḥ carathām
adrau cit asmai antaḥ duroṇe viśām na viśvaḥ amr̥taḥ su-ādhīḥ
saḥ hi kṣapāvān agniḥ rayīṇām dāśat yaḥ asmai aram su-uktaiḥ
etā cikitvaḥ bhūma ni pāhi devānām janma martān ca vidvān
vardhān yam pūrvīḥ kṣapaḥ vi-rūpāḥ sthātuḥ ca ratham r̥ta-pravītam
arādhi hotā svaḥ ni-sattaḥ kr̥ṇvan viśvāni apāṁsi satyā
goṣu pra-śastim vaneṣu dhiṣe bharanta viśve balim svaḥ naḥ
vi tvā naraḥ puru-trā saparyan pituḥ na jivreḥ vi vedī bharanta
sādhuḥ na gr̥dhnuḥ astāiva śūraḥ yātāiva bhīmaḥ tveṣaḥ samat-su
upa pra jinvan uśatīḥ uśantam patim na nityam janayaḥ sa-nīl̥āḥ svasāraḥ śyāvīm aruṣīm ajuṣran citram ucchantīm uṣasam na gāvaḥ
vīl̥u cit dr̥l̥hā pitaraḥ naḥ ukthaiḥ adrim rujan aṅgirasaḥ raveṇa cakruḥ divaḥ br̥hataḥ gātum asme iti ahariti svaḥ vividuḥ ketum usrāḥ
dadhan r̥tam dhanayan asya dhītim āt it aryaḥ dadhiṣvaḥ vi-bhr̥trāḥ atr̥ṣyantīḥ apasaḥ yanti accha devān janma prayasā vardhayantīḥ
mathīt yat īm vi-bhr̥taḥ mātariśvā gr̥he--gr̥he śyetaḥ jenyaḥ bhūt ādīm rājñe na sahīyase sacā san ā dūtyam bhr̥gavāṇaḥ vivāya
mahe yat pitre īm rasam dive kaḥ ava tsarat pr̥śanyaḥ cikitvān sr̥jat astā dhr̥ṣatā didyum asmai svāyām devaḥ duhitari tviṣim dhāt
sve ā yaḥ tubhyam dame ā vi-bhāti namaḥ vā dāśāt uśataḥ anu dyūn vardhaḥ agne vayaḥ asya dvi-barhāḥ yāsat rāyā sa-ratham yam junāsi
agnim viśvāḥ abhi pr̥kṣaḥ sacante samudram na sravataḥ sapta yahvīḥ na jāmibhiḥ vi cikite vayaḥ naḥ vidāḥ deveṣu pra-matim cikitvān
ā yat iṣe nr̥-patim tejaḥ ānaṭ śuci retaḥ ni-siktam dyauḥ abhīke agniḥ śardham anavadyam yuvānam su-ādhyam janayat sūdayat ca
manaḥ na yaḥ adhvanaḥ sadyaḥ eti ekaḥ satrā sūraḥ vasvaḥ īśe rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī itisu-pāṇī goṣu priyam amr̥tam rakṣamāṇā
mā naḥ agne sakhyā pitryāṇi pra marṣiṣṭhāḥ abhi viduḥ kaviḥ san nabhaḥ na rūpam jarimā mināti purā tasyāḥ abhi-śasteḥ adhi ihi
ni kāvyā vedhasaḥ śaśvataḥ kaḥ haste dadhānaḥ naryā purūṇi agniḥ bhuvat rayi-patiḥ rayīṇām satrā cakrāṇaḥ amr̥tāni viśvā
asme iti vatsam pari santam na vindan icchantaḥ viśve amr̥tāḥ amūrāḥ śrama-yuvaḥ padavyaḥ dhiyam-dhāḥ tasthuḥ pade parame cāru agneḥ
tisraḥ yat agne śaradaḥ tvām it śucim ghr̥tena śucayaḥ saparyān nāmāni cit dadhire yajñiyāni asūdayanta tanvaḥ su-jātāḥ
ā rodasī iti br̥hatī iti vevidānāḥ pra rudriyā jabhrire yajñiyāsaḥ vidat martaḥ nema-dhitā cikitvān agnim pade parame tasthi-vāṁsam
sam-jānānāḥ upa sīdan abhi-jñu patnī-vantaḥ namasyam namasyannitinamasyan ririkvāṁsaḥ tanvaḥ kr̥ṇvata svāḥ sakhā sakhyuḥ n i-miṣi rakṣamāṇāḥ
triḥ sapta yat guhyāni tveiti it padā avidan ni-hitāḥ yajñiyāsaḥ tebhiḥ rakṣante amr̥tam sa-joṣāḥ paśūn ca sthātr̥r̥n caratham ca pāhi
vidvān agne vayunāni kṣitīnām vi ānuṣak śurudhaḥ jīvase dhāḥ antaḥ-vidvān adhvanaḥ deva-yānān atandraḥ dūtaḥ abhavaḥ haviḥ-vāṭ
svu-ādhyaḥ divaḥ ā sapta yahvīḥ rāyaḥ duraḥ vi r̥ta-jñāḥ ajānan vidat gavyam saramā dr̥l̥ham ūrvam yena nu kam mānuṣī bhojate viṭ
ā ye viśvā su-apatyāni tasthuḥ kr̥ṇvānāsaḥ amr̥ta-tvāya gātum mahnā mahat-bhiḥ pr̥thivī vi tasthe mātā putraiḥ aditiḥ dhāyase veḥ
adhi śriyam ni dadhuḥ cārum asmin divaḥ yat akṣī iti amr̥tāḥ akr̥ṇvan adha kṣaranti sindhavaḥ na sr̥ṣṭāḥ pra nīcīḥ agne aruṣīḥ ajānan
rayiḥ na yaḥ pitr̥-vittaḥ vayaḥ-dhāḥ su-pranītiḥ cikituṣaḥ na śāsuḥ syona-śīḥ atithiḥ na prīṇānaḥ hotāiva sadma vidhataḥ vi tārīt
devaḥ na yaḥ savitā satya-manmā kratvā ni-pāti vr̥janāni viśvā puru-praśastaḥ amatiḥ na satyaḥ ātmāiva śevaḥ didhiṣāyyaḥ bhūt
devaḥ na yaḥ pr̥thivīm viśva-dhāyāḥ upa-kṣeti hita-mitraḥ na rājā puraḥ-sadaḥ śarma-sadaḥ na vīrāḥ anavadyā patijuṣṭāiva nārī
tam tvā naraḥ dame ā nityam iddham agne sacanta kṣitiṣu dhruvāsu adhi dyumnam ni dadhuḥ bhūri asmin bhava viśva-āyuḥ dharuṇaḥ rayīṇām
vi pr̥kṣaḥ agne magha-vānaḥ aśyuḥ vi sūrayaḥ dadataḥ viśvam āyuḥ sanema vājam sam-itheṣu aryaḥ bhāgam deveṣu śravase dadhānāḥ
r̥tasya hi dhenavaḥ vāvaśānāḥ smat-ūdhnīḥ pīpayanta dyu-bhaktāḥ parāvataḥ su-matim bhikṣamāṇāḥ vi sindhavaḥ samayā sasruḥ adrim
tve agne su-matim bhikṣamāṇāḥ divi śravaḥ dadhire yajñiyāḥ naktā ca cakruḥ uṣasā virūpeitivi-rūpe kr̥ṣṇam ca varṇam aruṇam ca sam dhurit idhuḥ
yān rāye martān susūdaḥ agne te syāma magha-vānaḥ vayam ca chāyāiva viśvam bhuvanam sisakṣi āpapri-vān rodasī iti antarikṣam
arvat-bhiḥ agne arvataḥ nr̥bhiḥ nr̥r̥n vīrair vīrān vanuyāmā tvotāḥ īśānāsaḥ pitr̥-vittasyar yaḥ vi sūrayaḥ śata-himāḥ naḥ aśyuḥ
etā te agne ucathāni vedhaḥ juṣṭāni santu manase hr̥de ca śakema rāyaḥ su-dhuraḥ yamam te adhi śravaḥ deva-bhaktam dadhānāḥ
upa-prayantaḥ adhvaram mantram vocema agnaye āre asme iti ca śr̥ṇvate
yaḥ snīhitīṣu pūrvyaḥ sam-jagmānāsu kr̥ṣṭiṣu arakṣat dāśuṣe gayam
uta bruvantu jantavaḥ ut agniḥ vr̥tra-hā ajani dhanam-jayaḥ raṇe--raṇe
yasya dūtaḥ asi kṣaye veṣi havyāni vītaye dasmat kr̥ṇoṣi adhvaram
tam it su-havyam aṅgiraḥ su-devam sahasaḥ yaho iti janāḥ āhuḥ su-barhiṣam
ā ca vahāsi tān iha devān upa pra-śastaye havyā su-candra vītaye
na yoḥ upabdiḥ aśvyaḥ śr̥ṇve rathasya kat cana yat agne yāsi dūtyam
tvāūtaḥ vājī ahrayaḥ abhi pūrvasmāt aparaḥ pra dāśvān agne asthāt
uta dyu-mat su-vīryam br̥hat agne vivāsasi devebhyaḥ deva dāśuṣe
juṣasva saprathaḥ-tamam vacaḥ devapsaraḥ-tamam havyā juhvānaḥ āsani
atha te aṅgiraḥ-tama agne vedhaḥ-tama priyam vocema brahma sānasi
kaḥ te jāmiḥ janānām agne kaḥ dāśu-adhvaraḥ kaḥ ha kasmin asi śritaḥ
tvam jāmiḥ janānām agne mitraḥ asi priyaḥ sakhā sakhi-bhyaḥ īḍyaḥ
yaja naḥ mitrāvaruṇā yaja devān r̥tam br̥hat agne yakṣi svam damam
kā te upa-itiḥ manasaḥ varāya bhuvat agne śam-tamā kā manīṣā kaḥ vā yajñaiḥ pari dakṣam te āpa kena vā te manasā dāśema
ā ihi agne iha hotā ni sīda adabdhaḥ su puraḥ-etā bhava naḥ avatām tvā rodasī iti viśvaminve itiviśvam-inve yaja mahe saumanasāya devān
pra su viśvān rakṣasaḥ dhakṣi agne bhava yajñānām abhiśasti-pāvā atha ā vaha soma-patim hari-bhyām ātithyam asmai cakr̥ma su-dāvne
prajāvatā vacasā vahniḥ āsā ā ca huve ni ca satsi iha devaiḥ veṣi hotram uta potram yajatra bodhi pra-yantaḥ janitaḥ vasūnām
