yathā viprasya manuṣaḥ haviḥ-bhiḥ devān ayajaḥ kavi-bhiḥ kaviḥ san eva hotariti satya-tara tvam adya agne mandrayā juhvā yajasva
kathā dāśema agnaye kā asmai deva-juṣṭā ucyate bhāmine gīḥ yaḥ martyeṣu amr̥taḥ r̥ta-vā hotā yajiṣṭhaḥ it kr̥ṇoti devān
yaḥ adhvareṣu śam-tamaḥ r̥ta-vā hotā tam oṁ iti namaḥ-bhiḥ ā kr̥ṇudhvam agniḥ yat veḥ martāya devān saḥ ca bodhāti manasā yajāti
saḥ hi kratuḥ saḥ maryaḥ saḥ sādhuḥ mitraḥ na bhūt adbhutasya rathīḥ tam medheṣu prathamam deva-yantīḥ viśaḥ upa bruvate dasmam ārīḥ
saḥ naḥ nr̥ṇām nr̥-tamaḥ riśādāḥ agniḥ giraḥ avasā vetu dhītim tanā ca ye magha-vānaḥ śaviṣṭhāḥ vāja-prasūtāḥ iṣayanta manma
eva agniḥ gotamebhiḥ r̥ta-vā viprebhiḥ astoṣṭa jāta-vedāḥ saḥ eṣu dyumnam pīpayat saḥ vājam saḥ puṣṭim yāti joṣam ā cikitvān
abhi tvā gotamāḥ girā jāta-vedaḥ vi-carṣaṇe dyumnaiḥ abhi pra nonumaḥ
tam oṁ iti tvā gotamaḥ girā rāyaḥ-kāmaḥ duvasyati dyumnaiḥ abhi pra nonumaḥ
tam oṁ iti tvā vāja-sātamam aṅgirasvat havāmahe dyumnaiḥ abhi pra nonumaḥ
tam oṁ iti tvā vr̥trahan-tamam yaḥ dasyūn ava-dhūnuṣe dyumnaiḥ abhi pra nonumaḥ
avocāma rahūgaṇāḥ agnaye madhu-mat vacaḥ dyumnaiḥ abhi pra nonumaḥ
hiraṇya-keśaḥ rajasaḥ vi-sāre ahiḥ dhuniḥ vātaḥ-iva dhrajīmān śuci-bhrājāḥ uṣasaḥ navedāḥ yaśasvatīḥ apasyuvaḥ na satyāḥ
ā te su-parṇāḥ aminanta evaiḥ kr̥ṣṇaḥ nonāva vr̥ṣabhaḥ yadi idam śivābhiḥ na smayamānābhiḥ ā agāt patanti mihaḥ stanayanti abhr̥ā
yat īm r̥tasya payasā piyānaḥ nayan r̥tasya pathi-bhiḥ rajiṣṭhaiḥ ayarmā mitraḥ varuṇaḥ pari-jmā tvacam pr̥ñcanti uparasya yonau
agne vājasya gomataḥ īśānaḥ sahasaḥ yaho iti asme iti dhehi jāta-vedaḥ mahi śravaḥ
saḥ idhānaḥ vasuḥ kaviḥ agniḥ īl̥enyaḥ girā revat asmabhyam puru-aṇīka dīdihi
kṣapaḥ rājan uta tmanā agne vastoḥ uta uṣasaḥ saḥ tigma-jambha rakṣasaḥ daha prati
ava naḥ agne ūti-bhiḥ gāyatrasya pra-bharmaṇi viśvāsu dhīṣu vandya
ā naḥ agne rayim bhara satrāsaham vareṇyam viśvāsu pr̥t-su dustaram
ā naḥ agne su-cetunā rayim viśvāyu-poṣasam mārḍīkam dhehi jīvase
pra pūtāḥ tigma-śociṣe vācaḥ gotama agnaye bharasva sumna-yuḥ giraḥ
yaḥ naḥ agne abhi-dāsati anti dūre padīṣṭa saḥ asmākam it vr̥dhe bhava
sahasra-akṣaḥ vi-carṣaṇiḥ agniḥ rakṣāṁsi sedhati hotā gr̥ṇīte ukthyaḥ
itthā hi some it made brahmā cakāra vardhanam śaviṣṭha vajrin ojasā pr̥thivyāḥ niḥ śaśāḥ ahim arcan anu sva-rājyam
saḥ tvā amadat vr̥ṣā madaḥ somaḥ śyena-ābhr̥taḥ sutaḥ yena vr̥tram niḥ at-bhyaḥ jaghantha vajrin ojasā arcan anu sva-rājyam
pra ihi abhi ihi dhr̥ṣṇuhi na te vajraḥ ni yaṁsate indra nr̥mṇam h i te śavaḥ hanaḥ vr̥tram jayāḥ apaḥ arcan anu sva-rājyam
niḥ indra bhūmyāḥ adhi vr̥tram jaghantha niḥ divaḥ sr̥ja marutvatīḥ ava jīva-dhanyāḥ imāḥ apaḥ arcan anu sva-rājyam
indraḥ vr̥trasya dodhataḥ sānum vajreṇa hīl̥itaḥ abhi-kramya ava ji ghnate apaḥ sarmāya codayan arcan anu sva-rājyam
adhi sānau ni jighnīate vajreṇa śata-parvaṇā mandānaḥ indraḥ andhasaḥ sakhi-bhyaḥ gātum icchati arcan anu sva-rājyam
indra tubhyam it adri-vaḥ anuttam vajrin vīryam yat ha tyam māy inam mr̥gam tam oṁ iti tvam māyayā avadhīḥ arcan anu sva-rājyam
vi te vajrāsaḥ asthiran navatim nāvyāḥ anu mahat te indra vīryam bāhvoḥ te balam hitam arcan anu sva-rājyam
sahasram sākam arcata pari stobhata viṁśatiḥ śatā enam anu anonavuḥ indrāya brahma ut-yatam arcan anu sva-rājyam
indraḥ vr̥trasya taviṣīm niḥ ahan sahasā sahaḥ mahat tat asya paiṁsyam vr̥tram jaghanvān asr̥jat arcan anu sva-rājyam
ime cit tava manyave vepeteiti bhiyasā mahī yat indra vajrin ojasā vr̥tram marutvān avadhīḥ arcan anu sva-rājyam
na vepasā na tanyatā indram vr̥traḥ vi bībhayat abhi enam vajraḥ āyasaḥ sahasra-bhr̥ṣṭiḥ āyāta arcan anu sva-rājyam
yat vr̥tram tava ca aśanim vajreṇa sam-ayodhayaḥ ahim indra jighāṁsataḥ divi te badbadhe śavaḥ arcan anu sva-rājyam
abhi-stane te adri-vaḥ yat sthāḥ jagat ca rejate tvaṣṭā cit tava manyave indra vevijyate bhiyā arcan anu sva-rājyam
nahi nu yāt adhi-imasi indram kaḥ vīryā paraḥ tasmin nr̥mṇam uta kratum devāḥ ojāṁsi sam dadhuḥ arcan anu sva-rājyam
yām atharvā manuḥ pitā dadhyaṅ dhiyam atnata tasmin brahmāṇi pūrva-thā indre ukthā sam agmata arcan anu sva-rājyam
indraḥ madāya vavr̥dhe śavase vr̥tra-hā nr̥-bhiḥ tam it mahat-su ājiṣu uta īm arbhe havāmahe saḥ vājeṣu pra naḥ aviṣat
asi hi vīra senyaḥ asi bhūri parādadiḥ asi dabhrasya cit vr̥dhaḥ yajamānāya śikṣasi sunvate bhūri te vasu
yat ut-īrate ājayaḥ dhr̥ṣṇave dhīyate dhanā yukṣva mada-cyutā harī iti kam hanaḥ kam vasau dadhaḥ asmān indra vasau dadhaḥ
kratvā mahān anu-svadham bhīmaḥ ā vavr̥dhe śavaḥ śriye r̥ṣvaḥ upākayoḥ ni śiprī hari-vān dadhe hastayoḥ vajram āyasam
ā paprau pārthivam rajaḥ badbadhe rocanā divi na tvāvān indra kaḥ cana na jātaḥ na janiṣyate ati viśvam vavakṣitha
yaḥ aryaḥ marta-bhojanam parādadāti dāśuṣe indraḥ asmabhyam śikṣatu vi bhaja bhūri te vasu bhakṣīya tava rādhasaḥ
made--made hi naḥ dadiḥ yūthā gavām r̥ju-kratuḥ sam gr̥bhāya puru śatā ubhayāhastyā vasu śiśīhi rāyaḥ ā bhara
mādayasva sute sacā śavase śūra rādhase vidma hi tvā puru-vasum upa kāmān sasr̥jmahe atha naḥ avitā bhava
ete te indra jantavaḥ viśvam puṣyanti vāryam antaḥ hi khyaḥ janānām aryaḥ vedaḥ adāśuṣām teṣām naḥ vedaḥ ā bhara
upo iti su śr̥ṇuhi giraḥ magha-van mā atathāḥ-iva yadā naḥ sūnr̥tāvataḥ karaḥ āt arthayāse it yoja nu indra te harī iti
akṣan amīmadanta hi ava priyāḥ adhūṣata astoṣata sva-bhānavaḥ viprāḥ naviṣṭhayā matī yoja nu indra te harī iti
su-sandr̥śam tvā vayam magha-van vandiṣīmahi pra nūnam pūrṇa-vandhuraḥ stutaḥ yāhi vaśān anu yoja nu indra te harī iti
saḥ gha tam vr̥ṣaṇam ratham adhi tiṣṭhāti govidam yaḥ pātram hāri-yojanam pūrṇam indra ciketati yoja nu indra te harī iti
yuktaḥ te astu dakṣiṇaḥ uta savyaḥ śatakrato itiśata-krato tena jāyām upa priyām mandānaḥ yāhi andhasaḥ yoja nu indra te harī iti
yunajmi te brahmaṇā keśinā harī iti upa pra yāhi dadhiṣe gabhastyoḥ ut tvā sutāsaḥ rabhasāḥ amandiṣuḥ pūṣaṇ-vān vajrin sam oṁ iti patnyā amadaḥ
aśva-vati prathamaḥ goṣu gacchati supra-āvīḥ indra martyaḥ tava ūti-bhiḥ tam it pr̥ṇakṣi vasunā bhavīyasā sindhum āpaḥ yathā abhitaḥ vi-cetasaḥ
āpaḥ na devīḥ upa yanti hotriyam avaḥ paśyanti vi-tatam yathā rajaḥ prācaiḥ devāsaḥ pra nayanti deva-yum brahma-priyam joṣayante varāḥ-iva
adhi dvayoḥ adadhāḥ ukthyam vacaḥ yata-srucā mithunā yā saparyataḥ asam-yattaḥ vrate te kṣeti puṣyati bhadrā śaktiḥ yajamānāya sunvate
āt aṅgirāḥ prathamam dadhire vayaḥ iddha-agnayaḥ śamyā ye su-kr̥tyayā sarvam paṇeḥ sam avindanta bhojanam aśva-vantam go--mantam ā paśum naraḥ
yajñaiḥ atharvā prathamaḥ pathaḥ tate tataḥ sūryaḥ vrata-pāḥ venaḥ ā ajani ā gāḥ ājat uśanā kavyaḥ sacā yamasya jātam amr̥tam yajāmahe
barhiḥ vā yat su-apatyāya vr̥jyate arkaḥ vā ślokam āghoṣate divi grāvā yatra vadati kāruḥ ukthyaḥ tasya it indraḥ abhi-pitveṣu raṇyati
asāvi somaḥ indra te śaviṣṭha dhr̥ṣṇo iti ā gahi ā tvā pr̥ṇaktu indriyam rajaḥ sūryaḥ na raśmi-bhiḥ
indram it harī vahataḥ apratidhr̥ṣṭa-śavasam r̥ṣīṇām ca stutīḥ upa yajñam ca mānuṣāṇām
iti arvācīnam su te manaḥ grāvā kr̥ṇotu vagnunā
imam indra sutam piba jyeṣṭham amartyam madam śukrasya tvā abhi akṣaran dhārāḥ r̥tasya sādane
indrāya nūnam arcata ukthāni ca bravītana sutāḥ amatsuḥ indavaḥ jyeṣṭham namasyata sahaḥ
nakiḥ tvat rathītaraḥ harī yat indra yacchase nakiḥ tvā anu majmanā nakiḥ su-aśvaḥ ānaśe
yaḥ ekaḥ it vi-dayate vasu martāya dāśuṣe īśānaḥ aprati-skutaḥ indraḥ aṅga
kadā martam arādhasam padā kṣumpam-iva sphurat kadā naḥ śuśravat giraḥ indraḥ aṅga
yaḥ cit hi tvā bahu-bhyaḥ ā suta-vān āvivāsati ugram tat patyate śavaḥ indraḥ aṅga
svādoḥ itthā viṣu-vataḥ madhvaḥ pibanti gauryaḥ yāḥ indreṇa sa-yāvarīḥ vr̥ṣṇā madanti śobhase vasvīḥ anu sva-rājyam
tāḥ asya pr̥śana-yuvaḥ somam śrīṇanti pr̥śnayaḥ priyāḥ indrasya dhenavaḥ vajram hinvanti sāyakam vasvīḥ anu sva-rājyam
tāḥ asya namasā sahaḥ saparyanti pra-cetasaḥ vratāni asya saścire purūṇi pūrva-cittaye vasvīḥ anu sva-rājyam
indraḥ dadhīcaḥ astha-bhiḥ vr̥trāṇi aprati-skutaḥ jaghāna navatīḥ nava
icchan aśvasya yat śiraḥ parvateṣu apa-śritam tat vidat śaryaṇāvati
atra aha goḥ amanvata nāma tvaṣṭuḥ apīcyam itthā candramasaḥ gr̥he
kaḥ adya yuṅkte dhuri gāḥ r̥tasya śimī-vataḥ bhāminaḥ duḥ-hr̥ṇāyūn āsan-iṣūn hatsu-asaḥ maya-bhūn yaḥ eṣām bhr̥tyām r̥ṇadhat saḥ jīvāt
kaḥ īṣate tujyate kaḥ bibhāya kaḥ maṁsate santam indram kaḥ anti kaḥ tokāya kaḥ ibhāya uta rāye adhi bravat tanve kaḥ janāya
kaḥ agnim īṭe haviṣā ghr̥tena srucā yajātai r̥tu-bhiḥ dhruvebhiḥ kasmai devāḥ ā vahān āśu homa kaḥ maṁsate vīti-hotraḥ su-devaḥ
tvam aṅga pra śaṁsiṣaḥ devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam na tvat anyaḥ magha-van asti marḍitā indra bravīmi te vacaḥ
mā te rādhāṁsi mā te ūtayaḥ vaso iti asmān kadā cana dabhan viśvā ca naḥ upa-mimīhi mānuṣa vasūn i carṣaṇi-bhyaḥ ā
pra ye śumbhante janayaḥ na saptayaḥ yāman rudrasya sūnavaḥ su-daṁsasaḥ rodasī hi marutaḥ cakrire vr̥dhe madanti vīrāḥ vidatheṣu ghr̥ṣvayaḥ
te ukṣitāsaḥ mahimānam āśata divi rudrāsaḥ adhi cakrire sadaḥ arcantaḥ arkam janayantaḥ indriyam adhi śriyaḥ dadhire pr̥śni-mātaraḥ
go--mātaraḥ yat śubhayante añji-bhiḥ tanūṣu śubhrāḥ dadhire virukmataḥ bādhante viśvam abhi-mātinam apa vartmāni eṣām anu rīyate ghr̥tam
vi ye bhrājante su-makhāsaḥ r̥ṣṭi-bhiḥ pra-cyavayantaḥ acyutā cit ojasā manaḥ-juvaḥ yat marutaḥ ratheṣu ā vr̥ṣa-vrātāsaḥ pr̥ṣatīḥ ayugdhvam
pra yat ratheṣu pr̥ṣatīḥ ayugdhvam vāje adrim marutaḥ raṁhayantaḥ uta aruṣasya vi syanti dhārāḥ carma-iva uda-bhiḥ vi undanti bhūma
ā vaḥ vahantu saptayaḥ raghu-syadaḥ raghu-patvānaḥ pra jigāta bāhu-bhiḥ sīdatā barhiḥ uru vaḥ sadaḥ kr̥tam mādayadhvam marutaḥ madhvaḥ andhasaḥ
te avardhanta sva-tavasaḥ mahi-tvanā ā nākam tasthuḥ uru cakrire sadaḥ viṣṇuḥ yat ha āvat vr̥ṣaṇam mada-cyutam vayaḥ na sdan adhi barhiṣi priye
śūrāḥ-iva it yuyudhayah na jagmayaḥ śravasyavaḥ na pr̥tanāsu yetire bhayante viśvā bhuvanā marut-bhyaḥ rājānaḥ-iva tveṣa-sandr̥śaḥ naraḥ
tvaṣṭā yat vajram su-kr̥tam hiraṇyayam sahasra-bhr̥ṣṭim su-apāḥ avartayat dhatte indraḥ nari apāṁsi kartave ahan vr̥tram niḥ apām aubjat arṇavam
ūrdhvam nunudre avatam te ojasā dādr̥hāṇam cit bibhiduḥ vi parvatam dhamantaḥ vāṇam marutaḥ su-dānavah made somasya raṇyāni cakrire
jihmam nunudre avatam tayā diśā asiñcan utsam gotamāya tr̥ṣṇa-je ā gacchanti īm avasā citra-bhānavaḥ kāmam viprasya tarpayanta dhāma-bhiḥ
yā vaḥ śarma śaśamānāya santi tri-dhātūni dāśuṣe yacchata adhi asmabhyam tāni marutaḥ vi yanta rayim naḥ dhatta vr̥ṣaṇaḥ su-vīram
marutaḥ yasya hi kṣaye pātha divaḥ vi-mahasaḥ saḥ su-gopātamaḥ janaḥ
yajñaiḥ vā yajña-vāhasaḥ viprasya vā matīnām marutaḥ śr̥ṇuta havam
uta vā yasya vājinaḥ anu vipram atakṣata saḥ gantā go--mati vraje
asya vīrasya barhiṣi sutaḥ somaḥ diviṣṭiṣu uktham madaḥ ca śasyate
asya śroṣantu ā bhuvaḥ viśvāḥ yaḥ carṣaṇīḥ abhi sūram cit sasruṣīḥ iṣaḥ
pūrvībhiḥ hi dadāśima śarat-bhiḥ marutaḥ vayam avaḥ-bhiḥ carṣaṇīnām
su-bhagaḥ saḥ pra-yajyavaḥ marutaḥ astu martyaḥ yasya prayāṁsi parṣatha
śaśamānasya vā naraḥ svedasya satya-śavasaḥ vida kāmasya venataḥ
yūyam tat satya-śavasaḥ āviḥ karta mahi-tvanā vidhyata vi-dyutā rakṣaḥ
gūhata guhyam tamaḥ vi yāta viśvam atriṇam jyotiḥ karta yat uśmas i
pra-tvakṣasaḥ pra-tavasaḥ vi-rapśinaḥ anānatāḥ avithurāḥ r̥jīṣ iṇaḥ juṣṭa-tamāsaḥ nr̥-tamāsaḥ añji-bhiḥ vi ānajre ke cit usrāivastr̥bhiḥ
upa-hvareṣu yat acidhvam yayim vayaḥ-iva marutaḥ kena cit pathā ścotanti kośāḥ upa vaḥ ratheṣu ā ghr̥tam ukṣata madhu-varṇam arcate
pra eṣām ajmeṣu vithurāiva rejate bhūmiḥ yāmeṣu yat ha yuñjate śubhe te krīl̥ayaḥ dhunayaḥ bhrājat-r̥ṣṭayaḥ svayam mahi-tvam panayanta dhūtayaḥ
saḥ hi sva-sr̥t pr̥ṣat-aśvaḥ yuvā gaṇaḥ ayā īśānaḥ taviṣī-bhiḥ āv r̥taḥ asi satyaḥ r̥ṇa-yāvā anedyaḥ asyāḥ dhiyaḥ pra-avitā atha vr̥ṣā gaṇaḥ
pituḥ pratnasya janmanā vadāmasi somasya jihvā pra jigāti cakṣasā yat īm indram śami r̥kvāṇaḥ āśata āt it nāmāni yajñiyāni dadhire
śriyase kam bhānu-bhiḥ sam mimikṣire te raśmi-bhiḥ te r̥kva-bhiḥ su-khādayaḥ te vāśī-mantaḥ iṣmiṇaḥ abhīravaḥ vidre priyasya mārutasya dhāmnaḥ
ā vidyunmat-bhiḥ marutaḥ su-arkaiḥ rathebhiḥ yāta r̥ṣṭimat-bhiḥ aśva-parṇaiḥ ā varṣiṣṭhayā naḥ iṣā vayaḥ na paptata su-māyāḥ
te aruṇebhiḥ varam ā piśaṅgaiḥ śubhe kam yānti rathatūḥ-bhiḥ aśvaiḥ rukmaḥ na citraḥ svadhiti-vān pavyā rathasya jaṅghananta bhūma
śriye kam vaḥ adhi tanūṣu vāśīḥ medhā vanā na kr̥ṇavante ūrdhvā yuṣmabhyam kam marutaḥ su-jātāḥ tuvi-dyumnāsaḥ dhanayante adrim
ahāni gr̥dhrāḥ pari ā vaḥ ā aguḥ imām dhiyam vārkāryām ca devīm brahma kr̥ṇvantaḥ gotamāsaḥ arkaiḥ ūrdhvam nunudre utsa-dhim pibadhyai
etat tyat na yojanam aceti sasvaḥ ha yat marutaḥ gotamaḥ vaḥ paśyan hiraṇya-cakrān ayaḥ-daṁṣṭrān vi-dhāvataḥ varāhūn
eṣā syā vaḥ marutaḥ anu-bhartrī prati stobhati vāghataḥ na vāṇī astobhayat vr̥thā āsām anu svadhām gabhastyoḥ
ā naḥ bhadrāḥ kratavaḥ yantu viśvataḥ adabdhāsaḥ apari-itāsaḥ ut-bhidaḥ devāḥ naḥ yathā sadam it vr̥dhe asan apra-āyuvaḥ rakṣitāraḥ dive--dive
devānām bhadrā su-matiḥ r̥ju-yatām devānām rātiḥ abhi naḥ ni vartatām devānām sakhyam upa sedima vayam devāḥ naḥ āyuḥ pra tirantu jīvase
tān pūrvayā ni-vidā hūmahe vayam bhagam mitram aditim dakṣam asridham aryamaṇam varuṇam somam aśvinā sarasvatī naḥ su-bhagā mayaḥ karat
tat naḥ vātaḥ mayaḥ-bhu vātu bheṣajam tat mātā pr̥thivī tat pitā dyauḥ tat grāvāṇaḥ soma-sutaḥ mayaḥ-bhuvaḥ tat aśvinā śr̥ṇutam dhiṣṇyā yuvam
tam īśānam jagataḥ tasthuṣaḥ patim dhiyam-jinvam avase hūmahe vayam pūṣā naḥ yathā vedasam asat vr̥dhe rakṣitā pāyuḥ adabdhaḥ svastaye
svasti naḥ indraḥ vr̥ddha-śravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśva-vedāḥ svasti naḥ tārkṣyaḥ ariṣṭa-nemiḥ svasti naḥ br̥haspatiḥ dadhātu
pr̥ṣat-aśvāḥ marutaḥ pr̥śni-mātaraḥ śubham-yāvānaḥ vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ agni-jihvāḥ manavaḥ sūra-cakṣasaḥ viśve naḥ devāḥ avasā ā gaman iha
bhadram karṇebhiḥ śr̥ṇuyāma devāḥ bhadram paśyema akṣa-bhiḥ yajatrāḥ sth iraiḥ aṅgaiḥ tustu-vāṁsaḥ tanūbhiḥ vi aśema deva-hitam yat āyuḥ
śatam it nu śaradaḥ anti devāḥ yatra naḥ cakra jarasam tanūnām putrāsaḥ yatra pitaraḥ bhavanti mā naḥ madhyā ririṣata āyuḥ gantoḥ
aditiḥ dyauḥ aditiḥ antarikṣam aditiḥ mātā saḥ pitā saḥ putraḥ viśve devāḥ aditiḥ pañca janāḥ aditiḥ jātam aditiḥ jani-tvam
r̥ju-nītī naḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ nayatu vidvān aryamā devaiḥ sa-joṣāḥ
te hi vasvaḥ vasavānāḥ te apra-mūrāḥ mahaḥ-bhiḥ vratā rakṣante viśvāhā
te asmabhyam śarma yaṁsan amr̥tāḥ martyebhyaḥ bādhamānāḥ apa dviṣaḥ
vi naḥ pathaḥ suvitāya ciyantu indraḥ marutaḥ pūṣā bhagaḥ vandyāsaḥ
uta naḥ dhiyaḥ go--agrāḥ pūṣan viṣṇo uti eva-yāvaḥ karta naḥ svasti-mataḥ
madhu vātāḥ r̥tayate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ mādhvīḥ naḥ santu oṣadhīḥ
madhu naktam uta uṣasaḥ madhu-mat pārthivam rajaḥ madhu dyauḥ astu naḥ pitā
madhu-mān naḥ vanaspatiḥ madhu-mān astu sūryaḥ mādhvīḥ gāvaḥ bhavantu naḥ
śam naḥ mitraḥ śam varuṇaḥ śam naḥ bhavatu aryamā śam naḥ indraḥ br̥haspatiḥ śam naḥ viṣṇuḥ uru-kramaḥ
tvam soma pra cikitaḥ manīṣā tvam rajiṣṭham anu neṣi panthām tava pra-nītī pitaraḥ naḥ indo iti deveṣu ratnam abhajanta dhīrāḥ
tvam soma kratu-bhiḥ su-kratuḥ bhūḥ tvam dakṣaiḥ su-dakṣaḥ viśva-vedāḥ tvam vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣa-tvebhiḥ mahi-tvā dyumnebhiḥ dyumnī abhavaḥ nr̥-cakṣāḥ
rājñaḥ nu te varuṇasya vratāni br̥hat gabhīram tava soma dhāma śuciḥ tvam asi priyaḥ na mitraḥ dakṣāyyaḥ aryamāiva asi soma
yā te dhāmāni divi yā pr̥thivyām yā parvateṣu oṣadhīṣu ap-su tebhiḥ naḥ viśvaiḥ su-manāḥ ahel̥an rājan soma prati havyā gr̥bhāya
tvam soma asi sat-patiḥ tvam rājā uta vr̥tra-hā tvam bhadraḥ asi kratuḥ
tvam ca soma naḥ vaśaḥ jīvātum na marāmahe priya-stotraḥ vanaspatiḥ
tvam soma mahe bhagam tvam yūne r̥ta-yate dakṣam dadhāsi jīvase
tvam naḥ soma viśvataḥ rakṣa rājan agha-yataḥ na riṣyet tvāvataḥ sakhā
soma yāḥ te mayaḥ-bhuvaḥ ūtayaḥ santi dāśuṣe tābhiḥ naḥ avitā bhava
imam yajñam idam vacaḥ jujuṣāṇaḥ upa-āgahi soma tvam naḥ vr̥dhe bhava
soma gīḥ-bhiḥ tvā vayam vardhayāmaḥ vacaḥ-vidaḥ su-mr̥l̥īkaḥ naḥ ā viśa
gaya-sphānaḥ amīva-hā vasu-vit puṣṭi-vardhanaḥ su-mitraḥ soma naḥ bhava
soma rarandhi naḥ hr̥di gāvaḥ na yavaseṣu ā maryaḥ-iva sve okye
yaḥ soma sakhye tava raraṇat deva martyaḥ tam dakṣaḥ sacate kavi ḥ
uruṣya ṇaḥ abhi-śasteḥ soma ni pāhi aṁhasaḥ sakhā su-śevaḥ edhi naḥ
ā pyāyasva sam etu te viśvataḥ soma vr̥ṣṇyam bhava vājasya sam-gathe
ā pyāyāasva madin-tama soma viśvebhiḥ aṁśu-bhiḥ bhava naḥ suśravaḥ-tamaḥ sakhā vr̥dhe
sam te payāṁsi sam oṁ iti yantu vājāḥ sam vr̥ṣṇyāni abhimāti-sahaḥ āpyāyamānaḥ amr̥tāya soma divi śravāṁsi ut-tamāni dhiṣva
yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti tā te viśvā pari-bhūḥ astu yajñam gaya-sphānaḥ pra-taraṇaḥ su-vīraḥ avīra-hā pra cara soma duryān
somaḥ dhenum somaḥ arvantam āśum somaḥ vīram karmaṇyam dadāti sadanyam vidathyam sabheyam pitr̥-śravaṇam yaḥ dadāśat asmai
aṣāhvam yut-su pr̥tanāsu paprim svaḥ-sām apsām vr̥janasya gopām bhareṣu-jām su-kṣitim su-śravasam jayantam tvām anu madema soma
tvam imāḥ oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāḥ tvam apaḥ ajanayaḥ tvam gāḥ tvam ā tatantha uru antarikṣam tvam jyotiṣā vi tamaḥ vavartha
devena naḥ manasā deva soma rāyaḥ bhāgam sahasāvan abhi yudhya mā tvā tanat īśiṣe vīryasya ubhayebhyaḥ pra cikitsa go--iṣṭau
etāḥ oṁ iti tyāḥ uṣasaḥ ketum akrata pūrve ardhe rajasaḥ bhānum añjate niḥ-kr̥ṇvānāḥ āyudhāni-iva dhr̥ṣṇavaḥ prati gāvaḥ aruṣīḥ yanti mātaraḥ
ut apaptan aruṇāḥ bhānavaḥ vr̥thā su-āyujaḥ aruṣīḥ gāḥ ayukṣata akran uṣasaḥ vayunāni pūrvathā ruśantam bhānum aruṣīḥ aśiśrayuḥ
arcanti nārīḥ apasaḥ na viṣṭi-bhiḥ samānena yojanena ā parāvataḥ iṣam vahantīḥ su-kr̥te su-dānave viśvā it aha yajamānāya sunvate
adhi peśāṁsi vapate nr̥tūḥ-iva apa ūrṇute vakṣaḥ usrāiva barjaham jyotiḥ viśvasmai bhuvanāya kr̥ṇvatī gāvaḥ na vrajam vi uṣāḥ āvar ity āvaḥ tamaḥ
prati arciḥ ruśat asyāḥ adarśi vi tiṣṭhate bādhate kr̥ṣṇam abhvam svarum na peśaḥ vidatheṣu añjan citram divaḥ duhitā bhānum aśret
atāriṣma tamasaḥ pāram asya uṣāḥ ucchantī vayunā kr̥ṇoti śriye chandaḥ na smayate vi-bhātī su-pratīkā saumanasāya ajīgariti
bhāsvatī netrī sūnr̥tānām divaḥ stave duhitā gotamebhiḥ prajāvataḥ nr̥-vataḥ aśva-budhyān uṣaḥ go--agrān upa māsi vājān
uṣaḥ tam aśyām yaśasam su-vīram dāsa-pravargam rayim aśva-budhyam su-daṁsasā śravasā yā vi-bhāsi vāja-prasūtā su-bhage br̥hantam
viśvāni devī bhuvanā abhi-cakṣya pratīcī cakṣuḥ urviyā vi bhāti viśvam jīvam carase bodhayantī viśvasya vācam avidat manāyoḥ
punaḥ-punaḥ jāyamānā purāṇī samānam varṇam abhi śumbhamānā śvaghnī-iva kr̥tnuḥ vijaḥ āminānā martasya devī jarayantī āyuḥ
vi-ūrṇvatī divaḥ antān abodhi apa svasāram sanutaḥ yuyoti pra-m inatī manuṣyā yugāni yoṣā jārasya cakṣasā vi bhāti
paśūn na citrā su-bhagā prathānā sindhuḥ na kṣodaḥ urviyā vi aśvait aminatī daivyāni vratāni sūryasya ceti raśmi-bhiḥ dr̥śānā
uṣaḥ tat citram ā bhara asmabhyam vājinī-vati yena tokam ca tanayam ca dhāmahe
uṣaḥ adya iha go--mati aśva-vati vibhāvari revat asme vi uccha sūnr̥tāvati
yukṣva hi vājinī-vati aśvān adya aruṇān uṣaḥ atha naḥ viśvā saubhagāni ā vaha
aśvinā vartiḥ asmat ā go--mat dasrā hiraṇya-vat arvāk ratham sa-manasā ni yacchatam
yau itthā ślokam ā divaḥ jyotiḥ janāya cakrathuh ā naḥ ūrjam vahatam aśvinā yuvam
ā iha devā mayaḥ-bhuvā dasrā hiraṇyavartanī itihiraṇya-vartanī uṣaḥ-budhaḥ vahantu soma-pītaye
agnīṣomau imam su me śr̥ṇutam vr̥ṣaṇā havam prati su-uktāni haryatam bhavatam dāśuṣe mayaḥ
agnīṣomā yaḥ adya vām idam vacaḥ saparyati tasmai dhattam su-vīryam gavām poṣam su-aśvyam
agnīṣomā yaḥ āhutim yaḥ vām dāsāt haviḥ-kr̥tim saḥ pra-jayā su-vīryam viśvam āyuḥ vi aśnavat
agnīṣomā ceti tat vīryam vām yat amuṣṇītam avasam paṇim gāḥ ava atiratam br̥sayasya śeṣaḥ avindatam jyotiḥ ekam bahu-bhyaḥ
yuvam etāni divi rocanāni agniḥ ca soma sakratūitisa-kratū adhattam yuvam sindhūn abhi-śasteḥ avadyāt agnīṣomau amuñcatam gr̥bhītān
ā anyam divaḥ mātariśvā jabhāra amathnāat anyam pari śyenaḥ adreḥ agnīṣomā brahmaṇā vavr̥dhānā urum yajñāya cakrathuḥ oṁ iti lokam
agnīṣomā haviṣaḥ pra-sthitasya vītam haryatam vr̥ṣaṇā juṣethām su-śarmāṇā su-avasā hi bhūtam atha dhattam yajamānāya śam yoḥ
yaḥ agnīṣomā haviṣā saparyāt devadrīcā manasā yaḥ ghr̥tena tasya vratam rakṣatam pātam aṁhasaḥ viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam
agnīṣomā sa-vedasā sahūtī itisa-hūtī vanatam giraḥ sam deva-trā babhūvathuḥ
agnīṣomau anena vām yaḥ vām ghr̥tena dāśati tasmai dīdayatam br̥hat
agnīṣomau imāni naḥ yuvam havyā jujoṣatam ā yātam upa naḥ sacā
agnīṣomā pipr̥tam arvataḥ naḥ ā pyāyantām usriyāḥ havya-sūdaḥ asme iti balāni maghavat-su dhattam kr̥ṇutam naḥ adhvaram śruṣṭi-mantam
imam stomam arhate jāta-vedase ratham-iva sam mahema manīṣayā bhadrā hi naḥ pra-matiḥ asya sam-sadi agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
yasmai tvam āyajase saḥ sādhati anarvā kṣeti dadhate su-vīryam saḥ tūtāva na enam aśnoti aṁhatiḥ agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
śakema tvā sam-idham sādhaya dhiyaḥ tve devāḥ haviḥ adanti āhutam tvam ādityān ā vaha tān hi uśmasi agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
bharāma idhmam kr̥ṇavāma havīṁṣi te citayantaḥ parvaṇāparvaṇā vayam jīvātave pra-taram sādhaya dhiyaḥ agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
viśām gopāḥ asya caranti jantavaḥ dvi-pat ca yat uta catuḥ-pat aktu-bhiḥ citraḥ pra-ketaḥ uṣasaḥ mahān asi agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
tvam adhvaryuḥ uta hotā asi pūrvyaḥ pra-śāstā potā januṣā puraḥ-hitaḥ viśvā vidvān ārtvijyā dhīra puṣyasi agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
yaḥ viśvataḥ su-pratīkaḥ sa-dr̥ṅ asi dūre cit san tal̥it-iva ati rocase rātryāḥ cit andhaḥ ati deva paśyasi agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
pūrvaḥ devāḥ bhavatu sunvataḥ rathaḥ asmākam śaṁsaḥ abhi astu duḥ-dhyaḥ tat ā jānīta uta puṣyata vacaḥ agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
vadhaiḥ duḥ-śaṁsān apa duḥ-dhyaḥ jahi dūre vā ye anti vā ke cit atri ṇaḥ atha yajñāya gr̥ṇate su-gam kr̥dhi agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
yat ayukthāḥ aruṣā rohitā rathe vāta-jūtā vr̥ṣabhasya-iva te āt invasi vaninaḥ dhūma-ketunā agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
adha svanāt uta bibhyuḥ patatriṇaḥ drapsā yat te yavasa-adaḥ vi asthiran su-gam tat te tāvakebhyaḥ rathebhyaḥ agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
ayam mitrasya varuṇasya dhāyase ava-yātām marutām hel̥aḥ adbhutaḥ mr̥l̥a su naḥ bhūtu eṣām manaḥ punaḥ agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
devaḥ devānām asi mitraḥ adbhutaḥ vasuḥ vasūnām asi cāruḥ adhvare śarman syāma tava saprathaḥ-tame agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
tat te bhadram yat sam-iddhaḥ sve dame soma-āhutaḥ jarase mr̥l̥ayat-tamaḥ dadhāsi ratnam draviṇam ca dāśuṣe agne sakhye mā riṣāma vayam tava
yasmai tvam su-draviṇaḥ dadāśaḥ anāgāḥ-tvam adite sarva-tātā yam bhadreṇa śavasā codayāsi prajāvatā rādhasā te syāma
saḥ tvam agne saubhaga-tvasya vidvān asmākam āyuḥ pra tira iha deva tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
dve virūpeitivi-rūpe carataḥ svartheitisu-arthe anyāanyā vatsam upa dhāpayeteiti hariḥ anyasyām bhavati svadhāvān śukraḥ anyasyām dadr̥śe su-varcāḥ
daśa imam tvaṣṭuḥ janayanta garbham atandrāsaḥ yuvatayaḥ vi-bhr̥tram tigma-anīkam sva-yaśasam janeṣu vi-rocamānam pari sīm nayanti
trīṇi jānā pari bhūṣanti asya samudre ekam divi ekam ap-su pūrvām anu pra diśam pārthivānām r̥tūn pra-śāsat vi dadhau anuṣṭhu
kaḥ imam vaḥ niṇyam ā ciketa vatsaḥ mātr̥r̥ḥ janayata sva-dhābhiḥ bahvīnām garbhaḥ apasām upa-sthāt mahān kaviḥ niḥ carati svadhāvān
iti tvaṣṭuḥ bibhyatuḥ jāyamānāt pratīcī iti siṁham prati joṣayeteiti
ubhe iti bhadre iti joṣayeteiti na mene gāvaḥ na vāśrāḥ upa tasthuḥ evaiḥ saḥ dakṣāṇām dakṣa-patiḥ babhūva añjanti yam dakṣiṇataḥ haviḥ-bhiḥ
ut yaṁyamīti savitāiva bāhū iti ubhe iti sicau yatate bhīmaḥ r̥ñjan ut śukram atkam ajate simasmāt navā mātr̥-bhyaḥ vasanā jahāti
tveṣam rūpam kr̥ṇute ut-taram yat sam-pr̥ñcānaḥ sadane go--bhiḥ at-bhiḥ kaviḥ budhnam pari marmr̥jyate dhīḥ sā devatātā sam-itiḥ babhūva
uru te jrayaḥ pari eti budhnam vi-rocamānam mahiṣasya dhāma viśvebhiḥ agne svayaśaḥ-bhiḥ iddhaḥ adabdhebhiḥ pāyu-bhiḥ pāhi asmān
dhanvan srotaḥ kr̥ṇute gatum ūrmim śukraiḥ ūrmi-bhiḥ abhi nakṣati kṣām viśvā sanāni jaṭhareṣu dhatte antaḥ navāsu carati pra-sūṣu
eva naḥ agne sam-idhā vr̥dhānaḥ revat pāvaka śravase vi bhāhi tat naḥ mi traḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
saḥ pratna-thā sahasā jāyamānaḥ sadyaḥ kāvyāni baṭ adhatta viśvā āpaḥ ca mitram dhiṣaṇā ca sādhan devāḥ agnim dhārayan draviṇaḥ-dām
saḥ pūrvayā ni-vidā kavyatā āyoḥ imāḥ pra-jāḥ ajanayat manūnām vivasvatā cakṣasā dyām apaḥ ca devāḥ agnim dhārayan draviṇaḥ-dām
tam il̥ata prathamam yajña-sādham viśaḥ ārīḥ āhutam r̥ñjasānam ūrjaḥ putram bharatam sr̥pra-dānum devāḥ agnim dhārayan draviṇaḥ-dām
saḥ mātariśvā puruvāra-puṣṭiḥ vidat gātum tanayāya svaḥ-vit viśām gopāḥ janitā rodasyoḥ devāḥ agnim dhārayan draviṇaḥ-dām
naktoṣasā varṇam āmemyāneity āmemyāne dhāpayeteiti śiśum ekam samīcī itisam-īcī dyāvākṣāmā rukmaḥ antaḥ vi bhāti devāḥ agnim dhārayan draviṇaḥ-dām
rāyaḥ budhnaḥ sam-gamanaḥ vasūnām yajñasya ketuḥ manma-sādhanaḥ veḥ amr̥ta-tvam rakṣamāṇāsaḥ enam devāḥ agnim dhārayan draviṇaḥ-dām
nu ca purā ca sadanam rayīṇām jātasya ca jāyamānasya ca kṣām sataḥ ca gopām bhavataḥ ca bhūreḥ devāḥ agnim dhārayan draviṇaḥ-dām
draviṇaḥ-dāḥ draviṇasaḥ turasya draviṇaḥ-dāḥ sanarasya pra yaṁsat draviṇaḥ-dāḥ vīra-vatīm iṣam naḥ draviṇaḥ-dāḥ rāsate dīrgham āyuḥ
eva naḥ agne sam-idhā vr̥dhānaḥ revat pāvaka śravase vi bhāhi tat naḥ mi traḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
apa naḥ śośucat agham agne śuśugdhi ā rayim apa naḥ śośucat agham
su-kṣetriyā sugātu-yā vasu-yā ca yajāmahe apa naḥ śośucat agham
pra yat bhandiṣṭhaḥ eṣām pra asmākāsaḥ ca sūrayaḥ apa naḥ śośucat agham
pra yat te agne sūrayaḥ jāyemahi pra te vayam apa naḥ śośucat agham
pra yat agneḥ sahasvataḥ viśvataḥ yanti bhānavaḥ apa naḥ śośucat agham
tvam hi viśvataḥ-mukha viśvataḥ pari-bhūḥ asi apa naḥ śośucat agham
dviṣaḥ naḥ viśvataḥ-mukha ati nāvāiva pāraya apa naḥ śośucat agham
saḥ naḥ sindhum-iva nāvayā ati parṣa svastaye apa naḥ śośucat agham
vaiśvānarasya su-matau syāma rājā hi kam bhuvanānām abhi-śrīḥ itaḥ jātaḥ viśvam idam vi caṣṭe vaiśvānaraḥ yatate sūryeṇa
pr̥ṣṭaḥ divi pr̥ṣṭaḥ agniḥ pr̥thivyām pr̥ṣṭaḥ viśvāḥ oṣadhīḥ ā viveśa vaiśvānaraḥ sahasā pr̥ṣṭaḥ agniḥ saḥ naḥ divā saḥ riṣaḥ pātu naktam
vaiśvānara tava tat satyam astu asmān rāyaḥ maghavānaḥ sacantām tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
jata-vedase sunavāma somam arāti-yataḥ ni dahāti vedaḥ saḥ naḥ parṣat ati duḥ-gāni viśvā nāvāiva sindhum duḥ-itā ati agniḥ
saḥ yaḥ vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣṇyebhiḥ sam-okāḥ mahaḥ divaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ ca sam-rāṭ satīna-satvā havyaḥ bhareṣu marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
yasya anāptaḥ sūryasya-iva yāmaḥ bhare--bhare vr̥tra-hā śuṣmaḥ asti vr̥ṣan-tamaḥ sakhi-bhiḥ svebhiḥ evaiḥ marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
divaḥ na yasya retasaḥ dughānāḥ panthāsaḥ yanti śavasā apari-itāḥ tarat-dveṣāḥ sasahiḥ paiṁsyebhiḥ marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
saḥ aṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ aṅgiraḥ-tamaḥ bhūt vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣa-bhiḥ sakhi-bhiḥ sakhā san r̥gmi-bhiḥ r̥gmī gātu-bhiḥ jyeṣṭhaḥ marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
saḥ sūnu-bhiḥ na rudrebhiḥ r̥bhvā nr̥-sahye sasahvān amitrān sa-nīl̥ebhiḥ śravasyāni tūrvan marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
saḥ manyu-mīḥ sa-madanasya kartā asmākebhiḥ nr̥-bhiḥ sūryam sanat asmi n ahan sat-patiḥ puru-hūtaḥ marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
tam ūtayaḥ raṇayat śūra-sātau tam kṣemasya kṣitayaḥ kr̥ṇvata trām saḥ viśvasya karuṇasy a īśe ekaḥ marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
tam apsanta śavasaḥ ut-saveṣu naraḥ naram avase tam dhanāya saḥ andhe cit tamasi jyotiḥ vidat marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
saḥ savyena yamati vrādhataḥ cit saḥ dakṣiṇe sam-gr̥bhītā kr̥tāni saḥ kīriṇā cit sanitā dhanāni marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
saḥ grāmebhiḥ sanitā saḥ rathebhiḥ vide viśvābhiḥ kr̥ṣti-bhiḥ nu adya saḥ paiṁsyebhiḥ abhi-bhūḥ aśastīḥ marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
saḥ jāmi-bhiḥ yat sam-ajāti mīl̥he ajāmi-bhiḥ vā puru-hūtaḥ evaiḥ apām tokasya tanayasya jeṣe marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
saḥ vajra-bhr̥t dasyu-hā bhīmaḥ ugraḥ sahasra-cetāḥ śata-nīthaḥ r̥bhvā camrīṣaḥ na śavasā pāñca-janyaḥ marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
tasya vajraḥ krandati smat svaḥ-sāḥ divaḥ na tveṣaḥ ravathaḥ śimī-vān tam sacante sanayaḥ tam dhanāni marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
yasya ajasram śavasā mānam uktham pari-bhujat rodasī iti viśvataḥ sīm saḥ pāriṣat kratu-bhiḥ mandasānaḥ marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
na yasya devāḥ devatā na martā āpaḥ cana śavasaḥ antam āpuḥ saḥ pra-rikvā tvakṣasā kṣmaḥ divaḥ ca marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī
rohit śyāvā sumat-aṁśuḥ lalāmīḥ dyukṣā rāye r̥jra-aśvasya vr̥ṣaṇ-vantam bibhratī dhūḥ-su ratham mandrā ciketa nāhuṣīṣu vikṣu
etat tyat te indra vr̥ṣṇe uktham vārṣāgirāḥ abhi gr̥ṇanti rādhaḥ r̥jra-aśvaḥ praṣṭi-bhiḥ ambarīṣaḥ saha-devaḥ bhayamānaḥ su-rādhāḥ
dasyūn śimyūn ca puru-hūtaḥ evaiḥ hatvā pr̥thivyām śarvā ni barhīt sanat kṣetram sakhi-bhiḥ śvitnyebhiḥ sanat sūryam sanat apaḥ su-vajraḥ
viśvāhā indraḥ adhi-vaktā naḥ astu apari-hvr̥tāḥ sanuyāma vājam tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
pra mandine pitu-mat arcata vacaḥ yaḥ kr̥ṣṇa-garbhāḥ niḥ-ahan r̥jiśvanā avasyavaḥ vr̥ṣaṇam vajra-dakṣiṇam marutvantam sakhyāya havāmahe
yaḥ vi-aṁsam jahr̥ṣāṇena manyunā yaḥ śambaram yaḥ ahan piprum avratam indraḥ yaḥ śuṣṇam aśuṣam ni avr̥ṇak marutvantam sakhyāya havāmahe
yasya dyāvāpr̥thivī iti paiṁsyam mahat yasya vrate varuṇaḥ yasya sūryaḥ yasya indrasya sindhavaḥ saścati vratam marutvantam sakhyāya havāmahe
yaḥ aśvānām yaḥ gavām go--patiḥ vaśī yaḥ āritaḥ karmaṇi-karmaṇi sthiraḥ vīl̥oḥ cit indraḥ yaḥ asunvataḥ vadhaḥ marutvantam sakhyāya havāmahe
yaḥ viśvasya jagataḥ prāṇataḥ patiḥ yaḥ brahmaṇe prathamaḥ gāḥ avi ndat indraḥ yaḥ dasyūn adharān ava-atirat marutvantam sakhyāya havāmahe
yaḥ śūrebhiḥ havyaḥ yaḥ ca bhīru-bhiḥ yaḥ dhāvat-bhiḥ hūyate yaḥ ca jigyubhiḥ indram yam viśvā bhuvanā abhi sam-dadhuḥ marutvantam sakhyāya havāmahe
rudrāṇām eti pra-diśā vi-cakṣaṇaḥ rudrebhiḥ yoṣā tanute pr̥thu jrayaḥ indram manīṣā abhi arcati śrutam marutvantam sakhyāya havāmahe
yat vā marutvaḥ parame sadha-sthe yat vā avame vr̥jane mādayāse ataḥ ā yāhi adhvaram naḥ accha tvāyā haviḥ cakr̥ma satya-rādhaḥ
tvāyā indra somam susuma su-dakṣa tvāyā haviḥ cakr̥ma brahma-vāhaḥ adha ni-yutvaḥ sa-gaṇaḥ marut-bhiḥ asmin yajñe barhiṣi mādayasva
mādyasva hari-bhiḥ ye te indra vi syasva śipre vi sr̥jasva dheneiti ā tvā su-śipra harayaḥ vahantu uśan havyāni prati naḥ juṣasva
marut-stotrasya vr̥janasya gopāḥ vayam indreṇa sanuyāma vājam tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
imām te dhiyam pra bhare mahaḥ mahīm asya stotre dhiṣaṇā yat te ānaje tam ut-save ca pra-save ca sasahim indram devāsaḥ śavasā amadan anu
asya śravaḥ nadyaḥ sapta bibhrati dyāvākṣāmā pr̥thivī darśatam vapuḥ asme iti sūryācandramasā abhi-cakṣe śraddhe kam indra carataḥ vi-tarturam
tam sma ratham magha-van pra ava sātaye jaitram yam te anu-madāma sam-game ājā naḥ indra manasā puru-stuta tvāyat-bhyaḥ magha-van śamar yaccha naḥ
vayam jayema tvayā yujā vr̥tam asmākam aṁśam ut ava bhare--bhare asmabhyam indra varivaḥ su-gam kr̥dhi pra śatrūṇām magha-van vr̥ṣṇyā ruja
nānā hi tvā havamānāḥ janāḥ ime dhanānām dhartaḥ avasā vipanyavaḥ asmākam sma ratham ā tiṣṭha sātaye jaitram hi indra ni-bhr̥tam manaḥ tava
go--jitā bāhū iti amita-kratuḥ simaḥ karman-karman śata-mūrtiḥ khajam-karaḥ akalpaḥ indraḥ prati-mānam ojasā atha janāḥ vi hvayante sisāsavaḥ
ut te śatāt magha-van ut cabhūyasaḥ ut sahasrāt ririce kr̥ṣṭiṣu śravaḥ amātram tvā dhiṣaṇā titviṣe mahī adha vr̥trāṇi jighnase puram-dara
triviṣṭi-dhātu prati-mānam ojasaḥ tisraḥ bhūmīḥ nr̥-pate trīṇi rocanā at i idam viśvam bhuvanam vavakṣitha aśatruḥ indra januṣā sanāt asi
tvām deveṣu prathamam havāmahe tvam babhūtha pr̥tanāsu sasahiḥ saḥ imam naḥ kārum upa-manyum ut-bhidam indraḥ kr̥ṇotu pra-save ratham puraḥ
tvam jigetha na dhanā rurodhitha arbheṣu ājā magha-van mahat-su ca tvām ugram avase sam śiśīmasi atha naḥ indra havaneṣu codaya
viśvāhā indraḥ adhi-vaktā naḥ astu apari-hvr̥tāḥ sanuyāma vājam tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
tat te indriyam paramam parācaiḥ adhārayanta kavayaḥ purā idam kṣamā idam anyat divi anyat asya sam īm iti pr̥cyate samanāiva ketuḥ
saḥ dhārayat pr̥thivīm paprathat ca vajreṇa hatvā niḥ apaḥ sasarja ahan ahim abhinat rauhiṇam vi ahan vi-aṁsam magha-vā śacībhiḥ
saḥ jātū-bharmā śrat-dadhānaḥ ojaḥ puraḥ vi-bhindan acarat vi dāsīḥ vi dvān vajrin dasyave hetim asya āryam sahaḥ vardhaya dyumnam indra
tat ūcuṣe mānuṣā imā yugāni kīrtenyam magha-vā nāma bibhrat upa-prayan dasyu-hatyāya vajrī yat ha sūnuḥ śravase nāma dadhe
tat asya idam paśyata bhūri puṣṭam śrat indrasya dhattana vīryāya saḥ gāḥ avindat saḥ avindat aśvān saḥ oṣadhīḥ saḥ apaḥ saḥ vanāni
bhūri-karmaṇe vr̥ṣabhāya vr̥śṇe satya-śuṣmāya sunavāma somam yaḥ ādr̥tya pari-panthī-iva śūraḥ ayajvanaḥ vi-bhajan eti vedaḥ
tat indra pra ava vīryam cakartha yat sasantam vajreṇa abodhayaḥ ah im anu tvā patnīḥ hr̥ṣitam vayaḥ ca viśve devāsaḥ amadan anu tvā
śuṣṇam piprum kuyavam vr̥tram indra yadā avadhīḥ vi puraḥ śambarasya tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
yoniḥ te indra ni-sade akāri tam ā ni sīda svānaḥ na arvā vi-mucya vayaḥ ava-sāya aśvān doṣā vastoḥ vahīyasaḥ pra-pitve
o iti tye naraḥ indram ūtaye guḥ nu cit tān sadyaḥ adhvanaḥ jagamyāt devāsaḥ manyum dāsasya ścamnan te naḥ ā vakṣan su-vitāya varṇam
ava tmanā bharate keta-vedāḥ ava tmanā bharate phenam udan kṣīreṇa snātaḥ kuyavasya yoṣeiti hate iti te iti syātām pravaṇe śiphāyāḥ
yuyopa nābhiḥ uparasya āyoḥ pra pūrvābhiḥ tirate rāṣṭi śūraḥ añjasī kuliśī vīra-patnī payaḥ hinvānāḥ uda-bhiḥ bharante
prati yat syā nīthā adarśi dasyoḥ okaḥ na accha sadanam jānatī gāt adha sma naḥ magha-van carkr̥tāt it mā naḥ maghāiva niṣṣapī parā dāḥ
saḥ tvam naḥ indra sūrye saḥ ap-su anāgāḥ-tve ā bhaja jīva-śaṁse mā antarām bhujam ā ririṣaḥ naḥ śraddhitam te mahate indriyāya
adha manye śrat te asmai adhāyi vr̥ṣā codasva mahate dhanāya mā naḥ akr̥te puru-hūta yonau indra kṣudhyat-bhyaḥ vayaḥ āsutim dāḥ
mā naḥ vadhīḥ indra mā parā dāḥ mā naḥ priyā bhojanāni pra moṣīḥ āṇḍā mā naḥ magha-van śakra niḥ bhet mā naḥ pātrā bhet saha-jānuṣāṇi
arvāṅ ā ihi soma-kāmam tvā āhuḥ ayam sutaḥ tasya piba madāya uru-vyacāḥ jaṭhare ā vr̥ṣasva pitāiva naḥ śr̥ṇuhi hūyamānaḥ
candramāḥ ap-su antaḥ ā su-parṇaḥ dhāvate divi na vaḥ hiraṇya-nemayaḥ padam vindanti vi-dyutaḥ vittam me asya rodasī iti
artham it vai oṁ iti arthinaḥ ā jāyā yuvate patim tuñjāteiti vr̥ṣṇyam payaḥ pari-dāya rasam duhe vittam me asya rodasī iti
mo iti su devāḥ adaḥ svaḥ ava pādi divaḥ pari mā somyasya śam-bhuvaḥ śūne bhūma kadā cana vittam me asya rodasī iti
yajñam pr̥cchāmi avamam saḥ tat dūtaḥ vi vocati kva r̥tam pūrvyam gatam kaḥ tat bibharti nūtanaḥ vittam me asya rodasī iti
amī iti ye devaḥ sthana triṣu ā rocane divaḥ kat vaḥ r̥tam kat anr̥tam kva pratnā vaḥ āhutiḥ vittam me asya rodasī iti
kat vaḥ r̥tasya dharṇasi kat varuṇasya cakṣaṇam kat aryamṇaḥ mahaḥ pathā ati krāmema duḥ-ḍhyaḥ vittam me asya rodasī iti

yaḥ indrāgnī iti citra-tamaḥ rathaḥ vām abhi viśvāni bhuvanāni caṣṭe tena ā yātam sa-ratham tasthivāṁsā atha somasya pibatam sutasya
yāvat idam bhuvanam viśvam asti uru-vyacā varimatā gabhīram tāvān ayam pātave somaḥ astu aram indrāgnī iti manase yuva-bhyām

eva indrāgnī iti papi-vāṁsā sutasya viśvā asmabhyam sam jayatam dhanāni tat naḥ mi traḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
vi hi akhyam manasā vasyaḥ icchan indrāgnī iti jñāsaḥ uta vā sa-jātān na anyā yuvat pra-matiḥ asti mahyam saḥ vām dhiyam vāja-yantīm atakṣam
aśravam hi bhūridāvat-tarā vām vi-jāmātuḥ uta vā gha syālāt atha somasya pra-yatī yuva-bhyām indrāgnī iti stomam janayāmi navyam
mā chedma raśmīn iti nādhamānāḥ pitr̥r̥ṇām śaktīḥ anu-yacchamānāḥ indrāgni-bhyām kam vr̥ṣaṇaḥ madanti tā hi adrī iti dhiṣaṇāyāḥ upa-sthe
yuvābhyām devī dhiṣaṇā madāya indrāgnī iti somam uśatī sunoti tau aśvinā bhadra-hastā supāṇī itisu-pāṇī ā dhāvatam madhunā pr̥ṅktam ap-su
yuvām indrāgnī iti vasunaḥ vi-bhāge tavaḥ-tamā śuśrava vr̥tra-hatye tau āsadya barhiṣi yajñe asmin pra carṣaṇī iti mādayethām sutasya
pra carṣaṇi-bhyaḥ pr̥tanāhaveṣu pra pr̥thivyāḥ riricātheiti divaḥ ca pra sindhu-bhyaḥ pra giri-bhyaḥ mahi-tvā pra indrāgnī iti viśvā bhuvanā ati anyā
ā bharatam śikṣatam vajrabāhū itivajra-bāhū asmān indrāgnī avatam śacībhiḥ ime nu te raśmayaḥ sūryasya yebhiḥ sa-pitvam pitaraḥ naḥ āsan
puram-darā śikṣatam vajra-hastā asmān indrāgnī iti avatam bhareṣu tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥th ivī uta dyauḥ
tatam me apaḥ tat oṁ iti tāyate punariti svādiṣṭhā dhītiḥ ucathāya śasyate ayam samudraḥ iha v iśva-devyaḥ svāhākr̥tasya sam oṁ iti tr̥pṇuta r̥bhavaḥ
ābhogayam pra yat icchantaḥ aitana apākāḥ prāñcaḥ mama ke cit āpayaḥ saudhanvanāsaḥ caritasya bhūmanā agacchata savituḥ dāśuṣaḥ gr̥ham
tat savitā vaḥ amr̥ta-tvam ā asuvat agohyam yat śravayantaḥ aitana tyam cit camasam asurasya bhakṣaṇam ekam santam akr̥ṇuta catuḥ-vayam
viṣṭavī śamī taraṇi-tvena vāghataḥ martāsaḥ santaḥ amr̥ta-tvam ānaśuḥ saudhanvanāḥ r̥bhavaḥ sūra-cakṣasaḥ saṁvatsare sam apr̥cyanta dhīti-bhiḥ
kṣetram-iva vi mamuḥ tejanenam ekam pātram r̥bhavaḥ jehamānam upa-stutāḥ upa-mam nādhamānāḥ amartyeṣu śravaḥ icchamānāḥ
ā mānīṣām antarikṣasya nr̥-bhyaḥ srucāiva ghr̥tam juhavāma vidmanā taraṇi-tvā ye pituḥ asya saścire r̥bhavaḥ vājam aruhan divaḥ rajaḥ
r̥bhuḥ naḥ indraḥ śavasā navīyān r̥bhuḥ vājebhiḥ vasu-bhiḥ vasuḥ dadiḥ yuṣmākam devāḥ avasā ahani priye abhi tiṣṭhema pr̥tsutīḥ asunvatām
iti yuvānā pitarā akr̥ṇotana
vājebhiḥ naḥ vāja-sātau aviḍḍhi r̥bhumān indra citram ā darṣi rādhaḥ tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
takṣan ratham su-vr̥tam vidmanāapasaḥ takṣan harī iti indra-vāhā vr̥ṣaṇvasūitivr̥ṣaṇ-vasū takṣan pitr̥-bhyām r̥bhavaḥ yuvat vayaḥ takṣan vatsāya mātaram sacābhuvam
ā naḥ yajñāya takṣata r̥bhu-mat vayaḥ r̥tve dakṣāya su-prajāvatīm iṣam yathā kṣayāma sarva-vīrayā viśā tat naḥ śardhāya dhāsatha su indriyam
ā takṣata sātim asmabhyam r̥bhavaḥ sātim rathāya sātim arvate naraḥ sāti m naḥ jaitrīm sam maheta viśva-hā jāmim ajāmim pr̥tanāsu sakṣaṇim
r̥bhukṣaṇam indram ā huve ūtaye r̥bhūn vājān marutaḥ soma-pītaye ubhā mitrāvarūṇā nūnam aśvinā te naḥ hinvantu sātaye dhiye jiṣe
r̥bhuḥ bharāya sam śiśātu sātim samarya-jit vājaḥ asmān aviṣṭu tat naḥ mi traḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
īl̥e dyāvāpr̥thivī iti pūrva-cittaye agnim gharmam su-rucam yāman iṣṭaye yābhiḥ bhare kāram aṁśāya jinvathaḥ tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yuvoḥ dānāya su-bharāḥ asaścataḥ ratham ā tasthuḥ vacasam na mantave yābhiḥ dhiyaḥ avathaḥ karman iṣṭaye tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yuvam tāsām divyasya pra-śāsane viśām kṣayathaḥ amr̥tasya majmanā yābh iḥ dhenum asvam pinvathaḥ narā tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ pari-jmā tanayasya majmanā dviimātā tūrṣu taraṇiḥ vi-bhūṣati yābhiḥ tri-mantuḥ abhavat vi-cakṣaṇaḥ tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ rebham ni-vr̥tam sitam at-bhyaḥ ut vandanam airayatam svaḥ dr̥śe yābhiḥ kaṇvam pra sisāsantam āvatam tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ antakam jasamānam āaraṇe bhujyum yābhiḥ avyathi-bhiḥ jijinvathuḥ yābh iḥ karkandhum vayyam ca jinvathaḥ tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ śucanti dhanasām su-saṁsadam taptam gharmam omyāvantam atraye yābhiḥ pr̥ṣni-gum puru-kutsam āvatam tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ śacībhiḥ vr̥ṣaṇā parāvr̥jam pra andham śroṇam cakṣase etave kr̥thaḥ yābhiḥ vartikām grasitām amuñcatam tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ sindhum madhu-mantam asaścatam vasiṣṭham yābhiḥ ajarau ajinvatam yābhiḥ kutsam śrutaryam naryam āvatam tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ viśpalām dhana-sām atharvyam sahasra-mīl̥he ājau ajinvatam yābhiḥ vaśam aśvyam preṇim āvatam tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ sudānūitisu-dānū auśijāya vaṇije dīrgha-śravase madhu kośaḥ akṣarat kakṣī-vantam stotāram yābhiḥ āvatam tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ rasām kṣodasā udgaḥ pipinvathuḥ anaśvam yābhiḥ ratham āvatam jiṣe yābhiḥ tri-śokaḥ usriyāḥ ut-ājata tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ sūryam pari-yāthaḥ parāvati mandhātāram kṣaitra-patyeṣu āvatam yābhiḥ vipram pra bharat-vājam āvatam tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ mahām atithi-gvam kaśaḥ-juvam divaḥ-dāsam śambara-hatye āvatam yābhiḥ pūḥ-bhidye trasadasyum āvatam tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ vamram vi-pipānam upa-stutam kalim yābhiḥ vitta-jānim duvasyathaḥ yābhiḥ vi-aśvam uta pr̥thim āvatam tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ narā śayave yābhiḥ atraye yābhiḥ purā manave gātum īṣathuḥ yābhiḥ śārīḥ ājatam syūma-raśmaye tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ paṭharvā jaṭharasya majmanā agniḥ na adīdet citaḥ iddhaḥ ajman ā yābhiḥ śaryātam avathaḥ mahādhane tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ patnīḥ vi-madāya ni-ūhathuḥ ā gha vā yābhiḥ aruṇīḥ aśikṣatam yābhiḥ su-dāse ūhathuḥ su-devyam tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ śantātī itiśam-tātī bhavathaḥ dadāśuṣe bhujyum yābhiḥ avathaḥ yābhiḥ adhri-gum omyāvatīm su-bharām r̥ta-stubham tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ kr̥śānum asane duvasyathaḥ jave yābhiḥ yūnaḥ arvantam āvatam madhu priyam bharathaḥ yat saraṭ-bhyaḥ tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ naram goṣu-yudham nr̥-sahye kṣetrasya sātā tanayasya jinvathaḥ yābhiḥ rathān avathaḥ yābhiḥ arvataḥ tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
yābhiḥ kutsam ārjuneyam śatakratūitiśata-kratū pra turvītim pra ca dabhītim āvatam yābhiḥ dhvasantim puru-santim āvatam tābhiḥ oṁ iti su ūti-bhiḥ aśvinā ā gatam
apnasvatīm aśvinā vācam asme iti kr̥tam naḥ dasrā vr̥ṣaṇā manīṣām adyūtye avase ni hvaye vām vr̥dhe ca naḥ bhavatam vāja-sātau
dyu-bhiḥ aktu-bhiḥ pari pātam asmān ariṣṭebhiḥ aśvinā saubhagebhiḥ tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
idam śreṣṭham jyotiṣām jyotiḥ ā agāt citraḥ pra-ketaḥ ajaniṣṭa vi-bhvā yathā pra-sūtā savituḥ savāya eva rātrī uṣase yonim araik
ruśat-vatsā ruśatī śvetyā ā agāt araik oṁ iti kr̥ṣṇā sadanāni asyāḥ samānabandhūitisamāna-bandhū amr̥teiti anūcī iti dyāvā varṇam carataḥ āmināne ity āmināne
samānaḥ adhvā svasroḥ anantaḥ tam anyāanyā carataḥ devaśiṣṭeitideva-śiṣṭe na metheteiti na tasthatuḥ sumeke itisu-meke naktoṣāsā sa-manasā virūpeitivi-rūpe
bhāsvatī netrī sūnr̥tānām aceti citrā vi duraḥ naḥ āvar ity āvaḥ prar-pya jagat vi oṁ iti naḥ rāyaḥ akhyat uṣāḥ ajīgaḥ bhuvanāni viśvā
jihma-śye caritave maghonī ābhogaye iṣṭaye rāye oṁ iti tvam dabhram paśyat-bhyaḥ urviyā vi-cakṣe uṣāḥ ajīgaḥ bhuvanān i viśvā
kṣatrāya tvam śravase tvam mahīyai iṣṭaye tvam artham-iva tvam ityai vi-sadr̥śā jīvitā abhi-pracakṣe uṣāḥ ajīgaḥ bhuvanāni viśvā
eṣā divaḥ duhitā prati adarśi vi-ucchantī yuvatiḥ śukra-vāsāḥ viśvasya īśānā pārthivasya vasvaḥ uṣaḥ adya iha su-bhage vi uccha
parāyatīnām anu eti pāthaḥ āyatīnām prathamā śaśvatīnām vi-ucchantī jīvam ut-īrayantī uṣāḥ mr̥tam kam cana bodhayantī
uṣaḥ yat agnim sam-idhe cakartha vi yat āvaḥ cakṣasā sūryasya yat mānuṣān yakṣyamāṇān ajīgariti tat deveṣu cakr̥ṣe bhadram apnaḥ
kiyati ā yat samayā bhavāti yāḥ vi-ūṣuḥ yāḥ ca nūnam vi-ucchān anu pūrvāḥ kr̥pate vāvaśānā pra-dīdhyānā joṣam anyābhiḥ eti
īyuḥ te ye pūrva-tarām apaśyan vi-ucchantīm uṣasam martyāsaḥ asmābhiḥ oṁ iti nu prati-cakṣyā abhūt o iti te yanti ye aparīṣu paśyān
yāvayat-dveṣāḥ r̥ta-pāḥ r̥te--jāḥ sumna-varī sūnr̥tāḥ īrayantī su-maṅgalīḥ bibhratī deva-vītim iha adya uṣaḥ śreṣṭha-tamā vi uccha
śaśvat purā uṣāḥ vi uvāsa devī atho iti adya idam vi āvaḥ maghonī atho iti vi ucchāt ut-tarān anu dyūn ajarā amr̥tā carati svadhābhiḥ
vi añji-bhiḥ divaḥ ātāsu adyaut apa kr̥ṣṇām niḥ-nijam devī āvar ity āvaḥ pra-bodhayantī aruṇebhiḥ aśvaiḥ ā uṣāḥ yāti su-yujā rathena
āvahantī poṣyā vāryāṇi citram ketum kr̥ṇute cekitānā īyuṣīṇām upa-mā śaśvatīnām vi-bhātīnām prathamā uṣāḥ vi aśvait
ut īrdhvam jīvaḥ asuḥ naḥ ā agāt apa pra agāt tamaḥ ā jyotiḥ et i araik panthām yātave sūryāya aganma yatra pra-tirante āyuḥ
syūmanā vācaḥ ut iyarti vahniḥ stavānaḥ rebhaḥ uṣasaḥ vi-bhātīḥ adya tat uccha gr̥ṇate maghoni asme iti āyuḥ ni didīhi prajāvat
yāḥ go--matīḥ uṣasaḥ sarva-vīrāḥ vi-ucchanti dāśuṣe martyāya vāyoḥ-iva sūnr̥tānām ut-arke tāḥ aśva-dāḥ aśnavat soma-sutvā
mātā devānām aditeḥ anīkam yajñasya ketuḥ br̥hatī vi bhāhi praśasti-kr̥t brahmaṇe naḥ vi uccha naḥ jane janaya viśva-vāre
yat citram apnaḥ uṣasaḥ vahanti ījānāya śaśamānāya bhadram tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
imāḥ rudrāya tavase kapardine kṣayat-vīrāya pra bharāmahe matīḥ yathā śam asat dvi-pade catuḥ-pade viśvam puṣṭam grāme asmin anāturam
mr̥l̥a naḥ rudra uta naḥ mayaḥ kr̥dhi kṣayat-vīrāya namasā vidhema te yat śam ca yoḥ ca manuḥ āyeje pitā tat aśyāma tava rudra pra-nītiṣu
aśyāma te su-matim deva-yajyayā kṣayat-vīrasya tava rudra mīḍhavaḥ sumna-yan it viśaḥ asmākam ā cara ariṣṭa-vīrāḥ juhavāma te haviḥ
tveṣam vayam rudram yajña-sādham vaṅkum kavim avase ni hvayāmahe āre asmat daivyam hel̥aḥ asyatu su-matim it vayam asya ā vr̥ṇīmahe
divaḥ varāham aruṣam kapardinam tveṣam rūpam namasā ni hvayāmahe haste bibhrat bheṣajā vāryāṇi śarma varma chardiḥ asmabhyam yaṁsat
idam pitre marutām ucyate vacaḥ svādoḥ svādīyaḥ rudrāya vardhanam rāsva ca naḥ amr̥ta marta-bhojanam tmane tokāya tanayāya mr̥l̥a
mā naḥ mahāntam uta mā naḥ arbhakam mā naḥ ukṣantam uta mā naḥ ukṣitam mā naḥ vadhīḥ pitaram mā uta mātaram mā naḥ priyāḥ tanvaḥ rudra ririṣaḥ
mā naḥ toke tanaye mā naḥ āyau mā naḥ goṣu mā naḥ aśveṣu ririṣaḥ vīrān mā naḥ rudra bhāmitaḥ vadhīḥ haviṣmantaḥ sadam it tvā havāmahe
upa te stomān paśupāḥ-iva ā akaram rāsva pitaḥ marutām sumnam asme iti bhadrā hi te su-matiḥ mr̥l̥ayat-tamā atha vayam ava it te vr̥ṇīmahe
āre te go--ghnam uta puruṣa-ghnam kṣayat-vīra sumnam asme iti te astu mr̥l̥a ca naḥ adhi ca brūhi deva adha ca naḥ śarma yaccha dvi-barhāḥ
avocāma namaḥ asmai avasyavaḥ śr̥ṇotu naḥ havam rudraḥ marutvān tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
citram devānām ut agāt anīkam cakṣuḥ mitrasya varuṇasya agneḥ ā aprāḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti antarikṣam sūryaḥ ātmā jagataḥ tasthuṣaḥ ca
sūryaḥ devīm uṣasam rocamānām maryaḥ na yoṣām abhi eti paścāt yatra naraḥ deva-yantaḥ yugāni vi-tanvate prati bhadrāya bhadram
bhadrāḥ aśvāḥ haritaḥ sūryasya citrāḥ eta-gvāḥ anu-mādyāsaḥ namasyantaḥ divaḥ ā pr̥ṣṭham asthuḥ pari dyāvāpr̥thivī yanti sadyaḥ
tat sūryasya deva-tvam tat mahi-tvam madhyā kartoḥ vi-tatam sam jabhāra yadā it ayukta haritaḥ sadha-sthāy āt rātrī vāsaḥ tanute simasmai
tat mitrasya varuṇasya abhi-cakṣe sūryaḥ rūpam kr̥ṇute dyoḥ upa-sthe anantam anyat ruśat asya pājaḥ kr̥ṣṇam anyat haritaḥ sam bharanti
adya devāḥ ut-itā sūryasya niḥ aṁhasaḥ pipr̥ta niḥ avadyāt tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
nāsatyābhyām barhiḥ-iva pra vr̥ñje stomān iyarmi abhriyāiva vātaḥ yau arbhagāya vi-madāya jāyām senājuvā ni-ūhatuḥ rathena
vīl̥upatma-bhiḥ āśuhema-bhiḥ vā devānām vā jūti-bhiḥ śāśadānā tat rāsabhaḥ nāsatyā sahasram ājā yamasya pra-dhane jigāya
tugraḥ ha bhujyum aśvinā uda-meghe rayim na kaḥ cit mamr̥-vām ava ahāḥ tam ūhathuḥ naubhiḥ ātman-vatībhiḥ antarikṣaprut-bhiḥ apa-udakābh iḥ
tisraḥ kṣapaḥ triḥ ahā ativrajat-bhiḥ nāsatyā bhujyum ūhathuḥ pataṅgaiḥ samudrasya dhanvan ārdrasya pāre tri-bhiḥ rathaiḥ śatapat-bhiḥ ṣaṭ-aśvaiḥ
anārambhaṇe tat avīrayethām anāsthāne agrabhaṇe samudre yat aśvinā ūhathuḥ bhujyum astam śata-aritrān nāvam ātasthivāṁsam
yam aśvinā dadathuḥ śvetam aśvam agha-aśvāya śaśvat it svasti tat vām dātram mahi kīrtenyam bhūt paidvaḥ vājī sadam it havyaḥ aryaḥ
yuvam narā stuvate pajriyāya kakṣīvate aradatam puram-dhim kārotarāt śaphāt aśvasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ śatam kumbhān asiñcatam surāyāḥ
himena agnim ghraṁsam avārayethām pitu-matīm ūrjam asmai adhattam r̥bīse atrim aśvinā ava-nītam ut ninyathuḥ sarva-gaṇam svasti
parā avatam nāsatyā anudethām uccābudhnam cakrathuḥ jihma-bāram kṣaran āpaḥ na pāyanāya rāye sahasrāya tr̥ṣyate gotamasya
jujuruṣaḥ nāsatyā uta vavrim pra amuñcatam drāpim-iva cyavānāt pra atiratam jahitasya āyuḥ dasrā āt it patim akr̥ṇutam kanīnām
tat vām narā śaṁsyam rādhyam ca abhiṣṭi-mat nāsatyā varūtham yat v idvāṁsā nidhim-iva apa-gūl̥ham ut darśatāt ūpathuḥ vandanāya
tat vām narā sanaye daṁsaḥ ugram āviḥ kr̥ṇomi tanyatuḥ na vr̥ṣṭim dadhyaṅ ha yat madhu ātharvaṇaḥ vām aśvasya sīrṣṇā pra yat īm uvāca
ajohavīt nāsatyā karā vām mahe yāman puru-bhujā puram-dhiḥ śrutam tat śāsuḥ-iva vadhri-matyāḥ hiraṇya-hastam aśvinau adattam
āsnaḥ vr̥kasya vartikām abhīke yuvam narā nāsatyā amumuktam uto iti kavim puru-bhujā yuvam ha kr̥pamāṇam akr̥ṇutam vi-cakṣe
caritram hi veḥ-iva acchedi parṇam ājā khelasya pari-takmyāyām sadyaḥ jaṅghām āyasīm viśpalāyai dhane hite sartave prati adhattam
śatam meṣān vr̥kye cakṣadānam r̥jra-aśvam tam pitā andham cakāra tasmai akṣī iti nāsatyā vi-cakṣe ā adhattam dasrā bhiṣajau anarvan
ā vām ratham duhitā sūryasya kārṣma-iva atiṣṭhat arvatā jayantī viśve devāḥ anu amanyanta hr̥t-bhiḥ sam oṁ iti śriyā nāsatyā sacetheiti
yat ayātam divaḥ-dāsāya vartiḥ bharat-vājāya aśvinā hayantā revat uvāha sacanaḥ rathaḥ vām vr̥ṣabhaḥ ca śiṁśumāraḥ ca yuktā
rayim su-kṣatram su-apatyam āyuḥ su-vīryam nāsatyā vahantā ā jahnāvīm sa-manasā upa vājaiḥ triḥ ahnaḥ bhāgam dadhatīm ayātam
pari-viṣṭam jāhuṣam viśvataḥ sīm su-gebhiḥ naktam ūhathuḥ rajaḥ-bhiḥ vi-bhindunā nāsatyā rathena vi parvatān ajarayū iti ayātam
ekasyāḥ vastoḥ āvatam raṇāya vaśam aśvinā sanaye sahasrā niḥ ahatam ducchunāḥ indra-vantā pr̥thu-śravasaḥ vr̥ṣaṇau arātīḥ
śarasya cit ārcat-kasya avatāt ā nīcāt uccā cakrathuḥ pātave vāḥ śayave cit nāsatyā śacībhiḥ jasuraye staryam pipyathuḥ gām
avasyate stuvate kr̥ṣṇiyāya r̥ju-yate nāsatyā śacībhiḥ paśum na naṣṭam-iva darśanāya viṣṇāpvam dadathuḥ viśvakāya
daśa rātrīḥ aśivena nava dyūn ava-naddham śnathitam ap-su antariti vi-prutam rebham udani pra-vr̥ktam ut ninyathuḥ somam-iva sruveṇa
pra vām daṁsāṁsi asvinau avocam asya patiḥ syām su-gavaḥ su-vīraḥ uta paśyan aśnuvan dīrgham āyuḥ astam-iva it jarimāṇam jagamyām
madhvaḥ somasya aśvinā madāya pratnaḥ hotā ā vivāsate vām barh iṣmatī rātiḥ vi-śritā gīḥ iṣā yātam nāsatyā upa vājaiḥ
yaḥ vām aśvinā manasaḥ javīyān rathaḥ su-aśvaḥ viśaḥ ājigāti yena gacchathaḥ su-kr̥taḥ duroṇam tena narā vartiḥ asmabhyam yātam
r̥ṣim narau aṁhasaḥ pāñca-janyam r̥bīsāt atrim muñcathaḥ gaṇena minantā dasyoḥ aśivasya māyāḥ anu-pūrvam vr̥ṣaṇā codayantā
aśvam na gūl̥ham aśvinā duḥ-evaiḥ r̥ṣim narā vr̥ṣaṇā rebham ap-su sam tam riṇīthaḥ vi-prutam daṁsaḥ-bhiḥ na vām jūryanti pūrvyā kr̥tāni
suṣupvāṁsam na niḥ-r̥teḥ upa-sthe sūryam na dasrā tamasi kṣiyantam śubhe rukmam na darśatam ni-khātam ut ūpathuḥ aśvinā vandanāya
tat vām narā śaṁsyam pajriyeṇa kakṣīvatā nāsatyā parijman śaphāt aśvasya vājinaḥ janāya śatam kumbhān asiñcatam madhūnām
yuvam narā stuvate kr̥ṣṇiyāya viṣṇāpvam dadathuḥ viśvakāya ghoṣāyai cit pitr̥-sade duroṇe patim jūryantyai aśvinau adattam
yuvam śyāvāya ruśatīm adattam mahaḥ kṣoṇasya aśvinā kaṇvāya pra-vācyam tat vr̥ṣaṇā kr̥tam vām yat nārsadāya śravaḥ adhi-adhattam
puru varpāṁsi aśvinā dadhānā ni pedave ūhathuḥ āśum aśvam sahasra-sām vājinam aprati-itam ahi-hanam śravasyam tarutram
etāni vām śravasyā sudānūitisu-dānū brahma āṅgūṣam sadanam rodasyoḥ yat vām pajrāsaḥ aśvinā havante yatam iṣā ca viduṣe ca vājam
sūnoḥ mānena aśvinā gr̥ṇānā vājam viprāya bhuraṇā radantā agastye brahmaṇā vavr̥dhānā sam viśpalām nāsatyā arṇtm
kuha yāntā su-stutim kāvyasya divaḥ napātā vr̥ṣaṇā śayu-trā hiraṇyasya-iva kalaśam ni-khātam ut ūpathuḥ daśame aśvinā ahan
yuvam cyavānam aśvinā jarantam punaḥ yuvānam cakrathuḥ śacībhiḥ yuvoḥ ratham duhitā sūryasya saha śriyā nāsatyā avr̥ṇīta
yuvam tugrāya pūrvyebhiḥ evaiḥ punaḥ-manyau abhavatam yuvānā yuvam bhujyum arṇasaḥ niḥ samudrāt vi-bhiḥ ūhathuḥ r̥jrebhiḥ aśvaiḥ
ajohavīt aśvinā taugryaḥ vām pra-ūl̥haḥ samudram avyathiḥ jaganvān niḥ tam ūhathuḥ su-yujā rathena manaḥ-javasā vr̥ṣaṇā svasti
ajohavīt aśvinā vartikā vām āsnaḥ yat sīm amuñcatam vr̥kasya vi jayuṣā yayathuḥ sānu adre jātam viṣvācaḥ ahatam viṣeṇa
śatam meṣān vr̥kye mamahānam tamaḥ pra-ṇītam aśivena pitrā ā akṣī iti r̥jra-aśve aśvinau adhattam jyotiḥ andhāya cakrathuḥ vi-cakṣe
śunam andhāya bharam ahvayat sā vr̥kīḥ aśvinā vr̥ṣaṇā narā iti jāraḥ kanīnaḥ-iva cakṣadānaḥ r̥jra-aśvaḥ śatam ekam ca meṣān
mahī vām ūtiḥ aśvinā mayaḥ-bhūḥ uta srāmam dhiṣṇyā sam riṇīthaḥ atha yuvām it ahvayat puram-dhiḥ ā agacchatam sīm vr̥ṣaṇau avaḥ-bhiḥ
adhenum dasrā staryam vi-saktām apinvatam śayave aśvinā gām yuvam śacībhiḥ vi-madāya jāyām ni ūhathuḥ puru-mitrasya yoṣām
yavam vr̥keṇa aśvina vapantā iṣam duhantā manuṣāya dasrā abhi dasyum bakureṇa dhamantā uru jyotiḥ cakrathuḥ āryāya
ātharvaṇāya aśvinā dadhīce aśvyam śiraḥ prati airayatam saḥ vām madhu pra vocat r̥ta-yan tvāṣṭram yat dasrau api-kakṣyam vām
sadā kavī iti su-matim ā cake vām viśvāḥ dhiyaḥ aśvinā pra avatam me asme iti rayim nāsatyā br̥hantam apatya-sācam śrutyam rarāthām
hiraṇya-hastam caśvinā rarāṇā putram narā vadhri-matyāḥ adattam tridhā ha śyāvam aśvinā vi-kastam ut jīvase airayatam sudānūitisu-dānū
etāni vām aśvinā vīryāṇi pra pūrvyāṇi āyavaḥ avocan brahma kr̥ṇvantaḥ vr̥ṣaṇā yuva-bhyām su-vīrāsaḥ vidatham ā vadema
ā vām rathaḥ aśvinā śyena-patvā su-mr̥l̥īkaḥ sva-vān yātu arvāṅ yaḥ martyasya manasaḥ javīyān tri-vandhuraḥ vr̥ṣaṇā vāta-raṁhāḥ
tri-vandhureṇa tri-vr̥ta rathena tri-cakreṇa su-vr̥tā ā yātam arvāk pinvatam gāḥ jinvatam arvataḥ naḥ vardhayatam aśvinā vīram asme iti
pravat-yāmanā su-vr̥tā rathena dasrau imam śr̥ṇutam ślokam adreḥ kim aṅga vām prati avartim gamiṣṭhā āhuḥ viprāsaḥ aśvinā purājāḥ
ā vām śyenāsaḥ aśvinā vahantu rathe yuktāsaḥ āśavaḥ pataṅgāḥ ye ap-turaḥ divyāsaḥ na gr̥dhrāḥ abhi prayaḥ nāsatyā vahanti
ā vām ratham yuvatiḥ tiṣṭhat atra juṣṭavī narā duhitā sūryasya pari vām aśvāḥ vapuṣaḥ pataṅgāḥ vayaḥ vahantu aruṣāḥ abhīke
ut vandanam airatam daṁsanābhiḥ ut rebham dasrā vr̥ṣaṇā śacībhiḥ niḥ taugryam pārayathaḥ samudrāt punariti cyavānam cakrathuḥ yuvānam
yuvam atraye ava-nītāya taptam ūrjam omānam aśvinau adhattam yuvam kaṇvāya api-riptāya cakṣuḥ prati adhattam su-ṣṭutim jujuṣāṇā
yuvam dhenum śayave nādhitāya apinvatam aśvinā pūrvyāya amuñcatam vartikām aṁhasaḥ niḥ prati jaṅghām viśpalāyāḥ adhattam
yuvam śvetam pedave indra-jūtam ahi-hanam aśvinā adattam aśvam johūtram aryaḥ abhi-bhūtim ugram sahasra-sām vr̥ṣaṇam vīl̥u-aṅgam
tā vām narā su avase su-jātā havāmahe aśvinā nādhamānāḥ ā naḥ upa vasu-matā rathena giraḥ juṣāṇā suvitāya yātam
ā śyenasya javasā nūtanena asme iti yatam nāsatyā sajoṣāḥ have hi vām aśvinā rāta-havyaḥ śaśvat-tamāyāḥ uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭau
ā vām ratham puru-māyam manaḥ-juvam jīra-aśvam yajñiyam jīvase huve sahasra-ketum vaninam śatat-vasum śruṣṭī-vānam varivaḥ-dhām abhi prayaḥ
ūrdhvā dhītiḥ prati asya pra-yāmani adhāyi śasman sam ayante ā diśaḥ svadāmi gharmam prati yanti ūtayaḥ ā vām ūrjānī ratham aśvinā aruhat
sam yat mithaḥ paspr̥dhānāsaḥ agmata śubhe makhāḥ amitāḥ jāyavaḥ raṇe yuvoḥ aha pravaṇe cekite rathaḥ yat aśvinā vahathaḥ sūrim ā varam
yuvam bhujyum bhuramāṇam vi-bhiḥ gatam svayukti-bhiḥ ni-vahantā pitr̥-bhyaḥ ā yāsiṣṭam vartiḥ vr̥ṣaṇā vi-jenyam divaḥ-dāsāya mahi ceti vām avaḥ
yuvoḥ aśvinā vapuṣe yuvāyujam ratham vānī iti yematuḥ asya śardhyam ā vām pati-tvam sakhyāya jagmuṣī yoṣā avr̥ṇīta jenyā yuvām patī iti
yuvam rebham pari-sūteḥ uruṣyathaḥ himena gharmam pari-taptam atraye yuvam śayoḥ avasam pipyathuḥ gavi pra dīrgheṇa vandanaḥ tāri āyuṣā
yuvam vandanam niḥ-r̥tam jaraṇyayā ratham na dasrā karaṇā sam invathaḥ kṣetrāt ā vipram janathaḥ vipanyayā pra vām atra vidhate daṁsanā bhuvat
agacchatam kr̥pamāṇam parāvati pituḥ svasya tyajasā ni-bādhitam svaḥ-vatīḥ itaḥ ūtīḥ yuvoḥ aha citrāḥ abhīke abhavan abhiṣṭayaḥ
uta syā vām madhu-mat makṣikā arapat made somasya auśijaḥ huvanyati yuvam dadhīcaḥ manaḥ ā vivāsathaḥ atha śiraḥ prati vām aśvyam vadat
yuvam pedave puru-vāram aśvinā spr̥dhām śvetam tarutāram duvasyathaḥ śaryaiḥ abhi-dyum pr̥tanāsu dustaram carkr̥tyam indram-iva carṣaṇ i-saham
kā rādhat hotrā aśvinā vām kaḥ vām joṣe ubhayoḥ kathā vidhāti apra-cetāḥ
vidvāṁsau it duraḥ pr̥cchet avidvān itthā aparaḥ acetāḥ nu cit nu marte akrau
tā vidvāṁsā havāmahe vām tā naḥ vidvāṁsā manma vocetam adya pra ārcat dayamānaḥ yuvākuḥ
vi pr̥cchāmi pākyā na devān vaṣaṭ-kr̥tasya adbhutasya dasrā pātam ca sahyasaḥ yuvam ca rabhyasaḥ naḥ
pra yā ghoṣe bhr̥gavāṇe na śobhe yayā vācā yajati pajriyaḥ vām pra iṣa-yuḥ na vidvān
śrutam gāyatram takavānasya ahan cit hi rirebha aśvinā vām ā akṣī iti śubhaḥ patī iti dan
yuvam hi āstam mahaḥ ran yuvam vā yat niḥ-atataṁsatam tā naḥ vasūiti su-gopā syātam pātam naḥ vr̥kāt agha-yoḥ
mā kasmai dhātam abhi amitriṇe naḥ mā akutra naḥ gr̥hebhyaḥ dhenavaḥ guḥ stana-bhujaḥ aśiśvīḥ
duhīyan mitra-dhitaye yuvāku rāye ca naḥ mimītam vāja-vatyai iṣe ca naḥ mimītam dhenu-matyai
aśvinoḥ asanam ratham anaśvam vājinī-vatoḥ tena aham bhūri cākana
ayam samaha mā tanu ūhyāte janān anu soma-peyam su-khaḥ rathaḥ
adha svapnasya niḥ vide abhuñjataḥ ca revataḥ ubhā tā basri naśyataḥ
kat itthā nr̥r̥n pātram deva-yatām śravat giraḥ aṅgirasām turaṇyan pra yat ānaṭ viśaḥ ā harmyasa uru kraṁsate adhvare yajatraḥ
stambhīt ha dyām saḥ dharuṇam pruṣāyat r̥bhuḥ vājāya draviṇan naraḥ goḥ anu sva-jām mahiṣaḥ cakṣata vrām menām aśvasya pari mātaram goḥ
nakṣat havam aruṇīḥ pūrvyam rāṭ turaḥ viśām aṅgirasām anu dyūn takṣat vajram ni-yutam tastambhat dyām catuḥ-pade naryāya dvi-pāde
asya made svaryam dāḥ r̥tāya api-vr̥tam usriyāṇām anīkam yat ha pra-sarge tri-kakup ni-vartat apa druhaḥ mānuṣasya duraḥ varit i
tubhyam payaḥ yat pitarau anītām rādhaḥ su-retaḥ turaṇe bhuraṇyū iti śuci yat te rekṇaḥ ayajanta sabaḥ-dughāyāḥ payaḥ usriyāyāḥ
adha pra jajñe taraṇiḥ mamattu pra roci asyāḥ uṣasaḥ na sūraḥ induḥ yebhiḥ āṣṭa sva-iduhavyaiḥ sruveṇa siñcan jaraṇā abhi dhāma
su-idhmā yat vana-dhitiḥ apasyāt sūraḥ adhvare pari rodhanā goḥ yat ha pra-bhāsi kr̥tvyān anu dyūn anarviśe paśu-iṣe turāya
aṣṭā mahaḥ divaḥ ādaḥ harī iti iha dyumna-saham abhi yodhānaḥ utsam harim yat te mandinam dhukṣan vr̥dhe go--rabhasam adri-bhiḥ vātāpyam
tvam āyasam prati vartayaḥ goḥ divaḥ aśmānam upa-nītam r̥bhvā kutsāya yatra puru-hūta vanvan śuṣṇam anantaiḥ pari-yāsi vadhaiḥ
purā yat sūraḥ tamasaḥ api-iteḥ tam adri-vaḥ phali-gam hetim asya śuṣṇasya cit pari-hitam yat ojaḥ divaḥ pari su-grathitam tat ā adar ity adaḥ
anu tvā mahī iti pājasī iti acakre iti dyāvākṣāmā madatām indra karman tvam vr̥tram āśayānam sirāsu mahaḥ vajreṇa sisvapaḥ varāhum
tvam indra naryaḥ yān avaḥ nr̥r̥n tiṣṭha vātasya su-yutaḥ vahiṣṭhān yam te kāvyaḥ uśanā mandinam dāt vr̥tra-hanam pāryam tatakṣa vajram
tvam sūraḥ haritaḥ ramayaḥ nr̥r̥n bharat cakram etaśaḥ na ayam indra pra-asya pāram navatim nāvyānām api kartam / ayajyūn
tvam naḥ asyāḥ indra duḥ-hanāyāḥ pāhi vajri-vaḥ duḥ-itāt abhīke pra naḥ vājān rathyaḥ aśva-budhyān iṣe yandhi śravase sūnr̥tāyai
mā sā te asmat su-matiḥ vi dasat vāja-pramahaḥ sam iṣaḥ varanta ā naḥ bhaja magha-van goṣu aryaḥ maṁhiṣṭhāḥ te sadha-mādaḥ syāma
pra vaḥ pāntam raghu-manyavaḥ andhaḥ yajñam rudrāya mīl̥huṣe bharadhvam divaḥ astoṣi asurasya vīraiḥ iṣudhyāiva marutaḥ rodasyoḥ
patnī-iva pūrva-hūtim vavr̥dhadhyai uṣasānaktā purudhā vidāneiti starīḥ na atkam vi-utam vasānā sūryasya śriyā su-dr̥śī hiraṇyaiḥ
mamattu naḥ pari-jmā vasarhā mamattu vātaḥ apām vr̥ṣaṇ-vān śiśītam indrāparvatā yuvam naḥ tat naḥ viśve varivasyantu devāḥ
uta tyā me yaśasā śvetanāyai vyantā pāntā auśijaḥ huvadhyai pra vaḥ napātam apām kr̥ṇudhvam pra mātarā rāspinasya āyoḥ
ā vaḥ ruvaṇyum auśijaḥ huvadhyai ghoṣāiva śaṁsam arjunasya naṁśe pra vaḥ pūṣṇe dāvane ā accha voceya vasu-tātim agneḥ
śrutam me mitrāvaruṇā havā imā uta śrutam sadane viśvataḥ sīm śrotu naḥ śrotu-rātiḥ su-śrotuḥ su-kṣetrā sindhuḥ at-bhiḥ
stuṣe sā vām varuṇa mitra rātiḥ gavām śatā pr̥kṣa-yāmeṣu pajre śruta-rathe priya-rathe dadhānāḥ sadyaḥ puṣṭim ni-rundhānāsaḥ agman
asya stuṣe mahi-maghasya rādhaḥ sacā sanema nahuṣaḥ su-vīrāḥ janaḥ yaḥ pajrebhyaḥ vājinī-vān aśva-vataḥ rathinaḥ mahyam sūr iḥ
janaḥ yaḥ mitrāvaruṇau abhi-dhruk apaḥ na vām sunoti akṣṇayādhruk svayam saḥ yakṣmam hr̥daye ni dhatta āpa yat īm hotrābhiḥ r̥ta-vā
saḥ vrādhataḥ nahuṣaḥ dam-sujūtaḥ śardhaḥ-taraḥ narām gūrta-śravāḥ visr̥ṣṭa-rātiḥ yāti bāl̥ha-sr̥tvā viśvāsu pr̥t-su sadam it śūraḥ
adha gmanta nahuṣaḥ havam sūreḥ śrota rājānaḥ amr̥tasya mandrāḥ nabhaḥ-juvaḥ yat niravasya rādhaḥ pra-śastaye mahinā ratha-vate
etam śardham dhāma yasya sūreḥ iti avocan daśa-tayasya naṁśe dyumnāni yeṣu vasu-tātiḥ raran viśve sanvantu pra-bhr̥theṣu vājam
mandāmahe daśa-tayasya dhāseḥ dviḥ yat pañca bibhrataḥ yanti annā kim iṣṭa-aśvaḥ iṣṭa-raśmiḥ ete īśānāsaḥ taruṣaḥ r̥ñjate nr̥r̥n
hiraṇya-karṇam maṇi-grīvam arṇaḥ tam naḥ viśve varivasyantu devāḥ aryaḥ giraḥ sadyaḥ ā jagmuṣīḥ ā usrāḥ cākantu ubhayeṣu asme iti
catvāraḥ mā maśarśārasya śiśvaḥ trayaḥ rājñaḥ āyavasasya jiṣṇoḥ rathaḥ vām mitrāvaruṇā dīrgha-apsāḥ syūma-gabhastiḥ sūraḥ na adyaut
pr̥thuḥ rathaḥ dakṣiṇāyāḥ ayoji ā enam devāsaḥ amr̥tāsaḥ asthuḥ kr̥ṣṇāt ut asthāt aryā vi-hāyāḥ cikitsantī mānuṣāya kṣayāya
pūrvā viśvasmāt bhuvanāt abodhi jayantī vājam br̥hatī sanutrī uccā vi akhyat yuvatiḥ punaḥ-bhūḥ ā uṣāḥ agan prathamā pūrva-hūtau
yat adya bhāgam vi-bhajāsi nr̥-bhyaḥ uṣaḥ devi martya-trā su-jāte devaḥ naḥ atra savitā damūnāḥ anāgasaḥ vocati sūryāya
gr̥ham-gr̥ham ahanā yāti accha dive--dive adhi nāma dadhānā sisāsantī dyotanā śaśvat ā agāt agram-agram it bhajate vasūnām
bhagasya svasā varuṇasya jāmiḥ uṣaḥ sūnr̥te prathamā jarasva paścā saḥ dadhyāḥ yaḥ aghasya dhātā jayema tam dakṣiṇayā rathena
ut īratām sūnr̥tāḥ ut puram-dhīḥ ut agnayaḥ śuśucānāsaḥ asthuḥ spārhā vasūni tamasā apa-gūl̥hā āviḥ kr̥ṇvanti uṣasaḥ vi-bhātīḥ
apa anyat eti abhi anyat eti viṣurūpeitiviṣu-rūpe ahanī iti sam careteiti pari-kṣitoḥ tamaḥ anyā guhā akaḥ adyaut uṣāḥ śośucatā rathena
sa-dr̥śīḥ adya sa-dr̥śīḥ it oṁ iti śvaḥ dīrgham sacante varuṇasya dhāma anavadyāḥ triṁśatam yojanāni ekāekā kratum pari yanti sadyaḥ
jānatī ahnaḥ prathamasya nāma śukrā kr̥ṣṇāt ajaniṣṭa śvitīcī r̥tasya yoṣā na mināti dhāma ahaḥ-ahaḥ niḥ-kr̥tam ācarantī
kanyāiva tanvā śāśadānā eṣi devi devam iyakṣamāṇam sam-smayamānā yuvatiḥ purastāt āviḥ vakṣāṁsi kr̥ṇuṣe vi-bhātī
su-saṅkāśā mātr̥mr̥ṣṭāiva yoṣā āviḥ tanvam kr̥ṇuṣe dr̥śe kam bhadrā tvam uṣaḥ vi-taram vi uccha na tat te anyāḥ uṣasaḥ naśanta
aśva-vatīḥ go--matīḥ viśva-vārāḥ yatamānāḥ raśmi-bhiḥ sūryasya parā ca yanti punaḥ ā ca yanti bhadrā nāma vahamānāḥ uṣasaḥ
r̥tasya raśmim anu-yacchamānā bhadram-bhadram kratum asmāsu dhehi uṣaḥ naḥ adya su-havā vi uccha asmāsu rāyaḥ maghavat-su ca syuriti syuḥ
uṣāḥ ucchantī sam-idhāne agnau ut-yan sūryaḥ urviyā jyotiḥ aśret devaḥ naḥ atra savitā nu artham pra asāvīt dvi-pat pra catuḥ-pat ityai
aminatī daivyāni vratāni pra-minatī manuṣyā yugāni īyuṣīṇām upa-mā śaśvatīnām āyatīnām prathamā uṣāḥ vi adyaut
eṣā divaḥ duhitā prati adarśi jyotiḥ vasānā samanā purastāt r̥tasya panthām anu eti sādhu prajānatī-iva na diśaḥ mināti
upo iti adarśi śundhyuvaḥ na vakṣaḥ nodhāḥ-iva āviḥ akr̥ta priyāṇi adma-sat na sasataḥ bodhayantī śaśvat-tamā ā agāt punaḥ āīyuṣīṇām
pūrve ardhe rajasaḥ aptyasya gavām janitrī akr̥ta pra ketum vi oṁ iti prathate vi-taram varīyaḥ ā ubhā pr̥ṇantī pitroḥ upa-sthā
eva it eṣā puru-tamā dr̥śe kam na ajāmim na pari vr̥ṇakti jāmim arepasā tanvā śāśadānā na arbhāt īṣate na mahaḥ vi-bhātī
abhrātāiva puṁsaḥ eti pratīcī garta-āruk-iva sanaye dhanānām jāyāiva patye uśatī su-vāsāḥ uṣāḥ hasrāiva ni riṇīte apsaḥ
khasā svasre jyāyasyai yonim araik apa eti asyāḥ prati-cakṣya-iva vi-ucchantī raśmi-bhiḥ sūryasya añji aṅkte samanagāḥ-iva vrāḥ
āsām pūrvāsām aha-su svasr̥r̥r̥ṇām aparā pūrvām abhi eti paścāt tāḥ pratna-vat navyasīḥ nūnam asme iti revat ucchantu su-dināḥ uṣasaḥ
pra bodhaya uṣaḥ pr̥ṇataḥ maghoni abudhyamānāḥ paṇayaḥ sasantu revat uccha maghavat-bhyaḥ maghoni revat stotre sūnr̥te jārayantī
ava iyam aśvait yuvatiḥ purastāt yuṅkte gavām aruṇānām anīkam vi nūnam ucchāt asati pra ketuḥ gr̥ham-gr̥ham upa tiṣṭhāte agniḥ
ut te vayaḥ cit vasateḥ apaptan naraḥ ca ye pitu-bhājaḥ vi-uṣṭau amā sate vahasi bhūri vāmam uṣaḥ devi dāśuṣe martyāya
astoḍhavam stomyāḥ brahmaṇā me avīvr̥dhadhvam uśatīḥ uṣasaḥ yuṣmākam devīḥ avasā sanema sahasriṇam ca śatinam ca vājam
prātriti ratnam prātaḥ-itvā dadhāti tam cikitvān prati-gr̥hya ni dhatte tena prajām vardhayamānaḥ āyuḥ rāyaḥ poṣeṇa sacate su-vīraḥ
su-guḥ asat su-hiraṇyaḥ su-aśvaḥ br̥hat asmai vayaḥ indraḥ dadhāti yaḥ tvā āyantam vasunā prātaḥ-itvaḥ mukṣījayāiva padim ut-sināti
āyam adya su-kr̥tam prātaḥ icchan iṣṭeḥ putram vasumatā rathena aṁśoḥ sutam pāyaya matsarasya kṣayat-vīram vardhaya sūnr̥tābhiḥ
upa kṣaranti sindhavaḥ mayaḥ-bhuvaḥ ījānam ca yakṣyamāṇam ca dhenavaḥ pr̥ṇantam ca papurim ca śravasyavaḥ ghr̥tasya dhārāḥ upa yanti viśvataḥ
nākasya pr̥ṣṭhe adhi tiṣṭhati śritaḥ yaḥ pr̥ṇāti saḥ ha deveṣu gacchati tasmai āpaḥ ghr̥tam arṣanti sindhavaḥ tasmai iyam dakṣiṇā pinvate sadā
dakṣiṇāvatām it imāni citrā dakṣiṇāvatām divi sūryāsaḥ dakṣiṇāvantaḥ amr̥tam bhajante dakṣiṇāvantaḥ pra tirante āyuḥ
mā pr̥ṇantaḥ duḥ-itam enaḥ ā aran mā jāriṣuḥ sūrayaḥ su-vratāsaḥ anyaḥ teṣām pari-dhiḥ astu kaḥ cit apr̥ṇantam abhi sam yantu śokāḥ
amandān somān pra bhare manīṣā sindhau adhi kṣiyataḥ bhāvyasya yaḥ me sahasram amimīta savān atūrtaḥ rājā śravaḥ icchamānaḥ
śatam rājñaḥ nādhamānasya niṣkān śatam aśvān pra-yatān sadyaḥ ādam śatam kakṣīvān asurasya gonām divi śravaḥ ajaram ā tatāna
upa mā śyāvāḥ svanayena dattāḥ vadhū-mantaḥ daśa rathāsaḥ asthuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ sahasram anu gavyam ā agāt sanat kakṣīvān abhi-pitve ahnām
catvāriṁśat daśa-rathasya śoṇāḥ sahasrasya agre śreṇim nayanti mada-cyutaḥ kr̥śana-vataḥ atyān kakṣīvantaḥ ut amr̥kṣanta pajrāḥ
pūrvām anu pra-yatim ā dade vaḥ trīn yuktān aṣṭau ari-dhāyasaḥ gāḥ su-bandhavaḥ ye viśyāḥ-iva vrāḥ anasvantaḥ śravaḥ aiṣanta pajrāḥ
āgadhitā pari-gadhitā yā kaśīkāiva jaṅgahe dadāti mahyam yādurī yāśūnām bhojyā śatā
upa-upa me parā mr̥śa mā me dabhrāṇi manyathāḥ sarvā aham asmi romaśā gandhārīṇām-iva avikā
agnim hotāram manye dāsvantam vasum sūnum sahasaḥ jāta-vedasam vipram na jāta-vedasam yaḥ ūrdhvayā su-adhvaraḥ devaḥ devācyā kr̥pā ghr̥tasya vi-bhrāṣṭim anu vaṣṭi śociṣā ājuhvānasya sarpiṣaḥa
yajiṣṭham tvā yajamānāḥ huvema jyeṣṭham aṅgirasām vipra manma-bhiḥ viprebhiḥ śukra manma-bhiḥ parijmānam-iva dyām hotāram carṣaṇīnām śociḥ-keśam vr̥ṣaṇam yam imāḥ viśaḥ pra avantu jūtaye viśaḥ
saḥ hi puru cit ojasā virukmatā dīdyānaḥ bhavati druham-taraḥ paraśuḥ na druhantaraḥ vīl̥u cit yasya sam-r̥tau śruvat vanāiva yat sthiram niḥ-sahamāṇaḥ yamate na ayate dhanva-sahā na ayate
dr̥l̥hā cit asmai anu duḥ yathā vide tejiṣṭhābhiḥ araṇi-bhiḥ dāṣṭi avase agnaye dāśṭi avase pra yaḥ purūṇi gāhate takṣat vanāiva śociṣā sthirā cit annā ni riṇāti ojasā ni sthirāṇi cit ojsā
tam asya pr̥kṣam uparāsu dhīmahi naktam yaḥ sudarśa-taraḥ divātarāt apra-āyuṣe divātarāt āt asya āyuḥ grabhaṇa-vat vīl̥u śarma na sūnave bhaktam abhaktam avaḥ vyantaḥ ajarāḥ agnayaḥ vyantaḥ ajarāḥ

saḥ hi śardhaḥ na mārutam tuvi-svaṇiḥ apnasvatīṣu urvarāsu iṣṭaniḥ ārtanāsu iṣṭaniḥ ādat havyāni ādadiḥ yajñasya ketuḥ aharṇā adha sma asya harṣataḥ hr̥ṣīvataḥ viśve juṣanta panthām naraḥ śubhe na panthām
dvitā yat īm kīstāsaḥ abhi-dyavaḥ namasyantaḥ upa-vocanta bhr̥gavaḥ maśnantaḥ dāśā bhr̥gavaḥ agniḥ īśe vasūnām śuciḥ yaḥ dharṇiḥ eṣām priyān api-dhīn vaniṣīṣṭa medhiraḥ ā vaniṣīśṭa medhiraḥ
viśvāsām tvā viśām patim havāmahe sarvāsām samānam dam-patim bhuje satya-girvāhasam bhuje atithim mānuṣāṇām pituḥ na yasya āsayā amī iti ca viśve amr̥tāsaḥ ā vayaḥ havyā deveṣu ā vayaḥ
tvam agne sahasā sahan-tamaḥ śuṣmin-tamaḥ jāyase deva-tātaye rayiḥ na deva-tātaye śuṣmin-tamaḥ hi te madaḥ dyumnin-tamaḥ uta kratuḥ adha sma te pari caranti ajara śruṣṭīvānaḥ na ajara
pra vaḥ mahe sahasā sahasvate uṣaḥ-budhe paśu-se na agnaye stomaḥ babhūtu agnaye prati yat īm haviṣmān viśvāsu kṣāsu joguve agre rebhaḥ na jarate r̥ṣūṇām jūrṇiḥ hotā r̥ṣūṇām
saḥ naḥ nediṣṭham dadr̥śānaḥ ā bhara agne devebhiḥ sa-canāḥ su-cetunā mahaḥ rayaḥ su-cetunā mahi śaviṣṭha naḥ kr̥dhi sam-cakṣe bhuje asyai mahi stotr̥-bhyaḥ magha-van su-vīryam mathīḥ ugraḥ na śavasā
ayam jāyata manuṣaḥ dharīmaṇi hotā yajiṣṭhaḥ uśijām anu vratam agniḥ svam anu vratam viśva-śruṣṭiḥ sakhi-yate rayiḥ-iva śravasyate adabdhaḥ hotā ni sadat il̥aḥ pade pari-vītaḥ il̥aḥ pade
tam yajña-sādham api vātayāmasi r̥tasya pathā namasā haviṣmatā deva-tātā haviṣmatā saḥ naḥ ūrjām upa-ābhr̥ti ayā kr̥pā na jūryati yam mātariśvā manave parāvataḥ devam bhāritibhāḥ parāvataḥ
evena sadyaḥ pari eti pārthivam muhuḥ-gīḥ retaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ kanikradat dadhat retaḥ kanikradat śatam cakṣāṇaḥ akṣa-bhiḥ devaḥ vaneṣu turvaṇiḥ sadaḥ dadhānaḥ upareṣu sānuṣu agniḥ pareṣu sānuṣu
saḥ su-kratuḥ puraḥ-hitaḥ dame--dame agniḥ yajñasya adhvarasya cetati kratvā yajñasya cetati kratvā vedhāḥ iṣu-yate viśvā jātāni paspaśe yataḥ ghr̥ta-śrīḥ atithiḥ ajāyata vahniḥ vedhāḥ ajāyata
kratvā yat asya taviṣīṣu pr̥ñcate agneḥ avena marutām na bhojyā iṣirāya na bhojyā saḥ hi sma dānam invati vasūnām ca majmanā saḥ naḥ trāsate duḥ-itāt abhi-hnutaḥ śaṁsāt aghāt abhi-hnutaḥ
viśvaḥ vi-hāyāḥ aratiḥ vasuḥ dadhe haste dakṣiṇe taraṇiḥ na śiśrathat śravasyayā na śiśrathat viśvasmai it iṣudhyate deva-trā havyam ā ūhiṣe viśvasmai it su-kr̥te vāram r̥ṇvati agniḥ dvārā vi r̥ṇvati
saḥ mānuṣe vr̥jane śam-tamaḥ hitaḥ agniḥ yajñeṣu jenyaḥ na viśpatiḥ priyaḥ yajñeṣu viśpatih saḥ havyā mānuṣāṇām il̥ā kr̥tāni patyate saḥ naḥ trāsate varuṇasya dhūrteḥ mahaḥ devasya dhūrteḥ
agnim hotāram īl̥ate vasu-dhitim priyam cetiṣṭham aratim ni erire havya-vāham ni erire viśva-āyum viśva-vedasam hotāram yajatam kavi m devāsaḥ raṇvam avase vasu-yavaḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ raṇvam vasu-yavaḥ
yam tvam ratham indra medha-sātaye apakā santam iṣira pra-nayasi pra anavadya nayasi sadyaḥ cit tam abhiṣṭaye karaḥ vaśaḥ ca vājinam saḥ asmākam anavadya tūtujāna vedhasām imām vācam na vedhasām

saḥ śrudhi yaḥ sma pr̥tanāsu kāsu cit dakṣāyyaḥ indra bhara-hūtaye nr̥-bhiḥ asi pra-tāūrtaye nr̥-bhiḥ yaḥ śūraiḥ [svar iti] svaḥ sanitā yaḥ vipraiḥ vājam tarutā tam īśānāsaḥ iradhanta vājinam pr̥kṣam atyam na vājinam

dasmaḥ hi ṣma vr̥ṣaṇam pinvasi tvacam kam cit yāvīḥ ararum śūra martyam pari-vr̥ṇakṣi martyam indra uta tubhyam tat dive tat rudrāya sva-yaśase mitrāya vocam varuṇāya sa-prathaḥ su-mr̥l̥īkāya s-prathaḥ
asmākam vaḥ indram uśmasi iṣṭaye sakhāya viśva-āyum pra-saham yujam vājeṣu pra-saham yujam asmākam brahma ūtaye ava pr̥tsuṣu kāsu cit nahi tvā śatruḥ starate str̥ṇoṣi yam viśvam śatrum str̥ṇoṣi yam
ni su nama ati-matim kayasya cit tejiṣṭhābhiḥ araṇi-bhiḥ na ūti-bhiḥ ugrābhiḥ ugra ūti-bhiḥ neṣi ṇaḥ yathā purā anenāḥ śūra manyase viśvāni pūroḥ apa parṣi vahniḥ āsā vahniḥ naḥ accha
pra tat voceyam bhavyāya indave havyaḥ na yaḥ iṣa-vān manma rejati rakṣaḥ-hā manma rejati svayam saḥ asmat ā nidaḥ vadhaiḥ ajeta duḥ-matim ava sravet agha-śaṁsaḥ ava-taram ava kṣudram-iva sravet
vanema tat hotrayā citantyā vanema rayim rayi-vaḥ su-vīryam raṇvam santam su-vīryam duḥ-manmānam sumantu-bhiḥ ā īm iṣā pr̥cīmahi ā satyābhiḥ indram dyumnahūti-bhiḥ yajatram dyumnahūti-bhiḥ
pra-pra vaḥ asme iti svayaśaḥ-bhiḥ ūtī pari-varge indraḥ duḥ-matīnām darīman duḥ-matīnām svayam sā riṣayadhyai yā naḥ upa-īṣe atraiḥ hatā īm asat na vakṣati kṣiptā jūrṇiḥ na vakṣati
tvam naḥ indra rāyā parīṇasā yāhi pathā anehasā puraḥ yāhi arakṣasā sacasva naḥ parāke ā sacasva astam-īke ā pāhi naḥ dūrāt ārāt abhiṣṭi-bhiḥ sadā pāhi abhiṣṭibhiḥ
tvam naḥ indra rāyā tarūṣasā ugram cit tvā mahimā sakṣat avase mahe mitram na avase ojiṣṭha trātaḥ avittariti ratham kam cit amatyar anyam asmat ririṣeḥ kam cit adri-vaḥ ririkṣantam cit adri-vaḥ
pāhi naḥ indra su-stuta sridhaḥ ava-yātā sadam it duḥ-matīnām devaḥ san duḥ-matīnām hantā pāpasya rakṣasaḥ trātā viprasya māvataḥ adha hi tvā janitā jījanat vaso iti rakṣaḥ-hanam tvā jījanat vaso iti
ā indra / yāhi upa naḥ parāvataḥ na ayam accha vidathāni-iva sat-patiḥ astam rājāiva sat-patiḥ havāmahe tvā vayam prayasvantaḥ sute sacā putrāsaḥ na pitaram vāja-sātaye maṁhiṣṭham vāja-sātaye
piba somam indra suvānam adri-bhiḥ kośena siktam avatam na vaṁsagaḥ tatr̥ṣāṇaḥ na vaṁsagaḥ madāya haryatāya te tuviḥ-tamāya dhāyase ā tvā yacchantu haritaḥ na sūryam ahā viśvāiva sūryam
avindat divaḥ ni-hitam guhā nidhim veḥ na garbham pari-vītam aśmani anante antaḥ aśmani vrajam vajrī gavām-iva sisāsan aṅgiraḥ-tamaḥ apa avr̥ṇot iṣaḥ indraḥ pari-vr̥tāḥ dvāraḥ iṣaḥ pari-vr̥tāḥ
dādr̥hāṇaḥ vajram indraḥ gabhastyoḥ kṣadma-iva tigmam asanāya sam śyat ahi-hatyāya sam śyat sam-vivyānaḥ ojasā śavaḥ-bhiḥ indra majmanā taṣṭāiva vr̥kṣam vaninaḥ ni vr̥ścasi paraśvāiva ni vr̥ścasi
tvam vr̥thā nadyaḥ indra sartave accha samudram asr̥jaḥ rathān-iva vājayataḥ rathān-iva itaḥ ūtīḥ ayuñjata samānam artham akṣitam dhenūḥ-iva manave viśva-dohasaḥ janāya viśva-dohasaḥ
imām te vācam vasu-yantaḥ āyavaḥ ratham na dhīraḥ su-apāḥ atakṣ iṣuḥ sumnāya tvām atakṣiṣuḥ śumbhantaḥ jenyam yathā vājeṣu vipra vājinam atyam-iva śavase sātaye dhanā viśvā dhanāni sātaye
iti vajreṇa dāśuṣe nr̥to iti atithi-gvāya śambaram gireḥ ugraḥ ava abharat mahaḥ dhanāni dayamānaḥ ojasā viśvā dhanāni ojasā
indraḥ samat-su yajamānam āryam pra āvat viśveṣu śatam-ūtiḥ ājiṣu svaḥ-mīl̥heṣu ājiṣu manave śāsat avratān tvacam kr̥ṣṇām arandhayat dakṣam na viśvam tatr̥ṣāṇam oṣati ni arśasānam oṣcati
sūraḥ cakram pra vr̥hat jātaḥ ojasā pra pitve vācam aruṇaḥ muṣāyati īśānaḥ ā muṣāyati uśanā yat parāvataḥ ajagan ūtaye kave sumnāni viśvā manuṣāiva turvaṇiḥ ahā viśvāiva turvaṇiḥ
saḥ naḥ navyebhiḥ vr̥ṣa-karman ukthaiḥ purām dartaritidartaḥ pāyu-bhiḥ pāhi śagmaiḥ divaḥ-dāsebhiḥ indra stavānaḥ vavr̥dhīthāḥ ahobhiḥ-iva dyauḥ
indrāya hi dyauḥ asuraḥ anamnata indrāya mahī pr̥thivī varīma-bhiḥ dyumna-sātā varīma-bhiḥ indram viśve sa-joṣasaḥ devāsaḥ dadhire puraḥ indrāya viśvā savanāni mānuṣā rātāni santu mānuṣā

viśveṣu hi tvā savaneṣu tuñjate samānam ekam vr̥ṣa-manyavaḥ pr̥thak svaār̥ḥritisvaḥ saniṣyavaḥ pr̥thak tam tvā nāvam na parṣaṇi m śūṣasya dhuri dhīmahi indram na yajñaiḥ citayantaḥ āyavaḥ stomebhiḥ indram āyavaḥ
vi tvā tatasre mithunāḥ avasyavaḥ vrajasya sātā gavyasya niḥ-sr̥jaḥ sakṣantaḥ indra niḥ-sr̥jaḥ yat gavyantā dvā janā svaḥ yantā sam-ūhasi āviḥ karikrat vr̥ṣaṇam sacābhuvam vajram indra sacābhuvam
viduḥ te asya vīryasya pūravaḥ puraḥ yat indra śāradīḥ ava-at iraḥ sasahānaḥ ava-atiraḥ śāsaḥ tam indra martyam ayajyum śavasaḥ pate mahīm amuṣṇāḥ pr̥thivīm imāḥ apaḥ mandasānaḥ imāḥ apaḥ
āt it te asya vīryasya carkiran madeṣu vr̥ṣan uśijaḥ yat āvitha sakhi-yataḥ yat āvitha cakartha kāram ebhyaḥ pr̥tanāsu pra-vantave te anyām-anyām nadyam saniṣṇata śravasyantaḥ saniṣṇata
uto iti naḥ asyāḥ uṣasaḥ juṣeta hi arkasya bodhi haviṣaḥ havīma-bh iḥ svaḥ-sātā havīma-bhiḥ yat indra hantave mr̥dhaḥ vr̥ṣā vajrin ciketasi ā me asya vedhasaḥ navīyasaḥ manma śrudhi navīyasaḥ
tvam tam indra vavr̥dhānaḥ asma-yuḥ amitra-yantam tuvi-jāta martyam vajreṇa śūra martyam jahi yaḥ naḥ agha-yati śr̥ṇuṣva suśravaḥ-tamaḥ riṣṭam na yāman apa bhūtu duḥ-matiḥ viśvā apa bhūtu duḥ-matiḥ
tvayā vayam magha-van pūrvye dhane indratvāūtāḥ sasahyāma pr̥tanyataḥ vanuyāma vanuṣyataḥ nediṣṭhe asmin ahani adhi voca nu sunvate asmin yajñe vi cayema bhare kr̥tam vāja-yantaḥ bhare kr̥tam
svaḥ-jeṣe bhare āprasya vakmani uṣaḥ-budhaḥ svasmin añjasi krāṇasya svasmin añjasi ahan indraḥ yathā vide śīrṣṇāśīrṣṇā upa-vācyaḥ asma-trā te sadhryak santu rātayaḥ bhadrāḥ bhadrasy rātayaḥ

tat tu prayaḥ pratna-thā te śuśukvanam yasmin yajñe vāram akr̥ṇvata kṣayam r̥tasya vāḥ asi kṣayam vi tat voceḥ adha dvitā antariti paśyanti raśmi-bhiḥ saḥ gha vide anu indraḥ go--eṣaṇaḥ bandhukṣit-bhyaḥ go--eṣaṇaḥ

nu itthā te pūrvathā ca pra-vācyam yat aṅgiraḥ-bhyaḥ avr̥ṇoḥ apa vrajam indra śikṣan apa vrajam ebhyaḥ samānyā diśā asmabhyam jeṣi yotsi ca sunvat-bhyaḥ randhaya kam cit avratam hr̥ṇāyantam cit avratam
sam yat janān kratu-bhiḥ śūraḥ īkṣayat dhane hite taruṣanta śravasyavaḥ pra yakṣanta śravasyavaḥ tasmai āyuḥ prajāvat it bādhe arcanti ojasā indra okyam didhiṣanta dhītayaḥ devān accha na dhītayaḥ
yuvam tam indrāparvatā puraḥ-yudhā yaḥ naḥ pr̥tanyāt apa tam-tam it hatam vajreṇa tam-tam it hatam dūre cattāya chantsat gahanam yat inakṣat asmākam śatrūn pari śūra viśvataḥ darmā darṣīṣṭa vi śvataḥ
ubhe punāmi rodasī iti r̥tena druhaḥ dahāmi sam mahīḥ anindrāḥ abhi-vlagya yatra hatāḥ amitrāḥ vaila-sthānam pari tr̥l̥hāḥ aśeran
abhivlagya cit adri-vaḥ śīrṣā yātu-matīnām chindhi vaṭūriṇā padā mahāvaṭūriṇā padā
ava āsām magha-van jahi śardhaḥ yātu-matīnām vaila-sthānake arbhake mahāvailasthe arbhake
yāsām tisraḥ pañcāśataḥ abhi-vlaṅgaiḥ apa-avapaḥ tat su te manāyati takat su te manāyati
piśaṅga-bhr̥ṣṭim ambhr̥ṇam piśācim indra sam mr̥ṇa sarvam rakṣaḥ ni barhaya

avaḥ mahaḥ indra dadr̥hi śrudhi naḥ śuśoca hi dyauḥ kṣāḥ na bhīṣā adri-vaḥ ghr̥ṇāt na bhīṣā adri-vaḥ śuṣmin-tamaḥ hi śuṣmi-bhiḥ vadhaiḥ ugrebhiḥ īyase apuruṣa-ghnaḥ aprati-ita śūra satva-bhiḥ tri-saptaiḥ śūra satva-bhiḥ
vanoti hi sunvan kṣayam parīṇasaḥ sunvānaḥ hi sma yajati ava dviṣaḥ devānām ava dviṣaḥ sunvānaḥ it sisāsati sahasrā vājī avr̥taḥ sunvānāya indraḥ dadāti ābhuvam rayim dadāti ābhuvam
ā tvā juvaḥ rarahāṇāḥ abhi prayaḥ vāyo iti vahantu iha pūrva-pītaye somasya ūrdhvā te anu sūnr̥tā manaḥ tiṣṭhatu jānatī niyutvatā rathena ā yāhi dāvane vāyoiti makhasya dāvane

mandantu tvā mandinaḥ vāyo iti indavaḥ asmat krāṇāsaḥ su-kr̥tāḥ abhi-dyavaḥ go--bhiḥ krāṇāḥ abhi-dyavaḥ yat ha krāṇāḥ iradhyai dakṣam sacante ūtayaḥ sadhrīcīnāḥ n i-yutaḥ dāvane dhiyaḥ upa bruvate īm dhiyaḥ
vāyuḥ yuṅkte rohitā vāyuḥ aruṇā vāyuḥ rathe ajirā dhuri vol̥have vahiṣṭhā dhuri vol̥have pra bodhaya puram-dhim jāraḥ ā sasatīm-iva pra cakṣaya rodasī iti vāsaya uṣasaḥ śravase vāsaya uṣasaḥ
tubhyam uṣasaḥ śucayaḥ parāvati bhadrā vastrā tanvate dam-su raśmi ṣu citrā navyeṣu raśmiṣu tubhyam dhenuḥ sabaḥ-dughā viśvā vasūni dohate ajanayaḥ marutaḥ vakṣaṇābhyaḥ divaḥ ā vakṣaṇābhyaḥ
tubhyam śukrāsa śucayaḥ turaṇyavaḥ madeṣu ugrāḥ iṣaṇanta bhurvaṇi apām iṣanta bhurvaṇi tvām tsārī dasamānaḥ bhagam īṭe takva-vīye tvam viśvasmāt bhuvanāt pāsi dharmaṇā asuryāt pāsi dharmaṇā
tvam naḥ vāyo iti eṣām apūrvyaḥ somānām prathamaḥ pītim arhasi sutānām pītim arhasi uto iti vihutmatīnām viśām vavarjuṣīṇām viśvāḥ it te dhenavaḥ duhre āśiram ghr̥tam duhrcate āśiram
stīrṇam barhiḥ upa naḥ yāhi vītaye sahasreṇa ni-yutā niyutvate śatinībhiḥ niyutvate tubhyam hi pūrva-pītaye devāḥ devāya yemire pra te sutāsaḥ madhu-mantaḥ asthiran madāya kratve asthiran
tubhya ayam somaḥ pari-pūtaḥ adri-bhiḥ spārhā vasānaḥ pari kośam arṣati śukrā vasānaḥ arṣati tava ayam bhāgaḥ āyuṣu somaḥ deveṣu hūyate vaha vāyo iti ni-yutaḥ yāhi asma-yuḥ juṣāṇaḥ yāhi asma-yuḥ
ā naḥ niyut-bhiḥ śatinībhiḥ adhvaram sahasriṇībhiḥ upa yāhi vītaye vāyo iti havyāni vītaye tava ayam bhāgaḥ r̥tviyaḥ sa-raśmiḥ sūrye sacā adhvaryu-bhiḥ bharamāṇāḥ ayaṁsata vāyo iti śukrāḥ ayaṁsata

ā vām rathaḥ niyutvān vakṣat avase abhi prayāṁsi su-dhitāni vītaye vāyo iti havyāni vītaye pibatam madhvaḥ andhasaḥ pūrva-peyam hi vām hitam vāyo iti ā candreṇa rādhasā ā gatam indraḥ ca rādhasā ā gatam

ā vām dhiyaḥ vavr̥tyuḥ adhvarān upa imam indum marmr̥janta vājinam āśum atyam na vājinam teṣām pibatam asmayū ity asma-yū ā naḥ gantam iha ūtyā indravāyūiti sutānām adri-bhiḥ yuvam madāya vāja-dā yuvam
ime vām somāḥ ap-su ā sutāḥ iha adhvaryu-bhiḥ bharamāṇāḥ ayaṁsata vāyo iti śukrāḥ ayaṁsata ete vām abhi asr̥kṣata tiraḥ pavitram āśavaḥ yuvāyavaḥ ati romāṇi avyayā somāsaḥ ati avyayā
ati vāyo iti sasataḥ yāhi śaśvataḥ yatra grāvā vadati tatra gacchatam gr̥ham indraḥ ca gacchatam vi sūnr̥tā dadr̥śe rīyate ghr̥tam ā pūrṇayā ni-yutā yāthaḥ adhvaram indraḥ ca yāthaḥ adhvaram
atra aha tat vahetheiti madhvaḥ āhutim yam aśvattham upa-tiṣṭhanta jāyavaḥ asme iti te santu jāyavaḥ sākam gāvaḥ suvate pacyate yavaḥ na te vāyo iti upa dasyanti dhenavaḥ na apa dasyanti dhenavaḥ

ime ye te su vāyo iti bāhu-ojasaḥ antaḥ nadī iti te patayanti ukṣaṇaḥ mahi vrādhantaḥ ukṣaṇaḥ dhanvan cit ye anāśavaḥ jīrāḥ cit agirāokasaḥ sūryasya-iva raśmayaḥ duḥ-niyantavaḥ hastayoḥ duḥ-niyantavaḥ

pra su jyeṣṭham ni-cirābhyām br̥hat namaḥ havyam matim bharata mr̥l̥ayat-bhyām svādiṣṭham mr̥l̥ayat-bhyām tā sam-rājā ghr̥tāsutī itighr̥ta-āsutī yajñe--yajñe upa-stutā atha enoḥ kṣatram na kutaḥ cana ādhr̥ṣe deva-tvam nu cit ādhr̥ṣe

adarśi gātuḥ urave varīyasī panthāḥ r̥tasya sam ayaṁsta raśmi-bhiḥ cakṣuḥ bhagasya raśmi-bhiḥ dyukṣam mitrasya sādanam aryamṇaḥ varuṇasya ca atha dadhāteiti br̥hat ukthyam vayaḥ upa-stutyam br̥hat vayaḥ
jyotiṣmatīm aditim dhārayat--kṣitim svaḥ-vatīm ā saceteiti dive--dive jāgr̥-vāṁsā dive--dive jyotiśmat kṣatram āśāteiti ādityā dānunaḥ patī mitraḥ tayoḥ varuṇaḥ yātayat-janaḥ aryamā yātayat-janaḥ
ayam mitrāya varuṇāya śam-tamaḥ somaḥ bhūtu ava-pāneṣu ābhagaḥ devaḥ deveṣu ābhagaḥ tam devāsaḥ juṣerata viśve adya sa-joṣasaḥ tathā rājānā karathaḥ yat īmahe r̥ta-vānā yat īmahe
yaḥ mitrāya varuṇāya avidhat janaḥ anarvāṇam tam pari pātaḥ aṁhasaḥ dāśvāṁsam martam aṁhasaḥ tam aryamā abhi rakṣati r̥ju-yantam anu vratam ukthaiḥ yaḥ enoḥ pari-bhūṣati vratam stomaiḥ ābhūṣati vrtam
namaḥ dive br̥hate rodasībhyām mitrāya vocam varuṇāya mīl̥huṣe su-mr̥l̥īkāya mīl̥huṣe indram agnim upa stuhi dyukṣam aryamaṇam bhagam jyok jīvantaḥ pra-jayā sacemahi somasya ūtī sacemahi
