ūtī devānām viyam indra-vantaḥ maṁsīmahi sva-yaśasaḥ marut-bhiḥ agniḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ śarma yaṁsan tat aśyāma magha-vānaḥ vayam ca
suṣuma ā yātam adri-bhiḥ go--śrītāḥ matsarāḥ ime somāsaḥ matsarāḥ ime ā rājānā divi-spr̥śā asma-trā gantam upa naḥ ime vām mitrāvaruṇā go--āśiraḥ somāḥ śukrāḥ go--āśiraḥ
ime ā yātam indavaḥ somāsaḥ dadhi-āśiraḥ sutāsaḥ dadhi-āśiraḥ uta vām uṣasaḥ budhi sākam sūryasya raśmi-bhiḥ sutaḥ mitrāya varuṇāya pītaye cāruḥ r̥tāya pītaye
tām vām dhenum na vāsarīm aṁśum duhanti adri-bhiḥ somam duhanti adr i-bhiḥ asma-trā gantam upa naḥ arvāncā soma-pītaye ayam vām mitrāvaruṇā nr̥-bhiḥ sutaḥ somaḥ ā pītaye sutaḥ
pra-pra pūṣṇaḥ tuvi-jātasya śasyate mahi-tvam asya tavasaḥ na tandate stotram asya na tandate arcāmi sumna-yan aham anti-ūtim mayaḥ-bhuvam viśvasya yaḥ manaḥ āyuyuve makhaḥ devaḥ āyuyuve makhaḥ

pra hi tvā pūṣan ajiram na yāmani stomebhiḥ kr̥ṇve r̥ṇavaḥ yathā mr̥dhaḥ uṣṭraḥ na pīparaḥ mr̥dhaḥ huve yat tvā mayaḥ-bhuvam devam sakhyāya martyaḥ asmākam āṅgūṣām dyumninaḥ kr̥dhi vājeṣu dyumninaḥ kr̥dhi
yasya te pūṣan sakhye vipanyavaḥ kratvā cit santaḥ avasā bubhujr ire iti kratvā bubhujrire tām anu tvā navīyasīm ni-yutam rāyaḥ īmahe ahel̥amānaḥ uru-śaṁsa sarī bhava vāje--vāje sarī bhava
asyāḥ oṁ iti su naḥ upa sātaye bhuvaḥ ahel̥amānaḥ rari-vān aja-aśva śravasyatām aja-aśva o iti su tvā vavr̥tīmahi stome--bhiḥ dasma sādhu-bhiḥ nahi tvā pūṣan ati-manye āghr̥ṇe na te sakhyam apa-hnute
astu śrauṣaṭ puraḥ agnim dhiyā dadhe ā nu tat śardhaḥ divyam vr̥ṇīmahe indravāyū iti vr̥ṇīmahe yat ha krāṇā vivasyati nābhā sam-dāyi navyasī agha pra su naḥ upa yantu dhītayaḥ devān accha na dhītayaḥ

yat ha tyat mitrāvaruṇau r̥tāt adhi ādadātheity ādadāthe anr̥tam svena manyunā dakṣasya svena manyunā yuvoḥ itthā adhi sadma-su apaśyāma hiraṇyayam dhībhiḥ cana manasā svebhiḥ akṣa-bhiḥ somasya svebhiḥ akṣa-bhiḥ
yuvām somebhiḥ deva-yantaḥ aśvinā āśrāvayantaḥ-iva ślokam āyavaḥ yuvām havyā abhi āyavaḥ yuvoḥ viśvāḥ adhi śriyaḥ pr̥kṣaḥ ca viśva-vedasā pruṣāyante vām pavayaḥ hiraṇyaye rathe dasr hiraṇyaye
aceti dasrā vi oṁ iti nākam r̥ṇvathaḥ yuñjate vām ratha-yujaḥ diviṣṭiśu adhvasmānaḥ divi ṣṭiṣu adhi vām sthāma vandhure rathe dasrā hiraṇyaye pathāiva yantau anu-śāsatā rajaḥ añjasā sāsatā rajaḥ
śacībhiḥ naḥ śacīvasūitiśacī-vasū divā naktam daśasyatam mā vām rātiḥ upa dasat kadā cana asmat rātiḥ kadā cana
vr̥ṣan indra vr̥ṣa-pānāsaḥ indavaḥ ime sutāḥ adri-sutāsaḥ ut-bhi daḥ tubhyam sutāsaḥ ut-bhidaḥ te tvā mandantu dāvane mahe citrāya rādhase gīḥ-bhiḥ girvāhaḥ stavamānaḥ ā gahi su-mr̥l̥īkaḥ naḥ ā gahi
o iti su ṇaḥ agne śr̥ṇuhi tvam īl̥itaḥ devebhyaḥ bravasi yajñiyebhyaḥ rāja-bhyaḥ yajñiyebhyaḥ yat ha tyām aṅgiras-bhyaḥ dhenum devāḥ adattana vi tām duhre aryamā kartari sacā eṣaḥ tām veda meca sacā

mo iti su vaḥ asmat abhi tāni paiṁsyā sanā bhūvan dyumnāni mā uta jāri ṣuḥ asmat purā uta jāriṣuḥ yat vaḥ citram yuge--yuge navyam ghoṣāt amartyam asmāsu tat marutaḥ yat ca duḥ-taram dcidhr̥ta yat ca duḥ-taram
dadhyaṅ ha me januṣam pūrvaḥ aṅgirāḥ priya-medhaḥ kaṇvaḥ atriḥ manuḥ viduḥ te me pūrve manuḥ viduḥ teṣām deveṣu āyatiḥ asmākam teṣu nābhayaḥ teṣām padena mahi ā name girā indrāgnī itgi ā name girā
hotā yakṣat vaninaḥ vanta vāryam br̥haspatiḥ yajati venaḥ ukṣa-bhiḥ puru-vārebhiḥ ukṣa-bhiḥ jagr̥mbha dūre--ādiśam ślokam adreḥ adha tmanā adhārayat aririndāni su-kratuḥ puru sadmāni su-kratuḥ
ye devāsaḥ divi ekādaśa stha pr̥thivyām adhi ekādaśa stha apsu-kṣitaḥ mahinā ekādaśa stha te devāsaḥ yajñam imam juṣadhvam
vedi-sade priya-dhāmāya su-dyute dhāsim-iva pra bhara yonim agnaye vastreṇa-iva vāsaya manmanā śucim jyotiḥ-ratham śukra-varṇam tamaḥ-hanam
abhi dvi-janmā tri-vr̥t annam r̥jyate saṁvatsare vavr̥dhe jagdham īm iti punariti / anyasya āsā jihvayā jenyaḥ vr̥ṣā ni anyena vaninaḥ mr̥ṣṭa vāraṇaḥ
kr̥ṣṇa-prutau vevije iti asya sa-kṣitau ubhā tarete iti abhi mātarā śiśum prācājihvam dhvasayantam tr̥ṣu-cyutam ā sācyam kupayam vardhanam pituḥ
mumukṣvaḥ manave mānavasyate raghu-druvaḥ kr̥ṣṇa-sītāsaḥ oṁ iti juvaḥ asamanāḥ ajirāsaḥ raghu-syadaḥ vāta-jūtāḥ upa yujyante āśavaḥ
āt asya te dhvasayantaḥ vr̥thā īrate kr̥ṣṇam abhvam mahi varpaḥ karikrataḥ yat sīm mahīm avanim pra abhi marmr̥śat abhi-śvasan stanayan eti nānadat
bhūṣan na yaḥ adhi babhrūṣu namnate vr̥ṣāiva patnīḥ abhi eti roruvat ojāyamānaḥ tanvaḥ ca śumbhate bhīmaḥ na śr̥ṅgā davidhāva duḥ-gr̥r̥bh iḥ
saḥ sam-stiraḥ vi-ṣṭiraḥ sam gr̥bhāyati jānan eva jānatīḥ nityaḥ ā śaye punaḥ vardhante api yanti devyam anyat varpaḥ pitroḥ kr̥ṇvate sacā
tam agnuvaḥ keśinīḥ sam hi rebhire ūrdhvāḥ tasthuḥ mamruṣīḥ pra āyave punariti tāsām jarām pra-muñcan eti nānadat asum param janayan jīvam astr̥tam
adhīvāsam pari mātuḥ rihan aha tuvi-grebhiḥ satva-bhiḥ yāti vi jrayaḥ vayaḥ dadhat pat-vate rerihat sadā anu śyenī sacate vartaniḥ aha
asmākam agne maghavat-su dīdihi adha śvasīvān vr̥ṣabhaḥ damūnāḥ ava-asya śiśu-matīḥ adīdeḥ varma-iva yut-su pari-jarbhurāṇaḥ
idam agne su-dhitam duḥ-dhitāt adhi priyāt oṁ iti cit manmanaḥ preyaḥ astu te yat te śukram tanvaḥ rocate śuci tena asmabhyam vanase ratnam ā tvam
rathāya nāvam uta naḥ gr̥hāya nitya-aritrām pat-vatīm rāsi agne asmākam vīrān uta naḥ maghonaḥ janān ca yā pārayāt śarma yā ca
abhi naḥ agne uktham it juguryāḥ dyāvākṣāmā sindhavaḥ ca sva-gūrtāḥ gavyam yavyam yantaḥ dīrghā ahā iṣam varam aruṇyaḥ varanta
baṭ itthā tat vapuṣe dhāyi darśatam devasya bhargaḥ sahasaḥ yataḥ jani yat īm upa hvarate sādhate matiḥ r̥tasya dhenāḥ anayanta sa-srutaḥ
pr̥kṣaḥ vapuḥ pitu-mān nityaḥ ā śaye dvitīyam ā sapta-śivāsu mātr̥ṣu tr̥tīyam asya vr̥ṣabhasya dohase daśa-pramatim janayanta yoṣaṇaḥ
niḥ yat īm budhnāt mahiṣasya varpasaḥ īśānāsaḥ śavasā kranta sūrayaḥ yat īm anu pra-divaḥ madhvaḥ ādhave guhā santam mātariśvā mathāyati
pra yat pituḥ paramāt nīyate pari ā pr̥kṣudhaḥ vīrudhaḥ dam-su rohati ubhā yat asya januṣam yat invataḥ āt it yaviṣṭhaḥ abhavat ghr̥ṇā śuciḥ
āt it mātr̥r̥ḥ ā aviśat yāsu ā śuciḥ ahiṁsyamānaḥ urviyā vi vavr̥dhe anu yat pūrvā aruhat sanājuvaḥ ni navyasīṣu avarāsu dhāvate
āt it hotāram vr̥ṇate diviṣṭiṣu bhagam-iva papr̥cānāsaḥ r̥ñjate devān yat kratvā majmanā puru-stutaḥ martam śaṁsam viśvadhā veti dhāyase
vi yat asthāt yajataḥ vāta-coditaḥ hvāraḥ na vakvā jaraṇāḥ anākr̥taḥ tasya patman dakṣuṣaḥ kr̥ṣṇa-jaṁhasaḥ śuci-janmanaḥ rajaḥ ā vi-adhvanaḥ
rathaḥ na yātaḥ śikva-bhiḥ kr̥taḥ dyām aṅgebhiḥ aruṣebhiḥ īyate āt asya te kr̥ṣṇāsaḥ dhakṣi sūrayaḥ śūrasya-iva tveṣathāt īṣate vayaḥ
tvayā hi agne varuṇaḥ dhr̥ta-vrataḥ mitraḥ śāśadre aryamā su-dānavaḥ yat sīm anu kratunā viśva-thā vi-bhuḥ arān na nemiḥ pari-bhūḥ ajāyathāḥ
tvam agne śaśamānāya sunvate ratnam yaviṣṭha devatātim invasi tvam tvā nu navyam sahasaḥ yuvan vayam bhagam na kāre mahi-ratna dhīmahi
asme iti rayim na su-artham damūnasam bhagan dakṣam na papr̥cāsi dhaṇarsim raśmīn-iva yaḥ yamati janmanī iti ubhe iti devānām śaṁsam r̥te ā ca su-kratuḥ
uta naḥ su-dyotmā jīraaśvaḥ hotā mandraḥ śr̥ṇavat candra-rathaḥ saḥ naḥ neṣat neṣa-tamaiḥ amūraḥ agniḥ vāmam su-vitam vasyaḥ accha
astāvi agniḥ śimīvat-bhiḥ arkaiḥ sāmrājyāya pra-taram dadhānaḥ amī ca ye maghavānaḥ vayam ca miham na sūraḥ ati niḥ tanyuḥ
sam-iddhaḥ agne ā vaha devān adya yata-sruce tantum tanuṣva pūrvyam suta-somāya dāśuṣe
ghr̥ta-vantam upa māsi madhu-mantam tanū-napāt yajñam viprasya māvataḥ śaśamānasya dāśuṣaḥ
śuciḥ pāvakaḥ adbhutaḥ madhvā yajñam mimikṣati narāsaṁsaḥ triḥ ā divaḥ devaḥ deveṣu yajñiyaḥ
īl̥itaḥ agne ā vaha indram citram iha priyam iyam hi tvā matiḥ mama accha su-jihva vacyate
str̥ṇānāsaḥ yata-srucaḥ barhiḥ yajñe su-adhvare vr̥ñje devavyacaḥ-tamam indrāya śarma sa-prathaḥ
vi śrayantām r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ pra-yai deve--bhyaḥ mahīḥ pāvakāsaḥ puru-spr̥haḥ dvāraḥ devīḥ asaścataḥ
ā bhandamāneiti upāke iti naktoṣasā su-peṣasā yahvī iti r̥tasya mātarā sīdatām barhiḥ ā su-mat
mandra-jihvā jugurvaṇī iti hotārā daivyā kavī yajñam naḥ yakṣatām imam sidhram adya divi-spr̥śam
śuciḥ deveṣu arpitā hotrā marut-su bhāratī il̥ā sarasvatī mahī barhiḥ sīdantu yajñiyāḥ
tat naḥ turīpam adbhutam puru vā aram tmanā tvaṣṭā poṣāya vi syatu rāye nābhā naḥ asma-yuḥ
ava-sr̥jan upa tmanā devān yakṣi vanaspate agniḥ havyā susūdat i devaḥ deveṣu medhiraḥ
pūṣaṇ-vate marutvate viśva-devāya vāyave svāhā gāyatra-vepase havyam indrāya kartana
svāhākr̥tāni ā gahi upa havyāni vītaye indra ā gahi śrudhi havam tvām havante adhvare
pra tavyasīm navyasīm dhītim agnaye vācaḥ matim sahasaḥ sūnave bhare apām napāt yaḥ vasu-bhiḥ saha priyaḥ hotā pr̥thivyām ni asīdat r̥tviyaḥ
saḥ jāyamānaḥ parame vi-omani āviḥ agniḥ abhavat mātariśvane asya kratvā sam-idhānasya majmanā pra dyāvā śociḥ pr̥thivī iti arocayat
asya tveṣāḥ ajarāḥ asya bhānavaḥ su-sandr̥śaḥ su-pratīkasya su-dyutaḥ bhātvakṣasaḥ ati aktuḥ na sindhavaḥ agneḥ rejante asasantaḥ ajarāḥ
yam āīrire bhr̥gavaḥ viśva-vedasam nābhā pr̥thivyāḥ bhuvanasya majmanā agnim tam gīḥ-bhiḥ hinuhi sve ā dame yaḥ ekaḥ vasvaḥ varuṇaḥ na rājati
na yaḥ varāya marutām-iva svanaḥ senāiva sr̥ṣṭā divyā yathā aśaniḥ agniḥ jambhaiḥ tigitaiḥ atti bharvati na śatrūn saḥ vanā ni r̥ñjate
kuvit naḥ agniḥ ucathasya vīḥ asat vasuḥ kuvit vasu-bhiḥ kāmam āvarat codaḥ kuvit tutujyāt sātaye dhiyaḥ śuci-pratīkam tam ayā dhiyā gr̥ṇe
ghr̥ta-pratīkam vaḥ r̥tasya dhūḥ-sadam agnim mitram na sam-idhānaḥ r̥ñjate indhānaḥ akraḥ vidatheṣu dīdyat śukra-varṇām ut oṁ iti naḥ yaṁsate dhiyam
apra-yucchan aprayucchat-bhiḥ agne śivebhiḥ naḥ pāyu-bhiḥ pāhi śagmaiḥ adabdhebhiḥ adr̥pitebhiḥ iṣṭe animiṣat-bhiḥ pari pāhi naḥ jāḥ
eti pra hotā vratam asya māyayā ūrdhvām dadhānaḥ śuci-peśasam dhiyam abhi srucaḥ kramate dakṣiṇāāvr̥taḥ yāḥ asya dhāma prathamam ha niṁsate
abhi īm r̥tasya dohanāḥ anūṣata yonau devasya sadane pari-vr̥tāḥ apām upa-sthe vi-bhr̥taḥ yat ā avasat adha svadhāḥ adhayat yābhiḥ īyate
yuyūṣataḥ sa-vayasā tat it vapuḥ samānam artham vi-taritratā mithaḥ ādt īm bhagaḥ na havyaḥ sam asmat ā vol̥huḥ na raśmīn sam ayaṁsta sārathiḥ
yam īm dvā sa-vayasā saparyataḥ samāne yonā mithunā sam-okasā divā na naktam palitaḥ yuvā ajani puru caran ajaraḥ mānuṣā yugā
tam īm hinvanti dhītayaḥ daśa vriśaḥ devam martāsaḥ ūtaye havāmahe dhanoḥ adhi pra-vataḥ ā saḥ r̥ṇvati abhivrajat-bhiḥ vayunā navā adhita
iti br̥hatī iti abhi-śriyā hiraṇyayī iti vakvarī iti barhiḥ āśāteiti
agne juṣasva prati harya tat vacaḥ mandra svadhāvaḥ r̥ta-jāta sukrato itisu-krato yaḥ viśvataḥ pratyaṅ asi darśataḥ raṇvaḥ sam-dr̥ṣṭau pitumān-iva kṣayaḥ
tam pr̥cchata saḥ jagāma saḥ veda saḥ cikitvān īyate saḥ nu īyate tasmin santi pra-śiṣaḥ tasmin iṣṭayaḥ saḥ vājasya śavasaḥ śuṣmiṇaḥ patiḥ
tam it pr̥cchanti na simaḥ vi pr̥cchati svena-va dhīraḥ manasā yat agrabhīt na mr̥ṣyate prathamam na aparam vacaḥ asya kratvā sacate apra-dr̥pitaḥ
tam it gacchanti juhvaḥ tam arvatīḥ viśvāni ekaḥ śr̥ṇavat vacāṁsi me puru-praiṣaḥ taturiḥ yajña-sādhanaḥ acchidra-ūtiḥ śiśuḥ ā adatta sam rabhaḥ
upa-sthāyam carati yat sam-ārata sadyaḥ jātaḥ tatsāra yujyebhiḥ abh i śvāntam mr̥śate nāndye mude yat īm gacchanti uśatīḥ api-sthitam
saḥ īm mr̥gaḥ apyaḥ vanarguḥ upa tvaci upa-masyām ni dhāyi vi abravīt vayunā martyebhyaḥ agniḥ vidvān r̥ta-cit hi satyaḥ
tri-mūrdhānam sapta-raśmim gr̥ṇīṣe anūnam agnim pitroḥ upa-sthe ni-sattam asya carataḥ dhruvasya viśvā divaḥ rocanā āpapri-vāṁsam
ukṣā mahān abhi vavakṣe eneiti ajaraḥ tasthau itaḥ-ūtiḥ r̥ṣvaḥ urvyāḥ padaḥ ni dadhāti sānau rihanti ūdhaḥ aruṣāsaḥ asya
samānam vatsam abhi sañcarantī itisam-carantī viṣvak dhenū iti vi carataḥ sumeke itisu-meke anapa-vr̥jyān adhvanaḥ mimāneiti viśvān ketān adhi mahaḥ dadhāneiti
dhīrāsaḥ padam kavayaḥ nayanti nānā hr̥dā rakṣamāṇāḥ ajuryam sisāsantaḥ pari apaśyanta sindhum āviḥ ebhyaḥ abhavat sūryaḥ nr̥r̥n
didr̥kṣeṇyaḥ pari kāṣṭhāsu jenyaḥ īl̥enyaḥ mahaḥ arbhāya jīvase puru-trā yat abhavat sūḥ aha ebhyaḥ garbhebhyaḥ magha-vā viśva-darśataḥ
kathā te agne śucayantaḥ āyoḥ dadāśuḥ vājebhiḥ āśuṣāṇāḥ ubhe iti yat toke iti tanaye dadhānāḥ r̥tasya sāman raṇayanta devāḥ
bodha me asya vacasaḥ yaviṣṭha maṁhiṣṭhasya pra-bhr̥tasya svadhāvaḥ pīyati tvaḥ anu tvaḥ gr̥ṇāti vandāruḥ te tanvam vande agne
ye pāyavaḥ māmateyam te agne paśyantaḥ andham duḥ-itāt arakṣan rarakṣa tān su-kr̥taḥ viśva-vedāḥ dipsantaḥ it ripavaḥ na aha debhuḥ
yaḥ naḥ agne arari-vān agha-yuḥ arāti-vā marcayati dvayena mantraḥ guruḥ punaḥ astu saḥ asmai anu mr̥kṣīṣṭa tanvam duḥ-uktaiḥ
uta vā yaḥ sahasya pra-vidvān martaḥ martam marcayati dvayena ataḥ pāhi stavamāna stuvantam agne mākiḥ naḥ duḥ-itāya dhāyīḥ
mathīt yat īm viṣṭaḥ mātariśvā hotāram viśva-apsum viśva-devyam ni yam dadhuḥ manuṣyāsu vikṣu svaḥ na citram vapuṣe vibhāvam
dadānam it na dadabhanta manma agniḥ varūtham mama tasyacākan juṣanta viśvāni asya karma upa-stutim bharamāṇasya kāroḥ
nitye cit nu yam sadane jagr̥bhre praśasti-bhiḥ dadhire yajñiyāsaḥ pra su nayanta gr̥bhayantaḥ iṣṭau aśvāsaḥ na rathyaḥ rarahāṇāḥ
purūṇi dasmaḥ ni riṇāti jambhaiḥ āt rocate vane ā vibhāvā āt asya vātaḥ anu vāti śociḥ astuḥ na śaryām asanām anu dyūn
na yam ripavaḥ na riṣaṇyavaḥ garbhe santam reṣaṇāḥ reṣayanti andhāḥ apaśyāḥ na dabhan abhi-khyā nityāsaḥ īm pretāraḥ arakṣan
mahaḥ saḥ rāyaḥ ā īṣate patiḥ dan inaḥ inasya vasunaḥ pade ā upa dhrajantam adrayaḥ vidhan it
saḥ yaḥ vr̥ṣā narān na rodasyoḥ śravaḥ-bhiḥ asti jīvapīta-sagarḥ pra yaḥ sasrāṇaḥ śiśrīta yonau
ā yaḥ puram nārmiṇīm adīdet atyaḥ kaviḥ nabhanyaḥ nārvā sūraḥ na rurukvān śata-ātmā
abhi dvi-janmā trī rocanāni viśvā rajāṁsi śuśucānaḥ asthāt hotā yajiṣṭhaḥ apām sadha-sthe
ayam saḥ hotā yaḥ dvi-janmā viśvā dadhe vāryāṇi śravasyā martaḥ yaḥ asmai su-tukaḥ dadāśa
puru tvā dāsvān voce ariḥ agne tava svit ā todasya-iva śaraṇe ā mahasya
vi aninasya dhaninaḥ pra-hoṣe cit araruṣaḥ kadā cana pra-jigataḥ adeva-yoḥ
saḥ candraḥ vipra martyaḥ mahaḥ vrādhan-tamaḥ divi pra-pra it te agne vanuṣaḥ syāma
mitram na yam śimyā goṣu gavyavaḥ su-ādhyaḥ vidathe ap-su jījanan arejetām rodasī iti pājasā girā prati priyam yajatam januṣām avaḥ
yat ha tyat vām puru-mīl̥hasya sominaḥ pra mitrāsaḥ na dadhire su-ābhuvaḥ adha kratum vidatam gātum arcate uta śrutam vr̥ṣaṇā pastya-vataḥ
ā vām bhūṣan kṣitayaḥ janma rodasyoḥ pra-vācyam vr̥ṣaṇā dakṣase mahe yat īm r̥tāya bharathaḥ yat arvate pra hotrayā śimyā vīthaḥ adhvaram
pra sā kṣitiḥ asura yā mahi priyā r̥ta-vānau r̥tam ā ghoṣathaḥ br̥hat yuvam divaḥ br̥hataḥ dakṣam ābhuvam gām na dhuri upa yuñjātheiti apaḥ
mahī atra mahinā vāram r̥ṇvathaḥ areṇavaḥ tujaḥ ā sadman dhenavaḥ svaranti tāḥ upara-tāti sūryam ā ni-mrucaḥ uṣasaḥ takvavīḥ-iva
ā vām r̥tāya keśinīḥ anūṣata mitra yatra varuṇa gātum arcathaḥ ava tmanā sr̥jatam pinvatam dhiyaḥ yuvam viprasya manmanām irajyathaḥ
yaḥ vām yajñaiḥ śaśamānaḥ ha dāśati kaviḥ hotā yajati manma-sādhanaḥ upa aha tam gacchathaḥ vīthaḥ adhvaram accha giraḥ su-matim gantam asmayū ity asma-yū
yuvām yajñaiḥ prathamā gobhiḥ añjate r̥ta-vānā manasaḥ na pra-yuktiṣu bharanti vām manmanā sam-yatā giraḥ adr̥pyatā manasā revat āśātheiti
revat vayaḥ dadhāthe revat āśātheiti narā māyābhiḥ itaḥ-ūti māhinam na vām dyāvaḥ aha-bhiḥ na uta sindhavaḥ na deva-tvam paṇayaḥ na ānaśuḥ magham
yuvam vastrāṇi pīvasā vasātheiti yuvoḥ acchidrāḥ mantavaḥ ha sargāḥ ava atiratam anr̥tāni viśvā r̥tena mitrāvaruṇā sacetheiti
etat cana tvaḥ vi ciketat eṣām satyaḥ mantraḥ kavi-śastaḥ r̥ghāvān triḥ-aśrim hanti catuḥ-aśriḥ ugraḥ deva-nidaḥ ha prathamāḥ ajūryan
apāt eti prathamā pat-vatīnām kaḥ tat vām mitrāvaruṇā ā ciketa garbhaḥ bhāram bharati ā cit asya r̥tam piparti anr̥tam ni tārīt
pra-yantam it pari jāram kanīnām paśyāmasi na upa-nipadyamānam anava-pr̥gṇā vi-tatā vasānam priyam mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma
anaśvaḥ jataḥ anabhīśuḥ arvā kanikradat patayat ūrdhva-sānuḥ ac ittam brahma jujuṣuḥ yuvānaḥ pra mitre dhāma varuṇe gr̥ṇantaḥ
ā dhenavaḥ māmateyam avantīḥ brahma-priyam pīpayan sasmin ūdhan pitvaḥ bhikṣeta vayunāni vidvān āsā āvivāsan aditim uruṣyet
ā vām mitrāvaruṇā havya-juṣṭim namasā devau avasā vavr̥tyām asmākam brahma pr̥tanāsu sahyāḥ asmākam vr̥ṣṭiḥ divyā su-pārā
yajāmahe vām mahaḥ sa-joṣāḥ havyebhiḥ mitrāvaruṇā namaḥ-bhiḥ ghr̥taiḥ ghr̥tasnūitighr̥ta-snū adha yat vām asme iti adhvaryavaḥ na dhīti-bhiḥ bharanti
pra-stutiḥ vām dhāma na pra-yuktiḥ ayāmi mitrāvaruṇā su-vr̥ktiḥ anakti yat vām vidatheṣu hotā sumnam vām sūriḥ vr̥ṣaṇau iyakṣan
pīpāya dhenuḥ aditiḥ r̥tāya janāya mitrāvaruṇā haviḥ-de hinoti yat vām vidathe saparyan saḥ rāta-havyaḥ mānuṣaḥ na hotā
uta vām vikṣu madyāsu andhaḥ gāvaḥ āpaḥ ca pīpayanta devīḥ uto iti naḥ asya pūrvyaḥ patiḥ dan vītam pātam payasaḥ usriyāyāḥ
viṣṇoḥ nu kam vīryāṇi pra vocam yaḥ pārthivāni vi-mame rajāṁsi yaḥ askabhāyat ut-taram sadha-stham vi-cakramāṇaḥ tredhā ūru-gāyaḥ
pra tat viṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇa mr̥gaḥ na bhīmaḥ kucaraḥ giri-sthāḥ yasya uruṣu triṣu vi-kramaṇeṣu adhi-kṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā
pra viṣṇave śūṣam etu manma giri-kṣite uru-gāyāya vr̥ṣṇe yaḥ idam dīrgham pra-yatam sadha-stham ekaḥ vi-mame tri-bhiḥ it pade--bhiḥ
yasya trī pūrṇā madhunā padāni akṣīyamāṇā svadhayā madanti yaḥ oṁ iti tri-dhātu pr̥thivīm uta dyām ekaḥ dādhāra bhuvanāni viśvā
tat asya priyam abhi pāthaḥ aśyām naraḥ yatra devayavaḥ madanti uru-kramasya saḥ hi bandhuḥ itthā viṣṇoḥ pade parame madhvaḥ utsaḥ
tā vām vāstūni uśmasi gamadhyai yatra gāvaḥ bhūri-śr̥ṅgāḥ ayāsaḥ atra aha tat uru-gāyasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ paramam padam ava bhāti bhūri
pra vaḥ pāntam andhasaḥ dhiyāyate mahe śūrāya viṣṇave ca arcata yā sānuni parvatānām adābhyā mahaḥ tasthatuḥ arvatāiva sādhunā
tveṣam itthā sam-araṇam śimī-vatoḥ indrāviṣṇūiti suta-pāḥ vām uruṣyati yā martyāya prati-dhīyamānam it kr̥śānoḥ astuḥ asanām uruṣyathaḥ
tāḥ īm vardhanti mahi asya paiṁsyam ni mātarā nayati retase bhuje dadhāti putraḥ avaram param pituḥ nāma tr̥tīyam adhi rocane divaḥ
tat-tat it asya paiṁsyam gr̥ṇīmasi inasya trātuḥ avr̥kasya mīl̥huṣaḥ yaḥ pārthivāni tri-bhiḥ it vigāma-bhiḥ uru kramiṣṭa uru-gāyāyajīvase
dve iti it asya kramaṇeiti svaḥ-dr̥śaḥ abhi-khyāya martyaḥ bhuraṇyati tr̥tīyam asya nakiḥ ā dadharṣati vayaḥ cana patayantaḥ patatriṇaḥ
catuḥ-bhiḥ sākam navatim ca nāma-bhiḥ cakram na vr̥ttam vyatīn avīvipat br̥hat-śarīraḥ vi-mimānaḥ r̥kva-bhiḥ yuvā akumāraḥ prati et i āhavam
bhava mitraḥ na śevyaḥ ghr̥ta-āsutiḥ vibhūta-dyumnaḥ eva-yāḥ ūām iti sa-prathāḥ adha te viṣṇo iti viduṣā cit ardhyaḥ stomaḥ yajñaḥ ca rādhyaḥ haviṣmatā
yaḥ pūrvyāya vedhase navīyase sumat-jānaye viṣṇave dadāśati yaḥ jātam asya mahataḥ mahi bravat saḥ it oṁ iti śravaḥ-bhiḥ yujyam cit abhi asat
tam oṁ iti stotāraḥ pūrvyam yathā vida r̥tasya garbham januṣā pipartana ā asya jānantaḥ nāma cit vivaktana mahaḥ te viṣṇo iti su-matim bhajāmahe
tam asya rājā varuṇaḥ tam aśvinā kratum sacanta mārutasya vedhasaḥ dādhāra dakṣam ut-tamam ahaḥ-vidam vrjam ca viṣṇuḥ sakhi-vān apa-ūrṇute
ā yaḥ vivāya sacathāya daivyaḥ indrāya viṣṇuḥ su-kr̥te sukr̥t-taraḥ vedhāḥ ajinvat tri-sadhasthaḥ āryam r̥tasya bhāge yajamānam ā abhajat
abodhi agniḥ jmaḥ ut eti sūryaḥ vi uṣāḥ candrā mahī āvaḥ arciṣā ayukṣātām aśvinā yātave ratham pra asāvīt devaḥ savitā jagat pr̥thak
yat yuñjātheiti vr̥ṣaṇam aśvinā ratham ghr̥tena naḥ madhunā kṣatram ukṣatam asmākam brahma pr̥tanāsu jinvatam vayam dhanā śūra-sātā bhajemahi
arvāṅ tri-cakraḥ madhu-vāhanaḥ rathaḥ jīra-aśvaḥ aśvinoḥ yātu su-stutaḥ tri-vandhuraḥ magha-vā viśva-saubhagaḥ śam naḥ ā vakṣat dvi-pade catuḥ-pade
ā naḥ ūrjam vahatam aśvinā yuvam madhu-matyā naḥ kaśayā mimikṣatam pra āyuḥ tāriṣṭam niḥ rapāṁsi mr̥kṣatam sedhatam dveṣaḥ bhavatam sacābhuvā
yuvam ha garbham jagatīṣu dhatthaḥ yuvam viśveṣu bhuvaneṣu antariti yuvam agnim ca vr̥ṣaṇau apaḥ ca vanaspatīn aśvinau airayethām
yuvam ha sthaḥ bhiṣajā bheṣajebhiḥ atho iti ha sthaḥ rathyā rathyebhiritirathyebhiḥ atho iti ha kṣatram adhi dhattha ugrā yaḥ vām haviṣmān manasā dadāśa
vasī iti rudrā purumantūitipuru-mantū vr̥dhantā daśasyatam naḥ vr̥ṣaṇau abhi ṣṭau dasrā ha yat rekṇaḥ aucathyaḥ vām pra yat sasrātheiti akavābhiḥ ūtī
kaḥ vām dāśat su-mataye cit asyai vasūiti yat dhetheiti namasā pade goḥ jigr̥tam asme iti revatīḥ puram-dhīḥ kāma-preṇa-iva manasā carantā
yuktaḥ ha yat vām taugryāya peruḥ vi madhye arṇasaḥ dhāyi pajraḥ upa vām avaḥ śaraṇam gameyam śūraḥ na ajma patayat-bhiḥ evaiḥ
upa-stutiḥ aucathyam uruṣyet mā mām ime iti patatriṇī iti vi dugdhām mā mām edhaḥ daśa-tayaḥ citaḥ dhāk pra yat vām baddhaḥ tmani khādati kṣām
na mā garan nadyaḥ mātr̥-tamāḥ dāsāḥ yat īm su-samubdham ava-adhuḥ śiraḥ yat asya traitanaḥ vi-takṣat svayam dāsaḥ uraḥ aṁsau api gdhetigdha
dīrgha-tamāḥ māmateyaḥ jujurvān daśame yuge apām artham yatīnām brahmā bhavati sārathiḥ
pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pr̥thivī iti r̥ta-vr̥dhā mahī iti stuṣe vidatheṣu pra-cetasā devebhiḥ ye iti deva-putreitideva-putre su-daṁsasā itthā dhiyā vāryāṇi pra-bhūṣataḥ
uta manye pituḥ adruhaḥ manaḥ mātuḥ mahi sva-tavaḥ tat havīma-bhiḥ su-retasā pitarā bhūma cakratuḥ uru pra-jāyāḥ amr̥tam varīma-bhiḥ
te sūnavaḥ su-apasaḥ su-daṁsasaḥ mahī iti jajñuḥ mātarā pūrva-cittaye sthātuḥ ca satyam jagataḥ ca dharmaṇ i putrasya pāthaḥ padam advayāvinaḥ
te māyinaḥ mamire su-pracetasaḥ jāmī iti sayonī itisa-yonī mithunā sam-okasā navyam-navyam tantum ā tanvate divi samudre antariti kavayaḥ su-dītayaḥ
tat rādhaḥ adya savituḥ vareṇyam vayam devasya pra-save manāmahe asmabhyam dyāvāpr̥thivī iti su-cetunā rayim dhattam vasu-mantam śata-gvinam
te iti hi dyāvāpr̥thivī iti viśva-śambhuvā r̥ta-varī ity r̥ta-varī rajasaḥ dhārayatkavī itidhārayat-kavī sujanmanī itisu-janmanī dhiṣaṇeiti antaḥ īyate devaḥ devī iti dharmaṇā sūryaḥ śuciḥ
uru-vyacasā mahinī iti asaścatā pitā mātā ca bhuvanāni rakṣataḥ sudhr̥ṣṭameitisu-dhr̥ṣṭame vapuṣye iti na rodasī iti pitā yat sīm abhi rūpaiḥ avāsayat
saḥ vahniḥ putraḥ pitroḥ pavitra-vān punāti dhīraḥ bhuvanāni māyayā dhenum ca pr̥śnim vr̥ṣabham su-retasam viśvāhā śukram payaḥ asya dhukṣata
ayam devānām apasām apaḥ-tamaḥ yaḥ jajāna rodasī iti viśva-śambhuvā vi yaḥ mame rajasī iti sukratu-yayā ajarebhiḥ skambhanebhiḥ sam ānr̥ce
te naḥ gr̥ṇāne iti mahinī iti mahi śravaḥ kṣatram dyāvāpr̥thivī iti dhāsathaḥ br̥hat yena abhi kr̥ṣṭīḥ tatanāma viśvahā panāyyam ojaḥ asme iti sam invatam
kim ūām iti śreṣṭhaḥ kim yaviṣṭhaḥ naḥ ā ajagan kim īyate dūtyam kat yat ūc ima na nindima camasam yaḥ mahākulaḥ agne bhrātaḥ druṇaḥ it bhūtim ūdima
ekam camasam caturaḥ kr̥ṇotana tat vaḥ devāḥ abruvan tat vaḥ ā agamam saudhanvanāḥ yadi eva kariṣyatha sākam devaiḥ yajñiyāsaḥ bhavi ṣyatha
agnim dūtam prati yat abravītana aśvaḥ kartvaḥ rathaḥ uta iha kartvaḥ dhenuḥ kartvā yuvaśā kartvā dvā tāni bhrātaḥ anu vaḥ kr̥tvī ā imasi
cakr̥-vāṁsaḥ r̥bhavaḥ tat apr̥cchata kva it abhūt yaḥ syaḥ dūtaḥ naḥ ā ajagan yadā ava-akhyat camasān caturaḥ kr̥tān āt it tvaṣṭā gnāsu antaḥ ni ānaje
hanāma enān iti tvaṣṭā yat abravīt camasam ye deva-pānam anindiṣuḥ anyā nāmāni kr̥ṇvate sute sacā anyaiḥ enān kanyā nāma-bhiḥ sparat
indraḥ harī yuyuje aśvinā ratham br̥haspatiḥ viśva-rūpām upa ājata r̥bhuḥ vi-bhvā vājaḥ devān agacchata su-apasaḥ yajñiyam bhāgam aitana
niḥ carmaṇaḥ gām ariṇīta dhīti-bhiḥ yā jarantā yuvaśā tā akr̥ṇotana saudhanvanāḥ aśvāt aśvam atakṣata yuktvā ratham upa devān ayātana
idam udakam pibata iti abravītana idam vā gha pibata muñja-nejanam saudhanvanāḥ yadi tat na-iva haryatha tr̥tīye gha savane mādayādhvai
āpaḥ bhūyiṣṭhāḥ iti ekaḥ abravīt agniḥ bhūyiṣṭhaḥ iti anyaḥ abravīt vadhaḥ-yantīm bahu-bhyaḥ pra ekaḥ abravīt r̥tā vadantaḥ camasān apiṁśata
śroṇām ekaḥ udakam gām ava ajati māṁsam ekaḥ piṁśati sūnayā ābhr̥tam ā ni-mrucaḥ śakr̥t ekaḥ apa abharat kim svit putrebhyaḥ pitarau upa āvatuḥ
udvat-su asmai akr̥ṇotana tr̥ṇam nivat-su apaḥ su-apasyayā naraḥ agohyasya yat asastana gr̥he tat adya idam r̥bhavaḥ na anu gacchatha
sam-mīlya yat bhuvanā pari-asarpata kva svit tātyā pitarā vaḥ āsatuḥ aśapata yaḥ karasnam vaḥ ādade yaḥ pra abravīt pro iti tasmai abravītana
suṣupvāṁsaḥ r̥bhavaḥ tat apr̥cchata agohya kaḥ idam naḥ abūbudhat śvānam bastaḥ bodhayitāram abravīt saṁvatsare idam adya vi akhyata
divā yānti marutaḥ bhūmyā agniḥ ayam vātaḥ antarikṣeṇa yāti at-bhiḥ yāti varuṇaḥ samudraiḥ yuṣmān icchantaḥ śavasaḥ napātaḥ
mā naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ aryamā āyuḥ indraḥ r̥bhukṣāḥ marutaḥ pari khyan yat vājinaḥ deva-jātasya sapteḥ pra-vakṣyāmaḥ vidathe vīyārṇi
yat niḥ-nijā rekṇasā prāvr̥tasya rātim gr̥bhītām mukhataḥ nayanti su-prāṅ ajaḥ memyat viśva-rūpaḥ indrāpūṣṇoḥ priyam api eti pāthaḥ
eṣaḥ chāgaḥ puraḥ aśvena vājinā pūṣṇaḥ bhagaḥ nīyate viśva-devyaḥ abhi-priyam yat purol̥āśam arvatā tvaṣṭā it enam sauśravasāya ji nvati
yad haviṣyam r̥tu-śaḥ deva-yānam triḥ mānuṣāḥ pari aśvam nayant i atra pūṣṇaḥ prathamaḥ bhāgaḥ eti yajñam devebhyaḥ prati-vedayan ajaḥ
hotā adhvaryuḥ āvayāḥ agnim-indhaḥ grāva-grābhaḥ uta śaṁstā su-vipraḥ tena yajñena su-ararṅketena su-iṣṭena vakṣaṇāḥ ā pr̥ṇadhvam
yūpa-vraskāḥ uta ye yūpa-vāhāḥ caṣālam ye aśva-yūpāya takṣati ye ca arvate pacanam sam-bharanti uto iti teṣām abhi-gūrtiḥ naḥ invatu
upa pra agāt su-mat me adhāyi manma devānām āśāḥ upa vīta-pr̥ṣṭhaḥ anu enam viprāḥ r̥ṣayaḥ madanti devānām puṣṭe cakr̥ma su-bandhum
yat vājinaḥ dāma sam-dānam arvataḥ yā śīrṣaṇyā raśanā rajjuḥ asya yat vā gha asya pra-bhr̥tam āsye tr̥ṇam sarvā tā te api deveṣu astu
yat aśvasya kraviṣaḥ makṣikā āśa yat vā svarau sva-dhitau riptam asti yat hastayoḥ śamituḥ yat nakheṣu sarvā tā te api deveṣu astu
yat ūvadhyam udarasya apa-vāti yaḥ āmasya kraviṣaḥ gandhaḥ asti su-kr̥tā tat śamitāraḥ kr̥ṇvantu uta medham śr̥ta-pākam pacantu
yat te gātrāt agninā pacyamānāt abhi śūlam ni-hatasya ava-dhāvati mā tat bhūmyām ā śriṣat mā tr̥ṇeṣu devebhyaḥ tat uśat-bhyaḥ rātam astu
ye vājinam pari-pasyanti pakvam ye īm āhuḥ surabhiḥ niḥ hara iti ye ca arvataḥ māṁsa-bhikṣām upa-āsate uto iti teṣām abhi-gūrtiḥ naḥ invatu
yat ni-īkṣaṇam māṁspacanyāḥ ukhāyāḥ yā pātrāṇi yūṣṇaḥ āsecanāni ūṣmaṇyā api-dhānā carūṇām aṅkāḥ sūnāḥ pari bhūṣanti aśvam
ni-kramaṇam ni-sadanam vi-vartanam yat ca paḍabaḍhabadabadrahṇīśam arvataḥ yat ca papau yat ca ghāsim jaghāsa sarvā tā te api deveṣu astu
mā tvā agniḥ dhvanayīt dhūma-gandhiḥ mā ukhā bhrājantī abhi vikta jaghriḥ iṣṭam vītam abhi-gūrtam vaṣaṭ-kr̥tam tam devāsaḥ prati gr̥bhṇanti aśvam
yat aśvāya vāsaḥ upa-str̥ṇanti adhī-vāsam yā hiraṇyāni asmai sam-dānam arvantam paḍabaḍhabadabadrahṇīśam priyā deveṣu ā yamayanti
yat te sāde mahasā śūkr̥tasya pārṣṇyā vā kaśayā vā tutoda srucāiva tā haviṣaḥ adhvareṣu sarvā tā te brahmaṇā sūdayāmi
catuḥ-triṁśat vājinaḥ deva-bandhoḥ vaṅkrīḥ aśvasya sva-dhitiḥḥ sam eti acchidrā gātrā vayunā kr̥ṇota paruḥ-paruḥ anu-ghuṣya vi śasta
ekaḥ tvaṣṭuḥ aśvasya vi-śastā dvā yantārā bhavataḥ tathā r̥tuḥ yā te gātrāṇām r̥tu-thā kr̥ṇomi tātā piṇḍānm pra juhomi agnau
mā tvā tapat priyaḥ ātmā api-yantam mā sva-dhitiḥ tanvaḥ ā tisthipat te mā te gr̥dhnuḥ avi-śastā ati-hāya chidrā gātrāṇi asinā mithu kariti kaḥ
na vai oṁ iti etat mriyase na riṣyasi devān it eṣi pathi-bhiḥ su-gebhiḥ harīiti te yuñjā pr̥ṣatī iti abhūtām upa asthāt vājī dhuri rāsabhasya
su-gavyam naḥ vājī su-aśvyam puṁsaḥ putrān uta viśvāpuṣam rayim anāgāḥ-tvam naḥ aditiḥ kr̥ṇotu kṣatram naḥ aśvaḥ vanatām haviṣmān
yat akrandaḥ prathamam jāyamānaḥ ut-yan samudrāt uta vā purīṣāt śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū iti upa-stutyam mahi jātam te arvan
yamena dattam tritaḥ enam ayunak indraḥ enam prathamaḥ adhi atiṣṭhat gandharvaḥ asya raśanām agr̥bhṇāt sūrāt aśvam vasavaḥ niḥ ataṣṭa
asi yamaḥ asi ādityaḥ arvan asi tritaḥ guhena vratena asi somena samayā vi-pr̥ktaḥ āhuḥ te trīṇi divi bandhanāni
trīṇi te āhuḥ divi bandhanāni trīṇi ap-su trīṇi antariti samudre uta-iva me varuṇaḥ chantsi arvan yatra te āhuḥ paramam janitram
imā te vājin ava-mārjanāni imā śaphānām sanituḥ ni-dhānā atra te bhadrāḥ raśanāḥ apaśyam r̥tasya yāḥ abhi-rakṣanti gopāḥ
ātmānam te manasā ārāt ajānām avaḥ divā patayantam pataṅgam śiraḥ apaśyam pathi-bhiḥ su-gebhiḥ areṇu-bhiḥ jehamānam patatri
atra te rūpam ut-tamam apaśyam jigīṣamāṇam iṣaḥ ā pade goḥ yadā te martaḥ anu bhogam ānaṭ āt it grasiṣṭhaḥ oṣadhīḥ ajīgariti
anu tvā rathaḥ anu maryaḥ arvan anu gāvaḥ anu bhagaḥ kanīnām anu vrātāsaḥ tava sakhyam īyuḥ anu devāḥ mamire vīryam te
hiraṇya-śr̥ṅgaḥ ayaḥ asya pādāḥ manaḥ-javāḥ avaraḥ indraḥ āsīt devāḥ it asya haviḥ-adyam āyan yaḥ arvantam prathamaḥ adhi-atiṣṭhat
īrma-antāsaḥ silika-madhyamāsaḥ sam śūraṇāsaḥ divyāsaḥ atyāḥ haṁsāḥ-iva śreṇi-śaḥ yatante yat ākṣiṣuḥ divyam ajmam aśvāḥ
tava śarīram patayiṣṇu arvan tava cittam vātaḥ-iva dhrajīmān tava śr̥ṅgāṇi vi-ṣṭhitā puru-trā araṇyeṣu jarbhurāṇā caranti
upa pra agāt śasanam vājī arvā devadrīcā manasā dīdhyānaḥ ajaḥ puraḥ nīyate nābhiḥ asya anu paścāt kavayaḥ yanti rebhāḥ
upa pra agāt paramam yat sadha-stham arvān accha pitaram mātaram ca adya devān juṣṭa-tamaḥ hi gamyāḥ atha ā śāste dāśuṣe vāryāṇi
asya vāmasya palitasya hotuḥ tasya bhrātā madhyamaḥ asti aśnaḥ tr̥tīyaḥ bhrātā ghr̥ta-pr̥ṣṭhaḥ asya atra apasyam viśpatim sapta-putram
sapta yuñjanti ratham eka-cakram ekaḥ aśvaḥ vahati sapta-nāmā tr i-nābhi cakram ajaram anarvam yatra imā viśvā bhuvanā adhi tasthuḥ
imam ratham adhi ye sapta tasthuḥ sapta-cakram sapta vahanti aśvāḥ sapta svasāraḥ abhi sam navante yatra gavām ni-hitā sapta nāma
kaḥ dadarśa prathamam jāyamānam asthan-vantam yat anasthā bibharti bhūmyāḥ asuḥ asr̥k ātmā kva svit kaḥ vidvāṁsam upa gāt praṣṭum etat
pākaḥ pr̥cchāmi manasā avi-jānan devānām enā ni-hitā padāni vatse baṣkaye adhi sapta tantūn vi tatnire kavayaḥ otavai oṁ iti
acikitvān cikituṣaḥ cit atra kavīn pr̥cchāmi vidmane na vidvān vi yaḥ tastambha ṣaṭ imā rajāṁsi ajasya rūpe kim api svit ekam
iha bravītu yaḥ īm aṅga veda asya vāmasya ni-hitam padam veri tiveḥ śīrṣṇaḥ kṣīram duhrate gāvaḥ asya vavrim vasānāḥ udakam padā apuḥ
mātā pitaram r̥te ā babhāja dhītī agre manasā sam hi jagme sā bībhatsuḥ garbha-rasā ni-viddhā namasvantaḥ it upa-vākam īyuḥ
yuktā mātā āsīt dhuri dakṣiṇāyāḥ atiṣṭhat garbhaḥ vr̥janīṣu antariti amīmet vatsaḥ anu gām apaśyat viśva-rūpyam triṣu yojaneṣu
tisraḥ mātr̥r̥ḥ trīn pitr̥r̥n bibhrat ekaḥ ūrdhvaḥ tasthau na īm ava glapayanti mantrayante divaḥ amuṣya pr̥ṣṭhe viśva-vidam vācam aviśva-minvām
dvādaśa-aram nahi tat jarāya varvarti cakram pari dyām r̥tasya ā putrāḥ agne mithunāsaḥ atra sapta śatāni viṁśatiḥ ca tasthuḥ
pañca-pādam pitaram dvādaśa-ākr̥tim divaḥ āhuḥ pare ardhe purīṣiṇam atha ime anye upare vi-cakṣaṇam sapta-cakre ṣaṭ-are āhuḥ arpitam
pañca-are cakre pari-vartamāne tasmin ā tasthuḥ bhuvanāni viśvā tasya na akṣaḥ tapyate bhūri-bhāraḥ sanāt eva na śīryate sa-nābhiḥ
sa-nemi cakram ajaram vi vavr̥te uttānāyām daśa yuktāḥ vahanti sūryasya cakṣiḥ rajasā eti āvr̥tam tasmin ārpitā bhuvanāni viśvā
sākam-jānām saptatham āhuḥ eka-jam ṣaṭ it yamāḥ r̥ṣayaḥ deva-jāḥ iti teṣām iṣṭāni vi-hitāni dhāma-śaḥ sthātre rejante vi-kr̥tāni rūpa-śaḥ
striyaḥ satīḥ tān oṁ iti me puṁsaḥ āāhuḥ paśyat akṣaṇ-vān na vi cetat andhaḥ kaviḥ yaḥ putraḥ saḥ īm ā ciketa yaḥ tā vi-jānāt saḥ pituḥ pitā asat
avaḥ pareṇa paraḥ enā avareṇa padā vatsam bibhratī gauḥ ut asthāt sā kadrīcī kam svit ardham parā agāt kva svit sūte nahi yūthe antari ti
avaḥ pareṇa pitaram yaḥ asya anu-veda paraḥ enā avareṇa kavi-yamānaḥ kaḥ iha pra vocat devam manaḥ kutaḥ adhi pra-jātam
ye arvāñcaḥ tān oṁ iti parācaḥ āhuḥ ye parāñcaḥ tān oṁ iti arvācaḥ āhuḥ indraḥ ca yā cakrathuḥ soma tāni dhurā na yuktāḥ rajasaḥ vahanti
dvā su-parṇā sa-yujā sakhāyā samanam vr̥kṣam pari sasvajāteiti tayoḥ anyaḥ pippalam svādu atti anaśnan anyaḥ abhi cākaśīti
yatra su-parṇā amr̥tasya bhāgam animeṣam vidathā abhi-svaranti inaḥ viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ saḥ mā dhīraḥ pākam atra ā viveśa
yasmin vr̥kṣe madhu-adaḥ su-parṇāḥ ni-viśante suvate ca adhi viśve tasya it āhuḥ pippalam svādu agre tat na ut naśat yaḥ pitaram na veda
yat gāyatre adhi gāyatram āhitam traistubhāt vā traistubham niḥ-atakṣata yat vā jagat jagati āhitam padam ye it tat viduḥ te amr̥ta-tvam ānaśuḥ
gāyatreṇa prati mimīte arkam arkeṇa sāma traistubhena vākam vākena vākam dvi-padā catuḥ-padā akṣareṇa mimate sapta vāṇīḥ
jagatā sindhum divi astabhāyat ratham-tare sūryam pari apaśyat gāyatrasya sam-idhaḥ tisraḥ āhuḥ tataḥ mahrā pra ririce mahi-tvā
upa hvaye su-dughām dhenum etām su-hastaḥ go--dhuk uta dohat enām śreṣṭham savam savitā sāviṣat naḥ abhi-iddhaḥ gharmaḥ tat oṁ iti su pra vocam
hiṅ-kr̥ṇvatī vasu-patnī vasūnām vatsam icchantī manasā abhi ā agāt duhām aśvi-bhyām payaḥ aghnyā iyam sā vardhatām mahate saubhagāya
gauḥ amīmet anu vatsam miṣantam mūrdhānam hiṅ akr̥ṇot mātavai oṁ iti sr̥kvaaṇam gharmam abhi vāvaśānā mimāti māyum payate payaḥ-bhiḥ
ayam saḥ śiṅkte yena gauḥ abhi-vr̥ṭā mimāti māyum dhvasanau adhi śritā sā citti-bhiḥ ni hi cakāra martyam vi-dyut bhavantī prati vavrim auhata
anat śaye tura-gātu jīvam ejat dhruvam madhye ā pastyānām jīvaḥ mr̥tasya carati svadhābhiḥ amartyaḥ martyena sa-yoniḥ
apaśyam gopām ani-padyamānam ā ca parā ca pathi-bhiḥ carantam saḥ sadhrīcīḥ saḥ viṣūcīḥ vasānaḥ ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣu antariti
yaḥ īm cakāra na saḥ asya veda yaḥ īm dadarśa hiruk it nu tasmāt saḥ mātuḥ yonā pari-vītaḥ antaḥ bahu-prajāḥ niḥ-r̥tim ā viveśa
dyauḥ me pitā janitā nābhiḥ atra bandhuḥ me mātā pr̥thivī mahī iyam uttānayoḥ camvoḥ yoniḥ antaḥ atra pitā duhituḥ garbham ā adhāt
pr̥cchāmi tvā param antam pr̥thivyāḥ pr̥cchāmi yatra bhuvanasya nābhiḥ pr̥cchāmi tvā vr̥ṣṇaḥ aśvasya retaḥ pr̥cchāmi vācaḥ paramam vi-oma
iyam vediḥ paraḥ antaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ ayam yajñaḥ bhuvanasya nābhiḥ ayam somaḥ vr̥ṣṇaḥ aśvasya retaḥ brahmā ayam vācaḥ paramam v i-oma
sapta ardha-garbhāḥ bhuvanasya retaḥ viṣṇoḥ tiṣṭhanti pra-diśā vi-dharmaṇi te dhīti-bhiḥ manasā te vipaḥ-citaḥ pari-bhuvaḥ pari bhavanti viśvataḥ
na vi jānāmi yat-iva idam asmi niṇyaḥ sam-naddhaḥ manasā carāmi yadā mā ā agan prathama-jāḥ r̥tasya āt it vācaḥ aśnuve bhāgam asyāḥ
apāṅ prāṅ eti svadhayā gr̥bhītaḥ amartyaḥ martyena sa-yoniḥ tā śaśvantā viṣūcīnā vi-yantā ni anyam cikyuḥ na ni cikyuḥ anyam
r̥caḥ akṣare parame vi-oman yasmin devāḥ adhi viśve ni-seduḥ yaḥ tat na veda kim r̥cā kariṣyati ye it tat viduḥ te ime sam āsate
suyavasa-at bhaga-vatī hi bhūyāḥ atho iti vayam bhaga-vantaḥ syāma addhi tr̥ṇam aghnye viśva-dānīm piba śuddham udakam ācarantī
gaurīḥ mimāya salilāni takṣatī eka-padī dvi-padī sā catuḥ-padī aṣṭāpadī nava-padī babhūvuṣī sahasra-akṣarā parame vi-oman
tasyāḥ samudrāḥ adhi vi kṣaranti tena jīvanti pra-diśaḥ catasraḥ tataḥ kṣarati akṣaram tat viśvam upa jīvati
śaka-mayam dhūmam ārāt apaśyam viṣu-vatā paraḥ enā avareṇa ukṣāṇam pr̥śnim apacanta vīrāḥ tāni dharmāṇi prathamāni āsan
trayaḥ keśinaḥ r̥tu-thā vi cakṣate saṁvatsare vapate ekaḥ eṣām viśvam ekaḥ abhi caṣṭe śacībhiḥ dhrājiḥ ekasya dadr̥śe na rūpam
catvāri vāk pari-mitā padāni tāni viduḥ brāhmaṇāḥ ye manīṣiṇaḥ guhā trīṇi ni-hitā na iṅgayanti turīyam vācaḥ manuṣyāḥ vadanti
indram mitram varuṇam agnim āhuḥ atho iti divyaḥ saḥ su-parṇaḥ garutmān ekam sat viprāḥ bahu-dhā vadanti agnim yamam mātariśvānam āhuḥ
kr̥ṣṇam ni-yānam harayaḥ su-parṇāḥ apaḥ vasānāḥ divam ut patanti te ā avavr̥tran sadanāt r̥tasya āt it ghr̥tena pr̥thivī vi udyate
iti tat ciketa tasmin sākam tri-śatāḥ na śaṅkavaḥ arpitāḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ na calācalāsaḥ
yaḥ te stanaḥ ḥ śaśayaḥ yaḥ mayaḥ-bhūḥ yena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi yaḥ ratna-dhāḥ vasu-vit yaḥ su-datraḥ sarasvati tam iha dhātave karitikaḥ
yajñena yajñam ayajanta devāḥ tāni dharmāṇi prathamāni āsan te ha nākam mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ
samānam etat udakam ut ca eti ava ca aha-bhiḥ bhūmim parjanyāḥ j invanti divam jinvanti agnayaḥ
divyam su-parṇam vāyasam br̥hantam apām garbham darśatam oṣadhīnām abhīpataḥ vr̥ṣṭi-bhiḥ tarpayantam sarasvantam avase johavīm i
kayā śubhā sa-vayasaḥ sa-nīl̥āḥ samānyā marutaḥ sam mimikṣuḥ kayā matī kutaḥ āitāsaḥ ete arcanti śuṣmam vr̥ṣaṇaḥ vasu-yā
kasya brahmāṇi jujuṣuḥ yuvānaḥ kaḥ adhvare marutaḥ ā vavarta śyenān-iva dhrajataḥ antarikṣe kena mahā manasā rīramāma
kutaḥ tvam indra māhinaḥ san ekaḥ yāsi sat-pate kim te itthā sam pr̥cchase sam-arāṇaḥ śubhānaiḥ voceḥ tat naḥ hari-vaḥ yat te asme iti
brahmāṇi me matayaḥ śam sutāsaḥ śuṣmaḥ iyarti pra-bhr̥taḥ me adriḥ ā śāsate prati haryanti ukthā imā harī iti vahataḥ tā naḥ accha
ataḥ vayam antamebhiḥ yujānāḥ sva-kṣatrebhiḥ tanvaḥ śumbhamānāḥ mahaḥ-bhiḥ etān upa yujmahe nu indra svadhām anu hi naḥ babhūtha
kva syā vaḥ marutaḥ svadhā āsīt yat mām ekam sam-adhatta ahi-hatye aham hi ugraḥ taviṣaḥ tuviṣmān viśvasya śatroḥ anamam vadha-snaiḥ
bhūri cakartha yujyebhiḥ asme iti samānebhiḥ vr̥ṣabha paiṁsyebhiḥ bhūrīṇi hi kr̥ṇavāma śaviṣṭha indra kratvā marutaḥ yat vaśāma
vadhīm vr̥tram marutaḥ indriyeṇa svena bhāmena taviṣaḥ babhūvān aham etāḥ manave viśva-candrāḥ su-gāḥ apaḥ cakara vajra-bāhuḥ
anuttam ā te maghavan nakiḥ nu na tvāvān asti devatā vidānaḥ na jāyamānaḥ naśate na jātaḥ yāni kariṣyā kr̥ṇuhi pra-vr̥ddhaḥ
ekasya cit me vi-bhu astu ojaḥ yā nu dadhr̥ṣvān kr̥ṇavai manīṣā aham hi ugraḥ marutaḥ vidānaḥ yāni cyavam indraḥ it īśe eṣām
amandat mā marutaḥ stomaḥ atra yat me naraḥ śrutyam brahma cakra indrāya vr̥ṣṇe su-makhāya mahyam sakhye sakhāyaḥ tanve tanūbhiḥ
eva it ete prati mā rocamānāḥ anedyaḥ śravaḥ ā iṣaḥ dadhānāḥ sam-cakṣya marutaḥ candra-varṇāḥ acchānta me chadayātha ca nūnanm
kaḥ nu atra marutaḥ mamahe vaḥ pra yātana sakhīn accha sakhāyaḥ manmāni citrāḥ api-vātayantaḥ eṣām bhūta navedāḥ me r̥tānām
ā yat duvasyāt duvase na kāruḥ asmān cakre mānyasya medhā o iti su vartta marutaḥ vipram accha imā brahmāṇi jaritā vaḥ arcat
eṣaḥ vaḥ stomaḥ marutaḥ iyam gīḥ māndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ ā iṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayām vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
tat nu vocāma rabhasāya janmane pūrvam mahitvam vr̥ṣabhasya ketave aidhāiva yāman marutaḥ tuvi-svaṇaḥ yudhāiva śakrāḥ taviṣāṇi kartana
nityam na sūnum madhu bibhrataḥ upa krīl̥anti krīl̥āḥ vidatheṣu ghr̥ṣvayaḥ nakṣanti rudrāḥ avasā namasvinam na mardhanti sva-tavasaḥ haviḥ-kr̥tam
yasmai ūmāsaḥ amr̥tāḥ arāsata rāyaḥ poṣam ca haviṣā dadāśuṣe ukṣanti asmai marutaḥ hitāḥ-iva puru rajāṁsi payasā mayaḥ-bhuvaḥ
ā ye rajāṁsi taviṣībhiḥ avyata pra vaḥ evāsaḥ sva-yatāsaḥ adhrajan bhayante viśvā bhuvanāni harmyā citraḥ vaḥ yāmaḥ pra-yatāsu r̥ṣṭiṣu
yat tveṣa-yāmāḥ nadayanta parvatān divaḥ vā pr̥ṣṭham naryāḥ acucyavuḥ viśvaḥ vaḥ ajman bhayate vanaspatiḥ rathiyantī-iva pra jihīte oṣadhiḥ
yūyam naḥ ugrāḥ marutaḥ su-cetunā ariṣṭa-grāmāḥ su-matim pipartana yatra vaḥ didyut radati kriviḥ-datī riṇāti paśvaḥ sudhitāiva barhaṇā
pra skambha-deṣṇāḥ anavabhra-rādhasaḥ alātr̥ṇāsaḥ vidatheṣu su-stutāḥ arcanti arkam madirasya pītaye viduḥ vīrasya prathamāni paiṁsyā
śatabhuji-bhiḥ tam abhi-hruteḥ aghāt pūḥ-bhiḥ rakṣata marutaḥ yam āvata janam yam ugrāḥ tavasaḥ vi-rapśinaḥ pāthana śaṁsāt tanayasya puṣṭiṣu
viśvāni bhadrā marutaḥ ratheṣu vaḥ mithaspr̥dhyāiva taviṣāṇi āhitā aṁseṣu ā vaḥ pra-patheṣu khādayaḥ akṣaḥ vaḥ cakrā samayā vi vavr̥te
bhūrīṇi bhadrā naryeṣu bāhuṣu vakṣaḥ-su rukmāḥ rabhasāsaḥ añjayaḥ aṁseṣu etāḥ paviṣu kṣurāḥ adhi vayaḥ na pakṣān vi anu śriyaḥ dhire
mahāntaḥ mahnā vi-bhvaḥ vi-bhūtayaḥ dūre--dr̥śaḥ ye divyāḥ-iva str̥-bhiḥ mandrāḥ su-jihvāḥ svaritāraḥ āsa-bhiḥ sam-miślāḥ indre marutaḥ pari-stubhaḥ
tat vaḥ su-jātāḥ marutaḥ mahi-tvanam dīrgham vaḥ dātram aditeḥ-iva vratam indraḥ cana tyajasā vi hruṇāti tat janāya yasmai su-kr̥te arādhvam
tat vaḥ jāmi-tvam marutaḥ pare yuge puru yat śaṁsam amr̥tāsaḥ āvata ayā dhiyā manave śruṣṭim āvya sākam naraḥ daṁsanaiḥ ā cikitrire
yena dīrgham marutaḥ śūśavāma yuṣmākena parīṇasā turāsaḥ ā yat tatanam vr̥jane janāsaḥ ebhiḥ yajñebhiḥ tat abhi iṣṭim aśyām
eṣaḥ vaḥ stomaḥ marutaḥ iyam gīḥ māndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ ā iṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayām vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
sahasram te indra ūtayaḥ naḥ sahasram iṣaḥ hari-vaḥ gūrta-tamāḥ sahasram rāyaḥ mādayadhyai sahasriṇaḥ upa naḥ yantu vājāḥ
ā naḥ avaḥ-bhiḥ marutaḥ yāntu accha jyeṣṭhebhiḥ vā br̥hat-divaiḥ su-māyāḥ adha yat eṣām ni-yutaḥ paramāḥ samudrasya cit dhanayanta pāre
mimyakṣa yeṣu su-dhitā ghr̥tācī hiraṇya-nirnik uparā na r̥ṣṭiḥ guhā carantī manuṣaḥ na yoṣā sabhāvatī vidathyāiva sam vāk
parā śubhrāḥ ayāsaḥ yavyā sādhāraṇyāiva maruto mimikṣuḥ na rodasī iti apa nudanta ghorāḥ juṣanta vr̥dham sakhyāya devāḥ
joṣat yat īm asuryā sacadhyai visita-stukā rodasī nr̥-manāḥ / ā sūryāiva vidhataḥ ratham gāt tveṣa-pratīkā nabhasaḥ na ityā
ā asthāpayanta yuvatim yuvānaḥ śubhe ni-miślām vidatheṣu pajrām arkaḥ yat vaḥ marutaḥ haviṣmān gāyat gātham suta-somaḥ duvasyan
pra tam vivakmi vakmyaḥ yaḥ eṣām marutām mahimā satyaḥ asti sacā yat īm vr̥ṣa-manāḥ aham-yuḥ sthirā cit janīḥ vahate su-bhāgāḥ
pānti mitrāvaruṇau avadyāt cayate īm aryamo iti apra-śastān uta cyavante acyutā dhruvāṇi vavr̥dhe īm marutaḥ dāti--vāraḥ
nahi nu vaḥ marutaḥ anti asme iti ārāttāt cit śavasaḥ antam āpuḥ te dhr̥ṣṇunāśavasā śūśu-vāṁsaḥ arṇaḥ na dveṣaḥ dhr̥ṣatā pari sthuḥ
vayam adya indrasya preṣṭhāḥ vayam śvaḥ vocemahi sa-marye vayam purā mahi ca naḥ anu dyūn tat naḥ r̥bhukṣāḥ narām anu syāt
eṣaḥ vaḥ stomaḥ marutaḥ iyam gīḥ māndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ ā iṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayām vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
yajñāyajñā vaḥ samanā tuturvaṇiḥ dhiyam-dhiyam vaḥ deva-yāḥ oṁ iti dadhidhve ā vaḥ arvācaḥ suvitāya rodasyoḥ mahe vavr̥tyām avase suvr̥kti-bhiḥ
vavrāsaḥ na ye sva-jāḥ sva-tavasaḥ iṣam svaḥ abhi-jāyanta dhūtayaḥ sahasriyāsaḥ apām na ūrmayaḥ āsā gāvaḥ vandyāsaḥ na ukṣaṇaḥ
somāsaḥ na ye sutāḥ tr̥pta-aṁśavaḥ hr̥t-su pītāsaḥ duvasaḥ na āsate ā eṣām aṁseṣu rambhiṇī-iva rarabhe hasteṣu khādiḥ ca kr̥tiḥ ca sam dadhe
ava sva-yuktāḥ divaḥ ā vr̥thā yayuḥ amartyāḥ kaśayā codata tmanā areṇavaḥ tuvi-jātāḥ acucyavuḥ dr̥l̥hāni cit marutaḥ bhrājad-r̥ṣṭayaḥ
kaḥ vaḥ antaḥ marutaḥ r̥ṣṭi-vidyutaḥ rejati tmanā hanvāiva jihvayā dhanva-cyutaḥ iṣām na yāmani puru-praiṣāḥ ahanyaḥ na etaśaḥ
kva svit asya rajasaḥ mahaḥ param kva avaram marutaḥ yasmin āyaya yat cyavayatha vithurāiva sam-hitam vi adriṇā patatha tveṣam arṇavam
sātiḥ na vaḥ ama-vatī svaḥ-vatī tveṣā vi-pākā marutaḥ pipiṣvatī bhadrā vaḥ rātiḥ pr̥ṇataḥ na dakṣiṇā pr̥thu-jrayī asuryāiva jañjatī
prati stobhanti sindhavaḥ pavi-bhyaḥ yat abhriyām vācam ut-īrayant i ava smayanta vi-dyutaḥ pr̥thivyām yadi ghr̥tam marutaḥ pruṣṇuvanti
asūta pr̥śniḥ mahate raṇāya tveṣam ayāsām marutām anīkam te sapsarāsaḥ ajanayanta abhvam āt it svadhām iṣirām pari apaśyan
eṣaḥ vaḥ stomaḥ marutaḥ iyam gīḥ māndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ ā iṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayām vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
mahaḥ cit tvam indra yataḥ etān mahaḥ cit asi tyajasaḥ varūtā saḥ naḥ vedhaḥ marutām cikitvān sumnā vanuṣva tava hi preṣṭhā
ayujran te indra viśva-kr̥ṣṭīḥ vidānāsaḥ niḥ-sidhaḥ martya-trā marutām pr̥tsutiḥ hāsamānā svaḥ-mīl̥hasya pra-dhanasya sātau
amyak sā te indra r̥ṣṭiḥ asme iti sanemi abhvam marutaḥ junanti agniḥ cit hi sma atase śuśukvān āpaḥ na dvīpam dadhati prayāṁsi
tvam tu naḥ indra tam rayim dāḥ ojiṣṭhayā dakṣiṇayāiva rātim stutaḥ ca yāḥ te cakananta vāyoḥ stanam na madhvaḥ pīpayanta vājaiḥ
tve iti rāyaḥ indra tośa-tamāḥ pra-netāraḥ kasya cit r̥ta-yoḥ te su naḥ marutaḥ mr̥l̥ayantu ye sma purā gātuyanti-iva devāḥ
prati pra yāhi indra mīl̥huṣaḥ nr̥r̥n mahaḥ pārthive sadane yatasva adha yat eṣām pr̥thu-budhnāsaḥ etāḥ tīrthe na aryaḥ paiṁsyāni tasthuḥ
prati ghorāṇām etānām ayāsām marutām śr̥ṇve āyatām upabdiḥ ye martyam pr̥tanāyantam ūmaiḥ r̥ṇa-vānam na patayanta sargaiḥ
tvam mānebhyaḥ indra viśva-janyā rada marut-bhiḥ śurudhaḥ go--agrāḥ stavānebhiḥ stavase deva devaiḥ vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
na nūnam asti no iti śvaḥ kaḥ tat veda yat adbhutam anyasya cittam abhi sam-careṇyam uta ādhītam vi naśyati
kim naḥ indra jighāṁsasi bhrātaraḥ marutaḥ tava tebhiḥ kalpasva sādhu-yā mā naḥ sam-araṇe vadhīḥ
kim na bhrātaḥ agastya sakhā san ati manyase vidma hi te yathā manaḥ asmabhyam it na ditsasi
aram kr̥ṇvantu vedim sam agnim indhatām puraḥ tatra amr̥tasya cetanam yajñam te tanavāvahai
tvam īśiṣe vasu-pate vasūnām tvam mitrāṇām mitra-pate dheṣṭhaḥ indra tvam marut-bhiḥ sam vadasva adha pra aśāna r̥tu-thā havīṁṣi
prati vaḥ enā namasā aham emi su-uktena bhikṣe su-matim turāṇām rarāṇatā marutaḥ vedyābhiḥ ni hel̥aḥ dhatta vi mucadhvam aśvān
eṣaḥ vaḥ stomaḥ marutaḥ namasvān hr̥dā taṣṭaḥ manasā dhāyi devāḥ upa īm ā yāta manasā juṣāṇāḥ yūyam hi stha namasaḥ it vr̥dhāsaḥ
stutāsaḥ naḥ marutaḥ mr̥l̥ayantu uta stutaḥ magha-vā śam-bhaviṣṭhaḥ ūrdhvā naḥ santu komyā vanāni ahāni viśvā marutaḥ jigīṣā
asmāt aham taviṣāt īṣamāṇaḥ indrāt bhiyā marutaḥ rejamānaḥ yuṣmabhyam havyā ni-śitāni āsan tāni āre cakr̥ma mr̥l̥ata naḥ
yena mānāsaḥ citayante usrāḥ vi-uṣṭiṣu śavasā śaśvatīnām saḥ naḥ marut-bhiḥ vr̥ṣabha śravaḥ dhāḥ ugraḥ ugrebhiḥ sthaviraḥ sahaḥ-dāḥ
tvam pāhi indra sahīyasaḥ nr̥r̥n bhava marut-bhiḥ avayāta-hel̥āḥ su-praketebhiḥ sasahiḥ dadhānaḥ vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
citraḥ vaḥ astu yāmaḥ citraḥ ūtī su-dānavaḥ marutaḥ ahi-bhānavaḥ
āre sā vaḥ su-dānavaḥ marutaḥ r̥ñjatī śaruḥ āre aśmā yam asyatha
tr̥ṇa-skandasya nu viśaḥ pari vr̥ṅkta su-dānavaḥ ūrdhvān naḥ katar jīvase
gāyat sāma nabhanyam yathā veḥ arcāma tat vavr̥dhānam svaḥ-vat gāvaḥ dhenavaḥ barhiṣi adabdhāḥ ā yat sadmānam divyam vivāsān
arcat vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣa-bhiḥ sva-iduhavyaiḥ mr̥gaḥ na aśnaḥ ati yat juguyārt pra mandayuḥ manām gūrta hotā bharate maryaḥ mithunā yajatraḥ
nakṣat hotā pari sadma mitā yan bharat garbham ā śaradaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ krandat aśvaḥ nayamānaḥ ruvat gauḥ antaḥ dūtaḥ na rodasī iti carat vāk
tā karma aṣa-tarā asmai pra cyautnāni deva-yantaḥ bharante jujoṣat indraḥ dasma-varcāḥ nāsatyāiva sugmyaḥ rathe--sthāḥ
tam uṁm iti stuhi indram yaḥ ha satvā yaḥ śūraḥ maghavā yaḥ rathe--sthāḥ pratīcaḥ cit yodhīyān vr̥ṣaṇ-vān vavavruṣaḥ cit tamasaḥ vi-hantā
pra yat itthā mahinā nr̥-bhyaḥ asti aram rodasī iti kakṣye iti na asmai sam vivye indraḥ vr̥janam na bhūma bharti svadhāvān opaśam-iva dyām
samat-su tvā śūra satām urāṇam prapathin-tamam pari-taṁsayadhyai sajoṣasaḥ indram made kṣoṇīḥ sūrim cit ye anu-madanti vājaiḥ
eva hi te śam savanā samudre āpaḥ yat te āsu madanti devīḥ viśvā te anu joṣyā bhūt gauḥ sūrīn cit yadi dhiṣā veṣi janān
asāma yathā su-sakhāyaḥ ena su-abhiṣṭayaḥ narām na śaṁsaiḥ asat yathā naḥ indraḥ vandane--sthāḥ turaḥ na karma nayamānaḥ ukthā
vi-spardhasaḥ narām na śaṁsaiḥ asmāka asat indraḥ vajra-hastaḥ mitra-yuvaḥ na pūḥ-patim su-śiśṭau madhya-yuvaḥ upa śikṣanti yajñaiḥ
yajñaḥ hi sma indram kaḥ cit r̥ndhan juhurtāṇaḥ cit manasā pari-yan tīrthe na accha tatr̥ṣāṇam okaḥ dīrghaḥ na sidhram ā kr̥ṇoti adhvā
mo iti su ṇaḥ indra atra pr̥t-su devaiḥ asti hi sma te śuṣmin ava-yāḥ mahaḥ cit yasya mīl̥huṣaḥ yavyā haviṣmataḥ marutaḥ vandate gīḥ
eṣaḥ stomaḥ indra tubhyam asme iti etena gātum hari-vaḥ vidaḥ naḥ ā naḥ vavr̥tyāḥ suvitāya deva vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
tvam rājā indra ye ca devāḥ rakṣa nr̥r̥n pāhi asura tvam asmān tvam sat-patiḥ magha-vā naḥ tarutraḥ tvam satyaḥ vasavānaḥ sahaḥ-dāḥ
danaḥ viśaḥ indra mr̥dhra-vācaḥ sapta yat puraḥ śarma śāradīḥ darta r̥ṇoḥ apaḥ anavadya arṇāḥ yūne vr̥tram puru-kutsāya randhīḥ
aja vr̥taḥ indra śūra-patnīḥ dyām ca yebhiḥ puru-hūta nūnam rakṣaḥ agnim aśuṣam tūrvayāṇam siṁhaḥ na dame apāṁsi vastoḥ
śeṣan nu te indra sasmin yonau pra-śastaye pavīravasya mahnā sr̥jat arṇāṁsi ava yat yudhā gāḥ tiṣṭhat harī iti dhr̥ṣatā mr̥ṣṭa vājān
vaha kutsam indra yasmin cākan syūmanyū iti r̥jrā vātasya asvā pra sūraḥ cakram vr̥hatāt abhīke abhi spr̥dhaḥ yāsiṣat vajra-bāhuḥ
jaghanvān indra mitrerūn coda-pravr̥ddhaḥ hari-vaḥ adāśūn pra ye paśyan aryamaṇam sacā āyoḥ tvayā śūrtāḥ vahamānāḥ apatyam
rapat kaviḥ indra arka-sātau kṣām dāsāya upa-barhaṇīm karitikaḥ karat tisraḥ magha-vā dānu-citrāḥ ni duryoṇe kuyavācam mr̥dhi śret
sanā tā te indra navyāḥ ā aguḥ sahaḥ nabhaḥ avi-raṇāya pūrvīḥ bhinat puraḥ na bhidaḥ adevīḥ nanamaḥ vadhaḥ adevasya pīyoḥ
tvam dhuniḥ indra dhuni-matīḥ r̥ṇoḥ apaḥ sīrāḥ na sravantīḥ pra yat samudram ati śūra parṣi pāraya turvaśam yadum svasti
tvam asmākam indra viśvadha syāḥ avr̥ka-tamaḥ narān nr̥-pātā saḥ naḥ viśvāsām spr̥dhām sahaḥ-dāḥ vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
matsi apāyi te mahaḥ pātrasya-iva hari-vaḥ matsaraḥ madaḥ vr̥ṣā te vr̥ṣṇe induḥ vājī sahasra-sātamaḥ
ā naḥ te gantu matsaraḥ vr̥ṣā madaḥ vareṇyaḥ saha-vān indra sānasiḥ pr̥tanāṣāṭ amartyaḥ
tvam hi śūraḥ sanitā codayaḥ manuṣaḥ ratham saha-vān dasyum avratam oṣaḥ pātram na śociṣā
muṣāya sūrya kave cakram īśānaḥ ojasā vaha śuṣṇāya vadham kutsam vātasya aśvaiḥ
śuṣmin-tamaḥ hi te madaḥ dyumnin-tamaḥ uta kratuḥ vr̥tra-ghnā var ivaḥ-vidā maṁsīṣṭhāḥ aśva-sātamaḥ
yathā pūrvebhyaḥ jaritr̥-bhyaḥ indra mayaḥ-iva āpaḥ na tr̥ṣyate babhūtha tām anu tvā ni-vidam johavīmi vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
matsi naḥ vasyaḥ-iṣṭaye indram indo iti vr̥ṣā ā viśa r̥ghāyamāṇaḥ invasi śatrum anti na vindasi
tasmin ā veśaya giraḥ yaḥ ekaḥ carṣaṇīnām anu svadhā yam upyate yavam na carkr̥ṣat vr̥ṣā
yasya viśvāni hastayoḥ pañca kṣitīnām vasu spāśayasva yaḥ asma-dhruk divyāiva aśaniḥ jahi
asunvantam samam jahi duḥ-nasam yaḥ na te mayaḥ asmabhyam asya vedanam daddhi sūriḥ cit ohate
āvaḥ yasya dvi-barhasaḥ arkeṣu sānuṣak asat ājau indrasya indo iti pra āvaḥ vājeṣu vājinam
yathā pūrvebhyaḥ jaritr̥-bhyaḥ indra mayaḥ-iva āpaḥ na tr̥ṣyate babhūtha tām anu tvā ni-vidam johavīmi vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
ā carṣaṇi-prāḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ janānām rājā kr̥ṣṭīnām puru-hūtaḥ indraḥ stutaḥ śravasyan avasā upa madrik yuktvā harī vr̥ṣaṇā yāhi arvāṅ
ye te vr̥ṣaṇaḥ vr̥ṣabhāsaḥ indra brahma-yujaḥ vr̥ṣa-rathāsaḥ atyāḥ tān ā tiṣṭha tebhiḥ ā yāhi arvāṅ havāmahe tvā sute indra some
ā tiṣṭha ratham vr̥ṣaṇam vr̥ṣā te sutaḥ somaḥ pari-siktā madhūni yuktvā vr̥ṣa-bhyām vr̥ṣabha kṣitīnām hari-bhyām yāhi pra-vatā upa madrik
ayam yajñaḥ deva-yāḥ ayam miyedhaḥ imā brahmāṇi ayam indra somaḥ stīrṇam barhiḥ ā tu śakra pra yāhi piba ni-sadya vi muca harī iti iha
o iti su-stutaḥ indra yāhi arvāṅ upa brahmāṇi mānyasya kāroḥ vidyāma vastoḥ avasā gr̥ṇantaḥ vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
yat ha syā te indra śruṣṭiḥ asti yayā babhūtha jaritr̥-bhyaḥ ūtī mā naḥ kāmam mahayantam ā dhak viśvā te aśyām pari āpaḥ āyoḥ
na gha rājā indraḥ ā dabhat naḥ yā nu svasārā kr̥ṇavanta yonau āpaḥ cit asmai su-tukāḥ aveṣan gamat naḥ indraḥ sakhyā vayaḥ ca
jetā nr̥-bhiḥ indraḥ pr̥t-su śūraḥ śrotā havam nādhamānasya kāroḥ pra-bhartā ratham dāśuṣaḥ upāke ut-yantā giraḥ yadi ca tmanā bhūt
eva nr̥-bhiḥ indraḥ su-śravasyā pra-khādaḥ pr̥kṣaḥ abhi mitriṇaḥ bhūt sa-marye iṣaḥ stavate vi-vāci satrākaraḥ yajamānasya śaṁsaḥ
tvayā vayam magha-van indra śatrūn abhi syāma mahataḥ manyamānān tvam trātā tvam oṁ iti naḥ vr̥dhe bhūḥ vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
pūrvīḥ aham śaradaḥ śaśramāṇā doṣāḥ vastoḥ uṣasaḥ jarayantīḥ mināti śriyam jarimā tanūnām api oṁ iti nu patnīḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ jagamyuḥ
ye cit hi pūrve r̥ta-sāpaḥ āsan sākam devebhiḥ avadan r̥tāni te cit ava asuḥ nahi antam āpuḥ sam oṁ iti nu patnīḥ vr̥ṣa-bhiḥ jagamyuḥ
na mr̥ṣā śrāntam yat avanti devāḥ viśvāḥ it spr̥dhaḥ abhi aśnavāva jayāva it atra śata-nītham ājim yat samyañcā mithunau abhi ajāva
nadasya mā rudhataḥ kāmaḥ ā agan itaḥ ājātaḥ amutaḥ kutaḥ cit lopāmudrā vr̥ṣaṇam niḥ riṇāti dhīram adhīrā dhayati śvasantam
imam nu somam antitaḥ hr̥t-su pītam upa bruve yat sīm āgaḥ cakr̥ma tat su mr̥l̥atu pulu-kāmaḥ hi martyaḥ
agastyaḥ khanamānaḥ khanitraiḥ pra-jām apatyam balam icchamānaḥ ubhau varṇau r̥ṣiḥ ugraḥ pupoṣa satyāḥ deveṣu āśiṣaḥ jagāma
yuvaḥ rajāṁsi su-yamāsaḥ aśvāḥ rathaḥ yat vām pari arṇāṁsi dīyat hiraṇyayā vām pavayaḥ pruṣāyan madhvaḥ pibantau uṣasaḥ sacetheiti
yuvam atyasya ava nakṣathaḥ yat vi-patmanaḥ naryasya pra-yajyoḥ svasā yat vām viśvagūrtī itiviśva-gūrtī bharāti vājāya īṭe madhu-pau iṣe ca
yuvam payaḥ usriyāyām adhattam pakvam āmāyām ava pūrvyam goḥ antaḥ yat vaninaḥ vām r̥tapsūity r̥ta-psū hvāraḥ na śuciḥ yajate haviṣmān
yuvam ha gharmam madhu-mantam atraye apaḥ na kṣodaḥ avr̥ṇītam eṣe tat vām narau aśvinā paśvaḥ-iṣṭiḥ rathyāiva cakrā prati yanti madhvaḥ
ā vām dānāya vavr̥tīya dasrā goḥ ohena taugryaḥ na jivriḥ apaḥ kṣoṇī iti sacate māhinā vām jūrṇaḥ vām akṣuḥ aṁhasaḥ yajatrā
ni yat yuvetheiti ni-yutaḥ sudānūitisu-dānū upa svadhābhiḥ sr̥jathaḥ puram-dhim preṣat veṣat vātaḥ na sūriḥ ā mahe dade su-vrataḥ na vājam
vayam cit hi vām jaritāraḥ satyāḥ vipanyāmahe vi paṇiḥ hita-vān adha cit hi sma aśvinau anindyā pāthaḥ hi sma vr̥ṣaṇau anti-devam
yuvām cit hi sma aśvinau anu dyūn vi-rudrasya pra-sravaṇasya sātau agastyaḥ narām nr̥ṣu pra-śastaḥ kārādhunī-iva citayat sahasraiḥ
pra yat vahetheiti mahinā rathasya pra syandrā yāthaḥ manuṣaḥ na hotā dhattam sūri-bhyaḥ uta vā su-aśvyam nāsatyā rayi-sācaḥ syāma
tam vām ratham vayam adya huvema stomaiḥ aśvinā suvitāya navyam ariṣṭa-nemim pari dyām iyānam vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
kat oṁ iti preṣṭhau iṣām rayīṇām adhvaryantā yat ut-ninīthaḥ apām ayam vām yajñaḥ akr̥ta pra-śaśtim vasudhitī itivasu-dhitī avitārā janānām
ā vām aśvāsaḥ śucayaḥ payaḥ-pāḥ vāta-raṁhasaḥ divyāsaḥ atyāḥ manaḥ-juvaḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ vīta-pr̥ṣṭhāḥ ā iha sva-rājaḥ aśvinā vahantu
ā vām rathaḥ avaniḥ na pravatvān sr̥pra-vandhuraḥ suvitāya gamyāḥ vr̥ṣṇaḥ sthātārā manasaḥ javīyān aham-pūrvaḥ yajataḥ dhiṣṇyā yaḥ
iha-iha jātā sam avāvaśītām arepasā tanvā nāma-bhiḥ svaiḥ jiṣṇuḥ vām anyaḥ su-makhasya sūriḥ divaḥ anyaḥ su-bhagaḥ putraḥ ūhe
pra vām ni-ceruḥ kakuhaḥ vaśān anu piśaṅga-rūpaḥ sadanāni gamyāḥ harī anyasya pīpayanta vājaiḥ mathnāa rajāṁsi aśvinā vi ghoṣaiḥ
pra vām śarat-vān vr̥ṣabhaḥ na niṣṣāṭ pūrvīḥ iṣaḥ carati madhvaḥ iṣṇan evaiḥ anyasya pīpayanta vājaiḥ veṣantīḥ ūrdhvāḥ nadyaḥ naḥ ā aguḥ
asarji vām sthavirā vedhasā gīḥ bāl̥he aśvinā tredhā kṣarantī upa-stutau avatam nādhamānam yāman ayāman śr̥ṇutam havam me
uta syā vām ruśataḥ vapsasaḥ gīḥ tri-barhiṣi sadasi pinvate nr̥r̥n vr̥ṣā vām meghaḥ vr̥ṣaṇā pīpāya goḥ na seke manuṣaḥ daśasyan
yuvām pūṣāiva aśvinā puram-dhiḥ agnim uṣām na jarate haviṣmān huve yat vām varivasyā gr̥ṇānaḥ vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
abhāūt idam vayunam o iti su bhūṣata rathaḥ vr̥ṣaṇ-vān madata manīṣiṇaḥ dhiyam-jinvā dhiṣṇyā viśpalāvasūiti divaḥ napātā su-kr̥te śuci-vratā
indra-tamā hi dhiṣṇyā marut-tamā dasrā daṁsiṣṭhā rathyā rathi-tamā pūṇarm ratham vahetheiti madhvaḥ ācitam tena dāśvāṁsam upa yāthaḥ aśvinā
kim atra dasrā kr̥ṇuthaḥ kim āsāthe janaḥ yaḥ kaḥ cit ahaviḥ mahīyate ati kramiṣṭam juratam paṇeḥ asum jyotiḥ viprāya kr̥ṇutam vacasyave
jambhayatam abhitaḥ rāyataḥ śunaḥ hatam mr̥dhaḥ vidathuḥ tāni aśvinā vācam-vācam jarituḥ ratninīm kr̥tam ubhā saṁsam nāsatyā avatam mama
yuvam etam cakratuḥ sindhuṣu plavam ātman-vantam pakṣiṇam taugryāya kam yena deva-trā manasā niḥ-ūhathuḥ su-paptani petathuḥ kṣodasaḥ mahaḥ
ava-viddham taugryam ap-su antaḥ anārambhaṇe tamasi pra-viddham catasraḥ nāvaḥ jaṭhalasya juṣṭāḥ ut aśvi-bhyām iṣitāḥ pārayanti
kaḥ svit vr̥kṣaḥ niḥ-sthitaḥ madhye arṇasaḥ yam taugryaḥ nādhitaḥ pari-aṣasvajat parṇā mr̥gasya pataroḥ-iva ārabhe ut aśvinā ūhathuḥ śromatāya kam
tat vām narā nāsatyau anu syāt yat vām mānāsaḥ ucatham avocan asmāt adya sadasaḥ somyāt ā vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
tam yuñjāthām manasaḥ yaḥ javīyān tri-vandhuraḥ vr̥ṣaṇā yaḥ tri-cakraḥ yena upa-yāthaḥ su-kr̥taḥ duroṇam tri-dhātunā patathaḥ viḥ na parṇaiḥ
su-vr̥t rathaḥ vartate yan abhi kṣām yat tiṣṭhathaḥ kratu-mantā anu pr̥kṣe vapuḥ vapuṣyā sacatām iyam gīḥ divaḥ duhitrā uṣasā sacetheiti
ā tiṣṭhatam su-vr̥tam yaḥ rathaḥ vām anu vratāni vartate haviṣmān yena narā nāsatyā iṣayadhyai vartiḥ yāthaḥ tanayāya tmane ca
mā vām vr̥kaḥ mā vr̥kīḥ ā dadharṣīt mā pari varktam uta mā ati dhaktam ayam vām bhāgaḥ ni-hitaḥ iyam gīḥ dasrau ime vām ni-dhayaḥ madhūnām
yuvam gotamaḥ puru-mīl̥haḥ atriḥ dasrā havate avase haviṣmān diśam na diṣṭām r̥juyāiva yantā ā me havam nāsatyā upa yātam
atāriṣma tamasaḥ pāram asya prati vām stomaḥ aśvinau adhāyi ā iha yātam pathi-bhiḥ deva-yānaiḥ vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
tā vām adya tau aparam huvema ucchantyām uṣasi vahniḥ ukthaiḥ nāsatyā kuha cit santau aryaḥ divaḥ napātā sudāḥ-tarāya
asme iti oṁ iti su vr̥ṣaṇā mādayethām ut paṇīn hatam ūrmyā madantā śrutam me acchokti-bhiḥ matīnām eṣṭā narā ni-cetārā ca karṇaiḥ
śriye pāūṣan iṣukr̥tāiva devā nāsatyā vahatum sūryāyāḥ vacyante vām kakuhāḥ ap-su jātāḥ yugā jūrṇāiva varuṇasya bhūreḥ
asme iti sā vām mādhvī iti rātiḥ astu stomam hinotam mānyasya kāroḥ anu yat vām śravasyā sudānūitisu-dānū su-vīryāya carṣaṇayaḥ madanti
eṣaḥ vām stomaḥ aśvinau akāri mānebhiḥ magha-vānā su-vr̥kti yātam vartiḥ tanayāya tmane ca agastye nāsatyā madantā
atāriṣma tamasaḥ pāram asya prati vām stomaḥ aśvinau adhāyi ā iha yātam pathi-bhiḥ deva-yānaiḥ vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
katarā pūrvā katarā aparā ayoḥ kathā jāte iti kavayaḥ kaḥ vi veda viśvam tmanā bibhr̥taḥ yat ha nāma vi vartete ahanī iti cakriyāiva
bhūri dve iti acarantī iti carantam pat-vantam garbham apadī iti dadhāteiti nityam na sūnum pitroḥ upa-sthe dyāvā rakṣatam pr̥thivī iti naḥ abhvāt
anehaḥ dātram aditeḥ anarvam huve svaḥ-vat avadham namasvat tat rodasī iti janayatam jaritre dyāvā rakṣatam pr̥thivī iti naḥ abhvāt
iti anu syāma rodasī iti devaputreitideva-putre ubhe iti devānām ubhayebhiḥ ahnām dyāvā rakṣatam pr̥thivī iti naḥ abhvāt
iti samanteitisam-ante svasārā jāmī iti pitroḥ upa-sthe abhijighrantī ity abhi-jighrantī bhuvanasya nābhim dyāvā rakṣatam pr̥thivī iti naḥ abhvāt
urvī iti sadmanī iti br̥hatī iti r̥tena huve devānām avasā janitrī iti dadhāte ye amr̥tam supratīke itisu-pratīke dyāvā rakṣatam pr̥thivī iti naḥ abhvāt
urvī iti pr̥thvī iti bahuleiti dūreanteitidūre--ante upa bruve namasā yajñe asmin dadhāteiti ye iti subhageitisu-bhage supratūrtī itisu-pratūrtī dyāvā rakṣatam pr̥thivī it niḥ abhvāt
devān vā yat cakr̥ma kat cit āgaḥ sakhāyam vā sadam it jāḥ-patim vā iyam dhīḥ bhūyāḥ ava-yānam eṣām dyāvā rakṣatam pr̥thivī iti naḥ abhvāt
ubhā śaṁsā naryā mām aviṣṭām ubhe iti mām ūtī iti avasā sacetām bhūri cit aryaḥ sudāḥ-tarāya iṣā madantaḥ iṣayema devāḥ
r̥tam dive tat avocam pr̥thivyai abhi-śrāvāya prathamam su-medhāḥ pātām avadyāt duḥ-itāt abhīke pitā mātā ca rakṣatām avaḥ-bhiḥ
idam dyāvāpr̥thivī iti satyam astu pitaḥ mātaḥ yat iha upa-bruve vām bhūtam devānām avame iti avaḥ-bhir vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
ā naḥ il̥ābhiḥ vidathe su-śasti viśvānaraḥ savitā devaḥ etu api yathā yuvānaḥ matsatha naḥ viśvam jagat abhi-pitve manīṣā
ā naḥ viśve āskrāḥ gamantu devāḥ mitraḥ aryamā varuṇaḥ sa-joṣāḥ bhuvan yathā naḥ viśve vr̥dhāsaḥ karan su-sahā vithuram na śavaḥ
preṣṭham vaḥ atithim gr̥ṇīṣe agnim śasti-bhiḥ turvaṇiḥ sa-joṣāḥ asat yathā naḥ varuṇaḥ su-kīrtiḥ iṣaḥ ca parṣat ari-gūrtaḥ sūriḥ
upa vaḥ ā iṣe namasā jigīṣā uṣasānaktā sudughāiva dhenuḥ samāne ahan vi-mimānaḥ arkam viṣu-rūpe payasi sasmin ūdhan
uta naḥ ahiḥ budhnyaḥ mayaḥ karitikaḥ śiśum na pipyuṣī-iva vet i sindhuḥ yena napātam apām junāma manaḥ-juvaḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ yam vahanti
uta naḥ īm tvaṣṭā ā gantu accha smat sūri-bhiḥ abhi-pitve sa-joṣāḥ ā vr̥tra-hā indraḥ carṣaṇi-prāḥ tuviḥ-tamaḥ narām naḥ iha gamyāḥ
uta naḥ īm matayaḥ aśva-yogāḥ śiśum na gāvaḥ taruṇam rihanti tam īm giraḥ janayaḥ na patnīḥ surabhiḥ-tamam narām nasanta
uta naḥ īm marutaḥ vr̥ddha-senāḥ smat rodasī iti sa-manasaḥ sadantu pr̥ṣat-aśvāsaḥ vanayaḥ na rathāḥ riśādasaḥ mitra-yujaḥ na devāḥ
pra nu yat eṣām mahinā cikitre pra yuñjate pra-yujaḥ te su-vr̥kti adha yat eṣām su-dine na śaruḥ viśvam ā iriṇam pruṣāyanta senāḥ
pro iti aśvinau avase kr̥ṇudhvam pra pūṣaṇam svatavasaḥ hi santi adveṣaḥ viṣṇuḥ vātaḥ r̥bhukṣāḥ accha sumnāya vavr̥tīya devān
iyam sā vaḥ asme iti dīdhitiḥ yajatrāḥ api-prāṇī ca sadanī ca bhūyāḥ ni yā deveṣu yatate vasu-yuḥ vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
pitum nu stoṣam mahaḥ dharmāṇam taviṣīm yasya tritaḥ vi ojasā vr̥tram vi-parvam ardayat
svādo iti pito iti madho iti pito iti vayam tvā vavr̥mahe asmākam avitā bhava
upa naḥ pito iti ā cara śivaḥ śivābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ mayaḥ-bhuḥ adviṣeṇyaḥ sakhā su-śevaḥ advayāḥ
tava tye pito iti rasāḥ rajāṁsi anu vi-sthitāḥ divi vātāḥ-iva śr̥itāḥ
tava tye pito iti dadataḥ tava svādiṣṭha te pito iti pra svādmānaḥ rasānām tuvigrīvāḥ-iva īrate
tve pito iti mahānām devānām manaḥ hitam akāri cāru ketunā tava ahim avasā avadhīt
yat adaḥ pito iti ajagan vivasva parvatānām atra cit naḥ madho iti pito iti aram bhakṣāya gamyāḥ
yat apām oṣadhīnām pariṁśam āriśāmahe vātāpe pīvaḥ it bhava
yat te soma go--āśiraḥ yava-āśiraḥ bhajāmahe vātāpe pīvaḥ it bhava
karambhaḥ oṣadhe bhava pīvaḥ vr̥kkaḥ udārathiḥ vātāpe pīvaḥ it bhava
tvam tvā vayam pito iti vacaḥ-bhiḥ gāvaḥ na havyā susūdima devebhyaḥ tvā sadha-mādam asmabhyam tvā sdha-mādam
sam-iddhaḥ adya rājasi devaḥ devaiḥ sahasra-jit dūtaḥ havyā kaviḥ vaha
tanū-napāt r̥tam yate madhvā yajñaḥ sam ajyate dadhat sahasriṇīḥ iṣaḥ
ājuhvānaḥ naḥ īḍyaḥ devān ā vakṣi yajñiyān agne sahasra-sāḥ asi
prācīnam barhiḥ ojasā sahasra-vīram astr̥ṇan yatra ādityāḥ vi-rājatha
virāṭ samrāṭ vibhvīḥ pra-bhvīḥ bahvīḥ ca bhūyasīḥ ca yāḥ duraḥ ghr̥tāni akṣaran
surukmeitisu-rukme hi su-peśasā adhi śriyā vi-rājataḥ uṣasau ā iha sīdatām
prathamā hi su-vācasā hotārā daivyā kavī iti yajñam naḥ yakṣatām imam
bhārati il̥e sarasvati yāḥ vaḥ sarvāḥ upa-bruve tāḥ naḥ codayata śriye
tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi hi pra-bhuḥ paśūn viśvān sam-ānaje teṣām naḥ sphātim ā yaja
upa tmanyā vanaspate pāthaḥ devebhyaḥ sr̥ja agniḥ havyāni sisvadat
puraḥ-gāḥ agniḥ devānām gāyatreṇa sam ajyate svāhākr̥tīṣu rocate
agne naya su-pathā rāye asmān viśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān yuyodhi asmat juhurāṇam enaḥ bhūyiṣṭhām te namaḥ-uktim vidhema
agne tvam pāraya navyaḥ asmān svasti-bhiḥ ati duḥ-gāṇi viśvā pūḥ ca pr̥thvī bahulā naḥ urvī bhava tokāya tanayāya śam yoḥ
agne tvam asmat yuyodhi amīvāḥ anagni-trāḥ abhi amanta kr̥ṣṭīḥ punaḥ asmabhyam suvitāya deva kṣām viśvebhiḥ amr̥tebhiḥ yajatra
pāhi naḥ agne pāyu-bhiḥ ajasraiḥ uta priye sadane ā śuśukvaan mā te bhayam jaritāram yaviṣṭha nūnam vidat mā aparam sahasvaḥ
mā naḥ agne ava sr̥jaḥ aghāya aviṣyave ripave ducchunāyai mā datvate daśate mā adate naḥ mā rīṣate sahasāvan parā dāḥ
vi gha tvāvān r̥ta-jāta yaṁsat gr̥ṇanaḥ agne tanve varūtham viśvāt ri rikṣoḥ uta vā ninitsoḥ abhi-hrutām asi hi deva viṣpaṭ
tvam tām agne ubhayān vi vidvān veṣi pra-pitve manuṣaḥ yajatra abhi-pitve manave śāsyaḥ bhūḥ marmr̥jenyaḥ uśik-bhiḥ na akraḥ
avocāma ni-vacanāni asmin mānasya sūnuḥ sahasāne agnau vayam sahasram r̥ṣi-bhiḥ sanema vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
anarvāṇam vr̥ṣabham mandra-jihvam br̥haspatim vardhaya navyam arkaiḥ gāthānyaḥ su-rucaḥ yasya devāḥ āśr̥ṇvanti navamānasya matārḥ
tam r̥tviyāḥ upa vācaḥ sacante sargaḥ na yaḥ deva-yatām asarji br̥haspatiḥ saḥ hi añjaḥ varāṁsi vi-bhvā abhavat sam r̥te mātariśvā
upa-stutim namasaḥ ut-yatim ca ślokam yaṁsat savitāiva pra bāhū iti asya kratvā ahanyaḥ yaḥ asti mr̥gaḥ na bhīmaḥ arakṣasaḥ tuvi ṣmān
asya ślokaḥ divi īyate pr̥thivyām atyaḥ na yaṁsat yakṣa-bhr̥t vi-cetāḥ mr̥gāṇām na hetayaḥ yanti ca imāḥ br̥haspateḥ ahi-māyān abhi dyūn
ye tvā deva usrikam manyamānāḥ pāpāḥ bhadram upa-jīvanti pajrāḥ na duḥ-dhye anu dadāsi vāmam br̥haspate cayase it piyārum
sup-raituḥ su-yavasaḥ na panthā duḥ-niyantuḥ pari-prītaḥ na mitraḥ anarvāṇaḥ abhi ye cakṣate naḥ api-vr̥tāḥ apaūrṇuvantaḥ asthuḥ
sam yam stubhaḥ avanayaḥ na yanti samudram na sravataḥ rodha-cakrāḥ saḥ vidvān ubhayam caṣṭe antaḥ br̥haspatiḥ taraḥ āpaḥ ca gr̥dhraḥ
eva mahaḥ tuvi-jātaḥ tuviṣmān br̥haspatiḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ dhāya deviḥ saḥ naḥ stutaḥ vīra-vat dhātu go--mat vidyāma iṣam vr̥janam jīra-dānum
kaṅkataḥ na kaṅkataḥ atho iti satīna-kaṅkataḥ dvau iti pluṣī iti iti ni adr̥ṣṭāḥ alipsata
iti ava-ghnatī hanti atho iti pinaṣṭi piṁṣatī
śarāsaḥ kuśarāsaḥ darbhāsaḥ sairyāḥ uta mauñjāḥ adr̥ṣṭāḥ vairiṇāḥ sarve sākam ni alipsata
ni gāvaḥ go--sthe asadan ni mr̥gāsaḥ avikṣata ni ketavaḥ janānām ni adr̥ṣṭāḥ alipsata
ete oṁ iti tye prati adr̥śran pra-doṣam taskarāḥ-iva adr̥ṣṭāḥ viśva-dr̥śṭāḥ prati-buddhāḥ abhūtana
dyauḥ vaḥ pitā pr̥thivī mātā somaḥ bhrātā aditiḥ svasā adr̥ṣṭāḥ viśva-dr̥ṣṭāḥ tiṣṭhata ilayata su kam
ye aṁsyāḥ ye aṅgyāḥ sūcīkāḥ ye pra-kaṅkatāḥ adr̥ṣṭāḥ kim cana iha vaḥ sarve sākam ni jasyata
ut purastāt sūryaḥ eti viśva-dr̥ṣṭaḥ adr̥ṣṭa-hā adr̥ṣṭan savārn jambhayan sarvāḥ ca yātu-dhānyaḥ
ut apaptat asau sūryaḥ puru viśvāni jūrvan ādityaḥ parvatebhyaḥ viśva-dr̥ṣṭaḥ adr̥ṣṭa-hā
sūrye viṣam ā sajāmi dr̥tim surāvataḥ gr̥he saḥ cit nu na marāt i no iti vayam marāma āre asya yojanam hari-sthāḥ madhu tvā madhulā cakāra
iyattikā śakuntikā sakā jaghāsa te viṣam so iti cit nu na marāti no iti vayam marāma āre asya yojanam hari-sthāḥ madhu tvā madhulā cakāra
triḥ sapta viṣpuliṅgakāḥ viṣasya puṣyam akṣan tāḥ cit nu na maranti no iti vayam marāma āre asya yojanam hari-sthāḥ madhu tvā madhulā cakāra
navānām navatīnām viṣasya ropuṣīṇām sarvāsām agrabham nāma āre asya yojanam hari-sthāḥ madhu tvā madhulā cakāra
triḥ sapta mayūryaḥ sapta svasāraḥ agruvaḥ tāḥ te viṣam vi jabhrire udakam kumbhinīḥ-iva
iyattakaḥ kuṣumbhakaḥ takam bhinadmi aśmanā tataḥ viṣam pra vavr̥te parācīḥ anu sam-vataḥ
kuṣumbhakaḥ tat abravīt gireḥ pra-vartamānakaḥ vr̥ścikasya arasam viṣam arasam vr̥ścika te viṣam
tvam agne dyu-bhiḥ tvam āśuśukṣaṇiḥ tvam at-bhyaḥ tvam aśmanaḥ pari tvam vanebhyaḥ tvam oṣadhībhyaḥ tvam nr̥ṇām nr̥-pate jāyase śuciḥ
tava agne hotram tava potram r̥tviyam tava neṣṭram tvam agnit r̥ta-yataḥ tava pra-śāstram tvam adhvari-yasi brahmā ca asi gr̥ṭha-patiḥ ca naḥ dame
tvam agne indraḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ satām asi tvam viṣṇuḥ uru-gāyaḥ namasyaḥ tvam brahmā rayi-vit brahmaṇaḥ pate tvam vidhartaritivi-dhartaḥ sacase puram-dhyā
tvam agne rājā varuṇaḥ dhr̥ta-vrataḥ tvam mitraḥ bhavasi dasmaḥ īḍyaḥ tvam aryamā sat-patiḥ yasya sam-bhujam tvam aṁśaḥ vidathe deva bhājayuḥ
tvam agne tvaṣṭā vidhate su-vīryam tava gnāvaḥ mitra-mahaḥ sa-jātyam tvam āśu-hemā rariṣe su-aśvyam tvam narām śardhaḥ asi puru-vasuḥ
tvam agne rudraḥ asuraḥ mahaḥ divaḥ tvam śardhaḥ mārutam pr̥kṣaḥ īśiṣe tvam vātaiḥ aruṇaiḥ yāsi śam-gayaḥ tvam pūṣā vidhataḥ pāsi nu tmanā
tvam agne draviṇaḥ-dāḥ aram-kr̥te tvam devaḥ savitā ratna-dhāḥ asi tvam bhagaḥ nr̥-pate vasvaḥ īśiṣe tvam pāyuḥ dame yaḥ te avidhat
tvām agne dame ā viśpatim viśaḥ tvām rājānam su-vidatram r̥ñjate tvam viśvāni su-anīka patyase tvam sahasrāṇi śatā daśa prati
tvām agne pitaram iṣṭi-bhiḥ naraḥ tvām bhrātrāya śamyā tanū-rucam tvam putraḥ bhavasi yaḥ te avidhat tvam sakhā su-śevaḥ pāsi ādhr̥ṣaḥ
tvam agne r̥bhuḥ āke namasyaḥ tvam vājasya kṣu-mataḥ rāyaḥ īśiṣe tvam vi bhāsi anu dhakṣi dāvane tvam vi-śikṣuḥ asi yajñam ātaniḥ
tvam agne aditiḥ deva dāśuṣe tvam hotrā bhāratī vardhase girā tvam il̥ā śata-himā asi dakṣase tvam vr̥tra-hā vasu-pate sarasvatī
tvam agne su-bhr̥taḥ ut-tamam vayaḥ tava spārhe varṇe ā sam-dr̥śi śriyaḥ tvam vājaḥ pra-taraṇaḥ br̥han asi tvam rayiḥ bahulaḥ viśvataḥ pr̥thuḥ
tvām agne ādityāsaḥ āsyam tvām jihvām śucayaḥ cakrire kave tvām rāti-sācaḥ adhvareṣu saścire tve iti devāḥ haviḥ adanti āhutam
tve iti agne viśve amr̥tāsaḥ adruhaḥ āsā devāḥ haviḥ adanti āhutam tvayā martāsaḥ svadante āsutim tvam garbhaḥ vīrudhām jajñiṣe śuciḥ
tvam tān sam ca prati ca asi majmanā agne su-jāta pra ca deva ri cyase pr̥kṣaḥ yat atra mahinā vi te bhuvat anu dyāvāpr̥thivī iti rodasī iti ubhe iti
ye stotr̥-bhyaḥ go--agrām aśva-peśasam agne rātim upa-sr̥janti sūrayaḥ asmān ca tān ca pra hi neṣi vasyaḥ ā br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
yajñena vardhata jāta-vedasam agnim yajadhvam haviṣā tanā girā sam-idhānam su-prayasam svaḥ-naram dyukṣam hotāram vr̥janeṣu dhūḥ-sadam
abhi tvā naktīḥ uṣasaḥ vavāśire agne vatsam na svasareṣu dhenavaḥ divaḥ-iva it aratiḥ mānuṣā yugā ā kṣapaḥ bhāsi puru-vāra sam-yataḥ
taṁ devāḥ budhne rajasaḥ su-daṁsasam divaḥpr̥thivyoḥ aratim ni er ire ratham-iva vedyam śukra-śociṣam agnim mitram na kṣitiṣu pra-śaṁsyam
tam ukṣamāṇam rajasi sve ā dame candram-iva su-rucam hvāre ā dadhuḥ pr̥śnyāḥ pataram citayantam akṣa-bhiḥ pāthaḥ na pāyum janasī iti ubhe iti anu
saḥ hotā viśvam pari bhūtu adhvaram tam oṁ iti havyaiḥ manuṣaḥ r̥ñjate girā hiri-śipraḥ vr̥dhasānāsu jarbhurat dyauḥ na str̥-bhiḥ citayat rodasī iti anu
saḥ naḥ revat sam-idhānaḥ svastaye sam-dadasvān rayim asmāsu dīdihi ā naḥ kr̥ṇuṣva suvitāya rodasī iti agne havyā manuṣaḥ deva vītaye
dāḥ naḥ agne br̥hataḥ dāḥ sahasriṇaḥ duraḥ na vājam śrutyai apa vr̥dhi prācī iti dyāvāpr̥thivī iti brahmaṇā kr̥dhi svaḥ na śukram uṣasaḥ vi didyutuḥ
saḥ idhānaḥ uṣasaḥ rāmyāḥ anu svaḥ na dīdet aruṣeṇa bhānunā hotrābhiḥ agniḥ manuṣaḥ su-adhvaraḥ rājā viśām atithiḥ cāruḥ āyave
eva naḥ / agne amr̥teṣu pūrvya dhīḥ pīpāya br̥hat-diveṣu mānuṣā duhānā dhenuḥ vr̥janeṣu kārave tmanā śatinam puru-rūpam iṣaṇi
vayam agne arvatā vā su-vīryam brahmaṇā vā citayema janān ati asmākam dyumnam adhi pañca kr̥ṣṭiṣu uccā svaḥ na śuśucīta dustaram
saḥ naḥ bodhi sahasya pra-śaṁsyaḥ yasmin su-jātāḥ iṣayanta sūrayaḥ yam agne yajñam upa-yanti vājinaḥ nitye toke dīdi-vāṁsam sve dame
ubhayāsaḥ jāta-vedaḥ syāma te stotāraḥ agne sūrayaḥ ca śarmaṇi vasvo rāyaḥ puru-candrasya bhūyasaḥ prajāvataḥ su-apatyasya śagdhi naḥ
ye stotr̥-bhyaḥ go--agrām aśva-peśasam agne rātim upa-sr̥janti sūrayaḥ asmān ca tān ca pra hi neṣi vasyaḥ ā br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
sam-iddhaḥ agniḥ ni-hitaḥ pr̥thivyām pratyaṅ viśvāni bhuvanāni asthāt hotā pāvakaḥ pra-divaḥ su-medhāḥ devaḥ devān yajatu agniḥ arhan
narāśaṁsaḥ prati dhāmāni añjan tisraḥ divaḥ prati mahnā su-arci ḥ ghr̥ta-pruṣā manasā havyam undan mūrdhan yajñasya sam anaktu devān
īl̥itaḥ agne manasā naḥ arhan devān yakṣi mānuṣāt pūrvaḥ adya saḥ ā vaha marutām śardhaḥ acyutam indram naraḥ barhi-sadam yajadhvam
deva barhiḥ vardhamānam su-vīram stīrṇam rāye su-bharam vedī iti asyām ghr̥tena aktam vasavaḥ sīdata idam viśve devāḥ ādityāḥ yajñiyāsaḥ
vi śrayantām urviyā hūyamānāḥ dvāraḥ devīḥ supra-ayanāḥ namaḥ-bhiḥ vyacasvatīḥ vi prathantām ajuryāḥ varṇam punānāḥ yaśasam su-vīram
sādhu apāṁsi sanatā naḥ ukṣite iti uṣasānaktā vayyāiva raṇvite iti tantum tatam saṁvayantī itisam-vayantī samīcī itisam-īcī yajñasya peśaḥ sudugheitisu-dughe payasvatī iti
daivyā hotārā prathamā viduḥ-tarā r̥ju yakṣataḥ sam r̥cā vapuḥ-tarā devān yajantau r̥tu-thā sam añjataḥ nābhā pr̥thivyāḥ adhi sānuṣu triṣu
sarasvatī sādhayantī dhiyam naḥ il̥ā devī bhāratī viśva-tūrtiḥ tisraḥ devīḥ svadhayā barhiḥ ā idam acchidram pāntu śaraṇam ni-sadya
piśaṅga-rūpaḥ su-bharaḥ vayaḥ-dhāḥ śruṣṭī vīraḥ jāyate deva-kāmaḥ pra-jām tvaṣṭā vi syatu nābhim asme iti atha devānām api etu pāthaḥ
vanaspatiḥ ava-sr̥jan upa sthāt agniḥ haviḥ sūdayāti pra dhībhiḥ tridhā sam-aktam nayatu pra-jānan devebhyaḥ daivyaḥ śamitā upa havyam
ghr̥tam mimikṣe ghr̥tam asya yoniḥ ghr̥te śritaḥ ghr̥tam oṁ iti asya dhāma anu-svadham ā vaha mādayasva svāhākr̥tam vr̥ṣabha vakṣi havyam
huve vaḥ su-dyotmānam su-vr̥ktim viśām agnim atithim su-prayasam m itraḥ-iva yaḥ didhiṣāyyaḥ bhūt devaḥ ādeve jane jāta-vedāḥ
imam vidhantaḥ apām sadha-sthe dvitā adadhuḥ bhr̥gavaḥ vikṣu āyoḥ eṣaḥ viśvāni abhi astu bhūma devānām agniḥ aratiḥ jīra-aśvaḥ
agnim devāsaḥ mānuṣīṣu vikṣu priyam dhuḥ kṣeṣyantaḥ na mitram saḥ dīdayat uśatīḥ ūrmyāḥ ā dakṣāyyaḥ yaḥ dāsvate dame ā
asya raṇvā svasya-iva puṣṭiḥ sam-dr̥ṣṭiḥ asya hiyānasya dhakṣoḥ vi yaḥ bharibhrat oṣadhīṣu jihvām atyaḥ na rathyaḥ dodhavīti vārān
ā yat me abhvam vanadaḥ pananta uśik-bhyaḥ na amimīta varṇam saḥ citreṇa cikite ram-su bhāsā jujurvān yaḥ muhuḥ ā yuvā bhūt
ā yaḥ vanā tatr̥ṣāṇaḥ na bhāti vāḥ na pathā rathyāiva svānīt kr̥ṣṇa-adhvā tapuḥ raṇvaḥ ciketa dyauḥ-iva smayamānaḥ nabhaḥ-bhiḥ
saḥ yaḥ vi asthāt abhi dhakṣat urvīṁ paśuḥ na eti sva-yuḥ agopāḥ agniḥ śociṣmān atasān yuṣṇan kr̥ṣṇa-vyathiḥ asvadayat na bhūma
nu te pūrvasya avasaḥ adhi-itau tr̥tīye vidathe manma śaṁsi asme iti agne saṁyat-vīram br̥hantam kṣu-mantam vājam su-apatyam rayim dāḥ
tvayā yathā gr̥tsa-madāsaḥ agne guhā vanvantaḥ uparān abhi syuritisyuḥ su-vīrāsaḥ abhimāti-sahaḥ smat sūri-bhyaḥ gr̥ṇate tat vayaḥ dhāḥ
hotā ajaniṣṭa cetanaḥ pitā pitr̥-bhyaḥ ūtaye pra-yakṣan jenyam vasu śakema vājinaḥ yamam
ā yasmin sapta raśmayaḥ tatāḥ yajñasya netari manuṣvat daivyam aṣṭamam potā viśvam tat invati
dadhanve vā yat īm anu vocat brahmāṇi veḥ oṁ iti tat pari viśvāni kāvyā nemiḥ cakram-iva abhavat
sākam hi śucinā śuciḥ pra-śāstā kratunā ajani vidvān asya vratā dhruvā vayāḥ-iva anu rohate
tāḥ asya varṇam āyuvaḥ neṣṭuḥ sacanta dhenavaḥ kuvit tisr̥-bhyaḥ ā varam svasāraḥ yāḥ idam yayuḥ
yadi mātuḥ upa svasā ghr̥tam bharantī asthita tāsām adhvaryuḥ āgatau yavaḥ vr̥ṣṭī-iva modate
svaḥ svāya dhāyase kr̥ṇutām r̥tvik r̥tvijam stomam yajñam ca āt aram vanema rarima vayam
yathā vidvān aram karat viśvebhyaḥ yajatebhyaḥ ayam agne tve iti api yam yajñam cakr̥ma vayam
imām me agne sam-idham imām upa-sadam vaneritivaneḥ imāḥ oṁ iti su śrudhi giraḥ
ayā te agne vidhema ūrjaḥ napāt aśvam-iṣṭe enā su-uktena su-jāta
tam tvā gīḥ-bhiḥ girvaṇasam draviṇasyum draviṇaḥ-daḥ saparyema saparyavaḥ
saḥ bodhi sūriḥ maghavā vasu-pate vasu-dāvan yuyodhi asmat dveṣāṁsi
saḥ naḥ vr̥ṣṭim divaḥ pari saḥ naḥ vājam anarvāṇam saḥ naḥ sahasriṇīḥ iṣaḥ
īl̥ānāya avasyave yaviṣṭha dūta naḥ girā yajiṣṭha hotaḥ ā gahi
antaḥ hi agne īyase vidvān janma ubhayā kave dūtaḥ janyāiva mitryaḥ
saḥ vidvān ā ca piprayaḥ yakṣi cikitvaḥ ānuṣak ā ca asmin satsi barhiṣi
śreṣṭham yaviṣṭha bhārata agne dyu-mantam ā bhara vaso iti puru-spr̥ham rayim
mā naḥ arātiḥ īśata devasya martyasya ca parṣi tasyāḥ uta dviṣaḥ
viśvāḥ uta tvayā vayam dhārāḥ udanyāḥ-iva ati gāhemahi dviṣaḥ
śuciḥ pāvaka vandyaḥ agne br̥hat vi rocase tvam ghr̥tebhiḥ āhutaḥ
tvam naḥ asi bhārata agne vaśābhiḥ ukṣa-bhiḥ aṣṭāpadībhiḥ āhutaḥ
dru-annaḥ sarpiḥ-āsutiḥ pratnaḥ hotā vareṇyaḥ sahasaḥ putraḥ adbhutaḥ
vājayan-iva nu rathān yogān agneḥ upa stuhi yaśaḥ-tamasya mīl̥huṣaḥ
yaḥ su-nīthaḥ dadāśuṣe/ ajuryaḥ jarayan arim cāru-pratīkaḥ āhutaḥ
yaḥ oṁ iti śriyā dameṣu ā doṣā uṣasi pra-śasyate yasya vratam na mīyate
ā yaḥ svaḥ na bhānunā citraḥ vi-bhāti arciṣā añjānaḥ ajaraiḥ abhi
atrim anu sva-rājyam agnim ukthāni vavr̥dhuḥ viśvāḥ adhi śriyaḥ dadhe
agneḥ indrasya somasya devānām ūti-bhiḥ vayam ariṣyantaḥ sacemahi abhi syāma pr̥tanyataḥ
ni hotā hotr̥-sadane vidānaḥ tveṣaḥ dīdi-vān asadat su-dakṣaḥ adabdha-vratapramatiḥ vasiṣṭhaḥ sahasram-bharaḥ śuci-jihvaḥ agniḥ
tvam dūtaḥ tvam oṁ iti naḥ paraḥ-pāḥ tvam vasyaḥ ā vr̥ṣabha pra-netā agne tokasya naḥ tane tanūnām apra-yucchan dīdyat bodhi gopāḥ
vidhema te parame janman agne vidhema stomaiḥ avare sadha-sthe yasmāt yoneḥ ut-āritha yaje tam pra tve iti havīṁṣi juhure sam-iddhe
agne yajasva haviṣā yajīyān śruṣṭī deṣṇam abhi gr̥ṇīhi rādhaḥ tvam h i asi rayi-patiḥ rayīṇām tvam śukrasya vacasaḥ manotā
ubhayam te na kṣīyate vasavyam dive--dive jāyamānasya dasma kr̥dhi kṣu-mantam jaritāram agne kr̥dhi patim su-apatyasya rāyaḥ
saḥ enā anīkena su-vidatraḥ asme iti yaṣṭā devān āyajiṣṭhaḥ svasti adabdhaḥ gopāḥ uta naḥ paraḥ-pāḥ agne dyu-mat uta revat didīhi
johūtraḥ agniḥ prathamaḥ pitāiva il̥aḥ pade manuṣā yat sam-iddhaḥ śriyam vasānaḥ amr̥taḥ vi-cetāḥ marmr̥jenyaḥ śravasyaḥ saḥ vājī
śruyāḥ agniḥ citra-bhānuḥ havam me viśvābhiḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ amr̥taḥ vi-cetāḥ śyāvā ratham vahataḥ rohitā vā uta aruṣā aha cakre vi-bhr̥traḥ
uttānāyām ajanayan su-sūtam bhuvat agniḥ puru-peśāsu garbhaḥ śiriṇāyām cit aktunā mahaḥ-bhiḥ apari-vr̥taḥ vasati pra-cetāḥ
jigharmi agnim haviṣā ghr̥tena prati-kṣiyantam bhuvanāni viśvā pr̥thum t iraścā vayasā br̥hantam vyaciṣṭham annaiḥ rabhasam dr̥śānam
ā viśvataḥ pratyañcam jigharmi arakṣasā manasā tat juṣeta marya-śrīḥ spr̥hayat-varṇaḥ agniḥ na abhi-mr̥śe tanvā jarbhurāṇaḥ
jñeyāḥ bhāgam sahasānaḥ vareṇa tvādūtāsaḥ manu-vat vadema anūnam agnim juhvā vacasyā madhu-pr̥cam dhana-sāḥ johavīmi
śrudhi havam indra mā riṣaṇyaḥ syāma te dāvane vasūnām imāḥ hi tvām ūrjaḥ vardhayanti vasu-yavaḥ sindhavaḥ na kṣarantaḥ
sr̥jaḥ mahīḥ indra yāḥ apinvaḥ pari-sthitāḥ ahinā śūra pūrvīḥ amartyam cit dāsam manyamānam ava abhinat ukthaiḥ vavr̥dhānaḥ
uktheṣu it nu śūra yeṣu cākan stomeṣu indra rudriyeṣu ca tubhya it etāḥ yāsu mandasānaḥ pra vāyave sisrate na śubhrāḥ
śubhram nu te śuṣmam vardhayantaḥ śubhram vajram bāhvoḥ dadhānāḥ śubhraḥ tvam indra vavr̥dhānaḥ asme iti dāsīḥ viśaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ
guhā hitam guhyam gūl̥ham apsu api-vr̥tam māyinam kṣiyantam uto iti apaḥ dyām tastabhvāṁsam ahan ahim śūra vīryeṇa
stava nu te indra pūrvyā mahāni uta stavāma nūtanā kr̥tāni stava vajram bāhvoḥ uśantam stava harī iti sūryasya ketū iti
harī iti nu te indra vājayantā ghr̥ta-ścutam svāram asvārṣṭām vi samanā bhūmiḥ aprathiṣṭa araṁsta parvataḥ cit sariṣyan
ni parvataḥ sādi apra-yucchan sam mātr̥-bhiḥ vāvaśānaḥ akrān dūre pāre vāṇīm vardhayantaḥ indra-iṣitām dhamanim paprathan ni
indraḥ mahām sindhum āśayānam māyāvinam vr̥tram asphurat niḥ arejetām rodasī iti bhiyāne iti kanikradataḥ vr̥ṣṇaḥ asya vajrāt
aroravīt vr̥ṣṇaḥ asya vajraḥ amānuṣam yat mānuṣaḥ ni-jūrvāt ni māyinaḥ dānavasya māyāḥ apādayat papi-vān sutasya
piba-piba it indra śūra somam mandantu tvā mandinaḥ sutāsaḥ pr̥ṇantaḥ te kukṣī iti vardhayantu itthā sutaḥ pauraḥ indram āva
tve iti indra api abhūma viprāḥ dhiyam vanema r̥ta-yā sapantaḥ avasyavaḥ dhīmahi pra-śastim sadyaḥ te rāyaḥ dāvane syāma
syāma te te indra ye te ūtī avasyavaḥ ūrjam vardhayantaḥ śuṣmin-tamam yam cākanāma deva asme iti rayim rāsi vīra-vantam
rāsi kṣayam rāsi mitram asme iti rāsi śardhaḥ indra mārutam naḥ sa-joṣasaḥ ye ca mandasānāḥ pra vāyavaḥ pānti agra-nītim
vyantu it nu yeṣu mandasānaḥ tr̥pat somam pāhi drahyat indra asmān su pr̥t-su ā tarutra avardhayaḥ dyām br̥hat-bhiḥ arkaiḥ
br̥hantaḥ it nu ye te tarutra ukthebhiḥ vā sumnam āvivāsān str̥ṇānāsaḥ barhiḥ pastya-vat tvāūtāḥ it indra vājam agman
ugreṣu it nu śūra mandasānaḥ tri-kadrukeṣu pāhi somam indra pra-dodhuvat śmaśruṣu prīṇānaḥ yāhi hari-bhyām sutasya pītim
dhiṣva śavaḥ śūra yena vr̥tram ava-abhinat dānum aurṇa-vābham apa avr̥ṇoḥ jyotiḥ āryāya ni savyataḥ sādi dasyuḥ indra
sanema ye te ūti-bhiḥ tarantaḥ viśvāḥ spr̥dhaḥ āryeṇa dasyūn asmabhyam tat tvāṣṭram viśva-rūpam arandhayaḥ sākhyasya tritāya
asya suvānasya mandinaḥ tritasya ni arbudam vavr̥dhānaḥ astari tyastaḥ avartayat sūryaḥ na cakram bhinat valam indraḥ aṅgirasvān
nūnam sā te prati varam jaritre duhīyat indra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣa stotr̥-bhyaḥ mā ati dhak bhagaḥ naḥ br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
yaḥ jātaḥ eva prathamaḥ manasvān devaḥ devān kratunā pari-abhūṣat yasya śuṣmāt rodasī iti abhyasetām nr̥mṇasya mahnā saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yaḥ pr̥thivīm vyathamānām adr̥ṁhat yaḥ parvatān pra-kupitān aramṇāt yaḥ antarikṣam vi-mame varīyaḥ yaḥ dyām astabhnāt saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yaḥ hatvā ahim ariṇāt sapta sindhūn yaḥ gāḥ ut-ājat apa-dhā valasya yaḥ aśmanoḥ antaḥ agnim jajāna sam-vr̥k samat-su saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yena imā viśvā cyavanā kr̥tāni yaḥ dāsam varṇam adharam guhā akar ityakaḥ śvaghnī-iva yaḥ jigīvān lakṣam ādat aryaḥ puṣṭāni saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yam sma pr̥cchanti kuha saḥ iti ghoram uta īm āhuḥ na eṣaḥ asti iti enam saḥ aryaḥ puṣṭīḥ vijaḥ-iva ā mināti śrat asmai dhatta saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yaḥ radhrasya coditā yaḥ kr̥śasya yaḥ brahmaṇaḥ nādhamānasya kīreḥ yukta-grāvṇaḥ yaḥ avitā su-śipraḥ suta-somasya saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yasya aśvāsaḥ pra-diśi yasya gāvaḥ yasya grāmāḥ yasya viśve rathāsaḥ yaḥ sūryam yaḥ uṣasam jajāna yaḥ apām netā saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yam krandasī iti saṁyatī itisam-yatī vihvayeteitivi-hvayete pare avare ubhayāḥ amitrāḥ samānam cit ratham ātasthi-vāṁsā nānā haveteiti saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yasmāt na r̥te vi-jayante janāsaḥ yam yudhyamānāḥ avase havante yaḥ viśvasya prati-mānam babhūva yaḥ acyuta-cyut saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yaḥ śaśvataḥ mahi enaḥ dadhānān amanyamānān śarvā jaghāna yaḥ śardhate na anu-dadāti śr̥dhyām yaḥ dasyoḥ hantā saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yaḥ śambaram parvateṣu kṣiyantam catvāriṁśyām śaradi anu-avindat ojāyamānam yaḥ ahim jaghāna dānum śayānam saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yaḥ sapta-raśmiḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ tuviṣmān ava-asr̥jat sartave sapta s indhūn yaḥ rauhiṇam asphurat vajra-bāhuḥ dyām ārohantam saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
dyāvā cit asmai pr̥thivī iti nameteiti śuṣmāt cit asya parvatāḥ bhayante yaḥ soma-pāḥ ni-citaḥ vajra-bāhuḥ yaḥ vajra-hastaḥ saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yaḥ sunvantam avati yaḥ pacantam yaḥ śaṁsantam yaḥ śaśamānam ūtī yasya brahma vardhanam yasya somaḥ yasya idam rādhaḥ saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ
yaḥ sunvate pacate dudhraḥ ā cit vājam dardarṣi saḥ kila asi satyaḥ vayam te indra viśvaha priyāsaḥ su-vīrāsaḥ vidatham ā vadema
r̥tuḥ janitrī tasyāḥ apaḥ pari makṣu jātaḥ ā aviśat yāsu vardhate tat āhanāḥ abhavat pipyuṣī payaḥ aṁśoḥ pīyūṣam prathamam tat ukthyam
sadhrī īm ā yanti pari bibhratīḥ payaḥ viśva-psnyāya pra bharanta bhojanam samānaḥ adhvā pra-vatām anu-syade yaḥ tā akr̥ṇoḥ prathamam saḥ asi ukthyaḥ
anu ekaḥ vadati yat dadāti tat rūpā minan tat-apāḥ ekaḥ īyate viśvāḥ ekasya vi-nudaḥ titikṣate yaḥ tā akr̥ṇoḥ prathamam saḥ asi ukthyaḥ
pra-jābhyaḥ puṣṭim vi-bhajantaḥ āsate rayim-iva pr̥ṣṭham pra-bhavantam āyate asinvan daṁṣṭraiḥ pituḥ atti bhojanam yaḥ tā akr̥ṇoḥ prathamam saḥ asi ukthyaḥ
adha akr̥ṇoḥ pr̥thivīm sam-dr̥śe dive yaḥ dhautīnām ahi-han ariṇak pathaḥ tam tvā stomebhiḥ uda-bhiḥ na vājinam devam devāḥ ajanan saḥ asi ukthyaḥ
yaḥ bhojanam ca dayase ca vardhanam ārdrāt ā śuṣkam madhu-mat dudohitha saḥ śevadhim ni dadhiṣe vivasvati viśvasya ekaḥ īśiṣe saḥ asi ukthyaḥ
yaḥ puṣpiṇīḥ ca pra-svaḥ ca dharmaṇā adhi dāne vi avanīḥ adhārayaḥ yaḥ ca asamāḥ ajanaḥ didyutaḥ divaḥ uruḥ ūrvān abhitaḥ saḥ asi ukthyaḥ
yaḥ nārmaram saha-vasum ni-hantave pr̥kṣāya ca dāsa-veśāya ca avahaḥ ūrjayantyāḥ apari-viṣṭam āsyam uta eva adya puru-kr̥t saḥ asi ukthyaḥ
śatam vā yasya daśa sākam ā adyaḥ ekasya śruṣṭau yat ha codam āv itha arajjau dasyūn sam unap dabhītaye supra-avyaḥ abhavaḥ saḥ asi ukthyaḥ
viśvā it anu rodhanāḥ asya paiṁsyam daduḥ asmai dadhire kr̥tnave dhanam ṣaṭ astabhnāḥ vi-stiraḥ pañca sam-dr̥śaḥ pari paraḥ abhavaḥ saḥ asi ukthyaḥ
