su-pravācanam tava vīra vīryam yat ekena kratunā vindase vasu jātū-sthirasya pra vayaḥ sahasvataḥ yā cakartha saḥ indra viśvā asi ukthyaḥ
aramayaḥ sara-apasaḥ tarāya kam turvītaye ca vayyāya ca srutim nīcā santam ut anayaḥ parāvr̥jam pra andham śroṇam śravayan saḥ asi ukthyaḥ
asmabhyam tat vaso iti dānāya rādhaḥ sam arthayasva bahu te vasavyam indra yat citram śravasyāḥ anu dyūn br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
adhvaryavaḥ bharata indrāya somam ā amatrebhiḥ siñcata madyam andhaḥ kāmī hi vīraḥ sadam asya pītim juhota vr̥ṣṇe tat it eṣaḥ vaṣṭ i
adhvaryavaḥ yaḥ apaḥ vavrivāṁsam vr̥tram jaghāna aśanyāiva vr̥kṣam tasmai etam bharata tat-vaśāya eṣaḥ indraḥ arhati pītim asya
adhvaryavaḥ yaḥ dr̥bhīkam jaghāna yaḥ gāḥ ut-ājat apa hi valam varitivaḥ tasmai etam antarikṣe na vātam indram somaiḥ ā ūrṇuta jūḥ na vastraiḥ
adhvaryavaḥ yaḥ uraṇam jaghāna nava cakhvāṁsam navatim ca bāhūn yaḥ arbudam ava nīcā babādhe tam indram somasya bhr̥the hinota
adhvaryavaḥ yaḥ su aśnam jaghāna yaḥ śuṣṇam aśuṣam yaḥ vi-aṁsam yaḥ piprum namucim yaḥ rudhi-krām tasmai indrāya andhasaḥ juhota
adhvaryavaḥ yaḥ śatam śambarasya puraḥ bibheda aśmanāiva pūrvīḥ yaḥ varcinaḥ śatam indraḥ sahasram apa-avapat bharata somam asmai
adhvaryavaḥ yaḥ śatam ā sahasram bhūmyāḥ upa-sthe avapat jaghanvān kutsasya āyoḥ atithi-gvasya vīrān ni avr̥ṇak bharata somam asmai
adhvaryavaḥ yat naraḥ kāmayādhve śruṣṭī vahantaḥ naśatha tat indre gabhasti-pūtam bharata śrutāya indrāya somam yajyavaḥ juhota
adhvaryavaḥ kartana śruṣṭim asmai vane ni-pūtam vane ut nayadhvam juṣāṇaḥ hastyam abhi vāvaśe vaḥ indrāya somam madiram juhota
adhvaryavaḥ payasā ūdhaḥ yathā goḥ somebhiḥ īm pr̥ṇata bhojam indram veda aham asya ni-bhr̥tam me etat ditsantam bhūyaḥ yajataḥ ciketa
adhvaryavaḥ yaḥ divyasya vasvaḥ yaḥ pārthivasya kṣamyasya rājā tam ūrdaram na pr̥ṇata yavena indram somebhiḥ tat apaḥ vaḥ astu
asmabhyam tat vaso iti dānāya rādhaḥ sam arthayasva bahu te vasavyam indra yat citram śravasyāḥ anu dyūn br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
pra gha nu asya mahataḥ mahāni satyā satyasya karaṇāni vocam tr i-kadrukeṣu apibat sutasya asya made ahim indraḥ jaghāna
avaṁśe dyām astabhāyat br̥hantam ā rodasī iti apr̥ṇat antarikṣam saḥ dhārayat pr̥thivīm paprathat ca somasya tā made indraḥ cakāra
sadma-iva prācaḥ vi mimāya mānaiḥ vajreṇa khāni atr̥ṇat nadīnām vr̥thā asr̥jat pathi-bhiḥ dīrgha-yāthaiḥ somasya tā made indraḥ cakāra
saḥ pra-vol̥hr̥n pari-gatya dabhīteḥ viśvam adhāk āyudham iddhe agnau sam gobhiḥ aśvaiḥ asr̥jat rathebhiḥ somasya tā made indraḥ cakāra
saḥ īm mahīm dhunim etoḥ aramṇāt saḥ asnātr̥r̥n apārayat svasti te ut-snāya rayim abhi pra tasthuḥ somasya tā made indraḥ cakāra
saḥ udañcam sindhum ariṇāt mahitvā vajreṇa anaḥ uṣasaḥ sam pipeṣa ajavasaḥ javinībhiḥ vi-vr̥ścan somasya tā made indraḥ cakāra
saḥ vidvān apa-goham kanīnām āviḥ bhavan ut atiṣṭhat parāvr̥k prati śroṇaḥ sthāt vi anak acaṣṭa somasya tā made indraḥ cakāra
bhinat valam aṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ gr̥ṇānaḥ vi parvatasya dr̥ṁhitāni airat riṇak rodhāṁsi kr̥trimāṇi eṣām somasya tā made indraḥ cakāra
svapnena abhi-upya cumurim dhunim ca jaghantha dasyum pra dabhītim āvaḥ rambhī cit atra vivide hiraṇyam somasya tā made indraḥ cakāra
nūnam sā te prati varam jaritre duhīyat indra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣa stotr̥-bhyaḥ mā ati dhak bhagaḥ naḥ br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
pra vaḥ satām jyeṣṭhatamāya su-stutim agnau-iva sam-idhāne haviḥ bhare indram ajuryam jarayantam ukṣitam sanāt yuvānam avase havāmahe
yasmāt indrāt br̥hataḥ kim cana īm r̥te viśvāni asmin sam-bhr̥tā adhi vīryā jaṭhare somam tanvi sahaḥ mahaḥ haste vajram bharati śīrṣaṇi kratum
na kṣoṇībhyām pari-bhve te indriyam na samudraiḥ parvataiḥ indra te rathaḥ na te vajram anu aśnoti kaḥ cana yat āśu-bhiḥ patasi yojanā puru
viśve hi asmai yajatāya dhr̥ṣṇave kratum bharanti vr̥ṣabhāya saścate vr̥ṣā yajasva haviṣā viduḥ-taraḥ piba indra somam vr̥ṣabheṇa bhānunā
vr̥ṣṇaḥ kośaḥ pavate madhvaḥ ūrmiḥ vr̥ṣabha-annāya vr̥ṣabhāya pātave vr̥ṣaṇā adhvaryū iti vr̥ṣabhāsaḥ adrayaḥ vr̥ṣaṇam somam vr̥ṣabhāya susvati
vr̥ṣā te vajraḥ uta te vr̥ṣā rathaḥ vr̥ṣaṇā harī iti vr̥ṣabhāṇi āyudhā vr̥ṣṇaḥ madasya vr̥ṣabha tvam īśiṣe indra somasya vr̥ṣabhasya tr̥pṇuhi
pra te nāvam na samane vacasyuvam brahmaṇā yāmi savaneṣu dadhr̥ṣiḥ kuvit naḥ asya vacasaḥ ni-bodhiṣat indram utsam na vasunaḥ sicāmahe
purā sam-bādhāt abhi ā vavr̥tsva naḥ dhenuḥ na vatsam yavasasya pipyuṣī sakr̥t su te sumati-bhiḥ śatakrato itiśata-krato sam patnībhiḥ na vr̥ṣaṇaḥ nasīmahi
nūnam sā te prati varam jaritre duhīyat indra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣa stotr̥-bhyaḥ mā ati dhak bhagaḥ naḥ br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
tat asmai navyam aṅgirasvat arcata śuṣmāḥ yat asya pratna-thā ut-īrate viśvā yat gotrā sahasā pari-vr̥tā made somasya dr̥ṁhitāni airayat
saḥ bhūtu yaḥ ha prathamāya dhāyase ojaḥ mimānaḥ mahimānam ā at irat śūraḥ yaḥ yut-su tanvam pari-vyata śīrṣaṇi dyām mahinā prati amuñcata
adha akr̥ṇoḥ prathamam vīryam mahat yat asya agre brahmaṇā śuṣmam airayaḥ rathe--sthena hari-aśvena vi-cyutāḥ pra jīrayaḥ sisrate sadhryak pr̥thak
adha yaḥ viśvā bhuvanā abhi majmanā īśāna-kr̥t pra-vayāḥ abhi avardhata āt rodasī iti jyotiṣā vahniḥ ā atanot sīvyan tamāṁsi dudhitā sam avyayat
saḥ prācīnān parvatān dr̥ṁhat ojasā adharācīnam akr̥ṇot apām apaḥ adhārayat pr̥thivīm viśva-dhāyasam astabhnāt māyayā dyām ava-srasaḥ
saḥ asmai aram bāhu-bhyām yam pitā akr̥ṇot viśvasmāt ā januṣaḥ vedasaḥ pari yena pr̥thivyām ni krivim śayadhyai vajreṇa hatvī avr̥ṇak tuvi-svaniḥ
amājūḥ-iva pitroḥ sacā satī samānāt ā sadasaḥ tvām iye bhagam kr̥dh i pra-ketam upa māsi ā bhara daddhi bhāgam tanvaḥ yena mamahaḥ
bhojam tvām indra vayam huvema dadiḥ tvam indra apāṁsi vājān avi ḍḍhi indra citrayā naḥ ūtī kr̥dhi vr̥ṣan indra vasyasaḥ naḥ
nūnam sā te prati varam jaritre duhīyat indra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣa stotr̥-bhyaḥ mā ati dhak bhagaḥ naḥ br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
prātariti rathaḥ navaḥ yoji sasniḥ catuḥ-yugaḥ tri-kaśaḥ sapta-raśmiḥ daśa-aritraḥ manuṣyaḥ svaḥ-sāḥ saḥ iṣṭi-bhiḥ mati-bhiḥ raṁhyaḥ bhūt
saḥ asmai aram prathamam saḥ dvitīyam uto iti tr̥tīyam manuṣaḥ saḥ hotā anyasyāḥ garbham anye oṁ iti jananta saḥ anyebhiḥ sacate jenyaḥ vr̥ṣā
harī iti nu kam rathe indrasya yojam āyai sūktena vacasā navena mo iti su tvām atra bahavaḥ hi viprāḥ ni rīraman yajamānāsaḥ anye
ā dvābhyām hari-bhyām indra yāhi ā catuḥ-bhiḥ ā ṣaṭ-bhiḥ hūyamānaḥ ā aṣṭābhiḥ daśa-bhiḥ soma-peyam ayam sutaḥ su-makha mā mr̥dhaḥ karitikaḥ
ā viṁśatyā triṁśatā yāhi arvāṅ ā catvāriṁśatā hari-bhiḥ yujānaḥ ā pañcāśatā su-rathebhiḥ indra ā ṣaṣṭyā saptatyā soma-peyam
ā aśītyā navatyā yāhi arvāṅ ā śatena hari-bhiḥ uhyamānaḥ ayam h i te śuna-hotreṣu somaḥ indra tvāyā pari-siktaḥ madāya
mama brahma indra yāhi accha viśvā harī iti dhuri dhiṣva rathasya puru-trā hi vi-havyaḥ babhūtha asmin śūra savane mādayasva
na me indreṇa sakhyam vi yoṣat asmabhyam asya dakṣiṇā duhīta upa jyeṣṭhe varūthe gabhastau prāye--prāye jigīvāṁsaḥ syāma
nūnam sā te prati varam jaritre duhīyat indra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣa stotr̥-bhyaḥ mā ati dhak bhagaḥ naḥ br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
apāyi asya andhasaḥ madāya manīṣiṇaḥ suvānasya prayasaḥ yasm in indraḥ pra-divi vavr̥dhānaḥ okaḥ dadhe brahmaṇyantaḥ ca naraḥ
asya mandānaḥ madhvaḥ vajra-hastaḥ ahim indraḥ arṇaḥ-vr̥tam vi vr̥ścat pra yat vayaḥ na svasarāṇi accha prayāṁsi ca nadīnām cakramanta
saḥ māhinaḥ indraḥ arṇaḥ apām pra airayat ahi-hā accha samudram ajanayat sūryam vidat gāḥ aktunā ahnām vayunāni sādhat
saḥ apratīni manave purūṇi indraḥ dāśat dāśuṣe hanti vr̥tram sadyaḥ yaḥ nr̥-bhyaḥ atasāyyaḥ bhūt paspr̥dhānebhyaḥ sūryasya sātau
saḥ sunvate indraḥ sūryam ā devaḥ riṇak martyāya stavān ā yat rayim ghat-avadyam asmai bharat aṁśam na etaśaḥ daśasyan
saḥ randhayat sa-divaḥ sārathaye śuṣṇam aśuṣam kuyavam kutsāya d ivaḥ-dāsāya navatim ca nava indraḥ puraḥ vi airat śambarasya
eva te indra ucatham ahema śravasyā na tmanā vājayantaḥ aśyāma tat sāptam āśuṣāṇāḥ nanamaḥ vadhaḥ adevasya pīyoḥ
eva te gr̥tsa-madāḥ śūra manma avasyavaḥ na vayunāni takṣuḥ brahmaṇyantaḥ indra te navīyaḥ iṣam ūrjam su-kṣitim sumnam aśyuḥ
nūnam sā te prati varam jaritre duhīyat indra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣa stotr̥-bhyaḥ mā ati dhak bhagaḥ naḥ br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
vayam te vayaḥ indra viddhi su ṇaḥ pra bharāmahe vāja-yuḥ na ratham vipanyavaḥ dīdhyataḥ manīṣā sumnam iyakṣantaḥ tvāvataḥ nr̥r̥n
tvam naḥ indra tvābhiḥ ūtī tvāyataḥ abhiṣṭi-pā asi janān tvam inaḥ dāśuṣaḥ varūtā itthādhīḥ abhi yaḥ nakṣati tvā
saḥ naḥ yuvā indraḥ johūtraḥ sakhā śivaḥ narām astu pātā yaḥ śaṁsantam yaḥ śaśamānam ūtī pacantam ca stuvantam ca pra-neṣat
tam oṁ iti stuṣe indram tam gr̥ṇīṣe yasmin purā vavr̥dhuḥ śāśaduḥ ca saḥ vasvaḥ kāmam pīparat iyānaḥ brahmaṇyataḥ nūtanasya āyoḥ
saḥ aṅgirasām ucathā jujuṣvān brahmā tūtot indraḥ gātum iṣṇan muṣṇan uṣasaḥ sūryeṇa stavān aśnasya cit śiśnathat pūrvyāṇi
saḥ ha śr̥utaḥ indraḥ nāma devaḥ ūrdhvaḥ bhuvan manuṣe dasma-tamaḥ ava priyam arśasānasya śāhvān śiraḥ bharat dāsasya svadhāvān
saḥ vr̥tra-hā indraḥ kr̥ṣṇa-yonīḥ puram-daraḥ dāsīḥ airayat vi ajanayan manave kṣāma-paḥ ca satrā śaṁsam yajamānasya tūtot
tasmai tavasyam anu dāyi satrā indrāya devebhiḥ arṇa-sātau prati yat asya vajram bāhvoḥ dhuḥ hatvī dasyūn puraḥ āyasīḥ ni tārīt
nūnam sā te prati varam jaritre duhīyat indra dakṣiṇā maghonī śikṣa stotr̥-bhyaḥ mā ati dhak bhagaḥ naḥ br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
viśva-jite dhana-jite svaḥ-jite satrājite nr̥-jite urvarājite aśva-j ite go--jite ap-jite bhara indrāya somam yajatāya haryatam
abhi-bhuve abhi-bhaṅgāya vanvate aṣāl̥hāya sahamānāya vedhase tuvi-graye vahnaye dustarītave satrāsahe namaḥ indrāya vocata
satrāsahaḥ jana-bhakṣaḥ janam-sahaḥ cyavanaḥ yudhmaḥ anu joṣam kṣitaḥ vr̥tam-cayaḥ sahuriḥ vikṣu āritaḥ indrasya vocam pra kr̥tāni vīryā
ananu-daḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ dodhataḥ vadhaḥ gambhīraḥ r̥ṣvaḥ asamaṣṭa-kāvyaḥ radhra-codaḥ śnathanaḥ vīl̥itaḥ pr̥thuḥ indraḥ su-yajñaḥ uṣasaḥ svaḥ janat
yajñena gātum apturaḥ vividrire dhiyaḥ hinvānāḥ uśijaḥ manīṣiṇaḥ abhi-svarā ni-sadā gāḥ avasyavaḥ indre hinvānāḥ draviṇāni āśata
indra śreṣṭhāni draviṇāni dhehi cittim dakṣasya su-bhagatvam asme iti poṣam rayīṇām ariṣṭim tanūnām svādmānam vācaḥ sudina-tvam ahnām
tri-kadrukeṣu mahiṣaḥ yava-āśiram tuvi-śuṣmaḥ tr̥pat somam apibat viṣṇunā sutam yathā avaśat saḥ īm mamāda mahi karma kartave mahām urum saḥ enam saścat devaḥ devam satyam indram satyaḥ induḥ
adha tviṣi-mān abhi ojasā krivim yudhā abhavat ā rodasī iti apr̥ṇat asya majmanā pra vavr̥dhe adhatta anyam jaṭhare pra īm aricyata saḥ enam saścat devaḥ devam satyam indram satyaḥ induḥ
sākam jātaḥ kratunā sākam ojasā vavakṣitha sākam vr̥ddhaḥ vīryaiḥ sasahiḥ mr̥dhaḥ vicarṣaṇiḥ dātā rādhaḥ stuvate kāmyam vasu saḥ enam saścat devaḥ devam satyam indram satyaḥ induḥ
tava tyat naryam nr̥taḥ apa indra prathamam pūrvyam divi pra-vācyam kr̥tam yat devasya śavasā pra ariṇā asum riṇan apaḥ bhuvat viśvam abhi adevam ojasā vidāt ūrjam śata-kratuḥ vidāt iṣam
gaṇānām tvā gaṇa-patim havāmahe kavim kavīnām upamaśravaḥ-tamam jyeṣṭha-rājam brahmaṇām brahmaṇaḥ pate ā naḥ śr̥ṇvan ūti-bhiḥ sīda sādanam
devāḥ cit te asurya pra-cetasaḥ br̥haspate yajñiyam bhāgam ānaśuḥ usrāḥ-iva sūryaḥ jyotiṣā mahaḥ viśveṣām it janitā brahmaṇām asi
ā vi-bādhya pari-rapaḥ tamāṁsi ca jyotiṣmantam ratham r̥tasya tiṣṭhasi br̥haspate bhīmam amitra-dambhanam rakṣaḥ-hanam gotra-bhidam svaḥ-vidam
sunīti-bhiḥ nayasi trāyase janam yaḥ tubhyam dāśāt na tam aṁhaḥ aśnavat brahma-dviṣaḥ tapanaḥ manyu-mīḥ asi br̥haspate mahi tat te mahi-tvanam
na tam aṁhaḥ na duḥ-itam kutaḥ cana na arātayaḥ titiruḥ na dvayāvinaḥ viśvāḥ it asmāt dhvarasaḥ vi bādhase yam su-gopāḥ rakṣasi brahmaṇaḥ pate
tvam naḥ go--pāḥ pathi-kr̥t vi-cakṣaṇaḥ tava vratāya mati-bhiḥ jarāmahe br̥haspate yaḥ naḥ abhi hvaraḥ dadhe svā tam marmartu ducchunā harasvatī
uta vā yaḥ naḥ marcayāt anāgasaḥ arātī-vā martaḥ sānukaḥ vr̥kaḥ br̥haspate apa tam vartaya pathaḥ su-gam naḥ asyai deva-vītaye kr̥dhi
trātāram tvā tanūnām havāmahe ava-spartaḥ adhi-vaktāram asmayum br̥haspate deva-nidaḥ ni barhaya mā duḥ-evāḥ ut-taram sumnam ut naśan
tvayā vayam su-vr̥dhā brahmaṇaḥ pate spārhā vasu manuṣyā ā dadīmahi yāḥ naḥ dūre tal̥itaḥ yāḥ arātayaḥ abhi santi jambhaya tāḥ anapnasaḥ
tvayā vayam ut-tamam dhīmahe vayaḥ br̥haspate papriṇā sasninā yujā mā naḥ duḥ-śaṁsaḥ abhi-dipsuḥ īśata pra su-śaṁsāḥ mati-bhiḥ tāriṣīmahi
ananu-daḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ jagmiḥ āhavam niḥ-taptā śatrum pr̥tanāsu sasahiḥ asi satyaḥ r̥ṇa-yāḥ brahmaṇaḥ pate ugrasya cit damitā vīl̥u-harṣiṇaḥ
adeveva manasā yaḥ riṣaṇyati śāsām ugraḥ mayamānaḥ jighāṁsati br̥haspate mā praṇak tasya naḥ vadhaḥ ni karma manyum duḥ-evasya śardhataḥ
bhareṣu havya namasā upa-sadyaḥ gantā vājeṣu sanitā dhanam-dhanam viśvāḥ it aryaḥ abhi-dipsvaḥ mr̥dhaḥ br̥haspatiḥ vi vavarha rathān-iva
tejiṣṭhayā tapanī rakṣasaḥ tapa ye tvā nide dadhire dr̥ṣṭa-vīryam āviḥ tat kr̥ṣva yat asat te ukthyam br̥haspate vi pari-rapaḥ ardaya
br̥haspate ati yat aryaḥ arhāt dyu-mat vi-bhāti kratu-mat janeṣu yat dīdayat śavasā r̥ta-prajāta tat asmāsu draviṇam dhehi citram
mā naḥ stenebhyaḥ ye abhi druhaḥ pade nirāmiṇaḥ ripavaḥ anneṣu jagr̥dhuḥ ā devānām ohate vi vrayaḥ hr̥di br̥haspate na paraḥ sāmnaḥ viduḥ
viśvebhyaḥ hi tvā bhuvanebhyaḥ pari tvaṣṭā ajanat sāmnaḥ-sāmnaḥ kaviḥ saḥ r̥ṇa-cit r̥ṇa-yāḥ brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ druhaḥ hantā mahaḥ r̥tasya dhartari
tava śriye vi ajihīta parvataḥ gavām gotram ut asr̥jaḥ yat aṅgiraḥ indreṇa yujā tamasā pari-vr̥tam br̥haspate niḥ apām aubjaḥ arṇavam
brahmaṇaḥ pate tvam asya yantā su-uktasya bodhi tanayam ca jinva viśvam tat bhadram yat avanti devāḥ br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
saḥ imām aviḍḍhi pra-bhr̥tim yaḥ īśiṣe ayā vidhema navayā mahā girā yathā naḥ mīḍhavān stavate sakhā tava br̥haspate sīsadhaḥ saḥ uta naḥ matim
yaḥ nantvāni anamat ni ojasā uta adardaḥ manyunā śambarāṇi vi pra acyavayat acyutā brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ ā ca aviśat vasu-mantam v i parvatam
tat devānām deva-tamāya kartvam aśrathnān dr̥l̥hā avradanta vīl̥itā ut gāḥ ājat abhinat brahmaṇā valam agūhat tamaḥ vi acakṣayat svar itisvaḥ
aśma-āsyam avatam brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ madhu-dhāram abhi yam ojasā atr̥ṇat tam eva viśve papire svaḥ-dr̥śaḥ bahu sākam sisicuḥ utsam udriṇam
sanā tā kā cit bhuvanā bhavītvā māt-bhiḥ śarat-bhiḥ duraḥ varanta vaḥ ayatantā carataḥ anyat-anyat it yā cakāra vayunā brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ
abhi-nakṣantaḥ abhi ye tam ānaśuḥ nidhim paṇīnām paramam guhā hitam te vidvāṁsaḥ prati-cakṣya anr̥tā punaḥ yataḥ oṁ iti āyan tat ut īyuḥ āviśam
r̥ta-vānaḥ prati-cakṣya anr̥tā punaḥ ā ataḥ ā tasthuḥ kavayaḥ mahaḥ pathaḥ te bāhu-bhyām dhamitam agnim asmani nakiḥ saḥ asti araṇaḥ juhuḥ hi tam
r̥ta-jyena kṣipreṇa brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ yatra vaṣṭi pra tar aśnoti dhanvanā tasya sādhvīḥ iṣavaḥ yābhiḥ asyati nr̥-cakṣasaḥ dr̥śaye karṇa-yonayaḥ
saḥ sam-nayaḥ saḥ vi-nayaḥ puraḥ-hitaḥ saḥ su-stutaḥ saḥ yudhi brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ cākṣmaḥ yat vājam bharate matī dhanā āt it sūryaḥ tapati tapyatuḥ vr̥thā
vi-bhu pra-bhu prathamam mehanāvataḥ br̥haspateḥ su-vidatrāṇi rādhyā imā sātāni venyasya vājinaḥ yena janāḥ ubhaye bhuñjate viśaḥ
yaḥ avare vr̥jane viśva-thā vi-bhuḥ mahām oṁ iti raṇvaḥ śavasā vavakṣitha saḥ devaḥ devān prati paprathe pr̥thu viśvā it oṁ iti tā pari-bhūḥ brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ
viśvam satyam magha-vānā yuvoḥ it āpaḥ cana pra minanti vratam vām accha indrābrahmaṇaspatī iti haviḥ naḥ annam yujāiva vājinā jigātam
uta āśiṣṭhāḥ anu śr̥ṇvanti vahnayaḥ sabheyaḥ vipraḥ bharate matī dhanā vīl̥u-dveṣāḥ anu vaśā r̥ṇam ādadiḥ saḥ ha vājī sam-ithe brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ
brahmaṇaḥ pateḥ abhavat yathāvaśam satyaḥ manyuḥ mahi karma kariṣyataḥ yaḥ gāḥ ut-ājat saḥ dive vi ca abhajat mahī-iva rītiḥ śavasā asarat pr̥thak
brahmaṇaḥ pate su-yamasya viśvahā rāyaḥ syāma rathyaḥ vayasvataḥ vīreṣu vīrān upa pr̥ṅdhi naḥ tvam yat īśānaḥ brahmaṇā veṣi me havam
brahmaṇaḥ pate tvam asya yantā su-uktasya bodhi tanayam ca jinva viśvam tat bhadram yat avanti devāḥ br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
indhānaḥ agnim vanavat vanuṣyataḥ kr̥ta-brahmā śūśuvat rāta-havyaḥ it jātena jātam ati saḥ pra sarsr̥te yam-yam yujam kr̥ṇute brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ
vīrebhiḥ vīrān vanavat vanuṣyataḥ gobhiḥ rayim paprathat bodhati tmanā tokam ca tasya tanayam ca vardhate yam-yam yujam kr̥ṇute brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ
sindhuḥ na kṣodaḥ śimī-vān r̥ghāyataḥ vr̥ṣāiva vadhrīn abhi vaṣṭi ojasā agneḥ-iva pra-sitiḥ na aha vartave yam-yam yujam kr̥ṇute brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ
tasmai arṣanti divyāḥ asaścataḥ saḥ satva-bhiḥ prathamaḥ goṣu gacchati anibhr̥ṣṭa-taviṣiḥ hanti ojasā yam-yam yujam kr̥ṇute brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ
tasmai it viśve dhunayanta sindhavaḥ acchidrā śarma dadhire purūṇi devānām sumne su-bhagaḥ saḥ edhate yam-yam yujam kr̥ṇute brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ
r̥juḥ it śaṁsaḥ vanavat vanuṣyataḥ devayan it adeva-yantam abhi asat supra-avīḥ it vanavat pr̥t-su dustaram yajvā it ayajyoḥ vi bhajāti bhojanam
yajasva vīra pra vihi manāyataḥ bhadram manaḥ kr̥ṇuṣva vr̥tra-tūrye haviḥ kr̥ṇuṣva su-bhagaḥ yathā asasi brahmaṇaḥ pateḥ avaḥ ā vr̥ṇīmahe
saḥ it janena saḥ viśā saḥ janmanā saḥ putraiḥ vājam bharate dhanā nr̥-bhiḥ devānām yaḥ pitaram āvivāsati śraddhāmanāḥ haviṣā brahmaṇaḥ patim
yaḥ asmai havyaiḥ ghr̥tavat-bhiḥ avidhat pra tam prācā nayati brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ uruṣyatīm aṁhasaḥ rakṣati riṣaḥ aṁhoḥ cit asmai uru-cakriḥ adbhutaḥ
imāḥ giraḥ ādityebhyaḥ ghr̥ta-snūḥ sanāt rāja-bhyaḥ juhvā juhomi śr̥ṇotu mitraḥ aryamā bhagaḥ naḥ tuvi-jātaḥ varuṇaḥ dakṣaḥ aṁśaḥ
imam stomam sa-kratavaḥ me adya mitraḥ aryamā varuṇaḥ juṣanta ādityāsaḥ śucayaḥ dhāra-pūtāḥ avr̥jināḥ anavadyāḥ ariṣṭāḥ
te ādityāsaḥ uravaḥ gabhīrāḥ adabdhāsaḥ dipsantaḥ bhūri-akṣāḥ antariti paśyanti vr̥jinā uta sādhu sarvam rāja-bhyaḥ paramā cit anti
dhārayantaḥ ādityāsaḥ jagat sthāḥ devāḥ viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ dīrgha-dhiyaḥ rakṣamāṇāḥ asuryam r̥ta-vānaḥ cayamānāḥ r̥ṇāni
vidyām ādityāḥ avasaḥ vaḥ asya yat aryaman bhaye ā cit mayaḥ-bhu yuṣmākam mitrāvaruṇā pra-nītau pari śvabhrāiva duḥ-itāni vr̥jyām
su-gaḥ hi vaḥ aryaman mitra panthāḥ anr̥kṣaraḥ varuṇa sādhuḥ ast i tena ādityāḥ adhi vocata naḥ yacchata naḥ duḥ-parihantu śarma
pipartu naḥ aditiḥ rāja-putrā ati dveṣāṁsi aryamā su-gebhiḥ br̥hat m itrasya varuṇasya śarma upa syāma puru-vīrāḥ ariṣṭāḥ
tisraḥ bhūmīḥ dhārayan trīn uta dyūn trīṇi vratā vidathe antaḥ eṣām r̥tena ādityāḥ mahi vaḥ mahi-tvam tat aryaman varuṇa mitra cāru
trī rocanā divyā dhārayanta hiraṇyayāḥ śucayaḥ dhāra-pūtāḥ asvapn-ajaḥ ani-miṣāḥ adabdhāḥ uru-śaṁsāḥ r̥jave martyāya
tvam viśveṣām varuṇa asi rājā ye ca devāḥ asura ye ca martāḥ śatam naḥ rāsva śaradaḥ vi-cakṣe aśyāma āyūṁṣi sudhitāni pūrvā
na dakṣiṇā vi cikite na savyā na prācīnam ādityāḥ na uta paścā pākyā cit vasavaḥ dhīryā cit yuṣmānītaḥ abhayam jyotiḥ aśyām
yaḥ rāja-bhyaḥ r̥tani-bhyaḥ dadāśa yam vardhayanti puṣṭayaḥ ca n ityāḥ saḥ revān yāti prathamaḥ rathena vasu-dāvā vidatheṣu pra-śastaḥ
śuciḥ apaḥ su-yavasāḥ adabdhaḥ upa kṣeti vr̥ddha-vayāḥ su-vīraḥ nakiḥ tam ghnanti antitaḥ na dūrāt yaḥ ādityānām bhavati pra-nītau
adite mitra varuṇa uta mr̥l̥a yat vaḥ vayam cakr̥ma kat cit āgaḥ uru aśyām abhayam jyotiḥ indra mā naḥ dīrghāḥ abhi naśan tamisrāḥ
ubhe iti asmai pīpayataḥ samīcī itisam-īcī divaḥ vr̥ṣṭim su-bhagaḥ nāma puṣyan ubhā kṣayau ājayan yāti pr̥t-su ubhau ardhau bhavataḥ sādhū iti asmai
yāḥ vaḥ māyāḥ abhi-druhe yajatrāḥ pāśāḥ ādityāḥ ripave vi-cr̥ttāḥ aśvī-iva tān ati yeṣam rathena ariṣṭāḥ urau ā śarman syāma
mā aham maghonaḥ varuṇa priyasya bhūri-dāvnaḥ ā vidam śūnam āpeḥ mā rāyaḥ rājan su-yamāt ava sthām br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
idam kaveḥ ādityasya sva-rājaḥ viśvāni santi abhi astu mahnā ati yaḥ mandraḥ yajathāya devaḥ su-kīrtim bhikṣe varuṇasya bhūreḥ
tava vrate su-bhagāsaḥ syāma su-ādhyaḥ varuṇa tustu-vāṁsaḥ upa-ayane uṣasām go--matīnām agnayaḥ na jaramāṇāḥ anu dyūn
ava syāma puru-vīrasya śarman uru-śaṁsasya varuṇa pranetarit ipra-netaḥ yūyam naḥ putrāḥ aditeḥ adabdhāḥ abhi kṣamadhvam yujyāya devāḥ
pra sīm ādityaḥ asr̥jat vi-dhartā r̥tam sindhavaḥ varuṇasya yanti na śrāmyanti na vi mucanti ete vayaḥ na paptuḥ raghu-yā pari-jman
vi mat śrathaya raśanām-iva āgaḥ r̥dhyāma te varuṇa khām r̥tasya mā tantuḥ chedi vayataḥ dhiyam me mā mātrā śāri apasaḥ purā r̥toḥ
apo iti su myakṣa varuṇa bhiyasam mat sam-rāṭ r̥ta-vaḥ anu mā gr̥bhāya dāma-iva vatsāt vi mumugdhi aṁhaḥ nahi tvat ārte ni-miṣaḥ cana īśe
mā naḥ vadhaiḥ varuṇa ye te iṣṭau enaḥ kr̥ṇvantam asura bhrīṇanti mā jyotiṣaḥ pra-vasathāni ganma vi su mr̥dhaḥ śiśrathaḥ jīvase naḥ
namaḥ purā te varuṇa uta nūnam uta aparam tuvi-jāta bravāma tve iti hi kam parvate na śritāni apra-cyutāni duḥ-dabha vratāni
parā r̥ṇā sāvīḥ adha mat-kr̥tāni mā aham rājan anya-kr̥tena bhojam av i-uṣṭāḥ it nu bhūyasīḥ uṣasaḥ ā naḥ jīvān varuṇa tāsu śādhi
yaḥ me rājan yujyaḥ vā sakhā vā svapne bhayam bhīrave mahyam āha stenaḥ vā yaḥ dipsati naḥ vr̥kaḥ vā tvam tasmāt varuṇa pāhi asmān
mā aham maghonaḥ varuṇa priyasya bhūri-dāvnaḥ ā vidam śūnam āpeḥ mā rāyaḥ rājan su-yamāt ava sthām br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
dhr̥ta-vratāḥ ādityāḥ iṣirāḥ āre mat karta rahasūḥ-iva āgaḥ śr̥ṇvataḥ vaḥ varuṇa mitra devāḥ bhadrasya vidvān avase huve vaḥ
yūyam devāḥ pra-matiḥ yūyam ojaḥ yūyam dveṣāṁsi sanutaḥ yuyota abhi-kṣattāraḥ abhi ca kṣamadhvam adya ca naḥ mr̥l̥ayata aparam ca
kim oṁ iti nu vaḥ kr̥ṇavāma apareṇa kim sanena vasavaḥ āpyena yūyam naḥ mitrāvaruṇā adite ca svastim indrāmarutaḥ dadhāta
haye devāḥ yūyam it āpayaḥ stha te mr̥l̥ata nādhamānāya mahyam mā vaḥ rathaḥ madhyama-vāṭ r̥te bhūt mā yuṣmāvat-su āpiṣu śramiṣma
pra vaḥ ekaḥ mimaya bhūri āgaḥ yat mā pitāiva kitavam śaśāsa āre pāśāḥ āre aghāni devāḥ mā mā adhi putre vim-iva grabhīṣṭa
arvāñcaḥ adya bhavatā yajatrāḥ ā vaḥ hārdi bhayamānaḥ vyayeyam trādhvam naḥ devāḥ ni-juraḥ vr̥kasya trādhvam kartāt ava-padaḥ yajatrāḥ
mā aham maghonaḥ varuṇa priyasya bhūri-dāvnaḥ ā vidam śūnam āpeḥ mā rāyaḥ rājan su-yamāt ava sthām br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
r̥tam devāya kr̥ṇvate savitre indrāya ahi-ghne na ramante āpaḥ ahaḥ-ahaḥ yāti aktuḥ apām kiyati ā prathamaḥ sargaḥ āsām
yaḥ vr̥trāya sinam atra abhariṣyat pra tam janitrī viduṣe uvāca pathaḥ radantīḥ anu joṣam asmai dive--dive dhunayaḥ yanti artham
ūrdhvaḥ hi asthāt adhi antarikṣe adha vr̥trāya pra vadham jabhāra miham vasānaḥ upa hi īm adudrot tigma-āyudhaḥ ajayat śatrum indraḥ
br̥haspate tapuṣā aśnāiva vidhya vr̥ka-dvarasaḥ asurasya vīrān yathā jaghantha dhr̥ṣatā purā cit eva jahi śatrum asmākam indra
ava kṣipa divaḥ aśmānam uccā yena śatrum mandasānaḥ ni-jūrvāḥ tokasya sātau tanayasya bhūreḥ asmān ardham kr̥ṇutāt indra gonām
pra hi kratum vr̥hathaḥ yam vanuthaḥ radhrasya sthaḥ yajamānasya codau indrāsomā yuvam asmān aviṣṭam asmin bhaya-sthe kr̥ṇutam oṁ iti lokam
na mā tamat na śramat na uta tandrat na vocāma mā sunota iti somam yaḥ me pr̥ṇāt yaḥ dr̥t yaḥ ni-bodhāt yaḥ mā sunvantam upa gobhiḥ ā ayat
sarasvati tvam asmān aviḍḍhi marutvatī dhr̥ṣatī jeṣi śatrūn tyam cit śardhantam taviṣī-yamāṇam indraḥ hanti vr̥ṣabham śaṇḍikānām
yaḥ naḥ sanutya uta vā jighatnuḥ abhi-khyāya tam tigitena vidhya br̥haspate āyudhaiḥ jeṣi śatrūn duhe riṣantam pari dhehi rājan
asmākebhiḥ satva-bhiḥ śūra śūraiḥ vīryā kr̥dhi yāni te kartvāni jyok abhūvan anu-dhūpitāsaḥ hatvī teṣām ā bhara naḥ vasūni
tam vaḥ śardham mārutam sumna-yuḥ girā upa bruve namasā daivyam janam yathā rayim sarva-vīram naśāmahai apatya-sācam śrutyam d ive--dive
asmākam mitrāvaruṇā avatam ratham ādityaiḥ rudraiḥ vasu-bhiḥ sacābhuvā pra yat vayaḥ na paptan vasmanaḥ pari śravasyavaḥ hr̥ṣīvantaḥ vana-sadaḥ
adha sma naḥ ut avata sa-joṣasaḥ ratham devāsaḥ abhi vikṣu vāja-yum yat āśavaḥ padyābhiḥ titrataḥ rajaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ sānau jaṅghananta pāṇi-bhiḥ
uta syaḥ naḥ indraḥ viśva-carṣaṇiḥ divaḥ śardhena mārutena su-kratuḥ anu nu sthāti avr̥kābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ ratham mahe sanaye vāja-sātaye
uta syaḥ devaḥ bhuvanasya sakṣaṇiḥ tvaṣṭā gnābhiḥ sa-joṣāḥ jūjuvat ratham il̥ā bhagaḥ br̥hat-divā uta rodasī iti pūṣā puram-dhiḥ aśvinau adha patī iti
uta tye devī iti subhageitisu-bhage mithu-dr̥śā uṣasānaktā jagatām api-juvā stuṣe yat vām pr̥thivi navyasā vacaḥ sthātuḥ ca vayaḥ tri-vayāḥ upa-stire
uta vaḥ śaṁsam uśijām-iva śmasi ahiḥ budhnyaḥ aja eka-pāt uta tritaḥ r̥bhu-kṣāḥ savitā canaḥ dadhe apām napāt āśu-hemā dhiyā śami
etā vaḥ vaśmi ut-yatā yajatrāḥ atakṣan āyavaḥ navyase sam śravasyavaḥ vājam cakānāḥ saptiḥ na rathyaḥ aha dhītim aśyāḥ
asya me dyāvāpr̥thivī iti r̥ta-yataḥ bhūtam avitrī iti vacasaḥ sisāsataḥ yayoḥ āyuḥ pra-taram teiti idam puraḥ upastuteity upa-stute vasu-yuḥ vā mahaḥ dadhe
mā naḥ guhyāḥ ripaḥ āyoḥ ahan dabhan mā naḥ ābhyaḥ rīradhaḥ ducchunābhyaḥ mā naḥ vi yauḥ sakhyā viddhi tasya naḥ sumna-yatā manasā tat tvā īmahe
ahel̥atā manasā śruṣṭim ā vaha duhānām dhenum pipyuṣīm asaścatam padyābhiḥ āśum vacasā ca vājinam tvām hinomi puru-hūta viśvahā
rākām aham su-havām su-stutī huve śr̥ṇotu naḥ su-bhagā bodhatu tmanā sīvyatu apaḥ sūcyā acchidyamānayā dadātu vīram śata-dāyam ukthyam
yāḥ te rāke su-matayaḥ su-peśasaḥ yābhiḥ dadāsi dāśuṣe vasūni tābhiḥ naḥ adya su-manāḥ upa-āgahi sahasra-poṣam su-bhage rarāṇā
sinīvāli pr̥thu-stuke yā devānām asi svasā juṣasva havyam āhutam pra-jām devi didiḍḍhi naḥ
yā su-bāhuḥ su-aṅguriḥ su-sūmā bahu-sūvarī tasyai viśpatnyai haviḥ sinīvālyai juhotana
yā guṅgūḥ yā sinīvālī yā rākā yā sarasvatī indrāṇīm ahve ūtaye varuṇānīm svastaye
ā te pitaḥ marutām sumnam etu mā naḥ sūryasya sam-dr̥śaḥ yuyothāḥ abhi naḥ vīraḥ arvati kṣameta pra jāyemahi rudra pra-jābhiḥ
tvādattebhiḥ rudra śam-tamebhiḥ śatam himāḥ aśīya bheṣajebhiḥ vi asmat dveṣaḥ vi-taram vi aṁhaḥ vi amīvāḥ cātayasva viṣūcīḥ
śreṣṭhaḥ jātasya rudra śriyā asi tavaḥ-tamaḥ tavasām vajrabāho itivajra-bāho parṣi naḥ pāram aṁhasaḥ svasti viśvāḥ abhi-itīḥ rapasaḥ yuyodhi
mā tvā rudra cukrudhāma namaḥ-bhiḥ mā duḥ-stutī vr̥ṣabha mā sa-hūtī ut naḥ vīrān arpaya bheṣajebhiḥ bhiṣak-tamam tvā bhiṣajām śr̥ṇomi
havīma-bhiḥ havate yaḥ haviḥ-bhiḥ ava stomebhiḥ rudram diṣīya r̥dūdaraḥ su-havaḥ mā naḥ asyai babhruḥ su-śipraḥ rīradhat manāyai
ut mā mamanda vr̥ṣabhaḥ marutvān tvakṣīyasā vayasā nādhamānam ghr̥ṇi-iva chāyām arapāḥ aśīya vivāseyam rudrasya sumnam
kva syaḥ te rudra mr̥l̥ayākuḥ hastaḥ yaḥ asti bheṣajaḥ jalāṣaḥ apa-bhartā rapasaḥ daivyasya abhi nu mā vr̥ṣabha cakṣamīthāḥ
pra babhrave vr̥ṣabhāya śvitīce mahaḥ mahīm su-stutim īrayāmi namasya kalmalīkinam namaḥ-bhiḥ gr̥ṇīmasi tveṣam rudrasya nāma
sthirebhiḥ aṅgaiḥ puru-rūpaḥ ugraḥ babhruḥ śukrebhiḥ pipiśe hiraṇyaiḥ īśānāt asya bhuvanasya bhūreḥ na vai oṁ iti yoṣat rudrāt asuryam
arhan bibharṣi sāyakāni dhanva arhan niṣkam yajatam viśva-rūpam arhan idam dayase viśvam abhvam na vai ojīyaḥ rudra tvat asti
stuhi śrutam garta-sadam yuvānam mr̥gam na bhīmam upa-hatnum ugram mr̥l̥a jaritre rudra stavānaḥ anyam te asmat ni vapantu senāḥ
kumāraḥ cit pitaram vandamānam prati nanāma rudra upa-yantam bhūreḥ dātāram sat-patim gr̥ṇīṣe stutaḥ tvam bheṣajā rāsi asme iti
yā vaḥ bheṣajā marutaḥ śucīni yā śam-tamā vr̥ṣaṇaḥ yā mayaḥ-bhu yāni manuḥ avr̥ṇīta pitā naḥ tā śam ca yoḥ ca rudrasya vaśmi
pari naḥ hetiḥ rudrasya vr̥jyāḥ pari tveṣasya duḥ-matiḥ mahī gāt ava sthirā maghavat-bhyaḥ tanuṣva mīḍhavaḥ tokāya tanayāya mr̥l̥a
eva babhro iti vr̥ṣabha cekitāna yathā deva na hr̥ṇīṣe na haṁsi havana-śrut naḥ rudra iha bodhi br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
dhārāvarāḥ marutaḥ ghr̥ṣṇu-ojasaḥ mr̥gāḥ na bhīmāḥ taviṣībhiḥ arcinaḥ agnayaḥ na śuśucānāḥ r̥jīṣiṇaḥ bhr̥mim dhamantaḥ apa gāḥ avr̥ṇvata
dyāvaḥ na str̥-bhiḥ citayanta khādinaḥ vi abhriyāḥ na dyutayanta vr̥ṣṭayaḥ rudraḥ yat vaḥ marutaḥ rukma-vakṣasaḥ vr̥ṣā ajani pr̥śnyāḥ śukre ūdhani
ukṣante aśvān atyān-iva ājiṣu nadasya karṇaiḥ turayante āśu-bhiḥ h iraṇya-śiprāḥ marutaḥ davidhvataḥ pr̥kṣam yātha pr̥ṣatībhiḥ sa-manyavaḥ
pr̥kṣe tā viśvā bhuvanā vavakṣire mitrāya vā sadam ā jīra-dānavaḥ pr̥ṣat-aśvāsaḥ anavabhra-rādhasaḥ r̥jipyāsaḥ na vayuneṣu dhūḥ-sadaḥ
indhanva-bhiḥ dhenu-bhiḥ rapśadūdha-bhiḥ adhvasma-bhiḥ pathi-bhiḥ bhrājat-r̥ṣṭayaḥ ā haṁsāsaḥ na svasarāṇi gantana madhoḥ madāya marutaḥ sa-manyavaḥ
ā naḥ brahmāṇi marutaḥ sa-manyavaḥ narām na śaṁsaḥ savanāni gantana aśvām-iva pipyata dhenum ūdhani kartā dhiyam jaritre vāja-peśasam
tam naḥ dāta marutaḥ vājinam rathe āpānam brahma citayat dive--dive iṣam stotr̥-bhyaḥ vr̥janeṣu kārave sanim medhām ariṣṭam dustaram sahaḥ
yat yuñjate marutaḥ rukma-vakṣasaḥ aśvān ratheṣu bhage ā su-dānavaḥ dhenuḥ na śiśve svasareṣu pinvate janāya rāta-haviṣe mahīm iṣam
yaḥ naḥ marutaḥ vr̥ka-tāti martyaḥ ripuḥ dadhe vasavaḥ rakṣata riṣaḥ vartayata vapuṣā cakriyā abhi tam ava rudrāḥ aśasaḥ hantana vadhariti
citram tat vaḥ marutaḥ yāma cekite pr̥śnyāḥ yat ūdhaḥ api āpayaḥ duhuḥ yat vā nide navamānasya rudriyāḥ tritam jarāya juratām adābhyāḥ
tān vaḥ mahaḥ marutaḥ eva-yāvnaḥ viṣṇoḥ eṣasya pra-bhr̥the havāmahe hiraṇya-varṇān kakuhān yata-srucaḥ brahmaṇyantaḥ śaṁsyam rādhaḥ īmahe
te daśa-gvāḥ prathamāḥ yajñam ūhire te naḥ hinvantu uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭiṣu uṣāḥ na rāmīḥ aruṇaiḥ apa ūrṇute mahaḥ jyotiṣā śucatā go--arṇasā
te kṣoṇībhiḥ aruṇebhiḥ na añji-bhiḥ rudrāḥ r̥tasya sadaneṣu vavr̥dhuḥ ni--meghamānāḥ atyena pājasā su-candram varṇam dadhire su-peśasam
tān iyānaḥ mahi varūtham ūtaye upa gha it enā namasā gr̥ṇīmasi tritaḥ na yān pañca hotr̥r̥r̥n abhiṣṭaye āvavartat avarān cakriyā avase
yayā radhram pārayatha ati aṁhaḥ yayā nidaḥ muñcatha vanditāram arvācī sā marutaḥ yā vaḥ ūtiḥ o iti su vāśrāiva su-matiḥ jigātu
upa īm asr̥kṣi vāja-yuḥ vacasyām canaḥ dadhīta nādyaḥ giraḥ me apām napāt āśu-hemā kuvit saḥ su-peśasaḥ karati joṣiṣat hi
imam su asmai hr̥daḥ ā su-taṣṭam mantram vocema kuvit asya vedat apām napāt asuryasya mahnā viśvāni aryaḥ bhuvanā jajāna
sam anyāḥ yanti upa yanti anyāḥ samānam ūrvam nadyaḥ pr̥ṇanti tam oṁ iti śucim śucayaḥ dīdi-vāṁsam apām napātam pari tasthuḥ āpaḥ
tam asmerāḥ yuvatayaḥ yuvānam marmr̥jyamānāḥ pari yanti āpaḥ saḥ śukrebhiḥ śikva-bhiḥ revat asme iti dīdāya anidhmaḥ ghr̥ta-nirnik ap-su
asmai tisraḥ avyathyāya nārīḥ devāya devīḥ didhiṣanti annam kr̥tāiva upa hi pra-sarsre ap-su saḥ pīyūṣam dhayati pūrva-sūnām
aśvasya atra janima asya ca svaḥ druhaḥ riṣaḥ sam-pr̥caḥ pāhi sūrīn āmāsu pūrṣu paraḥ apra-mr̥ṣyam na arātayaḥ vi naśan na anr̥tāni
sve ā dame su-dughā yasya dhenuḥ svadhām pīpāya su-bhu annam atti saḥ apām napāt ūrjayan ap-su antaḥ vasu-deyāya vidhate vi bhāti
yaḥ ap-su ā śucinā daivyena r̥ta-vā ajasraḥ urviyā vi-bhāti vayāḥ it anyā bhuvanāni asya pra jāyante vīrudhaḥ ca pra-jābhiḥ
apām napāt ā hi asthāt upa-stham jihmānām ūrdhvaḥ vidyutam vasānaḥ tasya jyeṣṭham mhimānam vahantīḥ hiraṇya-varṇāḥ pari yanti yahvīḥ
hiraṇya-rūpaḥ saḥ hiraṇya-sandr̥k apām napāt saḥ it oṁ iti hiraṇya-varṇaḥ hiraṇyayāt pari yoneḥ ni-sadya hiraṇya-dāḥ dadati annam asmai
tat asya anīkam uta cāru nāma apīcyam vardhate naptuḥ apām yam indhate yuvatayaḥ sam itthā hiraṇya-varṇam ghr̥tam annam asya
asmai bahūnām avamāya sakhye yajñaiḥ vidhema namasā haviḥ-bhiḥ sam sānu mārjmi didhiṣāmi bilmaiḥ dadhāmi annaiḥ pari vande r̥k-bhiḥ
saḥ īm vr̥ṣā ajanayat tāsu garbham saḥ īm śiśuḥ dhayati tam rihant i saḥ apām napāt anabhimlāta-varṇaḥ anyasya-iva iha tanvā v iveṣa
asmin pade parame tasthi-vāṁsam adhvasma-bhiḥ viśvahā dīdi-vāṁsam āpaḥ naptre ghr̥tam annam vahantīḥ svayam atkaiḥ pari dīyanti yahvīḥ
ayāṁsam agne su-kṣitim janāya ayāṁsam oṁ iti maghavat-bhyaḥ su-vr̥ktim viśvam tat bhadram yat avanti devāḥ br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
tubhyam hinvānaḥ vasiṣṭa gāḥ apaḥ adhukṣan sīm avi-bhiḥ adri-bhiḥ naraḥ piba indra svāhā pra-hutam vaṣaṭ-kr̥tam hotrāt ā somam prathamaḥ yaḥ īśiṣe
yajñaiḥ sam-miślāḥ pr̥ṣatībhiḥ r̥ṣṭi-bhiḥ yāman śubhrāsaḥ añjiṣu priyāḥ uta āsadya barhiḥ bharatasya sūnavaḥ potrāt ā somam pibata divaḥ naraḥ
amāiva naḥ su-havāḥ ā hi gantana ni barhiṣi sadatana raṇiṣṭana atha mandasva jujuṣāṇaḥ andhasaḥ tvaṣṭaḥ devebhiḥ jani-bhiḥ sumat-gaṇaḥ
ā vakṣi devān iha vipra yakṣi ca uśan hotaḥ ni sada yoniṣu triṣu prati vīhi pra-sthitam somyam madhu piba āgnīdhrāt tava bhāgasya tr̥pṇuhi
eṣaḥ syaḥ te tanvaḥ nr̥mṇa-vardhanaḥ sahaḥ ojaḥ pra-divi bāhvoḥ hitaḥ tubhyam sutaḥ maghavan tubhyam ābhr̥taḥ tvam asya brāhmaṇāt ā tr̥pat piba
juṣethām yajñam bodhatam havasya me sattaḥ hotā ni-vidaḥ pūrvyāḥ anu accha rājānā namaḥ eti āvr̥tam pra-śāstrāt ā pibatam somyam madhu
mandasva hotrāt anu joṣam andhasaḥ adhvaryavaḥ saḥ pūrṇām vaṣṭi āsicam tasmai etam bharata tat-vaśaḥ dadiḥ hotrāt somam draviṇaḥ-daḥ piba r̥tu-bhiḥ
yam oṁ iti pūrvam ahuve tam idam huve saḥ it / oṁ iti havyaḥ dadiḥ yaḥ nāma patyate adhvaryu-bhiḥ pra-sthitam somyam madhu potrāt somam draviṇaḥ-daḥ piba r̥tu-bhiḥ
medyantu te vahnayaḥ yebhiḥ īyase ariṣaṇyan vīl̥ayasva vanaspate āyūya dhr̥ṣṇo iti abhi-gūrya tvam neṣṭrāt somam draviṇaḥ-daḥ piba r̥tu-bhiḥ
apāt hotrāt uta potrāt amatta uta neṣṭrāt ajuṣata prayaḥ hitam turīyam pātram amr̥ktam amartyam draviṇaḥ-dāḥ pibatu drāviṇodasaḥ
arvāñcam adya yayyam nr̥-vāhanam ratham yuñjāthām iha vām vi-mocanam pr̥ṅktam havīṁṣi madhunā ā hi kam gatam atha somam pibatam vājinīvasūitivājinī-vasū
joṣi agne sam-idham joṣi āhutim joṣi brahma janyam joṣi su-stutim viśvebhiḥ viśvān r̥tunā vaso iti mahaḥ uśan devān uśataḥ pāyaya haviḥ
ut oṁ iti syaḥ devaḥ savitā savāya śaśvat-tamam tat-apāḥ vahniḥ asthāt nūnam devebhyaḥ vi hi dhāti ratnam atha abhajat vīti-hotram svastau
viśvasya hi śruṣṭaye devaḥ ūrdhvaḥ pra bāhavā pr̥thu-pāṇiḥ sisarti āpaḥ cit asya vrate ā ni-mr̥grāḥ ayam cit vātaḥ ramate pari-jman
āśu-bhiḥ cit yān vi mucāti nūnam arīramat atamānam cit etoḥ ahyarṣūṇām cit ni ayān aviṣyām anu vratam savituḥ mokī ā agāt
punariti sam avyat vi-tatam vayantī madhyā kartoḥ ni adhāt śakma dhīraḥ ut sam-hāya asthāt vi r̥tūn adardhaḥ aramatiḥ savitā devaḥ ā agāt
nānā okāṁsi duryaḥ viśvam āyuḥ vi tiṣṭhate pra-bhavaḥ śokaḥ agneḥ jyeṣṭham mātā sūnave bhāgam ā adhāt anu asya ketam iṣitam savitrā
sam-āvavarti vi-sthitaḥ jigīṣuḥ viśveṣām kāmaḥ caratām amā abhūt śaśvān apaḥ vi-kr̥tam hitvī ā agāt anu vratam savituḥ daivyasya
tvayā hitam apyam ap-su bhāgam dhanva anu ā mr̥gayasaḥ vi tasthuḥ vanāni vi-bhyaḥ nakiḥ asya tāni vratā devasya savituḥ minanti
yāt-rādhyam varuṇaḥ yonim apyam ani-śitam ni-miṣi jarbhurāṇaḥ viśvaḥ mārtāṇḍaḥ vrajam ā paśuḥ gāt stha-śaḥ janmāni savitā vi ā akar ity akaḥ
na yasya indraḥ varuṇaḥ na mitraḥ vratam aryamā na minanti rudraḥ na arātayaḥ tam idam svasti huve devam savitāram namaḥ-bhiḥ
bhagam dhiyam vājayantaḥ puram-dhim narāśaṁsaḥ gnāḥpatiḥ naḥ avyāḥ āaye vāmasya sam-gathe rayīṇām priyāḥ devasya savituḥ syāma
asmabhyam tat divaḥ at-bhyaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ tvayā dattam kāmyam rādhaḥ ā gāt śam yat stotr̥-bhyaḥ āpaye bhavāti uru-śaṁsāya savitaḥ jaritre
grāvāṇāiva tat it artham jaretheiti gr̥dhrāiva vr̥kṣam nidhi-mantam accha brahmāṇāiva vidathe uktha-śasā dūtāiva havyā janyā puru-trā
prātaḥ-yāvānā rathyāiva vīrā ajāiva yamā varam ā sacetheiti meneivetimene--iva tanvā śumbhamāneiti dampatīivetidampatī-iva kratu-vidā janeṣu
śr̥ṇgāiva naḥ prathamā gantam arvāk śaphau-iva jarbhurāṇā taraḥ-bhiḥ cakravākāiva prati vastoḥ usrā arvāñcā yātam rathyāiva śakrā
nāvāiva naḥ pārayatam yugāiva nabhyāiva naḥ upadhī ivety upadhī-iva pradhī ivety pradhī-iva / śvānāiva naḥ ariṣaṇyā tanūnām khr̥galāiva vi-srasaḥ pātam asmān
vātāiva ajuryā nadyāiva rītiḥ akṣīivety akṣī-iva cakṣuṣā ā yātam arvāk hastau-iva tanve śam-bhaviṣṭhā pādāiva naḥ nayatam vasyaḥ accha
oṣṭhau-iva madhu āsne vadantā stanau-iva pipyatam jīvase naḥ nāsāiva naḥ tanvaḥ rakṣitārā karṇau-iva su-śrutā bhūtam asme iti
hastāiva śaktim abhi sandadī itisam-dadī naḥ kṣāmāiva naḥ sam ajatam rajāṁsi imāḥ giraḥ aśv inā yuṣma-yantīḥ kṣṇotreṇa-iva sva-dhitim sam śiśītam
etāni vām aśvinā vardhanāni brahma stomam gr̥tsa-madāsaḥ akran tāni narā jujuṣāṇā upa yātam br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
somāpūṣaṇā jananā rayīṇām jananā divaḥ jananā pr̥thivyāḥ jātau viśvasya bhuvanasya gopau devāḥ akr̥ṇvan amr̥tasya nābhim
imau devau jāyamānau juṣanta imau tamāṁsi gūhatām ajuṣṭā ābhyām indraḥ pakvam āmāsu antariti somāpūṣa-bhyām janat usriyāsu
somāpūṣaṇā rajasaḥ vi-mānam sapta-cakram ratham aviśva-minvam viṣu-vr̥tam manasā yujyamānam tam jinvathaḥ vr̥ṣaṇā pañca-raśmim
divi anyaḥ sadanam cakre uccā pr̥thivyām anyaḥ adhi antarikṣe tau asmabhyam puru-vāram puru-kṣum rāyaḥ poṣam vi syatām nābhim asme iti
viśvāni anyaḥ bhuvanā jajāna viśvam anyaḥ abhi-cakṣāṇaḥ eti somāpūṣaṇau avatam dhiyam me yuvābhyām viśvāḥ pr̥tanāḥ jayema
dhiyam pūṣā jinvatu viśvam-invaḥ rayim somaḥ rayi-patiḥ dadhātu avatu devī aditiḥ anarvā br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
vāyo iti ye te sahasriṇaḥ rathāsaḥ tebhiḥ ā gahi niyutvān soma-pītaye
niyutvān vāyo iti ā gahi ayam śukraḥ ayāmi te gantā asi sunvataḥ gr̥ham
śukrasya adya go--āśiraḥ indravāyūiti niyutvataḥ ā yātam pibatam narā
ayam vām mitrāvaruṇā sutaḥ somaḥ r̥ta-vr̥dhā mama it iha śratam havam
rājānau anabhi-druhā dhruve sadasi ut-tame sahasra-sthūṇe āsāteiti
tā sam-rājā ghr̥tāsutī itighr̥ta-āsutī ādityā dānunaḥ patī saceteiti anava-hvaram
go--mat oṁ iti su nāsatyā asva-vat yātam aśvinā vartiḥ rudrā nr̥-pāyyam
na yat paraḥ na antaraḥ ādadharṣat vr̥ṣaṇvasūitivr̥ṣaṇ-vasū duḥ-śaṁsaḥ martyaḥ ripuḥ
tā naḥ ā vol̥ham aśvinā rayim piśaṅga-sandr̥śam dhiṣṇyā varivaḥ-vidam
indraḥ aṅga mahat bhayam abhi sat apa cucyavat saḥ hi sthiraḥ vi-carṣaṇiḥ
indraḥ ca mr̥l̥ayāti naḥ na naḥ paścāt agham naśat bhadram bhavāti naḥ puraḥ
indraḥ āśābhyaḥ pari sarvābhyaḥ abhayam karat jetā śatrūn vi-caṣarṇiḥ
viśve devāsaḥ ā gata śr̥ṇuta me imam havam ā idam barhiḥ ni sīdata
tīvraḥ vaḥ madhu-mān ayam śuna-hotreṣu matsaraḥ etam pibata kāmyam
indra-jyeṣṭhāḥ marut-gaṇāḥ devāsaḥ pūṣa-rātayaḥ viśve mama śruta havam
ambi-tame nadī-tame devi-tame sarasvati apraśastāḥ-iva smasi pra-śastim amba naḥ kr̥dhi
tve viśvā sarasvati śritā āyūṁṣi devyām śuna-hotreṣu matsva pra-jām devi didiḍḍhi naḥ
imā brahma sarasvati juṣasva vājinīvati yā te manma gr̥tsa-madāḥ r̥ta-vari priyā deveṣu juhvati
pra itām yajñasya śam-bhuvā yuvām it ā vr̥ṇīmahe agnim ca havya-vāhanam
dyāvā naḥ pr̥thivī iti imam sidhram adya divi-spr̥śam yajñam deveṣu yacchatām
ā vām upa-stham adruhā devāḥ sīdantu yajñiyāḥ iha adya soma-pītaye
kanikradat januṣam pra-bruvāṇaḥ iyarti vācam aritāiva nāvam su-maṅgalaḥ ca śakune bhavāsi mā tvā kā cit abhi-bhā viśvyā vidat
mā tvā śyenaḥ ut vadhīt mā su-parṇaḥ mā tvā vidat iṣu-mān vīraḥ astā pitryām anu pra-diśam kanikradat su-maṅgalaḥ bhadra-vādī vada iha
ava kranda dakṣiṇataḥ gr̥hāṇām su-maṅgalaḥ bhadra-vādī śakunte mā naḥ stenaḥ īśata mā agha-śaṁsaḥ br̥hat vadema vidathe su-vīrāḥ
pra-dakṣiṇit abhi gr̥ṇanti kāravaḥ vayaḥ vadantaḥ r̥tu-thā śakuntayaḥ ubhe iti vācau vadati sāma-gāḥ-iva gāyatram ca traistubham ca anu rājati
udgātāiva śakune sāma gāyasi brahmaputraḥ-iva savaneṣu śaṁsasi vr̥ṣāiva vājī śiśu-matīḥ api-itya sarvataḥ naḥ śakune bhadram ā vada viśvataḥ naḥ śakune puṇyam ā vada
āvadan tvam sakune bhadram ā vada tūṣṇīm āsīnaḥ su-matim cikiddhi naḥ yat ut-patan vadasi karkariḥ yathā br̥hat vadema v
somasya mā tavasam vakṣi agne vahnim cakartha vidathe yajadhyai devān accha dīdyat yuñje adrim śam-āye agne tanvam juṣasva
prāñcam yajñam cakr̥ma vardhatām gīḥ samit-bhiḥ agnim namasā duvasyan divaḥ śaśāsuḥ vidathā kavīnām gr̥sāya cit tavase gātum īṣuḥ
mayaḥ dadhe medhiraḥ pūta-dakṣaḥ divaḥ su-bandhuḥ januṣā pr̥thivyāḥ avindan oṁ iti darśatam ap-su antaḥ devāsaḥ agnim apasi svasr̥r̥ṇām
avardhayan su-bhagam sapta yahvīḥ śvetam jajñānam aruṣam mahi-tvā śiśum na jātam abhi āruḥ aśvāḥ devāsaḥ agnim janiman vapuṣyan
śukrebhiḥ aṅgaiḥ rajaḥ ātatanvān kratum punānaḥ kavi-bhiḥ pavitraiḥ śociḥ vasānaḥ pari āyuḥ apām śriyaḥ mimīte br̥hatīḥ anūnāḥ
vavrāja sīm anadatīḥ adabdhāḥ divaḥ yahvīḥ avasānāḥ anagnāḥ sanāḥ atra yuvatayaḥ sa-yonīḥ ekam garbham dadhire sapta vāṇīḥ
stīrṇāḥ asya sam-hataḥ viśva-rūpā ghr̥tasya yonau sravathe madhūnām asthuḥ atra dhenavaḥ pinvamānāḥ mahī iti dasmasya mātarā samīcī itisam-īcī
babhrāṇaḥ sūno iti sahasaḥ vi adyaut dadhānaḥ śukrā rabhasā vapūṁṣi ścotanti dhārāḥ madhunaḥ ghr̥tasya vr̥ṣā yatra vavr̥dhe kāvyena
pituḥ cit ūdhaḥ januṣā viveda vi asya dhārāḥ asr̥jat vi dhenāḥ guhā carantam sakhi-bhiḥ śivebhiḥ divaḥ yahvībhiḥ na guhā babhūva
pituḥ ca garbham janituḥ ca babhre pūrvīḥ ekaḥ adhayat pīpyānāḥ vr̥ṣṇe sapatnī itisapatnī śucaye sabandhū itisa-bandhū ubhe iti asmai manuṣye iti ni pāhi
urau mahān ani-bādhe vavardha āpaḥ agnim yaśasaḥ sam hi pūrvīḥ r̥tasya yonau aśayat damūnāḥ jāmīnām agniḥ apasi svasr̥r̥r̥ṇām
akraḥ na babhriḥ sam-ithe mahīnām didr̥kṣeyaḥ sūnave bhāḥ-r̥jīkaḥ ut usriyāḥ janitā yaḥ jajāna apām garbhaḥ nr̥-tamaḥ yahvaḥ agniḥ
apām garbham darśatam oṣadhīnām vanā jajāna su-bhagā vi-rūpam devāsaḥ cit manasā sam hi jagmuḥ paniṣṭham jātam tavasam duvasyan
br̥hantaḥ it bhānavaḥ bhāḥ-r̥jīkam agnim sacanta vi-dyutaḥ na śukrāḥ guhāiva vr̥ddham sadasi sve antaḥ apāre ūrve amr̥tam duhānāḥ
īl̥e ca tvā yajamānaḥ haviḥ-bhiḥ īl̥e sakhi-tvam su-matim ni-kāmaḥ devaiḥ avaḥ mimīhi sam jaritre rakṣa ca naḥ damye--bhiḥ anīkaiḥ
upa-kṣetāraḥ tava su-pranīte agne viśvāni dhanyā dadhānāḥ su-retasā śravasā tuñjamānāḥ abhi syāma pr̥tanāyūn adevān
ā devānām abhavaḥ ketuḥ agne mandraḥ viśvāni kāvyāni vidvān prati martān avāsayaḥ damūnāḥ anu devān rathiraḥ yāsi sādhan
ni duroṇe amr̥taḥ martyānām rājā sasāda vidathāni sādhan ghr̥ta-pratīkaḥ urviyā vi adyaut agniḥ viśvāni kāvyāni vidvān
ā naḥ gahi sakhyebhiḥ śivebhiḥ mahān mahībhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ saraṇyan asme iti rayim bahulam sam-tarutram su-vācam bhāgam yaśasam kr̥dhi naḥ
etā te agne janima sanāni pra pūrvyāya nūtanāni vocam mahānti vr̥ṣṇe savanā kr̥tā imā janman-janman ni-hitaḥ jāta-vedāḥ
janman-janman ni-hitaḥ jāta-vedāḥ viśvāmitrebhiḥ idhyate ajasraḥ tasya vayam su-matau yajñiyasya api bhadre saumanase syāma
imam yajñam sahasāvan tvam naḥ deva-trā dhehi su-krato itisu-krato rarāṇaḥ pra yaṁsi hotaḥ br̥hatīḥ iṣaḥ naḥ agne mahi draviṇam ā yajasva
il̥ām agne puru-daṁsam sanim goḥ śaśvat-tamam havamānāya sādha syāt naḥ sūnuḥ tanayaḥ vijāvā agne sā te su-matiḥ bhūtu asme iti
vaiśvānarāya dhiṣaṇām r̥ta-vr̥dhe ghr̥tam na pūtam agnaye janāmasi dvitā hotāram manuṣaḥ ca vāghataḥ dhiyā ratham na kuliśaḥ sam r̥ṇvati
saḥ rocayat januṣā rodasī iti ubhe iti saḥ mātroḥ abhavat putraḥ īḍyaḥ havya-vāṭ agniḥ ajaraḥ canaḥ-hitaḥ duḥ-dabhaḥ viśām atithiḥ vibhāvasuḥ
kratvā dakṣasya taruṣaḥ vi-dharmaṇi devāsaḥ agnim janayanta citti-bhiḥ rurucānam bhānunā jyotiṣā mahām atyam na vājam saniṣyan upa bruve
ā mandrasya saniṣyantaḥ vareṇyam vr̥ṇīmahe ahrayam vājam r̥gmiyam rātim bhr̥gāūṇām uśijam kavi-kratum agnim rājantam divyena śociṣā
agnim sumnāya dadhire puraḥ janāḥ vāja-śravasam iha vr̥kta-barhi ṣaḥ yata-srucaḥ su-rucam viśva-devyam rudram yajñānām sādhat-iṣṭi m apasām
pāvaka-śoce tava hi kṣayam pari hotaḥ yajñeṣu vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ naraḥ agne duvaḥ icchamānāsaḥ āpyam upa āsate draviṇam dhehi tebhyaḥ
ā rodasī iti apr̥ṇat ā svaḥ mahat jātam yat enam apasaḥ adhārayan saḥ adhvarāya pari nīyate kaviḥ atyaḥ na vāja-sātaye canaḥ-hitaḥ
namasyata havya-dātim su-adhvaram duvasyata dabhyam jāta-vedasam rathīḥ r̥tasya br̥hataḥ vi-carṣaṇiḥ agniḥ devānām abhavat puraḥ-hitaḥ
tisraḥ yahvasya sam-idhaḥ pari-jmanaḥ agneḥ apunan uśijaḥ amr̥tyavaḥ tāsām ekām adadhuḥ martye bhujam oṁ iti lokam oṁ iti dve iti upa jāmim īyatuḥ
viśām kavim viśpatim mānuṣīḥ iṣaḥ sam sīm akr̥ṇvan sva-dhitim na tejase saḥ ut-vataḥ ni-vataḥ yāti veviṣat saḥ garbham eṣu bhuvaneṣu dīdharat
saḥ jinvate jaṭhareṣu prajajñi-vān vr̥ṣā citreṣu nānadat na siṁhaḥ vaiśvānaraḥ pr̥thu-pājāḥ amartyaḥ vasu ratnā dayamānaḥ vi dāśuṣe
vaiśvānaraḥ pratna-thā nākam ā aruhat divaḥ pr̥ṣṭham bhandamānaḥ sumanma-bhiḥ saḥ pūrva-vat janayan jantave dhanam samānam ajmam pari eti jāgr̥viḥ
r̥ta-vānam yajñiyam vipram ukthyam ā yam dadhe mātariśvā divi kṣayam tam citra-yāmam hari-keśam īmahe sud-ītim agnim su-vitāya navyase
śucim na yāman iṣiram svaḥ-dr̥śam ketum divaḥ rocana-sthām uṣaḥ-budham agnim mūrdhānam divaḥ aprati-skutam tam īmahe namasā vājinam br̥hat
mandram hotāram śucim advayāvinam damūnasam ukthyam viśva-carṣaṇ im ratham na citram vapuṣāya darśatam manuḥ-hitam sadam it rāyaḥ īmahe
vaiśvānarāya pr̥thu-pājase vipaḥ ratnā vidhanta dharuṇeṣu gātave agniḥ hi devān amr̥taḥ duvasyati atha dharmāṇi sanatā na dūduṣat
antaḥ dūtaḥ rodasī iti dasmaḥ īyate hotā ni-sattaḥ manuṣaḥ puraḥ-hitaḥ kṣayam br̥hantam pari bhūṣati dyu-bhiḥ devebhiḥ agniḥ iṣitaḥ dhiyāvasuḥ
ketum yajñānām vidathasya sādhanam viprāsaḥ agnim mahayanta citti-bhiḥ apāṁsi yasmin adhi sam-dadhuḥ giraḥ tasmin sumnāni yajamānaḥ ā cake
pitā yajñānām asuraḥ vipaḥ-citām vi-mānam agniḥ vayunam ca vāghatām ā viveśa rodasī iti bhūri-varpasā puru-priyaḥ bhandate dhāma-bhiḥ kaviḥ
candram agnim candra-ratham hari-vratam vaiśvānaram apsu-sadam svaḥ-vidam vi-gāham tūrṇim taviṣībhiḥ āvr̥tam bhūrṇim devāsaḥ iha su-śriyam dadhuḥ
agniḥ devebhiḥ manuṣaḥ ca jantu-bhiḥ tanvānaḥ yajñam puru-peśasam dhiyā rathīḥ antaḥ īyate sādhadiṣṭi-bhiḥ jīraḥ damūnāḥ abhiśasti-cātanaḥ
agne jarasva su-apatye āyuni ūrjā pinvasva sam iṣaḥ didīhi naḥ vayāṁsi jinva br̥hataḥ ca jāgr̥ve uśik devānām asi su-kratuḥ vipām
viśpatim yahvam atithim naraḥ sadā yantāram dhīnām uśijam ca vāghatām adhvarāṇām cetanam jāta-vedasam pra śaṁsanti namasā jūti-bhiḥ vr̥dhe
vibhāvā devaḥ su-raṇaḥ pari kṣitīḥ agniḥ babhūva śavasā sumat-rathaḥ tasya vratāni bhūri-poṣiṇaḥ vayam upa bhūṣema dame ā suvr̥kti-bhiḥ
vaiśvānara tava dhāmāni ā cakre yebhiḥ svaḥ-vit abhavaḥ vi-cakṣaṇa jātaḥ ā apr̥ṇaḥ bhuvanāni rodasī iti agne tā viśvā pari-bhūḥ asi tmanā
vaiśvānarasya daṁsanābhyaḥ br̥hat ariṇāt ekaḥ su-apasyayā kaviḥ ubhā pitarā mahayan ajāyata agniḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti bhūri-retasā
samit-samit su-manāḥ bodhi asme iti śucāśucā su-matim rāsi vasvaḥ ā deva devān yajathāya vakṣi sakhā sakhīn su-manāḥ yakṣi agne
yam devāsaḥ triḥ ahan āyajante dive--dive varuṇaḥ mitraḥ agniḥ saḥ imam yajñam madhu-mantam kr̥dhi naḥ tanū-napāt ghr̥ta-yonim vidhantam
pra dīdhitiḥ viśva-vārā jigāti hotāram il̥aḥ prathamam yajadhyai accha namaḥ-bhiḥ vr̥ṣabham vandadhyai saḥ devān yakṣat iṣitaḥ yajīyān
ūrdhvaḥ vām gātuḥ adhvare akāri ūrdhvā śocīṁṣi prasthitā rajāṁsi divaḥ vā nābhā ni asādi hotā str̥ṇīmahi deva-vyacāḥ vi barhiḥ
sapta hotrāṇi manasā vr̥ṇānāḥ invantaḥ viśvam prati yan r̥tena nr̥-peśasaḥ vidatheṣu pra jātāḥ abhi imam yajñam vi caranta pūrvīḥ
ā bhandamāneiti uṣasau upāke iti uta smayeteiti tanvā virūpeitivi-rūpe yathā naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ jujoṣat indraḥ marutvān uta vā mahaḥ-bhiḥ
daivyā hotārā prathamā ni r̥ñje sapta pr̥kṣāsaḥ svadhayā madanti r̥tam śaṁsantaḥ r̥tam it te āhuḥ anu vratam vrata-pāḥ dīdhyānāḥ
ā bhāratī bhāratībhiḥ sa-joṣāḥ il̥āḥ devaiḥ manuṣyebhiḥ agniḥ sarasvatī sārasvatebhiḥ arvāk tisraḥ devīḥ barhiḥ ā idam sadantu
tat naḥ turīpam adha poṣayitnu deva tvaṣṭaḥ vi rarāṇaḥ syasveti syasva yataḥ vīraḥ karmaṇyaḥ su-dakṣaḥ yukta-grāvā jāyate deva-kāmaḥ
vanaspate ava sr̥ja upa devān agniḥ haviḥ śamitā sūdayāti saḥ it oṁ iti hotā satya-taraḥ yajāti yathā devānām janimāni veda
ā yāhi agne sam-idhānaḥ arvāṅ indreṇa devaiḥ sa-ratham turebhiḥ barhiḥ naḥ āstām aditiḥ su-putrā svāhā devāḥ amr̥tāḥ mādayantām
prati agniḥ uṣasaḥ cekitānaḥ abodhi vipraḥ pada-vīḥ kavīnām pr̥thu-pājāḥ devayat-bhiḥ samiddhaḥ apa dvārā tamasaḥ vahniḥ āvar ity āvaḥ
pra it oṁ iti agniḥ vavr̥dhe stomebhiḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ stotr̥r̥ṇām namasyaḥ ukthaiḥ pūrvīḥ r̥tasya sam-dr̥śaḥ cakānaḥ sam dūtaḥ adyaut uṣasaḥ vi-roke
adhāyi agniḥ mānuṣīṣu vikṣu apām garbhaḥ mitraḥ r̥tena sādhan ā hiryataḥ yajataḥ sānu asthāt abhūt oṁ iti vipraḥ havyaḥ matīnām
mitraḥ agniḥ bhavati yat sam-iddhaḥ mitraḥ hotā varuṇaḥ jata-vedāḥ mitraḥ adhvaryuḥ iṣiraḥ damūnāḥ mitraḥ sindhūnām uta parvatānām
pāti priyam ripaḥ agram padam veḥ pāti yahvaḥ caraṇam sūryasya pāti nābhā sapta-śīrṣāṇām agniḥ pāti devānām upa-mādam r̥ṣvaḥ
r̥bhuḥ cakre īḍyam cāru nāma viśvāni devaḥ vayunāni vidvān samasya carma ghr̥ta-vat padam veḥ tat it agniḥ rakṣati apra-yucchan
ā yonim agniḥ ghr̥ta-vantam asthāt pr̥thu-pragānam uśantam uśānaḥ dīdyānaḥ śuciḥ r̥ṣvaḥ pāvakaḥ punaḥ-punaḥ mātarā navyasī iti karitikaḥ
sadyaḥ jātaḥ oṣadhībhiḥ vavakṣe yadi vardhanti pra-svaḥ ghr̥tena āpaḥ-iva pra-vatā śumbhamānāḥ uruṣyat agniḥ pitroḥ upa-sthe
ut ūām iti stutaḥ sam-idhā yahvaḥ adyaut varṣman divaḥ adhi nābhā pr̥thivyāḥ mitraḥ agniḥ īḍyaḥ mātariśvā ā dūtaḥ vakṣat yajathāya devān
ut astambhīt sam-idhā nākam r̥ṣvaḥ agniḥ bhavan ut-tamaḥ rocanānām yadi bhr̥gu-bhyaḥ pari mātariśvā guhā santam havya-vāham sam-īdhe
il̥ām agne puru-daṁsam sanim goḥ śaśvat-tamam havamānāya sādha syāt naḥ sūnuḥ tanayaḥ vijāvā agne sā te su-matiḥ bhūtu asme iti
pra kāravaḥ mananā vacyamānāḥ devadrīcīn nayata deva-yantaḥ dakṣiṇāvāṭ vājinī prācī eti haviḥ bharantī agnaye ghr̥tācī
ā rodasī iti apr̥ṇāḥ jāyamānaḥ uta pra rikthāḥ adha nu prayajyo itipra-yajyo devaḥ cit agne mahinā pr̥thivyāḥ vacyantām te vahnayaḥ sapta-jihvāḥ
dyauḥ ca tvā pr̥thivī yajñiyāsaḥ ni hotāram sādayante damāya yadi viśaḥ mānuṣīḥ deva-yantīḥ prayasvatīḥ īl̥ate śukram arciḥ
mahān sadha-sthe dhruvaḥ ā ni-sattaḥ antaḥ dyāvā māhineiti haryamāṇaḥ āskre iti sapatnī itisa-patnī ajareiti amr̥kte iti sabardugheitisabaḥ-dughe uru-gāyasya dhenū iti
vratā te agne mahataḥ mahāni tava kratvā rodasī iti ā tatantha tvam dūtaḥ abhavaḥ jāyamānaḥ tvam netā vr̥ṣabha caṣarṇīnām
r̥tasya vā keśinā yogyābhiḥ ghr̥ta-snuvā rohitā dhuri dhiṣva atha vaha devān deva viśvān su-adhvarā kr̥ṇuhi jāta-vedaḥ
divaḥ cit ā te rucayanta rokāḥ uṣaḥ vi-bhātīḥ anu bhāsi pūrvīḥ apaḥ yat agne uśadhak vaneṣu hotuḥ mandrasya panayanta devāḥ
urau vā ye antarikṣe madanti divaḥ vā ye rocane santi devāḥ ūmāḥ vā ye su-havāsaḥ yajatrāḥ āyemire rathyaḥ agne aśvāḥ
ā ebhiḥ agne sa-ratham yāhi arvāṅ nānāratham vā vi-bhavaḥ hi aśvāḥ patnī-vataḥ triṁśatam trīn ca devān anu-svadham ā vaha mādayasva
saḥ hotā yasya rodasī iti cit urvī iti yajñam-yajñam abhi vr̥dhe gr̥ṇītaḥ prācī iti adhvarāiva tasthatuḥ sumeke itisu-meke r̥tavarī ity r̥ta-varī r̥ta-jātasya satye iti
il̥ām agne puru-daṁsam sanim goḥ śaśvat-tamam havamānāya sādha syāt naḥ sūnuḥ tanayaḥ vijāvā agne sā te su-matiḥ bhūtu asme iti
pra ye āruḥ śiti-pr̥ṣṭhasya dhāseḥ ā mātarā viviśuḥ sapta vāṇīḥ pari-kṣitāḥ pitarā sam carete pra sarsrāteiti dīrgham āyuḥ pra-yakṣe
divakṣasaḥ dhenavaḥ vr̥ṣṇaḥ aśvāḥ devīḥ ā tasthau madhu-mat vahantīḥ r̥tasya tvā sadasi kṣema-yantam pari ekā carati vartanim gauḥ
ā sīm arohat su-yamāḥ bhavantīḥ patiḥ cikitvān rayi-vit rayīṇām pra nīla-pr̥ṣṭhaḥ atasasya dhāseḥ tāḥ avāsayat purudha-pratīkaḥ
mahi tvāṣṭram ūrjayantīḥ ajuryam stabhu-yamānam vahataḥ vahant i vi aṅgebhiḥ didyutānaḥ sadha-sthe ekām-iva rodasī iti ā viveśa
jānanti vr̥ṣṇaḥ aruṣasya śevam uta bradhnasya śāsane raṇanti divaḥ-rucaḥ su-rucaḥ rocamānāḥ il̥ā yeṣām gaṇyā māhinā gīḥ
uto iti pitr̥-bhyām pra-vidā anu ghoṣam mahaḥ mahat-bhyām anayanta śūṣam ukṣā ha yatra pari dhānam aktoḥ anu svam dhāma jarituḥ vavakṣa
adhvaryu-bhiḥ pañca-bhiḥ sapta viprāḥ priyam rakṣante ni-hitam padam veḥ prāñcaḥ madanti ukṣaṇaḥ ajuryāḥ devāḥ devānām anu hi vratā guritiguḥ
daivyā hotārā prathamā ni r̥ñje sapta pr̥kṣāsaḥ svadhayā madanti r̥tam śaṁsantaḥ r̥tam it te āhuḥ anu vratam vrata-pā dīdhyānāḥ
vr̥ṣāyante mahe atyāya pūrvīḥ vr̥ṣṇe citrāyaḥraśmayaḥḥsu-yāmāḥḥdevaḥhotaḥḥmandra-taraḥḥcikitvānḥmahaḥḥdevānḥrodasī itiḥāḥihaḥvakṣi
pr̥kṣa-prayajaḥ draviṇaḥ su-vācaḥ su-ketavaḥ uṣasaḥ revat ūṣuḥ uto iti cit agne mahinā pr̥thivyāḥ kr̥tam cit enaḥ sam mahe daśasya
il̥ām agne puru-daṁsam sanim goḥ śaśvat-tamam havamānāya sādha syāt naḥ sūnuḥ tanayaḥ vijāvā agne sā te su-matiḥ bhūtu asme iti
añjanti tvām adhvare deva-yantaḥ vanaspate madhunā daivyena yat ūrdhvaḥ tiṣṭhāḥ dravinā iha dhattāt yat vā kṣayaḥ mātuḥ asyāḥ upa-sthe
sam-iddhasya śrayamāṇaḥ purastāt brahma vanvānaḥ ajaram su-vīram āre asmat amatim bādhamānaḥ ut śrayasva mahate saubhagāya
ut śrayasva vanaspate varṣman pr̥thivyāḥ adhi su-mitī mīyamānaḥ varcaḥ dhāḥ yajña-vāhase
yuvā su-vāsāḥ pari-vītaḥ ā agāt saḥ oṁ iti śreyān bhavati jāyamānaḥ tam dhīrāsaḥ kavayaḥ ut nayanti su-ādhyaḥ manasā deva-yantaḥ
jātaḥ jāyate sudina-tve ahnām sa-marye ā vidathe vardhamānaḥ punanti dhīrāḥ apasaḥ manīṣā deva-yāḥ vipraḥ ut iyarti vācam
yān vaḥ naraḥ deva-yantaḥ ni-mimyuḥ vanaspate sva-dhitiḥ vā tatakṣa te devāsaḥ svaravaḥ tasthi-vāṁsaḥ prajāvat asme iti didhiṣantu ratnam
ye vr̥kṇāsaḥ adhi kṣami ni-mitāsaḥ yata-srucaḥ te naḥ vyantu vāyarm deva-trā kṣetra-sādhasaḥ
ādityāḥ rudrāḥ vasavaḥ su-nīthāḥ dyāvākṣāmā pr̥thivī antarikṣam sa-joṣasaḥ yajñam avantu devāḥ ūrdhvam kr̥ṇvantu adhvarasya ketum
haṁsāḥ-iva śreṇiśaḥ yatānāḥ śukrāḥ vasānāḥ svaravaḥ naḥ ā aguḥ ut-nīyamānāḥ kavi-bhiḥ purastāt devāḥ devānām api yanti pāthaḥ
śr̥ṅgāṇi-iva śr̥ṅgiṇām sam dadr̥śre caṣāla-vantaḥ svaravaḥ pr̥thivyām vāghat-bhiḥ vā vi-have śroṣamāṇāḥ asmān avantu pr̥tanājyeṣu
vanaspate śata-valśaḥ vi roha sahasra-valśāḥ vi vayam ruhema yam tvām ayam sva-dhitiḥ tejamānaḥ pra-nināya mahate saubhagāya
sakhāyaḥ tvā vavr̥mahe devam martāsaḥ ūtaye apām napātam su-bhagam su-dīditim su-pratūrtim anehasam
kāyamānaḥ vanā tvam yat mātr̥r̥ḥ ajagan apaḥ na tat te agne pra-mr̥ṣe ni-vartanam yat dūre san iha abhavaḥ
ati tr̥ṣṭam vavakṣitha atha eva su-manāḥ asi pra-pra anye yanti pari anye āsate yeṣām sakhye asi śritaḥ
īyi-vāṁsam ati sridhaḥ śaśvatīḥ ati saścataḥ anu īm avindan ni-cirāsaḥ adruhaḥ ap-su siṁham-iva śritam
sasr̥vāṁsam-iva tmanā agnim itthā tiraḥ-hitam ā enam nayat mātar iśvā parāvataḥ devebhyaḥ mathitam pari
tam tvā martāḥ agr̥bhṇata devebhyaḥ havya-vāhana viśvān yat yajñān abhi-pāsi mānuṣa tava kratvā yaviṣṭhya
tat bhadram tava daṁsanā pākāya cit chadayati tvām yat agne paśavaḥ sam-āsate sam-iddham api-śarvare
ā juhota su-adhvaram śīram pāvaka-śociṣam āśum dūtam ajiram pratnam īḍyam śruṣṭī devam saparyata
trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇi agnim triṁśat ca devāḥ nava ca asaparyan aukṣan ghr̥taiḥ astr̥ṇan barhiḥ asmai āt it hotāram ni asādayanta
tvām agne manīṣiṇaḥ sam-rājam carṣaṇīnām devam martāsaḥ indhate sam adhvare
tvām yajñeṣu r̥tvijam agne hotāram īl̥ate gopāḥ r̥tasya dīdihi sve dame
saḥ gha yaḥ te dadāśati samidhā jāta-vedase saḥ agne dhatte su-vīryam saḥ puṣyati
saḥ ketuḥ adhvarāṇām agniḥ devebhiḥ ā gamat añjānaḥ sapta hotr̥-bhiḥ haviṣmate
pra hotre pūrvyam vacaḥ agnaye bharata br̥hat vipām jyotīṁṣi bibhrate na vedhase
agnim vardhantu naḥ giraḥ yataḥ jāyate ukthyaḥ mahe vājāya draviṇāya darśataḥ
agne yajiṣṭhaḥ adhvare devān deva-yate yaja hotā mandraḥ vi rājasi ati sridhaḥ
saḥ naḥ pāvaka dīdihi dyu-mat asme iti su-vīryam bhava stotr̥-bhyaḥ antamaḥ svastaye
tam tvā viprāḥ vipanyavaḥ jāgr̥-vāṁsaḥ sam indhate havya-vāham amartyam sahaḥ-vr̥dham
agniḥ hotā puraḥ-hitaḥ adhvarasya vi-carṣaṇiḥ saḥ veda yajñam ānuṣak
saḥ havya-vāṭ amartyaḥ uśik dūtaḥ canaḥ-hitaḥ agniḥ dhiyā sam r̥ṇvati
agniḥ dhiyā saḥ cetati ketuḥ yajñasya pūrvyaḥ artham hi asya taraṇi
agnim sūnum sana-śrutam sahasaḥ jāta-vedasam vahnim devāḥ akr̥ṇvata
adābhyaḥ puraḥ-etā viśām agniḥ mānuṣīṇām tūrṇiḥ rathaḥ sadā navaḥ
sāhvān viśvāḥ abhi-yujaḥ kratuḥ devānām amr̥ktaḥ agniḥ tuviśravaḥ-tamaḥ
abhi prayāṁsi vāhasā dāśvān aśnoti martyaḥ kṣayam pāvaka-śociṣaḥ
pari viśvāni su-dhitā agneḥ aśyāma manma-bhiḥ viprāsaḥ jāta-vedasaḥ
agne viśvāni vāryā vājeṣu saniṣāmahe tve iti devāsaḥ ā īrire
indrāgnī iti ā gatam sutam gīḥ-bhiḥ nabhaḥ vareṇyam asya pātam dhiyā iṣitā
indrāgnī iti jarituḥ sacā yajñaḥ jigāti cetanaḥ ayā pātam imam sutam
indram agnim kavi-chadā yajñasya jūtyā vr̥ṇe tā somasya iha tr̥mpatām
tośā vr̥tra-hanā huve sa-jityvānā aparājitā indrāgnī iti vāja-sātamā
pra vām arcanti ukthinaḥ nītha-vidaḥ jaritāraḥ indrāgnī iti iṣaḥ ā vr̥ṇe
indrāgnī iti navatim puraḥ dāsa-patnīḥ adhūnutam sākam ekena karmaṇā
indrāgnī iti apasaḥ pari upa pra yanti dhītayaḥ r̥tasya pathyāḥ anu
indrāgnī iti taviṣāṇi vām sadha-sthāni prayāṁsi ca yuvoḥ ap-tūryam hitam
indrāgnī iti rocanā divaḥ pari vājeṣu bhūṣathaḥ tat vām ceti pra vīryam
pra vaḥ devāya agnaye barhiṣṭham arca asmai gamat devebhiḥ ā saḥ naḥ yajiṣṭhaḥ barhiḥ ā sadat
r̥ta-vā yasya rodasī iti dakṣam sacante ūtayaḥ haviṣmantaḥ tam īl̥ate tam saniṣyantaḥ avase
saḥ yantā vipraḥ eṣām saḥ yajñānām atha hi saḥ agnim tam vaḥ duvasyata dātā yaḥ vanitā magham
saḥ naḥ śarmāṇi vītaye agniḥ yacchatu śam-tamā yataḥ naḥ pruṣṇavat vasu divi kṣiti-bhyaḥ ap-su ā
dīdi-vāṁsam apūrvyam vasvībhiḥ asya dhīti-bhiḥ r̥kvaaṇaḥ agnim indhate hotāram viśpatim viśām
uta naḥ brahman aviṣaḥ uktheṣu deva-hūtamaḥ śam naḥ śoca marut-vr̥dhaḥ agne sahasra-sātamaḥ
nu naḥ rāsva sahasra-vat toka-vat puṣṭi-mat vasu dyumat agne su-vīryam varṣiṣṭham anupa-kṣitam
ā hotā mandraḥ vadathāni asthāt satyaḥ yajvā kavi-tamaḥ saḥ vedhāḥ vidyut-rathaḥ sahasaḥ putraḥ agniḥ śociḥ-keśaḥ pr̥thivyām pājaḥ aśret
ayāmi te namaḥ-uktim juṣasva r̥ta-vaḥ tubhyam cetate sahasvaḥ vidvān ā vakṣi viduṣaḥ ni ṣatsi madhye ā barhiḥ ūtaye yajatra
dravatām te uṣasā vājayantī iti agne vātasya pathyābhiḥ accha yat sīm añjanti pūrvyam haviḥ-bhiḥ ā vandhurāiva tasthatuḥ duroṇe
mitraḥ ca tubhyam varuṇaḥ sahasvaḥ agne viśve marutaḥ sumnam arcan yat śociṣā sahasaḥ putra tiṣṭhāḥ abhi kṣitīḥ prathayan sūryaḥ nr̥r̥n
vayam te adya rarima hi kāmam uttāna-hastāḥ namasā upa-sadya yajiṣṭhena manasā yakṣi devān asredhatā manmanā vipraḥ agne
tvat hi putra sahasaḥ vi pūrvīḥ devasya yanti ūtayaḥ vi vājāḥ tvam dehi sahasriṇam rayim naḥ adrogheṇa vacasā satyam agne
tubhyam dakṣa kavikrato itikavi-krato yāni imā deva martāsaḥ adhvare akarma tvam viśvasya su-rathasya bodhi sarvam tat agne amr̥ta svada iha
vi pājasā pr̥thunā śośucānaḥ bādhasva dviṣaḥ rakṣasaḥ amīvāḥ su-śarmaṇaḥ br̥hataḥ śarmaṇi syām agneḥ aham su-havasya pra-nītau
tvam naḥ asyāḥ uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭau tvam sūre ut-ite bodhi gopāḥ janma-iva nityam tanayam juṣasva stomam me agne tanvā su-jāta
tvam nr̥-cakṣāḥ vr̥ṣabha anu pūrvīḥ kr̥ṣṇāsu agne aruṣaḥ vi bhāhi vaso iti neṣi ca parṣi ca ati aṁhaḥ kr̥dhi naḥ rāye uśijaḥ yaviṣṭha
aṣāl̥haḥ agne vr̥ṣabhaḥ didīhi puraḥ viśvāḥ saubhagā sam-jigīvān yajñasya netā prathamasya pāyoḥ jāta-vedaḥ br̥hataḥ su-pranīte
acchidrā śarma jaritariti purūṇi devān accha dīdyānaḥ su-medhāḥ rathaḥ na sasniḥ abhi vakṣi vājam agne tvam rodasī iti naḥ sumeke itisu-meke
pra pīpaya vr̥ṣabha jinva vājān agne tvam rodasī iti naḥ sudogheitisu-doghe devebhiḥ deva su-rucā rucānaḥ mā naḥ martasya duḥ-matiḥ pari sthāt
il̥ām agne puru-daṁsam sanim goḥ śaśvat-tamam havamānāya sādha syāt naḥ sūnuḥ tanayaḥ vijāvā agne sā te su-matiḥ bhūtu asme iti
ayam agniḥ su-vīryasya īśe mahaḥ saubhagasya rāyaḥ īśe su-aapatyasya go--mataḥ īśe vr̥tra-hathānām
imam naraḥ marutaḥ saścata vr̥dham yasmin rāyaḥ śe--vr̥dhāsaḥ abhi ye santi pr̥tanāsu duḥ-dhyaḥ viśvāhā śatrum ādabhuḥ
saḥ tvam naḥ rāyaḥ śiśīhi mīḍhavaḥ agne su-vīryasya tuvi-dyumna varṣiṣṭhasya prajāvataḥ anamīvasya śuṣmiṇaḥ
cakriḥ yaḥ viśvā bhuvanā abhi sasahiḥ cakriḥ deveṣu ā duvaḥ ā deveṣu yatate ā su-vīrye ā śaṁse uta nr̥ṇām
mā naḥ agne amataye mā avīratāyai rīradhaḥ mā agotāyai sahasaḥ putra mā nide apa dveṣāṁsi ā kr̥dhi
śagdhi vājasya su-bhaga prajāvataḥ agne br̥hataḥ adhvare sam rāyā bhūyasā sr̥ja mayaḥ-bhunā tuvi-dyumna yaśasvatā
sam-idhyamānaḥ prathamā anu dharma sam aktu-bhiḥ ajyate viśva-vāraḥ śociḥ-keśaḥ ghr̥ta-nirnik pāvakaḥ su-yajñaḥ agniḥ yajathāya devān
yathā ayajaḥ hotram agne pr̥thivyāḥ yathā divaḥ jāta-vedaḥ cikitvān eva anena haviṣā yakṣi devān manuṣvat yajñam pra tira imam adya
trīṇi āyūṁṣi tava jāta-vedaḥ tisraḥ ājānīḥ uṣasaḥ te agne tābhiḥ devānām avaḥ yakṣi vidvān atha bhava yajamānāya śam yoḥ
agnim su-dītim su-dr̥śam gr̥ṇantaḥ namasyāmaḥ tvā īḍyam jāta-vedaḥ tvām dūtam aratim havya-vāham devāḥ akr̥ṇvan amr̥tasya nābhim
yaḥ tvat hotā pūrvaḥ agne yajīyān dvitā ca sattā svadhayā ca śam-bhuḥ tasya anu dharma pra yaja cikitvaḥ atha naḥ dhāḥ adhvaram deva-vītau
bhava naḥ agne su-manāḥ upa-itau sakhāiva sakhye pitarāiva sādhuḥ puru-druhaḥ hi kṣitayaḥ janānām prati pratīcīḥ dahatāt arātīḥ
tapo iti su agne antarān amitrān tapa śaṁsam araruṣaḥ parasya tapo iti vaso iti cikitānaḥ acittān vi te tiṣṭhantām ajarāḥ ayāsaḥ
idhmena agne icchamānaḥ ghr̥tena juhomi havyam tarase balāya yāvat īśe brahmaṇā vandamānaḥ imām dhiyam śata-seyāya devīm
ut śociṣā sahasaḥ putra stutaḥ br̥hat vayaḥ śaśamāneṣu dhehi revat agne viśvāmitreṣu śam yoḥ marmr̥jma te tanvam bhūri kr̥tvaḥ
kr̥dhi ratnam su-sanitaḥ dhanānām saḥ gha it agne bhavasi yat sami ddhaḥ stotuḥ duroṇe su-bhagasya revat sr̥prā karasnā dadhiṣe vapūṁṣi

ā tu naḥ indra madryak huvānaḥ soma-pītaye hari-bhyām yāhi adri-vaḥ
sattaḥ hotā naḥ r̥tviyaḥ tistire barhiḥ ānuṣak ayujran prātaḥ adrayaḥ
imā brahma brahma-vāhaḥ kriyante ā barhiḥ sīda vīhi śūra purol̥āśam
rarandhi savaneṣu naḥ eṣu stomeṣu vr̥trahan uktheṣu indra girvaṇaḥ
matayaḥ soma-pām urum rihanti śavasaḥ patim indram vatsam na mātaraḥ
saḥ mandasva hi andhasaḥ rādhase tanvā mahe na stotāram nide karaḥ
vayam indra tvāyavaḥ haviṣmantaḥ jarāmahe uta tvam ama-yuḥ vaso iti
mā āre asmat vi mumucaḥ hari-priya ārvāṅ yāhi indra svadhāvaḥ matsva iha
arvāñcam tvā su-khe rathe vahatām indra keśinā ghr̥tasnūitighr̥ta-snū barhiḥ āsade
upa naḥ sutam ā gahi somam indra go--āśiram hari-bhyām yaḥ te asma-yuḥ
tam indra madam ā gahi barhiḥ-sthām grāva-bhiḥ sutam kuvit nu asya tr̥ṣṇavaḥ
indram itthā giraḥ mama accha aguḥ iṣitāḥ itaḥ āvr̥te soma-pītaye
indram somasya pītaye stomaiḥ iha havāmahe ukthebhiḥ kuvit āgamat
indra somāḥ sutāḥ ime tān dadhiṣva śatakrato itiśata-krato jaṭhare vājinīvaso itivājinī-vaso
vidma hi tvā dhanam-jayam vājeṣu dadhr̥ṣam kave adha te sumnam īmahe
imam indra go--āśiram yava-āśiram ca naḥ piba āgatya vr̥ṣa-bhiḥ sutam
tubhya it indra sve okye somam codāmi pītaye eṣaḥ rarantu te hr̥di
tvām sutasya pītaye pratnam indra havāmahe kuśikāsaḥ avasyavaḥ
ā yāhi arvāṅ upa vandhure--sthāḥ tava it anu pra-divaḥ soma-peyam priyā sakhāyā vi muca upa barhiḥ tvām ime havya-vāhaḥ havante
ā yāhi pūrvīḥ ati carṣaṇīḥ ā aryaḥ āśiṣaḥ upa naḥ hari-bhyām imāḥ hi tvā matayaḥ stoma-taṣṭāḥ indra havante sakhyam juṣāṇāḥ
ā naḥ yajñam namaḥ-vr̥dham sa-joṣāḥ indra deva hari-bhiḥ yāhi tūyam aham hi tvā mati-bhiḥ johavīmi ghr̥ta-prayāḥ sadha-māde madhūnām
ā ca tvām etā vr̥ṣaṇā vahātaḥ harī iti sakhāyā su-dhurā su-aṅgā dhānāvat indraḥ savanam juṣāṇaḥ sakhā sakhyuḥ śr̥ṇavat vandanāni
kuvit mā gopām karase janasya kuvit rājānam magha-van r̥jīṣin kuvit mā r̥ṣim papi-vāṁsam sutasya kuvit me vasvaḥ amr̥tasya śikṣāḥ
ā tvā br̥hantaḥ harayaḥ yujānāḥ arvāk indra sadha-mādaḥ vahantu pra ye dvitā divaḥ r̥ñjanti ātāḥ su-sammr̥ṣṭāsaḥ vr̥ṣabhasya mūrāḥ
indra piba vr̥ṣa-dhūtasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ ā yam te śyenaḥ uśate jabhāra yasya made cyāvayasi pra kr̥ṣṭīḥ yasya made apa gotrā vavartha
śunam huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nr̥-tamam vāja-sātau śr̥ṇvantam ugram ūtaye samat-su ghnantam vr̥trāṇi sam-jitam dhanānām
ayam te astu haryataḥ somaḥ ā hari-bhiḥ sutaḥ juṣāṇaḥ indra hari-bhiḥ naḥ ā gahi ā tiṣṭha haritam ratham
haryan uṣasam arcayaḥ sūryam haryan arocayaḥ vidvān cikitvān hari-aśva vardhase indra viśvā abhi śriyaḥ
dyām indraḥ hari-dhāyasam pr̥thivīm hari-varpasam adhārayat hari toḥ bhūri bhojanam yayoḥ antaḥ hariḥ carat
jajñānaḥ haritaḥ vr̥ṣā viśvam ā bhāti rocanam hari-aśvaḥ haritam dhatte āyudham ā vajram bāhvoḥ harim
indraḥ haryantam arjunam vajram śukraiḥ abhi-vr̥tam apa avr̥ṇot hari-bhiḥ adri-bhiḥ sutam ut gāḥ hari-bhiḥ ājata
ā mandraiḥ indra hari-bhiḥ yāhi mayūraroma-bhiḥ mā tvā ke cit ni yaman vim na pāśinaḥ ati dhanva-iva tān ihi
vr̥tra-khādaḥ valam-rujaḥ purām darmaḥ apām ajaḥ sthātā rathasya haryoḥ abhi-svare indraḥ dr̥l̥hā cit ārujaḥ
gambhīrān udadhīn-iva kratum puṣyasi gāḥ-iva pra su-gopāḥ yavasam dhenavaḥ yathā hradam kulyāḥ-iva āśata
ā naḥ tujam rayim bhara aṁśam na prati-jānate vr̥kṣam pakvam phalam aṅkī-iva dhūnuhi indra sam-pāraṇam vasu
sva-yuḥ indra sva-rāṭ asi smat-diṣṭiḥ svayaśaḥ-taraḥ saḥ vavr̥dhānaḥ ojasā puru-stuta bhava naḥ suśravaḥ-tamaḥ
yudhmasya te vr̥ṣabhasya sva-rājaḥ ugrasya yūnaḥ sthavirasya ghr̥ṣveḥ ajūryataḥ vajriṇaḥ vīryāṇi indra śrutasya mahataḥ mahāni
mahān asi mahiṣa vr̥ṣṇyebhiḥ dhana-spr̥t ugra sahamānaḥ anyān ekaḥ viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā saḥ yodhayā ca kṣayayā ca janān
pra mātrābhiḥ ririce rocamānaḥ pra devebhiḥ viśvataḥ aprati-itaḥ pra majmanā divaḥ indraḥ pr̥thivyāḥ pra uroḥ mahaḥ antarikṣāt r̥jīṣī
urum gabhīram januṣā abhi ugram viśva-vyacasam avatam matīnām indram somāsaḥ pra-divi sutāsaḥ samudram na sravataḥ ā viśanti
yam somam indra pr̥thivīdyāvā garbham na mātā bibhr̥taḥ tvāyā tam te hinvanti tam oṁ iti te mr̥janti adhvaryavaḥ vr̥ṣabha pātavai oṁ iti
marutvān indra vr̥ṣabhaḥ raṇāya piba somam anu-svadham madāya ā siñcasva jaṭhare madhvaḥ ūrmim tvam rājā asi pra-divaḥ sutānām
sa-joṣāḥ indra sa-gaṇaḥ marut-bhiḥ somam piba vr̥tra-hā śūra vidvān jahi śatrūn apa mr̥dhaḥ nudasva atha abhayam kr̥ṇuhi viśvataḥ naḥ
uta r̥tu-bhiḥ r̥tu-pāḥ pāhi somam indra devebhiḥ sakhi-bhiḥ sutam naḥ yān ā abhajaḥ marutaḥ ye tvā anu ahan vr̥tram adadhuḥ tubhyam ojaḥ
ye tvā ahi-hatye magha-van avardhan ye śāmbare harivaḥ ye go--iṣṭau ye tvā nnam anu-madantiḥviprāḥḥpibaḥindraḥsomamḥsa-gaṇaḥḥmarut-bhiḥ
marutvantam vr̥ṣabham vavr̥dhānam akava-arim divyam śāsam indram viśvāsaham avase nūtanāya ugram sahaḥ-dām iha tam huvema
sadyaḥ ha jataḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ kanīnaḥ pra-bhartum āvat andhasaḥ sutasya sādhoḥ piba prati-kāmam yathā te rasa-āśiraḥ prathamam somyasya
yat jāyathāḥ tat ahaḥ asya kāme aṁśoḥ pīyūṣam apibaḥ giri-sthām tam te mātā pari yoṣā janitrī mahaḥ pituḥ dame ā asiñcat agre
upa-sthāya mātaram annam aiṭa tigmam apaśyat abhi somam ūdhaḥ pra-yavayan acarat gr̥tsaḥ anyān mahāni cakre purudha-pratīkaḥ
ugraḥ turāṣāṭ abhibhūti-ojāḥ yathāvaśam tanvam cakre eṣaḥ tvaṣṭāram indraḥ januṣā abhi-bhūya āmuṣya somam apibat camūṣu
śunam huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nr̥-tamam vāja-sātau śr̥ṇvantam ugram ūtaye samat-su ghnantam vr̥trāṇi sam-jitam dhanānām
śaṁsā mahām indram yasmin viśvāḥ ā kr̥ṣṭayaḥ soma-pāḥ kāmam avyan yam su-kratum dhiṣaṇe vibhva-taṣṭam ghanam vr̥trāṇām janayanta devāḥ
yam nu nakiḥ pr̥tanāsu sva-rājam dvitā tarati nr̥-tamam hari-sthām ina-tamaḥ satva-bhiḥ yaḥ ha śūṣaiḥ pr̥thu-jrayāḥ amināt āyuḥ dasyoḥ
saha-vā pr̥t-su taraṇiḥ na arvā vi-ānaśī iti rodasī iti mehanāvān bhagaḥ na kāre havyaḥ matīnām pitāiva cāruḥ su-havaḥ vayaḥ-dhāḥ
dhartā divaḥ rajasaḥ pr̥ṣṭaḥ ūrdhvaḥ rathaḥ na vāyuḥ vasu-bhiḥ niyutvān kṣapām vastā janitā sūryasya vi-bhaktā bhāgam dhiṣaṇāiva vājam
śunam huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nr̥-tamam vāja-sātau śr̥ṇvantam ugram ūtaye samat-su ghnantam vr̥trāṇi sam-jitam dhanānām
indraḥ svāhā pibatu yasya somaḥ āgatya tumraḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ marutvān ā uru-vyacāḥ pr̥ṇatām ebhiḥ annaiḥ ā asya haviḥ tanvaḥ kāmam r̥dhyāḥ
ā te saparyū iti javase yunajmi yayoḥ anu pra-divaḥ śruṣṭim āvaḥ iha tvā dheyuḥ harayaḥ su-śipra piba tu asya su-sutasya cāroḥ
gobhiḥ mimikṣum dadhire su-pāram indram jyaiṣṭhyāya dhāyase gr̥ṇānāḥ mandānaḥ somam papi-vān r̥jīṣin sam asmabhyam purudhā gāḥ iṣaṇya
imam kāmam mandaya gobhiḥ aśvaiḥ candra-vatā rādhasā paprathaḥ ca svaḥ-yavaḥ mati-bhiḥ tubhyam viprāḥ indrāya vāhaḥ kuśikāsaḥ akran
śunam huvema maghavānam indram asmin bhare nr̥-tamam vāja-sātau śr̥ṇvantam ugram ūtaye samat-su ghnantam vr̥trāṇi sam-jitam dhanānām
carṣaṇi-dhr̥tam magha-vānam ukthyam indram giraḥ br̥hatīḥ abhi anūṣata vavr̥dhanam puru-hūtam suvr̥kti-bhiḥ amartyam jaramāṇam dive--dive
śata-kratum arṇavam śākinam naram giraḥ me indram upa yanti viśvataḥ vāja-sanim pūḥ-bhidam tūrṇim ap-turam dhāma-sācam abhi-ṣācam svaḥ-vidam
ākare vasoḥ jaritā panasyate anehasaḥ stubhaḥ indraḥ duvasyat i vivasvataḥ sadane ā hi pipriye satrāsaham abhimāti-hanam stuhi
nr̥ṇām oṁ iti tvā nr̥-tamam gīḥ-bhiḥ ukthaiḥ abhi pra vīram arcata sa-bādhaḥ sam sahase puru-māyaḥ jihīte namaḥ asya pra-divaḥ ekaḥ īśe
pūrvīḥ asya niḥ-sidhaḥ martyeṣu puru vasūni pr̥thivī bibharti indrāya dyāvaḥ oṣadhīḥ uta āpaḥ rayim rakṣanti jīrayaḥ vanāni
tubhyam brahmāṇi giraḥ indra tubhyam satrā dadhire hari-vaḥ juṣasva bodhi āpiḥ avasaḥ nūtanasya sakhe vaso iti jaritr̥-bhyaḥ vayaḥ dhāḥ
indra marutvaḥ iha pāhi somam yathā śāryāte apibaḥ sutasya tava pra-nītī tava śūra śarman ā vivāsanti kavayaḥ su-yajñāḥ
saḥ vāvaśānaḥ iha pāhi somam marut-bhiḥ indra sakhi-bhiḥ sutam naḥ jātam yat tvā pari devāḥ abhūṣan mahe bharāya puru-hūta viśve
ap-tūrye marutaḥ āpiḥ eṣaḥ amandan indram anu dāti-vārāḥ tebhiḥ sākam pibatu vr̥tra-khādaḥ sutam somam dāśuṣaḥ sve sadha-sthe
idam hi anu ojasā sutam rādhānām pate piba tu asya girvaṇaḥ
yaḥ te anu svadhām asat sute ni yaccha tanvam saḥ tvā mamattu somyam
pra te aśnotu kukṣyoḥ pra indra brahmaṇā śiraḥ pra bāhū iti śūra rādhase
dhānāvantam karambhiṇam apūpa-vantam ukthinam indra prātaḥ juṣasva naḥ
purol̥āsam pacatyam juṣasva indra ā gurasva ca tubhyam havyāni s israte
purol̥āsam ca naḥ ghasaḥ joṣayāse giraḥ ca naḥ vadhūyuḥ-iva yoṣaṇām
purol̥āsam sana-śruta prātaḥ-sāve juṣasva naḥ indra kratuḥ hi te br̥han
mādhyandinasya savanasya dhānāḥ purol̥āsam indra kr̥ṣva iha cārum pra yat stotā jaritā tūrṇi-arthaḥ vr̥ṣa-yamāṇaḥ upa gīḥ-bhiḥ īṭe
tr̥tīye dhānāḥ savane puru-stuta purol̥āśam āhutam mamahasva naḥ r̥bhu-mantam vāja-vantam tvā kave prayasvantaḥ upa śikṣema dhīti--bhiḥ
pūṣaṇ-vate te cakr̥ma karambham hari-vate hari-aśvāya dhānāḥ apūpam addhi sa-gaṇaḥ marut-bhiḥ somam piba vr̥tra-hā śūra vidvān
prati dhānāḥ bharata tūyam asmai purol̥āśam vīra-tamāya nr̥ṇām dive--dive sa-dr̥śīḥ indra tubhyam vardhantu tvā soma-peyāya dhr̥ṣṇo iti
indrāparvatā br̥hatā rathena vāmīḥ iṣaḥ ā vahatam su-vīrāḥ vītam havyāni adhvareṣu devā vardhethām gīḥ-bhiḥ il̥iyā madantā
tiṣṭha su kam magha-van mā parā gāḥ somasya nu tvā su-sutasya yakṣi pituḥ na putraḥ sicam ā rabhe te indra svādiṣṭhayā girā śacī-vaḥ
śaṁsāva adhvaryo iti prati me gr̥ṇīhi indrāya vāhaḥ kr̥ṇavāva juṣṭam ā idam barhiḥ yajamānasya sīda atha ca bhūt uktham indrāya śastam
jāyā it astam magha-van sā it oṁ iti yoniḥ tat it tvā yuktāḥ harayaḥ vahantu yadā kadā ca sunavāma somam agn tvā dūtaḥ dhanvāti accha
parā yāhi magha-van ā ca yāhi indra bhrātaḥ ubhayatra te artham yatra rathasya br̥hataḥ ni-dhānam vi-mocanam vājinaḥ rāsabhasya
apāḥ somam astam indra pra yāhi kalyāṇīḥ jāyā su-raṇam gr̥he te yatra rathasya br̥hataḥ ni-dhānam vi-mocanam vājinaḥ dakṣiṇāvat
ime bhojāḥ aṅgirasaḥ vi-rūpāḥ divaḥ putrāsaḥ asurasya vīrāḥ viśvāmitrāya dadataḥ maghāni sahasra-sāve pra tirante āyuḥ
rūpam-rūpam magha-vā bobhavīti māyāḥ kr̥ṇvānaḥ tanvam pari svām tr iḥ yat divaḥ pari muhūrtam ā agāt svaiḥ mantraiḥ anr̥tu-pāḥ r̥ta-vā
mahān r̥ṣiḥ deva-jāḥ deva-jūtaḥ astabhnāt sindhum arṇavam nr̥-cakṣāḥ viśvāmitraḥ yat avahat su-dāsam apriyāyata kuśikebhiḥ indraḥ
haṁsāḥ-iva kr̥ṇutha ślokam adri-bhiḥ madantaḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ adhvare sute sacā devebhiḥ viprāḥ r̥ṣayaḥ nr̥-cakṣasaḥ vi pibadhvam kuśikāḥ somyam madhu
upa pra ita kuśikāḥ cetayadhvam aśvam rāye pra muñcata su-dāsaḥ rājā vr̥tram jaṅghanat prāk apāk udak atha yajāte vare ā pr̥thivyāḥ
yaḥ ime iti rodasī iti ubhe iti aham indram atustavam viśvāmitrasya rakṣati brahma idam bhāratam janam
viśvāmitrāḥ arāsata brahma indrāya vajriṇe karat it naḥ su-rādhasaḥ
kim te kr̥ṇvanti kīkaṭeṣu gāvaḥ na āśiran duhre na tapanti gharmam ā naḥ bhara pra-magandasya vedaḥ naicāśākham magha-van randhaya naḥ
sasarparīḥ amatim bādhamānā br̥hat mimāya jamadagni-dattā ā sūryasya duhitā tatāna śravaḥ deveṣu amr̥tam ajuryam
sasarparīḥ abharat tūyam ebhyaḥ adhi śravaḥ pāñca-janyāsu kr̥ṣṭiṣu sā pakṣyā navyam āyuḥ dadhānā yām me palasti-jamadagnayaḥ daduḥ
sthirau gāvau bhavatām vīl̥uḥ akṣaḥ mā īṣā vi varhi mā yugam vi śāri indraḥ pātalye iti dadatām śarītoḥ ariṣṭa-neme abhi naḥ sacasva
balam dhehi tanūṣu naḥ balam indra anal̥ut-su naḥ balam tokāya tanayāya jīvase tvam hi bala-dāḥ asi
abhi vyayasva khadirasya sāram ojaḥ dhehi spandane śiṁśapāyām akṣa vīl̥o iti vīl̥ita vīl̥ayasva mā yāmāt asmāt ava jīhipaḥ naḥ
ayam asmān vanaspatiḥ mā ca hāḥ mā ca ririṣat svasti ā gr̥hebhyaḥ ā avasai ā vi-mocanāt
indra ūti-bhiḥ bahulābhiḥ naḥ adya yāt-śreṣṭhābhiḥ magha-van śūra ji nva yaḥ naḥ dveṣṭi adharaḥ saḥ padīṣṭa yam oṁ iti dviṣmaḥ tam oṁ iti prāṇaḥ jahātu
paraśum cit vi tapati śimbalam cit vi vr̥ścati ukhā cit indra yeṣantī pra-yastā phenam asyati
na sāyakasya cikite janāsaḥ lodham nayanti paśu manyamānāḥ na avājinam vājinā hāsayanti na gardabham puraḥ aśvāt nayanti
ime indra bharatasya putrāḥ apa-pitvam cikituḥ na pra-pitvam hi nvanti aśvam araṇam na nityam jyāvājam pari nayanti ājau
imam mahe vidathyāya śūṣam śaśvat kr̥tvaḥ īḍyāya pra jabhruḥ śr̥ṇotu naḥ damyebhiḥ anīkaiḥ śr̥ṇotu agniḥ divyaiḥ ajasraḥ
mahi mahe dive arca pr̥thivyai kāmaḥ me icchan carati pra-jānan yayoḥ ha stome vidatheṣu devāḥ saparyavaḥ mādayante sacā āyoḥ
yuvoḥ r̥tam rodasī iti satyam astu mahe su ṇaḥ su-vitāya pra bhūtam idam dive namaḥ agne pr̥thivyai saparyāmi prayasā yāmi ratnam
uto iti hi vām pūrvyāḥ āvividre r̥tavarī ity r̥ta-varī rodasī iti satya-vācaḥ naraḥ cit vām sam-ithe śūra-sātau vavandire pr̥thivi vevidānāḥ
kaḥ addhā veda kaḥ iha pra vocat devān accha pathyā kā sam eti dadr̥śre eṣām avamā sadāṁsi pareṣu yā guhyeṣu vrateṣu
kaviḥ nr̥-cakṣā abhi sīm acaṣṭa r̥tasya yonā vighr̥teitivi-ghr̥te madantī iti nānā cakrāteiti sadanam yathā veḥ samānena kratunā saṁvidāne itisam-vidāne

imam stomam rodasī iti pra bravīmi r̥dūdarāḥ śr̥ṇavan agni-jihvāḥ mitraḥ sam-rājaḥ varuṇaḥ yuvānaḥ ādityāsaḥ kavayaḥ paprathānāḥ
hiraṇya-pāṇiḥ savitā su-jihvaḥ triḥ ā divaḥ vidathe patyamānaḥ deveṣu ca savitariti ślokam aśreḥ āt asmabhyam ā suva sarva-tātim
su-kr̥t su-pāṇiḥ sva-vān r̥ta-vā devaḥ tvaṣṭā avase tāni naḥ dhāt pūṣaṇ-vantaḥ r̥bhavaḥ mādayadhvam ūrdhva-grāvāṇaḥ adhvaram ataṣṭa
vidyut-rathāḥ marutaḥ r̥ṣṭi-mantaḥ divaḥ maryāḥ r̥ta-jātāḥ ayāsaḥ sarasvatī śr̥ṇavan yajñiyāsaḥ dhāta rayim saha-vīram turāsaḥ
viṣṇum stomāsaḥ puru-dasmam arkāḥ bhagasya-iva kāriṇaḥ yāmani gman uru-kramaḥ kakuhaḥ yasya pūrvīḥ na mardhanti yuvatayaḥ janitrīḥ
indraḥ viśvaiḥ vīryaiḥ patyamānaḥ ubhe iti ā paprau rodasī iti mahi-tvā puram-daraḥ vr̥tra-hā dhr̥ṣṇu-seṇaḥ sam-gr̥bhya naḥ ā bhara bhūri paśvaḥ
nāsatyā me pitarā bandhu-pr̥cchā sa-jātyam aśvinoḥ cāru nāma yuvam h i sthaḥ rayi-dau naḥ rayīṇām dātram rakṣetheiti akavaiḥ adabdhā
mahat tat vaḥ kavayaḥ cāru nāma yat ha devāḥ bhavatha viśve indre sakhāḥ r̥bhu-bhiḥ puru-hūta priyebhiḥ imām dhiyam sātaye takṣata naḥ
aryamā ṇaḥ aditiḥ yajñiyāsaḥ adabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni yuyota naḥ anapatyāni gantoḥ prajāvān naḥ paśu-mān astu gātuḥ
devānām dūtaḥ purudha pra-sūtaḥ anāgān naḥ vocatu sarva-tātā śr̥ṇotu naḥ pr̥thivī dyauḥ uta āpaḥ sūryaḥ nakṣatraiḥ uru antarikṣam
śr̥ṇvantu naḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ parvatāsaḥ dhruva-kṣemāsaḥ il̥ayā madantaḥ ādityaiḥ naḥ aditiḥ śr̥ṇotu yacchantu naḥ marutaḥ śarma bhadram
sadā su-gaḥ pitu-mān astu panthā madhvā devāḥ oṣadhīḥ sam pipr̥kta bhagaḥ me agne sakhye na mr̥dhyāḥ ut rāyaḥ aśyām sadanam puru-kṣoḥ
svadasva havyā sam iṣaḥ didīhi asmadryak sam mimīhi śravāṁsi viśvān agne pr̥t-su tān jeṣi śatrūn ahā viśvā su-manāḥ dīdihi naḥ
uṣasaḥ pūrvāḥ adha yat vi-ūṣuḥ mahat vi jajñe akṣaram pade goḥ vratā devānām upa nu pra-bhūṣan mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
mo iti su naḥ atra juhuranta devāḥ mā pūrve agne pitaraḥ pada-jñāḥ purāṇyoḥ sadmanoḥ ketuḥ antaḥ mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
vi me puru-trā patayanti kāmāḥ śami accha dīdye pūrvyāṇi sam-iddhe agnau r̥tam it vadema mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
samānaḥ rājā vi-bhr̥taḥ puru-trā śaye śayāsu pra-yutaḥ vanā anu anyā vatsam bharati kṣeti mātā mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
ākṣit pūrvāsu aparāḥ anūrut sadyaḥ jātāsutaruṇīṣu antariti antaḥ-vatīḥ suvate apravītāḥ mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
śayuḥ parastāt adha nu dvi-mātā abandhanaḥ carati vatsaḥ ekaḥ mi trasya tā varuṇasya vratāni mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
dvi-mātā hotā vidatheṣu sam-rāṭ anu agram carati kṣeti budhnaḥ pra raṇyāni raṇya-vācaḥ bharante mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
śūrasya-iva yudhyataḥ antamasya pratīcīnam dadr̥śe viśvam āyat antaḥ matiḥ carati niḥ-sidham goḥ mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
ni veveti palitaḥ dūtaḥ āsu antaḥ mahān carati rocanena vapūṁṣi bibhrat abhi naḥ vi caṣṭe mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
viṣṇuḥ gopāḥ paramam pāti pāthaḥ priyā dhāmāni amr̥tā dadhānaḥ agniḥ tā viśvā bhuvanāni veda mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
nānā cakrāteiti yamyā vapāūṁṣi tayoḥ anyat rocate kr̥ṣṇam anyat śyāvī ca yat aruṣī ca svasārau mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
mātā ca yatra duhitā ca dhenū iti sabardugheitisabaḥ-dughe dhāpayeteiti samīcī itisam-īcī / r̥tasya te sadasi īl̥e antaḥ mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
anyasyāḥ vatsam mimāya kayā bhuvā ni dadhe dhenuḥ ūdhaḥ r̥tasya sā payasā apinvata il̥ā mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
padyā vaste puru-rūpā vapūṁṣi ūrdhvā tasthau tri-avim rerihāṇā r̥tasya sadma vi carāmi vidvān mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
padeivetipade--iva nihiteitini-hite dasme antariti tayoḥ anyat guhyam āviḥ anyat sadhrīcīnā pathyā sā viṣūcī mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
ā dhenavaḥ dhunayantām aśiśvīḥ sabaḥ-dughāḥ śaśayāḥ apra-dugdhāḥ navyāḥ-navyāḥ yuvatayaḥ bhavantīḥ mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
yat anyāsu vr̥ṣabhaḥ roravīti saḥ anyasmin yūthe ni dadhāti retaḥ saḥ hi kṣapāvān saḥ bhagaḥ saḥ rājā mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
vīrasya nu su-aśvyam janāsaḥ pra nu vocāma viduḥ asya devāḥ ṣol̥hā yuktāḥ pañca-pañca ā vahanti mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
devaḥ tvaṣṭā savitā viśva-rūpaḥ pupoṣa pra-jāḥ purudhā jajāna imā ca viśvā bhuvanāni asya mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
mahī sam airat camvā samīcī itisam-īcī ubhe te asya vasunā nyr̥ṣṭeitini-r̥ṣṭe śr̥ṇve vīraḥ vindamānaḥ vasūni mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
imām ca naḥ pr̥thivīm viśva-dhāyāḥ upa kṣeti hita-mitraḥ na rājā puraḥ-sadaḥ śarma-sadaḥ na vīrāḥ mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
niḥ-sidhvarīḥ te oṣadhīḥ uta āpaḥ rayim te indra pr̥thivī bibharti sakhāyaḥ te vāma-bhājaḥ syāma mahat devānām asura-tvam ekam
na tā minanti māyinaḥ na dhīrāḥ vratā devānām prathamā dhruvāṇi na rodasī iti adruhā vedyābhiḥ na parvatāḥ ni-name tasthi-vāṁsaḥ
ṣaṭ bhārān ekaḥ acaran bibharti r̥tam varṣiṣṭham upa gāvaḥ ā aguḥ tisraḥ mahīḥ uparāḥ tasthuḥ atyāḥ guhā dve iti nihiteitini-hite darśi ekā
tri-pājasyaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ viśva-rūpaḥ uta tri-udhā purudha prajāvān tri-anīkaḥ patyate māhina-vān saḥ retaḥ-dhā vr̥ṣabhaḥ śaśvatīnām
abhīke āsām pada-vīḥ abodhi ādityānām ahve cāru nāma āpaḥ cit asmai aramanta devīḥ pr̥thak vrajantīḥ pari sīm avr̥ñjan
trī ṣadha-sthā sindhavaḥ triḥ kavīnām uta tri-mātā vidatheṣu sam-rāṭ r̥ta-varīḥ yoṣaṇāḥ tisraḥ apyāḥ triḥ ā divaḥ vidathe patyamānāḥ
triḥ ā divaḥ savitaḥ vāryāṇi dive--dive ā suva triḥ naḥ ahnaḥ tri--dhātu rāyaḥ ā suva vasūni bhaga trātaḥ dhiṣaṇe sātaye dhāḥ
triḥ ā divaḥ savitā soṣavīti rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī itisu-pāṇī āpaḥ cit asya rodasī iti cit urvī iti ratnam bhikṣanta savituḥ savāya
triḥ ut-tamā duḥ-naśā rocanāni trayaḥ rājanti asurasya vīrāḥ r̥ta-vānaḥ iṣirāḥ duḥ-dabhāsaḥ triḥ ā divaḥ vidathe santu devāḥ
pra me vivikvaan avidat manīṣām dhenum carantīm pra-yutām agopām sadyaḥ cit yā duduhe bhūri dhāseḥ indraḥ tat agniḥ panitāraḥ asyāḥ
indraḥ su pūṣā vr̥ṣaṇā su-hastā divaḥ na prītāḥ śaśayam duduhre viśve yat asyām raṇayanta devāḥ pra vaḥ atra vasavaḥ sumnam aśyām
yā jāmaya vr̥ṣṇe icchanti śaktim namasyantīḥ jānate garbham asmin accha putram dhenavaḥ vāvaśānāḥ mahaḥ caranti bibhratam vapūṁṣi
accha vivakmi rodasī iti sumeke itisu-meke grāvṇaḥ yujānaḥ adhvare manīṣā imāḥ oṁ iti te manave bhūri-vārāḥ ūrdhvāḥ bhavanti darśatāḥ yajatrāḥ
yā te jihvā madhu-matī su-medhāḥ agne deveṣu ucyate urūcī tayā iha vi śvān avase yajatrān ā sādaya pāyayā ca madhūni
yā te agne parvatasya-iva dhārā asaścantī pīpayat dv citrā tām asmabhyam pra-matim jāta-vedaḥ vaso iti rāsva su-matim viśva-janyām
dhenuḥ pratnasya kāmyam duhānā antariti putraḥ carati dakṣiṇāyāḥ ā dyotanim vahati śubhra-yāmā uṣasaḥ stomaḥ aśvinau ajīgariti
su-yuk vahanti prati vām r̥tena ūrdhvā bhavanti pitarāiva medhāḥ jarethām asmat vi paṇeḥ manīṣām yuvoḥ avaḥ cakr̥ma ā yātam arvāk
suyuk-bhiḥ aśvaiḥ su-vr̥tā rathena dasrau imam śr̥ṇutam ślokam adreḥ kim aṅga vām prati avartim gamiṣṭhā āhuḥ viprāsaḥ aśvinā purājāḥ
ā manyethām ā gatam kat cit evaiḥ viśve janāsaḥ aśvinā havante imā hi vām go--r̥jīkā madhūni pra mitrāsaḥ na daduḥ usraḥ agre
tiraḥ puru cit aśvinā rajāṁsi āṅgūṣaḥ vām magha-vānā janeṣu ā iha yātam pathi-bhiḥ deva-yānaiḥ dasrau ime vām ni-dhayaḥ madhūnām
purāṇam okaḥ sakhyam śivam vām yuvoḥ narā draviṇam jahnāvyām punariti kr̥ṇvānāḥ sakhyā śivāni madhvā madema saha nu samānāḥ
aśvinā vāyunā yuvam su-dakṣā niyut-bhiḥ ca sa-joṣasā yuvānā nāsatyā tiraḥ-ahnyam juṣāṇā somam pibatam asridhā sudānūitisu-dānū
aśvinā pari vām iṣaḥ purūcīḥ īyuḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ yatamānāḥ amr̥dhrāḥ rathaḥ ha vām r̥ta-jāḥ adri-jūtaḥ pari dyāvāpr̥thivī iti yāti sadyaḥ
aśvinā madhusut-tamaḥ yuvākuḥ somaḥ tam pātam ā gatam duroṇe rathaḥ ha vām bhūri varpaḥ karikrat suta-vataḥ niḥ-kr̥tam āgamiṣṭhaḥ
mitraḥ janān yātayati bruvāṇaḥ mitraḥ dādhāra pr̥thivīm uta dyām mitraḥ kr̥ṣṭīḥ animiṣā abhi caṣṭe mitrāya havyam ghr̥ta-vat juhota
pra saḥ mitra martaḥ astu prayasvān yaḥ te āditya śikṣati vratena na hanyate na jīyate tvāūtaḥ na enam aṁhaḥ aśnoti antitaḥ na dūrāt
anamīvāsaḥ il̥ayā madantaḥ mita-jñavaḥ variman ā pr̥thivyāḥ ādityasya vratam upa-kṣiyantaḥ vayam mitrasya su-matau syāma
ayam mitraḥ namasyaḥ su-śevaḥ rājā su-kṣatraḥ ajaniṣṭa vedhāḥ tasya vayam su-matau yajñiyasya api bhadre saumanase syāma
mahān ādityaḥ namasā upa-sadyaḥ yātayat-janaḥ gr̥ṇate su-śevaḥ tasmai etat panya-tamāya juṣṭam agnau mitrāya haviḥ ā juhota
mitrasya carṣaṇi-dhr̥taḥ avaḥ devasya sānasi dyumnam citraśravaḥ-tamam
abhi yaḥ mahinā divam mitraḥ babhūva sa-prathāḥ abhi śravaḥ-bhiḥ pr̥thivīm
