mitrāya pañca yemire janāḥ abhiṣṭi-śavase saḥ devān viśvān bibharti
mitraḥ deveṣu āyuṣu janāya vr̥kta-barhiṣe iṣaḥ iṣṭa-vratāḥ akar ity akaḥ
iha-iha vaḥ manasā bandhutā naraḥ uśijaḥ jagmuḥ abhi tāni vedasā yābhiḥ māyābhiḥ pratijūti-varpasaḥ saudhanvanāḥ yajñiyam bhagam ānaśa
yābhiḥ śacībhiḥ camasām apiṁśata yayā dhiyā gām ariṇīta carmaṇaḥ yena harī iti manasā niḥ-atakṣata tena deva-tvam r̥bhavaḥ sam ānaśa
indrasya sakhyam r̥bhavaḥ sam ānaśuḥ manoḥ napātaḥ apasaḥ dadhanvire saudhanvanāsaḥ amr̥ta-tvam ā īrire viṣṭavī śamībhiḥ su-kr̥taḥ su-kr̥tyayā
indreṇa yātha sa-ratham sute sacā atho iti vaśānām bhavatha saha śriyā na vaḥ prati-mai su-kr̥tāni vāghataḥ saudhanvanāḥ r̥bhavaḥ vīryāṇi ca
indra r̥bhu-bhiḥ vājavat-bhiḥ sam-ukṣitam sutam somam ā vr̥ṣasva gabhastyoḥ dhiyā iṣitaḥ maghavan dāśuṣaḥ gr̥he saudhanvanebhiḥ saha matsva nr̥-bhiḥ
indra r̥bhu-mān vāja-vān matsva iha naḥ asmin savane śacyā puru-stuta imāni tubhyam svasarāṇi yemire vratā devānām manuṣaḥ ca dharma-bhiḥ
indra r̥bhu-bhiḥ vāji-bhiḥ vājayan iha stomam jarituḥ upa yāhi yajñi yam śatam ketebhiḥ iṣirebhiḥ āyave sahasra-nīthaḥ adhvarasya homani
uṣaḥ vājena vājini pra-cetāḥ stomam juṣasva gr̥ṇataḥ maghoni purāṇī devi yuvatiḥ puram-dhiḥ anu vratam carasi viśva-vāre
uṣaḥ devi amartyā vi bhāhi candra-rathā sūnr̥tāḥ īrayantī ā tvā vahantu su-yamāsaḥ aśvāḥ hiraṇya-varṇām pr̥thu-pājasaḥ ye
uṣaḥ pratīcī bhuvanāni viśvā ūrdhvā tiṣṭhasi amr̥tasya ketuḥ samānam artham caraṇīyamānā cakram-iva navyasi ā vavr̥tsva
ava syūma-iva cinvatī maghonī uṣā yāāi svasarasya patnī svaḥ janantī su-bhagā su-daṁsāḥ ā antāt divaḥ paprathe ā pr̥thivyāḥ
accha vaḥ devīm uṣasam vi-bhātīm pra vaḥ bharadhvam namasā su-vr̥ktim ūrdhvam madhudhā divi pājaḥ aśret pra rocanā ruruce raṇva-sandr̥k
r̥ta-varī divaḥ arkaiḥ abodhi ā revatī rodasī iti citram āsthāt āyatīm agne uṣasam vi-bhātīm vāmam eṣi draviṇam bhi kṣamāṇaḥ
r̥tasya budhne uṣasām iṣaṇyan vr̥ṣā mahī iti rodasī iti ā viveśa mahī mitrasya varuṇasya māyā candrāiva bhānum vi dadhe puru-trā
imāḥ oṁ iti vām bhr̥mayaḥ manyamānāḥ yuvāvate na tujyāḥ abhūvan kva tyat indrāvaruṇā yaśaḥ vām yena sma sinam bharathaḥ sakhi-bhyaḥ
ayam oṁ iti vām puru-tamaḥ rayi-yan śaśvat-tamam avase johavīti sa-joṣau indrāvaruṇā marut-bhiḥ divā pr̥thivyā śr̥ṇutam havam me
asme iti tat indrāvaruṇā vasu syāt asme iti rayiḥ marutaḥ sarva-vīraḥ asmān varūtrīḥ śaraṇaiḥ avantu asmān hotrā bhāratī dakṣiṇābhiḥ
br̥haspate juṣasva naḥ havyāni viśva-devya rāsva ratnāni dāśuṣe
śucim arkaiḥ br̥haspatim adhvareṣu namasyata anāmi ojaḥ ā cake
vr̥ṣabham carṣaṇīnām viśva-rūpam adābhyam br̥haspatim vareṇyam
iyam te pūṣan āghr̥ṇe su-stutiḥ deva navyasī asmābhiḥ tubhyam śasyate
tām juṣasva giram mama vāja-yantīm ava dhiyam vadhūyuḥ-iva yoṣaṇām
yaḥ viśvā abhi vi-paśyati bhuvanā sam ca paśyati saḥ naḥ pūṣā avitā bhuvat
tat savituḥ vareṇyam bhargaḥ devasya dhīmahi dhiyaḥ yaḥ naḥ pra-codayāt
devasya savituḥ vayam vāja-yantaḥ puram-dhyā bhagasya rātim īmahe
devam naraḥ savitāram viprāḥ yajñaiḥ suvr̥kti-bhiḥ namasyanti dhiyā iṣitāḥ
somaḥ jigāti gātu-vit devānām eti niḥ-kr̥tam r̥tasya yonim āsadam
somaḥ asmabhyam dvi-pade catuḥ-pade ca paśave anamīvāḥ iṣaḥ karat
asmākam āyuḥ vardhayan abhi-mātīḥ sahamānaḥ somaḥ sadha-stham ā asadat
ā naḥ mitrāvaruṇā ghr̥taiḥ gavyūtim ukṣatam madhvā rajāṁsi sukratūitisu-kratū
uru-śaṁsā namaḥ-vr̥dhā mahnā dakṣasya rājathaḥ drāghiṣṭhābhiḥ śuci-vratā
gr̥ṇānā jamat-agninā yonau r̥tasya sīdatam pātam somam r̥ta-vr̥dhā
tvām hi agne sadam it sa-manyavaḥ devāsaḥ devam aratim ni-erire iti kratvā ni-erire amartyam yajata martyeṣu ā devam ādevam janata pra-cetasam viśvam ādevam janata pra-cetasam
saḥ bhrātaram varuṇam agne ā vavr̥tsva devān accha su-matī yajña-vanasam jyeṣṭham yajña-vanasam r̥ta-vānam ādityam carṣaṇi-dhr̥tam rājānam carṣaṇi-dhr̥tam

sakhe sakhāyam abhi ā vavr̥tsva āśum na cakram rathyāiva raṁhyā asmabhyam dasma raṁhyā agne mr̥l̥īkam varuṇe sacā vidaḥ marut-su viśva-bhānuṣu tokāya tuje śuśucāna śam kr̥dhi asmabhyam dasma śam kr̥dhi
tvam naḥ agne varuṇasya vidvān devasya hel̥aḥ ava yāsisīṣṭhāḥ yajiṣṭhaḥ vahni-tamaḥ śośucānaḥ viśvā dveṣāṁsi pra mumugdhi asmat
saḥ tvam naḥ agne avamaḥ bhava ūtī nediṣṭhaḥ asyāḥ uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭau ava yakṣva naḥ varuṇam rarāṇaḥ vīhi mr̥l̥īkam su-havaḥ naḥ edhi
asya śreṣṭhā su-bhagasya sam-dr̥k devasya citra-tamā martyeṣu śuci ghr̥tam na taptam aghnyāyāḥ spārhā devasya maṁhanāiva dhenoḥ
triḥ asya tā paramā santi satyā spārhā devasya janimāni agneḥ anante antariti pari-vītaḥ ā agāt śuciḥ śukraḥ aryaḥ rorucānaḥ
saḥ dūtaḥ viśvā it abhi vaṣṭi sadma hotā hiraṇya-rathaḥ ram-sujihvaḥ rohit-aśvaḥ vapuṣyaḥ vibhāvā sadā raṇvaḥ pitumatī-iva saṁsat
saḥ cetayat manuṣaḥ yajña-bandhuḥ pra tam mahyā raśanayā nayanti saḥ kṣeti asya duryāsu sādhan devaḥ martasya sadhani-tvam āpa
saḥ tu naḥ agniḥ nayatu pra-jānan accha ratnam deva-bhaktam yat asya dhiyā yat viśve amr̥tāḥ akr̥ṇvan dyauḥ pitā janitā satyam ukṣan
saḥ jāyata prathamaḥ pastyāsu mahaḥ budhne rajasaḥ asya yonau apāt aśīrṣā guhamānaḥ antā āyoyuvānaḥ vr̥ṣabhasya nīl̥e
pra śardhaḥ ārta prathamam vi-panyā r̥tasya yonā vr̥ṣabhasya nīl̥e spārhaḥ yuvā vapuṣyaḥ vibhāvā sapta priyāsaḥ ajanayanta vr̥ṣṇe
asmākam atra pitaraḥ manuṣyāḥ abhi pra seduḥ r̥tam āśuṣāṇāḥ aśma-vrajāḥ su-dughā vavre antaḥ ut usrāḥ ājan uṣasaḥ huvānāḥ
te marmr̥jat a dadr̥-vāṁsaḥ adrim tat eṣām anye abhitaḥ vi vocan paśva-yantrāsaḥ abhi kāram arcan vidanta jyotiḥ cakr̥panta dhībhiḥ
te gavyatā manasā dr̥dhram ubdham gāḥ yemānam pari santam adrim dr̥l̥ham naraḥ vacasā daivyena vrajam go--mantam uśijaḥ vi vavruḥ
te manvata prathamam nāma dhenoḥ triḥ sapta mātuḥ paramāṇi vindan tat jānatīḥ abhi anūṣata vrāḥ āviḥ bhuvat aruṇīḥ yaśasā goḥ
neśat tamaḥ dudhitam rocata dyauḥ ut devyāḥ uṣasaḥ bhānuḥ arta ā sūryaḥ br̥hataḥ tiṣṭhat ajrān r̥ju marteṣu vr̥jina ca paśyan
āt it paścā bubudhānāḥ vi akhyan āt it ratnam dhārayanta dyu-bhaktam viśve viśvāsu duryāsu devāḥ mitra dhiye varuṇa satyam astu
accha voceya śuśucānam agnim hotāram viśva-bharasam yajiṣṭham śuci ūdhaḥ atr̥ṇat na gavām andhaḥ na pūtam pari-siktam aṁśoḥ
viśveṣām aditiḥ yajñiyānām viśveṣām atithiḥ mānuṣāṇām agniḥ devānām avaḥ āvr̥ṇānaḥ su-mr̥l̥īkaḥ bhavatu jāta-vedāḥ
yaḥ martyeṣu amr̥taḥ r̥ta-vā devaḥ deveṣu aratiḥ ni-dhāyi hotā yajiṣṭhaḥ mahnā śucadhyai havyaiḥ agniḥ manuṣaḥ īrayadhyai
iha tvam sūno iti sahasaḥ naḥ adya jātaḥ jātān ubhayān antaḥ agne dūtaḥ īyase yyjānaḥ ṣv r̥ju-muṣkān vr̥ṣaṇaḥ śukrān ca
atyā vr̥dhasnū itivr̥dha-snū rohitā ghr̥tasnūitighr̥ta-snū r̥tasya manye manasā javiṣṭhā antaḥ īyase aruṣā yujānaḥ yuṣmān ca devān viśaḥ ā ca martān
aryamaṇam varuṇam mitram eṣām indrāviṣṇūiti marutaḥ aśvinā uta su-aśvaḥ agne su-rathaḥ su-rādhāḥ ā it oṁ iti vaha su-haviṣe janāya
go--mān agne avi-mān aśvī yajñaḥ nr̥vat-sakhā sadam it apra-mr̥ṣyaḥ il̥āvān eṣaḥ asura prajāvān dīrghaḥ rayiḥ pr̥thu-budhnaḥ sabhāvān
yaḥ te idhmam jabharat siṣvidānaḥ mūrdhānam vā tatapate tvāyā bhuvaḥ tasya sva-tavān pāyuḥ agne viśvasmāt sīm agha-yataḥ uruṣya
yaḥ te bharāt anni-yate cit annam ni-śiṣat mandram atithim ut-īrat ā deva-yuḥ inadhate duroṇe tasmin rayiḥ dhruvaḥ astu dāsvān
yaḥ tvā doṣā yaḥ uṣasi pra-śaṁsāt priyam vā tvā kr̥ṇavate haviṣmān aśvaḥ na sve dame ā hemyāvān tam aṁhasaḥ pīparaḥ dāśvāṁsam
yaḥ tubhyam agne amr̥tāya dāśa-huvaḥ tve iti kr̥ṇavate yata-sruk na saḥ rāyā śaśamānaḥ vi yoṣat na enam aṁhaḥ pari varat agha-yoḥ
yasya tvam agne adhvaram jujoṣaḥ devaḥ martasya su-dhitam rarāṇaḥ prītā it asat hotrā sā yaviṣṭha asāma yasya vidhataḥ vr̥dhāsaḥ
cittim acittim cinavat vi vidvān pr̥ṣṭāiva vītā vr̥jinā ca martān rāye ca naḥ su-apatyāya deva ditim ca rāsva aditim uruṣya
kavim śaśāsuḥ kavayaḥ adabdhāḥ ni-dhārayantaḥ duryāsu āyoḥ ataḥ tvam dr̥śyān agne etān paṭ-bhiḥ paśyeḥ adbhutām aryaḥ evaiḥ
tvam agne vāghate su-pranītiḥ suta-somāya vidhate yaviṣṭha ratnam bhara śaśamānāya ghr̥ṣve pr̥thu candram avase carṣaṇi-prāḥ
adha ha yat vayam agne tvāyā paṭ-bhiḥ hastebhiḥ cakr̥ma tanūbhiḥ ratham na krantaḥ apasā bhurijoḥ r̥tam yemuḥ su-dhyaḥ āśuṣāṇāḥ
adha mātuḥ uṣasaḥ sapta viprāḥ jāyemahi prathamāḥ vedhasaḥ nr̥r̥n divaḥ putrāḥ aṅgirasaḥ bhavema adrim rujema dhaninam śucantaḥ
adha yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsaḥ pratnāsaḥ agne r̥tam āśuṣāṇāḥ śuci it ayan dīdhitim uktha-śāsaḥ kṣāmā bhindantaḥ aruṇīḥ apa vran
su-karmāṇaḥ su-rucaḥ deva-yantaḥ ayaḥ na devāḥ janima dhamantaḥ śucantaḥ agnim vavr̥dhantaḥ indram ūrvam gavyam pari-sadantaḥ agman
ā yūthāiva kṣu-mati paśvaḥ akhyat devānām yat janima anti ugra martānām cit urvaśīḥ akr̥pran vr̥dhe cit aryaḥ uparasya āyoḥ
akarma te si-apasaḥ abhūma r̥tam avasran uṣasaḥ vi-bhātīḥ anūnam agnim purudhā su-candram devasya marmr̥jataḥ cāru cakṣuḥ
etā te agne ucathāni vedhaḥ avocāma kavaye tā juṣasva ut śocasva kr̥ṇuhi vasyasaḥ naḥ mahaḥ rāyaḥ puru-vāra pra yandhi
ā vaḥ rājānam adhvarasya rudram hotāram satya-yajam rodasyoḥ agnim purā tanayitnoḥ acittāt hiraṇya-rūpam avase kr̥ṇudhvam
ayam yoniḥ cakr̥ma yam vayam te jāyāiva patye uśatī su-vāsāḥ arvācīnaḥ pari-vītaḥ ni sīda imāḥ oṁ iti te su-apāka pratīcīḥ
āśr̥ṇvate adr̥pitāya manma nr̥-cakṣase su-mr̥l̥īkāya vedhaḥ devāya śastim amr̥tāya śaṁsa grāvāiva sotā madhu-sut yam īl̥e
tvam cit naḥ śamyai agne asyāḥ r̥tasya bodhi r̥ta-cit su-ādhīḥ kadā te ukthā sadha-mādyāni kadā bhavanti sakhyā gr̥he te
kathā ha tat varuṇāya tvam agne kathā dive garhase kat naḥ āgaḥ kathā mitrāya mīl̥huṣe pr̥thivyai bravaḥ kat aryamṇe kat bhagāya
kat dhiṣṇyāsu vr̥dhasānaḥ agne kat vātāya pra-tavase śubhaṁmye pari-jmane nāsatyāya kṣe bravaḥ kat agne rudrāya nr̥-ghne
kathā mahe puṣtim-bharāya pūṣṇe kat rudrāya su-makhāya haviḥ-de kat v iṣṇave uru-gāyāya retaḥ bravaḥ kat agne śarave br̥hatyai
kathā śardhāya marutām r̥tāya kathā sūre br̥hate pr̥cchyamānaḥ prati bravaḥ aditaye turāya sādha divaḥ jāta-vedaḥ cikitvān
r̥tena r̥tam ni-yatam īl̥e ā goḥ āmā sacā madhu-mat pakvam agne kr̥ṣṇā satī ruśatā dhāsinā eṣā jāmaryeṇa payasā ppy
r̥tenaḥ hi sma vr̥ṣabhaḥ cit aktaḥ pumān agniḥ payasā pr̥ṣṭyena aspandamānaḥ acarat vayaḥ-dhāḥ vr̥ṣā śukram duduhe pr̥śniḥ ūdhaḥ
r̥tena adrim vi asan bhidantaḥ sam aṅgirasaḥ navanta go--bhiḥ śunam naraḥ pari sadan uṣasam āviḥ svaḥ abhavat jāte agnau
r̥tena devīḥ amr̥tāḥ amr̥ktāḥ arṇaḥ-bhiḥ āpaḥ madhumat-bhiḥ agne vājī na sargeṣu pra-stubhānaḥ pra sadam it sravitave dadhanyuh
mā kasya yakṣam sadam it huraḥ gāḥ mā veśasya pra-minataḥ mā āpeḥ mā bhrātuḥ agne anr̥joḥ r̥ṇam veḥ mā sakhyuḥ dakṣam ripoḥ bhujema
rakṣāṇaḥ agne tava rakṣaṇebhiḥ rarakṣāṇaḥ su-makha prīṇānaḥ prati sphura vi ruja vīl̥u aṁhaḥ jahi rakṣaḥ mahi cit vavr̥dhānam
ebhiḥ bhava su-manāḥ agne arkaiḥ imān spr̥śa manma-bhiḥ śūra vājān uta brahmāṇi aṅgiraḥ juṣasva sam te śastiḥ devavātā jareta
etā viśvā viduṣe tubhyam vedhaḥ nīthāni agne niṇyā vacāṁsi ni-vacanā kavaye kāvyāni aśaṁsiṣam mati-bhiḥ vipraḥ ukthaiḥ
kr̥ṇuṣva pājaḥ pra-sitim na pr̥thvīm yāhi rājāiva ama-vān ibhena tr̥ṣvīm anu pra-sitim drūṇānaḥ astā asi vidhya rakṣasaḥ tapiṣṭhaiḥ
tava bhramāsaḥ āśu-yā patanti anu spr̥śa dhr̥ṣatā śośucānaḥ tapāūṁṣi agne juhvā pataṅgān asam-ditaḥ vi sr̥ja viṣvak ulkāḥ
prati spaśaḥ vi sr̥ja tūrṇi-tamaḥ bhava pāyuḥ viśaḥ asyāḥ adabdhaḥ yaḥ naḥ dūre agha-śaṁsaḥ yaḥ anti agne mākiḥ te vyathiḥ ā dadharṣīt
ut agne tiṣṭha prati ā tanuṣva ni amitrān oṣatāt tigma-hete yaḥ naḥ arātim sam-idhāna cakre nīcā tam dhakṣi atasam na śuṣkam
ūrdhvaḥ bhava prati vidhya adhi asmat āviḥ kr̥ṇuṣva daivyāni agne ava sthirā tanuhi yātu-jūnām jāmim ajāmim pra mr̥ṇīhi śatrūn
saḥ te jānāti su-matim yaviṣṭha yaḥ īvate brahmaṇe gātum airat viśvāni asmai su-dināni rāyaḥ dyumnāni aryaḥ vi duraḥ abhi dyaut
saḥ it agne astu su-bhagaḥ su-dānuḥ yaḥ tvā nityena haviṣā yaḥ ukthaiḥ piprīṣati sve āyuṣi duroṇe viśvā it asmai su-dinā sā asat iṣṭiḥ
arcāmi te su-matim ghoṣi arvāk sam te vavātā jaratām iyam gīḥ su-aśvāḥ tvā su-rathāḥ marjayema asme iti kṣatrāṇi dhārayeḥ anu dyūn
iha tvā bhūri ā caret upa tman doṣāvastaḥ dīdivāṁsam anu dyūn krīl̥antaḥ tvā su-manasaḥ sapema abhi dyumnā tasthivāṁsaḥ janānām
yaḥ tvā su-aśvaḥ su-hiraṇyaḥ agne upa-yāti vasu-matā rathena tasya trātā bhavasi tasya sakhā yaḥ te ātithyam ānuṣak jujoṣat
mahaḥ rujāmi bandhutā vacaḥ-bhiḥ tat mā pituḥ gotamāt anu iyāya tvam naḥ asya vacasaḥ cikiddhi hotaḥ yaviṣṭha sukrato itisu-krato damūnāḥ
asvapna-jaḥ taraṇayaḥ su-śevāḥ atandrāsaḥ avr̥kāḥ aśramiṣṭhāḥ te pāyavaḥ sadhryañcaḥ ni-sadya agne tava naḥ pāntu amūra
ye pāyavaḥ māmateyam te agne paśyantaḥ andham duḥ-itāt arakṣan rarakṣa tān su-kr̥taḥ viśva-vedāḥ dipsantaḥ it ripavaḥ na aha debhuḥ
tvayā vayam sadhanyaḥ tvāūtāḥ tava pra-nītī aśyāma vājān ubhā śaṁsā sūdaya satya-tāte anuṣṭhuyā kr̥ṇuhi ahrayāṇa
ayā te agne sam-idhā vidhema prati stomam śasyamānam gr̥bhāya daha aśasaḥ rakṣasaḥ pāhi asmān druhaḥ nidaḥ mitra-mahaḥ avadyāt
vaiśvānarāya mīl̥huṣe sa-joṣāḥ kathā dāśema agnaye br̥hat bhāḥ anūnena br̥hatā vakṣathena upa stabhāyat upa-mit na rodhaḥ
mā nindata yaḥ imām mahyam rātim devaḥ dadau maryāya sva-dhāvān pākāya gr̥tsaḥ amr̥taḥ vi-cetāḥ vaiśvānaraḥ nr̥-tamaḥ yahvaḥ agniḥ
sāma dvi-barhāḥ mahi tigma-bhr̥ṣṭiḥ sahasra-retāḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ tuviṣmān padam na goḥ apa-gūl̥ham vividvān agniḥ mahyam pra it oṁ iti vocat manīṣām
pra tān agniḥ babhasat tigma-jambhaḥ tapiṣṭhena śociṣā yaḥ su-rādhāḥ pra ye minanti varuṇasya dhāma priyā mitrasya cetataḥ dhruvāṇi
abhrātaraḥ na yoṣaṇaḥ vyantaḥ pati-ripaḥ na janayaḥ duḥ-evāḥ pāpāsaḥ santaḥ anr̥tāḥ asatyāḥ idam padam ajanata gabhīram
idam me agne kiyate pāvaka āminate gurum bhāram na manma br̥hat dadhātha dhr̥ṣatā gabhīram yahvam pr̥ṣṭham prayasā sapta-dhātu
tam it nu eva samanā samānam abhi kratvā punatī dhītiḥ aśyāḥ sasasya carman adhi cāru pr̥śneḥ agne rupaḥ arupitam jabāru
pra-vācyam vacasaḥ kim me asya guhā hitam upa niṇik vadanti yat usriyāṇām apa vāḥ-iva vran pāti priyam rupaḥ agram padam veḥ
idam oṁ iti tyat mahi mahām anīkam yat usriyā sacata pūrvyam gauḥ r̥tasya pade adhi dīdyānam guhā raghu-syat raghu-yat viveda
adha dyutānaḥ pitroḥ sacā āsā amanuta guhyam cāru pr̥śneḥ mātuḥ pade parame anti sat goḥ vr̥ṣṇaḥ śociṣaḥ pra-yatasya jihvā
r̥tam voce namasā pr̥cchyamānaḥ tava āśasā jāta-vedaḥ yadi idam tvam asya kṣayasi yat ha viśvam divi yat oṁ iti draviṇam yat pr̥thivyām
kim naḥ asya draviṇam kat ha ratnam vi naḥ vocaḥ jāta-vedaḥ ci kitvān guhā adhvanaḥ paramam yat naḥ asya reku padam na ni-dānāḥ aganma
kā maryādā vayunā kat ha vāmam accha gamema raghavaḥ na vājam kadā naḥ devīḥ amr̥tasya patnīḥ sūraḥ varṇena tatanan uṣasaḥ
anireṇa vacasā phalgvena pratītyena kr̥dhunā atr̥pāsaḥ adha te agne k im iha vadanti anāyudhāsaḥ āsatā sacantām
asya śriye sam-idhānasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ vasoḥ anīkam dame ā ruroca ruśat vasānaḥ sudr̥śīka-rūpaḥ kṣitiḥ na rāyā puru-vāraḥ adyaut
ūrdhvaḥ oṁ iti su ṇaḥ adhvarasya hotaḥ agne tiṣṭha deva-tātā yajīyān tvam hi viśvam abhi asi manma pra vedhasaḥ cit tirasi manīṣām
amūraḥ hotā ni asādi vikṣu agniḥ mandraḥ vidatheṣu pra-cetāḥ ūrdhvam bhānum savitāiva aśret metāiva dhūmam stabhāyat upa dyām
yatā su-jūrṇiḥ rātinī ghr̥tācī pra-dakṣiṇit deva-tātim urāṇaḥ ut oṁ iti svaruḥ nava-jāḥ na akraḥ paśvaḥ anakti su-dhitaḥ su-mekaḥ
stīrṇe barhiṣi sam-idhāne agnau ūrdhvaḥ adhvaryuḥ jujuṣāṇaḥ asthāt pari agniḥ paśu-pāḥ na hotā tri-viṣṭi eti pra-divaḥ urāṇaḥ
pari tmanā mita-druḥ eti hotā agniḥ mandraḥ madhu-vacāḥ r̥ta-vā dravanti asya vājinaḥ na śokāḥ bhayante viśvā bhuvanā yat abhrāṭ
bhadrā te agne su-anīka sam-dr̥k ghorasya sataḥ viṣuṇasya cāruḥ na yat te śociḥ tamasā varanta na dhvasmānaḥ tanvi repaḥ ā dhuri ti
na yasya sātuḥ janitoḥ avāri na mātarāpitarā nu cit iṣṭau adha mitraḥ na su-dhitaḥ pāvakaḥ agniḥ dīdāya mānuṣīṣu vikṣu
dviḥ yam pañca jījanan sam-vasānāḥ svasāraḥ agnim mānuṣīṣu vi kṣu uṣaḥ-budham atharyaḥ na dantam śukram su-āsam paraśum na t igmam
tava tye agne haritaḥ ghr̥ta-snāḥ rohitāsaḥ r̥ju-añcaḥ su-añcaḥ aruṣāsaḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ r̥ju-muṣkāḥ ā deva-tātim ahvanta dasmāḥ
ye ha tye te sahamānāḥ ayāsaḥ tveṣāsaḥ agne arcayaḥ caranti śyenāsaḥ na duvasanāsaḥ artham tuvi-svaṇasaḥ mārutam na śardhaḥ
akāri brahma sam-idhāna tubhyam śaṁsāti uktham yajate vi oṁ iti dhāḥ hotāram agnim manuṣaḥ ni seduḥ namasyantaḥ uśijaḥ śaṁsam āyoḥ
ayam iha prathamaḥ dhāyi dhātr̥-bhiḥ hotā yajiṣṭhaḥ adhvareṣu īḍyaḥ yam apnavānaḥ bhr̥gavaḥ vi-rurucuḥ vaneṣu citram vi-bhvam viśe--viśe
agne kadā te ānuṣak bhuvat devasya cetanam adha hi tvā jagr̥bhrire matārsaḥ vikṣu īḍyam
r̥ta-vānam vi-cetasam paśyantaḥ dyām-iva str̥-bhiḥ viśveṣām adhvarāṇām haskartāram dame--dame
āśum dūtam vivasvataḥ viśvāḥ yaḥ carṣaṇīḥ abhi ā jabhruḥ ketum āyavaḥ bhr̥gavāṇam viśe--viśe
tam īm hotāram ānuṣak cikitvāṁsam ni sedire raṇvam pāvaka-śociṣam yajiṣṭham sapta dhāma-bhiḥ
tam śaśvatīṣu mātr̥ṣu vane ā vītam aśritam citram santam guhā hitam su-vedam kūcit-arthinam
sasasya yat vi-yutā sasmin ūdhan r̥tasya dhāman raṇayanta devāḥ mahān agniḥ namasā rāta-havyaḥ veḥ adhvarāya sadam it r̥ta-vā
veḥ adhvarasya dūtyāni vidvān ubhe iti antariti rodasī iti sam-cikitvān dūtaḥ īyase pra-divaḥ urāṇaḥ viduḥ-taraḥ divaḥ ārodhanāni
kr̥ṣṇam te ema ruśataḥ puraḥ bhāḥ cariṣṇu arciḥ vapuṣām it ekam yat apra-vītā dadhate ha garbham sadyaḥ cit jātaḥ bhavasi it oṁ iti dūtaḥ
sadyaḥ jātasya dadr̥śānam ojaḥ yat asya vātaḥ anu-vāti śociḥ vr̥ṇakti tigmām ataseṣu jihvām sthirā cit annā dayate vi jambhaiḥ
tr̥ṣu yat annā tr̥ṣuṇā vavakṣa tr̥ṣum dūtam kr̥ṇute yahvaḥ agniḥ vātasya mel̥im sacate ni-jūrvan āśum na vājayate hinve arvā
dūtam vaḥ viśva-vedasam havya-vāham amartyam yajiṣṭham r̥ñjase girā
saḥ hi veda vasu-dhitim mahān ārodhanam divaḥ saḥ devān ā iha vakṣati
saḥ veda devaḥ ānamam devān r̥ta-yate dame dāti priyāṇi cit vasu
saḥ hotā saḥ it oṁ iti dūtyam cikitvān antaḥ īyate vidvān ārodhanam divaḥ
te syāma ye agnaye dadāśuḥ havya-dātibhiḥ ye īm puṣyantaḥ indhate
te rāyā te su-vīryaiḥ sasa-vāṁsaḥ vi śr̥ṇvire ye agnā dadhire duvaḥ
asme iti rāyaḥ dive--dive sam carantu puru-spr̥haḥ asme iti vājāsaḥ īratām
saḥ vipraḥ carṣaṇīnām śavasā mānuṣāṇām ati kṣiprāiva vidhyati
agne mr̥l̥a mahān asi yaḥ īm ā deva-yum janam iyetha barhiḥ āsadam
saḥ mānuṣīṣu duḥ-dabhaḥ vikṣu pra-avīḥ amartyaḥ dūtaḥ viśveṣām bhuvat
saḥ sadma pari nīyate hotā mandraḥ diviṣṭiṣu uta potā ni sīdati
uta gnāḥ agniḥ adhvare uto iti gr̥ha-patiḥ dame uta brahmā ni sīdati
veṣi hi adhvari-yatām upa-vaktā janānām havyā ca mānuṣāṇām
veṣi it oṁ iti asya dūtyam yasya jujoṣaḥ adhvaram havyam martasya vol̥have
asmākam joṣi adhvaram asmākam yajñam aṅgiraḥ asmākam śr̥ṇudhi havam
pari te duḥ-dabhaḥ rathaḥ asmān aśnotu viśvataḥ yena rakṣasi dāśuṣaḥ
agne tam adya aśvam na stomaiḥ kratum na bhadram hr̥di-spr̥śam r̥dhyāma te ohaiḥ
adha hi agne kratoḥ bhadrasya dakṣasya sādhoḥ rathīḥ r̥tasya br̥hataḥ babhūtha
ebhiḥ naḥ arkaiḥ bhava naḥ arvāṅ svaḥ ṇa jyotiḥ agne viśvebhiḥ su-manāḥ anīkaiḥ
ābhiḥ te adya gīḥ-bhiḥ gr̥ṇantaḥ agne dāśema pra te divaḥ na stanayanti śuṣmāḥ
tava svādiṣṭhā agne sam-dr̥ṣṭiḥ idā cit ahnaḥ idā cit aktoḥ śriye rukmaḥ na rocate upāke
ghr̥tam na pūtam tanūḥ arepāḥ śuci hiraṇyam tat te rukmaḥ na rocata svadhāvaḥ
kr̥tam cit hi sma sanemi dveṣaḥ agne inoṣi martāt itthā yajamānāt r̥ta-vaḥ
śivā naḥ sakhyā santu bhrātrā agne deveṣu yuṣme iti sā naḥ nābhiḥ sadane sasmin ūdham
bhadram te agne sahasin anīkam upāke ā rocate sūryasya ruśat dr̥śe dadr̥śe nakta-yā cit arūkṣitam dr̥śe ā rūpe annam
vi sāhi agne gr̥ṇate manīṣām kham vepasā tuvi-jāta stavānaḥ viśvebhiḥ yat vavanaḥ śukra devaiḥ tat naḥ rāsva su-mahaḥ bhūri manma
tvat agne kāvyā tvam manīṣāḥ tvat ukthā jāyante rādhyāni tvat eti draviṇam vīra-peśāḥ itthādhiye dāśuṣe martyāya
tvat vājī vājam-bharaḥ vi-hāyāḥ abhiṣṭi-kr̥t jāyate satya-śuṣmaḥ tvat rayiḥ deva-jūtaḥ mayaḥ-bhuḥ tvat āśuḥ jūju-vān agne arvā
tvām agne prathamam deva-yantaḥ devam bhartā amr̥ta mandra-jihvam dveṣaḥ-yutam ā vivāsanti dhībhiḥ damūnasam gr̥ha-patim amūram
āre asmat amatim āre aṁhaḥ āre viśvām duḥ-matim yat ni-pāsi doṣā śivaḥ sahasaḥ sūno iti agne yam devaḥ ā cit sacase svasti
yaḥ tvām agne inadhate yata-sruk triḥ te annam kr̥ṇavat sasmin ahan saḥ su dyumnaiḥ abhi astu pra-sakṣat tava kratvā jāta-vedaḥ cikitvān
idhmam yaḥ te jabharat śaśramāṇaḥ mahaḥ agne anīkam ā saparyan saḥ idhānaḥ prati doṣām uṣasam puṣyan rayim sacate ghnan amitrān
agniḥ āśe br̥hataḥ kṣatriyasya agniḥ vājasya paramasya rāyaḥ dadhāti ratnam vidhate yaviṣṭhaḥ vi ānuṣak martyāya svadhāvān
yat cit hi te puruṣa-trā yaviṣṭha acitti-bhiḥ cakr̥ma kat cit āgaḥ kr̥dhi su asmān aditeḥ anāgān vi enāṁsi śiśrathaḥ viṣvak agne
mahaḥ cit agne enasaḥ abhīke ūrvāt devānām uta martyānām mā te sakhāyaḥ sadam it riṣāma yaccha tokāya tanayāya śam yoḥ
yathā ha tyat vasavaḥ gauryam cit padi sitām amuñcata yajatrāḥ evo iti su asmat muñcata vi aṁhaḥ pra tāri agne pra-taram naḥ āyuḥ
prati agniḥ uṣasām agram akhyat vi-bhātīnām su-manāḥ ratna-dheyam yātam aśvinā su-kr̥taḥ duroṇam ut sūryaḥ jyotiṣā devaḥ eti
ūrdhvam bhānum savitā devaḥ aśret drapsam davidhvat go--iṣaḥ na satvā anu vratam varuṇaḥ yanti mitraḥ yat sūryam divi ārohayanti
yam sīm akr̥ṇvan tamase vi-pr̥ce dhruva-kṣemāḥ anava-syantaḥ atharm tam sūryam haritaḥ sapta yahvīḥ spaśam viśvasya jagataḥ vahanti
vahiṣṭebhiḥ vi-haran yāsi tantum ava-vyayan asitam deva vasma davidhvataḥ raśmayaḥ sūryasya carma-iva ava adhuḥ tamaḥ ap-su antariti
anāyataḥ ani-baddhaḥ kathā ayam nyaṅ uttānaḥ ava padyate na kayā yāti svadhayā kaḥ dadarśa divaḥ skambhaḥ sam-r̥taḥ pāti nākam
prati agniḥ uṣasaḥ jāta-vedāḥ akhyat devaḥ rocamānāḥ mahaḥ-bhiḥ ā nāsatyā uru-gāyā rathena imam yajñam upa naḥ yātam accha
ūrdhvam ketum savitā devaḥ aśret jyotiḥ viśvasmai bhuvanāya kr̥ṇvan ā aprāḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti antarikṣam vi sūryaḥ raśmi-bhiḥ cekitānaḥ
āvahantī aruṇīḥ jyotiṣā ā agāt mahī citrā raśmi-bhiḥ cekitānā pra-bodhayantī su-vitāya devī uṣāḥ īyate su-yujā rathena
ā vām vahiṣṭhāḥ iha te vahantu rathāḥ aśvāsaḥ uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭau ime hi vām madhu-peyāya somāḥ asmin yajñe vr̥ṣaṇā mādayethām
anāyataḥ ani-baddhaḥ kathā ayam nyaṅ uttānaḥ ava padyate na kayā yāti svadhayā kaḥ dadarśa divaḥ skambhaḥ sam-r̥taḥ pāti nākam
agniḥ hotā naḥ adhvare vājī san pari nīyate devaḥ deveṣu yajñiyaḥ
pari tri-viṣṭi adhvaram yāti agniḥ rathīḥ-iva ā deveṣu prayaḥ dadhat
pari vāja-patiḥ kaviḥ agniḥ havyāni akramīt dadhat ratnāni dāśuṣe
ayam yaḥ sr̥ñjaye puraḥ daiva-vāte sam-idhyate dyu-mān amitra-dambhanaḥ
asya gha vīraḥ īvataḥ agneḥ īśīta martyaḥ tigma-jambhasya mīl̥huṣaḥ
tam arvantam na sānasim aruṣam na divaḥ śiśum marmr̥jyante dive--dive
bodhat yat mā hari-bhyām kumāraḥ sāha-devyaḥ accha na hūtaḥ ut aram
uta tyā yajatā harī iti kumārāt sāhadevyāt pra-yatā sadyaḥ ā dade
eṣaḥ vām devau aśvinā kumāraḥ sāha-devyaḥ dīrgha-āyuḥ astu somakaḥ
tam yuvam devau aśvinā kumāram sāha-devyam dīrgha-āyuṣam kr̥ṇotana
ā satyaḥ yātu magha-vān r̥jīṣī dravantu asya harayaḥ upa naḥ tasmai it andhaḥ susuma su-dakṣam iha abhi-pitvam karate gr̥ṇānaḥ
ava sya śūra adhvanaḥ na ante asmin naḥ adya savane mandadhyai śaṁsāti uktham uśanāiva vedhāḥ cikituṣe asuryāya manma
kaviḥ na niṇyam vidathāni sādhan vr̥ṣā yat sekam vi-pipānaḥ arcāt divaḥ itthā jījanat sapta kārūn ahnā cit cakruḥ vayunā gr̥ṇantaḥ
svaḥ yat vedi su-dr̥śīkam arkaiḥ mahi jyotiḥ rurucuḥ yat ha vastoḥ andhā tamāṁsi dudhitā vi-cakṣe nr̥-bhyaḥ cakāra nr̥-tamaḥ abhiṣṭau
vavakṣe indraḥ amitam r̥jīṣī ubhe iti ā paprau rodasī iti mahi-tvā ataḥ cit asya mahimā vi reci abhi yaḥ viśvā bhuvanā babhūva
viśvāni śakraḥ naryāṇi vidvān apaḥ rireca sakhi-bhiḥ ni-kāmaiḥ aśmānam cit ye bibhiduḥ vacaḥ-bhiḥ vrajam go--mantam uśijaḥ vi vavruritivavruḥ
apaḥ vr̥tram vavri-vāṁsam parā ahan pra āvat te vajram pr̥thivī sa-cetāḥ pra arṇāsi samudriyāṇi ainoḥ patiḥ bhavan śavasā śūra dhr̥ṣṇo iti
apaḥ yat adrim puru-hūta dardaḥ āviḥ bhuvat saramā pūrvyam te saḥ naḥ netā vājam ā darṣi bhūrim gotrā rujan aṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ gr̥ṇānaḥ
accha kavim nr̥-manaḥ gāḥ abhiṣṭau svaḥ-sātā magha-van nādamānam ūti-bhiḥ tam iṣaṇaḥ dyumna-hūtau ni māyāvān abrahmā dasyuḥ arta
ā dasyu-ghnā manasā yāhi astam bhuvat te kutsaḥ sakhye ni-kāmaḥ sve yonau ni sadatam sa-rūpā vi vām cikitsat r̥ta-cit ha nārī
yāsi kutsena sa-ratham avasyuḥ todaḥ vātasya haryoḥ īśānaḥ r̥jrā vājam na gadhyam yuyūṣan kaviḥ yat ahan pāryāya bhūṣāt
kutsāya śuṣṇam aśuṣam ni barhīḥ pra-pitve ahnaḥ kuyavam sahasrā sadyaḥ dasyūn pra mr̥ṇa kutsyena pra sūraḥ cakram vr̥hatāt abhīke
tvam piprum mr̥gayam śūśu-vāṁsam r̥jiśvane vaidathināya randhīḥ pañcāśat kr̥ṣṇā ni vapaḥ sahasrā ātkam na puraḥ jarimā vi dardaḥ
sūraḥ upāke tanvam dadhānaḥ vi yat te ceti amr̥tasya varpaḥ mr̥gaḥ na hastī taviṣīm uṣāṇaḥ siṁhaḥ na bhīmaḥ āyudhāni babhrat
indram kāmāḥ vasu-yantaḥ agman svaḥ mīl̥he na savane cakānāḥ śravasyavaḥ śaśamānāsaḥ ukthaiḥ okaḥ na raṇvā sudr̥śī-iva puṣṭiḥ
tam it vaḥ indram su-havam huvema yaḥ tā cakāra naryā purūṇi yaḥ māvate jaritre gadhyam cit makṣu vājam bharati spārha-rādhāḥ
tigmā yat antaḥ aśaniḥ patāti kasmin cit śūra muhuke janānām ghorā yat arya sam-r̥tiḥ bhavāti adha sma naḥ tanvaḥ bodhi gopāḥ
bhuvaḥ avitā vāma-devasya dhīnām bhuvaḥ sakhā avr̥kaḥ vāja-sātau tvām anu pra-matim ā jaganma uru-śaṁsaḥ jaritre viśvadha syāḥ
ebhiḥ nr̥-bhiḥ indra tvāyu-bhiḥ tvā maghavat-bhiḥ magha-van viśve ājau dyāvaḥ na dyumnaiḥ abhi santaḥ aryaḥ kṣapaḥ madema śaradaḥ ca pūrvīḥ
eva it indrāya vr̥ṣabhāya vr̥ṣṇe brahma akarma bhr̥gavaḥ na ratham nu cit yathā naḥ sakhyā vi-yoṣat asat naḥ ugraḥ avitā tanū-pāḥ
nu stutaḥ indra nu gr̥ṇānaḥ iṣam jaritre nadyaḥ na pīperitipīpeḥ akāri te hari-vaḥ brahma navyam dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
tvam mahān indra tubhyam ha kṣāḥ anu kṣatram maṁhanā manyata dyauḥ tvam vr̥tram śavasā jaghanvān sr̥jaḥ sindhūn ahinā jagrasānān
tava tviṣaḥ janiman rejata dyauḥ rejat bhūmiḥ bhiyasā svasya manyoḥ r̥ghāyanta su-bhvaḥ parvatāsaḥ ārdan dhanvāni sarayante āpaḥ
bhinat girim śavasā vajram iṣṇan āviḥ-kr̥ṇvānaḥ sahasānaḥ ojaḥ vadhīt vr̥tram vajreṇa mandasānaḥ saran āpaḥ javasā hata-vr̥ṣṇīḥ
su-vīraḥ te janitā manyata dyauḥ indrasya kartā svapaḥ-tamaḥ bhūt yaḥ īm jajāna svaryam su-vajram anapa-cyutam sadasaḥ na bhūma
yaḥ ekaḥ it cyāvayati pra bhūmā rājā kr̥ṣṭīnām puru-hūtaḥ indraḥ satyam enam anu viśve madanti rātim devasya gr̥ṇataḥ maghonaḥ
satrā somāḥ abhavan asya viśve satrā madāsaḥ br̥hataḥ madiṣṭhāḥ satrā abhavaḥ vasu-patiḥ vasūnām datre viśvāḥ adhithāḥ indra kr̥ṣṭīḥ
tvam adha prathamam jāyamānaḥ ame viśvāḥ adhithāḥ indra kr̥ṣṭīḥ tvam prati pra-vataḥ āśayānam ahim vajreṇa magha-van vi vr̥ścaḥ
satrāhanan dadhr̥ṣim tumram indram mahām apāram vr̥ṣabham su-vajram hantā yaḥ vr̥tram sanitā uta vājam dātā maghāni magha-vā su-rādhāḥ
ayam vr̥taḥ cātayate sam-īcīḥ yaḥ ājiṣu magha-vā śr̥ṇve ekaḥ ayam vājam bharati yam sanoti asya priyāsaḥ sakhye syāma
ayam śr̥ṇve adha jayan uta ghnan ayam uta pra kr̥ṇute yudhā gāḥ yadā satyam kr̥ṇute manyum indraḥ viśvam dr̥l̥ham bhayate ejat asmāt
sam indraḥ gāḥ ajayat sam hiraṇyā sam aśviyā magha-vā yaḥ ha pūrvīḥ ebhiḥ nr̥-bhiḥ nr̥-tamaḥ asya śākaiḥ rāyaḥ vi-bhaktā sam-bharaḥ ca vasvaḥ
kiyat svit indraḥ adhi eti mātuḥ kiyat pituḥ janituḥ yaḥ jajāna yaḥ asya śuṣmam muhukaiḥ iyarti vātaḥ na jūtaḥ stanayat-bhiḥ abhraiḥ
kṣiyantam tvam akṣiyantam kr̥ṇoti iyarti reṇum magha-vā sam-oham vi--bhañjanuḥ aśanimān-iva dyauḥ uta stotāram magha-vā vasau dhāt
ayam cakram iṣaṇat sūryasya ni etaśam rīramat sasr̥māṇam ā kr̥ṣṇaḥ īm juhurāṇaḥ jigharti tvacaḥ budhne rajasaḥ asya yonau
asiknayām yajamānaḥ na hotā
gavyantaḥ indram sakhyāya viprāḥ aśva-yantaḥ vr̥ṣaṇam vājayantaḥ jani-yantaḥ jani-dām akṣita-ūtim ā cyavayāmaḥ avate na kośam
trātā naḥ bodhi dadr̥śānaḥ āpiḥ abhi-khyātā marḍitā somyānām sakhā pitā pitr̥-tamaḥ pitr̥r̥ṇām kartā īm oṁ iti lokam uśate vayaḥ-dhāḥ
sakhi-yatām avitā bodhi sakhā gr̥ṇānaḥ indra stuvate vayaḥ dhāḥ vayam hi ā te cakr̥ma sa-bādhaḥ ābhiḥ śamībhiḥ mahayantaḥ indra
stutaḥ indraḥ magha-vā yat ha vr̥trā bhūrīṇi ekaḥ apratīni hanti asya priyaḥ jaritā yasya śarman nakiḥ devāḥ vārayante na martāḥ
eva naḥ indraḥ magha-vā vi-rapśī karat satyā carṣaṇi-dhr̥t anavār tvam rājā januṣām dhehi asme iti adhi śravaḥ māhinam yat jaritre
nu stutaḥ indra nu gr̥ṇānaḥ iṣam jaritre nadyaḥ na pīperitipīpeḥ akāri te hari-vaḥ brahma navyam dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
ayam panthāḥ anu-vittaḥ purāṇaḥ yataḥ devāḥ ut-ajāyanta viśve ataḥ cit ā janiṣīṣṭa pra-vr̥ddhaḥ mā mātaram amuyā pattave karitikaḥ
na aham ataḥ niḥ aya duḥ-gahā etat tiraścatā pārśvāt niḥ gamāni bahūni me akr̥tā kartvāni yudhyai tvena sam tvena pr̥cchai
parāyatīm mātaram anu acaṣṭa na na anu gāni anu nu gamāni tvaṣṭuḥ gr̥he apibat somam indraḥ śata-dhanyam camvoḥ sutasya
kim saḥ r̥dhak kr̥ṇavat yam sahasram māsaḥ jabhāra śaradaḥ ca pūrvīḥ nahī nu āsya prati-mānam asti antaḥ jateṣu uta ye jani-tvāḥ
avadyam-iva manyamānā guhā akaḥ indram mātā vīryeṇa ni-r̥ṣtam atha ut asthāt svayam atkam vasānaḥ ā rodasī iti apr̥ṇāt jāyamānaḥ
etāḥ arṣanti alalābhavantīḥ r̥tavarīḥ-iva sam-krośamānāḥ etāḥ vi pr̥ccha kim idam bhananti kam āpaḥ adrim pari-dhim rujanti
kim oṁ iti svit asmai ni-vidaḥ bhananta indrasya avadyam didhiṣante āpaḥ mama etān putraḥ mahatā vadhena vr̥tram jaghanvān asr̥jat vi sindhūn
mamat cana tvā yuvatiḥ parāāsa mamat cana tvā kuṣavā jagāra mamat cit āpaḥ śiśave mamr̥ḍyuḥ mamat cit indraḥ sahasā ut atiṣṭhat
mamat cana te magha-van vi-aṁsaḥ ni-vividhvān apa hanūiti jaghāna adha ni-viddhaḥ ut-taraḥ babhūvān śiraḥ dāsasya sam piṇak vadhena
gr̥ṣṭiḥ sāsūva sthaviram tavāgām anādhr̥ṣyam vr̥ṣabham tumram indram arīl̥ham vatsam carathāya mātā svayam gātum tanve icchamānam
uta mātā mahiṣam anu avenat amī iti tvā jahati putra devāḥ atha abravīt vr̥tram indraḥ haniṣyan sakhe viṣṇo iti vi-taram vi kramasva
kaḥ te mātaram vidhavām acakrat śayum kaḥ tvām ajighāṁsat carantam kaḥ te devaḥ adhi mārḍīke āsīt yat pra akṣiṇāḥ pitaram pāda-gr̥hya
avartyā śunaḥ āntrāṇi pece na deveṣu vivide marḍitāram apaśyam jāyām amahīyamānām adha me śyenaḥ madhu ā jabhāra
eva tvām indra vajrin atra viśve devāsaḥ su-havāsaḥ ūmāḥ mahām ubhe iti rodasī iti vr̥ddham r̥ṣvam niḥ ekam it gr̥ṇate vr̥tra-hatye
ava asr̥janta jivrayaḥ na devāḥ bhuvaḥ sam-rāṭ indra satya-yoni ḥ ahan ahim pari-śayānam arṇaḥ pra vartanīḥ aradaḥ viśva-dhenāḥ
atr̥pṇuvantam vi-yatam abudhyam abudhyamānam susupāṇam indra sapta prati pra-vataḥ āśayānam ahim vajreṇa vi riṇāḥ aparvan
akṣodayat śavasā kṣāma budhnam vāḥ na vātaḥ taviṣībhiḥ indraḥ dr̥l̥hāni aubhnāt uśamānaḥ ojaḥ ava abhinat kakubhaḥ parvatānām
abhi pra dadruḥ janayaḥ na garbham rathāḥ-iva pra yayuḥ sākam adrayaḥ atarpayaḥ vi-sr̥taḥ ubjaḥ ūrmīn tvam vr̥tān ariṇāḥ indra sindhūn
tvam mahīm avanim viśva-dhenām turvītaye vayyāya kṣarantīm aramayaḥ namasā ejat arṇaḥ su-taraṇān akr̥ṇoḥ indra sindhūn
pra agruvaḥ nabhanvaḥ na vakvaaḥ dhvasrāḥ apinvat yuvatīḥ r̥ta-jñāḥ dhanvāni ajrān apr̥ṇak tr̥ṣāṇān adhok indraḥ staryaḥ dam-supatnīḥ
pūrvīḥ uṣasaḥ śaradaḥ ca gūrtāḥ vr̥tram jaghanvān asr̥jat vi sindhūn pari-sthitāḥ atr̥ṇat badbadhānāḥ sīrāḥ indraḥ sravitave pr̥thivyā
vamrībhiḥ putram agruvaḥ adānam ni-veśanāt hari-vaḥ ā jabhartha v i andhaḥ akhyat ahim ādadānaḥ niḥ bhūt ukha-chit sam aranta parva
pra te pūrvāṇi karaṇāni vipra āvidvān āha viduṣe karāṁsi yathāyathā vr̥ṣṇyāni sva-gūrtā apāṁsi rājan naryā aviveṣīḥ
nu stutaḥ indra nu gr̥ṇānaḥ iṣam jaritre nadyaḥ na pīperitipīpeḥ akāri te hari-vaḥ brahma navyam dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
ā naḥ indraḥ dūrāt ā naḥ āsāt abhiṣṭi-kr̥t avase yāsat ugraḥ ojiṣṭhebhiḥ nr̥-patiḥ vajra-bāhuḥ sam-ge samat-su pr̥tanyūn
ā naḥ indraḥ hari-bhiḥ yātu accha arvācīnaḥ avase rādhase ca tiṣṭhāti vajrī magha-vā vi-rapśī imam yajñam anu naḥ vāja-sātau
imam yajñam tvam asmākam indra puraḥ dadhat saniṣyasi kratum naḥ śvaghnī-iva vajrin sanaye dhanānām tvayā vayam aryaḥ ājim jayema
uśan oṁ iti su ṇaḥ su-manāḥ upāke somasya nu su-sutasya svadhāvaḥ pāḥ indra prati-bhr̥tasya madhvaḥ sam andhasā mamadaḥ pr̥ṣṭhyena
vi yaḥ rarapśe r̥ṣi-bhiḥ navebhiḥ vr̥kṣaḥ na pakvaḥ sr̥ṇyaḥ na jetā maryaḥ na yoṣām abhi manyamānaḥ accha vivakmi puru-hūtam indram
giriḥ na yaḥ sva-tavān r̥ṣvaḥ indraḥ sanāt eva sahase jātaḥ ugraḥ ādartā vajram sthaviram na bhīmaḥ udnāiva kośam vasunā ni-r̥ṣṭam
na yasya vartā januṣā nu asti na rādhasaḥ āmarītā maghasya ut-vavr̥ṣāṇaḥ taviṣī-vaḥ ugra asmabhyam daddhi puru-hūta rāyaḥ
īkṣe rāyaḥ kṣayasya carṣaṇīnām uta vrajam apa-vartā asi gonām śikṣānaraḥ sam-itheṣu prahāvān vasvaḥ rāśim abhi-netā asi bhūrim
kayā tat śr̥ṇve śacyā śaciṣṭhaḥ yayā kr̥ṇoti muhu kā cit dr̥ṣvaḥ puru dāśuṣe vi-cayiṣṭhaḥ aṁhaḥ atha dadhāti draviṇam jaritre
mā naḥ mardhīḥ ā bhara daddhi tat naḥ pra dāśuṣe dātave bhūri yat te navye deṣṇe śaste asmin te ukthe pra bravāma vayam indra stuvantaḥ
nu stutaḥ indra nu gr̥ṇānaḥ iṣam jaritre nadyaḥ na pīperitipīpeḥ akāri te hari-vaḥ brahma navyam dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
ā yātu indraḥ avase upa naḥ iha stutaḥ sadha-māt astu śūraḥ vavr̥dhānaḥ taviṣīḥ yasya pūrvīḥ dyauḥ na kṣatram abhi-bhūti puṣyāt
tasya it iha stavatha vr̥ṣṇyāni tuvi-dyumnasya tuvi-rādhasaḥ nr̥r̥n yasya kratuḥ vidathyaḥ na sam-rāṭ sahvān tarutraḥ abhi asti kr̥ṣṭīḥ
ā yātu indraḥ divaḥ ā pr̥thivyāḥ makṣu samudrāt uta vā purīṣāt svaḥ-narāt avase naḥ marutvān parāvataḥ vā sadanāt r̥tasya
sthūrasya rāyaḥ br̥hataḥ yaḥ īśe tam oṁ iti stavāma vidatheṣu indram yaḥ vāyunā jayati go--matīṣu pra dhr̥ṣṇu-yā nayati vasyaḥ accha
upa yaḥ namaḥ namasi stabhāyan iyarti vācam janayan yajadhyai r̥ñjasānaḥ puru-vāraḥ ukthaiḥ ā indram kr̥ṇvīta sadaneṣu hotā
dhiṣā yadi dhiṣaṇyantaḥ saraṇyān sadantaḥ adrim auśijasya gohe ā duroṣāḥ pāśtyasya hotā yaḥ naḥ mahān sam-varaṇeṣu vahniḥ
satrā yat im bhārvarasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ sisakti śuṣmaḥ stuvate bharāya guhā yat īm auśijasya gohe pra yat dhiye pra ayase madāya
vi yat varāṁsi parvatasya vr̥ṇve payaḥ-bhiḥ jinve apām javāṁsi vidat gaurasya gavayasya gohe yadi vājāya su-dhyaḥ vahanti
bhadrā te hastā su-kr̥tā uta pāṇī iti pra-yantārā stuvate rādhaḥ indra kā te ni-sattiḥ kim oṁ iti naḥ mamatsi kim na ut-ut oṁ iti harṣase dātavai oṁ iti
eva vasvaḥ indraḥ satyaḥ sam-rāṭ hantā vr̥tram varivaḥ pūrave karitikaḥ puru-stuta kratvā naḥ śagdhi rāyaḥ bhakṣīya te avasaḥ daivyasya
nu stutaḥ indra nu gr̥ṇānaḥ iṣam jaritre nadyaḥ na pīperitipīpeḥ akāri te hari-vaḥ brahma navyam dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
yat naḥ indraḥ jujuṣe yat ca vaṣṭi tat naḥ mahān karati śuṣmī ā cit brahma stomam magha-vā somam ukthā yaḥ aśmānam śavasā bibhrat eti
vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣandhim catuḥ-aśrim asyan ugraḥ bāhu-bhyām nr̥-tamaḥ śacī-vān śriye paruṣṇīm uṣamāṇaḥ ūrṇām yasyāḥ parvāṇi sakhyāya vivye
yaḥ devaḥ deva-tamaḥ jāyamānaḥ mahaḥ vājebhiḥ mahat-bhiḥ ca śuṣmaiḥ dadhānaḥ vajram bāhvoḥ uśantam dyām amena rejayat pra bhūma
viśvā rodhāṁsi pra-vataḥ ca pūrvīḥ dyauḥ r̥ṣvāt janiman rejata kṣāḥ ā mātarā bharati śuṣmī ā goḥ nr̥-vat pari-jman nonuvanta vātāḥ
tā tu te indra mahataḥ mahāni viśveṣu it savaneṣu pra-vācyā yat śūra dhr̥ṣṇo iti dhr̥ṣatā dadhr̥ṣvān ahim vajreṇa śavasā aviveṣīḥ
tā tu te satyā tuvi-nr̥mṇa viśvā pra dhenavaḥ sisrate vr̥ṣṇaḥ ūdhnaḥ adha ha tvat vr̥ṣa-manaḥ bhiyānāḥ pra sindhavaḥ javasā cakramanta
atra aha te hari-vaḥ tāḥ oṁ iti devīḥ avaḥ-bhiḥ indra stavanta svasāraḥ yat sīm anu pra mucaḥ badbadhānāḥ dīrghām anu pra-sitim syandayadhyai
pipīl̥e aṁśuḥ madyaḥ na sindhuḥ ā tvā śamī śaśamānasya śaktiḥ asmadryak śuśumānasya yamyāḥ āśuḥ na raśmim tuvi-ojasam goḥ
asme iti varṣiṣṭhā kr̥ṇuhi jyeṣṭhā nr̥mṇāni satrā sahure sahāṁsi asmabhyam vr̥trā su-hanāni randhi jahi vadhaḥ vanuṣaḥ martyasya
asmākam it su śr̥ṇuhi tvam indra asmabhyam citrān upa māhi vājān asmabhyam viśvāḥ iṣaṇaḥ puram-dhīḥ asmākam su magha-van bodhi godāḥ
nu stutaḥ indra nu gr̥ṇānaḥ iṣam jaritre nadyaḥ na pīperitipīpeḥ akāri te hari-vaḥ brahma navyam dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
kathā mahām avr̥dhat kasya hotuḥ yajñam juṣāṇaḥ abhi somam ūdhaḥ piban uśānaḥ juṣamāṇaḥ andhaḥ vavakṣe r̥ṣvaḥ śucate dhanāya
kaḥ asya vīraḥ sadha-mādam āpa sam ānaṁśa sumati-bhiḥ kaḥ asya kat asya citram cikite kat ūtī vr̥dhe bhuvat śaśamānasya yajyoḥ
kathā śr̥ṇoti hūyamānam indraḥ kathā śr̥ṇvan avasām asya veda kāḥ asya pūrvīḥ upa-mātayaḥ ha kathā enam āhuḥ papurim jaritre
kathā sa-bādhaḥ śaśamānaḥ asya naśat abhi draviṇam dīdhyānaḥ devaḥ bhavat navedāḥ me r̥tānām namaḥ jagr̥bhvān abhi yat jujoṣat
kathā kat asyāḥ uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭau devaḥ martasya sakhyam jujoṣa kathā kat asya sakhyam sakhi-bhyaḥ ye asmin kāmam su-yujam tatasre
kim āt amatram sakhyam sakhi-bhyaḥ kadā nu te bhrātram pra bravāma śriye su-dr̥śaḥ vapuḥ asya sargāḥ svaḥ na citra-tamam iṣe ā goḥ
duham jighāṁsam dhvarasam anindrām tetikte tigmā tujase anīkā r̥ṇā cit yatra r̥ṇa-yāḥ naḥ ugraḥ dūre ajñātāḥ uṣasaḥ babādhe
r̥tasya hi śuru-dhaḥ santi pūrvīḥ r̥tasya dhītiḥ vr̥jināni hanti r̥tasya ślokaḥ badhirā tatarda karṇā budhānaḥ śucamānaḥ āyoḥ
r̥tasya dr̥l̥hā dharuṇāni santi purūṇi candrā vapuṣe vapūṁṣi r̥tena dīrgham iṣaṇanta pr̥kṣaḥ r̥tena gāvaḥ r̥tam ā viveśuḥ
r̥tam yemānaḥ r̥tam it vanoti r̥tasya śuṣmaḥ tura-yāḥ oṁ iti gavyuḥ r̥tāya pr̥thvī iti bahuleiti gabhīre iti r̥tāya dhenū iti parame iti duhāteiti
nu stutaḥ indra nu gr̥ṇānaḥ iṣam jaritre nadyaḥ na pīperitipīpeḥ akāri te hari-vaḥ brahma navyam dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
kā su-stutiḥ śavasaḥ sūnum indram arvācīnam rādhase ā vavartat dadiḥ hi vīraḥ gr̥ṇate vasūni saḥ go--patiḥ niḥ-sidhām naḥ janāsaḥ
saḥ vr̥tra-hatye havyaḥ saḥ īḍyaḥ saḥ su-stutaḥ indraḥ satya-rādhāḥ saḥ yāman ā magha-vā martyāya brahmaṇyate suṣvaye var ivaḥ dhāt
tam it naraḥ vi hvayante sam-īke ririkvaaṁsaḥ tanvaḥ kr̥ṇvata trām mithaḥ yat tyāgam ubhyāsaḥ agman naraḥ tokasya tanayasya sātau
kratuanti kṣitayaḥ yoge ugra āśuṣāṇāsaḥ mithaḥ arṇa-sātau sam yat viśaḥ avavr̥tranta yudhmāḥ āt it neme indrayante abhīke
āt it ha neme indriyam yajante āt it paktiḥ purol̥āśam riricyāt āt it somaḥ vi papr̥cyāt asusvīn āt it jujoṣa vr̥ṣabham yajadhyai
kr̥ṇoti asmai varivaḥ yaḥ itthā indrāya somam uśate sunoti sadhrīcīnena manasā avi-venam tam it sakhāyam kr̥ṇute samat-su
yaḥ indrāya sunavat somam adya pacāt paktīḥ uta bhr̥jjāti dhānāḥ prati manāyoḥ ucathāni haryan tasmin dadhat vr̥ṣaṇam śuṣmam indraḥ
yadā sa-maryam vi acet r̥ghāvā dīrgham yat ājim abhi akhyat aryaḥ acikradat vr̥ṣaṇam patnī accha duroṇe ā ni-śitam somasut-bhiḥ
bhūyasā vasnam acarat kanīyaḥ avi-krītaḥ akāniṣam punaḥ yan saḥ bhūyasā kanīyaḥ na arirecīt dīnāḥ dakṣāḥ vi duhanti pra vāṇam
kaḥ imam daśa-bhiḥ mama indram krīṇāti dhenu-bhiḥ yadā vr̥trāṇi jaṅghanat atha enam me punaḥ dadat
nu stutaḥ indra nu gr̥ṇānaḥ iṣam jaritre nadyaḥ na pīperitipīpeḥ akāri te hari-vaḥ brahma navyam dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
kaḥ adya naryaḥ deva-kāmaḥ uśan indrasya sakhyam jujoṣa kaḥ vā mahe avase pāryāya sam-iddhe agnau suta-somaḥ īṭe
kaḥ nanāma vacasā somyāya manāyuḥ vā bhavati vaste usrāḥ kaḥ indrasya yujyam kaḥ sakhi-tvam kaḥ bhrātram vaṣṭi kavaye kaḥ ūtī
kaḥ devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīte kaḥ ādityān aditim jyotiḥ īṭe kasya aśvi nau indraḥ agniḥ sutasya aṁśoḥ pibanti manasā avi-venam
tasmai agniḥ bhārataḥ śarma yaṁsat jyok paśyāt sūryam ut-carantam yaḥ indrāya sunavāma iti āha nare naryāya nr̥-tamāya nr̥ṇām
na tam jinanti bahavaḥ na dabhrāḥ uru asmai aditiḥ śarma yaṁsat priyaḥ su-kr̥t priyaḥ indre manāyuḥ priyaḥ supra-avīḥ priyaḥ asya somī
supra-avyaḥ prāśuṣāṭ eṣaḥ vīraḥ susveḥ paktim kr̥ṇute kevalā indraḥ na asusveḥ apiḥ na sakhā na jāmiḥ duḥpra-avyaḥ ava-hantā it avācaḥ
na revatā paṇinā sakhyam indraḥ asunvatā suta-pāḥ sam gr̥ṇīte ā asya vedaḥ khidati hanti nagnam vi susvaye paktaye kevalaḥ bhūt
indram pare avare madhyamāsaḥ indram yāntaḥ ava-sitāsaḥ indram indram kṣiyantaḥ uta yudhyamānāḥ indram naraḥ vājayantaḥ havante
aham manuḥ abhavam sūryaḥ ca aham kakṣīvān r̥ṣiḥ asmi vipraḥ aham kutsam ārjuneyam ni r̥ñje aham kaviḥ uśanā paśyata mā
aham bhūmim adadām āryāya aham vr̥ṣṭim dāśuṣe martyāya aham apaḥ anayam vavaśānāḥ mama devāsaḥ anu ketam āyan
aham puraḥ mandasānaḥ vi airam nava sākam navatīḥ śambarasya śata-tamam veśyam sarva-tātā divaḥ-dāsam atithi-gvam yat āvam
pra su saḥ vi-bhyaḥ marutaḥ viḥ astu pra śyenaḥ śyenebhyaḥ āśu-patvā acakrayā yat svadhayā su-parṇaḥ havyam bharat manave deva-juṣṭam
bharat yadi viḥ ataḥ vevijānaḥ pathā uruṇā manaḥ-javāḥ asarji tūyam yayau madhunā somyena uta śravaḥ vivide śyenaḥ atra
r̥jīpī śyenaḥ dadamānaḥ aṁśum parāvataḥ śakunaḥ mandram madam somam bharat dadr̥hāṇaḥ deva-vān divaḥ amuṣmāt ut-tārāt ādāya
ādāya śyenaḥ abharat somam sahasram savān ayutam ca sākam atra puram-dhiḥ ajahāt arātīḥ made somasya mūrāḥ amūraḥ
garbhe nu san anu eṣām avedam aham devānām janimāni viśvā śatam mā puraḥ āyasīḥ arakṣan adha śyenaḥ javasā niḥ adīyam
na gha saḥ mām apa joṣam jabhāra abhi īm āsa tvakṣasā vīryeṇa īmār puram-dhiḥ ajahāt arātīḥ uta vātān atarat śūśuvānaḥ
ava yat śyenaḥ asvanīt adha dyoḥ vi yat yadi vā ataḥ ūhuḥ puram-dhim sr̥jat yat asmai ava ha kṣipat jyām kr̥śānuḥ astā manasā bhuraṇyan
r̥jipyaḥ īm indra-vataḥ na bhujyum śyenaḥ jabhāra br̥hataḥ adhi snoḥ antariti patat patatri asya parṇam adha yāmani pra-sitasya tat veḥ
adha śvetam kalaśam gobhiḥ aktam āpipyānam magha-vā śukram andhaḥ adhvaryu-bhiḥ pra-yatam madhvaḥ agram indraḥ madāya prati dhat pibadhyai śūraḥ madāya prati dhat pibadhyai
tvā yujā tava tat soma sakhye indraḥ apaḥ manave sa-srutaḥ karitikaḥ ahan ahim ariṇāt sapta sindhūn apa avr̥ṇot apihitāiva khāni
tvā yujā ni khidat sūryasya indraḥ cakram sahasā sadyaḥ indo iti adhi snunā br̥hatā vartamānam mahaḥ druhaḥ apa viśva-āyu dhāyi
ahan indraḥ adahat agniḥ indo iti purā damyūn madhyandināt abhīke duḥ-ge duroṇe kratvā na yātām puru sahasrā śarvā ni barhīt
viśvasmāt sīm adhamān indra dasyūn viśaḥ dāsīḥ akr̥ṇoḥ apra-śastāḥ abādhethām amr̥ṇatam ni śatrūn avindethām apa-citim vadhatraiḥ
eva satyam maghavānā yuvam tat indraḥ ca soma ūrvam aśvyam goḥ ā adardr̥tam api-hitāni aśnā riricathuḥ kṣāḥ cit tatr̥dānā
ā naḥ stutaḥ upa vājebhiḥ ūtī indra yāhi hari-bhiḥ mandasānaḥ ti raḥ cit aryaḥ savanā purūṇi āṅgūṣebhiḥ gr̥ṇānaḥ satya-rādhāḥ
ā hi sma yāti naryaḥ cikitvān hūyamānaḥ sotr̥-bhiḥ upa yajñam su-aśvaḥ yaḥ abhīruḥ manyamānaḥ su-svāṇebhiḥ madati sam ha vīraiḥ
śrāvaya it asya karṇā vājayadhyai juṣṭām anu pra diśam mandayadhyai ut-vavr̥ṣāṇaḥ rādhase tuviṣmān karat naḥ indraḥ su-tīrthā abhayam ca
accha yaḥ gantā nādhamānam ūtī itthā vipram havamānam gr̥ṇantam upa tmani dadhānaḥ dhuri āśūn sahasrāṇi śatāni vajra-bāhuḥ
tvāūtāsaḥ magha-van indra viprāḥ vayam te syāma sūrayaḥ gr̥ṇantaḥ bhejānāsaḥ br̥hat-divasya rāyaḥ ākāyyasya dāvane puru-kṣoḥ
nakiḥ indra tvat ut-taraḥ na jyāyān asti vr̥tra-han nakiḥ eva yathā tvam
satrā te anu kr̥ṣṭayaḥ viśvā cakrāiva vavr̥tuḥ satrā mahān asi śrutaḥ
viśve cana it anā tvā devāsaḥ indra yuyudhuḥ yat ahā naktam ā at iraḥ
yatra uta bādhitebhyaḥ cakram kutsāya yudhyate muṣāyaḥ indra sūryam
yatra devān r̥ghāyataḥ viśvān ayudhyaḥ ekaḥ it tvam indra vanūn ahan
yatra uta martyāya kam ariṇāḥ indra sūryam pra āvaḥ śacībhiḥ etaśam
kim āt uta asi vr̥tra-han magha-van manyumat-tamaḥ atra aha dānum ā atiraḥ
etat gha it uta vīryam indra cakartha paiṁsyam striyam yat duḥ-hanāyuvam vadhīḥ duhitaram divaḥ
divaḥ cit gha duhitaram mahān mahīyamānām uṣasam indra sam piṇak
apa uṣāḥ anasaḥ sarat sam-piṣṭāt aha bibhyuṣī ni yat sīm śiśnathat vr̥ṣā
etat asyāḥ anaḥ śaye su-sampiṣṭam vi-pāśi ā sasāra sīm parāvataḥ
uta sindhum vi-bālyam vi-tasthānām adhi kṣami pari sthāḥ indra māyayā
uta śuṣṇasya dhr̥ṣṇu-yā pra mr̥kṣaḥ abhi vedanam puraḥ yat asya sam-piṇak
uta dāsam kauli-taram br̥hataḥ parvatāt adhi ava ahan indra śambaram
uta dāsasya varcinaḥ sahasrāṇi śatā avadhīḥ adhi pañca pradhīn-iva
uta tyam putram agruvaḥ parāvr̥ktam śata-kratuḥ uktheṣu indraḥ ā abhajat
uta tyā turvaśāyadū iti asnātārā śacī-patiḥ indraḥ vidvān apārayat
uta tyā sadyaḥ āryā sarayoḥ indra pārataḥ arṇācitrarathā avadhīḥ
anu dvā jahitā nayaḥ andham śroṇam ca vr̥tra-han na tat te sumnam aṣṭave
śatam aśman-mayīnām purām indraḥ vi āsyat divaḥ-dāsāya dāśuṣe
asvāpayat dabhītaye sahasrā triṁśatam hathaiḥ dāsānām indraḥ māyayā
saḥ gha it uta asi vr̥tra-han samānaḥ indra go--patiḥ yaḥ tā viśvāni cicyuṣe
uta nūnam yat indriyam kariṣyāḥ indra paiṁsyam adya nakiḥ ṭat ā minat
vamam-vāmam te ādure devaḥ dadātu aryamā vāmam pūṣā vāmam bhagaḥ vāmam devaḥ karūl̥atī
kayā naḥ citraḥ ā bhuvat ūtī sadāvr̥dhaḥ sakhā kayā śaciṣṭhayā vr̥tā
kaḥ tvā satyaḥ madānām maṁhiṣṭhaḥ matsat andhasaḥ dr̥l̥hā cit āruje vasu
abhi su naḥ sakhīnām avitā jaritr̥r̥ṇām śatam bhavāsi ūti-bhiḥ
abhi naḥ ā vavr̥tsva cakram na vr̥ttam arvataḥ niyut-bhiḥ carṣaṇīnām
pra-vatā hi kratūnām ā ha padāiva gacchasi abhakṣi sūrye sacā
sam yat te indra manyavaḥ sam cakrāṇi dadhanvire adha tve iti adha sūrye
uta sma hi tvām āhuḥ it magha-vānam śacī-pate dātāram avi-dīdhayum
uta sma sadyaḥ it pari śaśamānāya sunvate puru cit maṁhase vasu
nahi sma te śatam cana rādhaḥ varante āmuraḥ na cyautnāni kariṣyataḥ
asmān avantu te śatam asmān sahasram ūtayaḥ asmān viśvāḥ abhiṣṭayaḥ
asmān iha vr̥ṇīṣva sakhyāya svastaye mahaḥ rāye divitmate
asmān aviḍḍhi viśva-hā indra rāyā parīṇasā asmān viśvābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ
asmabhyam tān apa vr̥dhi vrajān astāiva go--mataḥ navābhiḥ indra ūti-bhiḥ
asmākam dhr̥ṣṇu-yā rathaḥ dyu-mān indra anapa-cyutaḥ gavyuḥ aśvayuḥ īyate
asmākam ut-tamam kr̥dhi śravaḥ deveṣu sūrya varṣiṣṭham dyām-iva upari
ā tu naḥ indra vr̥tra-han asmākam ardham ā gahi mahān mahībhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ
bhr̥miḥ cit gha asi tūtujiḥ ā citra citriṇīṣu ā citram kr̥ṇoṣi ūtaye
dabhrebhiḥ cit śaśīyāṁsam haṁsi vrādhantam ojasā sakhi-bhiḥ ye tve iti sacā
vayam indra tve iti sacā vayam tvā abhi nonumaḥ asmān-asmān it ut ava
saḥ naḥ citrābhiḥ adri-vaḥ anavadyābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ anādhr̥ṣṭābhiḥ ā gah i
bhūyāmo iti su tvāvataḥ sakhāyaḥ indra go--mataḥ yujaḥ vājāya ghr̥ṣvaye
tvam hi ekaḥ īśiṣe indra vājasya go--mataḥ saḥ naḥ yandhi mahīm iṣam
na tvā varante anyathā yat ditsasi stutaḥ magham stotr̥-bhyaḥ indra girvaṇaḥ
abhi tvā gotamāḥ girā anūṣata pra dāvane indra vājāya ghr̥ṣvaye
pra te vocāma vīryā yāḥ mandasanaḥ ā arujaḥ puraḥ dāsīḥ abhi-itya
tā te gr̥ṇanti vedhasaḥ yāni cakartha paiṁsyā suteṣu indra girvaṇaḥ
avīvr̥dhanta gotamāḥ indra tve iti stoma-vāhasaḥ ā eṣu dhāḥ vīra-vat yaśaḥ
yat cit hi śaśvatām asi indra sādhāraṇaḥ tvam tam tvā vayam hāvāmahe
arvācīnaḥ vaso iti bhava asme iti su matsva andhasaḥ somānām indra soma-pāḥ
asmākam tvā matīnām ā stomaḥ indra yacchatu arvāk ā vartaya harī iti
purol̥āsam ca naḥ ghasaḥ joṣayāse giraḥ ca naḥ vadhūyuḥ-iva yoṣaṇām
sahasram vyatīnām yuktānām indram īmahe śatam somasya khāryaḥ
sahasrā te śatā vayam gavām ā cyāvayāmasi asma-trā rādhaḥ etu te
daśa te kalaśānām hiraṇyānām adhīmahi bhūri-dāḥ asi vr̥tra-han
bhūri-dāḥ bhūri dehi naḥ mā dabhram bhūri ā bhara bhūri gha it indra ditsasi
bhūri-dāḥ hi asi śrutaḥ puru-trā śūra vr̥tra-han ā naḥ bhajasva rādhasi
pra te babhrū iti vi-cakṣaṇa śaṁsāmi go--saṇaḥ napāt mā ābhyām gāḥ anu śiśrathaḥ
kanīnakāiva vidradhe nave dru-pade arbhake babhrū iti yāmeṣu śobheteiti
aram me usra-yāmṇe aram anusra-yāmṇe babhrū iti yāmeṣu asridhā
pra r̥bhu-bhyaḥ dūtam-iva vācam iṣye upa-stire śvaitarīm dhenum īl̥e ye vāta-jūtāḥ taraṇi-bhiḥ evaiḥ pari dyām sadyaḥ apasaḥ babhūvuḥ
yadā aram akran r̥bhavaḥ pitr̥-bhyām pari-viṣṭī veṣaṇā daṁsanābhiḥ āt it devānām upa sakhyam āyan dhīrāsaḥ puṣṭim avahan manāyai
punaḥ ye cakruḥ pitarā yuvānā sanā yūpāiva jaraṇā śayānā te vājaḥ vi-bhvā r̥bhuḥ indravantaḥ madhu-psarasaḥ naḥ avantu yajñam
yat sam-vatsam r̥bhavaḥ gām arakṣan yat sam-vatsam r̥bhavaḥ māḥ apiṁśan yat sam-vatsam abharan bhāsaḥ asyāḥ tābhiḥ śamībhiḥ amr̥ta-tvam āśuḥ
jyeṣṭhaḥ āha camasā dvā kara iti kanīyān trīn kr̥ṇavāma iti āha kan iṣṭhaḥ āha caturaḥ kara iti tvaṣṭā r̥bhavaḥ tat panayat vacaḥ vaḥ
satyam ūcuḥ naraḥ eva hi cakruḥ anu svadhām r̥bhavaḥ jagmuḥ etām vi-bhrājamānān camasān ahāiva avenat tvaṣṭā caturaḥ dadr̥śvān
dvādaśa dyūn yat agohyasya ātithye raṇan r̥bhavaḥ sasantaḥ su-kṣetrā akr̥ṇvan anayanta sindhūn dhanva ā atiṣṭhan oṣadhīḥ nimnam āpaḥ
ratham ye cakruḥ su-vr̥tam nare--sthām ye dhenum viśva-juvam viśva-rūpām te ā takṣantu r̥bhavaḥ rayim naḥ su-avasaḥ su-apasaḥ su-hastāḥ
apaḥ hi eṣām ajuṣanta devāḥ abhi kratvā manasā dīdhyānāḥ vājaḥ devānām abhavat su-karmā indrasya r̥bhukṣāḥ varuṇasya vi-bhvā
ye harī iti medhayā ukthā madantaḥ indrāya cakruḥ su-yujā ye aśvā te rāyaḥ poṣam draviṇāni asme iti dhatta r̥bhavaḥ kṣema-yantaḥ na mitram
idā ahnaḥ pītim uta vaḥ madam dhuḥ na r̥te śrāntasya sakhyāya devāḥ te nūnam asme iti r̥bhavaḥ vasūni tr̥tīye asmin savane dadhāta
r̥bhuḥ vi-bhvā vājaḥ indraḥ naḥ accha imam yajñam ratna-dheyā upa yāta idā hi vaḥ dhiṣaṇā devī ahvām adhāt pītim sam madāḥ agmata vaḥ
vidānāsaḥ janmanaḥ vāja-ratnāḥ uta r̥tu-bhiḥ r̥bhavaḥ mādayadhvam sam vaḥ madāḥ agmata sam puram-dhiḥ su-vīrām asme iti rayim ā īrayadhvam
ayam vaḥ yajñaḥ r̥bhavaḥ akāri yam ā manuṣvat pra-divaḥ dadhidhve pra vaḥ accha jujuṣāṇāsaḥ asthuḥ abhūta viśve agriyā uta vājāḥ
abhūt oṁ iti vaḥ vidhate ratna-dheyam idā naraḥ dāśuṣe martyāya pibata vājāḥ r̥bhavaḥ dade vaḥ mahi tr̥tīyam savanam madāya
ā vājāḥ yāta upa naḥ r̥bhukṣāḥ mahaḥ naraḥ draviṇasaḥ gr̥ṇānāḥ ā vaḥ pītayaḥ abhi-pitve ahnām imāḥ astam navasvaḥ-iva gman
ā napātaḥ śavasaḥ yātana upa imam yajñam namasā hūyamānāḥ sa-joṣasaḥ sūrayaḥ yasya ca stha madhvaḥ pāta ratna-dhāḥ indra-vantaḥ
sa-joṣāḥ indra varuṇena somam sa-joṣāḥ pāhi girvaṇaḥ marut-bhiḥ agre--pābhiḥ r̥tu-pābhiḥ sa-joṣāḥ gnāḥpatnībhiḥ ratna-dhābhiḥ sa-joṣāḥ
sa-joṣasaḥ ādityaiḥ mādayadhvam sa-joṣasaḥ r̥bhavaḥ parvatebhiḥ sa-joṣasaḥ daivyena savitrā sa-joṣasaḥ sindhu-bhiḥ ratna-dhebhiḥ
ye asvinā ye pitarā ye ūtī dhenum tatakṣuḥ r̥bhavaḥ ye aśvā ye aṁsatrā ya r̥dhak rodasī iti ye vi-bhvaḥ naraḥ su-apatyāni cakruḥ
ye go--mantam vāja-vantam su-vīram rayim dhattha vasu-mantam puru-kṣum te agre--pāḥ r̥bhavaḥ mandasānāḥ asme iti dhatta ye ca rātim gr̥ṇanti
na apa abhūta na vaḥ atītr̥ṣāma aniḥ-śastāḥ r̥bhavaḥ yajñe asmin sam indreṇa madatha sam marut-bhiḥ sam rāja-bhiḥ ratna-dheyāya devāḥ
iha upa yāta śavasaḥ napātaḥ saudhanvanāḥ r̥bhavaḥ mā apa bhūta asmin hi vaḥ savane ratna-dheyam gamantu indram anu vaḥ madāsaḥ
ā agan r̥bhūṇām iha ratna-dheyam abhūt somasya su-sutasya pītiḥ su-kr̥tyayā yat su-apasyayā ca ekam vi-cakra camasam catuḥ-dhā
vi akr̥ṇota camasam catuḥ-dhā sakhe vi śikṣa iti abravīta atha aita vājāḥ amr̥tasya panthām gaṇam devānām r̥bhavaḥ su-hastāḥ
kim-mayaḥ svit camasaḥ eṣaḥ āsa yam kāvyena caturaḥ vi-cakra atha sunudhvam savanam madāya pāta r̥bhavaḥ madhunaḥ somyasya
śacyā akarta pitarā yuvānā śacyā akarta camasam deva-pānam śacyā harī iti dhanu-tarau ataṣṭa indra-vāhau r̥bhavaḥ vāja-ratnāḥ
yaḥ vaḥ sunoti abhi-pitve ahnām tīvram vājāsaḥ savanam madāya tasmai rayim r̥bhavaḥ sarva-vīram ā tākṣata vr̥ṣaṇaḥ mandasānāḥ
prātariti sutam apibaḥ hari-aśva mādhyandinam savanam kevalam te sam r̥bhu-bhiḥ pibasva ratna-dhebhiḥ sakhīn yān indra cakr̥ṣe su-kr̥tyā
ye devāsaḥ abhavata su-kr̥tyā śyenāḥ-iva it adhi divi ni-seda te ratnam dhāta śavasaḥ napātaḥ saudhanvanāḥ abhavata amr̥tāsaḥ
yat tr̥tīyam savanam ratna-dheyam akr̥ṇudhvam su-apasyā su-hastāḥ tat r̥bhavaḥ pari-siktam vaḥ etat sam madebhiḥ indriyebhiḥ pibadhvam
anaśvaḥ jātaḥ anabhīśuḥ ukthyaḥ rathaḥ tri-cakraḥ pari vartate rajaḥ mahat tat vaḥ devyasya pra-vācanam dyām r̥bhavaḥ pr̥thivīm yat ca puṣyatha
ratham ye cakruḥ su-vr̥tam su-cetasaḥ avi-hvarantam manasaḥ pari dhyayā tān oṁ iti nu asya savanasya pītaye ā vaḥ vājāḥ r̥bhavaḥ vedayāmasi
tat vaḥ vājāḥ r̥bhavaḥ su-pravācanam deveṣu vi-bhvaḥ abhavat mah i-tvanam jivrī iti yat santā pitarā sanājurā punaḥ yuvānā carathāya takṣatha
ekam vi cakra camasam catuḥ-vayam niḥ carmaṇaḥ gām ariṇīta dhīti-bhiḥ atha deveṣu amr̥ta-tvam ānaśa śruśṭī vājāḥ r̥bhavaḥ tat vaḥ ukthyam
r̥bhutaḥ rayiḥ prathamaśravaḥ-tamaḥ vāja-śrutāsaḥ yam ajījanan naraḥ vibhva-taṣṭaḥ vidatheṣu pra-vācyaḥ yam devāsaḥ avatha saḥ vi-carṣaṇiḥ
saḥ vājī arvā saḥ r̥ṣiḥ vacasyayā saḥ śūraḥ astā pr̥tanāsu dustaraḥ saḥ rāyaḥ poṣam saḥ su-vīryam dadhe yam vājaḥ vi-bhvā r̥bhavaḥ yam āviṣuḥ
śreṣṭham vaḥ peśaḥ adhi dhāyi darśatam stomaḥ vājāḥ r̥bhavaḥ tam jujuṣṭana dhīrāsaḥ hi stha kavayaḥ vipaḥ-citaḥ tān vaḥ enā brahmaṇā ā vedayāmasi
yūyam asmabhyam dhiṣaṇābhyaḥ pari vidvāṁsaḥ viśvā naryāṇi bhojanā dyu-mantam vājam vr̥ṣa-śuṣmam ut-tamam ā naḥ rayim r̥bhavaḥ takṣata ā vayaḥ
iha pra-jām iha rayim rarāṇāḥ iha śravaḥ vīra-vat takṣata naḥ yena vayam citayema ati anyān tam vājam citram r̥bhavaḥ dada naḥ
upa naḥ vājāḥ adhvaram r̥bhukṣāḥ devāḥ yāta pathi-bhiḥ deva-yānaiḥ yathā yajñam manuṣaḥ vikṣu āsu dadhidhve raṇvāḥ su-dineṣu ahnām
te vaḥ hrade manase santu yajñāḥ juṣṭāsaḥ adya ghr̥ta-nirnijaḥ guḥ pra vaḥ sutāsaḥ harayanta pūrṇāḥ kratve dakṣāya harṣayanta pītāḥ
tri-udāyam deva-hitam vaḥ stomaḥ vājāḥ r̥bhukṣaṇaḥ dade vaḥ juhve manuṣvat uparāsu vikṣu yuṣme iti sacā br̥hat-diveṣu somam
pīvaḥ-aśvāḥ śucat--rathāḥ hi bhūta āyaḥ-śiprāḥ vājinaḥ su-niṣkāḥ indrasya sūnaḥ śavasaḥ napātaḥ anu vaḥ ceti agriyam madāya
r̥bhum r̥bhukṣaṇaḥ rayim vāje vājin-tamam yujam indrasvantam havāmahe sadāsātamam aśvinam
saḥ it r̥bhavaḥ yam avatha yūyam indraḥ ca martyam saḥ dhībhiḥ astu sanitā medha-sātā saḥ arvatā
vi naḥ vājāḥ r̥bhukṣaṇaḥ pathaḥ citana yaṣṭave asmabhyam sūrayaḥ stutāḥ viśvāḥ āśāḥ tarīṣaṇi
tam naḥ vājāḥ r̥bhukṣaṇaḥ indra nāsatyā rayim sam aśvam carṣaṇi-bhyaḥ ā puru śasta maghattaye
uto iti hi vām dātrā santi pūrvā yā pūru-bhyaḥ trasadasyuḥ ni-tośe kṣetra-sām dādathuḥ urvarāsām ghanam dasyu-bhyaḥ abhi-bhūtim ugram
uta vājinam puruniḥ-sidhvānam dadhi-krām oṁ iti dadathuḥ viśva-kr̥ṣtim r̥jipyam śyenam pruṣita-psum āśum carkr̥tyam aryaḥ nr̥-patim na śūram
yam sīm anu pravatāiva dravantam viśvaḥ pūruḥ madati harṣamāṇaḥ paṭ-bhiḥ gr̥dhyantam medha-yum na śūram ratha-turam vātam-iva dhrajantam
yaḥ sma ārundhānaḥ gadhyā samat-su sanu-taraḥ carati goṣu gacchan āviḥ-r̥jīkaḥ vidathā ni-cikyat tiraḥ aratim pari āpaḥ āyoḥ
uta sma enam vastra-mathim na tāyum anu krośanti kṣitayaḥ bhareṣu nīcā ayamānam jasurim na śyenam śravaḥ ca accha paśu-mat ca yūtham
uta sma āsu prathamaḥ sariṣyan ni veveti śreṇi-bhiḥ rathānām srajam kr̥ṇvānaḥ janyaḥ na śubhvā reṇum rerihat kiraṇam dr̥śvān
uta syaḥ vājī sahuriḥ r̥ta-vā śuśrūṣamāṇaḥ tanvā sa-marye turam yatīṣu turayan r̥jipyaḥ adhi bhruvoḥ kirate reṇum r̥ñjan
uta sma asya tanyatoḥ-iva dyoḥ r̥ghāyataḥ abhi-yujaḥ bhayante yadā sahasram abhi sīm ayodhīt duḥ-vartuḥ sma bhavati bhīmaḥ r̥ñjan
uta sma asya panayanti janāḥ jūtim kr̥ṣṭi-praḥ abhi-bhūtim āśoḥ uta enam āhuḥ sam-ithe vi-yantaḥ parā dadhi-krāḥ asarat sahasraiḥ
ā dadhi-krāḥ śavasā pañca kr̥ṣṭīḥ sūryaḥ-iva jyotiṣāḥapaḥḥtatānaḥsahasra-sāḥḥśata-sāḥḥvājīḥarvāḥpr̥ṇaktuḥmadhvāḥsamḥimāḥvacāṁsi
āśum dadhi-krām tam oṁ iti nu stavāma divaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ uta carkirāma ucchantīḥ mām uṣasaḥ sūdayantu ati viśvāni duḥ-itāni parṣan
mahaḥ carkarmi arvataḥ kratu-prāḥ dadhi-krāvṇaḥ puru-vārasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ yam pūru-bhyaḥ dīdi-vāṁsam na agnim dadathuḥ mitrāvaruṇā taturi m
yaḥ aśvasya dadhi-krāvṇaḥ akārīt sam-iddhe agnau uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭau anāgasam tam aditiḥ kr̥ṇotu saḥ mitreṇa varuṇena sa-joṣāḥ
dadhi-krāvṇaḥ iṣaḥ ūrjaḥ mahaḥ yat amanmahi marutām nāma bhadram svastaye varuṇam mitram agnim havāmahe indram vajra-bāhum
indram-iva it ubhaye vi hvayante ut-īrāṇāḥ yajñam upa-prayantaḥ dadhi-krām oṁ iti sūdanam martyāya dadathuḥ mitrāvaruṇā naḥ aśvam
dadhi-krāvṇaḥ akāriṣam jiṣṇoḥ aśvasya vājinaḥ surabhi naḥ mukhā karat pra ṇaḥ āyūṁṣi tāriṣat
dadhi-krāvṇaḥ it oṁ iti nu cārkirāma viśvā it mām uṣasaḥ sūdayantu apām agneḥ uṣasaḥ sūryasya br̥haspateḥ āṅgirasasya jiṣṇoḥ
satvā bhariṣaḥ go--iṣaḥ duvanya-sat śravasyāt iṣaḥ uṣasaḥ turaṇya-sat satyaḥ dravaḥ dravaraḥ pataṅgaraḥ dadhi-krāvā iṣam ūjarm svaḥ janat
uta sma asya dravataḥ turaṇyataḥ parṇam na veḥ anu vāti pra-gardhinaḥ śyenasya-iva dhrajataḥ aṅkasam pari dadhi-krāvṇaḥ saha ūrjā taritrataḥ
uta syaḥ vājī kṣipaṇim turaṇyati grīvāyām baddhaḥ āpi-kakṣe āsani kratum dadhi-krāḥ anu sam-tavītvat pathām aṅkāṁsi anu āpanīphaṇat
haṁsaḥ śuci-sat vasuḥ antarikṣa-sat hotā vedi-sat atithiḥ duroṇa-sat nr̥-sat vara-sat r̥ta-sat vyoma-sat abjāḥ go--jāḥ r̥ta-jāḥ ādri-jāḥ r̥tam
indrā kaḥ vām varuṇā sumnam āpa stomaḥ haviṣmān amr̥taḥ na hotā yaḥ vām hr̥di kratu-mān asmat uktaḥ pasparśat indrāvaruṇā namasvān
indrā ha yaḥ varuṇā cakre āpī iti devau martaḥ sakhyāya prayasvān saḥ hanti vr̥trā sam-itheṣu śatrūn avaḥ-bhiḥ vā mahat-bhiḥ saḥ pra śr̥ṇve
indrā ha ratnam varuṇā dheṣṭhā itthā nr̥-bhyaḥ śaśamānebhyaḥ tā yadi sakhāyā sakhyāya somaiḥ sutebhiḥ su-prayasā mādayaiteiti
indrā yuvam varuṇā didyum asmin ojiṣṭham ugrā ni vadhiṣṭam vajram yaḥ naḥ duḥ-evaḥ vr̥katiḥ dabhītiḥ tasmin mimāthām abhi-bhūti ojaḥ
indrā yuvam varuṇā bhūtam asyāḥ dhiyaḥ pretārā vr̥ṣabhāiva dhenoḥ sā naḥ duhīyat yavasāiva gatvī sahasra-dhārā payasā mahī gauḥ
toke hite tanaye urvarāsu sūraḥ dr̥śīke vr̥ṣaṇaḥ ca paiṁsye indrā naḥ atra varuṇā syātām avaḥ-bhiḥ dasmā pari-takmyāyām
yuvām it hi avase pūrvyāya pari prabhūtī itipra-bhūtī go--iṣaḥ svāpī itisu-āpī vr̥ṇīmahe sakhyāya priyāya śūrā maṁhiṣṭhā pitarāiva śambhū itiśam-bhū
tāḥ vām dhiyaḥ avase vāja-yantīḥ ājim na jamuḥ yuva-yūḥ sudānūitisu-dānū śriye na gāvaḥ upa somam asthuḥ indram giraḥ varuṇam me manīṣāḥ
imāḥ indram varuṇam me manīṣāḥ agman upa draviṇam icchamānāḥ upa īm asthuḥ joṣṭāraḥ-iva vasvaḥ raghvīḥ-iva śravasaḥ bhikṣamāṇāḥ
aśvyasya tmanā rathyasya puṣṭeḥ nityasya rāyaḥ patayaḥ syāma tā cakrāṇau ūti-bhiḥ navyasībhiḥ asma-trā rāyaḥ ni-yutaḥ sacantām
ā naḥ br̥hantā br̥hatībhiḥ ūtī indra yātam varuṇa vāja-sātau yat didyavaḥ pr̥tanāsu pra-krīl̥ān tasya vām syāma sanitāraḥ ojaḥ
mama dvitā rāṣṭram kṣatriyasya viśva-āyoḥ viśve amr̥tāḥ yathā naḥ kratum sacante varuṇasya devāḥ rājāmi kr̥ṣṭeḥ upamasya vavreḥ
aham rājā varuṇaḥ mahyam tāni asuryāṇi prathamā dhārayanta kratum sacante varuṇasya devāḥ rājāmi kr̥ṣṭeḥ upamasya vavreḥ
iti sumeke itisu-meke tvaṣṭāiva viśvā bhuvanāni vidvān sam airayam rodasī iti dhārayam ca
aham apaḥ apinvam ukṣamāṇāḥ dharayam divam sadane r̥tasya r̥tena putraḥ aditeḥ r̥ta-vā uta tri-dhātu prathayat vi bhūma
mām naraḥ su-aśvāḥ vāja-yantaḥ mām vr̥tāḥ sam-araṇe havante kr̥ṇomi ājim magha-vā aham indraḥ iyarmi reṇum abhibhūti-ojāḥ
aham tā viśvā cakaram nakiḥ mā daivyam sahaḥ varate aprati-itam yat mā somāsaḥ mamadan yat ukthā ubhe iti bhayeteiti rajasī iti apāre iti
viduḥ te viśvā bhuvanāni tasya tā pra bravīṣi varuṇāya vedhaḥ tvam vr̥trāṇi śr̥ṇviṣe jaghanvān tvam vr̥tām ariṇāḥ indra sindhūn
asmākam atra pitaraḥ te āsan sapta r̥ṣayaḥ dauḥ-gahe badhyamāne te ā ayajanta trasadasyum asyāḥ indram na vr̥tra-turam ardha-devam
puru-kutsānī hi vām adāśat havyebhiḥ indrāvaruṇā namaḥ-bhiḥ atha rājānam trasadasyum asyāḥ vr̥tra-hanam dadathuḥ ardha-devam
rāyāḥ vayam sasa-vāṁsaḥ madema havyena devāḥ yavasena gāvaḥ tām dhenum indrāvaruṇā yuvam naḥ viśvāhā dhattam anapa-sphurantīm
kaḥ oṁ iti śravat katamaḥ yajñiyānām vandāru devaḥ katamaḥ juṣāte kasya imām devīm amr̥teṣu preṣṭhām hr̥di śreṣāma su-stutim su-havyām
kaḥ mr̥l̥āti katamaḥ āgamiṣṭhaḥ devānām oṁ itikatamaḥ śam-bhaviṣṭhaḥ ratham kam āhuḥ dravat-aśvam āśum yam sūryasya duhitā avr̥ṇīta
makṣu hi sma gacchathaḥ īvataḥ dyūn indraḥ na śaktim pari-takmyāyām divaḥ ājātā divyā su-parṇā kayā śacīnām bhavathaḥ śaciṣṭhā
kā vām bhūt upa-mātiḥ kayā naḥ ā aśvinā gamathaḥ hūyamānā kaḥ vām mahaḥ cit tyajasaḥ abhīke uruṣyatam mādhvī iti dasrā naḥ ūtī
uru vām rathaḥ pari nakṣati dyām ā yat samudrāt abhi varate vām madhvā mādhvī iti madhu vām pruṣāyan yat sīm vām pr̥kṣaḥ bhurajanta pakvaaḥ
sindhuḥ ha vām rasayā siñcat aśvān ghr̥ṇā vayaḥ aruṣāsaḥ pari gman tat oṁ iti su vām ajiram ceti yānam yena patī iti bhavathaḥ sūryāyāḥ
iha-iha yat vām samanā papr̥kṣe sā iyam asme iti su-matiḥ vāja-ratnā uruṣyatam jaritāram yuvam ha śritaḥ kāmaḥ nāsatyā yuvadrik
tam vām ratham vayam adya huvema pr̥thu-jrayam aśvinā sam-gatim goḥ yaḥ sūryām vahati vandhura-yuḥ girvāhasam puru-tamam vasu-yum
yuvam śriyam aśvinā devatā tān divaḥ napātā vanathaḥ śacībhiḥ yuvoḥ vapuḥ abhi pr̥kṣaḥ sacante vahanti yat kakuhāsaḥ rathe vām
kaḥ vām adya kārate rāta-havyaḥ ūtaye vā suta-peyāya vā arkaiḥ r̥tasya vā vanuṣe pūrvyāya namaḥ yemānaḥ aśvinā ā vavartat
hiraṇyayena purubhūitipuru-bhū rathena imam yajñam nāsatyā upa yātam pibāthaḥ it madhunaḥ somyasya dadhathaḥ ratnam vidhate janāya
ā naḥ yātam divaḥ accha pr̥thivyāḥ hiraṇyayena su-vr̥tā rathena mā vām anye ni yaman deva-yantaḥ sam yat dade nābhiḥ pūrvyā vām
nu naḥ rayim puru-vīram br̥hantam dasrā mimāthām ubhayeṣu asme iti naraḥ yat vām aśvinā stomam āvan sadha-stutim āja-mīl̥hāsaḥ agman
iha-iha yat vām samanā papr̥kṣe sā iyam asme iti su-matiḥ vāja-ratnā uruṣyatam jaritāram yuvam ha śritaḥ kāmaḥ nāsatyā yuvadrik
eṣaḥ syaḥ bhānuḥ ut iyarti yujyate rathaḥ pari-jmā divaḥ asya sānavi pr̥kṣāsaḥ asmin mithunāḥ adhi trayaḥ dr̥tiḥ turīyaḥ madhunaḥ vi rapśate
ut vām pr̥kṣāsaḥ madhu-mantaḥ īrate rathāḥ aśvāsaḥ uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭi ṣu apa-ūrṇuvantaḥ tanmaḥ ā pari-vr̥tam svaḥ na śukram tanvantaḥ ā rajaḥ
madhvaḥ pibatam madhu-pebhiḥ āsa-bhiḥ uta priyam madhune yuñjāthām ratham ā varanim madhunā jinvathaḥ pathaḥ dr̥tim vahetheiti madhu-mantam aśvinā
haṁsāsaḥ ye vām madhu-mantaḥ asridhaḥ hiraṇya-parṇāḥ uhuvaḥ uṣaḥ-budhaḥ uda-prutaḥ mandinaḥ mandi-nispr̥śaḥ madhvaḥ na makṣaḥ savanāni gacchathaḥ
su-adharāsaḥ madhu-mantaḥ agnayaḥ usrā jarante prati vastoḥ aśvi nā yat nikta-hastaḥ taraṇiḥ vi-cakṣaṇaḥ somam susāva madhu-mantam adri-bhiḥ
āke--nipāsaḥ aha-bhiḥ davidhvataḥ svaḥ na śukram tanvantaḥ ā rajaḥ sūraḥ cit aśvān yuyujānaḥ īyate viśvān anu svadhayā cetathaḥ pathaḥ
pra vām avocam aśvinā dhiyam-dhāḥ rathaḥ su-aśvaḥ ajaraḥ yaḥ asti yena sadyaḥ pari rajāṁsi yāthaḥ haviṣmantam taraṇim bhojam accha
iti diviṣṭiṣu tvam hi pūrva-pāḥ asi
śatena naḥ abhiṣṭi-bhiḥ niyutvān indra-sārathiḥ vāyo iti sutasya tr̥mpatam
ā vām sahasram harayaḥ indravāyūiti abhi prayaḥ vahantu soma-pītaye
ratham hiraṇya-vandhuram indravāyūiti su-adhvaram ā hi sthāthaḥ div i-spr̥śam
rathena pr̥thu-pājasā dāśvāṁsam upa gacchatam indravāyūiti iha ā gatam
indravāyūiti ayam sutaḥ tam devebhiḥ sa-joṣasā pibatam dāśuṣaḥ gr̥he
iha pra-yānam astu vām indravāyūiti vi-mocanam iha vām soma-pītaye
vāyo iti śukraḥ ayāmi te madhvaḥ agram diviṣṭiṣu ā yāhi soma-pītaye spārhaḥ deva niyutvatā
indraḥ ca vāyo iti eṣām somānām pītim arhathaḥ yuvām hi yanti indavaḥ nimnam āpaḥ na sadhryak
vāyo iti indraḥ ca śuṣmiṇā sa-ratham śavasaḥ patī iti niyutvantā naḥ ūtaye ā yātam soma-pītaye
yāḥ vām santi puru-spr̥haḥ ni-yutaḥ dāśuṣe narā asme iti tāḥ yajña-vāhasā indravāyūiti ni yacchatam
vihi hotrā avītāḥ vipaḥ na rāyaḥ aryaḥ vāyo iti ā candreṇe rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye
niḥ-yuvānaḥ aśastīḥ niyutvān indra-sārathiḥ vāyo iti ā candreṇe rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye
anu kr̥ṣṇe vasudhitī itivasu-dhitī yemāteiti viśva-peśasā vāyo iti ā candreṇe rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye
vahantu tvā manaḥ-yujaḥ yuktāsaḥ navatiḥ nava vāyo iti ā candreṇe rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye
vāyo iti śatam harīṇām yuvasva poṣyāṇām uta vā te sahasriṇaḥ rathaḥ ā yātu pājasā
idam vām āsye haviḥ priyam indrābr̥haspatī iti uktham madaḥ ca śasyate
ayam vām pari sicyate somaḥ indrābr̥haspatī iti cāruḥ madāya pītaye
ā naḥ indrābr̥haspatī iti gr̥ham indraḥ ca gacchatam soma-pā soma-pītaye
asme iti indrābr̥haspatī iti rayim dhattam śata-gvinam aśva-vantam sahasriṇam
indrābr̥haspatī iti vayam sute gīḥ-bhiḥ havāmahe asya somasya pītaye
somam indrābr̥haspatī iti pibatam dāśuṣaḥ gr̥he mādayethām tat-okasā
yaḥ tastambha sahasā vi jmaḥ antān br̥haspatiḥ tri-sadhasthaḥ raveṇa tam pratnāsaḥ r̥ṣayaḥ dīdhyānāḥ puraḥ viprāḥ dadhire mandra-jihvam
dhuna-itayaḥ su-praketam madantaḥ br̥haspate abhi ye naḥ tatasre pr̥ṣantam sr̥pram adabdham ūrvam br̥haspate rakṣatāt asya yonim
br̥haspate yā paramā parāvat ataḥ ā te r̥ta-spr̥śaḥ ni seduḥ tubhyam khātāḥ avatāḥ adri-dugdhāḥ madhvaḥ ścotanti abhitaḥ vi-rapśam
br̥haspatiḥ prathamam jāyamānaḥ mahaḥ jyotiṣaḥ parame vi-oman sapta-āsyaḥ tuvi-jātaḥ raveṇa vi sapta-raśmiḥ adhamat tamāṁsi
saḥ su-stubhā saḥ r̥kvatā gaṇena valam ruroja phali-gam raveṇa br̥haspatiḥ usriyāḥ havya-sūdaḥ kanikradat vāvaśatīḥ ut ājat
eva pitre viśva-devāya vr̥ṣṇe yajñaiḥ vidhema namasā haviḥ-bhiḥ br̥haspate su-prajāḥ vīra-vantaḥ vayam syāma patayaḥ rayīṇām
saḥ it rājā prati-janyāni viśvā śuṣmeṇa tasthau abhi vīryeṇa br̥haspatim yaḥ su-bhr̥tam bibharti valgu-yati vandate pūrva-bhājam
saḥ it kṣeti su-dhitaḥ okasi sve tasmai il̥ā pinvate viśva-dānīm tasmai viśaḥ svayam eva namante yasmin brahmā rājani pūrvaḥ et i
aprati-itaḥ jayati sam dhanāni prati-janyāni uta yā sa-janyā avasyave yaḥ varivaḥ kr̥ṇoti brahmaṇe rājā tam avanti devāḥ
indraḥ ca somam pibatam br̥haspate asmin yajñe mandasānā vr̥ṣaṇvasūitivr̥ṣaṇ-vasū ā vām viśantu indavaḥ su-ābhuvaḥ asme iti rayim sarva-vīram ni yacchatam
br̥haspate indra vardhatam naḥ sacā sā vām su-matiḥ bhūtu asme iti aviṣṭam dhiyaḥ jigr̥tam puram-dhīḥ jajastam aryaḥ vanuṣām arātīḥ
idam oṁ iti tyat puru-tamam purastāt jyotiḥ tamasaḥ vayuna-vat asthāt nūnam divaḥ duhitaraḥ vi-bhātīḥ gātum kr̥ṇavan uṣasaḥ janāya
asthuḥ oṁ iti citrāḥ uṣasaḥ purastāt mitāḥ-iva svaravaḥ adhvareṣu vi oṁ iti vrajasya tamasaḥ dvārā ucchantīḥ avran śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ
ucchantīḥ adya citayanta bhojān rādhaḥ-deyāya uṣasaḥ maghonīḥ acitre antariti paṇayaḥ sasantu abudhyamānāḥ tamasaḥ vi-madhye
kuvit saḥ devīḥ sanayaḥ navaḥ vā yāmaḥ babhūyāt uṣasaḥ vaḥ adya yena nava-gve aṅgire daśa-gve sapta-āsye revatīḥ revat ūṣa
yūyam hi devīḥ r̥tayuk-bhiḥ aśvaiḥ pari-prayātha bhuvanāni sadyaḥ pra-bodhayantīḥ uṣasaḥ sasantam dvi-pāt catuḥ-pāt carathāya jīvam
kva svit āsām katamā purāṇī yayā vi-dhānā vi-dadhuḥ r̥bhūṇām śubham yat śubhrāḥ uṣasaḥ caranti na vi jñāyante sa-dr̥śīḥ ajuryāḥ
tāḥ gha tāḥ bhadrāḥ uṣasaḥ purā āsuḥ abhiṣṭi-dyumnāḥ r̥tajāta-satyāḥ yāsu ījānaḥ śaśamānaḥ ukthaiḥ stuvan śaṁsan draviṇam sadyaḥ āpa
tāḥ ā caranti samanā purastāt samānataḥ samanā paprathānāḥ r̥tasya devīḥ sadasaḥ budhānāḥ gavām na sargāḥ uṣasaḥ jarante
tāḥ it nu eva samanā samānīḥ amīta-varṇāḥ uṣasaḥ caranti gūhantīḥ abhvam asitam ruśat-bhiḥ śukrāḥ tanūbhiḥ śucayaḥ rucānāḥ
rayim divaḥ duhitaraḥ vi-bhātīḥ prajāvantam yacchata asmāsu devīḥ syonāt ā vaḥ prati-budhyamānāḥ su-vīryasya patayaḥ syāma
tat vaḥ divaḥ duhitaraḥ vi-bhātīḥ upa bruve uṣasaḥ yajña-ketuḥ vayam syāma yaśasaḥ janeṣu tat dyauḥ ca dhattām pr̥thivī ca devī
prati syā sūnarī janī vi-ucchantī pari svasuḥ divaḥ adarśi duhitā
aśvāiva citrā aruṣī mātā gavām r̥ta-varī sakhā abhūt aśvinoḥ uṣāḥ
uta sakhā asi aśvinoḥ uta mātā gavām asi uta uṣaḥ vasvaḥ īśiṣe
yāvayat-dveṣasam tvā cikitvit sūnr̥tāvari prati stomaiḥ abhutsmahi
prati bhadrāḥ adr̥kṣata gavām sargāḥ na raśmayaḥ ā uṣāḥ aprāḥ uru jrayaḥ
āpapruṣī vibhāvari vi āvaḥ jyotiṣā tamaḥ uṣaḥ anu svadhām ava
ā dyām tanoṣi raśmi-bhiḥ ā antarikṣam uru priyam uṣaḥ śukreṇa śociṣā
tat devasya savituḥ vāryam mahat vr̥ṇīmahe asurasya pracetasaḥ chardiḥ yena dāśuṣe yacchati tmanā tat naḥ mahān ut ayān devaḥ aktu-bhiḥ
divaḥ dhartā bhuvanasya prajāpatiḥ piśaṅgam drāpim prati muñcate kaviḥ vi-cakṣaṇaḥ prathayan āpr̥ṇan uru ajījanat savitā sumnam ukthyam
ā aprāḥ rajāṁsi divyāni pārthivā ślokam devaḥ kr̥ṇute svāya dharmaṇe pra bāhū iti asrāk savitā savīmani ni-veśayan pra-suvan aktu-bhiḥ jagat
adābhyaḥ bhuvanāni pra-cākaśat vratāni devaḥ savitā abhi rakṣate pra asrāk bāhū iti bhuvanasya pra-jābhyaḥ dhr̥ta-vrataḥ mahaḥ ajmasya rājati
triḥ antarikṣam savitā mahi-tvanā trī rajāṁsi pari-bhūḥ trīṇi rocanā tisraḥ divaḥ pr̥thivīḥ tisraḥ invati tri-bhiḥ vrataiḥ abhi naḥ rakṣati tmanā
br̥hat-sumnaḥ pra-savitā ni-veśanaḥ jagataḥ sthātuḥ ubhayasya yaḥ vaśī saḥ naḥ devaḥ savitā śarma yacchatu asme iti kṣayāya tri-varūtham aṁhasaḥ
ā agan devaḥ r̥tu-bhiḥ vardhatu kṣayam dadhātu naḥ savitā su-prajām iṣam saḥ naḥ kṣapābhiḥ aha-bhiḥ ca jinvatu prajāvantam rayim asme iti sam invatu
abhūt devaḥ savitā vandyaḥ nu naḥ idānīm ahnaḥ upa-vācyaḥ nr̥-bhiḥ vi yaḥ ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ śreṣṭham naḥ atra draviṇam yathā dadhat
devebhyaḥ hi prathamam yajñiyebhyaḥ amr̥ta-tvam suvasi bhāgam ut-tamam āt it dāmānam savitaḥ vi ūrṇuṣe anūcīnā jīvitā mānuṣebhyaḥ
acittī yat cakr̥ma daivye jane dīnaiḥ dakṣaḥ pra-bhūtī puruṣatvatā deveṣu ca savitaḥ mānuṣeṣu ca tvam naḥ atra suvatāt anāgasaḥ
na pra-miye savituḥ daivyasya tat yathā viśvam bhuvanam dhārayiṣyati yat pr̥thivyāḥ variman ā su-aṅguriḥ varṣman divaḥ suvati satyam asya tat
indra-jyeṣṭhān br̥hat-bhyaḥ parvatebhyaḥ kṣayān ebhyaḥ suvasi pastya-vataḥ yathāyathā patayantaḥ vi-yemire eva eva tasthuḥ savitariti savāya te
ye te triḥ ahan savitariti savāsaḥ dive--dive saubhagam āsuvanti indraḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti sindhuḥ at-bhiḥ ādityaiḥ naḥ aditiḥ śarma yaṁsat
kaḥ vaḥ trātā vasavaḥ kaḥ varūtā dyāvābhūmī iti adite trāsīthām naḥ sahīyasaḥ varuṇa mitra martāt kaḥ vaḥ adhvare varivaḥ dhāti devāḥ
pra ye dhāmāni pūrvyāṇi arcān vi yat ucchān vi-yotāraḥ amūrāḥ vi-dhātāraḥ vi te dadhuḥ ajasrāḥ r̥ta-dhītayaḥ rurucanta dasmāḥ
pra pastyām aditim sindhum arkaiḥ svastim īl̥e sakhyāya devīm ubhe iti yathā naḥ ahanī iti ni-pātaḥ uṣasānaktā karatām adabdheiti
vi aryamā varuṇaḥ ceti panthām iṣaḥ patiḥ suvitam gātum agniḥ indrāviṣṇūiti nr̥-vat oṁ iti su stavānā śarma naḥ yantam ama-vat varūtham
ā parvatasya marutām avāṁsi devasya trātuḥ avri bhagasya pāt patiḥ janyāt aṁhasaḥ naḥ mitraḥ mitriyāt uta naḥ uruṣyet
iti ahinā budhnyena stuvīta devī iti api ebhiḥ iṣṭaiḥ samudram na sam-caraṇe saniṣyavaḥ gharma-svarasaḥ nadyaḥ apa vran
devaiḥ naḥ devī aditiḥ ni pātu devaḥ trātā trāyatām apra-yucchan nahi mitrasya varuṇasya dhāsim arhāmasi pra-miyam sānu agneḥ
agniḥ īśe vasavyasya agniḥ mahaḥ saubhagasya tāni asmabhyam rāsate
uṣaḥ maghoni ā vaha sūnr̥te vāryā puru asmabhyam vājinī-vati
tat su naḥ savitā bhagaḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā indraḥ naḥ rādhasā ā gamat
mahī dyāvāpr̥thivī iti iha jyeṣṭheiti rucā bhavatām śucayat-bhiḥ arkaiḥ yat sīm variṣṭheiti br̥hatī iti vi-minvan ruvat ha ukṣā paprathānebhiḥ evaiḥ
iti śucayat-bhiḥ arkaiḥ
saḥ it su-apāḥ bhuvaneṣu āsa yaḥ ime iti dyāvāpr̥thivī iti jajāna urvī iti gabhīre iti rajasī iti sumeke itisu-meke avaṁśe dhīraḥ śacyā sam airat
nu rodasī iti br̥hat-bhiḥ naḥ varūthaiḥ patnīvat-bhiḥ iṣayantī iti sa-joṣāḥ urūcī iti viśveiti yājate iti ni pātam dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ
pra vām mahi dyavī iti abhi upa-stutim bharāmahe śucī iti upa pra-śastaye
punāne iti tanvā mithaḥ svena dakṣeṇa rājathaḥ ūhyātheiti sanāt r̥tam
mahī iti mitrasya sādhathaḥ tarantī iti pipratī iti r̥tam pari yajñam ni sedathuḥ
kṣetrasya patinā vayam hitena-iva jayāmasi gām asvam poṣayitnu ā saḥ naḥ mr̥l̥āti īdr̥śe
kṣetrasya pate madhu-mantam ūrmim dhenuḥ-iva payaḥ asmāsu dhukṣva madhu-ścutam ghr̥tam-iva su-pāūtam r̥tasya naḥ patayaḥ mr̥l̥ayantu
madhu-matīḥ oṣadhīḥ dyāvaḥ āpaḥ madhu-mat naḥ bhavatu antarikṣam kṣetrasya patiḥ madhu-mān naḥ astu ariṣyantaḥ anu enam carema
śunam varatrāḥ badhyantām śunam aṣṭrām ut iṅgaya
śunāsīrau imām vācam juṣethām yat divi cakrathuḥ payaḥ tena imām upa siñcatam
arvācī su-bhage bhava sīte vandāmahe tvā yathā naḥ su-bhagā asasi yathā naḥ suphalā asasi
indraḥ sītām ni gr̥hṇātu tām pūṣā anu yacchatu sā naḥ payasvatī duhām uttarām-uttarām samām
śunam naḥ phālāḥ vi kr̥ṣantu bhūmim śunam kīnāśāḥ abhi yantu vāhaiḥ śunam parjanyaḥ madhunā payaḥ-bhiḥ śunāsīrā śunam asmāsu dhattam
samudrāt ūrmiḥ madhu-mān ut ārat upa aṁśunā sam amr̥ta-tvam ānaṭ ghr̥tasya nāma guhyam yat asti jihvā devānām amr̥tasya nābhiḥ
vayam nāma pra braāma ghr̥tasya asmin yajñe dhārayāma namaḥ-bhiḥ upa brahmā śr̥ṇavat śasyamānam catuḥ-śr̥ṅgaḥ avamīt gauraḥ etat
catvāri śr̥ṅgā trayaḥ asya pādāḥ dve iti śīrṣe iti sapta hastāsaḥ asya tridhā baddhaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ roravīti mahaḥ devaḥ martyān ā viveśa
tridhā hitam paṇi-bhiḥ guhyamānam gavi devāsaḥ ghr̥tam anu avindan indraḥ ekam sūryaḥ ekam jajāna venāt ekam svadhayā niḥ tatakṣuḥ
etāḥ arṣanti hr̥dyāt samudrāt śata-vrajāḥ ripuṇā na ava-cakṣe ghr̥tasya dhārāḥ abhi cākasīmi hiraṇyayaḥ vetasaḥ madhye āsām
samyak sravanti saritaḥ na dhenāḥ antaḥ hr̥dā manasā pūyamānāḥ ete arṣanti ūrmayaḥ ghr̥tasya mr̥gāḥ-iva kṣipaṇoḥ īṣamāṇāḥ
sindhoḥ-iva pra-adhvane śūghanāsaḥ vāta-pramiyaḥ patayanti yahvāḥ ghr̥tasya dhārāḥ aruṣaḥ na vājī kāṣṭhāḥ bhindan ūrmibhiḥ pinvamānaḥ
abhi pravanta samanāiva yoṣāḥ kalyāṇyaḥ smayamānāsaḥ agnim ghr̥tasya dhārāḥ sam-idhaḥ nasanta tāḥ juṣāṇaḥ haryati jāta-vedāḥ
kanyāḥ-iva vahatum etavai oṁ iti añji añjānāḥ abhi cākaśīmi yatra somaḥ sūyate yatra yajñaḥ ghr̥tasya dhārāḥ abhi tat pavante
abhi arṣata su-stutim gavyam ājim asmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta imam yajñam nayata devatā naḥ ghr̥tasya dhārāḥ madhu-mat pavante
dhāman te viśvam bhuvanam adhi śritam antariti samudre hr̥di antaḥ āyuṣi apām anīke sam-ithe yaḥ ābhr̥taḥ tam aśyāma madhu-mantam te ūrmim
abodhi agniḥ sam-idhā janānām prati dhenum-iva āyatīm uṣasam yahvāḥ-iva pra vayām ut-jihānāḥ pra bhānavaḥ sisrate nākam accha
abodhi hotā yajathāya devān ūrdhvaḥ agniḥ su-manāḥ prātaḥ asthāt sam-iddhasya ruśat adarśi pājaḥ mahān devaḥ tamasaḥ niḥ amoci
yat īm gaṇasya raśanām ajīgariti śuciḥ aṅkte śuci-bhiḥ go--bhiḥ agniḥ āt dakṣiṇā yujyate vāja-yantī uttānām ūrdhvaḥ adhayat juhūbhiḥ
agnim accha deva-yatām manāṁsi cakṣūṁṣī-iva sūrye sam caranti yat īm suvāte uṣasā virūpeitivi-rūpe śvetaḥ vājī jāyate agre ahnām
janiṣṭa hi jenyaḥ agre ahnām hitaḥ hiteṣu aruṣaḥ vaneṣu dame--dame sapta ratnā dadhānaḥ agniḥ hotā ni sasāda yajīyān
agniḥ hotā ni asīdat yajīyān upa-sthe mātuḥ surabhau oṁ iti loke yuvā kaviḥ puruniḥ-ṣṭhaḥ r̥ta-vā dhartā kr̥ṣṭīnām uta madhye iddhaḥ
pra nu tyam vipram adhvareṣu sādhum agnim hotāram īl̥ate namaḥ-bhi ḥ ā yaḥ tatāna rodasī iti r̥tena nityam mr̥janti vājinam ghr̥tena
mārjālyaḥ mr̥jyate sve damūnāḥ kavi-praśastaḥ atithiḥ śivaḥ naḥ sahasra-śr̥ṅgaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ tat-ojā viśvān agne sahasā pra asi anyān
pra sadyaḥ agne ati eṣi anyān āviḥ yasmai cāru-tamaḥ babhūtha īl̥enyaḥ vapuṣyaḥ vibhāvā priyaḥ viśām atithiḥ mānuṣīṇām
tubhyam bharanti kṣitayaḥ yaviṣṭha balim agne antitaḥ ā uta dūrāt ā bhandiṣṭhasya su-matim cikiddhi br̥hat te agne mahi śarma bhadram
ā adya ratham bhānu-maḥ bhānum antam agne tiṣṭha yajatebhiḥ sam-antam vidvān pathīnām uru antarikṣam ā iha devān haviḥ-adyāya vakṣi
avocāma kavaye medhyāya vacaḥ vandāru vr̥ṣabhāya vr̥ṣṇe gaviṣṭhiraḥ namasā stomam agnau divi-iva rukmam uru-vyañcam aśret
kumāram mātā yuvatiḥ sam-ubdham guhā bibharti na dadāti pitre anīkam asya na minat janāsaḥ puraḥ paśyanti ni-hitam aratau
kam etam tvam yuvate kumāram peṣī bibharṣi mahiṣī jajāna pūrvīḥ h i garbhaḥ śaradaḥ vavardha apaśyam jātam yat asūta mātā
hiraṇya-dantam śuci-varṇam ārāt kṣetrāt apaśyam āyudhā mimānam dadānaḥ asmai amr̥tam vipr̥kvat kim mām anindrāḥ kr̥ṇavan anukthāḥ
kṣetrāt apaśyam sanutariti carantam su-mat yūtham na puru śobhamānam na tāḥ agr̥bhran ajaniṣṭa hi saḥ paliknīḥ it yuvatayaḥ bhavanti
ke me maryakam vi yavanta gobhiḥ na yeṣām gopāḥ araṇaḥ cit āsa ye īm jagr̥bhuḥ ava te sr̥jantu ā ajāti paśvaḥ upa naḥ cikitvān
vasām rājānam vasatim janānām arātayaḥ ni dadhuḥ martyeṣu brahmāṇi atreḥ ava tam sr̥jantu ninditāraḥ nindyāsaḥ bhavantu
śunaḥ-śepam cit ni-ditam sahasrāt yūpāt amuñcaḥ aśamiṣṭa hi saḥ eva asmat agne vi mumugdhi pāsān hotariti cikitvaḥ iha tu ni-sadya
hr̥ṇīyamānaḥ apa hi mat aiye pra me devānām vrata-pāḥ uvāca indraḥ vidvān anu hi tvā cacakṣa tena aham agne anu-śiṣṭaḥ ā agām
vi jyotiṣā br̥hatā bhāti agniḥ āviḥ viśvāni kr̥ṇute mahi-tvā pra adevīḥ māyāḥ sahate duḥ-evāḥ śiśīte śr̥ṅgeiti rakṣase vi-nikṣe
uta khānāsaḥ divi santu agneḥ tigma-āyudhāḥ rakṣase hantavai oṁ iti made cit asya pra rujanti bhāmāḥ na varante pari-bādhaḥ adevīḥ
etam te stomam tuvi-jāta vipraḥ ratham na dhīraḥ su-apāḥ atakṣam yadi it agne prati tvam deva haryāḥ svaḥ-vatīḥ apaḥ ena jayema
tuvi-grīvaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ vavr̥dhānaḥ aśatru aryaḥ sam ajāti vedaḥ iti imam agnim amr̥tāḥ avocan barhiṣmate manave śarma yaṁsat havi ṣmate manave śarma yaṁsat
tvam agne varuṇaḥ jāyase yat tvam mitraḥ bhavasi yat sam-iddhaḥ tve viśve sahasaḥ putra devāḥ tvam indraḥ dāśuṣe martyāya
tvam aryamā bhavasi yat kanīnām nāma svadhāvan guhyam bibharṣi añjanti mitram su-dhitam na gobhiḥ yat dampatī itidam-patī sa-manasā kr̥ṇoṣi
tava śriye marutaḥ marjayanta rudra yat te janima cāru citram padam yat viṣṇoḥ upa-mam ni-dhāyi tena pāsi guhyam nāma gonām
tava śriyā su-dr̥śaḥ deva devāḥ puru dadhānāḥ amr̥tam sapanta hotāram agnim manuṣaḥ ni seduḥ daśasyantaḥ uśijaḥ śaṁsam āyoḥ
na tvat hotā pūrvaḥ agne yajīyān na kāvyaiḥ paraḥ asti svadhāvaḥ viśaḥ ca yasyāḥ atithiḥ bhavāsi saḥ yajñena vana-vat deva martān
vayam agne vanuyāma tvāūtāḥ vasu-yavaḥ haviṣā budhyamānāḥ vayam sa-marye vidatheṣu ahnām vayam rāyā sahasaḥ putra martān
yaḥ naḥ āgaḥ abhi enaḥ bharāti adhi it agham agha-śaṁse dadhāta jahi cikitvaḥ abhi-śastim etām agne yaḥ naḥ marcayati dvayena
tvām asyāḥ vi-uṣi deva pūrve dūtam kr̥ṇvānāḥ ayajanta havyaiḥ sam-sthe yat āgne īyase rayīṇām devaḥ martaiḥ vasu-bhiḥ idhyamānaḥ
ava spr̥dhi pitaram yodhi vidvān putraḥ yaḥ te sahasaḥ sūno iti ūhe kadā cikitvaḥ abhi cakṣase naḥ agne kadā r̥ta-cit yātayāse
bhūri nāma vandamānaḥ dadhāti pitā vaso iti yadi tat joṣayāse kuvit devasya sahasā cakānaḥ sumnam agniḥ vanate vavr̥dhānaḥ
tvam aṅga jaritāram yaviṣṭha viśvāni agne duḥ-itā ati parṣi stenāḥ adr̥śran ripavaḥ janāsaḥ ajñāta-ketāḥ vr̥jināḥ abhūvan
ime yāmāsaḥ tvadrik abhūvan vasave vā tat it āgaḥ avāci na aha ayam agniḥ abhi-śastaye naḥ na riṣate vavr̥dhānaḥ parā dāt
tvām agne vasu-patim vasūnām abhi pra mande adhvareṣu rājan tvayā vājam vāja-yantaḥ jayema abhi syāma pr̥tsutīḥ martyānām
havya-vāṭ agniḥ ajaraḥ pitā naḥ vi-bhuḥ vibhāvā su-dr̥śīkaḥ asme iti su-gārhapatyāḥ sam iṣaḥ didīhi asmadryak sam mimīhi śravāṁsi
viśām kavim viśpatim mānuṣīṇām śucim pāvakam ghr̥ta-pr̥ṣṭham agnim ni hotāram viśva-vidam dadhidhve saḥ deveṣu vanate vāryāṇi
juṣasva agne il̥ayā sa-joṣāḥ yatamānaḥ raśmi-bhiḥ sūryasya juṣasva naḥ sam-idham jāta-vedaḥ ā ca devān haviḥ-adyāya vakṣi
juṣṭaḥ damūnāḥ atithiḥ duroṇe imam naḥ yajñam upa yāhi vidvān viśvā agne abhi-yujaḥ vi-hatya śatru-yatām ā bhara bhojanāni
vedhena dasyum pra hi cātayasva vayaḥ kr̥ṇvānaḥ tanve svāyai piparṣi yat sahasaḥ putra devān saḥ agne pāhi nr̥-tama vāje asmān
vayam te agne ukthaiḥ vidhema vayam havyaiḥ pāvaka bhadra-śoce asme iti rayim viśva-vāram sam inva asme iti viśvāni draviṇāni dhehi
asmākam agne adhvaram juṣasva sahasaḥ sūno iti tri-sadhastha havyam vayam deveṣu su-kr̥taḥ syāma śarmaṇā naḥ tri-varūthena pāhi
viśvāni naḥ duḥ-gahā jāta-vedaḥ sindhum na nāvā duḥ-itā ati parṣi agne atri-vat namasā gr̥ṇānaḥ asmākam bodhi avitā tanūnām
yaḥ tvā hr̥dā kīriṇā manyamānaḥ amaryaḥ johavīmi jāta-vedaḥ yaśaḥ asmāsu dhehi pra-jābhiḥ agne amr̥ta-tvam aśyām
yasmai tvam su-kr̥te jāta-vedaḥ oṁ iti lokam agne kr̥ṇavaḥ syonam aśvinam saḥ putriṇam vīra-vantam go--mantam rayim naśate svasti
su-samiddhāya śociṣe ghr̥tam tīvram juhotana agnaye jāta-vedase
narāśaṁsaḥ susūdati imam yajñam adābhyaḥ kaviḥ hi madhu-hastyaḥ
īl̥itaḥ agne ā vaha indram citram iha priyam su-khaiḥ rathebhiḥ ūtaye
ūrṇa-mradāḥ vi prathasva abhi arkāḥ anūṣata bhava naḥ śubhra sātaye
devīḥ dvāraḥ vi śrayadhvam supra-ayanāḥ naḥ ūtaye pra-pra yajñam pr̥ṇītana
supratīke itisu-pratīke vayaḥ-vr̥dhā yahvī r̥tasya mātarā doṣām uṣasam īmahe
vātasya patman īl̥itā daivyā hotārā manuṣaḥ imam naḥ yajñam ā gatam
il̥ā sarasvatī mahī tisraḥ devīḥ mayaḥ-bhuvaḥ barhiḥ sīdantu asri dhah
śivaḥ tvaṣṭaḥ iha ā gahi vi-bhuḥ poṣe uta tmanā yajñe--yajñe naḥ ut ava
yatra vettha vanaspate devānām guhyā nāmāni tatra havyāni gamaya
svāhā agnaye varuṇāya svāhā indrāya marut-bhyaḥ svāhā devebhyaḥ haviḥ
agnim tam manye yaḥ vasuḥ astam yam yanti dhenavaḥ astam avarntaḥ āśavaḥ astam nityāsaḥ vājinaḥ iṣam stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara
saḥ agniḥ yaḥ vasuḥ gr̥ṇe sam yam āyanti dhenavaḥ sam arvantaḥ raghu-druvaḥ sam su-jātāsaḥ sūraya iṣam stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara
agniḥ hi vājinam viśe dadāti viśva-carṣaṇiḥ agniḥ rāye su-ābhuvam saḥ prītaḥ yāti vāryam iṣam stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara
ā te agne idhīmahi dyu-mantam deva ajaram yat ha syā te panīyasī sam-it dīdayati dyavi iṣam stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara
ā te agne r̥cā haviḥ śukrasya śociṣaḥ pate su-candra dasma viśpate havya-vāṭ tubhyam hūyate iṣam stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara
pro iti tye agnayaḥ agniṣu viśvam puṣyanti vāryam te hinvire te invire te iṣaṇyanti ānuṣak iṣam stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara
tava tye agne arcayaḥ mahi vrādhanta vājinaḥ ye patva-bhiḥ śaphānām vrajā bhuranta gonām iṣam stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara
navāḥ naḥ agne ā bhara stotr̥-bhyaḥ su-kṣitīḥ iṣaḥ te syāma ye ānr̥cuḥ tvādūtāsaḥ dame--dame iṣam stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara
ubhe su-candra sarpiṣaḥ darvī iti śrīṇīṣe āsani uto iti naḥ ut pupūryāḥ ukthyeṣu śavasaḥ pate iṣam stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara
eva agnim ajuryamuḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ yajñebhiḥ ānuṣak dadhat asme iti su-vīryam uta tyat āśu-aśvyam iṣam stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara
sakhāyaḥ sam vaḥ samyañcam iṣam stomam ca agnaye varṣiṣṭhāya kṣi tīnām ūrjaḥ naptre sahasvate
kutra cit yasya sam-r̥tau raṇvāḥ naraḥ nr̥-sadane arhantaḥ cit yam indhate sam-janayanti jantavaḥ
sam yat iṣaḥ vanāmahe sam havyā mānuṣāṇām uta dyumnasya śavasā r̥tasya raśmim ā dade
saḥ sma kr̥ṇoti ketum ā naktam cit dūre ā sate pāvakaḥ yat vanaspatīn pra sma mināti ajaraḥ
ava sma yasya veṣaṇe svedam pathiṣu juhvati abhi īm aha sva-jenyam bhūma pr̥ṣṭāiva ruruhuḥ
yam martyaḥ puru-spr̥ham vidat viśvasya dhāyase pra svādanam pitūnām asta-tātim cit āyave
saḥ hi ṣma dhanva ākṣitam dātā na dāti ā paśuḥ hiri-śmaśruḥ śuci--dan r̥bhuḥ anibhr̥ṣṭa-taviṣiḥ
śuciḥ sma yasmai atri-vat pra svadhitiḥ-iva rīyate su-sūḥ asūta mātā krāṇā yat ānaśe bhagam
ā yaḥ te sarpiḥ-āsute agne śam asti dhāyase ā eṣu dyumnam uta śravaḥ ā cittam martyeṣu dhāḥ
