iti cit manyum adhrijaḥ tvādātam ā paśum dade āt agne apr̥ṇataḥ atriḥ sasahyāt dasyūn iṣaḥ sasahyāt nr̥r̥n
tvām agne r̥ta-yavaḥ sam īdhire pratnam pratnāsaḥ ūtaye sahaḥ-kr̥ta puru-candram yajatam viśva-dhāyasam damūnasam gr̥ha-patim vareṇyam
tvām agne atithim pūrvyam viśaḥ śociḥ-keśam gr̥ha-patim ni sedire br̥hat-ketum puru-rūpam dhana-spr̥tam su-śarmāṇam su-avasam jarat-viṣam
tvām agne mānuṣīḥ īl̥ate viśaḥ hotrāvidam vivicim ratna-dhātamam guhā santam su-bhaga viśva-darśatam tuvi-svaṇasam su-yajam ghr̥ta-śr iyam
tvām agne dharṇasim viśva-dhā vayam gīḥ-bhiḥ gr̥ṇantaḥ namasā upa sedima saḥ naḥ juṣasva sam-idhānaḥ aṅgiraḥ devaḥ martasya yaśasā sudīti-bhiḥ
tvam agne puru-rūpaḥ viśe--viśe vayaḥ dadhāsi pratna-thā purustuta purūṇi annā sahasā vi rājasi tviṣiḥ sā te titviṣāṇasya na ādhr̥ṣe
tvām agne sam-idhānam yaviṣṭhya devāḥ dūtam cakrire havya-vāhanam uru-jrayasam ghr̥ta-yonim āhutam tveṣam cakṣuḥ dadhire codayat-mati
tvām agne pra-divaḥ āhutam ghr̥taiḥ sumna-yavaḥ su-samidhā sam īdhire saḥ vavr̥dhānaḥ oṣadhī-bhiḥ ukṣitaḥ abhi jrayāṁsi pārthivā vi t iṣṭhase
tvām agne haviṣmantaḥ devam martāsaḥ īl̥ate manye tvā jāta-vedasam saḥ havyā vakṣi ānuṣak
agniḥ hotā dāsvataḥ kṣayasya vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ sam yajñāsaḥ carant i yam sam vājāsaḥ śravasyavaḥ
uta sma yam śiśum yathā navam janiṣṭa araṇī iti dhartāram mānuṣīṇām viśām agnim su-adhvaram
uta sma duḥ-gr̥bhīyase putraḥ na hvāryāṇām puru yaḥ dagdhā asi vanā agne paśuḥ na yavase
adha sma yasya arcayaḥ samyak sam-yanti dhūminaḥ yat īmahe tr itaḥ divi upa dhmātāiva dhamati śiśīte dhmātari yathā
tava aham agne ūti-bhiḥ mitrasya ca praśasti-bhiḥ dveṣaḥ-yutaḥ na duḥ-itā turyāma martyānām
tat naḥ agne abhi naraḥ rayim sahasvaḥ ā bhara saḥ kṣepayat saḥ poṣayat bhuvat vājasya sātaye uta edhi naḥ vr̥dhe
agne ojiṣṭham ā bhara dyumnam asmabhyam adhrigo ity adhri-go pra naḥ rāyā parīṇasā ratsi vājāya panthām
tvam naḥ agne adbhuta kratvā dakṣasya maṁhanā tve iti asuryam ā aruhat krāṇā mitraḥ na yajñiyaḥ
tvam naḥ agne eṣām gayam puṣṭim ca vardhaya ye stomebhiḥ pra sūrayaḥ naraḥ maghāni ānaśuḥ
ye agne candra te giraḥ śumbhanti aśva-rādhasaḥ śuṣmebhiḥ śuṣmiṇaḥ naraḥ divaḥ cit yeṣām br̥hat su-kīrtiḥ bodhati tmanā
tava tye agne arcayaḥ bhrājantaḥ yanti dhr̥ṣṇu-yā pari-jmānaḥ na vi-dyutaḥ svānaḥ rathaḥ na vājayuḥ
nu naḥ agne ūtaye sa-bādhasaḥ ca rātaye asmākāsaḥ ca sūrayaḥ vi śvāḥ āsāḥ tarīṣaṇi
tvam naḥ agne aṅgiraḥ stutaḥ stavānaḥ ā bhara hotaḥ vibhva-saham rayim stotr̥-bhyaḥ stavase ca naḥ uta edhi pr̥t-su naḥ vr̥dhe
anasya gopāḥ ajaniṣṭa jāgr̥viḥ agniḥ su-dakṣaḥ suvitāya navyase ghr̥ta-pratīkaḥ br̥hatā divi-spr̥śā dyu-mat vi bhāti bharatebhyaḥ śuciḥ
yajñasya ketum prathamam puraḥ-hitam agnim naraḥ tri-sadhasthe sam īdhire indreṇa devaiḥ saratham saḥ barhiṣi sīdat ni hotā yajathāya su-kratuḥ
asam-mr̥ṣṭaḥ jāyase mātroḥ śuciḥ mandraḥ kaviḥ ut atiṣṭhaḥ vivasvataḥ ghr̥tena tvā avardhayan agne āhuta dhūmaḥ te ketuḥ abhavat divi śr̥itaḥ
agniḥ naḥ yajñam upa vetu sādhu-yā agnim naraḥ vi bharante gr̥he--gr̥he agniḥ dūtaḥ abhavat havya-vāhanaḥ agnim vr̥ṇānāḥ vr̥ṇate kavi-kratum
tubhya idam agne madhumat-tamam vacaḥ tubhyam manīṣā iyam astu śam hr̥de tvām giraḥ sindhum-iva avanīḥ mahīḥ ā pr̥ṇanti śavasā vardhayanti ca
tvām agne aṅgirasaḥ guhā hitam anu avindan śiśriyāṇam vane--vane saḥ jāyase mathyamānaḥ sahaḥ mahat tvām āhuḥ sahasaḥ putram aṅgiraḥ
pra agnaye br̥hate yajñiyāya r̥tasya vr̥ṣṇe asurāya manma ghr̥tam na yajñe āsye su-pūtam giram bhare vr̥ṣabhāya pratīcīm
r̥tam cikitvaḥ r̥tam it cikiddhi r̥tasya dhārāḥ anu tr̥ndhi pūrvīḥ na aham yātum sahasā na dvayena r̥tam sapāmi aruṣasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ
kayā naḥ agne r̥tayan r̥tena bhuvaḥ navedāḥ ucathasya navyaḥ veda me devaḥ r̥tu-pāḥ r̥tūnām na aham patim sanituḥ asya rāyaḥ
ke te agne ripave bandhanāsaḥ ke pāyavaḥ saniṣanta dyu-mantaḥ ke dhāsim agne anr̥tasya pānti ke asataḥ vacasaḥ santi gopāḥ
sakhāyaḥ te viṣuṇāḥ agne ete śivāsaḥ santaḥ aśivāḥ abhūvan adhūrṣata svayam ete vacaḥ-bhiḥ r̥ju-yate vr̥jināni bruvantaḥ
yaḥ te agne namasā yajñam īṭe r̥tam saḥ pāti aruṣasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ tasya kṣayaḥ pr̥thuḥ ā sādhuḥ etu pra-sarsrāṇasya nahuṣasya śeṣaḥ
arcantaḥ tvā havāmahe arcantaḥ sam idhīmahi agne arcantaḥ ūtaye
agneḥ stomam manāmahe sidhram adya divi-spr̥śaḥ devasya draviṇasyavaḥ
agniḥ juṣata naḥ giraḥ hotā yaḥ mānuṣeṣu ā saḥ yakṣat daivyam janam
tvam agne sa-prathāḥ asi juṣṭaḥ hotā vareṇyaḥ tvayā yajñam vi tanvate
tvām agne vāja-sātamam viprāḥ vardhanti su-stutam saḥ naḥ rāsva su-vīryam
agne nemiḥ arān-iva devān tvam pari-bhūḥ asi ā rādhaḥ citram r̥ñjase
agnim stomena bodhaya sam-idhānaḥ amartyam havyā deveṣu naḥ dadhat
tam adhvareṣu īl̥ate devam martāḥ amartyam yajiṣṭham mānuṣe jane
tam hi śaśvantaḥ īl̥ate srucā devam ghr̥ta-ścutā agnim havyāya vol̥have
agniḥ jātaḥ arocata ghnan dasyūn jyotiṣā tamaḥ avindat gāḥ apaḥ svaḥ
agnim īl̥enyam kavim ghr̥ta-pr̥ṣṭham saparyata vetu me ṣr̥ṇavat havam
agnim ghr̥tena vavr̥dhuḥ stomebhiḥ viśva-carṣaṇim su-ādhībhiḥ vacasyu-bhiḥ
pra vedhase kavaye vedyāya giram bhare yaśase pūrvyāya ghr̥ta-prasattaḥ asuraḥ su-śevaḥ rāyaḥ dhartā dharuṇaḥ vasvaḥ agniḥ
r̥tena r̥tam dharuṇam dhārayanta yajñasya śoke parame vi-oman divaḥ dharman dharuṇe seduṣaḥ nr̥r̥n jātaiḥ ajātān abhi ye nanakṣuḥ
aṁhaḥ-yuvaḥ tanvaḥ tanvate vi vayaḥ mahat dustaram pūrvyāya saḥ sam-vataḥ nava-jātaḥ tuturyāt siṁham na kruddham abhitaḥ pari sthuḥ
mātāiva yat bharase paprathānaḥ janam-janam dhāyase cakṣase ca vayaḥ-vayaḥ jarase yat dadhānaḥ pari tmanā viṣu-rūpaḥ jigāsi
vājaḥ nu te śavasaḥ pātu antam urum dogham dharuṇam deva rāyaḥ padam na tāyuḥ guhā dadhānaḥ mahaḥ rāye citayan atrim aspar ity aspaḥ
br̥hat vayaḥ hi bhānave arca devāya agnaye yam mitram na praśast i-bhiḥ martāsaḥ dadhire puraḥ
saḥ hi dyu-bhiḥ janānām hotā dakṣasya bāhvoḥ vi havyam agniḥ ānuṣak bhagaḥ na vāram r̥ṇvati
asya stome maghonaḥ sakhye vr̥ddha-śociṣaḥ viśvā yasmin tuvi-svaṇi sam arye śuṣmam ādadhuḥ
adha hi agne eṣām su-vīryasya maṁhanā tam it yahvam na rodasī iti pari śravaḥ babhūvatuḥ
nu naḥ ā ihi vāryam agne gr̥ṇānaḥ ā bhara ye vayam ye ca sūrayaḥ svasti dhāmahe sacā uta edhi pr̥t-su naḥ vr̥dhe
ā yajñaiḥ deva martyaḥ itthā tavyāṁsam ūtaye agnim kr̥te su-adhvare pūruḥ īl̥īta avase
asya hi svayaśaḥ-taraḥ āsā vi-dharman manyase tam nākam citra-śociṣam mandram paraḥ manīṣayā
asya vai asau oṁ iti arciṣā yaḥ ayukta tujā girā divaḥ na yasya retasā br̥hat śocanti arcayaḥ
asya kratvā vi-cetasaḥ dasmasya vasu rathe ā adha viśvāsu havyaḥ agniḥ vikṣu pra śasyate
nu naḥ it hi vāryam āsā sacanta sūrayaḥ ūrjaḥ napāt abhiṣṭaye pāhi śagdhi svastaye uta edhi pr̥t-su naḥ vr̥dhe
prātaḥ agniḥ puru-priyaḥ viśaḥ staveta atithiḥ viśvāni yaḥ amartyaḥ havyā marteṣu raṇyati
dvitāya mr̥kta-vāhase svasya dakṣasya maṁhanā indum saḥ dhatte ānuṣak stotā cit te amartya
tam vaḥ dīrghāyu-śociṣam girā huve maghonām ariṣṭaḥ yeṣām rathaḥ vi aśva-dāvan īyate
citrā vā yeṣu dīdhitiḥ āsan ukthā pānti ye stīrṇam barhiḥ svaḥ-nare śravāṁsi dadhire pari
ye me pañcāśatam daduḥ aśvānām sadha-stuti dyu-mat agne mahi śravaḥ br̥hat kr̥dhi maghonām nr̥-vat amr̥ta nr̥ṇām
abhi ava-sthāḥ pra jāyante pra vavreḥ vavriḥ ciketa upa-sthe mātuḥ vi caṣte
juhure vi citayantaḥ animiṣam nr̥mṇam pānti ā dr̥l̥hām puram viviśuḥ
ā śvaitreyasya jantavaḥ dyu-mat vardhanta kr̥ṣṭayaḥ niṣka-grīvaḥ br̥hat-ukthaḥ enā madhvā na vāja-yuḥ
priyam dugdham na kāmyam ajāmi jāmyoḥ sacā gharmaḥ na vāja-jaṭharaḥ adabdhaḥ śaśvataḥ dabhaḥ
krīl̥an naḥ raśme ā bhuvaḥ sam bhasmanā vāyunā vevidānaḥ tāḥ asya san dhr̥ṣajaḥ na tigmāḥ su-saṁśitāḥ vakṣyaḥ vakṣaṇe--sthāḥ
yam agne vāja-sātama tvam cit manyase rayim tam naḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ śravāyyam deva-trā panaya yujam
ye agne na īrayanti te vr̥ddhāḥ ugrasya śavasaḥ apa dveṣaḥ apa hvaraḥ anya-vratasya saścire
hotāram tvā vr̥ṇīmahe agne dakṣasya sādhanam yajñeṣu pūrvyam girā prayasvantaḥ havāmahe
itthā yathā te ūtaye sahasāvan dive--dive rāye r̥tāya sukrato itisu-krato gobhiḥ syāma sadha-mādaḥ vīraiḥ syāma sadha-mādaḥ
manuṣvat tvā ni dhīmahi manuṣvat sam idhīmahi agne manuṣvat aṅgi raḥ devān deva-yate yaja
tvam hi mānuṣe jane agne su-prītaḥ idhyase srucaḥ tvā yanti ānuṣak su-jāta sarpiḥ-āsute
tvām viśve sajoṣasaḥ devāsaḥ dūtam akrata saparyantaḥ tvā kave yajñeṣu devam īl̥ate
devam vaḥ deva-yajyayā agnim īl̥īta martyaḥ sam-iddhaḥ śukra dīdi hi r̥tasya yonim ā asadaḥ sasasya yonim ā asadaḥ
pra viśva-sāman atri-vat arca pāvaka-śociṣe yaḥ adhvareṣu īḍyaḥ hotā mandra-tamaḥ viśi
ni agnim jāta-vedasam dadhāta devam r̥tvijam pra yajñaḥ etu ānuṣak adya devavyacaḥ-tamaḥ
cikitvit-manasam tvā devam martāsaḥ ūtaye vareṇyasya te avasaḥ iyānāsaḥ amanmahi
agne cikiddhi asya naḥ idam vacaḥ sahasya tam / tvā su-śipra dam-pate stomaiḥ vardhanti atrayaḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ śumbhanti atrayaḥ
agne sahantam ā bhara dyumnasya pra-sahā rayim viśvāḥ yaḥ carṣaṇīḥ abhi āsā vājeṣu sasahat
tam agne pr̥tanāsaham rayim sahasvaḥ ā bhara tvam hi satyaḥ adbhutaḥ dātā vājasya go--mataḥ
viśve hi tvā sa-joṣasaḥ janāsaḥ vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ hotāram sadma-su priyam vyanti vāryā puru
saḥ hi sma viśva-carṣaṇiḥ abhi-māti sahaḥ dadhe agne eṣu kṣayeṣu ā revat naḥ śukra dīdihi dyu-mat pāvaka dīdihi
agne tvam naḥ antamaḥ uta trātā śivaḥ bhava varūthyaḥ
vasuḥ agniḥ vasu-śravā accha nakṣi dyumat-tamam rayim dāḥ
saḥ naḥ bodhi śrudhi havam uruṣya naḥ agha-yataḥ samasmāt
tam tvā śociṣṭha dīdi-vaḥ sumnāya nūnam īmahe sakhi-bhyaḥ
accha vaḥ agnim avase devam gāsi saḥ naḥ vasuḥ rāsat putraḥ r̥ṣūṇām r̥ta-vā parṣati dviṣaḥ
saḥ hi satyaḥ yam pūrve cit devāsaḥ cit yam īdhire hotāram mandra-jihvam it sudīti-bhiḥ vibhāvasum
saḥ naḥ dhītī variṣthayā śreṣṭhayā ca su-matyā agne rāyaḥ didīhi naḥ suvr̥kti-bhiḥ vareṇya
agniḥ deveṣu rājati agniḥ marteṣu āviśan agniḥ naḥ havya-vāhanaḥ agnim dhībhiḥ saparyata
agniḥ tuviśravaḥ-tamam tuvi-brahmāṇam ut-tamam atūrtam śravayat-patim putran dadāti dāśuṣe
agniḥ dadāti sat-patim sasāha yaḥ yudhā nr̥-bhiḥ agniḥ atyam raghu-syadam jetāram aparājitam
yat vāhiṣṭham tat agnaye br̥hat arca vibhāvaso itivibhāvaso mahiṣī-iva tvat rayiḥ tvat vājāḥ ut īrate
tava dyu-mantaḥ arcayaḥ grāvāiva ucyate br̥hat uto iti te tanyatuḥ yathā svānaḥ arta tmanā divaḥ
eva agnim vasu-yavaḥ sahasānam vavandima saḥ naḥ viśvā at i dviṣaḥ parṣat nāvāiva su-kratuḥ
agne pāvaka rociṣā mandrayā deva jihvayā ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca
tam tvā ghr̥tasno itighr̥ta-sno īmahe citrabhāno iticitra-bhāno svaḥ-dr̥śam devān ā vītaye vaha
vīti-hotram tvā kave dyu-mantam sam idhīmahi agne br̥hantam adhvare
agne viśve--bhiḥ ā gahi deve--bhiḥ havya-dātaye hotāram tvā vr̥ṇīmahe
yajamānāya sunvate ā agne su-vīrya vaha devaiḥ ā satsi barhiṣi
sam-idhanaḥ sahasra-jit agne dharmāṇi puṣyasi devānām dūtaḥ ukthyaḥ
ni agnim jāta-vedasam hotra-vāham yaviṣṭhyam dadhāta devam r̥tvijam
pra yajñaḥ etu ānuṣak adya devavyacaḥ-tamaḥ str̥ṇīta barhiḥ āsade
ā idam marutaḥ aśvinā mitraḥ sīdantu varuṇaḥ devāsaḥ sarvayā vi śā
anasvantā sat-patiḥ mamahe me gāvā cetiṣṭhaḥ asuraḥ maghonaḥ traivr̥ṣṇaḥ agne daśa-bhiḥ sahasraiḥ vaiśvānara tri-aruṇaḥ ciketa
yaḥ me śatā ca viṁśatim ca gonām harī iti ca yuktā su-dhurā dadāti vaiśvānara su-stutaḥ vavr̥dhānaḥ agne yaccha tri-aruṇāya śarma
eva te agne su-matim cakānaḥ naviṣṭhāya navamam trasadasyuḥ yaḥ me giraḥ tuvijātasya pūrvīḥ yuktena abhi tri-aruṇaḥ gr̥ṇāti
yaḥ me iti pra-vocati aśva-medhāya sūraye dadat r̥cā sanim yate dadat medhām r̥ta-yate
yasya mā paruṣāḥ śatam ut-harṣayanti ukṣaṇaḥ aśva-medhasya dānāḥ somāḥ-iva tri-āśiraḥ
indrāgnī iti śata-dāvni aśva-medhe su-vīryam kṣatram dhārayatam br̥hat divi sūryam-iva ajaram
sam-iddhaḥ agniḥ divi śociḥ aśret pratyaṅ uṣasam urviyā vi bhāti eti prācī viśva-vārā namaḥ-bhiḥ devān īl̥ānā haviṣā ghr̥tācī
sam-idhyamānaḥ amr̥tasya rājasi haviḥ kr̥ṇvantam sacase svastaye viśvam saḥ dhatte draviṇam yam invasi ātithyam agne ni ca dhatte it puraḥ
agne śardha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnāni ut-tamāni santu sam jaḥ-patyam su-yamam ā kr̥ṇuṣva śatru-yatām abhi tiṣṭha mahāṁsi
sam-iddhasya pra-mahasaḥ agne vande tava śriyam vr̥ṣabhaḥ dyumna-vān asi sam adhvareṣu idhyase
sam-iddhaḥ agne āhuta devān yakṣi su-adhvara tvam hi havya-vāṭ asi
ā juhota duvasyata agnim pra-yati adhvare vr̥ṇīdhvam havya-vāhanam
trī aryamā manuṣaḥ deva-tātā trī rocanā divyā dhārayanta arcanti tvā marutaḥ pūta-dakṣāḥ tvam eṣām r̥ṣiḥ indra asi dhīraḥ
anu yat īm marutaḥ mandasānam ārcan indram papi-vāṁsam sutasya ā adatta vajram abhi yat ahim han apaḥ yahvīḥ asr̥jat sartavai oṁ iti
uta brahmāṇaḥ marutaḥ me asya indraḥ somasya su-sutasya peyāḥ tat hi havyam manuṣe gāḥ avindat ahan ahim papi-vān indraḥ asya
āt rodasī iti vi-taram vi skabhāyat sam-vivyānaḥ cit bhayase mr̥gam karitikaḥ jigartim indraḥ apa-jargurāṇaḥ prati śvasantam ava dānavam hannitihan
adha kratvā magha-van tubhyam devāḥ anu viśve adaduḥ soma-peyam yat sūryasya haritaḥ patantīḥ puraḥ satīḥ uparāḥ etaśe karitikaḥ
nava yat asya navatim ca bhogān sākam vajreṇa magha-vā vivr̥ścat arcanti indram marutaḥ sadha-sthe traistubhena vacasā bādhata dyām
sakhā sakhye apacat tūyam agniḥ asya kratvā mahiṣā trī śatāni trī sākam indraḥ manuṣaḥ sarāṁsi sutam pibat vr̥tra-hatyāya somam
trī yat śatā mahiṣāṇām aghaḥ māḥ trī sarāṁsi magha-vā somyā apāḥ kāram na viśve ahvanta devāḥ bharam indrāya yat ahim jaghāna
uśanā yat sahasyaiḥ ayātam gr̥ham indra jūjuvānebhiḥ aśvaiḥ vanvānaḥ atra saratham yayātha kutsena devaiḥ avanoḥ ha śuṣṇam
pra anyat cakram avr̥haḥ sūryasya kutsāya anyat varivaḥ yātave akar ity akaḥ anāsaḥ dasyūn amr̥ṇaḥ vadhena ni duryoṇe avr̥ṇak mr̥dhra-vācaḥ
stomāsaḥ tvā gauri-vīteḥ avardhan arandhayaḥ vaidathināya piprum ā tvām r̥jiśvā sakhyāya cakre pacan paktīḥ apibaḥ somam asya
nava-gvāsaḥ suta-sāomāsaḥ indram daśa-gvāsaḥ abhi arcanti arkaiḥ gavyam cit ūrvam apidhāna-vantam tam cit naraḥ śaśamānāḥ apa vran
katho iti nu te pari carāṇi vidvān vīryā magha-van yā cakartha yā co iti nu navyā kr̥ṇavaḥ śaviṣṭha pra it oṁ iti tā te vidatheṣu bravāma
etā viśvā cakr̥-vān indra bhūri apari-itaḥ januṣā vīryeṇa yā cit nu vajrin kr̥ṇavaḥ dadhr̥ṣvān na te vartā taviṣyāḥ asti tasyāḥ
indra brahma kriyamāṇā juṣasva yā te śaviṣṭha navyāḥ akarma vastrāiva bhadrā su-kr̥tā vasu-yuḥ ratham na dhīraḥ su-apāḥ atakṣam
kva syaḥ vīraḥ kaḥ apaśyat indram sukha-ratham īyamānam hari-bhyām yaḥ rāyā vajrī suta-somam icchan tat okaḥ gantā puru-hūtaḥ ūtī
ava acacakṣam padam asya sasvaḥ ugram ni-dhātuḥ anu āyam icchan apr̥ccham anyān uta te me āhuḥ indram naraḥ bubudhānāḥ aśema
pra nu vayam sute yā te kr̥tāni indra bravāma yāni naḥ jujoṣaḥ vedat avidvān śr̥ṇavat ca vidvān vahate ayam magha-vā sarva-senaḥ
sthiram manaḥ cakr̥ṣe jātaḥ indra veṣi it ekaḥ yudhaye bhūyasaḥ cit aśmānam cit śavasā didyutaḥ vi vidaḥ gavām ūrvam usriyāṇām
paraḥ yat tvam paramaḥ ājaniṣṭhāḥ parāvati śrutyam nāma bibhrat ataḥ cit indrāt abhayanta devāḥ viśvāḥ apaḥ ajayat dāsa-patnīḥ
tubhya it ete marutaḥ su-śevāḥ arcanti arkam sunvanti andhaḥ ahim ohānam apa āśayānam pra māyābhiḥ māyinam sakṣat indraḥ
vi su mr̥dhaḥ januṣā dānam invan ahan gavā magha-van sam-cakānaḥ atra dāsasya namuceḥ śiraḥ yat avartayaḥ manave gātum icchan
yujam hi mām akr̥thāḥ āt it indra śiraḥ dāsasya namuceḥ mathāyan aśmānam cit svaryam vartamānam pra cakriyāiva rodasī iti marut-bhyaḥ
striyaḥ hi dāsaḥ āyudhāni cakre kim mā karan abalāḥ asya senāḥ antaḥ hi akhyat ubhe iti asya dheneiti atha upa pra ait yudhaye dasyum indraḥ
sam atra gāvaḥ abhitaḥ anavanta iha-iha vatsaiḥ vi-yutāḥ yat āsan sam tāḥ indraḥ asr̥jat asya śākaiḥ yat īm somāsaḥ su-sutāḥ amandan
yat īm somāḥ babhru-dhūtāḥ amandan aroravīt vr̥ṣabhaḥ sādaneṣu puram-daraḥ papi-vān indraḥ asya punaḥ gavām adadāt usriyāṇām
bhadram idam ruśamāḥ agne akran gavām catvāri dadataḥ sahasrā r̥ṇam-cayasya pra-yatā maghāni prati agrabhīṣma nr̥-tamasya nr̥ṇām
su-peśasam mā ava sr̥janti astam gavām sahasraiḥ ruśamāsaḥ agne tīvrāḥ indram amamanduḥ sutāsaḥ aktoḥ vi-uṣṭau pari-takmyāyāḥ
aucchat sā rātrī pari-takmyā yā r̥ṇam-caye rājani ruśamānām atyaḥ na vājī raghuḥ ajyamānaḥ babhruḥ catvāri asanat sahasrā
catuḥ-sahasram gavyasya paśvaḥ prati agrabhīṣma ruśameṣu agne gharmaḥ cit taptaḥ pra-vr̥je yaḥ āsīt ayasmayaḥ tam oṁ iti ādāma viprāḥ
indraḥ rathāya pra-vatam kr̥ṇoti yam adhi-asthāt magha-vā vja-yantam yūthāiva paśvaḥ vi unoti gopāḥ ariṣṭaḥ yāti prathamaḥ sisāsan
ā pra drava hari-vaḥ mā vi venaḥ piśaṅga-rāte abhi naḥ sacasva nahi tvat indra vasyaḥ anyat asti amemān cit jani-vataḥ cakartha
ut yat sahaḥ sahasaḥ ā ajaniṣṭa dediṣṭe indraḥ indriyāṇi viśvā pra acodayat su-dughāḥ vavre antaḥ vi jyotiṣā sam-vavr̥tvat tamaḥ avar ity avaḥ
anavaḥ te ratham aśvāya takṣan tvaṣṭā vajram puru-hūta dyu-mantam brahmāṇaḥ indram mahayantaḥ arkaiḥ avardhayan ahaye hantavai oṁ iti
vr̥ṣṇe yat te vr̥ṣaṇaḥ arkam arcān indra grāvāṇaḥ aditiḥ sa-joṣāḥ anaśvāsaḥ ye pavayaḥ arathāḥ indra-iṣitāḥ abhi avartanta dasyūn
pra te pūrvāṇi karaṇāni vocam pra nūtanā magha-van yā cakartha śakt i-vaḥ yat vi-bharāḥ rodasī iti ubhe iti jayan apaḥ manave dānu-citrāḥ
tat it nu te karaṇam dasma vipra ahim yat ghnan ojaḥ atra abhimīthāḥ śuṣṇasya cit pari māyāḥ agr̥bhṇāḥ pra-pitvam yan apa dasyūn asedhaḥ
tvam apaḥ yadave turvaśāya aramayaḥ su-dughāḥ pāraḥ indra ugram ayātam avahaḥ ha kutsam sam ha yat vām uśanā aranta devāḥ
indrākutsā vahamānā rathena ā vām atyāḥ api karṇe vahantu niḥ sīm at-bhyaḥ dhamathaḥ niḥ sadha-sthāt maghonaḥ hr̥daḥ varathaḥ tamāṁsi
vātasya yuktān su-yujaḥ cit aśvān kaviḥ cit eṣaḥ ajagan avasyuḥ viśve te atra marutaḥ sakhāyaḥ indra brahmāṇi taviṣīm avardhan
sūraḥ cit ratham pari-takmyāyām pūrvam karat uparam jūju-vāṁsam bharat cakram etaśaḥ sam riṇāti puraḥ dadhat saniṣyati kratum naḥ
ā ayam janāḥ abhi-cakṣe jagāma indraḥ sakhāyam suta-somam icchan vadan grāvā ava vedim bhriyāte yasya jīram adhvaryavaḥ caranti
ye cākananta cākananta nu te martāḥ amr̥ta mo iti te aṁhaḥ ā aran vavandhi yajyūn uta teṣu dhehi ojaḥ janeṣu yeṣu te syāma
adardaḥ utsam asr̥jaḥ vi khāni tvam arṇavān badbadhānān aramṇāḥ mahāntam indra parvatam vi yat varitivaḥ sr̥jaḥ vi dhārāḥ ava dānavam hannitihan
tvam utsān r̥tu-bhiḥ badbadhānān araṁhaḥ ūdhaḥ parvatasya vajri n ahim cit ugra pra-yutam śayānam jaghanvān indra taviṣīm adhatthāḥ
tyasya cit mahataḥ niḥ mr̥gasya vadhaḥ jaghāna taviṣībhiḥ indraḥ yaḥ ekaḥ it apratiḥ manyamānaḥ āt asmāt anyaḥ ajaniṣṭa tavyān
tyam cit eṣām svadhayā madantam mihaḥ napātam su-vr̥dham tamaḥ-gām vr̥ṣa-prabharmā dānavasya bhāmam vajreṇa vajrī ni jaghāna śuṣṇam
tyam cit asya kratu-bhiḥ ni-sattam amarmaṇaḥ vidat it asya marma yat īm su-kṣatra pra-bhr̥tā madasya yuyutsantam tamasi harmye dhāḥ
tyam cit itthā katpayam śayānam asūrye tamasi vavr̥dhānam tam cit mandānaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ sutasya uccaiḥ indraḥ apa-gūrya jaghāna
ut yat indraḥ mahate dānavāya vadhaḥ yamiṣṭa sahaḥ aprati-itam yat īm vajrasya pra-bhr̥tau dadābha viśvasya jantoḥ adhamam cakāra
tyam cit arṇam madhu-pam śayānam asinvam vavram mahi ādat ugraḥ apādam atram mahatā vadhena ni duryoṇe avr̥ṇak mr̥dhra-vācam
kaḥ asya śuṣmam taviṣīm varāte ekaḥ dhanā bharate aprati-itaḥ ime cit asya jrayasaḥ nu devī iti indrasya ojasaḥ bhiyasā jihāteiti
ni asmai devī sva-dhitiḥ jihīte indrāya gātuḥ uśatī-iva yeme sam yat ojaḥ yuvate viśvam ābhiḥ anu svadhāvne kṣitayaḥ namanta
ekam nu tvā sat-patim pāñca-janyam jātam śr̥ṇomi yaśasam janeṣu tam me jagr̥bhre āśasaḥ naviṣṭham doṣā vastoḥ havamānāsaḥ indram
eva hi tvām r̥tu-thā yātayantam maghā viprebhyaḥ dadatam śr̥ṇomi kim te brahmāṇaḥ gr̥hate sakhāyaḥ ye tvāyā ni-dadhuḥ kāmam indra
mahi mahe tavase dīdhye nr̥r̥n indrāya itthā tavase atavyān yaḥ asmai su-matim vāja-sātau stutaḥ jane sa-maryaḥ ciketa
saḥ tvam naḥ indra dhiyasānaḥ arkaiḥ harīṇām vr̥ṣan yoktram aśreḥ yāḥ itthā magha-van anu joṣam vakṣaḥ abhi pra aryaḥ sakṣi janān
na te te indra abhi asmat r̥ṣva ayuktāsaḥ abrahmatā yat asan ti ṣṭha ratham adhi tam vajra-hasta ā raśmim deva yamase su-aśvaḥ
puru yat te indra santi ukthā gave cakartha urvarāsu yudhyan tatakṣe sūryāya cit okasi sve vr̥ṣā samat-su dāsasya nāma cit
vayam te te indra ye ca naraḥ śardhaḥ jajñānāḥ yātāḥ ca rathāḥ ā asmān jagamyāt ahi-śuṣma satvā bhagaḥ na havyaḥ pra-bhr̥theṣu cāruḥ
papr̥kṣeṇyam indra tve iti hi ojaḥ nr̥mṇāni ca nr̥tamānaḥ amartaḥ saḥ naḥ enīm vasavānaḥ rayim dāḥ pra aryaḥ stuṣe tuvi-maghasya dānam
eva naḥ indra ūti-bhiḥ ava pāhi gr̥ṇataḥ śūra karūn uta tvacam dadataḥ vāja-sātau piprīhi madhvaḥ su-sutasya cāroḥ
uta tye mā pauru-kutasyasya sūreḥ trasadasyoḥ hiraṇinaḥ rarāṇāḥ vahantu mā daśa śyetāsaḥ asya gairi-kṣitasya kratu-bhiḥ nu saśce
uta tye mā māruta-aśvasya śoṇāḥ kratvāmaghāsaḥ vidathasya rātau sahasrā me cyavatānaḥ dadānaḥ ānūkam aryaḥ vapuṣe na ārcat
uta tye mā dhvanyasya juṣṭāḥ lakṣmaṇyasya su-rucaḥ yatānāḥ mahnā rāyaḥ sam-varaṇasya r̥ṣeḥ vrajam na gāvaḥ pra-yatāḥ api gman
ajāta-śatrum ajarā svaḥ-vatī anu svadhā amitā dasmam īyate sunotana pacata brahma-vāhase puru-stutāya pra-taram dadhātana
ā yaḥ somena jaṭharam apiprata amandata magha-vā madhvaḥ andhasaḥ yat īm mr̥gāya hantave mahāvadhaḥ sahasra-bhr̥ṣṭim uśanā vadham yamat
yaḥ asmai ghraṁse uta vā yaḥ ūdhani somam sunoti bhavati dyu-mān aha apa-apa sakraḥ tatanuṣṭim ūhati tanū-śubhram magha-vā yaḥ kava-sakhaḥ
yasya avadhīt pitaram yasya mātaram yasya śakroaḥ bhrātaram na ataḥ īṣate veti it oṁ iti asya pra-yatā yatam-karaḥ na kilbiṣāt īṣate vasvaḥ ākaraḥ
na pañca-bhiḥ daśa-bhiḥ vaṣṭi ārabham na asunvatā sacate puṣyatā cana jināti vā it amuyā hanti vā dhuniḥ ā deva-yum bhajati go--mati vraje
vi-tvakṣaṇaḥ sam-r̥tau cakram-āsajaḥ asunvataḥ viṣuṇaḥ sunvataḥ vr̥dhaḥ indraḥ viśvasya damitā vi-bhīṣaṇaḥ yathāvaśam nayati dāsam āryaḥ
sam īm paṇeḥ ajati bhojanam muṣe vi dāśuṣe bhajati sūnaram vasu duḥ-ge cana dhriyate viśvaḥ ā puru janaḥ yaḥ asya taviṣīm acukrudhat
sam yat janau su-dhanau viśva-śardhasau avet indraḥ magha-vā goṣu śubhriṣu yujam hi anyam akr̥ta pra-vepanī ut īm gavyam sr̥jate satva-bhiḥ dhuniḥ
sahasra-sām āgni-veśim gr̥ṇīṣe śatrim agne upa-mām ketum aryaḥ tasmai āpaḥ sam-yataḥ pīpayanta tasmin kṣatram ama-vat tveṣam astu
yaḥ te sādhiṣṭhaḥ avase indra kratuḥ ṭam ā bhara asmabhyam carṣaṇ i-saham sasnim vājeṣu dustaram
yat indra te catasraḥ yat śūra santi tisraḥ yat vā pañca kṣitīnām avaḥ tat su naḥ ā bhara
ā te avaḥ vareṇyam vr̥ṣan-tamasya hūmahe vr̥ṣa-jūtiḥ hi jajñiṣe ābhūbhiḥ indra turvaṇiḥ
vr̥ṣā hi asi rādhase jajñiṣe vr̥ṣṇi te śavaḥ sva-kṣatram te dhr̥ṣam manaḥ satrāham indra paiṁsyam
tvam tam indra martyam amitra-yantam adri-vaḥ sarva-rathā śatakrato itiśata-krato ni yāhi śavasaḥ pate
tvām it vr̥trahan-tama janāsaḥ vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ ugram pūrvīṣu pūrvyam havante vāja-sātaye
asmākam indra dustaram puraḥ-yāvānam ājiṣu sa-yāvānam dhane--dhane vāja-yantam ava ratham
asmākam indra ā ihi naḥ ratham ava puram-dhyā vayam śaviṣṭha vāryam divi śravaḥ dadhīmahi divi stomam manāmahe
saḥ ā gamat indraḥ yaḥ vasūnām ciketat dātum dāmanaḥ rayīṇām dhanva-caraḥ na vaṁsa-gaḥ tr̥ṣāṇaḥ cakamānaḥ pibatu dugdham aṁśum
ā te hanūiti hari-vaḥ śūra śipreiti ruhat somaḥ na parvatasya pr̥ṣṭhe anu tvā rājan arvataḥ na hinvan gīḥ-bhiḥ madema puru-hūta viśve
cakram na vr̥ttam puru-hūta vepate manaḥ bhiyā me amateḥ it adri-vaḥ rathāt adhi tvā jaritā sadāvr̥dha kuvit nu stoṣam magha-van puru-vasuḥ
eṣaḥ grāvāiva jaritā te indra iyarti vācam br̥hat āśuṣāṇaḥ pra sevyena magha-van yaṁsi rāyaḥ pra dakṣiṇit hari-vaḥ mā vi venaḥ
vr̥ṣā tvā vr̥ṣaṇam vardhatu dyauḥ vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣa-bhyām vahase hari-bhyām saḥ naḥ vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣa-rathaḥ su-śipra vr̥ṣakrato itivr̥ṣa-krato vr̥ṣā vajrin bhare dhāḥ
yaḥ rohitau vājinau vājinī-vān tri-bhiḥ śataiḥ sacamānau adiṣṭa yūne sam asmai kṣitayaḥ namantām śruta-rathāya marutaḥ duvaḥ-yā
sam bhānunā yatate sūryasya ājuhvānaḥ ghr̥ta-pr̥ṣṭhaḥ su-añcāḥ tasmai amr̥dhrāḥ uṣasaḥ vi ucchān yaḥ indrāya sunavāma iti āha
samiddha-agniḥ vanavat stīrṇa-barhiḥ yukta-grāvā suta-somaḥ jarāte grāvāṇaḥ yasya iṣiram vadanti ayat adhvaryuḥ haviṣā ava sindhum
vadhūḥ iyam patim icchantī eti yaḥ īm vahāte mahiṣīm iṣirām ā asya śravasyāt rathaḥ ā ca ghoṣāt puru sahasrā pari vartayāte
na saḥ rājā vyathate yasmin indraḥ tīvram somam pibati go--sakhāyam ā satvanaiḥ ajati hanti vr̥tram kṣeti kṣitīḥ su-bhagaḥ nāma puṣyan
puṣyāt kṣeme abhi yoge bhavāti ubhe iti vr̥tau saṁyatī itisam-yatī sam jayāti priyaḥ sūrye priyaḥ agnā bhavāti yaḥ indrāya suta-somaḥ dadāśat
uroḥ te indra rādhasaḥ vi-bhvī rātiḥ śatakrato itiśata-krato adha naḥ viśva-carṣaṇe dyumnā su-kṣatra maṁhaya
yat īm indra śravāyyam iṣam śaviṣṭha dadhiṣe paprathe dīrghaśrut-tamam hiraṇya-varṇa dustaram
śuṣmāsaḥ ye te adri-vaḥ mehanā keta-sāpaḥ ubhā devau abhiṣṭaye divaḥ ca gmaḥ ca rājathaḥ
uto iti naḥ asya kasya cit dakṣasya tava vr̥tra-han asmabhyam nr̥mṇam ā bhāra asmabhyam nr̥-manasyase
nu te ābhiḥ abhiṣṭi-bhiḥ tava śarman śatakrato itiśata-krato indra syāma su-gopāḥ śūra syāma su-gopāḥ
itividat-vaso ubhayāhasti ā bhara
yat manyase vareṇyam indra dyukṣam tat ā bhara vidyāma tasya te vayam akūpārasya dāvane
yat te ditsu pra-rādhyam manaḥ asti sr̥utam br̥hat tena dr̥l̥hā cit adri-vaḥ ā vājam darṣi sātaye
maṁhiṣṭham vaḥ maghonām rājānam carṣaṇīnām indram upa pra-śastaye pūrvībhiḥ jujuṣe giraḥ
asmai it kāvyam vacaḥ uktham indrāya śaṁsyam tasmai oṁ iti brahma-vāhase giraḥ vardhanti atrayaḥ giraḥ śumbhanti atrayaḥ
ā yāhi adri-bhiḥ sutam somam soma-pate piba vr̥ṣan indra vr̥ṣa-bhi ḥ vr̥trahan-tama
vr̥ṣā grāvā vr̥ṣā madaḥ vr̥ṣā somaḥ ayam sutaḥ vr̥ṣan indra vr̥ṣa-bhiḥ vr̥trahan-tama
vr̥ṣā tvā vr̥ṣaṇam huve vajrin citrābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ vr̥ṣan indra vr̥ṣa-bhiḥ vr̥trahan-tama
r̥jīṣī vajrī vr̥ṣabhaḥ turāṣāṭ śuṣmī rājā vr̥tra-hā sama-pāvā yuktvā hari-bhyām upa yāsat arvāṅ mādhyandine savane matsat indraḥ
yat tvā sūrya svaḥ-bhānuḥ tamasā avidhyat āsuraḥ akṣetra-vit yathā mugdhaḥ bhuvanāni adīdhayuḥ
svaḥ-bhānoḥ adha yat indra māyā avaḥ divaḥ vartamānāḥ ava-ahan gūl̥ham sūryam tamasā apa-vratena turīyeṇa brahmaṇā avindat atri ḥ
mā mām imam tava santam atre irasyā drugdhaḥ bhiyasā ni gārīt tvam mitraḥ asi satya-rādhāḥ tau mā iha avatam varuṇaḥ ca rājā
grāvṇaḥ brahmā yuyujānaḥ saparyan kīriṇā devān namasā upa-śikṣan atriḥ sūryasya divi cakṣuḥ ā adhāt svaḥ-bhānoḥ apa māyā adhukṣat
yam vai sūryam svaḥ-bhānuḥ tamasā avidhyat āsuraḥ atrayaḥ tam anu avindan nahi anye aśaknuvan
kaḥ nu vām mitrāvaruṇau r̥ta-yan divaḥ vā mahaḥ pārthivasya vā de r̥tasya vā sadasi trāsīthām naḥ yajña-yate vā paśu-saḥ na vājān
te naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ aryamā āyuḥ indraḥ r̥bhukṣāḥ marutaḥ juṣanta namaḥ-bhiḥ vā ye dadhate su-vr̥ktim stomam rudrāya mīl̥huṣe sa-joṣāḥ
ā vām yeṣṭhā aśvinā huvadhyai vātasya patman rathyasya puṣṭau uta vā divaḥ asurāya manma pra andhāṁsi-iva yajyave bharadhvam
pra sakṣaṇaḥ divyaḥ kaṇva-hotā tritaḥ divaḥ sa-joṣāḥ vātaḥ agniḥ pūṣā bhagaḥ pra-bhr̥the viśva-bhojāḥ ājim na jagmuḥ āśvaśva-tamāḥ
pra vaḥ rayim yukta-aśvam bharadhvam rāyaḥ eṣe avase dadhīta dhīḥ su-śevaḥ evaiḥ auśijasya hotā ye vaḥ evāḥ marutaḥ turāṇām
pra vaḥ vāyum ratha-yujam kr̥ṇudhvam pra devam vipram panitāram arkaiḥ iṣudhyavaḥ r̥ta-sāpaḥ puram-dhīḥ vasvīḥ naḥ atra patnīḥ ā dhiye dhuritidhuḥ
upa vaḥ eṣe vandyebhiḥ śūṣaiḥ pra yahvī iti divaḥ citayat-bhiḥ arkaiḥ uṣasānaktā viduṣīivetividuṣī-iva viśvam ā ha vahataḥ martyāya yajñam
abhi vaḥ arce poṣyāvataḥ nr̥r̥n vāstoḥ patim tvaṣṭāram rarāṇaḥ dhanyā sa-joṣāḥ dhiṣaṇā namaḥ-bhiḥ vanaspatīn oṣadhīḥ rāyaḥ eṣe
tuje naḥ tane parvatāḥ santu sva-etavaḥ ye vasavaḥ na vīrāḥ panitaḥ āptyaḥ yajataḥ sadā naḥ vardhāt naḥ śaṁsam naryaḥ abhiṣṭau
vr̥ṣṇaḥ astoṣi bhūmyasya garbham tritaḥ napātam apām su-vr̥kti gr̥ṇīte agniḥ etari na śūṣaiḥ śociḥ-keśaḥ ni riṇāti vanā
kathā mahe rudriyāya bravāma kat rāye cikituṣe bhagāya āpaḥ oṣadhīḥ uta naḥ avantu dyauḥ vanā girayaḥ vr̥kṣa-keśāḥ
śr̥ṇotu naḥ ūrjām patiḥ giraḥ saḥ nabhaḥ tarīyān iṣiraḥ pari-jmā śr̥ṇvantu āpaḥ puraḥ na śubhrāḥ pari srucaḥ babr̥hāṇasya adreḥ
vida cit nu mahāntaḥ ye vaḥ evāḥ bravāma dasmāḥ vāryam dadhānāḥ vayaḥ cana su-bhvaḥ ā ava yanti kṣubhā martam anu-yatam vadha-snaiḥ
ā daivyāni pārthivāni janma apaḥ ca accha su-makhāya vocam vardhantām dyāvaḥ giraḥ candra-agrāḥ udā vardhantām abhi-sātāḥ arṇāḥ
pade--pade me jarimā ni dhāyi varūtrī vā śakrā yā pāyu-bhiḥ ca sisaktu mātā mahī rasā naḥ smat sūri-bhiḥ r̥ju-hastā r̥ju-vaniḥ
kathā dāśema namasā su-dānūn eva-yā marutaḥ accha-uktau pra-śravasaḥ marutaḥ accha-uktau mā naḥ ahiḥ budhnyaḥ riṣe dhāt asmākam bhūt upamāti-vaniḥ
iti cit nu pra-jāyai paśu-matyai devāsaḥ vanate martyaḥ vaḥ ā devāsaḥ vanate martyaḥ vaḥ atra śivām tanvaḥ dhāsim asyāḥ jarām c it me niḥ-r̥tiḥ jagrasīta
tām vaḥ devāḥ su-matim ūrjayantīm iṣam aśyāma vasavaḥ śasā goḥ sā naḥ su-dānuḥ mr̥l̥ayantī devī prati dravantī suvitāya gamyāḥ
abhi naḥ il̥ā yūthasya mātā smat nadībhiḥ urvaśī vā gr̥ṇātu urvaśī vā br̥hat-divā gr̥ṇanā abhi-ūrṇvānā pra-bhr̥thasya āyoḥ
sisaktu naḥ ūrjavyasya puṣṭeḥ
pra śam-tamā varuṇam dīdhitī gīḥ mitram bhagam aditim nūnam aśyāḥ pr̥ṣat-yoniḥ pañca-hotā śr̥ṇotu atūrta-panthāḥ asuraḥ mayaḥ-bhuḥ
prati me stomam aditiḥ jagr̥bhyāt sūnum na mātā hr̥dyam su-śevam brahma priyam deva-hitam yat asti aham mitre varuṇe yat mayaḥ-bhuḥ
ut īraya kavi-tamam kavīnām unatta enam abhi madhvā ghr̥tena saḥ naḥ vasūni pra-yatā hitāni candrāṇi devaḥ savitā suvāti
sam indra ṇaḥ manasā neṣi gobhiḥ sam sūri-bhiḥ hari-vaḥ sam svasti sam brahmaṇā deva-hitam yat asti sam devānām su-matyā yajñ iyānām
devaḥ bhagaḥ savitā rāyaḥ aṁśaḥ indraḥ vr̥trasya sam-jitaḥ dhanānām r̥bhukṣāḥ vājaḥ uta vā puram-dhiḥ avantu naḥ amr̥tāsaḥ turāsaḥ
marutvataḥ aprati-itasya jiṣṇoḥ ajūryataḥ pra bravāma kr̥tāni na te pūrve magha-van na aparāsaḥ na vīryam nūtanaḥ kaḥ cana āpa
upa stuhi prathamam ratna-dheyam br̥haspatim sanitāram dhanānām yaḥ śaṁsate stuvate śam-bhaviṣṭhaḥ puru-vasuḥ āgamat johuvānam
tava ūti-bhiḥ sacamānāḥ ariṣṭāḥ br̥haspate magha-vānaḥ su-vīrāḥ ye aśva-dāḥ uta vā santi go--dāḥ ye vastra-dāḥ su-bhagāḥ teṣu rāyaḥ
vi-sarmāṇam kr̥ṇuhi vittam eṣām ye bhuñjate apr̥ṇantaḥ naḥ ukthaiḥ apa-vratān pra-save vavr̥dhānān brahma-dviṣaḥ sūryāt yavayasva
yaḥ ohate rakṣasaḥ deva-vītau acakrebhiḥ tam marutaḥ ni yāta yaḥ vaḥ samīm śaśamānasya nindāt tucchyān kāmān karate sisvidānaḥ
tam oṁ iti stuhi yaḥ su-iṣuḥ su-dhanvā yaḥ viśvasya kṣayati bheṣajasya yakṣva mahe saumanasāya rudram namaḥ-bhiḥ devam asuram duvasya
damūnasaḥ apasaḥ ye su-hastāḥ vr̥ṣṇaḥ patnīḥ nadyaḥ vibhva-taṣṭāḥ sarasvatī br̥hat-divā uta rākā daśasyantīḥ varivasyantu śubhrāḥ
pra su mahe suśaraṇāya medhām giram bhare navyasīm jāyamānām yaḥ āhanāḥ duhituḥ vakṣaṇāsu rūpā minānaḥ akr̥ṇot idam naḥ
pra suṣṭutiḥ stanayantaṁ ruvantam il̥as patiñ jaritar nūnam aśyāḥ yo abdimāṁm iyartipra vidyutā rodasī ukṣamāṇaḥ
eṣaḥ stomaḥ mārutam śardhaḥ accha rudrasya sūnūn yuvanyūn ut aśyāḥ kāmaḥ rāye havate mā svasti upa stuhi pr̥ṣat-aśvān ayāsaḥ
pra eṣaḥ stomaḥ pr̥thivīm antarikṣam vanaspatīn oṣadhīḥ rāye aśyāḥ devaḥ-devaḥ su-havaḥ bhūtu mahyam mā naḥ mātā pr̥thivī duḥ-matau dhāt
urau devāḥ ani-bādhe syāma
sam aśvinoḥ avasā nūtanena mayaḥ-bhuvā su-pranītī gamema ā naḥ rayim vahatam ā uta vīrān ā viśvāni amr̥tā saubhagāni
ā dhenavaḥ payasā tūrṇi-arthāḥ amardhantīḥ upa naḥ yantu madhvā mahaḥ rāye br̥hatīḥ sapta vipraḥ mayaḥ-bhuvaḥ jaritā johavīti
ā su-stutī namasā vartayadhyai dyāvā vājāya pr̥thivī iti amr̥dhreiti pitā mātā madhu-vacāḥ su-hastā bhare--bhare naḥ yaśasau aviṣṭām
adhvaryavaḥ cakr̥-vāṁsaḥ madhūni pra vāyave bharata cāru śukram hotāiva naḥ prathamaḥ pāhi asya deva madhvaḥ rarima te madāya
daśa kṣipaḥ yuñjate bāhū iti adrim somasya yā śamitārā su-hastā madhvaḥ rasam su-gabhastiḥ giri-sthām caniścadat duduhe śukram aṁśuḥ
asāvi te jujuṣāṇāya somaḥ kratve dakṣāya br̥hate madāya harī iti rathe su-dhurā yoge arvāk indra priyā kr̥ṇuhi hūyamānaḥ
ā naḥ mahīm aramatim sa-joṣāḥ gnām devīm namasā rāta-havyām madhoḥ madāya br̥hatīm r̥ta-jñām ā agne vaha pathi-bhiḥ deva-yānaiḥ
añjanti yam prathayantaḥ na viprāḥ vapāvantam na agninā tapantaḥ pituḥ na putraḥ upasi preṣṭhaḥ ā gharmaḥ agnim r̥tayan asādi
accha mahī br̥hatī śam-tamā gīḥ dūtaḥ na gantu aśvinā huvadhyai mayaḥ-bhuvā sarathā ā yātam arvāk gantam ni-dhim dhuram āṇiḥ na nābhim
pra tavyasaḥ namaḥ-uktim turasya aham pūṣṇaḥ uta vāyoḥ adikṣi yā rādhasā coditārā matīnām yā vājasya draviṇaḥ-dau uta tman
ā nāma-bhiḥ marutaḥ vakṣi viśvān ā rūpebhiḥ jāta-vedaḥ huvānaḥ yajñam giraḥ jarituḥ su-stutim ca viśve ganta marutaḥ viśve ūtī
ā naḥ divaḥ br̥hataḥ parvatāt ā sarasvatī yajatā gantu yajñam havam devī jujuṣāṇā ghr̥tācī śagmām naḥ vācam uśatī śr̥ṇotu
ā vedhasam nīla-pr̥ṣṭham br̥hantam br̥haspatim sadane sādayadhvam sādat-yonim dame ā dīdi-vāṁsam hiraṇya-varṇam aruṣam sapema
ā dharṇasiḥ br̥hat-divaḥ rarāṇaḥ viśvebhiḥ gantu oma-bhiḥ huvānaḥ gnāḥ vasānaḥ oṣadhīḥ amr̥dhraḥ tridhātu-śr̥ṅgaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ vayaḥ-dhāḥ
mātuḥ pade parame śukre āyoḥ vipanyavaḥ rāspirāsaḥ agman su-śevyam namasā rāta-havyāḥ śiśum mr̥janti āyavaḥ na vāse
br̥hat vayaḥ br̥hate tubhyam agne dhiyājuraḥ mithunāsaḥ sacanta devaḥ-devaḥ su-havaḥ bhūtu mahyam mā naḥ mātā pr̥thivī duḥ-matau dhāt
urau devāḥ ani-bādhe syāma
sam aśvinoḥ avasā nūtanena mayaḥ-bhuvā su-pranītī gamema ā naḥ rayim vahatam ā uta vīrān ā viśvāni amr̥tā saubhagāni
tam pratna-thā pūrva-thā viśva-thā im-athā jyeṣṭha-tātim barhi-sadam svaḥ-vidam pratīcīnam vr̥janam dohase girā āśum jayantam anu yāsu vardhase
śriye su-dr̥śīḥ uparasya yāḥ svaḥ vi-rocamānaḥ kakubhām acodate su-gopāḥ asi na dabhāya sukrato itisu-krato paraḥ māyābhiḥ r̥te āsa nāma te
atyam haviḥ sacate sat ca dhātu ca ariṣta-gātuḥ saḥ hotā sahaḥ-bhariḥ pra-sarsrāṇaḥ anu barhiḥ vr̥ṣā śiśuḥ madhye yuvā ajaraḥ vi-sruhā hitaḥ
pra vaḥ ete su-yujaḥ yāman iṣṭaye nīcīḥ amuṣmai yamyaḥ r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ suyantu-bhiḥ sarva-śāsaiḥ abhīśu-bhiḥ kriviḥ nāmāni pravaṇe muṣāyati
sam-jarbhurāṇaḥ taru-bhiḥ sute--gr̥bham vayākinam citta-garbhāsu su-svaruḥ dhāra-vākeṣu r̥ju-gātha śobhase vardhasva patnīḥ abhi jīvaḥ adhvare
yādr̥k eva dadr̥śe tādr̥k ucyate sam chāyayā dadhire sidhrayā ap-su ā mahīm asmabhyam uru-sām uru jrayaḥ br̥hat su-vīram anapa-cyutam sahaḥ
veti agruḥ jani-vān vai ati spr̥dhaḥ sa-maryatā manasā sūryaḥ kaviḥ ghraṁsam rakṣantam pari viśvataḥ gayam asmākam śarma vanavat sva-vasuḥ
jyāyāṁsam asya yatunasya ketunā r̥ṣi-svaram carati yāsu nāma te yādr̥śmin dhāyi tam apasyayā vidat yaḥ oṁ iti svayam vahate saḥ aram karat
samudram āsām ava tasthe agrimā na riṣyati savanam yasmin āyatā atra na hārdi kravaṇasya rejate yatra matiḥ vidyate pūta-bandhanī
saḥ hi kṣatrasya manasasya citti-bhiḥ eva-vadasya yajatasya sadhreḥ ava-tsārasya spr̥ṇavāma raṇva-bhiḥ śaviṣṭham vājam viduṣā cit ardhyam
śyenaḥ āsām aditiḥ kakṣyaḥ madaḥ viśva-vārasya yajatasya māyinaḥ sam anyam-anyam arthayanti etave viduḥ vi-sāṇam pari-pānam anti te
sadāpr̥ṇaḥ yajataḥ vi dviṣaḥ vadhīt bāhu-vr̥ktaḥ śruta-vit taryaḥ vaḥ sacā ubhā saḥ varā prati eti bhāti ca yat īm gaṇam bhajate suprayāva-bhiḥ
sutam-bharaḥ yajamānasya sat-patiḥ viśvāsām ūdhaḥ saḥ dhiyām ut-añcanaḥ bharat dhenuḥ rasa-vat śiśriye payaḥ anu-bruvāṇaḥ adhi eti na svapan
yaḥ jāgāra tam r̥caḥ kāmayante yaḥ jāgāra tam oṁ iti sāmāni yanti yaḥ jāgāra tam ayam somaḥ āha tava aham asmi sakhye ni-okāḥ
agniḥ jāgāra tam r̥caḥ kāmayante agniḥ jāgāra tam oṁ iti sāmāni yanti agniḥ jāgāra tam ayam somaḥ āha tava aham asmi sakhye ni-okāḥ
vidāḥ divaḥ vi-syan adrim ukthaiḥ āyatyāḥ uṣasaḥ arcinaḥ guḥ apa avr̥ta vrajinīḥ ut svaḥ gāt vi duraḥ mānuṣīḥ devaḥ āvar ity āvaḥ
vi sūryaḥ amatim na śriyam sāt ā ūrvāt gavām mātā jānatī gāt dhanva-arṇasaḥ nadyaḥ khādaḥ-arṇāḥ sthūṇāiva su-mitā dr̥ṁhata dyauḥ
asmai ukthāya parvatasya garbhaḥ mahīnām januṣe pūrvyāya vi pavartaḥ jihīta sādhata dyauḥ āvivāsantaḥ dasayanta bhūma
su-uktebhiḥ vaḥ vacaḥ-bhiḥ deva-juṣṭaiḥ indrā nu agnī iti avase huvadhyai ukthebhiḥ hi sma kavayaḥ s-yajñāḥ āvivāsantaḥ marutaḥ yajanti
eto iti nu adya su-dhyaḥ bhavāma pra ducchunāḥ minavāma varīyaḥ āre dveṣāṁsi sanutaḥ dadhāma ayāma prāñcaḥ yajamānam accha
ā ita dhiyam kr̥ṇavāma sakhāyaḥ apa yā mātā r̥ṇuta vrajam goḥ yayā manuḥ viśi-śipram jigāya yayā vaṇik vaṅkuḥ āpa purīṣam
anūnot atra hasta-yataḥ adriḥ ārcan yena daśa māsaḥ nava-gvāḥ r̥tam yatī saramā gāḥ avindat viśvāni satyā aṅgirāḥ cakāra
viśve asyāḥ vi-uṣi māhināyāḥ sam yat gobhiḥ aṅgirasaḥ navanta utsaḥ āsām parame sadha-sthe r̥tasya pathā saramā vidat gāḥ
ā sūryaḥ yātu sapta-aśvaḥ kṣetram yat asya urviyā dīrgha-yāthe raghuḥ śyenaḥ patayat andhaḥ accha yuvā kaviḥ dīdayat goṣu gacchan
ā sūryaḥ aruhat śukram arṇaḥ ayukta yat haritaḥ vīta-pr̥ṣṭhāḥ udnā na nāvam anayanta dhīrāḥ āśr̥ṇvatīḥ āpaḥ arvāk atiṣṭhan
dhiyam vaḥ ap-su dadhiṣe svaḥ-sām yayā ataran daśa māsaḥ nava-gvāḥ ayā dhiyā syāma deva-gopāḥ ayā dhiyā tuturyāma ati aṁhaḥ
hayaḥ na vidvān ayuji svayam dhuri tām vahāmi prataraṇīm avasyuvam na asyāḥ vaśmi vi-mucam na āvr̥tam punaḥ vidvān pathaḥ puraḥ-etā r̥ju neṣati
agne indra varuṇa mitra devāḥ śardhaḥ pra yanta māruta uta viṣṇo iti ubhā nāsatyā rudraḥ adha gnāḥ pūṣā bhagaḥ sarasvatī juṣanta
indrāgnī iti mitrāvaruṇā aditim svar iti svaḥ pr̥thivīm dyām marutaḥ parvatān apaḥ huve viṣṇum pūṣaṇam brahmaṇaḥ patim bhagam nu śaṁsam sav itāram ūtaye
uta naḥ viṣṇuḥ uta vātaḥ asridhaḥ draviṇaḥ-dā uta somaḥ mayaḥ karat uta r̥bhavaḥ uta rāye naḥ aśvinā uta tvaṣṭā uta vibhvā anu maṁsate
uta tyam naḥ mārutam śardhaḥ ā gamat divi-kṣayam yajatam barhiḥ āsade br̥haspatiḥ śarma pūṣā uta naḥ yamat varūthyam varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā
uta tye naḥ parvatāsaḥ su-śastayaḥ su-dītayaḥ nadyaḥ trāmaṇe bhuvan bhagaḥ vi-bhaktā śavasā avasā ā gamat uru-vyacāḥ aditiḥ śrotu me havam
devānām patnīḥ uśatīḥ avantu naḥ pra avantu naḥ tujaye vāja-sātaye yāḥ pārthivāsaḥ yāḥ apām api vrate tāḥ naḥ devīḥ su-havāḥ śarma yacchata
uta gnāḥ vyantu deva-patnīḥ indrāṇī agnāyī aśvinī rāṭ ā rodasī iti varuṇānī śr̥ṇotu vyantu devīḥ yaḥ r̥tuḥ janīnām
prayuñjatī divaḥ eti bruvāṇā mahī mātā duhituḥ bodhayantī āvivāsantī yuvatiḥ manīṣā pitr̥-bhyaḥ ā sadane johuvānā
ajirāsaḥ tat-apaḥ īyamānāḥ ātasthi-vāṁsaḥ amr̥tasya nābhim anantāsaḥ uravaḥ viśvataḥ sīm pari dyāvāpr̥thivī iti yanti panthāḥ
ukṣā samudraḥ aruṣaḥ su-parṇaḥ pūrvasya yonim pituḥ ā viveśa madhye divaḥ ni-hitaḥ pr̥śniḥ aśmā vi cakrame rajasaḥ pāti antau
catvāraḥ īm bibhrati kṣema-yantaḥ daśa garbham carase dhāpayante tri-dhātavaḥ paramāḥ asya gāvaḥ divaḥ caranti pari sadyaḥ antān
idam vapuḥ ni-vacanam janāsaḥ caranti yat nadyaḥ tasthuḥ āpaḥ dve iti yat īm bibhr̥taḥ mātuḥ anye iha-iha jāte iti yamyā sabandhūitisa-bandhū
vi tanvate dhiyaḥ asmai apāṁsi vastrā putrāya mātaraḥ vayanti upa-prakṣe vr̥ṣaṇaḥ modamānāḥ divaḥ pathā vadhvaḥ yanti accha
tat astu mitrāvaruṇā tat agne śam yoḥ asmabhyam idam astu śastam aśīmahi gādham uta prati-sthām namaḥ dive br̥hate sādanāya
kat oṁ iti priyāya dhāmne manāmahe sva-kṣatrāya sva-yaśase mahe vayam āmenyasya rajasaḥ yat abhre ā apaḥ vr̥ṇānā vi-tanoti māyinī
tāḥ atnata vayunam vīra-vakṣaṇam samānyā vr̥tayā viśvam ā rajaḥ apo iti apācīḥ aparāḥ apa ījate pra pūrvābhiḥ tirate deva-yuḥ janaḥ
ā grāva-bhiḥ ahanyebhiḥ aktu-bhiḥ variṣṭham vajram ā jigharti māyini śatam vā yasya pra-caran sve dame sam-vartayantaḥ vi ca vataryan ahā
tām asya rītim paraśoḥ-iva prati anīkam akhyam bhuje asya varpasaḥ sacā yadi pitumantam-iva kṣayam ratnam dadhāti bhara-hūtaye vi śe
saḥ jihvayā catuḥ-anīkaḥ r̥ñjate cāru vasānaḥ varuṇaḥ yatan arim na tasya vidma puruṣa-tvatā vayam yataḥ bhagaḥ savitā dāti vāryam
devam vaḥ adya savitāram ā īṣe bhagam ca ratnam vi-bhajantam āyoḥ ā vām narā puru-bhujā vavr̥tyām dive--dive cit aśvinā sakhi-yan
prati pra-yānam asurasya vidvān su-uktaiḥ devam savitāram duvasya upa bruvīta namasā vi-jānan jyeṣṭham ca ratnam vi-bhajantam āyoḥ
adatra-yā dayate vāryāṇi pūṣā bhagaḥ aditiḥ vaste usraḥ indraḥ viṣṇuḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ agniḥ ahāni bhadrā janayanta dasmāḥ
tat naḥ anarvā savitā varūtham tat sindhavaḥ iṣayantaḥ anu gman upa yat voce adhvarasya hotā rāyaḥ syāma patayaḥ vāja-ratnāḥ
pra ye vasu-bhyaḥ īvat ā namaḥ duḥ ye mitre varuṇe sūkta-vācaḥ ava etu abhvam kr̥ṇuta varīyaḥ divaḥpr̥thivyoḥ avasā madema
viśvaḥ devasya netuḥ martaḥ vurīta sakhyam viśvaḥ rāye iṣudhyati dyumnam vr̥ṇīta puṣyase
te te deva netaḥ ye ca imān anu-śase te rāyā te hi āpr̥ce sacemahi sacathyaiḥ
ataḥ naḥ ā nr̥r̥n atithīn ataḥ patnīḥ daśasyata āre viśvam pathe--sthām dviṣaḥ yuyotuyūyuviḥ
yatra vahniḥ abhi-hitaḥ dudravat droṇyaḥ paśuḥ nr̥-manāḥ vīra-pastyaḥ arṇāḥ dhīrāiva sanitā
eṣaḥ te deva netariti rathaḥpatiḥ śam rayiḥ śam rāye śam svastaye iṣaḥ-stutaḥ manāmahe deva-stutaḥ manāmahe
agne sutasya pītaye viśvaiḥ ūmebhiḥ ā gahi devebhiḥ havya-dātaye
r̥ta-dhītayaḥ ā gata satya-dharmāṇaḥ adhvaram agneḥ pibata jihvayā
viprebhiḥ vipra santya prātaryāva-bhiḥ ā gahi devebhiḥ soma-pītaye
ayam somaḥ camū iti sutaḥ amatre pari sicyate priyaḥ indrāya vāyave
vāyo iti ā yāhi vītaye juṣāṇaḥ havya-dātaye piba sutasya andhasaḥ abhi prayaḥ
indraḥ ca vāyo iti eṣām sutānām pītim arhathaḥ tān juṣethām arepasau abhi prayaḥ
sutāḥ indrāya vāyave somāsaḥ dadhi-āśiraḥ nimnam na yanti sindhavaḥ abhi prayaḥ
sa-jūḥ viśvebhiḥ devebhiḥ aśvi-bhyām uṣasā sa-jūḥ ā yāhi agne atri-vat sute raṇa
sa-jūḥ mitrāvaruṇābhyām sa-jūḥ somena viṣṇunā ā yāhi agne atri-vat sute raṇa
sa-jūḥ ādityaiḥ vasu-bhiḥ sa-jūḥ indreṇa vāyunā ā yāhi agne atri-vat sute raṇa
svasti naḥ mimītām aśvinā bhagaḥ svasti devī aditiḥ anarvaṇaḥ svasti pūṣā asuraḥ dadhātu naḥ svasti dyāvāpr̥thivī iti su-cetunā
svastaye vayum upa bravāmahai somam svasti bhuvanasya yaḥ patiḥ br̥haspatim sarva-gaṇam svastaye svastaye ādityāsaḥ bhavantu naḥ
viśve devāḥ naḥ adya svastaye vaiśvānaraḥ vasuḥ agniḥ svastaye devāḥ avantu r̥bhavaḥ svastaye svasti naḥ rudraḥ pātu aṁhasaḥ
svasti mitrāvaruṇā svasti pathye revati svasti naḥ indraḥ ca agniḥ ca svasti naḥ adite kr̥dhi
svasti panthām anu carema sūryācandramasau-iva punaḥ dadatā aghnatā jānatā sam gamemahi
pra śyāva-aśva dhr̥ṣṇu-yā arca marut-bhiḥ r̥kva-bhiḥ ye adrogham anu-svadham śravaḥ madanti yajñiyāḥ
te hi sthirasya śavasaḥ sakhāyaḥ santi dhr̥ṣṇu-yā te yāman ā dhr̥ṣat-vinaḥ tmanā pānti śaśvataḥ
te spandrāsaḥ na ukṣaṇaḥ ati skandanti śarvarīḥ marutām adha mahaḥ divi kṣamā ca manmahe
marut-su vaḥ dadhīmahi stomam yajñam ca dhr̥ṣṇu-yā viśve ye mānuṣā yugā pānti martyam riṣaḥ
arhantaḥ ye su-dānavaḥ naraḥ asāmi-śavasaḥ pra yajñam yajñiyebhyaḥ divaḥ arca marut-bhyaḥ
ā rukmaiḥ ā yudhā naraḥ r̥ṣvāḥ r̥ṣṭīḥ asr̥kṣata anu enān aha vi-dyutaḥ marutaḥ jajjhatīḥ-iva bhānuḥ arta tmanā divaḥ
ye vavr̥dhanta pārthivāḥ ye urau antarikṣe ā vr̥jane vā nadīnām sadha-sthe vā mahaḥ divaḥ
śardhaḥ mārutam ut śaṁsa satya-śavasam r̥bhvasam uta sma te śubhe naraḥ pra spandrāḥ yujata tmanā
uta sma te paruṣṇyām ūrṇāḥ vasata śundhyavaḥ uta pavyā rathānām adrim bhindanti ojasā
āpathayaḥ vi-pathayaḥ antaḥ-pathāḥ anu-pathāḥ etebhiḥ mahyam nāma-bhiḥ yajñam vi-stāraḥ ohate
adha naraḥ ni ohate adha ni-yutaḥ ohate adha pārāvatāḥ iti citrā rūpāṇi darśyā
chandaḥ-stubhaḥ kubhanyavaḥ utsam ā kīriṇaḥ nr̥tuḥ te me ke cit na tāyavaḥ ūmāḥ āsan dr̥śi tviṣe
yaḥ r̥ṣvāḥ r̥ṣṭi-vidyutaḥ kavayaḥ santi vedhasaḥ tam r̥ṣe mārutam gaṇam namasya ramaya girā
accha r̥ṣe mārutam gaṇam dānā mitram na yoṣaṇā divaḥ vā dhr̥ṣṇavaḥ ojasā stutāḥ dhībhiḥ iṣaṇyata
nu manvānaḥ eṣām devān accha na vakṣaṇā dānā saceta sūri-bhiḥ yāma-śrutebhiḥ añji-bhiḥ
pra ye me bandhu-eṣe gām vocanta sūrayaḥ pr̥śnim vocanta mātaram adha pitaram iṣmiṇam rudram vocanta śikvasaḥ
sapta me sapta śākinaḥ ekam-ekā śatā daduḥ yamunāyām adhi śr̥utam ut rādhaḥ gavyam mr̥je ni rādhaḥ aśvyam mr̥je
kaḥ veda jānam eṣām kaḥ vā purā sumneṣu āsa marutām yat yuyujre k ilāsyaḥ
ā etān ratheṣu tasthuṣaḥ kaḥ śuśrāva kathā yayuḥ kasmai sasruḥ su-dāse anu āpayaḥ il̥ābhiḥ vr̥ṣṭayaḥ saha
te me āhuḥ ye āyayuḥ upa dyu-bhiḥ vi-bhiḥ made naraḥ maryāḥ arepasaḥ imān paśyan iti stuhi
ye añjiṣu ye vāśīṣu sva-bhānavaḥ srakṣu rukmeṣu khādiṣu śrāyāḥ ratheṣu dhanva-su
yuṣmākam sma rathān anu mude dadhe marutaḥ jīra-dānavaḥ vr̥ṣṭī dyāvaḥ yatīḥ-iva
ā yam naraḥ su-dānavaḥ dadāśuṣe divaḥ kośam acucyavuḥ vi parjanyam sr̥jantiḥrodasī itiḥanuḥdhanvanāḥyantiḥvr̥ṣṭayaḥ
tatr̥dānāḥ sindhavaḥ kṣodasā rajaḥ pra sasruḥ dhenavaḥ yathā syannāḥ aśvāḥ-iva adhvanaḥ vi-mocane vi yat vartante enyaḥ
ā yāta marutaḥ divaḥ ā antarikṣāt amāt uta mā ava sthāta parāvataḥ
iti it sumnam astu vaḥ
tam vaḥ śardham rathānām tveṣam gaṇam mārutam navyasīnām anu pra yanti vr̥ṣṭayaḥ
śardham-śardham vaḥ eṣām vrātam-vrātam gaṇam-gaṇam suśasti-bhiḥ anu krāmema dhīti-bhiḥ
kasmai adya su-jātāya rāta-havyāya pra yayuḥ enā yāmena marutaḥ
yena tokāya tanayāya dhānyam bījam vahadhve akṣitam asmabhyam tat dhattana yat vaḥ īmahe rādhaḥ viśva-āyu saubhagam
ati iyāma nidaḥ tiraḥ svasti-bhiḥ hitvā avadyam arātīḥ vr̥ṣṭavī sam yoḥ āpaḥ usri bheṣajam syāma marutaḥ saha
su-devaḥ samaha asati su-vīraḥ naraḥ marutaḥ saḥ martyaḥ yam trāyadhve syāma te
stuhi bhojān stuvataḥ asya yāmani raṇam gāvaḥ na yavase yataḥ pūrvān-iva sakhīn anu hvaya girā gr̥ṇīhi kāminaḥ
pra śardhāya mārutāya sva-bhānavaḥ imām vācam anaja parvata-cyute gharma-stubhe divaḥ ā pr̥ṣṭha-yajvane dyumna-śravase mahi nr̥mṇam arcata
pra vaḥ marutaḥ taviṣāḥ udanyavaḥ vayaḥ-vr̥dhaḥ aśva-yujaḥ pari-jrayaḥ sam vi-dyutā dadhati vāśati tritaḥ svaranti āpaḥ avanā pari-jrayaḥ
vidyut-mahasaḥ naraḥ aśma-didyavaḥ vāta-tviṣaḥ marutaḥ parvata-cyutaḥ abda-yā cit muhuḥ ā hrāduni-vr̥taḥ stanayat-amāḥ rabhasāḥ ut-ojasaḥ
vi aktūn rudrāḥ vi ahāni śikvasaḥ vi antarikṣam vi rajāṁsi dhūtayaḥ vi yat ajrān ajatha nāvaḥ īm yathā vi duḥ-gāni marutaḥ na aha riṣyatha
tat vīryam vaḥ marutaḥ mahi-tvanam dīrgham tatāna sūryaḥ na yojanam etāḥ na yāme agr̥bhīta-śociṣaḥ anaśva-dām yat ni ayātana giri m
abhrāji śardhaḥ marutaḥ yat arṇasam moṣatha vr̥kṣam kapanāiva vedhasaḥ adha sma naḥ aramatim sa-joṣasaḥ cakṣuḥ-iva yantam anu neṣatha su-gam
na saḥ jīyate marutaḥ na hanyate na sredhati na vyathate na riṣyt na asya rāyaḥ upa dasyanti na ūtayaḥ rṣim vā yam rājānam vā susūdatha
niyutvantaḥ grāma-jitaḥ yathā naraḥ aryamaṇaḥ na marutaḥ kavandhinaḥ pinvanti utsam yat ināsaḥ asvaran vi undanti pr̥thivīm madhvaḥ andhasā
pravatvatī iyam pr̥thivī marut-bhyaḥ pravatvatī dyauḥ bhavati prayat-bhyaḥ pravatvatīḥ pathyāḥ antarikṣyāḥ pravatvantaḥ parvatāḥ jīra-dānavaḥ
yat marutaḥ sa-bharasaḥ svaḥ-naraḥ sūrye ut-ite madatha divaḥ naraḥ na vaḥ aśvāḥ śrathayanta aha sisrataḥ sadyaḥ asya adhvanaḥ pāram aśnutha
aṁseṣu vaḥ r̥ṣṭayaḥ pat-su khādayaḥ vakṣaḥ-su rukmāḥ marutaḥ rathe śubhaḥ agni-bhrājasaḥ vi-dyutaḥ gabhastyoḥ śiprāḥ śīr̥ṣa-su vi-tatāḥ hiraṇyayīḥ
tam nākam aryaḥ agr̥bhīta-śociṣam ruśat pippalam marutaḥ vi dhūnutha sam acyanta vr̥janā atitviṣanta yat svaranti ghoṣam vi-tatam r̥ta-yavaḥ
yuṣmādattasya marutaḥ vi-cetasaḥ rāyaḥ syāma rathyaḥ vayasvataḥ na yaḥ yucchati tiṣyaḥ yathā divaḥ asme iti roranta marutaḥ sahasriṇam
yūyam rayim marutaḥ spārha-vīram yūyam r̥ṣim avatha sāma-vipram yūyam arvantam bharatāya vājam yūyam dhattha rājānam śruṣṭi-mantam
tat vaḥ yāmi draviṇam sadyaḥ-ūtayaḥ yena svaḥ na tatanāma nr̥r̥n abhi idam su me marutaḥ haryata vacaḥ yasya tarema śatam himāḥ
pra-yajyavaḥ marutaḥ bhrājat-r̥ṣṭayaḥ br̥hat vayaḥ dadhire rukma-vakṣasaḥ īyante aśvaiḥ su-yamebhiḥ āśu-bhiḥ śubham yātām anu rathāḥ avr̥tsata
svayam dadhidhve taviṣīm yathā vida br̥hat mahāntaḥ urviyā vi rājatha uta antarikṣam mamire vi ojasā śubham yātām anu rathāḥ avr̥tsata
sākam jātāḥ su-bhvaḥ sākam ukṣitāḥ śriye cit ā pra-taram vavr̥dhuḥ naraḥ vi-rokiṇaḥ sūryasya-iva raśmayaḥ śubham yātām anu rathāḥ avr̥tsata
ābhūṣeṇyam vaḥ marutaḥ mahi-tvanam didr̥kṣeṇyam sūryasya-iva cakṣaṇam uto iti asmān amr̥ta-tve dadhātana śubham yātām anu rathāḥ avr̥tsata
ut īrayatha marutaḥ samudrataḥ yūyam vr̥ṣṭim varṣayatha purīṣiṇaḥ na vaḥ dasrā upa dasyanti dhenavaḥ śubham yātām anu rathāḥ avr̥tsata
yat aśvān dhūḥ-su pr̥ṣatīḥ ayugdhvam hiraṇyayān prati atkān amugdhvam viśvāḥ it spr̥dhaḥ marutaḥ vi asyatha śubham yātām anu rathāḥ avr̥tsata
iti tat uta dyāvāpr̥thivī iti yāthana pari śubham yātām anu rathāḥ avr̥tsata
yat pūrvyam marutaḥ yat ca nūtanam yat udyate vasavaḥ yat ca śasyate viśvasya tasya bhavatha navedasaḥ śubham yātām anu rathāḥ avr̥tsata
mr̥l̥ata naḥ marutaḥ mā vadhiṣṭana asmabhyam śarma bahulam vi yantana adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gātana śubham yātām anu rathāḥ avr̥tsata
yūyam asmān nayata vasyaḥ accha niḥ aṁhati-bhyaḥ marutaḥ gr̥ṇānāḥ juṣadhvam naḥ havya-dātim yajatrāḥ vayam syāma patayaḥ rayīṇām
agne śardhantam ā gaṇam piṣṭam rukmebhiḥ añji-bhiḥ viśaḥ adya marutām ava hvaye divaḥ cit rocanāt adhi
yathā cit manyase hr̥dā tat it me jagmuḥ āśasaḥ ye te nediṣṭham havanāni āgaman tān vardha bhīma-sandr̥śaḥ
mīl̥huṣmatī-iva pr̥thivī parāhatā madantī eti asmat ā r̥kṣaḥ na vaḥ marutaḥ śimī-vān amaḥ dudhraḥ gauḥ-iva bhīma-yuḥ
ni ye riṇanti ojasā vr̥thā gāvaḥ na duḥ-dhuraḥ aśmānam cit svaryam parvatam girim pra cyavayanti yāma-bhiḥ
ut tiṣṭha nūnam eṣām stomaiḥ sam-ukṣitānām marutām puru-tamam apūrvyam gavām sargam-iva hvaye
yuṅgdhvam hi aruṣīḥ rathe yuṅgdhvam ratheṣu rohitaḥ yuṅgdhvam harī iti ajirā dhuri vol̥have vahiṣṭhā dhuri vol̥have
uta syaḥ vājī aruṣaḥ tuvi-svaṇiḥ iha sma dhāyi darśataḥ mā vaḥ yāmeṣu marutaḥ ciram karat pra tam ratheṣu codata
ratham nu mārutam vayam śravasyum ā huvāmahe ā yasmin tasthau suraṇāni bibhratī sacā marut-su rodasī
tam vaḥ śardham rathe--śubham tveṣam panasyum ā huve yasmin su-jātā su-bhagā mahīyate sacā marut-su mīl̥huṣī
ā rudrāsaḥ indra-vantaḥ sa-joṣasaḥ hiraṇya-rathāḥ suvitāya gantana iyam vaḥ asmat prati haryate matiḥ tr̥ṣṇa-je na divaḥ utsāḥ udanyave
vāśī-mantaḥ r̥ṣṭi-mantaḥ manīṣiṇaḥ su-dhanvānaḥ iṣu-mantaḥ niṣaṅgiṇaḥ su-aśvāḥ stha su-rathāḥ pr̥śni-mātaraḥ su-āyudhāḥ marutaḥ yāthana śubham
dhūnutha dyām parvatām dāśuṣe vasu ni vaḥ vanā jihate yāmanaḥ bhiyā kopayatha pr̥thivīm pr̥śni-mātaraḥ śubhe yat ugrāḥ pr̥ṣatīḥ ayugdhvam
vāta-tviṣaḥ marutaḥ varṣa-nirnijaḥ yamāḥ-iva su-sadr̥śaḥ su-peśasaḥ piśaṅga-aśvāḥ aruṇa-asvāḥ arepasaḥ pra-tvakṣasaḥ mahinā dyauḥ-iva uravaḥ
puru-drapsāḥ añji-mantaḥ su-dānavaḥ tveṣa-sandr̥śaḥ anavabhra-rādhasaḥ sujātāsaḥ januṣā rukma-vakṣasaḥ divaḥ arkāḥ amr̥tam nāma bhejire
r̥ṣṭayaḥ vaḥ marutaḥ aṁsayoḥ adhi sahaḥ ojaḥ bāhvoḥ vaḥ balam hitam nr̥mṇā śīrṣa-su āyudhā ratheṣu vaḥ viśvā vaḥ śrīḥ adhi tanūṣu pipiśe
go--mat aśva-vat ratha-vat su-vīram candra-vat rādhaḥ marutaḥ dada naḥ pra-śastim naḥ kr̥ṇuta rudriyāsaḥ bhakṣīya vaḥ avasaḥ daivyasya
haye naraḥ marutaḥ mr̥l̥ata naḥ tuvi-maghāsaḥ amr̥tāḥ r̥ta-jñāḥ satya-śrutaḥ kavayaḥ yuvānaḥ br̥hat-girayaḥ br̥hat ukṣamāṇāḥ
tam oṁ iti nūnam taviṣī-mantam eṣām stuṣe gaṇam mārutam navyasīnām ye āśu-aśvāḥ ama-vat vahante uta īśire amr̥tasya sva-rājaḥ
tveṣam gaṇam tavasam khādi-hastam dhuni-vratam māyinam dāti-vāram mayaḥ-bhuvaḥ ye amitāḥ mahi-tvā vandasva vipra tuvi-rādhasaḥ nr̥r̥n
ā vaḥ yantu uda-vāhāsaḥ adya vr̥ṣṭim ye viśve marutaḥ junanti ayam yaḥ agniḥ marutaḥ sam-iddhaḥ etam juṣadhvam kavayaḥ yuvānaḥ
yūyam rājānam iryam janāya vibhva-taṣṭam janayatha yajatrāḥ yuṣmat eti muṣṭi-hā bāhu-jūtaḥ yuṣmat sat-aśvaḥ marutaḥ su-vīraḥ
arāḥ-iva it acaramāḥ ahāiva pra-pra jāyante akavāḥ mahaḥ-bhi ḥ pr̥śneḥ putrāḥ upa-māsaḥ rabhiṣṭhāḥ svayā matyā marutaḥ sam mi mikṣuḥ
yat pra ayāsiṣṭa pr̥ṣatībhiḥ aśvaiḥ vīl̥upavi-bhiḥ marutaḥ rathebhiḥ kṣodante āpaḥ riṇate vanāni ava usriyaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ krandatu dyauḥ
prathiṣṭa yāman pr̥thivī cit eṣām bhartāiva garbham svam it śavaḥ dhuḥ vātān hi aśvān dhuri āyuyujre varṣam svedam cakrire rudriyāsaḥ
haye naraḥ marutaḥ mr̥l̥ata naḥ tuvi-maghāsaḥ amr̥tāḥ r̥ta-jñāḥ satya-śrutaḥ kavayaḥ yuvānaḥ br̥hat-girayaḥ br̥hat ukṣamāṇāḥ
pra vaḥ spaṭ akran suvitāya dāvane arca dive pra pr̥thivyai r̥tam bhare ukṣante aśvān taruṣante ā rajaḥ anu svam bhānum śrathayante arṇavaiḥ
amāt eṣām bhiyasā bhūmiḥ ejati nauḥ na pūrṇā kṣarati vyathiḥ yatī dūre--dr̥śaḥ ye citayante ema-bhiḥ antaḥ mahe vidathe yetire naraḥ
gavām-iva śriyase śr̥ṅgam uttamam sūryaḥ na cakṣuḥ rajasaḥ vi-sarjane atyāḥ-iva su-bhvaḥ cāravaḥ sthana maryāḥ-iva śriyase cetatha naraḥ
kaḥ vaḥ mahānti mahatām ut aśnavat kaḥ kāvyā marutaḥ kaḥ ha paiṁsyā yūyam ha bhūmim kiraṇam na rejatha pra yat bharadhve suvitāya dāvane
aśvāḥ-iva it aruṣāsaḥ sa-bandhavaḥ śūrāḥ-iva pra-yudhaḥ pra uta yuyudhuḥ maryāḥ-iva su-vr̥dhaḥ vavr̥dhuḥ naraḥ sūryasya cakṣuḥ pra minanti vr̥ṣṭi-bhiḥ
te ajyeṣṭhāḥ akaniṣṭhāsaḥ ut-bhidaḥ amadhyamāsaḥ mahasā vi vavr̥dhuḥ su-jātāsaḥ januṣā pr̥śni-mātaraḥ divaḥ maryāḥ ā naḥ accha jigātana
vayaḥ na ye śreṇīḥ paptuḥ ojasā antān divaḥ br̥hataḥ sānunaḥ pari aśvāsaḥ eṣām ubhaye yathā viduḥ pra parvatasya nabhanūn acucyavuḥ
mimātu dyauḥ aditiḥ vītaye naḥ sam dānu-citrāḥ uṣasaḥ yatantām ā acucyavuḥ divyam kośam ete r̥ṣe rudrasya marutaḥ gr̥ṇānāḥ
il̥e agnim su-avasam namaḥ-bhiḥ iha pra-sattaḥ vi cayat kr̥tam naḥ rathaiḥ-iva pra bhare vājayat-bhiḥ pra-dakṣiṇit marutām stomam r̥dhyām
ā ye tasthuḥ pr̥ṣatīṣu śrutāsu su-kheṣu rudrāḥ marutaḥ ratheṣu vanā cit ugrāḥ jihate ni vaḥ bhiyā pr̥thivī cit rejate parvataḥ cit
parvataḥ cit mahi vr̥ddhaḥ bibhāya divaḥ cit sānu rejata svane vaḥ yat krīl̥atha marutaḥ r̥ṣṭi-mantaḥ āpaḥ-iva sadhryañcaḥ dhavadhve
varāḥ-iva it raivatāsaḥ hiraṇyaiḥ abhi svadhābhiḥ tanvaḥ pipiśre śr iye śreyāṁsaḥ tavasaḥ ratheṣu satrā mahāṁsi cakrire tanūṣu
ajyeṣṭhāsaḥ akaniṣṭhāsaḥ ete sam bhrātaraḥ vavr̥dhuḥ saubhagāya yuvā p itā svapā rudraḥ eṣām su-dughā pr̥śniḥ su-dinā marut-bhyaḥ
yat ut-tame marutaḥ madhyame vā yat vā avame su-bhagāsaḥ divi stha ataḥ naḥ rudrāḥ uta vā nu asya agne vittāt haviṣaḥ yat yajāma
agniḥ ca yat marutaḥ viśva-vedasaḥ divaḥ vahadhve ut-tarāt adhi snu-bhiḥ te mandasānāḥ dhunayaḥ riśādasaḥ vāmam dhatta yajamānāya sunvate
agne marut-bhiḥ śubhayat-bhiḥ r̥kva-bhiḥ somam piba mandasānaḥ gaṇaśri-bhiḥ pāvakebhiḥ viśvam-invebhiḥ āyu-bhiḥ vaiśvānara pra-divā ketunā sa-jūḥ
kaḥ stha naraḥ śreṣṭha-tamāḥ ye ekaḥ-ekaḥ āyaya paramasyāḥ parāvataḥ
kva vaḥ aśvāḥ kva abhīśavaḥ katham śeka kathā yaya pr̥ṣṭhe sadaḥ nasoḥ yamaḥ
jaghane codaḥ eṣām vi sakthāni naraḥ yamuḥ putra-kr̥the na janayaḥ
parā vīrāsaḥ itana maryāsaḥ bhadra-jānayaḥ agni-tapaḥ yathā asatha
sanat sā aśvyam paśum uta gavyam śata-avayam śyāvāśva-stutāya yā doḥ vīrāya upa-barbr̥hat
uta tvā strī śaśīyasī puṁsaḥ bhavati vasyasī adeva-trāt arādhasaḥ
vi yā jānāti jasurim vi tr̥ṣyantam vi kāminam deva-trā kr̥ṇute manaḥ
uta gha nemaḥ astutaḥ pumān iti bruve paṇiḥ saḥ vaira-deye it samaḥ
uta me arapat yuvatiḥ mamanduṣī prati śyāvāya vartanim vi rohitā puru-mīl̥hāya yematuḥ viprāya dīrgha-yaśase
yaḥ me dhenūnām śatam vaidat-aśviḥ yathā dadat tarantaḥ-iva maṁhanā
ye īm vahante āśu-bhiḥ pibantaḥ madiram madhu atra śravāṁsi dadhire
yeṣām śriyā adhi rodasī iti vi-bhrājante ratheṣu ā divi rukmaḥ-iva upari
yuvā saḥ mārutaḥ gaṇaḥ tveṣa-rathaḥ anedyaḥ śubham-yāvā aprati-skutaḥ
kaḥ veda nūnam eṣām yatra madanti dhūtayaḥ r̥ta-jātāḥ arepasaḥ
yūyam martam vipanyavaḥ pra-netāraḥ itthā dhiyā śrotāraḥ yāma-hūtiṣu
te naḥ vasūni kāmyā puru-candrāḥ riśādasaḥ ā yajñiyāsaḥ vavr̥ttana
etam me stomam ūrmye dārbhyāya parā vaha giraḥ devi rathīḥ-iva
uta me vocatāt iti suta-some ratha-vītau na kāmaḥ apa veti me
eṣaḥ kṣeti ratha-vītiḥ magha-vā go--matīḥ anu parvateṣu apa-śritaḥ
r̥tena r̥tam api-hitam dhruvam vām sūryasya yatra vi-mucanti aśvān daśa śatā saha tasthuḥ tat ekam devānām śreṣṭham vapuṣām apaśyam
tat su vām mitrāvaruṇā mahi-tvam īrmā tasthuṣīḥ aha-bhiḥ duduhre viśvāḥ pinvathaḥ svasarasya dhenāḥ anu vām ekaḥ paviḥ ā vavatar
adhārayatam pr̥thivīm uta dyām mitra-rājānā varuṇā mahaḥ-bhiḥ vardhayatam oṣadhīḥ pinvatam gāḥ ava vr̥ṣṭim sr̥jatam jīradānūitijīra-dānū
ā vām aśvāsaḥ su-yujaḥ vahantu yata-raśmayaḥ upa yantu arvāk ghr̥tasya niḥ-nik anu vartate vām upa sindhavaḥ pra-divi kṣarant i
anu śrutām amatim vardhat urvīm barhiḥ-iva yajuṣā rakṣamāṇā namasvantā dhr̥ta-dakṣā adhi garte mitra āsātheiti varuṇa il̥āsu antariti
akravi-hastā su-kr̥te paraḥ-pā yam trāsāthe varuṇā ilāsu antariti rājānā kṣatram ahr̥ṇīyamānā sahasra-sthūṇam bibhr̥thaḥ saha dvau
hiraṇya-nirnik ayaḥ asya sthūṇā vi bhrājate divi aśvājanī-iva bhadre kṣetre ni-mitā talvile vā sanema madhvaḥ adhi-garytasya
hiraṇya-rūpam uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭau ayaḥ-sthūṇam ut-itā sūryasya ā rohathaḥ varuṇa mitra gartam ataḥ cakṣātheiti aditim ditim ca
yat baṁhiṣṭham na ati-vidhe sudānūitisu-dānū acchidram śarma bhuvanasya gopā tena naḥ mitrāvaruṇau aviṣṭam sisāsantaḥ jigīvāṁsaḥ syāma
r̥tasya gopau adhi tiṣṭhathaḥ ratham satya-dharmāṇā parame vi-omani yam atra mitrāvaruṇā avathaḥ yuvam tasmai vr̥ṣṭiḥ madhu-mat pinvate divaḥ
sam-rājau asya bhuvanasya rājathaḥ mitrāvaruṇā vidathe svaḥ-dr̥śā vr̥ṣṭim vām rādhaḥ amr̥ta-tvam īmahe dyāvāpr̥thivī iti vi caranti tanyavaḥ
sam-rājau ugrā vr̥ṣabhā divaḥ patīiti pr̥thivyāḥ mitrāvaruṇā vicarṣaṇī itivi-carṣaṇī citrebhiḥ abhraiḥ upa tiṣṭhathaḥ ravam dyām varṣayathaḥ asurasya māyayā
māyā vām mitrāvaruṇā divi śritā sūryaḥ jyotiḥ carati citram āyudham tam abhreṇa vr̥ṣṭyā gūhathaḥ divi parjanya drapsā madhu-mantaḥ īrate
ratham yuñjate marutaḥ śubhe sukham śūraḥ na mitrāvaruṇā go--iṣṭiṣu rajāṁsi citrā vi caranti tanyavaḥ divaḥ sam-rājā payasā naḥ ukṣatam
vācam su mitrāvaruṇau irāvatīm parjanyaḥ citrām vadati tviṣi-matīm abhrā vasata marutaḥ su māyayā dyām varṣayatam aruṇām arepasam
dharmaṇā mitrāvaruṇā vipaḥ-citā vratā rakṣetheiti asurasya māyayā r̥tena viśvam bhuvanam vi rājathaḥ sūryam ā dhatthaḥ divi citryam ratham
varuṇam vaḥ riśādasam r̥cā mitram havāmahe pari vrajāiva bāhvoḥ jaganvāṁsā svaḥ-naram
tā bāhavā su-cetunā pra yantam asmai arcate śevam hi jāryam vām vi śvāsu kṣāsu joguve
yat nūnam aśyām gatim mitrasya yāyām pathā asya priyasya śarmaṇ i ahiṁsānasya saścire
yuvābhyām mitrāvaruṇā upa-mam dheyām r̥cā yat ha kṣaye maghonām stotr̥r̥ṇām ca spūrdhase
ā naḥ mitra sudīti-bhiḥ varuṇaḥ ca sadha-sthe ā sve kṣaye maghonām sakhīnām ca vr̥dhase
yuvam naḥ yeṣu varuṇā kṣatram br̥hat ca bibhr̥thaḥ uru naḥ vāja-sātaye kr̥tam rāye svastaye
ucchantyām me yajatā deva-kṣatre ruśat-gavi sutam somam na hasti-bhi ḥ ā paṭ-bhiḥ dhāvatam narā bibhratau arcanānasam
yaḥ ciketa saḥ su-kratuḥ deva-trā saḥ bravītu naḥ varuṇaḥ yasya darśataḥ mitraḥ vā vanate giraḥ
tā hi śreṣṭha-varcasā rājānā dīrghaśrut-tamā tā satpatī itisat-patī r̥ta-vr̥dhā r̥ta-vānā jane--jane
tā vām iyānaḥ avase pūrvau upa bruve sacā su-aśvāsaḥ su cetunā vājān abhi pra dāvane
mitraḥ aṁhoḥ cit āt uru kṣayāya gātum vanate mitrasya hi pra-tūvartaḥ su-matiḥ asti vidhataḥ
vayam mitrasya avasi syāma saprathaḥ-tame anehasaḥ tvāūtayaḥ satrā varuṇa-śeṣasaḥ
yuvam mitrā imam janam yatathaḥ sam ca nayathaḥ mā maghonaḥ par i khyatam mo iti asmākam r̥ṣīṇām go--pīthe naḥ uruṣyatam
ā cikitāna sukratūitisu-kratū devau marta riśādasā varuṇāya r̥ta-peśase dadhīta prayase mahe
tā hi kṣatram avi-hrutam samyak asuryam āśāteiti adha vratāiva mānuṣam svaḥ na dhāyi darśatam
tā vām eṣe rathānām urvīm gavyūtim eṣām rāta-havyasya su-stutim dadhr̥k stomaiḥ manāmahe
adha hi kāvyā yuvam dakṣasya pūḥ-bhiḥ adbhutā ni ketunā janānām ciketheiti pūta-dakṣasā
tat r̥tam pr̥thivi br̥hat śravaḥ-eṣe r̥ṣīṇām jrayasānau aram pr̥thu ati kṣaranti yāma-bhiḥ
ā yat vām īya-cakṣasā mitrā vayam ca sūrayaḥ vyaciṣṭhe bahu-pāyye yatemahi sva-rājye
baṭ itthā deva niḥ-kr̥tam ādityā yajatam br̥hat varuṇa mitra aryaman varṣiṣṭham kṣatram āśātheiti
ā yat yonim hiraṇyayam varuṇa mitra sadathaḥ dhartārā carṣaṇīnām yantam sumnam riśādasā
viśve hi viśva-vedasaḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā vratā padāiva saścire pānti martyam riṣaḥ
te hi satyāḥ r̥ta-spr̥śaḥ r̥ta-vānaḥ jane--jane su-nīthāsaḥ su-dānavaḥ aṁhoḥ cit uru-cakrayaḥ
kaḥ nu vām mitra astutaḥ varuṇaḥ vā tanūnām tat su vām ā īṣate matiḥ atri-bhyaḥ ā īṣate matiḥ
pra vaḥ mitrāya gāyata varuṇāya vipā girā mahi-kṣatrau r̥tam br̥hat
sam-rājā yā ghr̥tayonī itighr̥ta-yonī mitraḥ ca ubhā varuṇaḥ ca devā deveṣu pra-śastā
tā naḥ śaktam pārthivasya mahaḥ rāyaḥ divyasya mahi vām kṣatram deveṣu
r̥tam r̥tena sapantā iṣiram dakṣam āśāteiti adruhā devau vardheteiti
vr̥ṣṭi-dyāvā rīti-āpā iṣaḥ patī iti dānu-matyāḥ br̥hantam gartam āśāteiti
trī rocanā varuṇa trīn uta dyūn trīṇi mitra dhārayathaḥ rajāṁsi vavr̥dhānau amatim kṣatriyasya anu vratam rakṣamāṇau ajuryam
irāvatīḥ varuṇa dhenavaḥ vām madhu-mat vām sindhavaḥ mitra duhre trayaḥ tasthuḥ vr̥ṣabhāsaḥ tisr̥r̥ṇām dhiṣaṇānām retaḥ-dhāḥ vi dyu-mantaḥ
prātaḥ devīm aditim johavīmi madhyandine ut-itā sūryasya rāye mitrāvaruṇā sarva-tātā īl̥e tokāya tanayāya śam yoḥ
yā dhartārā rajasaḥ rocanasya uta ādityā divyā pārthivasya na vām devāḥ amr̥tāḥ ā minanti vratāni mitrāvaruṇā dhruvāṇi
puru-uruṇā cit hi asti avaḥ nūnam vām varuṇa mitra vaṁsi vām su-matim
tā vām samyak adruhvāṇā iṣam aśyāma dhāyase vayam te rudrā syāma
pātam naḥ rudrā pāyu-bhiḥ uta trāyethām su-trātrā turyāma dasyūn tanū-bhiḥ
mā kasya adbhutakratūity adbhuta-kratū yakṣam bhujema tanūbhiḥ mā śeṣasā mā tanasā
ā naḥ gantam riśādasā varuṇa mitra barhaṇā upa imam cārum adhvaram
viśvasya hi pra-cetasā varuṇa mitra rājathaḥ īśānā pipyatam dhiyaḥ
upa naḥ sutam ā gatam varuṇa mitra dāśuṣaḥ asya somasya pītaye
ā mitre varuṇe vayam gīḥ-bhiḥ juhumaḥ atri-vat ni barhiṣi sadatam soma-pītaye
vratena sthaḥ dhruva-kṣemā dharmaṇā yātayat-janā ni barhiṣi sadatam soma-pītaye
mitraḥ ca naḥ varuṇaḥ ca juṣetām yajñam iṣṭaye ni barhiṣi sadatam soma-pītaye
yat adya sthaḥ pārāvati yat ārvāvati aśvinā yat vā puru puru-bhujā yat antarikṣe ā gatam
iha tyā puru-bhūtamā puru daṁsāṁsi bibhratā varasyā yāmi adhrigūity adhri-gū huve tuviḥ-tamā bhuje
īrmā anyat vapuṣe vapuḥ cakram rathasya yemathuḥ pari anyā nāhuṣā yugā mahnā rajāṁsi dīyathaḥ
tat oṁ iti su vām enā kr̥tam viśvā yat vām anu stave nānā jātau arepasā sam asme iti bandhum ā īyathuḥ
ā yat vām sūryā ratham tiṣṭhat raghu-syadam sadā pari vām aruṣāḥ vayaḥ ghr̥ṇā varante ātapaḥ
yuvoḥ atriḥ ciketati narā sumnena cetasā gharmam yat vām arepasam nāsatyā āsnā bhuraṇyati
ugraḥ vām kakuhaḥ yayiḥ śr̥ṇve yāmeṣu sam-taniḥ yat vām daṁsaḥ-bhiḥ aśvinā atriḥ narā āvavartati
madhvaḥ oṁ iti su madhu-yuvā rudrā sisakti pipyuṣī yat samudrā ati parṣathaḥ pakvāḥ pr̥kṣaḥ bharanta vām
satyam it vai oṁ iti aśvinā yuvām āhuḥ mayaḥ-bhuvā tā yāman yāma-hūtamā yāman ā mr̥l̥ayat-tamā
imā brahmāṇi vardhanā aśvi-bhyām santu śam-tamā yā takṣāma rathān-iva avocāma br̥hat namaḥ
kū-sthaḥ devau aśvinā adya divaḥ manāvasūiti tat śravathaḥ vr̥ṣaṇvasūitivr̥ṣaṇ-vasū atriḥ vām ā vivāsati
kuha tyā kuha nu śrutā divi devā nāsatyā kasmin ā yatathaḥ jane kaḥ vām nadīnām sacā
kam yāthaḥ kam ha gacchathaḥ kam accha yuñjātheiti ratham kasya brahmāṇi raṇyathaḥ vayam vām uśmasi iṣṭaye
pauram cit hi uda-prutam paura paurāya jinvathaḥ yat īm gr̥bhīta-tātaye siṁham-iva druhaḥ pade
pra cyavānāt jujuruṣaḥ vavrim atkam na muñcathaḥ yuvā yadi kr̥thaḥ punaḥ ā kāmam r̥ṇve vadhvaḥ
asti hi vām iha stotā smasi vām sam-dr̥śi śr̥iye nu śrutam me ā gatam avaḥ-bhiḥ vājinīvasūitivājinī-vasū
kaḥ vām adya purūṇām ā vavne martyānām kaḥ vipraḥ vipra-vāhasā kaḥ yajñaiḥ vājinīvasūitivājinī-vasū
ā vām rathaḥ rathānām yeṣṭhaḥ yātu aśvinā puru cit asma-yuḥ tiraḥ āṅgūṣaḥ martyeṣu ā
śam oṁ iti su vām madhu-yuvā asmākam astu carkr̥tiḥ arvācīnā vi-cetasā vi-bh iḥ śyenāiva dīyatam
aśvinā yat ha karhi cit śuśruyātam imam havam vasvīḥ oṁ iti su vām bhujaḥ pr̥ñcanti su vām pr̥caḥ
prati priya-tamam ratham vr̥ṣaṇam vasu-vāhanam stotā vām aśvinau r̥ṣiḥ stomena prati bhūṣati mādhvī iti mama śrutam havam
ati-āyātam aśvinā tiraḥ viśvāḥ aham sanā dasrā hiraṇya-vartanī itihiraṇya-vartanī su-sumnā sindhu-vāhasā mādhvī iti mama śrutam havam
ā naḥ ratnāni bibhratau aśvinā gacchatam yuvam rudrā hiraṇya-vartanī itihiraṇya-vartanī juṣāṇā vājinīvasūitivājinī-vasū mādhvī iti mama śrutam havam
su-stubhaḥ vām vr̥ṣaṇvasūitivr̥ṣaṇ-vasū rathe vāṇīcī āhitā uta vām kakuhaḥ mr̥gaḥ pr̥kṣaḥ kr̥ṇoti vāpuṣaḥ mādhvī iti mama śrutam havam
bodhit-manasā rathyā iṣirā havana-śrutā vi-bhiḥ cyavānam aśvinā ni yāthaḥ advayāvinam mādhvī iti mama śrutam havam
ā vām narā manaḥ-yujaḥ aśvāsaḥ pruṣita-psavaḥ vayaḥ vahantu pītaye saha sumnebhiḥ aśvinā mādhvī iti mama śrutam havam
aśvinau ā iha gacchatam nāsatyā mā vi venatam tiraḥ cit arya-yā pari vartiḥ yātam adābhyā mādhvī iti mama śrutam havam
asmin yajñe adābhyā jaritāram śubhaḥ patī iti avasyum aśvinā yuvam gr̥ṇantam upa bhūṣathaḥ mādhvī iti mama śrutam havam
abhūt uṣā ruśat-paśuḥ ā agniḥ adhāyi r̥tviyaḥ ayoji vām vr̥ṣaṇvasūit ivr̥ṣaṇ-vasū rathaḥ dasrau amartyaḥ mādhvī iti mama śrutam havam
ā bhāti agniḥ uṣasām anīkam ut viprāṇām deva-yāḥ vācaḥ asthuḥ arvāñcā nūnam rathyā iha yātam pīpi-vāṁsam aśvinā gharmam accha
na saṁskr̥tam pra mimītaḥ gamiṣṭhā anti nūnam aśvinā upa-stutā iha divā abhi-pitve avasā āgamiṣṭhā prati avartim dāśuṣe śam-bhaviṣṭhā
uta ā yātam sam-gave prātaḥ ahnaḥ madhyandine ut-itā sūryasya divā naktam avasā śam-tamena na idānīm pītiḥ aśvinā ā tatāna
idam hi vām pra-divi sthānam okaḥ ime gr̥hāḥ aśvinā idam duroṇam ā naḥ divaḥ br̥hataḥ parvatāt ā at-bhyaḥ yātam iṣam ūrjam vahantā
sam aśvinoḥ avasā nūtanena mayaḥ-bhuvā su-pranītī gamema ā naḥ rayim vahatam ā uta vīrān ā viśvāni amr̥tā saubhagāni
prātaḥ-yāvānā prathamā yajadhvam purā gr̥dhrāt araruṣaḥ pibātaḥ prātaḥ hi yajñam aśvinā dadhāteiti pra śaṁsanti kavayaḥ pūrva-bhājaḥ
prātaḥ yajadhvam aśvinā hinota na sāyam asti deva-yāḥ ajuṣṭam uta anyaḥ asmat yajate vi ca āvaḥ pūrvaḥ-pūrvaḥ yajamānaḥ vanīyān
hiraṇya-tvak madhu-varṇaḥ ghr̥ta-snuḥ pr̥kṣaḥ vahan ā rathaḥ vatarte vām manaḥ-javāḥ aśvinā vāta-raṁhāḥ yena ati-yāthaḥ duḥ-ritāni viśvā
yaḥ bhūyiṣṭham nāsatyābhyām viveṣa caniṣṭham pitvaḥ rarate vi-bhāge saḥ tokam asya pīparat śamībhiḥ anūrdhva-bhāsaḥ sadam it tuturyāt
sam aśvinoḥ avasā nūtanena mayaḥ-bhuvā su-pranītī gamema ā naḥ rayim vahatam ā uta vīrān ā viśvāni amr̥tā saubhagāni
aśvinau ā iha gacchatam nāsatyā mā vi venatam haṁsau-iva patatam ā sutān upa
aśvinā hariṇau-iva gaurau-iva anu yavasam haṁsau-iva patatam ā sutān upa
aśvinā vājinīvasūitivājinī-vasū juṣethām yajñam iṣṭaye haṁsau-iva patatam ā sutān upa
atriḥ yat vām ava-rohan r̥bīsam ajohavīt nādhamānāiva yoṣā śyenasya cit javasā nūtanena ā agacchatam aśvinā śam-tamena
vi jihīṣva vanaspate yoniḥ sūṣyantyāḥ-iva śrutam me aśvinā havam sapta-vadhrim ca muñcatam
bhītāya nādhamānāya r̥ṣaye sapta-vadhraye māyābhiḥ aśvinā yuvam vr̥kṣam sam ca vi ca acathaḥ
yathā vātaḥ puṣkariṇīm sam-iṅgayati sarvataḥ eva te garbhaḥ ejatu niḥ-aitu daśa-māsyaḥ
yathā vātaḥ yathā vanam yathā samudraḥ ejati eva tvam daśa-māsya saha ava ihi jarāyuṇā
daśa māsān śaśayānaḥ kumāraḥ adhi mātari niḥ-aitu jīvaḥ akṣataḥ jīvaḥ jīvantyā adhi
mahe naḥ adya bodhaya uṣaḥ rāye divitmatī yathā cit naḥ abodhayaḥ satya-śravasi vāyye su-jāte aśva-sūnr̥te
yā su-nīthe śaucat-rathe vi aucchaḥ duhitaḥ divaḥ sā vi uccha sahīyasi satya-śravasi vāyye su-jāte aśva-sūnr̥te
sā naḥ adya ābharat-vasuḥ vi uccha duhitaḥ divaḥ yo iti vi aucchaḥ sahīyasi satya-śravasi vāyye su-jāte aśva-sūnr̥te
abhi ye tvā vibhāvari stomaiḥ gr̥ṇanti vahnayaḥ maghaiḥ maghoni su-śriyaḥ dāman-vantaḥ su-rātayaḥ su-jāte aśva-sūnr̥te
yat cit hi te gaṇāḥ ime chadayanti maghattaye pari cit vaṣṭayaḥ dadhuḥ dadataḥ rādhaḥ ahrayam su-jāte aśva-sūnr̥te
ā eṣu dhāḥ vīra-vat yaśaḥ uṣaḥ maghoni sūriṣu ye naḥ rādhāṁsi ahrayā magha-vānaḥ arāsata su-jāte aśva-sūnr̥te
tebhyaḥ dyumnam br̥hat yaśaḥ uṣaḥ maghoni ā vaha ye naḥ rādhāṁsi aśvyā gavyā bhajanta sūrayaḥ su-jāte aśva-sūnr̥te
uta naḥ go--matīḥ iṣaḥ ā vaha duhitaḥ divaḥ sākam sūryasya raśmi-bhiḥ śukraiḥ śocat-bhiḥ arci-bhiḥ su-jāte aśva-sūnr̥te
vi uccha duhitaḥ divaḥ mā ciram tanuthāḥ apaḥ na it tvā stenam yathā ripum tapāti sūraḥ arciṣā su-jāte aśva-sūnr̥te
etāvat vā ot uṣaḥ tvam bhūyaḥ vā dātum arhasi yā stotr̥-bhyaḥ vibhāvari ucchantī na pra-mīyase su-jāte aśva-sūnr̥te
dyuta-dyāmānam br̥hatīm r̥tena r̥ta-varīm aruṇa-psum vi-bhātīm devīm uṣasam svaḥ āvahantīm prati viprāsaḥ mati-bhiḥ jarante
eṣā janam darśatā bodhayantī su-mān pathaḥ kr̥ṇvatī yāti agre br̥hat-rathā br̥hatī viśvam-invā uṣāḥ jyotiḥ yacchati agre ahnām
eṣā gobhiḥ aruṇebhiḥ yujānā asredhantī rayim apra-āyu cakre pathaḥ radantī suvitāya puru-stutā viśva-vārā vi bhāti
eṣā vi-enī bhavati dvi-barhāḥ āviḥ-kr̥ṇvānā tanvam purastāt r̥tasya panthām anu eti sādhu pra-jānatī-iva na diśaḥ mināti
eṣā śubhrā na tanvaḥ vidānā ūrdhvāiva snātī dr̥śaye naḥ asthāt apa dveṣaḥ bādhamānā tamāṁsi uṣāḥ divaḥ duhitā jyotiṣā ā agāt
eṣā pratīcī duhitā divaḥ nr̥r̥n yoṣāiva bhadrā ni riṇīte apsaḥ vi-ūrṇvatī dāśuṣe vāryāṇi punaḥ jyotiḥ yuvatiḥ pūrva-thā akar ity akaḥ
yuñjate manaḥ uta yuñjate dhiyaḥ viprāḥ viprasya br̥hataḥ vipaḥ-citaḥ vi hotrāḥ dadhe vayuna-vit ekaḥ it mahī devasya savituḥ pari-stutiḥ
viśvā rūpāṇi prati muñcate kaviḥ pra asāvīt bhadram dvi-pade catuḥ-pade vi nākam akhyat savitā vareṇyaḥ anu pra-yānam uṣasaḥ vi rājati
yasya pra-yāmam anu anye it yayuḥ devāḥ devasya mahimānam ojasā yaḥ pārthivāni vi-mame saḥ etaśaḥ rajāṁsi devaḥ savitā mahi-tvanā
uta yāsi savitariti trīṇi rocanā uta sūryasya raśmi-bhiḥ sam ucyas i uta rātrīm ubhayataḥ pari īyase uta mitraḥ bhavasi deva dharma-bhiḥ
uta īśiṣe pra-savasya tvam ekaḥ it uta pūṣā bhavasi deva yāma-bhiḥ uta idam viśvam bhuvanam vi rājasi śyāva-aśvaḥ te savitariti stomam ānaśe
tat savituḥ vr̥ṇīmahe vayam devasya bhojanam śreṣṭham sarva-dhātamam turam bhagasya dhīmahi
asya hi svayaśaḥ-taram savituḥ kat cana priyam na minanti sva-rājyam
saḥ hi ratnāni dāśuṣe suvāti savitā bhagaḥ tam bhāgam citram īmahe
adya naḥ deva savitariti prajāvat sāvīḥ saubhagam parā duḥ-svapnyam suva
viśvāni deva savitaḥ duḥ-itāni parā suva yat bhadram tat naḥ ā suva
anāgasaḥ aditaye devasya savituḥ save viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi
ā viśva-devam sat-patim su-uktaiḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe satya-savam savitāram
yaḥ ime iti ubhe iti ahanī iti puraḥ eti apra-yucchan su-ādhīḥ devaḥ savitā
yaḥ imā viśvā jātāni āśrāvayati ślokena pra ca suvāti savitā
accha vada tavasam gīḥ-bhiḥ ābhiḥ stuhi parjanyam namasā vivāsa kanikradat vr̥ṣabhaḥ jīra-dānuḥ retaḥ dadhāti oṣadhīṣu garbham
vi vr̥kṣān hanti uta hanti rakṣasaḥ viśvam bibhāya bhuvanam mahāvadhāt uta anāgāḥ īṣate vr̥ṣṇya-vataḥ yat parjanyaḥ stanayan hanti duḥ-kr̥taḥ
rathī-iva kaśayā aśvān abhi-kṣipan āviḥ dūtān kr̥ṇute varṣyān aha dūrāt siṁhasya stanathāḥ ut īrate yat parjanyaḥ kr̥ṇute varṣyam nabhaḥ
pra vātāḥ vānti patayanti vi-dyutaḥ ut oṣadhīḥ jihate pinvate svaḥ irā viśvasmai bhuvanāya jāyate yat parjanyaḥ pr̥thivīm retasā avati
yasya vrate pr̥thivī nannamīti yasya vrate śapha-vat jarbhurīti yasya vrate oṣadhīḥ viśva-rūpāḥ saḥ naḥ parjanya mahi śarma yaccha
divaḥ naḥ vr̥ṣṭim marutaḥ rarīdhvam pra pinvata vr̥ṣṇaḥ aśvasya dhārāḥ arvāṅ etena stanayitnunā ā ihi apaḥ ni-siñcan asuraḥ p itā nāḥ
abhi kranda stanaya garbham ā dhāḥ udan-vatā pari dīya rathena dr̥tim su karṣa vi-sitam nyañcam samāḥ bhavantu ut-vataḥ ni-pādāḥ
mahāntam kośam ut aca ni siñca syandantām kulyāḥ vi-sitāḥ purastāt ghr̥tena dyāvāpr̥thivī iti vi undhi su-prapānam bhavatu aghnyābhyaḥ
yat parjanya kanikradat stanayan haṁsi duḥ-kr̥taḥ prati idam viśvam modate yat kim ca pr̥thivyām adhi
iti su gr̥bhāya akaḥ dhanvāni ati-etavai oṁ iti ajījanaḥ oṣadhīḥ bhojanāya kam uta pra-jābhyaḥ avidaḥ manīṣām
baṭ itthā parvatānām khidram bibharṣi pr̥thivi pra yā bhūmim pravatvati mahnā jinoṣi mahini
stomāsaḥ tvā vi-cāriṇi prati stobhanti aktu-bhiḥ pra yā vājam na heṣantam perum asyasi arjuni
dr̥l̥hā cit yā vanaspatīn kṣmayā dardharṣi ojasā yat te abhrasya vi-dyutaḥ divaḥ varṣanti vr̥ṣṭayaḥ
pra sam-rāje br̥hat arca gabhīram brahma priyam varuṇāya śrutāya vi yaḥ jaghāna śamitāiva carma upa-stire pr̥thivīm sūryāya
vaneṣu vi antarikṣam tatāna vājam arvat-su payaḥ usriyāsu hr̥t-su kratum varuṇaḥ ap-su agnim divi sūryam adadhāt somam adrau
nīcīna-bāram varuṇaḥ kavandham pra sasarja rodasī iti antarikṣam tena viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā yavam na vr̥ṣṭiḥ vi unatti bhūma
unatti bhūmim pr̥thivīm uta dyām yadā dugdham varuṇaḥ vaṣṭi āt it sam abhreṇa vasata parvatāsaḥ taviṣī-yantaḥ śrathayanta vīrāḥ
imām oṁ iti su āsurasya śrutasya mahīm māyām varuṇasya pra vocam mānena-iva tasthi-vān antarikṣe vi yaḥ mame pr̥thivīm sūryeṇa
imām oṁ iti nu kavi-tamasya māyām mahīm devasya nakiḥ ā dadharṣa ekam yat udnā na pr̥ṇanti enīḥ āsiñcantīḥ avanayaḥ samudram
aryamyam varuṇa mitryam vā sakhāyam vā sadam it bhrātaram vā veśam vā nityam varuṇa araṇam vā yat sīm āgaḥ cakr̥ma śiśrathaḥ tat
kitavāsaḥ yat riripuḥ na dīvi yat vā gha satyam uta yat na vidma sarvā tā vi sya śithirāiva deva adha te syāma varuṇa priyāsaḥ
indrāgnī iti yam avathaḥ ubhā vājeṣu martyam dr̥l̥hā cit saḥ pra bhedati dyumnā vāṇīḥ-iva tritaḥ
yā pr̥tanāsu dustarā yā vājeṣu śravāyyā yā pañca carṣaṇīḥ abhi indrāgnī iti tā havāmahe
tayoḥ it ama-vat śavaḥ tigmā didyut maghonoḥ prati druṇā gabhastyoḥ gavām vr̥tra-ghne ā īṣate
ā vām eṣe rathānām indrāgnī iti havāmahe patī iti turasya rādhasaḥ vidvāṁsā girvaṇaḥ-tamā
tā vr̥dhantau anu dyūn martāya devau adabhā arhantā cit puraḥ dadhe aṁśāiva devau arvate
eva indrāgni-bhyām ahāvi havyam sūṣyam ghr̥tam na pūtam adri-bhiḥ tā sūriṣu śravaḥ br̥hat rayim gr̥ṇat-su didhr̥tam iṣam gr̥ṇat-su didhr̥tam
pra vaḥ mahe matayaḥ yantu viṣṇave marutvate giri-jāḥ evayāmarut pra śardhāya pra-yajyave su-khādaye tavase bhandat-iṣṭaye dhuni-vratāya śavase
pra ye jātāḥ mahinā ye ca nu svayam pra vidmanā bruvate evayāmarut kratvā tat vaḥ marutaḥ na ādhr̥ṣe śavaḥ dānā mahnā tat eṣām adhr̥ṣṭāsaḥ na adrayaḥ
pra ye divaḥ br̥hataḥ śr̥ṇvire girā su-śukvānaḥ su-bhvaḥ evayāmarut na yeṣām irī sadha-sthe īṣṭe ā agnayaḥ na sva-vidyutaḥ pra spandrāsaḥ dhunīnām
saḥ cakrame mahataḥ niḥ uru-kr̥amaḥ samānasmāt sadasaḥ evayāmarut yadā ayukta tmanā svāt adhi snu-bhiḥ vi-spardhasaḥ vi-mahasaḥ jigāti śe--vr̥dhaḥ nr̥-bhiḥ
svanaḥ na vaḥ ama-vān rejayat vr̥ṣā tveṣaḥ yayiḥ taviṣaḥ evayāmarut yena sahantaḥ r̥ñjata sva-rociṣaḥ sthāḥ-raśmānaḥ hiraṇyayāḥ su-āyudhāsaḥ iṣmiṇaḥ
apāraḥ vaḥ mahimā vr̥ddha-śavasaḥ tveṣam śavaḥ avatu evayāmarut sthātāraḥ hi pra-sitau sam-dr̥śi sthana te naḥ uruṣyata nidaḥ śuśukvāṁsaḥ na agnayaḥ
te rudrāsaḥ su-makhāḥ agnayaḥ yathā tuvi-dyumnāḥ avantu evayāmarut dīrgham pr̥thu paprathe sadma pārthivam yeṣām ajmeṣu ā mahaḥ śardhāṁs i adbhuta-enasām
adveṣaḥ naḥ marutaḥ gātum ā itana śrota havam jarituḥ evayāmarut viṣṇoḥ mahaḥ sa-manyavaḥ yuyotana smat rathyaḥ na daṁsanā apa dveṣāṁsi sanutariti
ganta naḥ yajñam yajñiyāḥ su-śami śrota havam arakṣaḥ evayāmarut jyeṣṭhāsaḥ na parvatāsaḥ vi-omani yūyam tasya pra-cetasaḥ syāta duḥ-dhartavaḥ nidaḥ
tvam hi agne prathamaḥ manotā asyāḥ dhiyaḥ abhavaḥ dasma hotā tvam sīm vr̥ṣan akr̥ṇoḥ dustarītu sahaḥ viśvasmai sahase sahadhyai
adha hātā ni asīdaḥ yajīyān il̥aḥ pade iṣayan īḍyaḥ san tam tvā naraḥ prathamam deva-yantaḥ mahaḥ rāye citayantaḥ anu gman
vr̥tāiva yantam bahu-bhiḥ vasavyaiḥ tve iti rayim jāgr̥-vāṁsaḥ anu gman ruśantam agnim darśatam br̥hantam vapāvantam viśvahā dīdi-vāṁsam
padam devasya namasā vyantaḥ śravasyavaḥ śravaḥ āpan amr̥ktam nāmāni cit dadhire yajñiyāni bhadrāyām te raṇayanta sam-dr̥ṣṭau
tvām vardhanti kṣitayaḥ pr̥thivyām tvām rāyaḥ ubhayāsaḥ janānām tvam trātā taraṇe cetyaḥ bhūḥ pitā mātā sadam it mānuṣāṇām
saparyeṇyaḥ saḥ priyaḥ vikṣu agniḥ hotā mandraḥ ni sisāda yajīyān tam tvā vayam dame ā dīdi-vāṁsam upa jñu-bādhaḥ namasā sadema
tvam tvā vayam su-dhyaḥ navyam agne sumna-yavaḥ īmahe deva-yantaḥ tvam viśaḥ anayaḥ dīdyānaḥ divaḥ agne br̥hatā rocanena
viśām kavim viśpatim śaśvatīnām ni-tośanam vr̥ṣabham carṣaṇīnām preti-iṣaṇim iṣayantam pāvakam rājantam agnim yajatam rayīṇām
saḥ agne īje śaśame ca martaḥ yaḥ te ānaṭ sam-idhā havya-dātim yaḥ āhutim pari veda namaḥ-bhiḥ viśvā it saḥ vāmā dadhate tvāūtaḥ
asmsi oṁ iti te mahi mahe vidhema namaḥ-bhiḥ agne sam-idhā uta havyaiḥ vedī sūno iti sahasaḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ ukthaiḥ ā te bhadrāyām su-matau yātema
ā yaḥ tatantha rodasī iti vi bhāsā śravaḥ-bhiḥ ca śravasyaḥ tarutraḥ br̥hat-bhiḥ vājaiḥ sthavirebhiḥ asme iti revat-bhiḥ agne vi-taram vi bhāhi
nr̥-vat vaso iti sadam it dhehi asme iti bhūri tokāya tanayāya paśvaḥ pūrvīḥ iṣaḥ br̥hatīḥ āre--aghāḥ asme iti bhadrā sauśravasāni santu
purūṇi agne purudhā tvāyā vasūni rājan vasutā te aśyām purūṇi hi tve iti puru-vāra santi agne vasu vidhate rājani tve iti
tvam hi kṣaita-vat yaśaḥ agne mitraḥ na patyase tvam vi-carṣaṇe śravaḥ vaso iti puṣṭim na puṣyasi
tvām hi sma carṣaṇayaḥ yajñebhiḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ īl̥ate tvām vājī yāti avr̥kaḥ rajaḥ-tūḥ viśva-carṣaṇiḥ
sa-joṣaḥ tvā divaḥ naraḥ yajñasya ketum indhate yat ha sya mānuṣaḥ janaḥ sumna-yuḥ juhve adhvare
r̥dhat yaḥ te su-dānave dhiyā martaḥ śaśamate ūtī saḥ br̥hataḥ divaḥ dviṣaḥ aṁhaḥ na tarati
sam-idhā yaḥ te āhutim ni-śitim martyaḥ naśat vayāvantam saḥ puṣyati kṣayam agne śata-āyuṣam
tveṣaḥ te dhūmaḥ r̥ṇvati divi san śukraḥ ātataḥ sūraḥ na hi dyutā tvam kr̥pā pāvaka rocase
adha hi vikṣu īḍyaḥ asi priyaḥ naḥ atithiḥ raṇvaḥ puri-iva jūyarḥ sūnuḥ na trayayāyyaḥ
kratvā hi droṇe ajyase agne vājī na kr̥tvyaḥ parijmāiva svadhā gayaḥ atyaḥ na hvāryaḥ śiśuḥ
tvam tyā cit acyutā agne paśuḥ na yavase dhāma ha yat te ajara vanā vr̥ścanti śikvasaḥ
veṣi hi adhvari-yatām agne hotā dame viśām sam-r̥dhaḥ viśpate kr̥ṇu juṣasva havyam aṅgiraḥ
accha naḥ mitra-mahaḥ deva devān agne vocaḥ su-matim rodasyoḥ vīhi svastim su-kṣitim divaḥ nr̥r̥n dviṣaḥ aṁhāṁsi duḥ-itā tarema tā tarema tava avasā tarema
agne saḥ kṣeṣat r̥ta-pāḥ r̥te--jāḥ uru jyotiḥ naśate deva-yuḥ te yam tvam mitreṇa varuṇaḥ sa-joṣāḥ deva pāsi tyajasā martam aṁhaḥ
īje yajñebhiḥ śaśame śamībhiḥ r̥dhat-vārāya agnaye dadāśa eva cana tam yaśasām ajuṣṭiḥ na aṁhaḥ martam naśate na pra-dr̥ptiḥ
sūraḥ na yasya dr̥śatiḥ arepāḥ bhīmā yat eti śucataḥ te ā dhīḥ heṣasvataḥ śurudhaḥ na ayam aktoḥ kutrāa cit raṇvaḥ vasatiḥ vane--jāḥ
tigmam cit ema mahi varpaḥ asya bhasat aśvaḥ na yamasāna āsā vi-jehamānaḥ paraśuḥ na jihvām draviḥ na dravayati dāru dhakṣat
saḥ it astāiva prati dhāt asiṣyan śiśīta tejaḥ ayasaḥ na dhārām citra-dhrajatiḥ aratiḥ yaḥ aktoḥ veḥ na dru-sadvā raghupatma-jaṁhāḥ
saḥ īm rebhaḥ na prati vaste usrāḥ śociṣā rarapīti mitr-amahāḥ naktam yaḥ īm aruṣaḥ yaḥ divā nr̥r̥n amartyaḥ aruṣaḥ yaḥ divā nr̥r̥n
divaḥ na yasya vidhataḥ navīnot vr̥ṣā rukṣaḥ oṣadhīṣu nūnot ghr̥ṇā na yaḥ dhrajasā patmanā yan ā rodasī iti vasunā dam supatnī itisu-patnī
dhāyaḥ-bhiḥ vā yaḥ yujyebhiḥ arkaiḥ vidyut na davidyot svebhiḥ śuṣmaiḥ śardhaḥ vā yaḥ marutām tatakṣa r̥bhuḥ na tveṣaḥ rabhasānaḥ adyaut
yathā hotaḥ manuṣaḥ deva-tātā yajñebhiḥ sūno iti sahasaḥ yajāsi eva naḥ adya samanā samānān uśan agne uśasaḥ yakṣi devān
saḥ naḥ vibhāvā cakṣaṇiḥ na vastoḥ agniḥ vandāru vedyaḥ canaḥ dhāt viśva-āyuḥ yaḥ amr̥taḥ martyeṣu uṣaḥ-bhut bhūt atithiḥ jāta-vedāḥ
dyāvaḥ na yasya panayanti abhvam bhāsāṁsi vaste sūryaḥ na śukraḥ vi yaḥ inoti ajaraḥ pāvakaḥ aśnasya cit śiśnathat pūrvyāṇi
vadmā hi sūno iti asi adma-sadvā cakre agniḥ januṣā ajmā annam saḥ tvam naḥ ūrja-sane ūrjam dhāḥ rājāiva jeḥ avr̥ke kṣeṣi antariti
ni-tikti yaḥ vāranam annam atti vāyuḥ na rāṣṭrī ati eti aktūn tuyārmaḥ yaḥ te ādiśām arātīḥ atyaḥ na hrutaḥ patataḥ pari-hrut
ā sūryaḥ na bhānumat-bhiḥ arkaiḥ agne tatantha rodasī iti vi bhāsā citraḥ nayat pari tamāṁsi aktaḥ śociṣā patman auśijaḥ na dīyan
tvām hi mandra-tamam arka-śokaiḥ vavr̥mahe mahi naḥ śroṣi agne indram na tvā śavasā devatā vāyum pr̥ṇanti rādhasā nr̥-tamāḥ
nu naḥ agne avr̥kebhiḥ svasti veṣi rāyaḥ pathi-bhiḥ parṣi aṁhaḥ tā sūri-bhyaḥ gr̥ṇate rāsi sumnam madema śata-himāḥ su-vīrāḥ
huve vaḥ sūnum sahasaḥ yuvānam adrogha-vācam mati-bhiḥ yaviṣṭham yaḥ invati draviṇāni pra-cetāḥ viśva-vārāṇi puru-vāraḥ adhruk
tve iti vasūni puru-aṇīka hotaḥ doṣā vastoḥ ā īrire yajñiyāsaḥ kṣāma-iva viśvā bhuvanāni yasmin sam saubhagāni dadhire pāvake
tvam vikṣu pra-divaḥ sīda āsu kratvā rathīḥ abhavaḥ vāryāṇām ataḥ inoṣi vidhate cikitvaḥ vi ānuṣak jāta-vedaḥ vasūni
yaḥ naḥ sanutyaḥ abhi-dāsat agne yaḥ antaraḥ mitra-mahaḥ vanuṣyāt tam ajarebhiḥ vr̥ṣa-bhiḥ tava svaiḥ tapa tapiṣṭha tapasā tapasvān
yaḥ te yajñena sam-idhā yaḥ ukthaiḥ arkebhiḥ sūno iti sahasaḥ dadāśat saḥ martyeṣu amr̥ta pra-cetā rāyā dyumnena śravasā vi bhāti
saḥ tat kr̥dhi iṣitaḥ tūyam agne spr̥dhaḥ bādhasva sahasā sahasvān yat śasyase dyu-bhiḥ aktaḥ vacaḥ-bhiḥ tat juṣasva jarituḥ ghoṣi manma
aśyāma tam kāmam agne tava ūtī aśyāma rayim rayi-vaḥ su-vīram aśyāma vājam abhi vājayants aśyāma dyumnam ajara ajaram te
pra navyasā sahasaḥ sūnum accha yajñena gātum avaḥ icchamānaḥ vr̥ścat-vanam kr̥ṣṇayāmam ruśantam vītī hotāram divyam jigāti
saḥ śvitānaḥ tānyatuḥ rocana-sthāḥ ajarebhiḥ nānadat-bhiḥ yaviṣṭhaḥ yaḥ pāvakaḥ puru-tamaḥ purūṇi pr̥thūni agniḥ anu-yāti bharvan
vi te viṣvak vāta-jūtāsaḥ agne bhāmāsaḥ śuce śucayaḥ caranti tuvi-mrakṣāsaḥ divyāḥ nava-gvāḥ vanā vananti dhr̥ṣatā rujantaḥ
ye te śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ śuciṣmaḥ kṣām vapanti vi-sitāsaḥ aśvāḥ adha bhramaḥ te urviyā vi bhāti yātayamānaḥ adhi sānu pr̥śneḥ
adha jihvā pāpatīti pra vr̥ṣṇaḥ goṣu-yudhaḥ na aśaniḥ sr̥jānā śūrasya-iva pra-sitiḥ kṣātiḥ agneḥ duḥ-vartuḥ bhīmaḥ dayate vanāni
ā bhānunā pārthivāni jrayāṁsi mahaḥ todasya dhr̥ṣatā tatantha saḥ bādhasva apa bhayā sahaḥ-bhiḥ spr̥dhaḥ vanuṣyan vanuṣaḥ ni jūvar
saḥ citra citram citayantam asme iti citra-kṣatra citra-tamam vayaḥ-dhām candram rayim puru-vīram br̥hantam candra candrābhiḥ gr̥ṇate yuvasva
mūrdhānam divaḥ aratim pr̥thivyāḥ vaiśvānaram r̥te ā jātam agnim kavim sam-rājam atithim janānām āsan ā pātram janayanta devāḥ
nābhim yajñānām sadanam rayīṇām mahām āhāvam abhi sam navanta vaiśvānaram rathyam adhvarāṇām yajñasya ketum janayanta devāḥ
tvat vipraḥ jāyate vājī agne tvat vīrāsaḥ abhimāti-sāhaḥ vaiśvānara tvam asmāsu dhehi vasūni rājan spr̥hayāyyāṇi
tvām viśve amr̥ta jāyamānam śiśum na devāḥ abhi sam navante tava kratu-bhiḥ amr̥ta-tvam āyan vaiśvānara yat pitroḥ adīdeḥ
