vaiśvānara tava tāni vratāni mahāni agne nakiḥ ā dadharṣa yat jāyamānaḥ pitroḥ upa-sthe avindaḥ ketum vayuneṣu ahnām
vaiśvānarasya vi-mitāni cakṣasā sānūni divaḥ amr̥tasya ketunā tasya it oṁ iti viśvā bhuvanā adhi mūrdhani vayāḥ-iva ruruhuḥ sapta vi-sruhaḥ
vi yaḥ rajāṁsi amimīta su-kratuḥ vaiśvānaraḥ vi divaḥ rocanā kavi ḥ pari yaḥ viśvā bhuvanāni paprathe adabdhaḥ gopāḥ amr̥tasya rakṣi tā
pr̥kṣasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ aruṣasya nu sahaḥ pra nu vocam vidathā jāta-vedasaḥ vaiśvānarāya matiḥ navyasī śuciḥ somaḥ-iva pavate cāruḥ agnaye
saḥ jāyamānaḥ parame vi-omani vratāni agniḥ vrata-pāḥ arakṣata vi antarikṣam amimīta su-kratuḥ vaiśvānaraḥ mahinā nākam aspr̥śat
vi astabhnāt rodasī iti mitraḥ adbhutaḥ antaḥ-vāvat akr̥ṇot jyotiṣā tamaḥ vi carmaṇīivet icarmaṇī-iva dhiṣaṇeiti avartayat vaiśvānaraḥ viśvam adhatta vr̥ṣṇyam
apām upa-sthe mahiṣāḥ agr̥bhṇata viśaḥ rājānam upa tasthuḥ r̥gmiyam ā dūtaḥ agnim abharat vivasvataḥ vaiśvānaram mātariśvā parāvataḥ
yuge--yuge vidathyam gr̥ṇat-bhyaḥ agne rayim yaśasam dhehi navyasīm pavyāiva rājan agha-śaṁsam ajara nīcā ni vr̥śca vaninam na tejasā
asmākam agne maghavat-su dhāraya anāmi kṣatram ajaram su-vīryam vayam jayema śatinam sahasriṇam vaiśvānara vājam agne tava ūti-bhiḥ
adabdhebhiḥ tava gopābhiḥ iṣṭe asmākam pāhi tri-sadastha sūrīn rakṣa ca naḥ daduṣām śardhaḥ agne vaiśvānara pra ca tārīḥ stavānaḥ
ahaḥ ca kr̥ṣṇam ahaḥ arjunam ca vi varteteiti rajasī iti vedyābhiḥ vaiśvānaraḥ jāyamānaḥ na rājā ava atirat jyotiṣā agniḥ tamāṁsi
na aham tantum na vi jānāmi otum na yam vayanti sam-are atamānāḥ kasya svit putraḥ iha vaktvāni paraḥ vadāti avareṇa pitrā
saḥ it tantum saḥ vi jānāti otum saḥ vaktvāni r̥tu-thā vadāti yaḥ īm ciketat amr̥tasya gopāḥ avaḥ caran paraḥ anyena paśyan
ayam hotā prathamaḥ paśyata imam idam jyotiḥ amr̥tam martyeṣu ayam saḥ jajñe dhruvaḥ ā ni-sattaḥ amartyaḥ tanvā vardhamānaḥ
dhruvam jyotiḥ ni-hitam dr̥śaye kam manaḥ javiṣṭham patayat-su antariti viśve devāḥ sa-manasaḥ sa-ketāḥ ekam kratum abhi vi yānti sādhu
vi me karṇā patayataḥ vi cakṣuḥ vi idam jyotiḥ hr̥daye āhitam yat vi me manaḥ carati dūre--ādhīḥ kim svit vakṣyāmi kim oṁ iti nu maniṣye
viśve devāḥ anamasyan bhiyānāḥ tvām agne tamasi tasthi-vāṁsam vaiśvānaraḥ avatu ūtaye naḥ amartyaḥ avatu ūtaye naḥ
puraḥ vaḥ mandram divyam su-vr̥ktim pra-yati yajñe agnim adhvare dadhidhvam puraḥ ukthebhiḥ saḥ hi naḥ vibhāvā su-adhvarā kārati jāta-vedāḥ
tam oṁ iti dyu-maḥ puru-aṇīka hotaḥ agne agni-bhiḥ manuṣaḥ idhānaḥ stomam yam asmai mamatāiva śūṣam ghr̥tam na śuci matayaḥ pavante
pīpāya saḥ śravasā martyeṣu yaḥ agnaye dadāśa vipraḥ ukthaiḥ citrābhiḥ tam ūti-bhiḥ citra-śociḥ vrajasya sātā go--mataḥ dadhāti
ā yaḥ paprau jāyamānaḥ urvī iti dūre--dr̥śā bhāsā kr̥ṣṇa-adhvā adha bahu cit tamaḥ ūrmyāyāḥ tiraḥ śociṣā dadr̥śe pāvakaḥ
nu naḥ citram puru-vājābhiḥ ūtī agne rayim maghavat-bhyaḥ ca dhehi ye rādhasā śravasā ca ati anyān su-vīryebhiḥ ca abhi santi janān
imam yajñam canaḥ dhāḥ agne uśan yam te āsānaḥ juhute haviṣmān bharat-vājeṣu dadhiṣe su-vr̥ktim avīḥ vājasya gadhyasya sātau
vi dveṣāṁsi inuhi vardhaya il̥ām madema śata-himāḥ su-vīrāḥ
yajasva hotaḥ iṣitaḥ yajīyān agne bādhaḥ marutām na pra-yukti ā naḥ mitrāvaruṇā nāsatyā dyāvā hotrāya pr̥thivī iti vavr̥tyāḥ
tvam hotā mandra-tamaḥ naḥ adhruk antaḥ devaḥ vidathā marteṣu pāvakayā juhvā vahniḥ āsā agne yajasva tanvam tava svām
dhanyā cit hi tve iti dhiṣaṇā vaṣṭi pra devān janma gr̥ṇate yajadhyai vepiṣṭhaḥ aṅgirasām yat ha vipraḥ madhu chandaḥ bhanati rebhaḥ iṣṭau
āyum na yam namasā rāta-havyāḥ añjanti su-prayasam pañca janāḥ
vr̥ñje ha yat namasā barhiḥ agnau ayāmi sruk ghr̥ta-vatī su-vr̥ktiḥ amyakṣi sadma sadane pr̥thivyāḥ aśrāyi yajñaḥ sūrye na cakṣuḥ
dr̥śasya naḥ puru-aṇīka hotaḥ devebhiḥ agne agni-bhiḥ idhānaḥ rāyaḥ sūno iti sahasaḥ vavasānāḥ ati srasema vr̥janam na aṁhaḥ
madhye hotā duroṇe barhiṣaḥ rāṭ agniḥ todasya rodasī iti yajadhyai ayam saḥ sūnuḥ sahasaḥ r̥ta-vā dūrāt sūryaḥ na śociṣā tatāna
ā yasmin tve iti su apāke yajatra yakṣat rājan sarvatātāiva nu dyauḥ tri-sadhasthaḥ tataruṣaḥ na jaṁhaḥ havyā maghāni mānuṣā yajadhyai
tejiṣṭhā yasya aratiḥ vane--rāṭ todaḥ adhvan na vr̥dhasānaḥ adyaut adroghaḥ na dravitā cetati tman amartyaḥ avartraḥ oṣadhīṣu
saḥ asmākebhiḥ etari na śūṣaiḥ agniḥ stave dame ā jāta-vedāḥ dru-annaḥ vanvan kratvā na arvā usraḥ pitāiva jārayāyi yajñaiḥ
adha sma asya panayanti bhāsaḥ vr̥thā yat takṣat anu-yāti pr̥thvīm sadyaḥ yaḥ spandraḥ vi-sitaḥ dhavīyān r̥ṇaḥ na tāyuḥ ati dhanva rāṭ
saḥ tvam naḥ arvan nidāyāḥ viśvebhiḥ agne agnibhiḥ idhānaḥ madema śata-himāḥ su-vīrāḥ
tvat viśvā su-bhaga saubhagāni agne vi yānti vaninaḥ na vayāḥ śruṣṭī rayiḥ vājaḥ vr̥tra-tūrye divaḥ vr̥ṣṭiḥ īḍyaḥ rītiḥ apām
tvam bhagaḥ naḥ ā hi ratnam iṣe parijmāiva kṣayasi dasma-varcāḥ agne mitraḥ na br̥hataḥ r̥tasya asi kṣattā vāmasya deva bhūreḥ
saḥ sat-patiḥ śavasā hanti vr̥tram agne vipraḥ vi paṇeḥ bharti vājam yam tvam pra-cetaḥ r̥ta-jāta rāyā sa-joṣāḥ naptrā apām hinoṣi
yaḥ te sūno iti sahasaḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ ukthaiḥ yajñaiḥ martaḥ ni-śitam vedyā ānaṭ viśvam saḥ deva prati vāram agne dhatte dhānyam patyate vasavyaiḥ
tā nr̥-bhyaḥ ā sauśravasā su-vīrā agne sūno iti sahasaḥ puṣyase dhāḥ kr̥ṇoṣi yat śavasā bhūri paśvaḥ vayaḥ vr̥kāya araye jasuraye
vadmā sūno iti sahasaḥ naḥ vi-hāyāḥ agne tokam tanayam vāji naḥ dāḥ viśvābhiḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ abhi pūrtim aśyām madema śata-himāḥ su-vīrāḥ
agnā yaḥ martyaḥ duvaḥ dhiyam jujoṣa dhīti-bhiḥ bhasat nu saḥ pra pūrvyaḥ iṣam vurīta avase
agniḥ it hi pra-certāḥ agniḥ vedhaḥ-tamaḥ r̥ṣiḥ agnim hotāram īl̥ate yajñeṣu manuṣaḥ viśaḥ
nānā hi agne avase spardhante rāyaḥ aryaḥ tūrvantaḥ dasyum āyavaḥ vrataiḥ sīkṣantaḥ avratam
agniḥ apsām r̥ti-saham vīram dadāti sat-patim yasya trasanti śavasaḥ sam-cakṣi śatravaḥ bhiyā
agniḥ hi vidmanā nidaḥ devaḥ martam uruṣyati saha-vā yasya avr̥taḥ rayiḥ vājeṣu avr̥taḥ
accha naḥ mitra-mahaḥ deva devān agne vocaḥ su-matim rodasyoḥ vīhi svastim su-kṣitim divaḥ nr̥r̥n dviṣaḥ aṁhāṁsi duḥ-itā tarema tā tarema tava avasā tarema
imam oṁ iti su vaḥ atithim uṣaḥ-budham viśvāsām viśām patim r̥ñjase girā vet i it divaḥ januṣā kat cit ā śuciḥ jyok cit atti garbhaḥ yat acyutam
mitram na yam su-dhitam bhr̥gavaḥ dadhuḥ vanaspatau īḍyam ūrdhva-śociṣam saḥ tvam su-prītaḥ vīta-havye adbhuta praśasti-bhiḥ mahayase dive--dive
saḥ tvam dakasya avr̥kaḥ vr̥dhaḥ bhūḥ aryaḥ parasya antarasya taruṣaḥ rāyaḥ sūno iti sahasaḥ martyeṣu ā chardiḥ yaccha vīta-havyāya sa-prathaḥ bharat-vājāya sa-prathaḥ
dyutānam vaḥ atithim svaḥ-naram agnim hotāram manuṣaḥ su-adhvaram vipram na dyukṣa-vacasam suvr̥kti-bhiḥ havya-vāham aratim devam r̥ñjase
pāvakayā yaḥ citayantyā kr̥pā kṣāman ruruce uṣasaḥ na bhānunā tūvarn na yāman etaśasya nu raṇe yaḥ ghr̥ṇe na tatr̥ṣāṇaḥ ajaraḥ
agnim-agnim vaḥ sam-idhā duvasyata priyam-priyam vaḥ atithim gr̥ṇīṣaṇi upa vaḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ amr̥tam vivāsata devaḥ deveṣu vanate hi vāryam devaḥ deveṣu vanate hi naḥ duvaḥ
sam-iddham agnim sam-idhā girā gr̥ṇe śucim pāvakam puraḥ adhvare dhruvam vipram hotāram puru-vāram adruham kavim sumnaiḥ īmahe jāta-vedasam
tvām dūtam agne amr̥tam yuge--yuge havya-vāham dadhire pāyum īḍyam devāsaḥ ca martāsaḥ ca jāgr̥vim vi-bhum viśpatim namasā ni sedire
vi-bhūṣan agne ubhayān anu vratā dūtaḥ devānām rajasī iti sam īyase yat te dhītim su-matim āvr̥ṇīmahe adha sma naḥ tri-varūthaḥ śivaḥ bhava
tam su-pratīkam su-dr̥śam su-añcam avidvāṁsaḥ viduḥ-taram sapema saḥ yakṣat viśvā vayunāni vidvān pra havyam agniḥ amr̥teṣu vocat
tam agne pāsi uta tam piparṣi yaḥ te ānaṭ kavaye śūra dhītim yajñasya vā ni-śitim vā ut-itim vā tam it pr̥ṇakṣi śavasā uta rāyā
tvam agne vanuṣyataḥ ni pāhi tvam oṁ iti naḥ sahasāvan avadyāt sam tvā dhvasman-vat abhi etu pāthaḥ sam rayiḥ spr̥hayāyyaḥ sahasrī
agniḥ hotā gr̥ha-patiḥ saḥ rājā viśvā veda janima jāta-vedāḥ devānām uta yaḥ martyānām yajiṣṭhaḥ saḥ pra yajatām r̥ta-vā
agne yat adya viśaḥ adhvarasya hotariti pāvaka-śoce veḥ tvam hi yajvā r̥tā yajāsi mahinā vi yat bhūḥ havyā vaha yaviṣṭha yā te adya
abhi prayāṁsi su-dhitāni hi khyaḥ ni tvā dadhīta rodasī iti yajadhyai ava naḥ magha-van vāja-sātau agne viśvāni duḥ-itā tarema tā tarema tava avasā tarema
agne viśvebhiḥ su-anīka devaiḥ ūrṇāvantam prathamaḥ sīda yonim kulāyanim ghr̥ta-vantam savitre yajñam naya yajamānāya sādhu
imam oṁ iti tyam atharva-vat agnim manthanti vedhasaḥ yam aṅku-yantam ā anayan amūram syāvyābhyaḥ
janiṣva deva-vītaye sarva-tātā svastaye ā devān vakṣi amr̥tān r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ yajñam deveṣu pispr̥śaḥ
vayam oṁ iti tvā gr̥ha-pate janānām agne akarma sam-idhā br̥hantam asthūri naḥ gārhapatyāni santu tigmena naḥ tejasā sam siśādhi
tvam agne yajñānām hotā viśveṣām hitaḥ devebhiḥ mānuṣe jane
saḥ naḥ mandrābhiḥ adhvare jihvābhiḥ yaja mahaḥ ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca
vettha hi vedhaḥ adhvanaḥ pathaḥ ce deva añjasā agne yajñeṣu sukrato itisu-krato
tvām īl̥e adha dvitā bharataḥ vāji-bhiḥ śunam īje yajñeṣu yajñiyam
tvam imā vāryā puru divaḥ-dāsāya sunvate bharat-vājāya dāśuṣe
tvam dūtaḥ amartyaḥ ā vaha daivyam janam śr̥ṇvan viprasya su-stutim
tvām agne su-ādhyaḥ martāsaḥ deva-vītaye yajñeṣu devam īl̥ate
tava pra yakṣi sam-dr̥śam uta kratum su-dānavaḥ viśve juṣanta kāminaḥ
tvam hotā manuḥ-hitaḥ vahniḥ āsā viduḥ-taraḥ agne yakṣi divaḥ viśaḥ
agne ā yāhi vītaye gr̥ṇānaḥ havya-dātaye ni hotā satsi barhiṣi
tam tvā samit-bhiḥ aṅgiraḥ ghr̥tena vardhayāmasi br̥hat śoca yaviṣṭhya
saḥ naḥ pr̥thu śravāyyam accha deva vivāsasi br̥hat agne su-vīryam
tvām agne puṣkarāt adhi atharvā niḥ amanthata mūdhnarḥ viśvasya vāghataḥ
tam oṁ iti tvā dadhyaṅ r̥ṣiḥ putraḥ īdhe atharvaṇaḥ vr̥tra-hanam puram-daram
tam oṁ iti tvā pāthyaḥ vr̥ṣā sam īdhe dasyuhan-tamam dhanam-jayam raṇe--raṇe
ā ihi oṁ iti su bravāṇi te agne itthā itarāḥ giraḥ ebhiḥ vardhāse indu-bhiḥ
yatra kva ca te manaḥ dakṣam dadhase ut-taram tatra sadaḥ kr̥ṇavase
nahi te pūram akṣi-pat bhuvat nemānām vaso iti atha duvaḥ vanavase
ā agniḥ agāmi bhārataḥ vr̥tra-hā puru-cetanaḥ divaḥ-dāsasya sat-patiḥ
saḥ hi viśvā ati pārthivā rayim dāśat mahi-tvanā vanvan avātaḥ astr̥taḥ
saḥ pratna-vat navīyasā agne dyumnena sam-yatā br̥hat tatantha bhānunā
pra vaḥ sakhāyaḥ agnaye stomam yajñam ca dhr̥ṣṇu-yā arca gāya ca vedhase
saḥ hi yaḥ mānuṣā yugā sīdat hotā kavi-kratuḥ dūtaḥ ca havya-vāhanaḥ
tā rājānā śuci-vratā ādityān mārutam gaṇam vaso iti yakṣi iha rodasī iti
vasvī te agne sam-dr̥ṣṭiḥ iṣa-yate martyāya ūrjaḥ napāt amr̥tasya
kratvā dāḥ astu śreṣṭhaḥ adya tvā vanvan su-rekṇāḥ martaḥ ānāśa su-vr̥ktim
te te agne tvāūtāḥ iṣayantaḥ viśvam āyuḥ tarantaḥ aryaḥ arātīḥ vanvantaḥ aryaḥ arātīḥ
agniḥ tigmena śociṣā yāsat viśvam ni atriṇam agniḥ naḥ vanate rayim
su-vīram rayim ā bhara jāta-vedaḥ vi-carṣaṇe jahi rakṣāṁsi su-krato itisu-krato
tvam naḥ pāhi aṁhasaḥ jāta-vedaḥ agha-yataḥ / rakṣa naḥ brahmaṇaḥ kave
yaḥ naḥ agne duḥ-evaḥ ā martaḥ vadhāya dāśati tasmāt naḥ pāhi aṁhasaḥ
tvam tam deva jihvayā pari bādhasva duḥ-krtam martaḥ yaḥ naḥ jighāṁsati
bharat-vājāya sa-prathaḥ śarma yaccha sahantya agne vareṇyam vasu
agniḥ vr̥trāṇi jaṅghanat draviṇasyuḥ vipanyayā sam-iddhaḥ śukraḥ āhutaḥ
garbhe mātuḥ pituḥ pitā vi-didyutānaḥ akṣare sīdan r̥tasya yonim ā
brahma prajāvat ā bhara jāta-vedaḥ vi-carṣaṇe agne yat dīdayat d ivi
upa tvā raṇva-sandr̥śam prayasvantaḥ sahaḥ-kr̥ta agne sasr̥jmahe giraḥ
upa chāyām-iva ghr̥ṇeḥ aganma śarma te vayam agne hiraṇya-sandr̥śaḥ
yaḥ ugraḥ-iva śarya-hā tigma-śr̥ṅgaḥ na vaṁsa-gaḥ agne puraḥ rurojitha
ā yam haste na khādinam śiśum jātam na bibhrati viśām agnim su-adhvaram
pra devam deva-vītaye bharata vasuvit-tamam ā sve yonau ni sīdatu
ā jātam jāta-vedasi priyam śiśīta atithim syone ā gr̥ha-patim
agne yukṣva hi ye tava aśvāsaḥ deva sādhavaḥ aram vahanti manyave
accha naḥ yāhi ā vaha abhi prayāṁsi vītaye ā devān soma-pītaye
uu agne bhārata dyu-mat ajasreṇa davidyutat śoca vi bhāhi ajara
vītī yaḥ devam martaḥ duvasyet agnim īl̥īta adhvare haviṣmān hotāram satya-yajam rodasyoḥ uttāna-hastaḥ namasā vivāset
ā te agne r̥cā haviḥ hr̥dā taṣṭam bharāmasi te te bhavantu ukṣaṇaḥ r̥ṣabhāsaḥ vaśāḥ uta
agnim devāsaḥ agriyam indhate vr̥trahan-tamam yena vasūni ābhr̥tā tr̥l̥hā rakṣāṁsi vājinā
piba somam abhi yam ugra tardaḥ ūrvam gavyam mahi gr̥ṇānaḥ indra vi yaḥ dhr̥ṣṇo iti vadhiṣaḥ vajra-hasta viśvā vr̥tram amitriyā śavaḥ-bhiḥ
saḥ īm pāhi yaḥ r̥jīṣī tarutraḥ yaḥ śipra-vān vr̥ṣabhaḥ yaḥ matīnām yaḥ gotra-bhit vajra-bhr̥t yaḥ hari-sthāḥ saḥ indra citrān abhi tr̥ndhi vājān
eva pāhi pratna-thā mandatu tvā śrudhi brahma vavr̥dhasva uta gīḥ-bhiḥ āviḥ sūryam kr̥ṇuhi pīpihīṣaḥ jahi śatrūn abhi gāḥ indra tr̥ndhi
te tvā madāḥ br̥hat indra svadhāvaḥ ime pītāḥ ukṣayanta dyu-mantam mahām anūnam tavasam vi-bhūtim matsarāsaḥ jarhr̥ṣanta pra-sāham
yebhiḥ sūryam uṣasam mandasānaḥ avāsayaḥ apa dr̥l̥hāni dardrat mahām adrim pari gāḥ indra santam nutthāḥ acyutam sadasaḥ pari svāt
tava kratvā tava tat daṁsanābhiḥ āmāsu pakvam śacyā ni dīdharitidīdhaḥ aurṇoḥ duraḥ usriyābhyaḥ vi dr̥l̥hā ut ūrvāt gāḥ asr̥jaḥ aṅgirasvān
paprātha kṣām mahi daṁsaḥ vi urvīm upa dyām r̥ṣvaḥ br̥hat indra stabhāyaḥ adhārayaḥ rodasī iti devaputreitideva-putre pratne iti mātarā yahvī iti r̥tasya
adha tvā viśve puraḥ indra devāḥ ekam tavasam dadhire bharāya adevaḥ yat abhi auhiṣṭa devān svaḥ-sātā vr̥ṇate indram atra
adha dyauḥ cit te apa sā nu vajrāt dvitā anamat bhiyasā svasya manyoḥ ahim yat indraḥ abhi ohasānam ni cit viśva-āyuḥ śayathe jaghāna
adha tvaṣṭā te mahaḥ ugra vajram sahasra-bhr̥ṣṭim vavr̥tat śata-aśrim ni-kāmam ara-manasam yena navantam ahim sam piṇak r̥jīṣin
vardhān yam viśve marutaḥ sa-joṣāḥ pacat śatam mahiṣān indra tubhyam pūṣā viṣṇuḥ trīṇi sarāṁsi dhāvan vr̥tra-hanam madiram aṁśum asmai
ā kṣodaḥ mahi vr̥tam nadīnām pari-sthitam asr̥jaḥ ūrmim apām tāsām anu pra-vataḥ indra panthām pra ārdayaḥ nīcīḥ apasaḥ samudram
eva tā viśvā cakr̥-vāṁsam indram mahām ugram ajuryam sahaḥ-dām su-vīram tvā su-āyudham su-vajram ā brahma navyam avase vavr̥tyāt
saḥ naḥ vājāya śravase iṣe ca rāye dhehi dyu-mataḥ indra viprān bharat-vāje nr̥-vataḥ indra sūrīn divi ca sma edhi pārye naḥ indra
ayā vājam deva-hitam sanema madema śata-himāḥ su-vīrāḥ
tam oṁ iti stuhi yaḥ abhibhūti-ojāḥ vanvan avātaḥ puru-hūtaḥ indraḥ aṣāl̥ham ugram sahamānam ābhiḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ vardha vr̥ṣabham carṣaṇīnām
saḥ yudhmaḥ satvā khaja-kr̥t samat-vā tuvi-mrakṣaḥ nadanu-mān r̥jīṣī br̥hat-reṇuḥ cyavanaḥ mānuṣīṇām ekaḥ kr̥ṣṭīnām abhavat saha-vā
tvam ha nu tyat adamayaḥ dasyūn ekaḥ kr̥ṣṭīḥ avanoḥ āryāya asti svit nu vīryam tat te indra na svit asti tat r̥tu-thā vi vocaḥ
sat it hi te tuvi-jātasya manye sahaḥ sahiṣṭha turataḥ turasya ugram ugrasya tavasaḥ tavīyaḥ aradhrasya radhra-turaḥ babhūva
tat naḥ pratnam sakhyam astu yuṣme iti itthā vadat-bhiḥ valam aṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ han acyuta-cyut dasma iṣayantam r̥ṇoḥ puraḥ vi duraḥ asya viśvāḥ
saḥ hi dhībhiḥ havyaḥ asti ugraḥ īśāna-kr̥t mahati vr̥tra-tūrye saḥ toka-sātā tanaye saḥ vajrī vitantasāyyaḥ abhavat samat-su
saḥ majmanā janima mānuṣāṇām amartyena nāmnā ati pra sarsre saḥ dyumnena saḥ śavasā uta rāyā saḥ vīryeṇa nr̥-tamaḥ sam-okāḥ
saḥ yaḥ na muhe na mithu janaḥ bhūt sumantu-nāmā / cumurim dhunim ca vr̥ṇak piprum śambaram śuṣṇam indraḥ purām cyautnāya śayathāya nu cit
ut-avatā tvakṣasā panyasā ca vr̥tra-hatyāya ratham indra tiṣṭha dhi ṣva vajram haste ā dakṣiṇa-trā abhi pra manda puru-datra māyāḥ
agniḥ na śuṣkam vanam indra hetī rakṣaḥ ni dhakṣi aśaniḥ na bhīmā gambhīrayā r̥ṣvayā yaḥ ruroja sdhvanayat duḥ-itā dambhayat ca
ā sahasram pathi-bhiḥ indra rāyā tuvi-dyumna tuvi-vājebhiḥ arvāk yāhi sūno iti sahasaḥ yasya nu cit adevaḥ īśe puru-hūta yotoḥ
pra tuvi-dyumnasya sthavirasya ghr̥ṣveḥ divaḥ rarapśe mahimā pr̥thi vyāḥ na asya śatruḥ na prati-mānam asti na prati-sthiḥ puruymāyasya sahyoḥ
pra tat te adya karaṇam kr̥tam bhūt kutsam yat āyum atithi-gvam asmai puru sahasrā ni śiśāḥ abhi kṣām ut tūrvayāṇam dhr̥ṣatā ninetha
anu tvā ahi-ghne adha deva devāḥ madan viśve kavi-tamam kavīnām karaḥ yatra varivaḥ bādhitāya dive janāya tanve gr̥ṇānaḥ
anu dyāvāpr̥thivī iti tat te ojaḥ amartyāḥ jihate indra devāḥ kr̥ṣva kr̥tno iti akr̥tam yat te asti uktham navīyaḥ janayasva yajñaiḥ
mahān indraḥ nr̥-vat ā carṣaṇi-prāḥ uta dvi-barhāḥ aminaḥ sahaḥ-bhiḥ asmadryak vavr̥dhe vīryāya uruḥ pr̥thuḥ su-kr̥taḥ kartr̥-bhiḥ bhūt
indram eva dhiṣaṇā sātaye dhāt br̥hantam r̥ṣvam ajaram yuvānam aṣāl̥hena śavasā śūsu-vāṁsam sadyaḥ cit yaḥ vavr̥dhe asāmi
pr̥thū iti karasnā bahulā gabhastī iti asmadryak sam mimīhi śravāṁsi yūthāiva paśvaḥ paśu-pāḥ damūnāḥ asmān indra abhi ā vavr̥tsva ājau
tam vaḥ indram catinam asya śākaiḥ iha nūnam vāja-yantaḥ huvema yathā cit pūrve jaritāraḥ āsuḥ anedyāḥ anavadyāḥ ariṣṭāḥ
dhr̥ta-vrataḥ dhana-dāḥ soma-vr̥ddhaḥ saḥ hi vāmasya vasunaḥ puru-kṣuḥ sam jigmire pathyāḥ rāyaḥ asmin samudre na sindhavaḥ yādamānāḥ
śaviṣṭham naḥ ā bhara śūra śavaḥ ojiṣṭham ojaḥ abhi-bhūte ugram viśvā dyumnā vr̥ṣṇyā mānuṣāṇām asmbhyam dāḥ hari-vaḥ mādayadhyai
yaḥ te madaḥ pr̥tanāṣāṭ amr̥dhraḥ indra tam naḥ ā bhara śūśu-vāṁsam yena tokasya tanayasya sātau maṁsīmahi jigīvāṁsaḥ tvāūtāḥ
ā naḥ bhara vr̥ṣaṇam śuṣmam indra dhana-spr̥tam śūśu-vāṁsam su-dakṣam yena vaṁsāma pr̥tanāsu śatrūn tava ūti-bhiḥ uta jāmīn ajāmīn
ā te śuṣmaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ etu paścāt ā uttarāt adharāt ā purastāt ā viśvataḥ abhi sam etu arvāṅ indra dyumnam svaḥ-vat dhehi asme iti
nr̥-vat te indra nr̥-tamābhiḥ ūtī vaṁsīmahi vāmam śromatebhiḥ īkṣe h i vasvaḥ ubhayasya rājan dhāḥ ratnam mahi sthūram br̥hantam
marutvantam vr̥ṣabham vavr̥dhānam akava-arim divyam śāsam indram viśva-saham avase nūtanāya ugram sahaḥ-dām iha tam huvema
janam vajrin mahi cit manyamānam ebhyaḥ nr̥-bhyaḥ randhaya yeṣu asmi adha hi tvā pr̥thivyām śūra-sātau havāmahe tanaye goṣu ap-su
vayam te ebhiḥ puru-hūta sakhyaiḥ śatroḥ-śatroḥ ut-tare it syāma ghnantaḥ vr̥trāṇi ubhayāni śūra rāyā madema br̥hatā tvāūtāḥ
dyauḥ na yaḥ indra abhi bhūma aryaḥ tasthau rayiḥ śavasā pr̥t-su janān tam naḥ sahasra-bharam urvarāsām daddhi sūno iti sahasaḥ vr̥tra-turam
divaḥ na tubhyam anu indra satrā asuryam devebhiḥ dhāyi viśvam ahi m yat vr̥tram apaḥ vavri-vāṁsam han r̥jīṣin viṣṇunā sacānaḥ
tūrvan ojīyān tavasaḥ tavīyān kr̥ta-brahmā indraḥ vr̥ddha-mahāḥ rājā abhavat madhunaḥ somyasya viśvāsām yat purām datnurm āvat
śataiḥ apadran paṇayaḥ indra atra daśa-oṇaye kavaye arka-sātau vadhaiḥ śuṣṇasya aśuṣasya māyāḥ pitvaḥ na arirecīt kim cana pra
mahaḥ druhaḥ apa viśva-āyu dhāyi vajrasya yat patane pādi śuṣṇaḥ uru saḥ sa-ratham sārathaye kaḥ indraḥ kutsāya sūryasya sātau
pra śyenaḥ na madiram aṁśum asmai śiraḥ dāsasya namuceḥ mathāyan pra āvat namīm sāpyam sasantam pr̥ṇak rāyā sam iṣā sam svast i
vi piproḥ ahi-māyasya dr̥l̥hāḥ puraḥ vajrin śavasā na dardaritidardaḥ su-dāman tat rekṇaḥ apra-mr̥ṣyam r̥jiśvane dātram dāśuṣe dāḥ
saḥ vetasum daśa-māyam daśa-oṇim tūtujim indraḥ svabhiṣṭi-sumnaḥ ā tugram śaśvat ibham dyotanāya mātuḥ na sīm upa sr̥ja iyadhyai
saḥ īm spr̥dhaḥ vanate aprati-itaḥ bibhrat vajram vr̥tra-hanam gabhastau tiṣṭhat harī iti adhi astāiva garte vacaḥ-yujā vahataḥ indram r̥ṣvam
sanema te avasā navyaḥ indra pra pūravaḥ stavante enā yajñaiḥ sapta yat puraḥ śarma śāradīḥ darta han dāsīḥ puru-kutsāya śikṣan
tvam vr̥dhaḥ indra pūrvyaḥ bhūḥ varivasyan uśane kāvyāya parā nava-vāstvam anu-deyam mahe pitre dadātha svam napātam
tvam dhuniḥ indra dhuni-matīḥ r̥ṇoḥ apaḥ sīrāḥ na sravantīḥ pra yat samudram ati śūra parṣi pāraya turvaśam yadum svasti
tava ha tyat indra viśvam ājau sastaḥ dhunīcumurī iti yā ha sisvap dīdayat it tubhyam somebhiḥ sunvan dabhītiḥ idhma-bhr̥tiḥ pakthī arkaiḥ
imāḥ oṁ iti tvā puru-tamasya kāroḥ havyam vīra havyāḥ havante dhiyaḥ rathe--sthām ajaram navīyaḥ rayiḥ vi-bhūtiḥ īyate vacasyā
tam oṁ iti stuṣe indram yaḥ vidānaḥ girvāhasam gīḥ-bhiḥ yajña-vr̥ddham yasya divam ati mahnā pr̥thivyāḥ puru-māyasya ririce mahi-tvam
saḥ it tamaḥ avayunam tatanvat sūryeṇa vayuna-vat cakāra kadā te martāḥ amr̥tasya dhāma iyakṣantaḥ na minanti svadhāvaḥ
yaḥ tā cakāra saḥ kuha svit indraḥ kam ā janam carati kāsu vikṣu kaḥ te yajñaḥ manase śam varāya kaḥ arkaḥ indra katamaḥ saḥ hotā
idā hi te veviṣataḥ purājāḥ pratnāsaḥ āsuḥ puru-kr̥t sakhāyaḥ ye madyamāsaḥ uta nūtanāsaḥ uta avamasya puru-hūta bodhi
tam pr̥cchantaḥ avarāsaḥ parāṇi pratnā te indra śrutyā anu yemuḥ arcāmasi vīra brahma-vāhaḥ yāt eva vidma tāt tvā mahāntam
abhi tvā pājaḥ rakṣasaḥ vi tasthe mahi jajñānam abhi tat su tiṣṭha tava pratnena yujyena sakhyā vajreṇa dhr̥ṣṇo iti apa tā nudasva
saḥ tu śrudhi indra nūtanasya brahmaṇyataḥ vīra kāru-dhāyaḥ tvam hi āpiḥ pra-divi pitr̥r̥ṇām śaśvat babhūtha su-havaḥ āiṣṭau
pra ūtaye varuṇam mitram indram marutaḥ kr̥ṣva avase naḥ adya pra pūṣaṇam viṣṇum agnim puram-dhim savitāram oṣadhīḥ parvatān ca
ime oṁ iti tvā puru-śāka prayajyo itipra-yajyo jaritāraḥ abhi arcanti arkaiḥ śrudhi havam ā huvataḥ huvānaḥ na tvāvān anyaḥ amr̥ta tvat asti
nu me ā vācam upa yāhi vidvān viśvebhiḥ sūno iti sahasaḥ yajatraiḥ ye agni-jihvāḥ r̥ta-sāpaḥ āsuḥ ye manum cakruḥ uparam dasāya
saḥ naḥ bodhi puraḥ-etā su-geṣu uta duḥ-geṣu pathi-kr̥t vidānaḥ ye aśramāsaḥ uravaḥ vahiṣṭhāḥ tebhiḥ naḥ indra abhi vakṣi vājam
yaḥ ekaḥ it havyaḥ carṣaṇīnām indram tam gīḥ-bhiḥ abhi arce ābhiḥ yaḥ patyate vr̥ṣabhaḥ vr̥ṣṇya-vān satyaḥ satvā puru-māyaḥ sahasvān
tam oṁ iti naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ nava-gvāḥ sapta viprāsaḥ abhi vājayantaḥ nakṣat-dābham taturim parvate--sthām adrogha-vācam mati-bhiḥ śaviṣṭham
tam īmahe indram asya rāyaḥ puru-vīrasya nr̥-vataḥ puru-kṣoḥ yaḥ askr̥dhoyuḥ ajaraḥ svaḥ-vān tam ā bhara hari-vaḥ mādayadhyai
tat naḥ vi vocaḥ yadi te purā cit jaritāraḥ ānaśuḥ sumnam indra kaḥ te bhāgaḥ kim vayaḥ dudhra khidvaḥ puru-hūta puruvaso itipuru-vaso asura-ghnaḥ
tam pr̥cchantī vajra-hastam rathe--sthām indram vepī vakvarī yasya nu gīḥ tuvi-grābham tuvi-kūrmim rabhaḥ-dām gātum iṣe nakṣate tumram accha
ayā ha tyam māyayā vavr̥dhānam manaḥ-juvā sva-tavaḥ parvatena acyutā cit vīl̥itā su-ojaḥ rujaḥ vi dr̥l̥hā dhr̥ṣatā vi-rapśin
tam vaḥ dhiyā navyasyā śaviṣṭham pratnam pratna-vat pari-taṁsayadhyai saḥ naḥ vakṣat ani-mānaḥ su-vahnā indraḥ viśvāni ati duḥ-gahāṇi
ā janāya druhvaṇe pārthivāni divyāni dīpayaḥ antarikṣā tapa vr̥ṣan viśvataḥ śociṣā tān brahma-dviṣe śocaya kṣām apaḥ ca
bhuvaḥ janasya divyasya rājā pārthivasya jagataḥ tveṣa-sandr̥k dhiṣva vajram dakṣiṇe indra haste viśvā ajurya dayase vi māyāḥ
ā sam-yatam indra ṇaḥ svastim śatru-tūryāya br̥hatīm amr̥dhrām yayā dāsāni āryāṇi vr̥trā karaḥ vajrin su-tukā nāhuṣāṇi
saḥ naḥ niyut-bhiḥ puru-hūta vedhaḥ viśva-vārābhiḥ ā gahi prayajyo itipra-yajyo na yāḥ adevaḥ varate na devaḥ ā ābhiḥ yāhi tūyam ā madryadrik
sute it tvam ni-miślaḥ indra some stome brahmaṇi śasyamāne ukthe yat vā yuktābhyām magha-van hari-bhyām bibhrat vajram bāhvoḥ indra yāsi
yat vā divi pārye susvim indra vr̥tra-hatye vasi śūra-sātau yat vā dakṣasya bibhyuṣaḥ abibhyat arandhayaḥ śardhataḥ indra dasyūn
pātā sutam indraḥ astu somam pra-nenīḥ ugraḥ jaritāram ūtī kartā vīrāya susvaye ūm ṁm iti[?] lokam dātā vasu stuvate kīraye cit
gantā iyanti savanā hari-bhyām babhriḥ vajram papiḥ somam dadiḥ gāḥ kartā vīram naryam sarva-vīram śrotā havam gr̥ṇataḥ stoma-vāhāḥ
asmai vayam yat vavāna tat viviṣmaḥ indrāya yaḥ naḥ pra-divaḥ apaḥ karitikaḥ sute some stumasi śaṁsat ukthā indrāya brahma vardhanam yathā asat
brahmāṇi hi cakr̥ṣe vardhanāni tāvat te indra mati-bhiḥ viviṣmaḥ sute some suta-pāḥ śam-tamāni rāndryā kriyāsma vakṣaṇāni yajñaiḥ
saḥ naḥ bodhi purol̥āśam rarāṇaḥ piba tu somam go--r̥jīkam indra ā idam barhiḥ yajamānasya sīda urum kr̥dhi tvāyataḥ oṁ iti lokam
saḥ mandasva hi anu joṣam ugra pra tvā yajñāsaḥ ime aśnuvantu pra ime havāsaḥ puru-hūtam asme iti ā tvā iyam dhīḥ avase indra yamyāḥ
tam vaḥ sakhāyaḥ sam yathā suteṣu somebhiḥ īm pr̥ṇata bhojam indram kuvit tasmai asati naḥ bharāya na susvim indraḥ avase mr̥dhāti
eva it indraḥ sute astāvi some bharat-vājeṣu kṣayat it maghonaḥ asat yathā jaritre uta sūriḥ indraḥ rāyaḥ viśva-vārasya dātā
vr̥ṣā madaḥ indre ślokaḥ ukthā sacā someṣu suta-pāḥ r̥jīṣī arcatryaḥ magha-vā nr̥-bhyaḥ ukthaiḥ dyukṣaḥ rājā girām akṣita-ūtiḥ
taturiḥ vīraḥ naryaḥ vi-cetāḥ śrotā havam gr̥ṇataḥ urvi-ūtiḥ vasuḥ śaṁsaḥ narām kāru-dhāyāḥ vājī stutaḥ vidathe dāti vājam
akṣaḥ na cakryoḥ śūra br̥han pra te mahnā ririce rodasyoḥ vr̥kṣasya nu te puru-hūta vayāḥ vi ūtayaḥ ruruhuḥ indra pūrvīḥ
śacī-vataḥ te puru-śāka śākāḥ gavām-iva srutayaḥ sam-caraṇīḥ vatsānām na tantayaḥ te indra dāman-vantaḥ adāmānaḥ su-dāman
anyat adya karvaram anyat oṁ iti śvaḥ asat ca sat muhuḥ ā cakriḥ indraḥ mitraḥ naḥ atra varuṇaḥ ca pūṣā aryaḥ vaśasya pari-etā asti
vi tvat āpaḥ na parvatasya pr̥ṣṭhāt ukthebhiḥ indra anayanta yajñaiḥ tam tvā ābhiḥ sustuti-bhiḥ vājayantaḥ ājim na jagmuḥ girvāhaḥ aśvāḥ
na yam jaranti śaradaḥ na māsāḥ na dyāvaḥ indram ava-karśayanti vr̥ddhasya cit vardhatām asya tanūḥ stomebhiḥ ukthaiḥ ca śasyamānā
na vīl̥ave namate na sthirāya na śardhate dasyu-jūtāya stavān ajrāḥ indrasya girayaḥ cit r̥ṣvāḥ gambhīre cit bhavati gādham asmai
gambhīreṇa naḥ uruṇā amatrin pra iṣaḥ yandhi suta-pāvan vājān sthāḥ oṁ iti su ūrdhvaḥ ūtī ariṣaṇyan aktoḥ vi-uṣṭau pari-takmyāyām
sacasva nāyam avase abhīke itaḥ vā tam indra pāhi riṣaḥ amā ca enam araṇye pāhi riṣaḥ madema śata-himāḥ su-vīrāḥ
yā te ūtiḥ avamā yā paramā yā madhyamā indra śuṣmin asti tābhiḥ oṁ iti su vr̥tra-hatye avīḥ naḥ ebhiḥ ca vājaiḥ mahān naḥ ugra
ābhiḥ spr̥dhaḥ mithatīḥ ariṣaṇyan amitrasya vyathaya manyum indra ābhiḥ viśvāḥ abhi-yujaḥ viṣūcīḥ āryāya viśaḥ ava tārīḥ dāsīḥ
indra jāmayaḥ uta ye ajāmayaḥ arvācīnāsaḥ vanuṣaḥ yuyujre tvam eṣām vithurā śavāṁsi jahi vr̥ṣṇyāni kr̥ṇuhi parācaḥ
śūraḥ vā śūram vanate śarīraiḥ tanū-rucā taruṣi yat kr̥ṇvaiteiti toke vā goṣu tanaye yat ap-su vi krandasī iti urvarāsu bravaiteiti
nahi tvā śūraḥ na turaḥ na dhr̥ṣṇuḥ na tvā yodhaḥ manyamānaḥ yuyodha indra nakiḥ tvā prati asti eṣām viśvā jātāni abhi asi tāni
saḥ patyate ubhayoḥ nr̥mṇam ayoḥ yadi vedhasaḥ sam-ithe havante vr̥tre vā mahaḥ nr̥-vati kṣaye vā vyacasvantā yadi vitantasaiteiti
adha sma te carṣaṇayaḥ yat ejān indra trātā uta bhava varūtā asmākāsaḥ ye nr̥-tamāsaḥ aryaḥ indra sūrayaḥ dadhire puraḥ naḥ
anu te dāyi mahe indriyāya satrā te viśvam anu vr̥tra-hatye anu kṣatram anu sahaḥ yajatra indra devebhiḥ anu te nr̥-sahye
eva naḥ spr̥dhaḥ sam aja samat-su indra rarandhi mithatīḥ adevīḥ vidyāma vastoḥ avasā gr̥ṇantaḥ bharat-vājāḥ uta te indra nūnam
śrudhi naḥ indra hvayāmasi tvā mahaḥ vājasya sātau vavr̥ṣāṇāḥ sam yat viśaḥ ayanta śūra-sātau ugram naḥ avaḥ pārye ahan dāḥ
tvām vājī havate vājineyaḥ mahaḥ vājasya gadhyasya sātau tvām vr̥treṣu indra sat-patim tarutram tvām caṣṭe muṣṭi-hā goṣu yudhyan
tvam kavim codayaḥ arka-sātau tvam kutsāya śuṣṇam dāśuṣe varka tvam śiraḥ amarmaṇaḥ parā ahan atithi-gvāya śaṁsyam kariṣyan
tvam ratham pra bharaḥ yodham r̥ṣvam āvaḥ yudhyantam vr̥ṣabham daśa-dyum tvam tugram vetasave sacā ahan tvam tujim gr̥ṇantam indra tūtorititūtoḥ
tvam tat uktham indra barhaṇā karitikaḥ pra yat śatā sahasrā śūra darṣi ava gireḥ dāsam śambaram han pra āvaḥ divaḥ-dāsam citrābhi ḥ ūtī
tvam śraddhābhiḥ mandasānaḥ somaiḥ dabhītaye cumurim indra sisvap tvam rajim pithīnase daśasyan ṣaṣṭim sahasrā śacyā sacā ahan
aham cana tat sūri-bhiḥ ānaśyān tava jyāyaḥ indra sumnam ojaḥ tvayā yat stavante sadha-vīra vīrāḥ tri-varūthena nahuṣā śaviṣṭha
vayam te asyām indra dyumna-hūtau sakhāyaḥ syāma mahina preṣṭhāḥ prātardaniḥ kṣatra-śrīḥ astu śreṣṭhaḥ ghane vr̥trāṇām sanaye dhanānām
kim asya made kim oṁ iti asya pītau indraḥ kim asya sakhye cakāra raṇāḥ vā ye ni-sadi ki m te asya purā vividre kim oṁ iti nūtanāsaḥ
sat asya made sat oṁ iti asya pītau indraḥ sat asya sakhye cakāra raṇāḥ vā ye ni-sadi sat te asya purā vividre sat oṁ iti nūtanāsaḥ
nahi nu te mahimanaḥ samasya na magha-van maghavat-tvasya vi dma na rādhasaḥ-rādhasaḥ nūtanasya indra nakiḥ dadr̥śe indriyam te
etat tyat te indriyam aceti yena avadhīḥ vara-śikhasya śeṣaḥ vajrasya yat te ni-hatasya śuṣmāt svanāt cit indra paramaḥ dadāra
vadhīt indraḥ vara-śikhasya śeṣaḥ abhi-āvartine cāyamānāya śikṣan vr̥cīvataḥ yat hariyūpīyāyām han pūrve ardhe bhiyasā aparaḥ darta
triṁśat-śatam varmiṇaḥ indra sākam yavyāvatyām puru-hūta śravasyā vr̥cīvantaḥ śarave patyamānāḥ pātrā bhindānāḥ ni-arthāni āyan
yasya gāvau aruṣā suyavasyū itisu-yavasyū antaḥ oṁ iti su carataḥ rerihāṇā saḥ sr̥ñjayāya turvaśam parā adāt vr̥cīvataḥ daiva-vātāya śikṣan
dvayān agne rathinaḥ viṁśatim gāḥ vadhū-mataḥ magha-vā mahyam sam-rāṭ abhi-āvartī cāyamānaḥ dadāti duḥ-nāśā iyam dakṣiṇā pārthavānām
ā gāvaḥ agman uta bhadram akran sīdantu go--sthe raṇayantu asme iti prajāvatīḥ puru-rūpāḥ iha syuḥ indrāya pūrvīḥ uṣasaḥ duhānāḥ
indraḥ yajvane pr̥ṇate ca śikṣati upa it dadāti na svam muṣāyati bhūyaḥ-bhūyaḥ rayim it asya vardhayan abhinne khilye ni dadhāti deva-yum
na tāḥ naśanti na dabhāti taskaraḥ na āsām āmitraḥ vyathiḥ ā dadharṣati devān ca yābhiḥ yajate dadāti ca jyok it tābhiḥ sacate go--patiḥ saha
na tāḥ arvā reṇu-kakāṭaḥ aśnute na saṁskr̥ta-tram upa yanti tāḥ abhi uru-gāyam abhayam tasya tāḥ anu gāvaḥ martasya vi caranti yajvanaḥ
gāvaḥ bhagaḥ gāvaḥ indraḥ me acchān gāvaḥ somasya prathamasya bhakṣaḥ imāḥ yāḥ gāvaḥ saḥ janāsaḥ indraḥ icchāmi it hr̥dā manasā cit indram
yūyam gāvaḥ medayatha kr̥śam cit aśrīram cit kr̥ṇutha su-pratīkam bhadram gr̥ham kr̥ṇutha bhadra-vācaḥ br̥hat vaḥ vayaḥ ucyate sabhāsu
prajāvatīḥ su-yavasam riśantīḥ śuddhāḥ apaḥ su-prapāne pibantīḥ mā vaḥ stenaḥ īśata mā agha-śaṁsaḥ pari vaḥ hetiḥ rudrasya vr̥jyāḥ
upa idam upa-parcanam āsu goṣu upa pr̥cyatām upa r̥ṣabhasya retasi upa indra tava vīrye
indram vaḥ naraḥ sakhyāya sepuḥ mahaḥ yantaḥ su-mataye cakānāḥ mahaḥ hi dātā vajra-hastaḥ asti mahām oṁ iti raṇvam avase yajadhvam
ā yasmin haste naryāḥ mimikṣuḥ ā rathe hiraṇyaye rathe--sthāḥ ā raśmayaḥ gabhastyoḥ sthūrayoḥ ā adhvan aśvāsaḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ yujānāḥ
śriye te pādā duvaḥ ā mimikṣuḥ dhr̥ṣṇuḥ vajrī śavasā dakṣiṇa-vān vasānaḥ atkam surabhim dr̥śe kam svaḥ na nr̥to iti iṣiraḥ babhūtha
saḥ somaḥ āmiśla-tamaḥ sutaḥ bhūt yasmin paktiḥ pacyate santi dhānāḥ indram naraḥ stuvantaḥ brahma-kārāḥ ukthā śaṁsantaḥ devavāta-tamāḥ
na te antaḥ śavasaḥ dhāyi asya vi tu bābadhe rodasī iti mahi-tvā ā tā sūriḥ pr̥ṇati tūtujānaḥ yūthāiva ap-su sam-ījamānaḥ ūtī
eva it indraḥ su-havaḥ r̥ṣvaḥ astu ūtī anūtī hiri-śipraḥ satvā eva hi jātaḥ asamāti-ojāḥ puru ca vr̥trā hanati ni dasyūn
bhūyaḥ it vavr̥dhe vīryāya ekaḥ ajuryaḥ dayate vasūni pra ririce d ivaḥ indraḥ pr̥thivyāḥ ardham it asya prati rodasī iti ubhe iti
adha manye br̥hat asuryam asya yāni dādhāra nakiḥ ā mināti dive--dive sūryaḥ darśataḥ bhūt vi sadmāni urviyā su-kratuḥ dhāt
ada cit nu cit tat apaḥ nadīnām yat ābhyaḥ aradaḥ gātum indra ni parvatāḥ adma-sadaḥ na seduḥ tvayā dr̥l̥hāni sukrato itisu-krato rajāṁsi
satyam it tat na tvāvān anyaḥ asti indra devaḥ na martyaḥ jyāyān ahan ahim pari-śayānam arṇaḥ ava asr̥jaḥ apaḥ accha samudram
tvam apaḥ vi duraḥ viṣūcīḥ indra dr̥l̥ham arujaḥ parvatasya rājā abhavaḥ jagataḥ carṣaṇīnām sākam sūryam janayan dyām uṣasam
abhūḥ ekaḥ rayi-pate rayīṇām ā hastayoḥ adhithāḥ indra kr̥ṣṭīḥ vi toke ap-su tanaye ca sūre avocanta carṣaṇayaḥ vivācaḥ
tvat bhiyā indra pārthivāni viśvā acyutā cit cyavayante rajāṁsi dyāvākṣāmā parvatāsaḥ vanāni viśvam dr̥l̥ham bhayate ajman ā te
tvam kutsena abhi śuṣṇam indra aśuṣam yudhya kuyavam gaviṣṭau daśa pra-pitve adha sūryasya muṣāyaḥ cakram aviveḥ rapāṁsi
tvam śatāni ava śambarasya puraḥ jaghantha apratīni dasyoḥ aśikṣaḥ yatra śacyā śacī-vaḥ divaḥ-dāsāya sunvate suta-kre bharat-vājāya gr̥ṇate vasūni
saḥ satya-satvan mahate raṇāya ratham ā tiṣṭha tuvi-nr̥mṇa bhīmam yāhi pra-pathin avasā upa madrik pra ca śruta śravaya carṣaṇi-bhyaḥ
apūrvyā puru-tamāni asmai mahe vīrāya tavase turāya virapśine vajriṇe śam-tamāni vacāṁsi āsā sthavirāya takṣam
saḥ mātarā sūryeṇa kavīnām avāsayat rujat adrim gr̥ṇānaḥ su-ādhībhiḥ r̥kva-bhiḥ vāvaśānaḥ ut usriyāṇām asr̥jat ni-dānam
saḥ vahni-bhiḥ r̥kva-bhiḥ goṣu śaśvat mitajñu-bhiḥ puru-kr̥tvā jigāya puraḥ puraḥ-hā sakhi-bhiḥ sakhi-yan dr̥l̥hā ruroja kavi-bhiḥ kaviḥ san
saḥ nīvyābhiḥ jaritāram accha mahaḥ vājebhiḥ mahat-bhiḥ ca śuṣmaiḥ puru-vīrābhiḥ vr̥ṣabha kṣitīnām ā girvaṇaḥ suvitāya pra yāhi
saḥ sargeṇa śavasā taktaḥ atyaiḥ apaḥ indraḥ dakṣiṇataḥ turāṣāṭ itthā sr̥jānāḥ anapa-vr̥t artham dive--dive viviṣuḥ apra-mr̥ṣyam
yaḥ ojiṣṭhaḥ indra tam su naḥ dāḥ madaḥ vr̥ṣan su-abhiṣṭiḥ dāsvān sauvaśvyam yaḥ vana-vat su-aśvaḥ vr̥trā samat-su sasahat amitrān
tvām hi indra avase vivācaḥ havante carṣaṇayaḥ śūra-sātau tvam viprebhiḥ vi paṇīn aśāyaḥ tvāūtaḥ it sanitā vājam arvā
tvam tān indra ubhayān amitrān dāsā vr̥trāṇi āryā ca śūra vadhīḥ vanāiva su-dhitebhiḥ atkaiḥ ā pr̥t-su darṣi nr̥ṇām nr̥-tama
saḥ tvam naḥ indra akavābhiḥ ūtī sakhā viśva-āyuḥ avitā vr̥dhe bhūḥ svaḥ-sātā yat hvayāmasi tvā yudhyantaḥ nema-dhitā pr̥t-su śūra
nūnam naḥ indra aparāya ca syāḥ bhava mr̥l̥īkaḥ uta naḥ abhiṣṭau itthā gr̥ṇantaḥ mahinasya śarman divi syāma pārye gosa-tamāḥ
iti jagmuḥ giraḥ indra pūrvīḥ vi ca tvat yanti vi-bhvaḥ manīṣāḥ purā nūnam ca stutayaḥ r̥ṣīṇām paspr̥dhre indre adhi uktha-arkā
puru-hūtaḥ yaḥ puru-gūrtaḥ r̥bhvā ekaḥ puru-praśastaḥ asti yajñaiḥ rathaḥ na mahe śavase yujānaḥ asmābhiḥ indraḥ anu-mādyaḥ bhūt
na yam hiṁsanti dhītayaḥ na vāṇīḥ indram nakṣanti it abhi vadharyantīḥ yadi stotāraḥ śatam yat sahasram gr̥ṇanti girvaṇasam śam tat asmai
asmai etat divi arcāiva māsā mimikṣaḥ indre ni ayāmi somaḥ janam na dhanvan abhi sam yat āpaḥ satrāḥ vavr̥dhuḥ havanāni yajñaiḥ
asmai etat mahi āṅgūṣam asmai indrāya stotram mati-bhiḥ avāci asat yathā mahati vr̥tra-tūrye indraḥ viśva-āyuḥ avitā vr̥dhaḥ ca
kadā bhuvan ratha-kṣayāṇi brahma kadā stotre sahasra-poṣyam dāḥ kadā stomam vāsayaḥ asya rāyā kadā dhiyaḥ karasi vāja-ratnāḥ
karhi svit tat indra yat nr̥-bhiḥ nr̥r̥n vīraiḥ vīrān nīl̥ayāse jaya ājīn tri-dhātu gāḥ adhi jayāsi goṣu indra dyumnam svaḥ-vat dhehi asme iti
karhi svit tat indra yat jaritre viśva-psu brahma kr̥ṇavaḥ śaviṣṭha kadā dhiyaḥ na ni-yutaḥ yuvāse kadā go--maghā havanāni gacchāḥ
saḥ go--maghāḥ jaritre aśva-candrāḥ vāja-śravasaḥ adhi dhehi pr̥kṣaḥ pīpihi iṣaḥ su-dughām indra dhenum bharat-vājeṣu su-rucaḥ rurucyāḥ
tam ā nūnam vr̥janam anyathā cit śūraḥ yat śakra vi duraḥ gr̥ṇīṣe mā niḥ aram śukra-dughasya dhenoḥ āṅgirasān brahmaṇā vipra jinva
satrā madāsaḥ tava viśva-janyāḥ satrā rāyaḥ adha ye pārthivāsaḥ satrā vājānām abhavaḥ vi-bhaktā yat deveṣu dhārayathāḥ asuryam
anu pra yeje janaḥ ojaḥ asya satrā dadhire anu vīryāya syūma-gr̥bhe dudhaye arvate ca kratum vr̥ñjanti api vr̥tra-hatye
tam sadhrīcīḥ ūtayaḥ vr̥ṣṇyāni paiṁsyāni ni-yutaḥ saścuḥ indram samudram na sindhavaḥ uktha-śuṣmāḥ uru-vyacasam giraḥ ā viśanti
saḥ rāyaḥ khām upa sr̥ja gr̥ṇānaḥ puru-candrasya tvam indra vasvaḥ patiḥ babhūtha asamaḥ janānām ekaḥ viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā
saḥ tu śrudhi śrutyā yaḥ duvaḥ-yuḥ dyauḥ na bhūma abhi rāyaḥ aryaḥ asaḥ yathā naḥ śavasā cakānaḥ yuge--yuge vayasā cekitānaḥ
arvāk ratham viśva-vāram te ugra indra yuktāsaḥ harayaḥ vahantu kīriḥ cit hi tvā havate svaḥ-vān r̥dhīmahi sadha-mādaḥ te adya
pro iti droṇe harayaḥ karma agman punānāsaḥ r̥jyantaḥ abhūvan indraḥ naḥ asya pūrvyaḥ pāpīyāt dyukṣaḥ madasya somyasya rājā
āsasrāṇāsaḥ śavasānam accha indram su-cakre rathyāsaḥ aśvāḥ abhi śravaḥ r̥jyantaḥ vaheyuḥ nu cit nu vāyoḥ amr̥tam vi dasyet
variṣṭhaḥ asya dakṣiṇām iyarti indraḥ maghonām tuvikūrmi-tamaḥ yayā vajri-vaḥ pari-yāsi aṁhaḥ maghā ca dhr̥ṣṇo iti dayase vi sūrīn
indraḥ vājasya sthavirasya dātā indraḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ vardhatām vr̥ddha-mahāḥ indraḥ vr̥tram haniṣṭhaḥ astu satvā ā tā sūriḥ pr̥ṇati tūtujānaḥ
apāt itaḥ ut oṁ iti naḥ citra-tamaḥ mahīm bharṣat dyu-matīm indra-hūtim panyasīm dhītim daivyasya yāman janasya rātim vanate su-dānuḥ
dūrāt cit ā vasataḥ asya karṇā ghoṣāt indrasya tanyati bruvāṇaḥ ā iyam enam deva-hūtiḥ vavr̥tyāt madryak indram iyam r̥cyamānā
tam vaḥ dhiyā paramayā purājām ajaram indram abhi anūṣi arkaiḥ brahma ca giraḥ dadhire sam asmin mahān ca stomaḥ adhi vardhat indre
vardhāt yam yajñaḥ uta somaḥ indram vardhāt brahma giraḥ ukthā ca manma vardha aha enam uṣasaḥ yāman aktoḥ vardhān māsāḥ śaradaḥ dyāvaḥ indram
eva jajñānam sahase asāmi vavr̥dhānam rādhase ca śrutāya mahām ugram avase vipra nūnam ā vivāsema vr̥tra-tūryeṣu
mandrasya kaveḥ divyasya vahneḥ vipra-manmanaḥ vacanasya madhvaḥ apa naḥ tasya sacanasya deva iṣaḥ yuvasva gr̥ṇate go--agrāḥ
ayam uśānaḥ pari adrim usrāḥ r̥tadhīti-bhiḥ r̥ta-yuk yujānaḥ rujayt arugṇam vi valasya sānum paṇīn vacaḥ-bhiḥ abhi yodhat indraḥ
ayam dyotayat adyutaḥ vi aktūn doṣā vastoḥ śaradaḥ induḥ indra imam ketum adadhuḥ nu cit ahnām śuci-janmanaḥ uṣasaḥ cakāra
ayam rocayat arucaḥ rucānaḥ ayam vāsayat vi r̥tena pūrvīḥ ayam īyate r̥tayuk-bhiḥ aśvaiḥ svaḥ-vidā nābhinā carṣaṇi-prāḥ
nu gr̥ṇānaḥ gr̥ṇate pratna rājan iṣaḥ pinva vasu-deyāya pūrvīḥ apaḥ oṣadhīḥ aviṣā vanāni gāḥ arvataḥ nr̥r̥n r̥case rirīhi
indra piba tubhyam sutaḥ madāya ava sya harī iti vi muca sakhāyā uta pra gāya gaṇe ā ni-sadya atha yajñāya gr̥ṇate vayaḥ dhāḥ
asya piba yasya jajñanaḥ ndra madāya kratve apibaḥ vi-rapśin tam oṁ iti te gāvaḥ naraḥ āpaḥ adriḥ indum sam ahyan pītaye sam asmai
sam-iddhe agnau sute indra some ā tvā vahantu harayaḥ vahiṣṭhāḥ tvāyatā manasā johavīmi indra ā yāhi suvitāya mahe naḥ
ā yāhi śaśvat uśatā yayātha indra mahā manasā soma-peyam upa brahmāṇi śr̥ṇavaḥ imā naḥ atha te yajñaḥ tanve vayaḥ dhāt
yat indra divi pārye yat r̥dhak yat vā sve sadane yatra vā asi ataḥ naḥ yajñam avase niyutvān sa-joṣāḥ pāhi girvaṇaḥ marut-bhiḥ
ahel̥amānaḥ upa yāhi yajñam tubhyam pavante indavaḥ sutāsaḥ gāvaḥ na vājrin svam okaḥ accha indra ā gahi prathamaḥ yajñiyānām
yā te kākut su-kr̥tā yā variṣṭhā yayā śaśvat pibasi madhvaḥ ūrmim tayā pāhi pra te adhvaryuḥ asthāt sam te vajraḥ vartatām indra gavyuḥ
eṣaḥ drapsaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ viśva-rūpaḥ indrāya vr̥ṣṇe sam akāri somaḥ etam piba hari-vaḥ sthātaḥ ugra yasya īśiṣe pra-divi yaḥ te annam
sutaḥ somaḥ asutāt indra vasyān ayam śreyān cikituṣe raṇāya etam titirvaḥ upa yāhi yajñam tena viśvāḥ taviṣīḥ ā pr̥ṇasva
hvayāmasi tvā ā indra yāhi arvāṅ aram te somaḥ tanve bhavāti śatakrato itiśata-krato mādayasva suteṣu pra asmān ava pr̥tanāsu pra vikṣu
prati asmai pipīṣate viśvāni viduṣe bhara aram-gamāya jagmaye apaścāt-daghvane nare
ā īm enam prati-etana somebhiḥ soma-pātanam amatrebhiḥ r̥jīṣiṇam indram sutebhiḥ indu-bhiḥ
yadi sutebhiḥ indu-bhiḥ somebhiḥ prati-bhūṣatha veda viśvasya medhiraḥ dhr̥ṣat tam-tam it ā īṣate
asmai-asmai it andhasaḥ adhvaryo iti pra bhara sutam kuvit samasya jenyasya śardhataḥ abhi-śasteḥ ava-sparat
yasya tyat śambaram made divaḥ-dāsāya randhayaḥ ayam saḥ somaḥ indra te sutaḥ piba
yasya tīvra-sutam madam madhyam antam ca rakṣase ayam saḥ somaḥ indra te sutaḥ piba
yasya gāḥ antaḥ aśmanaḥ made dr̥l̥hāḥ ava-asr̥jaḥ ayam saḥ somaḥ indra te sutaḥ piba
yasya mandānaḥ andhasaḥ māghonam dadhiṣe śavaḥ ayam saḥ somaḥ indra te sutaḥ piba
yaḥ rayi-vaḥ rayim-tamaḥ yaḥ dyumnaiḥ dyumnavat-tamaḥ somaḥ sutaḥ saḥ indra te asti svadhāpatemadaḥ
yaḥ śagmaḥ tuvi-śagma te rāyaḥ dāmā matīnām somaḥ sutaḥ saḥ indra te asti svadhāpatemadaḥ
yena vr̥ddhaḥ na śavasā turaḥ na svābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ somaḥ sutaḥ saḥ indra te asti svadhāpatemadaḥ
tyam oṁ iti vaḥ apra-hanam gr̥ṇīṣe śavasaḥ patim indram viśva-saham naram maṁhiṣṭham viśva-carṣaṇim
yam vardhayanti it giraḥ patim turasya rādhasaḥ tam it nu asya rodasī iti devī iti śuṣmam saparyataḥ
tat vaḥ ukthasya barhaṇā indrāya upa-str̥ṇīṣaṇi vipaḥ na yasya ūtayaḥ vi yat rohanti sa-kṣitaḥ
avidat dakṣam mitraḥ navīyān papānaḥ devebhyaḥ vasyaḥ acait sasa-vān staulābhiḥ dhautarībhiḥ uruṣyā pāyuḥ abhavat sakhi-bhyaḥ
r̥tasya pathi vedhāḥ apāyi śriye manāṁsi devāsaḥ akran dadhānaḥ nāma mahaḥ vacaḥ-bhiḥ vapuḥ dr̥śaye venyaḥ vi āvar ity āvaḥ
dyumat-tamam dakṣam dhehi asme iti sedha janānām pūrvīḥ arātīḥ varṣīyaḥ vayaḥ kr̥ṇuhi śacībhiḥ dhanasya sātau asmān aviḍḍhi
indra tubhyam it magha-van abhūma vayam dātre hari-vaḥ mā vi venaḥ nakiḥ āpiḥ dadr̥śe martya-trā kim aṅga radhra-codanam tvā āhuḥ
mā jasvane vr̥ṣabha naḥ rarīthāḥ mā te revataḥ sakhye riṣāma pūrvīḥ te indra niḥ-sidhaḥ janeṣu jahi asusvīn pra vr̥ha apr̥ṇataḥ
ut abhrāṇi-iva stanayan iyarti indraḥ rādhāṁsi aśvyāni gavyā tvam āsi pra-divaḥ kāru-dhāyāḥ mā tvā adāmānaḥ ā dabhan maghonaḥ
adhvaryo iti vīra pra mahe sutānām indrāya bhara saḥ hi asya rājā yaḥ pūrvyābhiḥ uta nūtanābhiḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ vavr̥dhe gr̥ṇatām r̥ṣīṇām
asya made puru varpāṁsi vidvān indraḥ vr̥trāṇi aprati jaghāna tam oṁ iti pra hoṣi madhu-mantam asmai somam vīrāya śipriṇe pibadhyai
pātā sutam indraḥ astu somam hantā vr̥tram vajreṇa mandasānaḥ gantā yajñam parāvataḥ cit accha vasuḥ dhīnām avitā kāru-dhāyāḥ
idam tyat pātram indra-pānam indrasya priyam amr̥tam apāyi matsat yathā saumanasāya devam vi asmat dveṣaḥ yuyavat vi aṁhaḥ
enā mandānaḥ jahi śūra śatrūn jāmim ajāmim magha-van amitrān abhi-seṇān abhi ādediśānān parācaḥ indra pra mr̥ṇa jahi ca
āsu sma naḥ magha-van indra pr̥t-su asmabhyam mahi varivaḥ su-gam karitikaḥ apām tokasya tanayasya jeṣe indra sūrīn kr̥ṇuhi sma naḥ ardham
ā tvā harayaḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ yujānāḥ vr̥ṣa-rathāsaḥ vr̥ṣa-raśmayaḥ atyāḥ asmatrāñcaḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ vajra-vāhaḥ vr̥ṣṇe madāya su-yujaḥ vahantu
ā te vr̥ṣan vr̥ṣaṇaḥ droṇam asthuḥ ghr̥ta-pruṣaḥ na ūrmayaḥ madantaḥ indra pra tubhyam vr̥ṣa-bhiḥ sutānām vr̥ṣṇe bharanti vr̥ṣabhāya somam
vr̥ṣā asi divaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ vr̥ṣā sindhūnām vr̥ṣabhaḥ stiyānām vr̥ṣṇe te induḥ vr̥ṣabha pīpāya svāduḥ rasaḥ madhu-peyaḥ varāya
ayam devaḥ sahasā jāyamānaḥ indreṇa yujā paṇim astabhāyat ayam svasya pituḥ āyudhāni induḥ amuṣṇāt aśivasya māyāḥ
ayam akr̥ṇot uṣasaḥ su-patnīḥ ayam sūrye adadhāt jyotiḥ antariti ayam tri-dhātu divi rocaneṣu triteṣu vindat amr̥tam ni-gūl̥ham
ayam dyāvāpr̥thivī iti vi skabhāyat ayam ratham ayunak sapta-raśmim ayam goṣu śacyā pakvam antariti somaḥ dādhāra daśa-yantram utsam
yaḥ ā anayat parāvataḥ su-nītī turvaśam yadum indraḥ saḥ naḥ yuvā sakhā
avipre cit vayaḥ dadhat anāśunā cit arvatā indraḥ jetā hitam dhanam
mahīḥ asya pra-nītayaḥ pūrvīḥ uta pra-śastayaḥ na asya kṣīyante ūtayaḥ
sakhāyaḥ brahma-vāhase arcata pra ca gāyata saḥ hi naḥ pra-matiḥ mahī
tvam ekasya vr̥tra-han avitā dvayoḥ asi uta īdr̥śe yathā vayam
nayasi it oṁ iti ati dviṣaḥ kr̥ṇoṣi uktha-śaṁsinaḥ nr̥-bhiḥ su-vīraḥ ucyase
brahmāṇam brahma-vāhasam gīḥ-bhiḥ sakhāyam r̥gmiyam gām na dohase huve
yasya viśvāni hastayoḥ ūcuḥ vasūni ni dvitā vīrasya pr̥tanāsahaḥ
vi dr̥l̥hāni cit adri-vaḥ janānām sacī-pate vr̥ha māyāḥ anānata
tam oṁ iti tvā satya soma-pāḥ indra vājānām pate ahūmahi śravasyavaḥ
tam oṁ iti tvā yaḥ purā āsitha yaḥ vā nūnam hite dhane havyaḥ saḥ śrudh i havam
dhībhiḥ arvat-bhiḥ arvataḥ vājān indra śravāyyān tvayā jeṣma hitam dhanam
abhūḥ oṁ iti vīra girvaṇaḥ mahān indra dhane hite bhare vitantasāyyaḥ
yā te ūtiḥ amitra-han makṣujavaḥ-tamā asati tayā naḥ hinuhi ratham
saḥ rathena rathi-tamaḥ asmākena abhi-yugvanā jeṣi jiṣṇo iti hitam dhanam
yaḥ ekaḥ it tam oṁ iti stuhi kr̥ṣṭīnām vi-carṣaṇiḥ patiḥ jajñe vr̥ṣa-kratuḥ
yaḥ gr̥ṇatām it āsitha āpiḥ ūtī śivaḥ sakhā saḥ tvam naḥ indra mr̥l̥aya
dhiṣva vajram gabhastyoḥ rakṣaḥ-hatyāya vajri-vaḥ sasahīṣṭhāḥ abhi spr̥dhaḥ
pratnam rayīṇām yujam sakhāyam kīri-codanam brahma-vāhaḥ-tamam huve
saḥ hi viśvāni pārthivā ekaḥ vasūni patyate girvaṇaḥ-tamaḥ adhri-guḥ
saḥ naḥ niyut-bhiḥ ā pr̥ṇa kāmam vāje--bhiḥ aśvi-bhiḥ gomat-bhiḥ go--pate dhr̥ṣat
tat vaḥ gāya sute sacā puru-hūtāya satvane śam yat gave na śākine
na gha vasuḥ ni yamate dānam vājasya go--mataḥ yat sīm upa śravat giraḥ
kuvit-sasya pra hi vrajam go--mantam dasyu-hā gamat śacībhiḥ apa naḥ varat
imāḥ oṁ iti tvā śatakrato itiśata-krato abhi pra nonuvuḥ giraḥ indra vatsam na mātaraḥ
duḥ-naśam sakhyam tava gauḥ asi vīra gavyate aśvaḥ aśva-yate bhava
saḥ mandasva hi andhasaḥ rādhase tanvā mahe na stotāram nide karaḥ
imāḥ oṁ iti tvā sute--sute nakṣante girvaṇaḥ giraḥ vatsam gāvaḥ na dhenavaḥ
puru-tamam purūṇām stotr̥r̥ṇām vi-vāci vājebhiḥ vāja-yatām
asmākam indra bhūtu te stomaḥ vāhiṣṭhaḥ antamaḥ asmān rāye mahe h inu
adhi br̥buḥ paṇīnām varṣiṣṭhe mūrdhan asthāt uruḥ kakṣaḥ na gāṅgyaḥ
yasya vāyoḥ-iva dravat bhadrā rātiḥ sahasriṇī sadyaḥ dānāya maṁhate
tat su naḥ viśve aryaḥ ā sadā gr̥ṇanti kāravaḥ br̥bum sahasra-dātamam sūrim sahasra-sātamam
tvām it hi havāmahe sātā vājasya kāravaḥ tvām vr̥treṣu indra sat-patim naraḥ tvām kāṣṭhāsu arvataḥ
saḥ tvam naḥ citra vajra-hasta dhr̥ṣṇu-yā mahaḥ stavānaḥ adri-vaḥ gām aśvam rathyam indra sam kira satrā vājam na jigyuṣe
yaḥ satrāhā vi-carṣaṇiḥ indram tam hūmahe vayam sahasra-muṣka tuvi-nr̥mṇa sat-pate bhava samat-su naḥ vr̥dhe
bādhase janān vr̥ṣabhāiva manyunā ghr̥ṣau mīl̥he r̥cīṣama asmākam bodhi avitā mahādhane tanūṣu ap-su sūrye
indra jyeṣṭham naḥ ā bhara ojiṣṭham papuri śravaḥ yena ime iti citra vajra-hasta rodasī iti ā ubhe iti suśipra prāḥ
tvām ugram avase carṣaṇi-saham rājan deveṣu hūmahe viśvā su naḥ vithurā pibdanā vaso iti amitrān su-sahān kr̥dhi
yat indra nāhuṣīṣu ā ojaḥ nr̥mṇam ca kr̥ṣṭiṣu yat vā pañca kṣitīnām dyumnam ā bhara satrā viśvāni paiṁsyā
yat vā tr̥kṣau magha-van druhyau ā jane yat pūrau kat ca vr̥ṣṇyam asmabhyam tat rirīhi sam nr̥-sahye amitrān pr̥t-su turvaṇe
indra tri-dhātu śaraṇam tri-varūtham svasti-mat chardiḥ yaccha maghavat-bhyaḥ ca mahyam ca yavaya didyum ebhyaḥ
ye gavyatā manasā śatrum ādabhuḥ abhi-praghnanti dhr̥ṣṇu-yā adha sma naḥ magha-van indra girvaṇaḥ tanū-pāḥ antamaḥ bhava
adha sma naḥ vr̥dhe bhava indra na ayam ava yudhi yat antarikṣe patayanti parṇinaḥ didyavaḥ tigma-mūrdhānaḥ
yatra śūrāsaḥ tanvaḥ vi-tanvate priyā śarma pitr̥r̥ṇām adha sma yaccha tanve tane ca chardhiḥ acittam yavaya dveṣaḥ
yat indra sarge arvataḥ codayāse mahādhane asamane adhvani vr̥j ine pathi śyenān-iva śravasyataḥ
sindhūn-iva pravaṇe āśu-yā yataḥ yadi kleśam anu svani ā ye vayaḥ na varvr̥tati āmiṣi gr̥bhītāḥ bāhvoḥ gavi
svāduḥ kila ayam madhu-mān uta ayam tīvraḥ kila ayam rasa-vān uta ayam uto iti nu asya papi-vāṁsam indram na kaḥ cana sahate āhaveṣu
ayam svāduḥ iha madiṣṭhaḥ āsa yasya indraḥ vr̥tra-hatye mamāda purūṇi yaḥ cyautnā śambarasya vi navatim nava ca dehyaḥ han
ayam me pītaḥ ut iyarti vācam ayam manīṣām uśatīm ajīgaḥ ayam ṣaṭ urvīḥ amimīta dhīraḥ na yābhyaḥ bhuvanam kat cana āre
ayam saḥ yaḥ varimāṇam pr̥thivyāḥ varṣmāṇam divaḥ akr̥ṇot ayam saḥ ayam pīyūṣam tisr̥ṣu pravat-su somaḥ dādhāra uru antarikṣam
ayam vidat citra-dr̥śīkam arṇaḥ śukra-sadmanām uṣasām anīke ayam mahān mahatā skambhanena ut dyām astabhnāt vr̥ṣabhaḥ marutvān
dhr̥ṣat piba kalaśe somam indra vr̥tra-hā śūra sam-are vasūnām mādhyandine savane ā vr̥ṣasva rayi-sthānaḥ rayim asmāsu dhehi
indra pra naḥ puraetāiva paśya pra naḥ naya pra-taram vasyaḥ accha bhava su-pāraḥ ati-pārayaḥ naḥ bhava su-nītiḥ uta vāma-nītiḥ
iti upa stheyāma śaraṇā br̥hantā
variṣṭhe naḥ indra vandhure dhāḥ vahiṣṭhayoḥ śata-van aśvayoḥ ā iṣam ā vakṣi iṣām varṣiṣṭhām mā naḥ tārīt magha-van rāyaḥ aryaḥ
indra mr̥l̥a mahyam jīvātum iccha codaya dhiyam ayasaḥ na dhārām yat kim ca aham tvāyuḥ idam vadāmi tat juṣasva kr̥dhi mā deva-vantam
trātāram indram avitāram indram have--have su-havam śūram indram hvayāmi śakram puru-hūtam indram svasti naḥ magha-vā dhātu indraḥ
indraḥ su-trāmā sva-vān avaḥ-bhiḥ su-mr̥l̥īkaḥ bhavatu viśva-vedāḥ bādhatām dveṣaḥ abhayam kr̥ṇotu su-vīryasya patayaḥ syāma
tasya vayam su-matau yajñiyasya api bhadre saumanase syāma saḥ su-trāmā sva-vān indraḥ asme iti ārāt cit dveṣaḥ sanutaḥ yuyotu
ava tve iti indra pra-vataḥ na ūrmiḥ giraḥ brahmāṇi ni-yutaḥ dhavante uru na rādhaḥ savanā purūṇi apaḥ gāḥ vajrin yuvase sam indūn
kaḥ īm stavat kaḥ pr̥ṇāt kaḥ yajāte yat ugram it magha-vā viśvahā avet pādau-iva pra-haran anyam-anyam kr̥ṇoti pūrvam aparam śacībhiḥ
śr̥ṇve vīraḥ ugram-ugram dama-yan anyam-anyam ati-nenīyamānaḥ edhamāna-dviṭ ubhayasya rājā coṣkūyate viśaḥ indraḥ manuṣayān
parā pūrveṣām sakhyā vr̥ṇakti vi-tarturāṇaḥ aparebhiḥ eti ananu-bhūtīḥ ava-dhūnvānaḥ pūrvīḥ indraḥ śaradaḥ tartarīti
rūpam-rūpam prati-rūpaḥ babhūva tat asya rūpam prati-cakṣaṇāya indraḥ māyābhiḥ puru-rūpaḥ īyate yuktāḥ hi asya harayaḥ śatā daśa
yujānaḥ haritā rathe bhūri tvaṣṭā iha rājati kaḥ viśvāhā dviṣataḥ pakṣaḥ āsate uta āsīneṣu sūriṣu
agavyūti kṣetram ā aganma devāḥ urvī satī bhūmiḥ aṁhūraṇā abhūt br̥haspate pra cikitsa go--iṣṭau itthā sate jaritre indra panthām
dive--dive sa-dr̥śīḥ anyam ardham kr̥ṣṇāḥ asedhat apa sadmanaḥ jāḥ ahan dāsā vr̥ṣabhaḥ vasnayantā uda-vraje varcinam śambaram ca
prastokaḥ it nu rādhasaḥ te indra daśa kośayīḥ daśa vājinaḥ adāt divaḥ-dāsāt atithi-gvasya rādhaḥ śāmbaram vasu prati agrabhīṣma
daśa aśvān daśa kośān daśa vastrā adhi-bhojanā daso iti hiraṇya-piṇḍān divaḥ-dāsāt asāniṣam
daśa rathān praṣṭi-mataḥ śatam gāḥ atharva-bhyaḥ aśvathaḥ pāyave adāt
mahi rādhaḥ viśva-janyam dadhānān bharat-vājān sañjaryaḥ abhi ayaṣṭa
vanaspate vīl̥u-aṅgaḥ hi bhūyāḥ asmat-sakhā pra-taraṇaḥ su-vīraḥ gobhiḥ sam-naddhaḥ asi vīl̥ayasva āsthātā te jayatu jetvāni
divaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ pari ojaḥ ut-bhr̥tam vanaspati-bhyaḥ pari ābhr̥tam sahaḥ apām ojmānam pari gobhiḥ āvr̥tam indrasya vajram haviṣā ratham yaja
indrasya vajraḥ marutām anīkam mitrasya garbhaḥ varuṇasya nābhiḥ saḥ imām naḥ havyad-ātim juṣāṇaḥ deva ratha prati havyā gr̥bhāya
upa śvāsaya pr̥thivīm uta dyām puru-trā te manutām vi-sthitam jagat saḥ dundubhe sa-jūḥ indreṇa devaiḥ dūrāt davīyaḥ apa sedha śatrūn
ā krandaya balam ojaḥ naḥ ā dhāḥ niḥ stanihi duḥ-itā bādhamānaḥ apa protha dundubhe ducchunāḥ itaḥ indrasya muṣṭiḥ asi vīl̥ayasva
ā amūḥ aja prati-āvartaya imāḥ ketu-mat dundubhiḥ vāvadīti sam aśva-parṇāḥ caranti naḥ naraḥ asmākam indra rathinaḥ jayantu
yajñāyajñā vaḥ agnaye girāgirā ca dakṣase pra-pra vayam amr̥tam jāta-vedasam priyam mitram na śaṁsiṣam
ūrjaḥ napātam saḥ hina ayam asma-yuḥ dāśema havya-dātaye bhuvat vājeṣu avitā bhuvat vr̥dhaḥ uta trātā tanūnām
vr̥ṣā hi agne ajaraḥ mahān vi-bhāsi arciṣā ajasreṇa śociṣā śośucat śuce sudīti-bhiḥ su dīdihi
mahaḥ devān yajasi yakṣi ānuṣak tava kratvā uta daṁsanā arvācaḥ sīm kr̥ṇuhi agne avase rāsva vājā uta vaṁsva
yam āpaḥ adrayaḥ vanā garbham r̥tasya piprati sahasā yaḥ math itaḥ jāyate nr̥-bhiḥ pr̥thivyāḥ adhi sānavi
ā yaḥ paprau bhānunā rodasī iti ubhe iti dhūmena dhāvate divi tiraḥ tamaḥ dadr̥śe ūrmyāsu ā śyāvāsu aruṣaḥ vr̥ṣā ā śyāvāḥ aruṣaḥ vr̥ṣā
br̥hat-bhiḥ agne arci-bhiḥ śukreṇa deva śociṣā bharat-vāje sam-idhānaḥ yaviṣṭhya revat naḥ śukra dīdihi dyu-mat pāvaka dīdihi
viśvāsām gr̥ha-patiḥ viśām asi tvam agne mānuṣīṇām śatam pūḥ-bhiḥ yaviṣṭha pāhi aṁhasaḥ sam-eddhāram śatam himāḥ stotr̥-bhyaḥ ye ca dadati
tvam naḥ citraḥ ūtyā vaso iti rādhāṁsi codaya asya rāyaḥ tvam agne rathīḥ asi vidāḥ gādham tuce tu naḥ
parṣi tokam tanayam partr̥-bhiḥ tvam adabdhaiḥ aprayutva-bhiḥ agne helāṁsi daivyā yuyodhi naḥ adevāni hvarāṁsi ca
ā sakhāyaḥ sabaḥ-dughām dhenum ajadhvam upa navyasā vacaḥ sr̥jadhvam anapa-sphurām
yā śardhāya mārutāya sva-bhānave śravaḥ amr̥tyu dhukṣata yā mr̥l̥īke marutām turāṇām yā sumnaiḥ eva-yāvarī
bharat-vājāya ava dhukṣata dvitā dhenum ca viśva-dohasam iṣam ca v iśva-bhojasam
tam vaḥ indram na su-kratum varuṇam-iva māyinam aryamaṇam na mandram sr̥pra-bhojasam viṣṇum na stuṣe ādiśe
tveṣam śardhaḥ na mārutam tuvi-svaṇi anarvāṇam pūṣaṇam sam yathā śatā sam sahasrā kāriṣat carṣaṇi-bhyaḥ ā āviḥ gūl̥hā vasu karat su-vedā naḥ vasu karat
ā mā pūṣan upa drava śaṁsiṣam nu te api-karṇe āghr̥ṇe aghāḥ aryaḥ arātayaḥ
mā kākambīram ut vr̥haḥ vanaspatim aśastīḥ vi hi nīnaśaḥ mā uta sūraḥ ahariti eva cana grīvā ādadhate veḥ
dr̥teḥ-iva te avr̥kam astu sakhyam acchidrasya dadhan-vataḥ su-pūrṇasya dadhan-vataḥ
paraḥ hi martyaiḥ asi samaḥ devaiḥ uta śriyā abhi khyaḥ pūṣan pr̥tanāsu naḥ tvam ava nūnam yathā purā
vāmī vāmasya dhūtayaḥ pra-nītiḥ astu sūnr̥tā devasya vā marutaḥ martyasya vejānasya pra-yajyavaḥ
sadyaḥ cit yasya carkr̥tiḥ pari dyām devaḥ na eti sūryaḥ tveṣam śavaḥ dadhire nāma yajñiyam marutaḥ vr̥tra-ham śavaḥ jyeṣṭham vr̥tra-ham śavaḥ
sakr̥t ha dyauḥ ajāyata sakr̥t bhūmiḥ ajāyata pr̥śnyāḥ dugdham sakr̥t payaḥ tat anyaḥ na anu jāyate
stuṣe janam su-vratam navyasībhiḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ mitrāvaruṇā sumna-yantā te ā gamantu te iha śruvantu su-kṣatrāsaḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ agniḥ
viśaḥ-viśaḥ īḍyam adhvareṣu adr̥pta-kratum aratim yuvatyoḥ divaḥ śiśum sahasaḥ śūnum agnim yajñasya ketum aruṣam yajadhyai
aruṣasya duhitarā virūpeitivi-rūpe str̥-bhiḥ anyā pipiśe sūraḥ anyā mithaḥ-turā vicarantī itivi-carantī pāvake iti manma śrutam nakṣata r̥cyamāneiti
itipra-yajyo
saḥ me vapuḥ chadayat aśvinoḥ yaḥ rathaḥ virukmān manasā yujānaḥ yena narā nāsatyā iṣayadhyai vartiḥ yāthaḥ tanayāya tmane ca
parjanyavātā vr̥ṣabhā pr̥thivyāḥ purīṣāṇi jinvatam apyāni satya-śrutaḥ kavayaḥ yasya gīḥ-bhiḥ jagataḥ sthātaḥ jagat ā kr̥ṇudhvam
pāvīravī kanyā citra-āyuḥ sarasvatī vīra-patnī dhiyam dhāt gnābhiḥ acchidram śaraṇam sa-joṣāḥ duḥ-ādharṣam gr̥ṇate śarma yaṁsat
pathaḥ-pathaḥ pari-patim vacasyā kāmena kr̥taḥ abhi ānaṭ arkam saḥ naḥ rāsat śurudhaḥ candra-agrāḥ dhiyam-dhiyam sīsadhāti pra pūṣā
prathama-bhājam yaśasam vayaḥ-dhām su-pāṇim devam su-gabhastim r̥bhvam hotā yakṣat yajatam pastyānām agniḥ tvaṣṭāram su-havam vibhāvā
bhuvanasya pitaram gīḥ-bhiḥ ābhiḥ rudram divā vardhaya rudram aktau br̥hantam r̥ṣvam ajaram su-sumnam r̥dhak huvema kavinā iṣitāsaḥ
ā yuvānaḥ kavayaḥ yajñiyāsaḥ marutaḥ ganta gr̥ṇataḥ varasyām ac itram cit hi jinvatha vr̥dhantaḥ itthā nakṣantaḥ naraḥ aṅgirasvat
pra vīrāya pra tavase turāya aja yūthāiva paśu-rakṣiḥ astam saḥ pispr̥śati tanvi śrutasya str̥-bhiḥ na nākam vacanasya vipaḥ
yaḥ rajāṁsi vi-mame pārthivāni triḥ cit viṣṇuḥ manave bādhitāya tasya te śarman upa-dadyamāne rāyā madema tanvā tanā ca
tat naḥ ahiḥ budhnyaḥ at-bhiḥ arkaiḥ tat parvataḥ tat savitā canaḥ dhāt tat oṣadhībhiḥ abhi rāti-sācaḥ bhagaḥ puram-dhiḥ jinvatu pra rāye
nu naḥ rayim rathyam carṣaṇi-prām puru-vīram mahaḥ r̥tasya gopām kṣayam dāta ajaram yena janān spr̥dhaḥ adevīḥ abhi ca kramāma vi śaḥ ādevīḥ abhi aśnavāma
huve vaḥ devīm aditim namaḥ-bhiḥ mr̥l̥īkāya varuṇam mitram agnim abhi kṣa-dām aryamaṇam su-śevam trātr̥r̥n devān savitāram bhagam ca
su-jyotiṣaḥ sūrya dakṣa-pitr̥r̥n anāgāḥ-tve su-mahaḥ vīhi devān dvi-janmānaḥ ye r̥ta-sāpaḥ satyāḥ svaḥ-vantaḥ yajatāḥ agni-jihvāḥ
uta dyāvāpr̥thivī iti kṣatram uru br̥hat rodasī iti śaraṇam susumneitisu-sumne mahaḥ karathaḥ varivaḥ yathā naḥ asme iti kṣayāya dhiṣaṇeiti anehaḥ
ā naḥ rudrasya sūnavaḥ namantām adya hūtāsaḥ vasavaḥ adhr̥ṣṭāḥ yat īm arbhe mahati vā hitāsaḥ bādhe marutaḥ ahvāma devān
mimyakṣa yeṣu rodasī nu devī sisakti pūṣā abhyardha-yajvā śrutvā havam marutaḥ yat ha yātha bhūma rejante adhvani pra-vikte
abhi tyam vīram girvaṇasam arca indram brahmaṇā jaritaḥ navena śravat it havam upa ca stavānaḥ rāsat vājān upa mahaḥ gr̥ṇānaḥ
omānam āpaḥ mānuṣīḥ amr̥ktam dhāta tokāya tanayāya śam yoḥ yūyam hi stha bhiṣajaḥ mātr̥-tamāḥ viśvasya sthātuḥ jagataḥ janitrīḥ
ā naḥ devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇaḥ hiraṇya-pāṇiḥ yajataḥ jagamyāt yaḥ datra-vān uṣasaḥ na pratīkam vi-ūrṇute dāśuṣe vāryāṇi
uta tvam sūno iti sahasaḥ naḥ adya devān asmin adhvare vavr̥tyāḥ syām aham te sadam it rātau tava syām agne avasā su-vīraḥ
uta tyā me havam ā jagmyātam nāsatyā dhībhiḥ yuvam aṅga viprā atrim na mahaḥ tamasaḥ amumuktam tūrvatam narā duḥ-itāt abhīke
te naḥ rāyaḥ dyu-mataḥ vāja-vataḥ dātāraḥ bhūta nr̥-vataḥ puru-kṣoḥ daśasyantaḥ divyāḥ pārthivāsaḥ go--jātāḥ apyāḥ mr̥l̥ata ca devāḥ
te naḥ rudraḥ sarasvatī sa-joṣāḥ mīl̥huṣmantaḥ viṣṇuḥ mr̥l̥antu vāyuḥ r̥bhukṣāḥ vājaḥ daivyaḥ vi-dhātā parjanyāvātā pipyatām iṣam naḥ
uta syaḥ devaḥ savitā bhagaḥ naḥ apām napāt avatu dānu papriḥ tvaṣṭā devebhiḥ jani-bhiḥ sa-joṣāḥ dyauḥ devebhiḥ pr̥thivī samudraiḥ
uta naḥ ahiḥ budhnyaḥ śr̥ṇotu ajaḥ eka-pāt pr̥thivī samudraḥ viśve devāḥ r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ huvānāḥ stutāḥ mantrāḥ kavi-śastāḥ avantu
eva napātaḥ mama tasya dhībhiḥ bharat-vājāḥ abhi arcanti arkaiḥ gnāḥ hutāsaḥ vasavaḥ adhr̥ṣṭāḥ viśve stutāsaḥ bhūta yajatrāḥ
ut oṁ iti tyat cakṣuḥ mahi mitrayoḥ ā eti priyam varuṇayoḥ adabdham r̥tasya śuci darśatam anīkam rukmaḥ na divaḥ ut-itā vi adyaut
veda yaḥ trīṇi vidathāni eṣām devānām janma sanutaḥ ā ca vipraḥ r̥ju marteṣu vr̥jinā ca paśyan abhi caṣṭe sūraḥ aryaḥ evān
stuṣe oṁ iti vaḥ mahaḥ r̥tasya gopān aditim mitram varuṇam su-jātān aryamaṇam bhagam adabdha-dhītīn accha voce sa-dhanyaḥ pāvakān
riśādasaḥ sat-patīn adabdhān mahaḥ rājñaḥ su-vasanasya dātr̥r̥n yūnaḥ su-kṣatrān kṣayataḥ divaḥ nr̥r̥n ādityān yāmi aditim duvaḥ-yu
dyauḥ pitaḥ pr̥thivi mātaḥ adhruk agne bhrātaḥ vasavaḥ mr̥l̥ata naḥ vi śve ādityāḥ adite sa-joṣāḥ asmabhyam śarma bahulam vi yanta
mā naḥ vr̥kāya vr̥kye samasmai agha-yate rīradhata yajatrāḥ yūyam hi stha rathyaḥ naḥ tanūnām yūyam dakṣasya vacasaḥ babhūva
mā vaḥ enaḥ anya-kr̥tam bhujema mā tat karma vasavaḥ yat cayadhve viśvasya hi kṣayatha viśva-devāḥ svayam ripuḥ tanvam ririṣīṣṭa
namaḥ it ugram namaḥ ā vivāse namaḥ dādhāra pr̥thivīm uta dyām namaḥ devebhyaḥ namaḥ īśe eṣām kr̥tam cit enaḥ namasā ā vivāse
r̥tasya vaḥ rathyaḥ pūta-dakṣān r̥tasya pastya-sadaḥ adabdhān tān ā namaḥ-bhiḥ uru-cakṣasaḥ nr̥r̥n viśvān vaḥ ā name mahaḥ yajatrāḥ
te hi śreṣṭha-varcasaḥ te oṁ iti naḥ tiraḥ viśvāni duḥ-itā nayanti su-kṣatrāsaḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ agniḥ r̥ta-dhītayaḥ vakmarāja-satyāḥ
te naḥ indraḥ pr̥thivī kṣāma vardhan pūṣā bhagaḥ aditiḥ pañca janāḥ su-śarmāṇaḥ su-avasaḥ su-nīthāḥ bhavantu naḥ su-trātrāsaḥ su-gopāḥ
nu sadmānam divyam naṁśi devāḥ bhārat-vājaḥ su-matim yāti hotā āsānebhiḥ yajamānaḥ miyedhaiḥ devānām janma vasu-yuḥ vavanda
apa tyam vr̥jinam ripum stenam agne duḥ-ādhyam daviṣṭham asya sat-pate kr̥dhi su-gam
grāvāṇaḥ soma naḥ hi kam sakhi-tvanāya vāvaśuḥ jahi ni atriṇam paṇim vr̥kaḥ hi saḥ
yūyam hi stha su-dānavaḥ indra-jyeṣṭhāḥ abhi-dyavaḥ kartā naḥ adhvan ā su-gam gopāḥ amā
api panthām aganmahi svasti-gām anehasam yena viśvāḥ pari dviṣaḥ vr̥ṇakti vindate vasu
na tat divā na pr̥thivyā anu manye na yajñena na uta śamībhiḥ ābhiḥ ubjantu tam su-bhvaḥ parvatāsaḥ ni hīyatām ati-yājasya yaṣṭā
ati vā yaḥ marutaḥ manyate naḥ brahma vā yaḥ kriyamāṇam ninitsāt tapāūṁṣi tasmai vr̥jināni santu brahma-dviṣam abhi tam śocatu dyauḥ
kim aṅga tvā brahmaṇaḥ soma gopām kim aṅga tvā āhuḥ abhiśasti-pām naḥ kim aṅga naḥ paśyasi nidyamānān brahma-dviṣe tapuṣim hetim asya
avantu mām uṣasaḥ jāyamānāḥ avantu mā sindhavaḥ pinvamānāḥ avantu mā parvatāsaḥ dhruvāsaḥ avantu mā pitaraḥ deva-hūtau
viśva-dānīm su-manasaḥ syāma paśyema nu sūryam uccarantam tathā karat vasu-patiḥ vasūnām devān ohānaḥ avasā āgamiṣṭhaḥ
indraḥ nediṣṭham avasā āgamiṣṭhaḥ sarasvatī sindhu-bhiḥ pinvamānā parjanyaḥ naḥ oṣadhībhiḥ mayaḥ-bhuḥ agniḥ su-śaṁsaḥ su-havaḥ pitāiva
viśve devāsaḥ ā gata śr̥ṇuta me imam havam ā idam barhiḥ ni sīdata
yaḥ vaḥ devāḥ ghr̥ta-snunā havyena prati-bhūṣati tam viśve upa gacchatha
upa naḥ sūnavaḥ giraḥ śr̥ṇvantu amr̥tasya ye su-mr̥l̥īkāḥ bhavantu naḥ
viśve devāḥ r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ r̥tu-bhiḥ havana-śrutaḥ juṣantām yujyam payaḥ
stotram indraḥ marut-gaṇaḥ tvaṣṭr̥-mān mitraḥ aryamā imā havyā juṣanta naḥ
imam naḥ agne adhvaram hotaḥ vayuna-śaḥ yaja cikitvān daivyam janam
viśve devāḥ śr̥ṇuta imam havam me ye antarikṣe ye upa dyavi stha ye agni-jihvāḥ uta vā yajatrāḥ āsadya asmin barhiṣi mādayadhvam
viśve devāḥ mama śr̥ṇvantu yajñiyāḥ ubhe iti rodasī iti apām napāt ca manma mā vaḥ vacāṁsi pari-cakṣyāṇi vocam sumneṣu it vaḥ antamāḥ madema
ye ke ca jmā mahinaḥ ahi-māyāḥ divaḥ jajñire apām sadha-sthe te asmabhyam iṣaye viśvam āyuḥ kṣapaḥ usrāḥ varivasyantu devāḥ
agnīparjanyau avatam dhiyam me asmin have su-havā su-stutim naḥ il̥ām anyaḥ janayat garbham anyaḥ prajāvatīḥ iṣaḥ ā dhattam asme iti
stīrṇe barhiṣi sam-idhāne agnau su-uktena mahā namasā vivāse asmin naḥ adya vidathe yajatrāḥ / viśve devāḥ haviṣi mādayadhvam
vayam oṁ iti tvā pathaḥ pate ratham na vāja-sātaye dhiye pūṣan ayujmahi
abhi naḥ naryam vasu vīram prayata-dakṣiṇam vāmam gr̥ha-patim naya
aditsantam cit āghr̥ṇe pūṣan dānāya codaya paṇeḥ cit vi mrada manaḥ
vi pathaḥ vāja-sātaye cinuhi vi mr̥dhaḥ jahi sādhantām ugra naḥ dhiyaḥ
pari tr̥ndhipaṇīnām ārayā hr̥dayā kave atha īm asmabhyam randhaya
vi pūṣan ārayā tuda paṇeḥ iccha hr̥di priyam atha īm asmabhyam randhaya
ā rikha kikirā kr̥ṇu paṇīnām hr̥dayā kave atha īm asmabhyam randhaya
yām pūṣan brahma-codanīm ārām bibharṣi āghr̥ṇe tayā samasya hr̥dayam ā rikha kikirā kr̥ṇu
yā te aṣṭrā go--opaśā āghr̥ṇe paśu-sādhanī tasyāḥ te sumnam īmahe
uta naḥ go--saṇim dhiyam aśvasām vājasām uta nr̥-vat kr̥ṇuhi vītaye
sam pūṣan viduṣā naya yaḥ añjasā anu-śāsati yaḥ eva idam iti bravat
sam oṁ iti pūṣṇā gamemahi yaḥ gr̥hān abhi-śāsati ime eva iti ca bravat
pūṣṇaḥ cakram na riṣyati na koaḥ ava padyate no iti asya vyathate paviḥ
yaḥ asmai haviṣā avidhat na tam pūṣā api mr̥ṣyate prathamaḥ vindate vasu
pūṣā gāḥ anu etu naḥ pūṣā rākṣatu arvataḥ pūṣā vājam sanotu naḥ
pūṣan anu pra gāḥ ihi yajamānasya sunvataḥ asmākam stuvatām uta
mākiḥ neśam mākīm riṣan mākīm sam śāri kevaṭe atha ariṣṭābhiḥ ā gāhi
śr̥ṇvantam pūṣaṇam vayam iryam anaṣṭa-vedasam īśānam rāyaḥ īmahe
pūṣan tava vrate vayam na riṣyema kadā cana stotāraḥ te iha smasi
pari pūṣā parastāt hastam dadhātu dakṣiṇam punaḥ naḥ naṣṭam ā ajatu
ā ihi vām vi-mucaḥ napāt āghr̥ṇe sam sacāvahai rathīḥ r̥tasya naḥ bhava
rathi-tamam kapardinam īśānam rādhasaḥ mahaḥ rāyaḥ sakhāyam īmahe
rāyaḥ dhārā asi āghr̥ṇe vasoḥ rāśiḥ aja-aśva dhīvataḥ-dhīvataḥ sakhā
pūṣaṇam nu aja-aśvam upa stoṣāma vājinam svasuḥ yaḥ jāraḥ ucyate
mātuḥ didhiṣum abravam svasuḥ jāraḥ śr̥ṇotu naḥ bhrātā indrasya sakhā mama
ājāsaḥ pūṣaṇam rathe ni-śr̥mbhāḥ te jana-śriyam devam vahantu bibhrataḥ
yaḥ enam ādideśati karambha-at iti pūṣaṇam na tena devaḥ ādiśe
uta gha saḥ rathi-tamaḥ sakhyā sat-patiḥ yujā indraḥ vr̥trāṇi jighnate
uta adaḥ paruṣe gavi sūraḥ cakram hiraṇyayam ni airayat rathi-tamaḥ
yad adya tvā puru-stuta bravāma dasra mantu-maḥ tat su naḥ manma sādhaya
imam ca naḥ go--eṣaṇam sātaye sīsadhaḥ gaṇam ārāt pūṣan asi śrutaḥ
ā te svastim īmahe āre--aghām upa-vasum adya ca sarva-tātaye śvaḥ ca sarva-tātaye
indrā nu pūṣaṇā vayam sakhyāya svastaye huvema vāja-sātaye
somam anyaḥ upa asadat pātave camvoḥ sutam karambham anyaḥ icchati
ajāḥ anyasya vahnayaḥ harī iti anyasya sam-bhr̥tā / tābhyām vr̥trāṇi jighnate
yat indraḥ anayat ritaḥ mahīḥ apaḥ vr̥ṣan-tamaḥ tatra pūṣā abhavat sacā
tām pūṣṇaḥ su-matim vayam vr̥kṣasya pra vayām-iva indrasya ca ā rabhāmahe
ut pūṣaṇam yuvāmahe abhīśūn-iva sārathiḥ mahyai indram svastaye
śukram te anyat yajatam te anyat viṣurūpeitiviṣu-rūpe ahanī iti dyauḥ-iva asi viśvāḥ hi māyāḥ avasi svadhāvaḥ bhadrā te pūṣan iha rātiḥ astu
aja-aśvaḥ paśu-pāḥ vāja-pastyaḥ dhiyam-jinvaḥ bhuvane viśve arpitaḥ aṣṭrām pūṣā śithirām ut-varīvr̥jat sam-cakṣāṇaḥ bhuvanā devaḥ īyate
yāḥ te pūṣan nāvaḥ antariti samudre hiraṇyayīḥ antarikṣe caranti tābhiḥ yāsi dūtyām sūryasya kāmena kr̥ta śravaḥ icchamānaḥ
pūṣā su-bandhuḥ divaḥ ā pr̥thivyāḥ il̥aḥ patiḥ magha-vā dasma-vacārḥ yam devāsaḥ adaduḥ sūryāyai kāmena kr̥tam tavasam su-añcam
pra nu voca suteṣu vām vīryā yāni cakrathuḥ hatāsaḥ vām pitaraḥ deva-śatravaḥ indrāgnī iti jīvathaḥ yuvam
baṭ itthā mahimā vām indrāgnī iti paniṣṭhaḥ ā samānaḥ vām janitā bhrātarā yuvam yamau iheha-mātarā
oki-vāṁsā sute sacā aśvā saptīivetisaptī-iva ādane indrā nu agnī iti avasā iha vajriṇā vayam devā havāmahe
yaḥ indrāgnī iti suteṣu vām stavat teṣu r̥ta-vr̥dhā joṣa-vākam vadataḥ pajra-hoṣi ṇā na devā bhasathaḥ cana
indrāgnī iti kaḥ asya vām devau martaḥ ciketati viṣūcaḥ aśvān yuyujānaḥ īyate ekaḥ samāne ā rathe
indrāgnī iti apāt iyam pūrvā ā agāt pat-vatībhyaḥ hitvī śiraḥ jihvayā vāvadat carat triṁśat padā ni akramīt
indrāgnī iti ā hi tanvate naraḥ dhanvāni bāhvoḥ mā naḥ asmin mahādhane parā varktam go--iṣṭiṣu
indrāgnī iti tapanti mā aghāḥ aryaḥ arātayaḥ apa dveṣāṁsi ā kr̥tam yuyutam sūryāt adhi
indrāgnī iti yuvoḥ api vasu divyāni pārthivā ā naḥ iha pra yacchatam rayim viśvāyu-poṣasam
indrāgnī iti uktha-vāhasā stomebhiḥ havana-śrutā viśvābhiḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ ā gatam asya somasya pītaye
śnathat vr̥tram uta sanoti vājam indrā yaḥ agnī iti sahurī iti saparyāt irajyantā vasavyasya bhūreḥ sahaḥ-tamā sahasā vāja-yantā
tā yodhiṣṭam abhi gāḥ indra nūnam apaḥ svaḥ uṣasaḥ agne ūl̥hāḥ diśaḥ svaḥ uṣasaḥ indra citrāḥ apaḥ gāḥ agne yuvase niyutvān
ā vr̥tra-hanā vr̥traha-bhiḥ śuṣmaiḥ indra yātam namaḥ-bhiḥ agne arvāk yuvam rādhaḥ-bhiḥ akavebhiḥ indra agne asme iti bhavatam ut-tamebhiḥ
tā huve yayoḥ idam papne viśvam purā kr̥tam indrāgnī iti na mardhataḥ
ugrā vi-ghaninā mr̥dhaḥ indrāgnī iti havāmahe tā naḥ mr̥l̥ātaḥ īdr̥śe
hataḥ vr̥trāṇi āryā hataḥ dāsāni satpatī itisat-patī hataḥ viśvāḥ apa dviṣaḥ
indrāgnī iti yuvām ime abhi stomāḥ anūṣata pibatam śam-bhuvā sutam
yāḥ vām santi puru-spr̥haḥ ni-yutaḥ dāśuṣe narā indrāgnī iti tābhiḥ ā gatam
tābhiḥ ā gacchatam narā upa idam savanam sutam indrāgnī iti soma-pītaye
tam īl̥iṣva yaḥ arciṣā vanā viśvā pari-svajat kr̥ṣṇā kr̥ṇoti jihvayā
yaḥ iddhe āvivāsati sumnam indrasya martyaḥ dyumnāya su-tarāḥ apaḥ
tā naḥ vāja-vatīḥ iṣaḥ āśūn pipr̥tam arvataḥ indram agnim ca vol̥have
ubhā vām indrāgnī iti āhuvadhyai ubhā rādhasaḥ saha mādayadhyai ubhā dātārau iṣām rayīṇām ubhā vājasya sātaye huve vām
ā naḥ gavyebhiḥ aśvyaiḥ vasavyaiḥ upa gacchatam sakhāyau devau sakhyāya śam-bhuvā indrāgnī iti tā havāmahe
indrāgnī iti śr̥ṇutam havam yajamānasya sunvataḥ vītam havyāni ā gatam p ibatam somyam madhu
iyam adadāt rabhasam r̥ṇa-cyutam divaḥ-dāsam vadhri-aśvāya dāśuṣe yā śaśvantam ācakhāda avasam paṇim tā te dātrāṇi taviṣā sarasvati
iyam śuṣmebhiḥ bisakhāḥ-iva arujat sānu girīṇām taviṣebhiḥ ūrmi-bhiḥ pārāvata-ghnīm avase suvr̥kti-bhiḥ sarasvatīm ā vivāsema dhīti-bhiḥ
sarasvati deva-nidaḥ ni barhaya pra-jām viśvasya br̥sayasya māyinaḥ uta kṣiti-bhyaḥ avanīḥ avindaḥ viṣam ebhyaḥ asravaḥ vājinī-vati
pra naḥ devī sarasvatī vājebhiḥ vājinī-vatī dhīnām avitrī avatu
yaḥ tvā devi sarasvati upa-brūte dhane hite indram na vr̥tra-tūyer
tvam devi sarasvati ava vājeṣu vājini rada pūṣāiva naḥ sanim
uta syā naḥ sarasvatī ghorā hiraṇya-vartaniḥ vr̥tra-ghnī vaṣṭi su-stutim
yasyāḥ anantaḥ ahutaḥ tveṣaḥ cariṣṇuḥ arṇavaḥ amaḥ carati roruvat
sā naḥ viśvā ati dviṣaḥ savsr̥r̥r̥ḥ anyā r̥ta-varī atan ahāiva sūryaḥ
uta naḥ priyā priyāsu sapta-svasā su-juṣṭā sarasvatī stomyā bhūt
āpapruṣī pārthivāni uru rajaḥ antarikṣam sarasvatī nidaḥ pātu
tri-sadhasthā sapta-dhātuḥ pañca jātā vardhayantī vāje--vāje havyā bhūt
pra yā mahimnā mahināsu cekite dyumnebhiḥ anyā apasām apaḥ-tamā rathaḥ-iva br̥hatī vi-bhvane kr̥tā upa-stutyā cikituṣā sarasvatī
sarasvati abhi naḥ neṣi vasyaḥ mā apa spharīḥ payasā mā naḥ ā dhak juṣasva naḥ sakhyā veśyā ca mā tvat kṣetrāṇi araṇāni ganma
stuṣe narā divaḥ asya pra-santā aśvinā huve jaramāṇaḥ arkaiḥ yā sadyaḥ usrā vi-uṣi jmaḥ antān yuyāūṣataḥ pari uru varāṁsi
tā yajñam ā śuci-bhiḥ cakramāṇā rathasya bhānum rurucuḥ rajaḥ-bhiḥ puru varāṁsi amitā mimānā apaḥ dhanvāni ati yāthaḥ ajrān
tā ha tyat vartiḥ yat aradhram ugrā itthā dhiyaḥ ūhathuḥ śaśvat aśvaiḥ manaḥ-javebhiḥ iṣiraiḥ śayadhyai pari vyarthiḥ dāśuṣaḥ martyasya
tā navyasaḥ jaramāṇasya manma upa bhūṣataḥ yuyujānasaptī itiyuyujāna-saptī śubham pr̥kṣam iṣam ūrjam vahantā hotā yakṣat pratnaḥ adhruk yuvānā
tā valgū dasrā puruśāka-tamā pratnā navyasā vacasā ā vivāse yā śaṁsate stuvate śam-bhaviṣṭhā babhūvatuḥ gr̥ṇate citrarātī iticitra-rātī
tā bhujyum vi-bhiḥ at-bhyaḥ samudrāt tugrasya sūnum ūhathuḥ rajaḥ-bhiḥ areṇu-bhiḥ yojanebhiḥ bhujantā patatri-bhiḥ arṇasaḥ niḥ upa-sthāt
vi jayuṣā rathyā yātam adrim śrutam havam vr̥ṣaṇā vadhri-matyāḥ daśasyantā śayave pipyathuḥ gām iti cyavānā su-matim bhuraṇyūiti
yat rodasī iti pra-divaḥ asti bhūmā hel̥aḥ devānām uta martya-trā tat ādityāḥ vasavaḥ rudriyāsaḥ rakṣaḥ-yuje tapuḥ agham dadhāta
yaḥ īm rājānau r̥tu-thā vi-dadhat rajasaḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ ciketat gambhīrāya rakṣase hetim asya droghāya cit vacase ānavāya
antaraiḥ cakraiḥ tanayāya vartiḥ dyu-matā ā yātam nr̥-vatā rathena sanutyena tyajasā martyasya vanuṣyatām api śīrṣā vavr̥ktam
ā paramābhiḥ uta madhyamābhiḥ niyut-bhiḥ yātam avamābhiḥ arvāk dr̥l̥hasya cit go--mataḥ vi vrajasya duraḥ vartam gr̥ṇate citrarātī iticitra-rātī
kva tyā valgū iti puru-hūtā adya dūtaḥ na stomaḥ avidat namasvān ā yaḥ arvāk nāsatyā vavarta preṣṭhā hi asathaḥ asya manman
aram me gantam havanāya asmai gr̥ṇānā yathā pibāthaḥ andhaḥ pari ha tyat vartiḥ yāthaḥ riṣaḥ na yat paraḥ na antaraḥ tuturyāt
akāri vām andhasaḥ varīman astāri barhiḥ supra-ayanatamam uttāna-hastaḥ yuvayuḥ vavanda ā vām nakṣantaḥ adrayaḥ āñjan
ūrdhvaḥ vām agniḥ adhvareṣu asthāt pra rātiḥ eti jūrṇinī ghr̥tācī pra hotā gūrta-manāḥ urāṇaḥ ayukta yaḥ nāsatyā havīman
adhi śriye duhitā sūryasya ratham tasthau puru-bhujā śata-ūtim pra māyābhiḥ māyinā bhūtam atra narā nr̥tūiti janiman yajñiyānām
yuvam śrībhiḥ darśatābhiḥ abhiḥ śubhe puṣṭim ūhathuḥ sūryāyāḥ pra vām vayaḥ vapuṣe anu paptan nakṣat vāṇī su-stutā dhiṣṇyā vām
ā vām vayaḥ aśvāsaḥ vahiṣṭhāḥ abhi prayaḥ nāsatyā vahantu pra vām rathaḥ manaḥ-javāḥ asarji iṣaḥ pr̥kṣaḥ iṣidhaḥ anu pūrvīḥ
puru hi vām puru-bhujā deṣṇam dhenum naḥ iṣam pinvatam asakrām stutaḥ ca vām mādhvī iti su-stutiḥ ca rasāḥ ca ye vām anu rātim agman
uta me r̥jre iti purayasya raghvī iti su-mīl̥he śatam peruke ca pakvaa śāṇḍaḥ dāt hiraṇinaḥ smat-diṣṭīn daśa vaśāsaḥ abhi-sācaḥ r̥ṣvān
sam vām śatā nāsatyā sahasrā aśvānām puru-panthāḥ gire dāt bharat-vājāya vīra nu gire dāt hatā rakṣāṁsi puru-daṁsasā syuritisyuḥ
ā vām sumne variman sūri-bhiḥ syām
ut oṁ iti śriye uṣasaḥ rocamānāḥ asthuḥ apām na ūrmayaḥ ruśantaḥ kr̥ṇoti viśvā su-pathā su-gāni abhūt oṁ iti vasvī dakṣiṇā maghonī
bhadrā dadr̥kṣe urviyā vi bhāsi ut te śociḥ bhānavaḥ dyām apaptan āviḥ vakṣaḥ kr̥ṇuṣe śumbhamānā uṣaḥ devi rocamānā mahaḥ-bhiḥ
vahanti sīm aruṇāsaḥ ruśantaḥ gāvaḥ su-bhagām urviyā prathanām apa ījate śūraḥ astāiva śatrūn bādhate tamaḥ ajiraḥ na vol̥hā
su-gā uta te su-pathā parvateṣu avāte apaḥ tarasi svabhāno itisva-bhāno sā naḥ ā vaha pr̥thu-yāman r̥ṣve rayim divaḥ duhitaḥ iṣayadhyai
sā ā vaha yā ukṣa-bhiḥ avātā uṣaḥ varam vahasi joṣam anu tvam divaḥ duhitaḥ yā ha devī pūrva-hūtau maṁhanā darśatā bhūḥ
ut te vayaḥ cit vasateḥ apaptan naraḥ ca ye pitu-bhājaḥ vi-uṣṭau amā sate vahasi bhūri vāmam uṣaḥ devi dāśuṣe martyāya
eṣā syā naḥ duhitā divaḥ-jāḥ kṣitīḥ ucchantī mānuṣīḥ ajīgariti yā bhānunā ruśatā rāmyāsu ajñāyi tiraḥ tamasaḥ cit aktūn
vi tat yayuḥ aruṇayuk-bhiḥ aśvaiḥ citram bhānti uṣasaḥ candra-rathāḥ agram yajñasya br̥hataḥ nayantīḥ vi tāḥ bādhante tamaḥ ūrmyāyāḥ
śravaḥ vājam iṣam ūrjam vahantīḥ ni dāśuṣe uṣasaḥ martyāya maghonīḥ vīra-vat patyamānāḥ avaḥ dhāta vidhate ratnam adya
idā hi vaḥ vidhate ratnam asti idā vīrāya dāśuṣe uṣasaḥ idā viprāya jarate yat ukthā ni sma māvate vahatha purā cit
idā hi te uṣaḥ adrisāno ity adri-sāno gotrā gavām aṅgirasaḥ gr̥ṇanti vi arkeṇa bibhiduḥ brahmaṇā ca satyā nr̥ṇām abhavat deva-hūtiḥ
uccha divaḥ duhitariti pratna-vat naḥ bharadvāja-vat vidhate maghoni su-vīram rayim gr̥ṇate rirīhi uru-gāyam adhi dhehi śravaḥ naḥ
vapuḥ nu tat cikituṣe cit astu samānam nāma dhenu patyamānam marteṣu anyat dohase pīpāya sakr̥t śukram duduhe pr̥śniḥ ūdhaḥ
ye agnayaḥ na śośucan idhānāḥ dviḥ yat triḥ marutaḥ vavr̥dhanta areṇavaḥ hiraṇyayāsaḥ eṣām sākam nr̥mṇaiḥ paiṁsyebhiḥ ca bhūvan
rudrasya ye mīl̥huṣaḥ santi putrāḥ yān co iti nu dādhr̥viḥ bharadhyai vide hi mātā mahaḥ mahī sā sā it pr̥śniḥ su-bhve garbham ā adhāt
na ye īṣante januṣaḥ ayā nu antariti santaḥ avadyāni punānāḥ n iḥ yat duhre śucayaḥ anu joṣam anu śr̥iyā tanvam ukṣamāṇāḥ
makṣu na yeṣu dohase cit ayāḥ ā nāma ghr̥ṣṇu mārutam dadhānāḥ na ye staunāḥ ayāsaḥ mahnā nu cit su-dānuḥ ava yāsat ugrān
te it ugrāḥ śavasā dhr̥ṣṇu-senāḥ ubhe iti yujanta rodasī iti sumeke itisu-meke adha sma eṣu rodasī sva-śociḥ ā amavat-su tasthau na rokaḥ
anenaḥ vaḥ marutaḥ yāmaḥ astu anaśvaḥ cit yam ajati arathīḥ anavasaḥ anabhīśuḥ rajaḥ-tūḥ vi rodasī iti pathyāḥ yāti sādhan
na asya vartā na tarutā nu asti marutaḥ yam avatha vāja-sātau toke vā goṣu tanaye yam ap-su saḥ vrajam dartā pārye adha dyoḥ
pra citram arkam gr̥ṇate turāya mārutāya sva-tavase bharadhvam ye sahāṁsi sahasā sahante rejate agne pr̥thivī makhebhyaḥ
tviṣi-mantaḥ adhvarasya-iva didyut tr̥ṣu-cyavasaḥ juhvaḥ na agneḥ arcatrayaḥ dhunayaḥ na vīrāḥ bhrājat-janmānaḥ marutaḥ adhr̥ṣṭāḥ
tam vr̥dhantam mārutam bhrājat-r̥ṣṭim rudrasya sūnum havasā ā vivāse divaḥ śardhāya śucayaḥ manīṣā girayaḥ na āpaḥ ugrāḥ aspr̥dhran
viśveṣām vaḥ satām jyeṣṭha-tamā gīḥ-bhiḥ mitrāvaruṇā vavr̥dhadhyai sam yā raśmāiva yamatuḥ yamiṣṭhā dvā janān asamā bāhu-bhiḥ svaiḥ
iyam mat vām pra str̥ṇīte manīṣā upa priyā namasā barhiḥ accha yantam naḥ mitrāvaruṇau adhr̥ṣṭam chardiḥ yat vām varūthyam sudānūitisu-dānū
ā yātam mitrāvaruṇā su-śasti upa priyā namasā hūyamānā sam yau apnaḥ-sthaḥ apasāiva janān śrudhi-yataḥ cit yatathaḥ mahitvā
aśvā na yā vājinā pūtabandhūitipūta-bandhū r̥tā yat garbham aditiḥ bharadhyai pra yā mahi mahāntā jāyamānā ghorā martāya ripave ni dīdharitidīdhaḥ
viśve yat vām maṁhanā mandamānāḥ kṣatram devāsaḥ adadhuḥ sa-joṣāḥ pari yat bhūthaḥ rodasī iti cit urvī iti santi spaśaḥ adabdhāsaḥ amūrāḥ
tā hi kṣatram dhārayetheiti anu dyūn dr̥ṁhetheiti sānum upamāt-iva dyoḥ dr̥l̥haḥ nakṣatraḥ uta viśva-devaḥ bhūmim ā atān dyām dhāsinā āyoḥ
tā vigram dhaitheiti jaṭharam pr̥ṇadhyai ā yat sadma sa-bhr̥tayaḥ pr̥ṭṇanti na mr̥ṣyante yuvatayaḥ avātāḥ vi yat payaḥ viśva-jinvā bharante
tā jihvayā sadam ā idam su-medhāḥ ā yat vām satyaḥ aratiḥ r̥te bhūt tat vām mahi-tvam ghr̥ta-annau astu yuvam dāśuṣe vi cayiṣṭam aṁhaḥ
pra yat vām mitrāvaruṇā spūrdhan priyā dhāma yuva-dhitā minanti na ye devāsaḥ ohasā na martāḥ ayajña-sācaḥ apyaḥ na putrāḥ
vi yat vācam kīstāsaḥ bharante śaṁsanti ke cit ni-vidaḥ manānāḥ āt vām bravāma satyāni ukthā nakiḥ devebhiḥ yatathaḥ mahi-tvā
avoḥ itthā vām chardiṣaḥ abhiṣṭau yuvoḥ mitrāvaruṇau askr̥dhoyu anu yat gāvaḥ sphurān r̥jipyam dhr̥ṣṇum yat raṇe vr̥ṣaṇam yunajan
śruṣṭī vām yajñaḥ ut-yataḥ sa-joṣāḥ manuṣvat vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ yajadhyai ā yaḥ indrāvaruṇau iṣe adya mahe sumnāya mahe āvavartat
tā hi śreṣṭhā deva-tātā tujā śūrāṇām śaviṣṭhā tā hi bhūtam maghonām maṁhiṣṭhā tuvi-śuṣmā r̥tena vr̥tra-turā sarva-senā
tā gr̥ṇīhi namasyebhiḥ śūṣaiḥ sumnebhiḥ indrāvaruṇā cakānā vajreṇa anyaḥ śavasā hanti vr̥tram sisakti anyaḥ vr̥janeṣu vipraḥ
gnāḥ ca yat naraḥ ca vavr̥dhanta viśve devāsaḥ narām sva-gūrtāḥ pra ebhyaḥ indrāvaruṇā mahi-tvā dyauḥ ca pr̥thivi bhūtam urvī iti
saḥ it su-dānuḥ sva-vān r̥ta-vā indrā yaḥ vām varuṇā dāśati tman iṣā saḥ dviṣaḥ taret dāsvān vaṁsat rayim rayi-vataḥ ca janān
yam yuvam dāśu-adhvarāya devā rayim dhatthaḥ vasu-mantam puru-kṣum asme iti saḥ indrāvaruṇau api syāt pra yaḥ bhanakti vanuṣām aśastīḥ
uta naḥ su-trātaḥ deva-gopāḥ sūri-bhyaḥ indrāvaruṇā rayiḥ syāt yeṣām śuṣmaḥ pr̥tanāsu sāhvān pra sadyaḥ dyumnā tirate taturiḥ
nu naḥ indrāvaruṇā gr̥ṇānā pr̥ṅktam rayim sauśravasāya devā itthā gr̥ṇantaḥ mahinasya śardhaḥ apaḥ na nāvā duḥ-itā tarema
pra sam-rāje br̥hate manma nu priyam arca devāya varuṇāya sa-prathaḥ ayam yaḥ urvī iti mahinā mahi-vrataḥ kratvā vi-bhāti ajaraḥ na śociṣā
indrāvaruṇā suta-pau imam sutam somam pibatam madyam dhr̥ta-vratā yuvoḥ rathaḥ adhvaram deva-vītaye prati svasaram upa yāti pītaye
indrāvaruṇā madhumat-tamasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ somasya vr̥ṣaṇā ā vr̥ṣethām idam vām andhaḥ pari-siktam asme iti āsadya asmin barhiṣi mādayethām
sam vām karmaṇā sam iṣā hinomi indrāviṣṇūiti apasaḥ pāre asya juṣethām yajñam draviṇam ca dhattam ariṣṭaiḥ naḥ pathi-bhiḥ pārayantā
yā viśvāsām janitārā matīnām indrāviṣṇūiti kalaśā soma-dhānā pra vām giraḥ śasyamānāḥ avantu pra stomāsaḥ gīyamānāsaḥ arkaiḥ
indrāviṣṇūiti madapatī itimada-patī madānām ā somam yātam draviṇo iti dadhānā sam vām añjantu aktu-bhiḥ matīnām sam stomāsaḥ śasyamānāsaḥ ukthaiḥ
ā vām aśvāsaḥ abhimāti-sahaḥ indrāviṣṇūiti sadha-mādaḥ vahantu juṣethām viśvā havanā matīnām upa brahmāṇi śr̥ṇutam giraḥ me
indrāviṣṇūiti tat panayāyyam vām somasya made uru cakramātheiti akr̥ṇutam antarikṣam varīyaḥ aprathatam jīvase naḥ rajāṁsi
indrāviṣṇūiti haviṣā vavr̥dhānā agra-advānā namasā rāta-havyā ghr̥tāsutī itighr̥ta-āsutī draviṇam dhattam asme iti samudraḥ sthaḥ kalaśaḥ soma-dhānaḥ
indrāviṣṇūiti pibatam madhvaḥ asya somasya dasrā jaṭharam pr̥ṇethām ā vām andhāṁsi madirāṇi agman upa brahmāṇi śr̥ṇutam havam me
ubhā jigyathuḥ na parā jayetheiti na parā jigye kataraḥ cana enoḥ indraḥ ca viṣṇo iti yat apasr̥dhethām tredhā sahasram vi tat airayethām
ghr̥tavatī itighr̥ta-vatī bhuvanānām abhi-śriyā urvī pr̥thvī iti madhudugheitimadhu-dughe su-peśasā dyāvāpr̥thivī iti varuṇasya dharmaṇā viskabhiteitivi-skabhite ajareiti bhūri-retasā
asaścantī iti bhūridhāreitibhūri-dhāre payasvatī iti ghr̥tam duhāteiti su-kr̥te śucivrateitiśuci-vrate / rājantī iti asya bhuvanasya rodasī iti asme iti retaḥ siñcatam yat manuḥ-hitam
yaḥ vām r̥jave kramaṇāya rodasī iti martaḥ dadāśa dhiṣaṇeiti saḥ sādhati pra pra-jābhiḥ jāyate dhamarṇaḥ pari yuvoḥ siktā viṣu-rūpāṇi sa-vratā
ghr̥tena dyāvāpr̥thivī iti abhīvr̥teity abhi-vr̥te ghr̥ta-śriyā ghr̥ta-pr̥cā ghr̥ta-vr̥dhā urvī iti pr̥thvī iti hotr̥-vūrye purohiteitipuraḥ-hite te iti it viprāḥ īl̥ate sumnam iṣṭayega
madhu naḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti mimikṣatām madhu-ścutā madhudugheitimadhu-dughe madhuvrateitimadhu-vrate dadhāneiti yajñam draviṇam ca devatā mahi śravaḥ vājam asme iti su-vīryam
iti viśva-śambhuvā sanim vājam rayim asme iti sam invatām
ut oṁ iti syaḥ devaḥ savitā hiraṇyayā bāhū iti ayaṁsta savanāya su-kratuḥ ghr̥tena pāṇī iti abhi pruṣṇute makhaḥ yuvā su-dakṣaḥ rajasaḥ vi-dharmaṇi
devasya vayam savituḥ savīmani śreṣṭhe syāma vasunaḥ ca dāvane yaḥ viśvasya dvi-padaḥ yaḥ catuḥ-padaḥ ni-veśane pra-save ca asi bhūmanaḥ
adabdhebhiḥ savitariti payu-bhiḥ tvam śivebhiḥ adya pari pāhi naḥ gayam hiraṇya-jihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣa mākiḥ naḥ agha-śaṁsaḥ īśata
ut oṁ iti syaḥ devaḥ savitā damūnāḥ hiraṇya-pāṇiḥ prati-doṣam asthāt ayaḥ-hanuḥ yajataḥ mandra-jihvaḥ ā dāśuṣe suvati bhūri vāmam
ut oṁ iti ayān upavaktāiva bāhū iti hiranyayā savitā su-pratīkā divaḥ rohāṁsi aruhat pr̥thivyāḥ arīramat patayat kat cit abhvam
vāmam adya savitaḥ vāmam oṁ iti śvaḥ dive--dive vāmam asmabhyam sāvīḥ vāmasya hi kṣayasya deva bhūreḥ ayā dhiyā vāma-bhājaḥ syāma
indrāsomā mahi tat vām mahi-tvam yuvam mahāni prathamāni cakrathuḥ yuvam sūryam vividathuḥ yuvam svaḥ viśvā tamāṁsi ahatam nidaḥ ca
indrāsomā vāsayathaḥ uṣasam ut sūryam nayathaḥ jyotiṣā saha upa dyām skambhathuḥ skambhanena aprathatam pr̥thivīm mātaram vi
indrāsomau ahim apaḥ pari-sthām hathaḥ vr̥tram anu vām dyauḥ amanyata pra arṇāṁsi airayatam nadīnām ā samudrāṇi paprathuḥ purūṇi
indrāsomā pakvam āmāsu antaḥ ni gavām it dadhathuḥ vakṣaṇāsu jagr̥bhathuḥ anapi-naddham āsu ruśat citrāsu jagatīṣu antariti
indrāsomā yuvam aṅga tarutram apatya-sācam śrutyam rarātheiti yuvam śuṣmam naryam carṣaṇi-bhyaḥ sam vivyathuḥ pr̥tanāsaham ugrā
yaḥ adri-bhit prathama-jāḥ r̥ta-vā br̥haspatiḥ āṅgirasaḥ haviṣmān dvibarha-jmā prāgharma-sat pitā naḥ ā rodasī iti vr̥ṣabhaḥ roravīti
janāya cit yaḥ īvate oṁ iti lokam br̥haspatiḥ deva-hūtau cakāra ghnan vr̥trāṇi vi puraḥ dardarīti jayan śatrūn amitrān pr̥t-su sāhan
br̥haspatiḥ sam ajayat vasūni mahaḥ vrajān go--mataḥ devaḥ eṣaḥ apaḥ sisāsan svaḥ aprati-itaḥ br̥haspatiḥ hanti amitram akairḥ
somārudrā dhārayethām asuryam pra vām iṣṭayaḥ aram aśnuvantu dame--dame sapta ratnā dadhānā śam naḥ bhūtam dvi-pade śam catuḥ-pade
somārudrā vi vr̥hatam viṣūcīm amīvā yā naḥ gayam āviveśa āre bādhethām niḥ-r̥tim parācaiḥ asme iti bhadrā sauśravasāni santu
somārudrā yuvam etāni asme iti viśvā tanūṣu bheṣajāni dhattam ava syatam muñcatam yat naḥ asti tanūṣu baddham kr̥tam enaḥ asmat
tigma-āyudhau tigmahetī ititigma-hetī su-śevau somārudrā iha su mr̥l̥atam naḥ pra naḥ muñcatam varuṇasya pāśāt gopāyatam naḥ su-manasyamānā
jīmūtasya-iva bhavati pratīkam yat varmī yāti sa-madām upa-sthe anāviddhayā tanvā jaya tvam saḥ tvā varmaṇaḥ mahimā pipartu
dhanvanā gāḥ dhanvanā ājim jayema dhanvanā tīvrāḥ sa-madaḥ jayema dhanuḥ śatroḥ apa-kāmam kr̥ṇoti dhanvanā sarvāḥ pra-diśaḥ jayema
vakṣyantī-iva it ā ganīganti karṇam priyam sakhāyam pari-sasvajānā yoṣāiva śiṅkte vi-tatā adhi dhanvan jyā iyam samane pārayantī
te iti ācarantī ity ācarantī samanāiva yoṣā mātāiva putram bibhr̥tām upa-sthe apa śatrūn vidhyatām saṁvidāne itisam-vidāne ātnīriti ime iti visphurantī itivi-sphurantī amitrān
bahvīnām pitā bahurasya putraḥ ciścā kr̥ṇoti samanā ava-gatya iṣu-dhiḥ saṅkāḥ pr̥tanāḥ ca sarvāḥ pr̥ṣṭhe ni-naddhaḥ jayati pra-sūtaḥ
rathe tiṣṭhan nayati vājinaḥ puraḥ yatra-yatra kāmayate su-sārathiḥ abhīśūnām mahimānam panāyata manaḥ paścāt anu yacchanti raśmayaḥ
tīvrān ghoṣān kr̥ṇvate vr̥ṣa-pāṇayaḥ aśvāḥ rathebhiḥ saha vājayantaḥ ava-krāmantaḥ pra-padaiḥ amitrān kṣiṇanti śatrūn anapa-vyayantaḥ
ratha-vāhanam haviḥ asya nāma yatra āyudham ni-hitam asya varma tatra ratham upa śagmam sadema viśvāhā vayam su-manasyamānāḥ
svādu-saṁsadaḥ pitaraḥ vayaḥ-dhāḥ kr̥cchra-śritaḥ śakti-vantaḥ gabhīrāḥ citra-senāḥ iṣu-balāḥ amr̥dhrāḥ sataḥ-vīrāḥ uravaḥ vrāta-sahāḥ
brāhmaṇāsaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ śive iti naḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti anehasā pūṣā naḥ pātu duḥ-itāt r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ rakṣa mākiḥ naḥ agha-śaṁsaḥ īśata
su-parṇam vaste mr̥gaḥ asyāḥ dantaḥ gobhiḥ sam-naddhā patati pra-sūtā yatra naraḥ sam ca vi ca dravanti tatra asmabhyam iṣavaḥ śarma yaṁsan
r̥jīte pari vr̥ṅdhi naḥ aśmā bhavatu naḥ tanūḥ somaḥ adhi bravītu naḥ aditiḥ śarma yacchatu
ā jaṅghanti sānu eṣām jaghanān upa jighnate aśva-ajani pra-cetasaḥ aśvān samat-su codaya
