nakiḥ tam karmaṇā naśat na pra yoṣat na yoṣati devānām yaḥ it manaḥ yajamānaḥ iyakṣati abhi it ayajvanaḥ bhuvat
asat atra su-vīryam uta tyat āśu-aśvyam devānām yaḥ it manaḥ yajamānaḥ iyakṣati abhi it ayajvanaḥ bhuvat
pra kr̥tāni r̥jīṣiṇaḥ kaṇvāḥ indrasya gāthayā made somasya vocata
yaḥ sr̥bindam anarśanim piprum dāsam ahīśuvam vadhīt ugraḥ riṇan apaḥ
ni arbudasya viṣṭapam varṣmāṇam br̥hataḥ tira kr̥ṣe tat indra paiṁsyam
prati śrutāya vaḥ dhr̥ṣat tūrṇāśam na gireḥ adhi huve su-śipram ūtaye
saḥ goḥ aśvasya vi vrajam mandānaḥ somyebhyaḥ puram na śūra darṣasi
yadi me raraṇaḥ sute ukthe vā dadhase canaḥ ārāt upa svadhā ā gahi
vayam gha te api smasi stotāraḥ indra girvaṇaḥ tvam naḥ jinva soma-pāḥ
uta naḥ pitum ā bhara sam-rarāṇaḥ avi-kṣitam magha-van bhūri te vasu
uta naḥ go-mataḥ kr̥dhi hiraṇya-vataḥ aśvinaḥ il̥ābhiḥ sam rabhemahi
br̥bat-uktham havāmahe sr̥pra-karasnam ūtaye sādhu kr̥ṇvantam avase
yaḥ sam-sthe cit śata-kratuḥ āt īm kr̥ṇoti vr̥tra-hā jaritr̥-bhyaḥ puru-vasuḥ
saḥ naḥ śakraḥ cit ā śakat dāna-vān antara-ābharaḥ indraḥ viśvābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ
yaḥ rāyaḥ avaniḥ mahān su-pāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā tam indram abhi gāyata
āyantāram mahi sthiram pr̥tanāsu śravaḥ-jitam bhūreḥ īśānam ojasā
nakiḥ asya śacīnām ni-yantā sūnr̥tānām nakiḥ vaktā na dāt iti
na nūnam brahmaṇām r̥ṇam prāśūnām asti sunvatām na somaḥ apratā pape
panye it upa gāyata panye ukthāni śaṁsata brahma kr̥ṇota panye it
panyaḥ ā dardirat śatā sahasrā vājī avr̥taḥ indraḥ yaḥ yajvanaḥ vr̥dhaḥ
vi su cara svadhāḥ anu kr̥ṣṭīnām anu āhuvaḥ indra piba sutānām
piba sva-dhainavānām uta yaḥ tugrye sacā uta ayam indra yaḥ tava
ati ihi manyu-sāvinam susu-vāṁsam upa-araṇe imam rātam sutam piba
ihi tisraḥ parāvataḥ ihi pañca janān ati dhenāḥ indra ava-cākaśat
sūryaḥ raśmim yathā sr̥ja tvā yacchantu me giraḥ nimnam āpaḥ na sadhryak
adhvaryo iti ā tu hi siñca somam vīrāya śipriṇe bhara sutasya pītaye
yaḥ udnaḥ phali-gam bhinat nyak sindhūn ava-asr̥jat yaḥ goṣu pakvam dhārayat
ahan vr̥tram r̥cīṣamaḥ aurṇa-vābham ahīśuvam himena avidhyat arbudam
pra vaḥ ugrāya niḥ-ture aṣāl̥hāya pra-sakṣiṇe devattam brahma gāyata
yaḥ viśvāni abhi vratā somasya made andhasaḥ indraḥ deveṣu cetati
iha tyā sadha-mādyā harī iti hiraṇya-keśyā vol̥hām abhi prayaḥ hitam
arvāñcam tvā puru-stuta priyamedha-stutā harī iti soma-peyāya vakṣataḥ
vayam gha tvā suta-vantaḥ āpaḥ na vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ pavitrasya pra-sravaṇeṣu vr̥tra-han pari stotāraḥ āsate
svaranti tvā sute naraḥ vaso iti nireke ukthinaḥ kadā sutam tr̥ṣāṇaḥ okaḥ ā gamaḥ indra svabdī-iva vaṁsagaḥ
kaṇvebhiḥ dhr̥ṣṇo iti ā dhr̥ṣat vājam darṣi sahasriṇam piśaṅga-rūpam magha-van vi-carṣaṇe makṣu go--mantam īmahe
pāhi gāya andhasaḥ made indrāya medhya-atithe yaḥ sam-miślaḥ haryoḥ yaḥ sute sacā vajrī rathaḥ hiraṇyayaḥ
yaḥ su-savyaḥ su-dakṣiṇaḥ inaḥ yaḥ su-kratuḥ gr̥ṇe yaḥ ākaraḥ sahasrā yaḥ śata-maghaḥ indraḥ yaḥ pūḥ-bhit āritaḥ
yaḥ dhr̥ṣitaḥ yaḥ avr̥taḥ yaḥ asti śmaśruṣu śritaḥ vibhūta-dyumnaḥ cyavanaḥ puru-stutaḥ kratvā gauḥ-iva śākinaḥ
kaḥ īm veda sute sacā pibantam kat vayaḥ dadhe ayam yaḥ puraḥ vi-bhinatti ojasā mandānaḥ śiprī andhasaḥ
dānā mr̥gaḥ na vāraṇaḥ puru-trā caratham dadhe nakiḥ tvā ni yamat ā sute gamaḥ mahān carasi ojasā
yaḥ ugraḥ san aniḥ-str̥taḥ sthiraḥ raṇāya saṁskr̥taḥ yadi stotuḥ magha-vā śr̥ṇavat havam na indraḥ yoṣati ā gamat
satyam itthā vr̥ṣā it asi vr̥ṣa-jūtiḥ naḥ avr̥taḥ vr̥ṣā hi ugra śr̥ṇviṣe parāvati vr̥ṣaḥ arvāvati śrutaḥ
vr̥ṣaṇaḥ te abhīśavaḥ vr̥ṣā kaśā hiraṇyayī vr̥ṣā rathaḥ magha-van vr̥ṣaṇā harī iti vr̥ṣā tvam śatakrato itiśata-krato
vr̥ṣā sotā sunotu te vr̥ṣan r̥jīpin ā bhara vr̥ṣā dadhanve vr̥ṣaṇam nadīṣu ā tubhyam sthātaḥ harīṇām
ā indra yāhi pītaye madhu śaviṣṭha somyam na ayam accha magha-vā śr̥ṇavat giraḥ brahma ukthā ca su-kratuḥ
vahantu tvā rathesthām ā harayaḥ ratha-yujaḥ tiraḥ cit aryam savanāni vr̥tra-han anyeṣām yā śatakrato itiśata-krato
asmākam adya antamam stomam dhiṣva mahāmaha asmākam te savanā santu śam-tamā madāya dyukṣa soma-pāḥ
nahi saḥ tava naḥ mama śāstre anyasya raṇyati yaḥ asmān vīraḥ ā anayat
indraḥ cit gha tat abravīt striyāḥ aśāsyam manaḥ uto iti aha kratum raghum
saptī iti cit gha mada-cyutā mithunā vahataḥ ratham eva it dhūḥ vr̥ṣṇaḥ ut-tarā
adhaḥ paśyasva mā upari sam-tarām pādakau hara mā te kaśa-plakau dr̥śan strī hi brahmā babhūvitha
ā indra yāhi hari-bhiḥ upa kaṇvasya su-stutim divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
ā tvā grāvā vadan iha somī ghoṣeṇa yacchatu divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
atra vi nemiḥ eṣām urām na dhūnute vr̥kaḥ divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
ā tvā kaṇvāḥ iha avase havante vāja-sātaye divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
dadhāmi te sutānām vr̥ṣṇe na pūrva-pāyyam divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
smat-purandhiḥ naḥ ā gahi viśvataḥ-dhīḥ naḥ ūtaye divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
ā naḥ yāhi mahe--mate sahasra-ūte śata-magha divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
ā tvā hotā manuḥ-hitaḥ deva-trā vakṣat īḍyaḥ divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
ā tvā mada-cyutā harī iti śyenam pakṣāiva vakṣataḥ divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
ā yāhi aryaḥ ā pari svāhā somasya pītaye divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
ā naḥ yāhi upa-śruti uktheṣu raṇaya iha divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
sa-rūpaiḥ ā su naḥ gahi sam-bhr̥taiḥ sambhr̥ta-aśvaḥ divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
ā yāhi parvatebhyaḥ samudrasya adhi viṣṭapaḥ divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
ā naḥ gavyāni aśvyā sahasrā śūra dardr̥hi divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
ā naḥ sahasra-śaḥ bhara ayutāni śatāni ca divaḥ amuṣya śāsataḥ divam yaya divāvaso itidivāvaso
ā yat indraḥ ca dadvahe iti sahasram vasu-rociṣaḥ ojiṣṭham aśvyam paśum
ye r̥jrāḥ vāta-raṁhasaḥ aruṣāsaḥ raghu-syadaḥ bhrājante sūryāḥ-iva
pārāvatasya rātiṣu dravat-cakreṣu āśuṣu tiṣṭham vanasya madhye ā
agninā indreṇa varuṇena viṣṇunā ādityaiḥ rudraiḥ vasu-bhiḥ sacābhuvā sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
viśvābhiḥ dhībhiḥ bhuvanena vājinā divā pr̥thivyā adri-bhiḥ sacābhuvā sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
viśvaiḥ devaiḥ tri-bhiḥ ekādaśaiḥ iha at-bhiḥ marut-bhiḥ bhr̥gu-bhiḥ sacābhuvā sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
juṣethām yajñam bodhatam havasya me viśvā iha devau savanā ava gacchatam sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
stomam juṣethām yuvaśāiva kanyanām viśvā iha devau savanā ava gacchatam sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
giraḥ juṣethām adhvaram juṣethām viśvā iha devau savanā ava gacchatam sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
hāridravāiva patathaḥ vanā it upa somam sutam mahiṣāiva ava gacchathaḥ sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
haṁsau-iva patathaḥ adhvagau-iva somam sutam mahiṣāiva ava gacchathaḥ sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
śyenau-iva patathaḥ havya-dātaye somam sutam mahiṣāiva ava gacchathaḥ sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
pibatam ca tr̥pṇutam ca ā ca gacchatam pra-jām ca dhattam draviṇam ca dhattam sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
jayatam ca pra stutam ca pra ca avatam pra-jām ca dhattam draviṇam ca dhattam sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
hatam ca śatrūn yatatam ca mitriṇaḥ pra-jām ca dhattam draviṇam ca dhattam sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
mitrāvaruṇa-vantau uta dharma-vantā marutvantā jarituḥ gacchathaḥ havam sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
aṅgirasvantau uta viṣṇu-vantā marutvantā jarituḥ gacchathaḥ havam sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
r̥bhu-mantā vr̥ṣaṇā vāja-vantā marutvantā jarituḥ gacchathaḥ havam sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
brahma jinvatam uta jinvatam dhiyaḥ hatam rakṣāṁsi sedhatam amīvāḥ sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
kṣatram jinvatam uta jinvatam nr̥r̥n hatam rakṣāṁsi sedhatam amīvāḥ sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
dhenūḥ jinvatam uta jinvatam viśaḥ hatam rakṣāṁsi sedhatam amīvāḥ sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
atreḥ-iva śr̥ṇutam pūrvya-stutim śyāva-aśvasya sunvataḥ mada-cyutā sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
sargān-iva sr̥jatam su-stutīḥ upa śyāva-aśvasya sunvataḥ mada-cyutā sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
raśmīn-iva yacchatam adhvarān upa śyāva-aśvasya sunvataḥ mada-cyutā sa-joṣasau uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somam pibatam aśvinā
arvāk ratham ni yacchatam pibatam somyam madhu ā yātam aśvinā ā gatam avasyuḥ vām aham huve dhattam ratnāni dāśuṣe
namaḥ-vāke pra-sthite adhvare narā vivakṣaṇasya pītaye ā yātam aśvinā ā gatam avasyuḥ vām aham huve dhattam ratnāni dāśuṣe
svāhākr̥tasya tr̥mpatam sutasya devau andhasaḥ ā yātam aśvinā ā gatam avasyuḥ vām aham huve dhattam ratnāni dāśuṣe
avitā asi sunvataḥ vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ piba somam madāya kam śatakrato itiśata-krato yam te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pr̥tanāḥ uru jrayaḥ sam apsu-jit marutvān indra sat-pate
pra ava stotāram magha-van ava tvām piba somam madāya kam śatakrato itiśata-krato yam te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pr̥tanāḥ uru jrayaḥ sam apsu-jit marutvān indra sat-pate
ūrjā devān avasi ojasā tvām piba somam madāya kam śatakrato itiśata-krato yam te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pr̥tanāḥ uru jrayaḥ sam apsu-jit marutvān indra sat-pate
janitā divaḥ janitā pr̥thivyāḥ piba somam madāya kam śatakrato itiśata-krato yam te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pr̥tanāḥ uru jrayaḥ sam apsu-jit marutvān indra sat-pate
janitā aśvānām janitā gavām asipiba somam madāya kam śatakrato itiśata-krato yam te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pr̥tanāḥ uru jrayaḥ sam apsu-jit marutvān indra sat-pate
atrīṇām stomam adri-vaḥ mahaḥ kr̥dhi piba somam madāya kam śatakrato itiśata-krato yam te bhāgam adhārayan viśvāḥ sehānaḥ pr̥tanāḥ uru jrayaḥ sam apsu-jit marutvān indra sat-pate
śyāva-aśvasya sunvataḥ tathā śr̥ṇu yathā aśr̥ṇoḥ atreḥ karmāṇi kr̥ṇvataḥ pra trasadasyum āvitha tvam ekaḥ it nr̥-sahye indra brahmāṇi vardhayan
pra idam brahma vr̥tra-tūryeṣu āvitha pra sunvataḥ śacī-pate indra viśvābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ mādhyandinasya savanasya vr̥tra-han anedya piba somasya vajri-vaḥ
sehānaḥ ugra pr̥tanāḥ abhi druhaḥ śacī-pate indra viśvābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ mādhyandinasya savanasya vr̥tra-han anedya piba somasya vajr i-vaḥ
eka-rāṭ asya bhuvanasya rājasi śacī-pate indra viśvābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ mādhyandinasya savanasya vr̥tra-han anedya piba somasya vajri--vaḥ
sa-sthāvānā yavayasi tvam ekaḥ it śacī-pate indra viśvābhiḥ ūti-bh iḥ mādhyandinasya savanasya vr̥tra-han anedya piba somasya vajri-vaḥ
kṣemasya ca pra-yujaḥ ca tvam īśiṣe śacī-pate indra viśvābhiḥ ūti--bhiḥ mādhyandinasya savanasya vr̥tra-han anedya piba somasya vajri-vaḥ
kṣatrāya tvam avasi na tvam āvitha śacī-pate indra viśvābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ mādhyandinasya savanasya vr̥tra-han anedya piba somasya vajri-vaḥ
śyāva-aśvasya rebhataḥ tathā śr̥ṇu yathā aśr̥ṇoḥ atreḥ karmāṇi kr̥ṇvataḥ pra trasadasyum āvitha tvam ekaḥ it nr̥-sahye indra brahmāṇi vardhayan
yajñasya hi sthaḥ r̥tvijā sasnī iti vājeṣu karmasu indrāgnī iti tasya bodhatam
toṣāsā ratha-yāvānā vr̥tra-hanā aparājitā indrāgnī iti tasya bodhatam
idam vām madiram madhu adhukṣan adri-bhiḥ naraḥ indrāgnī iti tasya bodhatam
juṣethām yajñam iṣṭaye sutam somam sadhastutī itisadha-stutī indrāgnī iti ā gatam narā
imā juṣethām savanā yebhiḥ havyāni ūhathuḥ indrāgnī iti ā gatam narā
imām gāyatra-vartanim juṣethām su-stutim mama indrāgnī iti ā gatam narā
prātaryāva-bhiḥ ā gatam devebhiḥ jenyāvasūiti indrāgnī iti soma-pītaye
śyāva-aśvasya sunvataḥ atrīṇām śr̥ṇutam havam indrāgnī iti soma-pītaye
eva vām ahve ūtaye yathā ahuvanta medhirāḥ indrāgnī iti soma-pītaye
ā aham sarasvatī-vatoḥ indrāgnyoḥ avaḥ vr̥ṇe yābhyām gāyatram r̥cyate
agnim astoṣi r̥gmiyam agnim īl̥ā yajadhyai agniḥ devān anaktu naḥ ubhe iti hi vidatheiti kaviḥ antariti carati dūtyam nabhantām anyake same
ni agne navyasā vacaḥ tanūṣu śaṁsam eṣām ni arātīḥ rarāvṇām viśvāḥ aryaḥ arātīḥ itaḥ yucchantu āmuraḥ nabhantām anyake same
agne manmāni tubhyam kam ghr̥tam na juhve āsani saḥ deveṣu pra ciki ddhi tvam hi asi pūrvyaḥ śivaḥ dūtaḥ vivasvataḥ nabhantām anyake same
tat-tat agniḥ vayaḥ dadhe yathāyathā kr̥paṇyati ūrjāāhutiḥ vasūnām śam ca yoḥ ca mayaḥ dadheviśvasyai devahūtyai nabhantām anyake same
saḥ ciketa sahīyasā agniḥ citreṇa karmaṇā saḥ hotā śaśvatīnām dakṣiṇābhiḥ abhi-vr̥taḥ inoti ca pratīvyam nabhantām anyake same
agniḥ jātā devānām agniḥ veda martānām apīcyam agniḥ saḥ draviṇaḥ-dāḥ agniḥ dvārā vi ūrṇute su-āhutaḥ navīyasā nabhantām anyake same
agniḥ deveṣu sam-vasuḥ saḥ vikṣu yajñiyāsu ā saḥ mudā kāvyā puru viśvam bhūma-iva puṣyati devaḥ deveṣu yajñiyaḥ nabhantām anyake same
yaḥ agniḥ sapta-mānuṣaḥ śritaḥ viśveṣu sindhuṣu tam ā aganma tri--pastyam mandhātuḥ dasyuhan-tamam agnim yajñeṣu pūrvyam nabhantām anyake same
agniḥ trīṇi tri-dhātūni ā kṣeti vidathā kaviḥ saḥ trīn ekādaśān iha yakṣat ca piprayat ca naḥ vipraḥ dūtaḥ pari-kr̥taḥ nabhantām anyake same
tvam naḥ agne āyuṣu tvam deveṣu pūrvya vasvaḥ ekaḥ irajyasi tvām āpaḥ pari-srutaḥ pari yanti sva-setavaḥ nabhantām anyake same
indrāgnī iti yuvam su naḥ sahantā dāsathaḥ rayim yena dr̥l̥hā samat-su ā vīl̥u cit sahiṣīmahi agniḥ vanāiva vāte it nabhantām anyake same
nahi vām vavrayāmahe atha indram it yajāmahe śaviṣṭham nr̥ṇām naram saḥ naḥ kadā cit arvatā gamat ā vāja-sātaye gamat ā medha-sātaye nabhantām anyake same
tā hi madhyam bharāṇām indrāgnī iti adhi-kṣitaḥ tā oṁ iti kavi-tvanā kavī iti pr̥cchyamānā sakhī-yate sam dhītam aśnutam narā nabhantām anyake same
abhi arca nabhāka-vat indrāgnī iti yajasā girā yayoḥ viśvam idam jagat iyam dyauḥ pr̥thivī mahī upa-sthe bibhr̥taḥ vasu nabhantām anyake same
pra brahmāṇi nabhāka-vat indrāgni-bhyām irajyata yā sapta-budhnam arṇavam jihma-bāram apa-ūrṇutaḥ indraḥ īśānaḥ ojasā nabhantām anyake same
api vr̥śca purāṇa-vat vratateḥ-iva guṣpitam ojaḥ dāsasya dambhaya vayam tat asya sam-bhr̥tam vasu indreṇa vi bhajemahi nabhantām anyake same
yat indrāgnī iti janāḥ ime vi-hvayante tanā girā asmākebhiḥ nr̥-bhiḥ vayam sasahyāma pr̥tanyataḥ vanuyāma vanuṣyataḥ nabhantām anyake same
yā nu śvetau avaḥ divaḥ ut-carātaḥ upa dyu-bhiḥ indrāgnyoḥ anu vratam uhānāḥ yanti sindhavaḥ yān sīm bandhāt amuñcatām nabhantām anyake same
pūrvīḥ te indra upa-mātayaḥ pūrvīḥ uta pra-śastayaḥ sūno iti hinvasya hari-vaḥ vasvaḥ vīrasya āpr̥caḥ yā nu sādhanta naḥ dhiyaḥ nabhantām anyake same
tam śiśīta suvr̥kti-bhiḥ tveṣam satvānam r̥gmiyam uto iti nu cit yaḥ ojasā śuṣṇasya āṇḍāni bhedati jeṣat svaḥ-vatīḥ apaḥ nabhantām anyake same
tam śiśīta su-adhvaram satyam satvānam r̥gmiyam uto iti nu cit yaḥ ojasā śuṣṇasya āṇḍāni bhedati jeṣat svaḥ-vatīḥ apaḥ nabhantām anyake same
eva indrāgni-bhyām pitr̥-vat navīyaḥ mandhātr̥-vat aṅgirasvat avāci tri-dhātunā śarmaṇā pātam asmān vayam syāma patayaḥ rayīṇām
asmai oṁ iti su pra-bhūtaye varuṇāya marut-bhyaḥ arca viduḥ-tarebhyaḥ yaḥ dhītā mānuṣāṇām paśvaḥ gāḥ-iva rakṣati nabhantām anyake same
tam oṁ iti su samanā girā pitr̥r̥ṇām ca manma-bhiḥ nābhākasya prasasti-bhiḥ yaḥ sindhūnām upa ut-aye sapta-svasā saḥ madhyamaḥ nabhantām anyake same
saḥ kṣapaḥ pari sasvaje ni usraḥ māyayā dadhe saḥ viśvam pari darśataḥ tasya venīḥ anu vratam uṣaḥ tisraḥ avardhayan nabhantām anyake same
yaḥ kakubhaḥ ni-dhārayaḥ pr̥thivyām adhi darśataḥ saḥ mātā pūrvyam padam tat varuṇasya saptyam saḥ hi gopāḥ-iva iryaḥ nabhantām anyake same
yaḥ dhartā bhuvanānām yaḥ usrāṇām apīcyā veda nāmāni guhyā saḥ kaviḥ kāvyā puru rūpam dyauḥ-iva puṣyati nabhantām anyake same
yasmin viśvāni kāvyā cakre nābhiḥ-iva śritā tritam jūtī saparyata vraje gāvaḥ na sam-yuje yuje aśvāmn ayukṣata nabhantām anyake same
yaḥ āsu atkaḥ āśaye viśvā jātāni eṣām pari dhāmāni marmr̥śat varuṇasya puraḥ gayaḥ viśve devāḥ anu vratam nabhantām anyake same
saḥ samudraḥ apīcyaḥ turaḥ dyām-iva rohati ni yat āsu yajuḥ dadhe saḥ māyāḥ arcinā padā astr̥ṇāt nākam ā aruhat nabhantām anyake same
yasya śvetā vi-cakṣaṇā tisraḥ bhūmīḥ adhi-kṣitaḥ triḥ ut-tarāṇi papratuḥ varuṇasya dhruvam sadaḥ saḥ saptānām irajyati nabhantām anyake same
yaḥ śvetān adhi-nirnijaḥ cakre kr̥ṣṇān anu vratā saḥ dhāma pūrvyam mame yaḥ skambhena vi rodasī iti ajaḥ na dyām adhārayat nabhantām anyake same
astabhnāt dyām asuraḥ viśva-vedāḥ amimīta varimāṇam pr̥thivyāḥ ā asīdat viśvā bhuvanāni sam-rāṭ viśvā it tāni varuṇasya vratāni
eva vandasva varuṇam br̥hantam namasya dhīram amr̥tasya gopām saḥ naḥ śarma tri-varūtham vi yaṁsat patam naḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti upa-sthe
imām dhiyam śikṣamāṇasya deva kratum dakṣam varuṇa sam śiśādhi yayā ati viśvā duḥ-itā tarema su-tarmāṇam adhi nāvam ruhema
ā vām grāvāṇaḥ aśvinā dhībhiḥ viprāḥ acucyavuḥ nāsatyā soma-pītaye nabhantām anyake same
yathā vām atriḥ aśvinā gīḥ-bhiḥ vipraḥ ajohavīt nāsatyā soma-pītaye nabhantām anyake same
eva vām ahve ūtaye yathā ahuvanta medhirāḥ nāsatyā soma-pītaye nabhantām anyake same
ime viprasya vedhasaḥ agneḥ astr̥ta-yajvanaḥ giraḥ stomāsaḥ īrate
asmai te prati-haryate jāta-vedaḥ vi-carṣaṇe agne janāmi su-stutim
ārokāḥ-iva gha it aha tigmāḥ agne tava tviṣaḥ dat-bhiḥ vanāni bapsati
harayaḥ dhūma-ketavaḥ vāta-jūtāḥ upa dyavi yatante vr̥thak agnayaḥ
ete tye vr̥thak agnayaḥ iddhāsaḥ sam adr̥kṣata uṣasām-iva ketavaḥ
kr̥ṣṇā rajāṁsi patsutaḥ pra-yāṇe jāta-vedasaḥ agniḥ yat rodhati kṣam i
dhāsim kr̥ṇvānaḥ oṣadhīḥ bapsat agniḥ na vāyati punaḥ yan taruṇīḥ api
jihvābhiḥ aha nannamat arciṣā jañjaṇābhavan agniḥ vaneṣu rocate
ap-su agne sadhiḥ tava saḥ oṣadhīḥ anu rudhyase garbhe san jāyase punariti
ut agne tava tat ghr̥tāt arciḥ rocate āhutam niṁsānam juhvaḥ mukhe
ukṣa-annāya vaśāannāya soma-pr̥ṣṭhāya vedhase stomaiḥ vidhema agnaye
uta tvā namasā vayam hotaḥ vareṇyakrato itivareṇya-krato agne samit-bhiḥ īmahe
uta tvā bhr̥gu-vat śuce manuṣvat agne āhuta aṅgirasvat havāmahe
tvam hi agne agninā vipraḥ vipreṇa san satā sakhā sakhyā sam-idhyase
saḥ tvam viprāya dāśuṣe rayim dehi sahasriṇam agne vīra-vatīm iṣam
agne bhrātariti sahaḥ-kr̥ta rohit-aśva śuci-vrata imam stomam juṣasva me
uta tvā agne mama stutaḥ vāśrāya prati-haryate go--stham gāvaḥ-iva āśata
tubhyam tāḥ aṅgiraḥ-tama viśvāḥ su-kṣitayaḥ pr̥thak agne kāmāya yemire
agnim dhībhiḥ manīṣiṇaḥ medhirāsaḥ vipaḥ-citaḥ adma-sadyāya hinvire
tam tvām ajmeṣu vājinam tanvānāḥ agne adhvaram vahnim hotāram īl̥ate
puru-trā hi sadr̥ṅ asi viśaḥ viśvāḥ anu pra-bhuḥ samat-su tvā havāmahe
tam īl̥iṣva yaḥ āhutaḥ agniḥ vi-bhrājate ghr̥taiḥ imam naḥ śr̥ṇavat havam
tam tvā vayam havāmahe śr̥ṇvantam jāta-vedasam agne ghnantam apa dviṣaḥ
viśām rājānam adbhutam adhi-akṣam dharmaṇām imam agnim īl̥e saḥ oṁ iti śravat
agnim viśvāyu-vepasam maryam na vājinam hitam saptim na vājayāmasi
ghnan mr̥dhrāṇi apa dviṣaḥ dahan rakṣāṁsi viśvahā agne tigmena dīdi hi
yam tvā janāsaḥ indhate manuṣvat aṅgiraḥ-tama agne saḥ bodhi me vacaḥ
yat agne divi-jāḥ asi apsu-jāḥ vā sahaḥ-kr̥ta tam tvā gīḥ-bhiḥ havāmahe
tubhyam gha it te janāḥ ime viśvāḥ su-kṣitayaḥ pr̥thak dhāsim hinvanti attave
te gha it agne su-ādhyaḥ ahā viśvā nr̥-cakṣasaḥ tarantaḥ syāma duḥ-gahā
agnim mandram puru-priyam śīram pāvaka-śociṣam hr̥t-bhiḥ mandrebhiḥ īmahe
saḥ tvam agne vibhāvasuḥ sr̥jan sūryaḥ na raśmi-bhiḥ śardhan tamāṁsi jighnase
tat te sahasvaḥ īmahe dātram yat na upa-dasyati tvat agne vāyarm vasu
sam-idhā agnim duvasyata ghr̥taiḥ bodhayata atithim ā asmin havyā juhotana
agne stomam juṣasva me vardhasva anena manmanā prati su-uktāni harya naḥ
agnim dūtam puraḥ dadhe havya-vāham upa bruve devān ā sādayāt iha
ut te br̥hantaḥ arcayaḥ sam-idhānasya dīdi-vaḥ agne śukrāsaḥ īrate
upa tvā juhvaḥ mama ghr̥tācīḥ yantu haryata agne havyā juṣasva naḥ
mandram hotāram r̥tvijam citra-bhānum vibhāvasum agnim īl̥e saḥ oṁ iti śravat
pratnam hotāram īḍyam juṣṭam agnim kavi-kratum adhvarāṇām abhi-śriyam
juṣāṇaḥ aṅgiraḥ-tama imā havyāni ānuṣak agne yajñam naya r̥tu-thā
sam-idhānaḥ oṁ iti santya śukra-śoce iha ā vaha cikitvān daivyam janam
vipram hotāram adruham dhūma-ketum vibhāvasum yajñānām ketum īmahe
agne ni pāhi naḥ tvam prati sma deva riṣataḥ bhindhi dveṣaḥ sahaḥ-kr̥ta
agniḥ pratnena manmanā śumbhānaḥ tanvam svām kaviḥ vipreṇa vavr̥dhe
ūrjaḥ napātam ā huve agnim pāvaka-śociṣam asmin yajñe su-adhvare
saḥ naḥ mitra-mahaḥ tvam agne śukreṇa śociṣā devaiḥ ā satsi barhi ṣi
yaḥ agnim tanvaḥ dame devam martaḥ saparyati tasmai it dīdayat vasu
agniḥ mūrdhā divaḥ kakut patiḥ pr̥thivyāḥ ayam apām retāṁsi jinvati
ut agne śucayaḥ tava śukrāḥ bhrājantaḥ īrate tava jyotīṁṣi arcayaḥ
īśiṣe vāryasya hi dātrasya agne svaḥ-patiḥ stotā syām tava śamarṇi
tvām agne manīṣiṇaḥ tvām hinvanti citti-bhiḥ tvām vardhantu naḥ g iraḥ
adabdhasya svadhāvataḥ dūtasya rebhataḥ sadā agneḥ sakhyam vr̥ṇīmahe
agniḥ śucivrata-tamaḥ śuciḥ vipraḥ śuciḥ kaviḥ śuciḥ rocate āhutaḥ
uta tvā dhītayaḥ mama giraḥ vr̥dhantu visvahā agne sakhyasya bodhi naḥ
yat agne syām aham tvam tvam vā gha syāḥ aham syuḥ te satyāḥ iha āśiṣaḥ
vasuḥ vasu-patiḥ hi kam asi agne vibhāvasuḥ syāma te su-matau api
agne dhr̥ta-vratāya te samudrāya-iva sindhavaḥ giraḥ vāśrāsaḥ īrate
yuvānam viśpatim kavim viśva-adam puru-vepasam agnim śumbhāmi manma-bhiḥ
yajñānām rathye vayam tigma-jambhāya vīl̥ave stomaiḥ iṣema agnaye
ayam agne tve iti api jaritā bhūtu santya tasmai pāvaka mr̥l̥aya
dhīraḥ hi asi adma-sat vipraḥ na jāgr̥viḥ sadā agne dīdayasi dyavi
purā agne duḥ-itebhyaḥ purā mr̥dhrebhyaḥ kave pra naḥ āyuḥ vaso iti tira
ā gha ye agnim indhate str̥ṇanti barhiḥ ānuṣak yeṣām indraḥ yuvā sakhā
br̥han it idhmaḥ eṣām bhūri śastam pr̥thu svaruḥ yeṣām indraḥ yuvā sakhā
ayuddhaḥ it yudhā vr̥tam śūraḥ ā ajati satva-bhiḥ yeṣām indraḥ yuvā sakhā
ā bundam vr̥tra-hā dade jātaḥ pr̥cchat vi mātaram ke ugrāḥ ke ha śr̥ṇvire
prati tvā śavasī vadat ghirau apsaḥ na yodhiṣat yaḥ te śatru-tvam ācake
uta tvam magha-van śr̥ṇu yaḥ te vaṣṭi vavakṣi tat yat vīl̥ayāsi vīl̥u tat
yat ājim yāti āji-kr̥t indraḥ svaśva-yuḥ upa rathi-tamaḥ rathīnām
vi su viśvāḥ abhi-yujaḥ vajrin viṣvak yathā vr̥ha bhava naḥ suśravaḥ-tamaḥ
asmākam su ratham puraḥ indraḥ kr̥ṇotu sātaye na yam dhūrvanti dhūtaryaḥ
vr̥jyāma te pari dviṣaḥ aram te śakra dāvane gamema it indra go--mataḥ
śanaiḥ cit yantaḥ adri-vaḥ aśva-vantaḥ śata-gvinaḥ vivakṣaṇāḥ anehasaḥ
ūrdhvā hi te dive--dive sahasrā sūnr̥tā śatā jaritr̥-bhyaḥ vi-maṁhate
vidma hi tvā dhanam-jayam indra dr̥l̥hā cit ārujam ādāriṇam yathā gayam
kakuham cit tvā kave mandantu dhr̥ṣṇo iti indavaḥ ā tvā paṇim yat īmahe
yaḥ te revān adāśuriḥ pra-mamarṣa maghattaye tasya naḥ vedaḥ ā bhara
ime oṁ iti tvā vi cakṣate sakhāyaḥ indra sominaḥ puṣṭa-vantaḥ yathā paśum
uta tvā abadhiram vayam śrut-karṇam santam ūtaye dūrāt iha havāmahe
yat śuśrūyāḥ imam havam duḥ-marṣam cakriyāḥ uta bhaveḥ āpiḥ naḥ antamaḥ
yat cit hi te api vyathiḥ jaganvāṁsaḥ amanmahi go--dāḥ it indra bodhi naḥ
ā tvā rambham na jivrayaḥ rarabhma śavasaḥ pate uśmasi tvā sadha-sthe ā
stotram indrāya gāyata puru-nr̥mṇāya satvane nakiḥ yam vr̥ṇvate yudhi
abhi tvā vr̥ṣabha sute sutam sr̥jāmi pītaye tr̥mpa vi aśnuhi madam
mā tvā mūrāḥ aviṣyavaḥ mā upa-hasvānaḥ ā dabhan mākīm brahma-dviṣaḥ vanaḥ
iha tvā go--parīṇasā mahe mandantu rādhase saraḥ gauraḥ yathā piba
yā vr̥tra-hā parāvati sanā navā ca cucyuve tā saṁsat-su pra vocata
apibat kadruvaḥ sutam indraḥ sahasra-bāhve atra adediṣṭa paiṁsyam
satyam tat turvaśe yadau vidānaḥ ahnavāyyam vi ānaṭ turvaṇe śami
taraṇim vaḥ janānām tradam vājasya go--mataḥ samānam oṁ iti pra śaṁsiṣam
r̥bhukṣaṇam na vartave uktheṣu tugrya-vr̥dham indram some sacā sute
yaḥ kr̥ntat it vi yonyam tri-śokāya girim pr̥thum go--bhyaḥ gātum niḥ-etave
yat dadhiṣe manasyasi mandānaḥ pra it iyakṣasi mā tat kaḥ indra mr̥l̥aya
dabhram cit hi tvāvataḥ kr̥tam śr̥ṇve adhi kṣami jigātu indra te manaḥ
tava it oṁ iti tāḥ su-kīrtayaḥ asan uta pra-śastayaḥ yat indra mr̥l̥ayāsi naḥ
mā naḥ ekasmin āgasi mā dvayoḥ uta triṣu vadhīḥ mā śūra bhūriṣu
bibhaya hi tvāvataḥ ugrāt abhi-prabhaṅgiṇaḥ dasmāt aham r̥ti-sahaḥ
mā sakhyuḥ śūnam ā vide mā putrasya prabhuvaso itiprabhu-vaso āvr̥tvat bhūtu te manaḥ
kaḥ nu maryāḥ amithitaḥ sakhā sakhāyam abravīt jahā kaḥ asmat īṣate
evāre vr̥ṣabha sute asinvan bhūri āvayaḥ śvaghnī-iva ni-vatā caran
ā te etā vacaḥ-yujā harī iti gr̥bhṇe samat-rathā yat īm brahma-bhyaḥ it dadaḥ
bhindhi viśvāḥ apaḥ dviṣaḥ pari bādhaḥ jahi mr̥dhaḥ vasu spārham tat ā bhara
yat vīl̥au indra yat sthire yat parśāne parābhr̥tam vasu spārham tat ā bhara
yasya te viśva-mānuṣaḥ bhūreḥ dattasya vedati vasu spārham tat ā bhara
tvāvataḥ puruvaso itipuru-vaso vayam indra pranetaritipra-netaḥ smasi sthātaḥ harīṇām
tvām hi satyam adri-vaḥ vidma dātāram iṣām vidma dātāram rayīṇām
ā yasya te mahimānam śatam-ūte śatakrato itiśata-krato gīḥ-bhiḥ gr̥ṇanti kāravaḥ
su-nīthaḥ gha saḥ martyaḥ yam marutaḥ yam aryamā mitraḥ pānti adruhaḥ
dadhānaḥ go--mat aśva-vat su-vīryam āditya-jūtaḥ edhate sadā rāyā puru-spr̥hā
tam indram dānam īmahe śavasānam abhīrvam īśānam rāyaḥ īmahe
tasmin hi santi ūtayaḥ viśvāḥ abhīravaḥ sacā tam ā vahantu saptayaḥ puru-vasum madāya harayaḥ sutam
yaḥ te madaḥ vareṇyaḥ yaḥ indra vr̥trahan-tamaḥ yaḥ ādadiḥ svaḥ nr̥-bhiḥ yaḥ pr̥tanāsu dustaraḥ
yaḥ dustaraḥ viśva-vāra śravāyyaḥ vājeṣu asti tarutā saḥ naḥ śaviṣṭha savanā ā vaso iti gahi gamema go--mati vraje
gavyaḥ su ṇaḥ yathā purā aśva-yā uta ratha-yā varivasya mahāmaha
nahi te śūra rādhasaḥ antam vindāmi satrā daśasya naḥ magha-van nu cit adri-vaḥ dhiyaḥ vājebhiḥ āvitha
yaḥ r̥ṣvaḥ śravayat-sakhā viśvā it saḥ veda janima puru-stutaḥ tam viśve mānuṣā yugā indram havante taviṣam yata-srucaḥ
saḥ naḥ vājeṣu avitā puru-vasuḥ puraḥ-sthātā magha-vā vr̥tra-hā bhuvat
abhi vaḥ vīram andhasaḥ madeṣu gāya girā mahā vi-cetasam indram nāma śrutyam śākinam vacaḥ yathā
dadiḥ rekṇaḥ tanve dadiḥ vasu dadiḥ vājeṣu puru-hūta vājinam nūnam atha
viśveṣām irajyantam vasūnām sasahvāṁsam cit asya varpasaḥ kr̥pa-yataḥ nūnam ati atha
mahaḥ su vaḥ aram iṣe stavāmahe mīl̥huṣe aram-gamāya jagmaye yajñebhiḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ viśva-manuṣām marutām iyakṣasi gāye tvā namasā gi rā
ye pātayante ajma-bhiḥ girīṇām snu-bhiḥ eṣām yajñam mahi-svaṇīnām sumnam tuvi-svaṇīnām pra adhvare
pra-bhaṅgam duḥ-matīnām indra śaviṣṭha ā bhara rayim asmabhyam yujyam codayat-mate jyeṣṭham codayat-mate
sanitariti / su-sanitaḥ ugra citra cetiṣṭha sūnr̥ta pra-sahā sam-rāṭ sahurim sahantam bhujyum vājeṣu pūrvyam
ā saḥ etu yaḥ īvat ā adevaḥ pūrtam ādade yathā cit vaśaḥ aśvyaḥ pr̥thu-śravasi kānīte asyāḥ vi-uṣi ādade
ṣaṣṭim sahasrā aśvyasya ayutā asanam uṣṭrānām viṁśatim śatā daśa śyāvīnām śatā daśa tri-aruṣīṇām daśa gavām sahasrā
daśa śyāvāḥ r̥dhat-rayaḥ vīta-vārāsaḥ āśavaḥ mathrāḥ nemim ni vavr̥tuḥ
dānāsaḥ pr̥thu-śravasaḥ kānītasya su-rādhasaḥ ratham hiraṇyayam dadat maṁhiṣṭhaḥ sūriḥ abhūt varṣiṣṭham akr̥ta śravaḥ
ā naḥ vāyo iti mahe tane yāhi makhāya pājase vayam hi te cakr̥ma bhūri dāvane sadyaḥ cit mahi dāvane
yaḥ aśvebhiḥ vahate vaste usrāḥ triḥ sapta saptatīnām ebhiḥ somebhiḥ somasut-bhiḥ soma-pāḥ dānāya śukrapūta-pāḥ
yaḥ me imam cit oṁ iti tmanā amandat citram dāvane araṭave akṣe nahuṣe su-kr̥tvani sukr̥t-tarāya su-kratuḥ
iti ghr̥ta-snāḥ aśva-iṣitam rajaḥ-iṣitam śunāiṣitam pra ajma tat idam nu tat
agha priyam iṣirāya ṣaṣṭim sahasrā asanam aśvānām it na vr̥ṣṇām
gāvaḥ na yūtham upa yanti vadhrayaḥ upa mā yanti vadhrayaḥ
adha yat cārathe gaṇe śatam uṣṭrān acikradat adha śvitneṣu viṁśatim śatā
śatam dāse balbūthe vipraḥ tarukṣe ā dade te te vāyo iti ime janāḥ madanti indra-gopāḥ madanti deva-gopāḥ
adha syā yoṣaṇā mahī pratīcī vaśam aśvyam adhi-rukmā vi nīyate
mahi vaḥ mahatām avaḥ varuṇa mitra dāśuṣe yam ādityāḥ abhi druhaḥ rakṣatha na īm agham naśat anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
vida devāḥ aghānām ādityāsaḥ apa-ākr̥tim pakṣā vayaḥ yathā upari vi asme iti śarma yacchata anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
vi asme iti adhi śarma tat pakṣā vayaḥ na yantana viśvāni viśva-vedasaḥ varūthyā manāmahe anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
yasmai arāsata kṣayam jīvātum ca pra-cetasaḥ manoḥ viśvasya gha it ime ādityāḥ rāyaḥ īśate anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
pari naḥ vr̥ṇajan aghā duḥ-gāṇi rathyaḥ yathā syāma it indrasya śarmaṇi ādityānām uta avasi anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
pari-hvr̥tā it anā janaḥ yuṣmādattasya vāyati devāḥ adabhram āśa vaḥ yam ādityāḥ ahetana anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
na tam tigmam cana tyajaḥ na drāsat abhi tam guru yasmai oṁ iti śarma sa-prathaḥ ādityāsaḥ arādhvam anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
yuṣme iti devāḥ api smasi yudhyantaḥ-iva varmasu yūyam mahaḥ naḥ enasaḥ yūyam arbhāt uruṣyata anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
aditiḥ naḥ uruṣyatu aditiḥ śarma yacchatu mātā mitrasya revataḥ ayarmṇaḥ varuṇasya ca anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
yat devāḥ śarma śaraṇam yat bhadram yat anāturam tri-dhātu yat varūthyam tat asmāsu vi yantana anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
ādityāḥ ava hi khyata adhi kūlāt-iva spaśaḥ su-tīrtham arvataḥ yathā anu naḥ neṣatha su-gam anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
na iha bhadram rakṣasvine na ava-yai na upa-yai uta gave ca bhadram dhenave vīrāya ca śravasyate anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
yat āviḥ yat apīcyam devāsaḥ asti duḥ-kr̥tam trite tat viśvam āptye āre asmat dadhātana anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
yat ca goṣu duḥ-svapnyam yat ca asme iti duhitaḥ divaḥ tritāya tat vibhāvari āptyāya parā vaha anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
niṣkam vā gha kr̥ṇavate srajam vā duhitaḥ divaḥ trite duḥ-svapnyam sarvam āptye pari dadmasi anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
tat-annāya tat-apase tam bhāgam upa-seduṣe tritāya ca dvitāya ca uṣaḥ duḥ-svapnyam vaha anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
yathā kalām yathā śapham yathā r̥ṇam sam-nayāmasi eva duḥ-svapnyam sarvam āptye sam nayāmasi anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
ajaiṣma adya asanāma ca abhūma anāgasaḥ vayam uṣaḥ yasmāt duḥ-svapnyāt abhaiṣma apa tat ucchatu anehasaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ su-ūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ
svādoḥ abhakṣi vayasaḥ su-medhāḥ su-ādhyaḥ varivovit-tarasya viśve yam devāḥ uta martyāsaḥ madhu bruvantaḥ abhi sam-caranti
antariti ca pra agāḥ aditiḥ bhavāsi ava-yātā harasaḥ daivyasya indo iti indrasya sakhyam juṣāṇaḥ śrauṣṭī-iva dhuram anu rāye r̥dhyāḥ
apāma somam amr̥tāḥ abhūma aganma jyotiḥ avidāma devān kim nūnam asmān kr̥ṇavat arāti kim oṁ iti dhūrtiḥ amr̥ta martyasya
śam naḥ bhava hr̥de ā pītaḥ indo iti pitāiva soma sūnave su-śevaḥ sakhāiva sakhye uru-śaṁsa dhīraḥ pra naḥ āyuḥ jīvase soma tārīḥ
ime mā pītāḥ yaśasaḥ uruṣyavaḥ ratham na gāvaḥ sam anāha parva-su te mā rakṣantu visrasaḥ caritrāt uta mā srāmāt yavayantu indavaḥ
agnim na mā mathitam sam didīpaḥ pra cakṣaya kr̥ṇuhi vasyasaḥ naḥ atha hi te made ā soma manye revān-iva pra cara puṣṭim accha
iṣireṇa te manasā sutasya bhakṣīmahi pitryasya-iva rāyaḥ soma rājan pra naḥ āyūṁṣi tārīḥ ahāni-iva sūryaḥ vāsarāṇi
soma rājan mr̥l̥aya naḥ svasti tava smasi vratyāḥ tasya viddhi alarti dakṣaḥ uta manyuḥ indo iti mā naḥ aryaḥ anu-kāmam parā dāḥ
tvam hi naḥ tanvaḥ soma gopāḥ gātre--gātre ni-sasattha nr̥-cakṣāḥ yat te vayam pra-mināma vratāni saḥ naḥ mr̥l̥a su-sakhā deva vasyaḥ
r̥dūdareṇa sakhyā saceya yaḥ mā na riṣyet hari-aśva pītaḥ ayam yaḥ somaḥ ni adhāyi asme iti tasmai indram pra-tiram emi āyuḥ
apa tyāḥ asthuḥ anirāḥ amīvāḥ niḥ atrasan tamiṣīcīḥ abhaiṣuḥ ā somaḥ asmān aruhat vi-hāyāḥ aganma yatra pra-tirante āyuḥ
yaḥ naḥ induḥ pitaraḥ hr̥t-su pītaḥ amartyaḥ martyān āviveśa tasmai somāya haviṣā vidhema mr̥l̥īke asya su-matau syāma
tvam soma pitr̥-bhiḥ sam-vidānaḥ anu dyāvāpr̥thivī iti ā tatantha tasmai te indo iti haviṣā vidhema vayam syāma patayaḥ rayīṇām
trātāraḥ devāḥ adhi vocata naḥ mā naḥ ni-drā īśata mā uta jalpiḥ vayam somasya viśvaha priyāsaḥ su-vīrāsaḥ vidatham ā vadema
tvam naḥ soma viśvataḥ vayaḥ-dhāḥ tvam svaḥ-vit ā viśa nr̥-cakṣāḥ tvam naḥ indo iti ūti-bhiḥ sa-joṣāḥ pāhi paścātāt uta vā purastāt
abhi pra vaḥ su-rādhasam indram arca yathā vide yaḥ jaritr̥-bhyaḥ magha-vā puru-vasuḥ sahasreṇa-iva śikṣati
śatānīkāiva pra jigāti dhr̥ṣṇu-yā hanti vr̥trāṇi dāśuṣe gireḥ-iva pra rasāḥ asya pinvire datrāṇi puru-bhojasaḥ
ā tvā sutāsaḥ indavaḥ madāḥ ye indra girvaṇaḥ āpaḥ na vajrin anu okyam saraḥ pr̥ṇanti śūra rādhase
anehasam pra-taraṇam vivakṣaṇam madhvaḥ svādiṣṭham īm piba ā yathā mandasānaḥ kirāsi naḥ pra kṣudrāiva tmanā dhr̥ṣat
ā naḥ stomam upa dravat hiyānaḥ aśvaḥ na sotr̥-bhiḥ yam te svadhāvan svadayanti dhenavaḥ indra kaṇveṣu rātayaḥ
ugram na vīram namasā upa sedima vi-bhūtim akṣita-vasum udrī-iva vajrin avataḥ na siñcate kṣaranti indra dhītayaḥ
yat ha nūnam yat vā yajñe yat vā pr̥thivyām adhi ataḥ naḥ yajñam āśu-bhiḥ mahe--mate ugraḥ ugrebhiḥ ā gahi
ajirāsaḥ harayaḥ ye te āśavaḥ vātāḥ-iva pra-sakṣiṇaḥ yebhiḥ apatyam manuṣaḥ pari-īyase yebhiḥ viśvam svaḥ dr̥śe
etāvataḥ te īmahe indra sumnasya go--mataḥ yathā pra āvaḥ magha-van medhya-atithim yathā nīpa-atithim dhane
yathā kaṇve magha-van trasadasyavi yathā pakthe daśa-vraje yathā go--śarye asanoḥ r̥jiśvani indra go--mat hiraṇya-vat
pra su śrutam su-rādhasam arca śakram abhiṣṭaye yaḥ sunvate stuvate kāmyam vasu sahasreṇa-iva maṁhate
śata-anīkāḥ hetayaḥ asya dustarāḥ indrasya sam-iṣaḥ mahīḥ gir iḥ na bhujmā maghavat-su pinvate yat īm sutāḥ amandiṣuḥ
yat īm sutāsaḥ indavaḥ abhi priyam amandiṣuḥ āpaḥ na dhāyi savanam me ā vaso iti dughāiva upa dāśuṣe
anehasam vaḥ havamānam ūtaye madhvaḥ kṣaranti dhītayaḥ ā tvā vaso iti havamānāsaḥ indavaḥ upa stotreṣu dadhire
ā naḥ some su-adhvare iyānaḥ atyaḥ na tośate yam te svadāvan svadanti gūrtyaḥ paure chandayase havam
pra vīram ugram vivicim dhana-spr̥tam vi-bhūtim rādhasaḥ mahaḥ udrī-iva vajrin avataḥ vasu-tvanā sadā pīpetha dāśuṣe
yat ha nūnam parāvati yat vā pr̥thivyām divi yujānaḥ indra hari-bhiḥ mahe--mate r̥ṣvaḥ r̥ṣvebhiḥ ā gahi
rathirāsaḥ harayaḥ ye te asridhaḥ ojaḥ vātasya piprati yebhiḥ ni dasyum manuṣaḥ ni-ghoṣayaḥ yebhiḥ svar iti svaḥ pari-īyase
etāvataḥ te vaso iti vidyāma śūra navyasaḥ yathā pra āvaḥ etaśam kr̥tvye dhane yathā vaśam daśa-vraje
yathā kaṇve magha-van medhe adhvare dīrgha-nīthe damūnasi yathā go--śarye asisāsaḥ adri-vaḥ mayi gotram hari-śriyam
yathā manau sām-varaṇau somam indra apibaḥ sutam nīpa-atithau magha-van medhya-atithau puṣṭi-gau śruṣṭi-gau sacā
pārṣadvāṇaḥ praskaṇvam sam asādayat śayānam jivrim uddhitam sahasrāṇi asisāsat gavām r̥ṣiḥ tvāūtaḥ dasyave vr̥kaḥ
yaḥ ukthebhiḥ na vindhate cikit yaḥ r̥ṣi-codanaḥ indram tam accha vada navyasyā matī ariṣyantam na bhojase
yasmai arkam sapta-śīrṣāṇam ānr̥cuḥ tri-dhātum ut-tame pade saḥ tu imā viśvā bhuvanāni cikradat āt it janiṣṭa paiṁsyam
yaḥ naḥ dātā vasūnām indram tam hūmahe vayam vidma hi asya su-matim navīyasīm ghamema go--mati vraje
yasmai tvam vaso iti dānāya śikṣasi saḥ rāyaḥ poṣam aśnute tam tvā vayam magha-van indra girvaṇaḥ suta-vantaḥ havāmahe
kadā cana starīḥ asi na indra saścasi dāśuṣe upa-upa it nu magha-van bhūyaḥ it nu te dānam devasya pr̥cyate
pra yaḥ nanakṣe abhi ojasā krivim vadhaiḥ śuṣṇam ni-ghoṣayan yadā it astambhīt prathayan amūm divam āt it janiṣṭa pārthivaḥ
yasya ayam viśvaḥ āryaḥ dāsaḥ śevadhi-pāḥ ariḥ tiraḥ cit arye ruśame pavīravi tubhya it saḥ ajyate rayiḥ
turaṇyavaḥ madhu-mantam ghr̥ta-ścutam viprāsaḥ arkam ānr̥cuḥ asme iti rayiḥ paprathe vr̥ṣṇyam śavaḥ asme iti suvānāsaḥ indavaḥ
yathā manau vivasvati somam śakra apibaḥ sutam yathā trite chandaḥ indra jujoṣasi āyau mādayase sacā
pr̥ṣadhre medhye mātariśvani indra suvāne amandathāḥ yathā somam daśa-śipre daśa-oṇye syūma-raśmau r̥jūnasi
yaḥ ukthā kevalā dadhe yaḥ somam dhr̥ṣitā apibat yasmai viṣṇuḥ trīṇi padā vi-cakrame upa mitrasya dharma-bhiḥ
yasya tvam indra stomeṣu cākanaḥ vāje vājin śatakrato itiśata-krato tam tvā vayam sudughām-iva go--duhaḥ juhūmasi śravasyavaḥ
yaḥ naḥ dātā saḥ naḥ pitā mahān ugraḥ īśāna-kr̥t ayāman ugraḥ magha-vā puru-vasuḥ goḥ aśvasya pra dātu naḥ
yasmai tvam vaso iti dānāya maṁhase saḥ rāyaḥ poṣam invati vasu-yavaḥ vasu-patim śata-kratum stomaiḥ indram havāmahe
kadā cana pra yucchasi ubhe iti ni pāsi janmanī iti / turīya āditya havanam te indriyam ā tasthau amr̥tam divi
yasmai tvam magha-van indra girvaṇaḥ śikṣo iti śikṣasi dāśuṣe asmākam giraḥ uta sustutim vaso iti kaṇva-vat śr̥ṇudhi havam
astāvi manma pūrvyam brahma indrāya vocata pūrvīḥ r̥tasya br̥hatīḥ anūṣata stotuḥ medhāḥ asr̥kṣata
sam indraḥ rāyaḥ br̥hatīḥ adhūnuta sam kṣoṇī iti sam oṁ iti sūryam sam śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ sam go--āśiraḥ somāḥ indram amandiṣuḥ
upa-mam tvā maghonām jyeṣṭham ca vr̥ṣabhāṇām purbhit-tamam magha-van indra go--vidam īśānam rāyaḥ īmahe
yaḥ āyum kutsam atithi-gvam ardayaḥ vavr̥dhānaḥ dive--dive tam tvā vayam hari-aśvam śata-kratum vāja-yantaḥ havāmahe
ā naḥ viśveṣām rasam madhvaḥ siñcantu adrayaḥ ye parāvati sunv ire janeṣu ā ye arvāvati indavaḥ
viśvā dveṣāṁsi jahi ca avaca ā kr̥dhi viśve sanvantu ā vasu śīṣṭeṣu cit te madirāsaḥ aṁśavaḥ yatra somasya tr̥mpasi
indra nedīyaḥ ā it ihi mita-medhābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ ā śam-tama śam-tamābhiḥ abhiṣṭi-bhiḥ ā su-āpe svāpi-bhiḥ
āji-turam sat-patim viśva-carṣaṇim kr̥dhi pra-jāsu ābhagam pra su tira śacībhiḥ ye te ukthinaḥ kratum punate ānuṣak
yaḥ te sādhiṣṭhaḥ avase te syāma bhareṣu te vayam hotrābhiḥ uta devahūti-bhiḥ sasa-vāṁsaḥ manāmahe
aham hi te hari-vaḥ brahma vāja-yuḥ ājim yāmi sadā ūti-bhiḥ tvām it eva tam ame sam aśva-yuḥ gavyuḥ agre mathīnām
etat te indra vīryam gīḥ-bhiḥ gr̥ṇanti kāravaḥ te stobhantaḥ ūrjam āvan ghr̥ta-ścutam paurāsaḥ nakṣan dhīti-bhiḥ
nakṣante indram avase su-kr̥tyayā yeṣām suteṣu mandase yathā sam-varte amadaḥ yathā kr̥śe eva asme iti indra matsva
ā naḥ viśve sa-joṣasaḥ devāsaḥ gantana upa naḥ vasavaḥ rudrāḥ avase naḥ ā gaman śr̥ṇvantu marutaḥ havam
pūṣā viṣṇuḥ havanam me sarasvatī avantu sapta sindhavaḥ āpaḥ vātaḥ parvatāsaḥ vanaspatiḥ śr̥ṇotu pr̥thivī havam
yat indra rādhaḥ asti te māghonam maghavat-tama tena naḥ bodhi sadha-mādyaḥ vr̥dhe bhagaḥ dānāya vr̥tra-han
āji-pate nr̥-pate tvam it hi naḥ vāje ā vakṣi sukrato itisu-krato vītī hotrābhiḥ uta devavīti-bhiḥ sasa-vāṁsaḥ vi śr̥ṇvire
santi hi arye āśiṣaḥ indre āyuḥ janānām asmān nakṣasva magha-van upa avase dhukṣasva pipyuṣīm iṣam
vayam te indra stomebhiḥ vidhema tvam asmākam śatakrato itiśata-krato mahi sthūram śaśayam rādhaḥ ahrayam praskaṇvāya ni tośaya
bhūri it indrasya vīryam vi akhyam abhi ā ayati rādhaḥ te dasyave vr̥ka
śatam śvetāsaḥ ukṣaṇaḥ divi tāraḥ na rocante mahnā divam na tastabhuḥ
śatam veṇūm śatam śunaḥ śatam carmāṇi mlātāni śatam me balbaja-stukāḥ aruṣīṇām catuḥ-śatam
su-devāḥ stha kāṇvāyanāḥ vayaḥ-vayaḥ vi-carantaḥ aśvāsaḥ na caṅkramata
āt it sāptasya carkiran na anūnasya mahi śravaḥ śyāvīḥ ati-dhvasan pathaḥ cakṣuṣā cana sam-naśe
prati te dasyave vr̥ka rādhaḥ adarśi ahrayam dyauḥ na prathinā śavaḥ
daśa mahyam pauta-krataḥ sahasrā dasyave vr̥kaḥ nityāt rāyaḥ amaṁhata
śatam me gardabhānām śatam ūrṇāvatīnām śatam dāsān ati srajaḥ
tatro iti api pra aṇīyata pūta-kratāyai vi-aktā aśvānām it na yūthyām
aceti agniḥ cikituḥ havya-vāṭ saḥ sumat-rathaḥ agniḥ śukreṇa śociṣā br̥hat sūraḥ arocata divi sūryaḥ arocata
yuvam devā kratunā pūrvyeṇa yuktāḥ rathena taviṣam yajatrā ā agacchatam nāsatyā śacībhiḥ idam tr̥tīyam savanam pibāthaḥ
yuvām devāḥ trayaḥ ekādaśāsaḥ satyāḥ satyasya dadr̥śe purastāt asmākam yajñam savanam juṣāṇā pātam somam aśvinā dīdyagnī itidīdi-agnī
panāyyam tat aśvinā kr̥tam vām vr̥ṣabhaḥ divaḥ rajasaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ sahasram śaṁsāḥ uta ye gaviṣṭau sarvān it tān upa yāta pibadhyai
ayam vām bhāgaḥ ni-hitaḥ yajatrā imāḥ giraḥ nāsatyā upa yātam pi batam somam madhu-mantam asme iti pra dāśvāṁsam avatam śacībhiḥ
yam r̥tvijaḥ bahudhā kalpayantaḥ sa-cetasaḥ yajñam imam vahanti yaḥ anūcānaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ yuktaḥ āsīt kā svit tatra yajamānasya sam-vit
ekaḥ eva agniḥ bahudhā sam-iddhaḥ ekaḥ sūryaḥ viśvam anu pra-bhūtaḥ ekā eva uṣāḥ sarvam idam vi bhāti ekam vai idam vi babhūva sarvam
jyotiṣmantam ketu-mantam tri-cakram su-kham ratham su-sadam bhūri-vāram citra-maghā yasya yoge adhi-jajñe tam vām huve ati riktam pibadhyai
imāni vām bhāga-dheyāni sisrate indrāvaruṇā pra mahe suteṣu vām yajñe--yajñe ha savanā bhuraṇyathaḥ yat sunvate yajamānāya śikṣathaḥ
niḥ-sidhvarīḥ oṣadhīḥ āpaḥ āstām indrāvaruṇā mahimānam āśata yā sisratuḥ rajasaḥ pāre adhvanaḥ yayoḥ śatruḥ nakiḥ adevaḥ ohate
satyam tat indrāvaruṇā kr̥śasya vām madhvaḥ ūrmim duhate sapta vāṇīḥ tābhiḥ dāśvāṁsam avatam śubhaḥ patī iti yaḥ vām adabdhaḥ abhi pāti citti-bhiḥ
ghr̥ta-pruṣaḥ saumyāḥ jīra-dānavaḥ sapta svasāraḥ sadane r̥tasya yāḥ ha vām indrāvaruṇā ghr̥ta-ścutaḥ tābhiḥ dhattam yajamānāya śikṣatam
avocāma mahate saubhagāya satyam tveṣābhyām mahimānam indriyam asmān su indrāvaruṇā ghr̥ta-ścutaḥ tri-bhiḥ sāptebhiḥ avatam śubhaḥ patī iti
indrāvaruṇā yat r̥ṣi-bhyaḥ manīṣām vācaḥ matim śrutam adattam agre yāni sthānāni asr̥janta dhīrāḥ yajñam tanvānāḥ tapasā abhi apaśyam
indrāvaruṇā saumanasam adr̥ptam rāyaḥ poṣam yajamāneṣu dhattam pra-jām puṣṭim bhūtim asmāsu dhattam dīrghāyu-tvāya pra tiratam naḥ āyuḥ
agne ā yāhi agni-bhiḥ hotāram tvā vr̥ṇīmahe ā tvām anaktu pra-yatā haviṣmatī yajiṣṭham barhiḥ āsade
accha hi tvā sahasaḥ sūno iti aṅgiraḥ srucaḥ caranti adhvare ūrjaḥ napātam ghr̥ta-keśam īmahe agnim yajñeṣu pūrvyam
agne kaviḥ vedhāḥ asi hotā pāvaka yakṣyaḥ mandraḥ yajiṣṭhaḥ adhvareṣu īḍyaḥ viprebhiḥ śukra manma-bhiḥ
adrogham ā vaha uśataḥ yaviṣṭhya devān ajasra vītaye abhi prayāṁsi su-dhitā ā vaso iti gahi mandasva dhīti-bhiḥ hitaḥ
tvam it sa-prathāḥ asi agne trātaḥ r̥taḥ kaviḥ tvām viprāsaḥ sam-idhāna dīdi-vaḥ ā vivāsanti vedhasaḥ
śoca śociṣṭha dīdihi viśe mayaḥ rāsva stotre mahān asi devānām śarman mama santu sūrayaḥ śatru-sahaḥ su-agnayaḥ
yathā cit r̥ddham atasam agne sam-jūrvasi kṣami eva daha mitra-mahaḥ yaḥ asma-dhruk duḥ-manmā kaḥ ca venati
mā naḥ martāya ripave rakṣasvine mā agha-śaṁsāya rīradhaḥ asredhat-bhiḥ taraṇi-bhiḥ yaviṣṭhya śivebhiḥ pāhi pāyu-bhiḥ
pāhi naḥ agne ekayā pāhi uta dvitīyayā pāhi gīḥ-bhiḥ tisr̥-bhiḥ ūrjām pate pāhi catasr̥-bhiḥ vaso iti
pāhi viśvasmāt rakṣasaḥ arāvṇaḥ pra sma vājeṣu naḥ ava tvām it hi nediṣṭham deva-tātaye āpim nakṣāmahe vr̥dhe
ā naḥ agne vayaḥ-vr̥dham rayim pāvaka śaṁsyam rāsva ca naḥ upa-māte puru-spr̥ham su-nītī svayaśaḥ-taram
yena vaṁsāma pr̥tanāsu śardhataḥ tarantaḥ aryaḥ ādiśaḥ saḥ tvam naḥ vardha pra-yasā śacīvaso itiśacī-vaso jinva dhiyaḥ vasu-vidaḥ
śiśānaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ yathā agniḥ śr̥ṅge davidhvat tigmāḥ asya hanavaḥ na prati-dhr̥ṣe su-jambhaḥ sahasaḥ yahuḥ
nahi te agne vr̥ṣabha prati-dhr̥ṣe jambhāsaḥ yat vi-tiṣṭhase saḥ tvam naḥ hotariti su-hutam haviḥ kr̥dhi vaṁsva naḥ vāryā puru
śeṣe vaneṣu mātroḥ sam tvā martāsaḥ indhate atandraḥ havyā vahasi haviḥ-kr̥taḥ āt it deveṣu rājasi
sapta hotāraḥ tam it īl̥ate tvā agne su-tyajam ahrayam bhinatsi adr im tapasā vi śociṣā pra agne tiṣṭha janān ati
agnim-agnim vaḥ adhri-gum huvema vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ agnim hita-prayasaḥ śaśvatīṣu ā hotāram carṣaṇīnām
ketena śarman sacate su-sāmani agne tubhyam cikitvanā iṣaṇyayā naḥ puru-rūpam ā bhara vājan nediṣṭham ūtaye
agne jaritaḥ viśpatiḥ tepānaḥ deva rakṣasaḥ aproṣi-vān gr̥ha-patiḥ mahān asi divaḥ pāyuḥ diroṇa-yuḥ
mā naḥ rakṣaḥ ā veśīt āghr̥ṇivaso ity āghr̥ṇi-vaso mā yātuḥ yātu-māvatām paraḥ-gavyūti anirām apa kṣudham agne sedha rakṣasvinaḥ
ubhayam śr̥ṇavat ca naḥ indraḥ arvāk idam vacaḥ satrācyā magha-vā soma-pītaye dhiyā śaviṣṭhaḥ ā gamat
tam hi sva-rājam vr̥ṣabham tam ojase dhiṣaṇe niḥ-tatakṣatuḥ uta upa-mānām prathamaḥ ni sīdasi soma-kāmam hi te manaḥ
ā vr̥ṣasva puruvaso itipuru-vaso sutasya indra andhasaḥ vidma hi tvā hari-vaḥ pr̥t-su sasahim adhr̥ṣṭam cit dadhr̥ṣvaṇim
aprāmi-satya magha-van tathā it asat indra kratvā yathā vaśaḥ sanema vājam tava śiprin avasā makṣu cit yantaḥ adri-vaḥ
śagdhi oṁ iti su śacī-pate indra viśvābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ bhagam na hi tvā yaśasam vasu-vidam anu śūra carāmasi
pauraḥ aśvasya puru-kr̥t gavām asi utsaḥ deva hiraṇyayaḥ nakiḥ h i dānam pari-mardhiṣat tve iti yat-yat yāmi tat ā bhara
tvam hi ā ihi cerave vidāḥ bhagam vasuttaye ut vavr̥ṣasva magha-van go--iṣṭaye ut indra aśvam-iṣṭaye
tvam puru sahasrāṇi śatāni ca yūthā dānāya maṁhase ā puram-daram cakr̥ma vipra-vacasaḥ indram gāyantaḥ avase
avipraḥ vā yat avidhat vipraḥ vā indra te vacaḥ saḥ pra mamandat tvāyā śatakrato itiśāta-krato prācāmanyo itiprācāmanyo aham-sana
ugra-bāhuḥ mrakṣa-kr̥tvā puram-daraḥ yadi me śr̥ṇavat havam vasūyavo vasupatiṁ śatakratum stomair indram havāmahe
na pāpāsaḥ manāmahe na arāyāsaḥ na jalhavaḥ yat it nu indram vr̥ṣaṇam sacā sute sakhāyam kr̥ṇavāmahai
ugram yuyujma pr̥tanāsu sasahim r̥ṇa-kātim adābhyam veda bhr̥mam cit sanitā rathi-tamaḥ vājinam yam it oṁ iti naśat
yataḥ indra bhayāmahe tataḥ naḥ abhayam kr̥dhi magha-van śagdhi tava tam naḥ ūti-bhiḥ vi dviṣaḥ vi mr̥dhaḥ jahi
tvam hi rādhaḥ-pate rādhasaḥ mahaḥ kṣayasya asi vidhataḥ tam tvā vayam magha-van indra girvaṇaḥ suta-vantaḥ havāmahe
indraḥ spaṭ uta vr̥tra-hā paraḥ-pāḥ naḥ vareṇyaḥ saḥ naḥ rakṣiṣat caramam saḥ madhyamam saḥ paścāt pātu naḥ puraḥ
tvam naḥ paścāt adharāt uttarāt puraḥ indra ni pāhi viśvataḥ āre asmat kr̥ṇuhi daivyam bhayam āre hetīḥ adevīḥ
adya-adya śvaḥ-śvaḥ indras trāsva pare ca naḥ viśvā ca naḥ jaritr̥r̥n sat-pate ahā divā naktam ca rakṣiṣaḥ
pra-bhaṅgī śūraḥ magha-vā tuvi-maghaḥ sam-miślaḥ vīryāya kam ubhā te bāhū iti vr̥ṣaṇā śatakrato itiśata-krato ni yā vajram mimikṣatuḥ
pro iti asmai upa-stutim bharata yat jujoṣati ukthaiḥ indrasya māhinam vayaḥ vardhanti sominaḥ bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
ayujaḥ asamaḥ nr̥-bhiḥ ekaḥ kr̥ṣṭīḥ ayāsyaḥ pūrvīḥ ati pra vavr̥dhe viśvā jātāni ojasā bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
ahitena cit arvatā jīra-dānuḥ siṣāsati pra-vācyam indra tat tava vīryāṇi kariṣyataḥ bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
ā yāhi kr̥ṇavāma te indra brahmāṇi vardhanā yebhiḥ śaviṣṭha cākanaḥ bhadram iha śravasyate bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
dhr̥ṣataḥ cit dhr̥ṣat manaḥ kr̥ṇoṣi indra yat tvam tīvraiḥ somaiḥ saparyataḥ namaḥ-bhiḥ prati-bhūṣataḥ bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
ava caṣṭe r̥cīṣamaḥ avatān-iva mānuṣaḥ juṣṭavī dakṣasya sominaḥ sakhāyam kr̥ṇute yujam bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
viśve te indra vīryam devāḥ anu kratum daduḥ bhuvaḥ viśvasya go--patiḥ puru-stuta bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
gr̥ṇe tat indra te śavaḥ upa-mam deva-tātaye yat haṁsi vr̥tram ojasā śacī-pate bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
samanāiva vapuṣyataḥ kr̥ṇavat mānuṣā yugā vide tat indraḥ cetanam agha śrutaḥ bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
ut jātam indra te śavaḥ ut tvām ut tava kratum bhūrigo itibhūri-go bhūri vavr̥dhuḥ magha-van tava śarmaṇi bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
aham ca tvam ca vr̥tra-han sam yujyāva sani-bhyaḥ ā arāti-vā ci t adri-vaḥ anu nau śūra maṁsate bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
satyam ir vai oṁ iti tam vayam indram stavāma na anr̥tam mahān asunvataḥ vadhaḥ bhūri jyotīṁṣi sunvataḥ bhadrāḥ indrasya rātayaḥ
saḥ pūrvyaḥ mahānām venaḥ kratu-bhiḥ ānaje yasya dvārā manuḥ pitā deveṣu dhiyaḥ ānaje
divaḥ mānam na ut sadan soma-pr̥ṣṭhāsaḥ adrayaḥ ukthā brahma ca śaṁsyā
saḥ vidvāṁn aṅgiraḥ-bhyaḥ indraḥ gāḥ avr̥ṇot apa stuṣe tat asya paiṁsyam
saḥ pratna-thā kavi-vr̥dhaḥ indraḥ vākasya vakṣaṇiḥ śivaḥ arkasya homani asma-trā gantu avase
āt oṁ iti nu te anu kratum svāhā varasya yajyavaḥ śvātram arkāḥ anūṣata indra gotrasya dāvane
indre viśvāni vīryā kr̥tāni kartvāni ca yam arkāḥ adhvaram viduḥ
yat pāñca-janyayā viśā indre ghoṣāḥ asr̥kṣata astr̥ṇāt barhaṇā vipaḥ aryaḥ mānasya saḥ kṣayaḥ
iyam oṁ iti te anu-stutiḥ cakr̥ṣe tāni paiṁsyā pra āvaḥ cakrasya vartanim
asya vr̥ṣṇaḥ vi-odane uru kramiṣṭa jīvase yavam na paśvaḥ ā dade
tat dadhānāḥ avasyavaḥ yuṣmābhiḥ dakṣa-pitaraḥ syāma marutvataḥ vr̥dhe
baṭ r̥tviyāya dhāmnai r̥kva-bhiḥ śūra nonumaḥ jeṣāma indra tvayā yujā
asme iti rudrāḥ mehanā parvatāsaḥ vr̥tra-hatye bhara-hūtau sa-joṣāḥ yaḥ śaṁsate stuvate dhāyi pajraḥ indra-jyeṣṭāḥ asmān avantu devāḥ
ut tvā mandantu stomāḥ kr̥ṇuṣva rādhaḥ adri-vaḥ ava brahma-dviṣaḥ jahi
padā paṇīn arādhasaḥ ni bādhasva mahān asi nahi tvā kaḥ cana prati
tvam īśiṣe sutānām indra tvam asutānām tvam rājā janānām
ā ihi pra ihi kṣayaḥ divi āghoṣan carṣaṇīṇām ā ubhe iti pr̥ṇāsi rodasī iti
tyam cit parvatam girim śata-vantam sahasriṇam vi stotr̥-bhyaḥ rurojitha
vayam oṁ iti tvā divā sute vayam naktam havāmahe asmākam kāmam ā pr̥ṇa
kva syaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ yuvā tuvi-grīvaḥ anānataḥ brahmā kaḥ tam saparyati
kasya svit savanam vr̥ṣā jujuṣvān ava gacchati indram kaḥ oṁ iti svit ā cake
kam te dānāḥ asakṣata vr̥tra-han kam su-vīryā ukthe kaḥ oṁ iti svit antamaḥ
ayam te mānuṣe jane somaḥ pūruṣu sūyate tasya ā ihi pra drava p iba
ayam te śaryaṇāvati su-somāyām adhi priyaḥ ārjīkīye madin-tamaḥ
tam adya rādhase mahe cārum madāya ghr̥ṣvaye ā ihi īm indra drava piba
yat indra prāk apāk udak nyak vā hūyase nr̥-bhiḥ ā yāhi tūyam āśu-bhiḥ
yat vā pra-sravaṇe divaḥ mādayāse svaḥ-nare yat vā samudre andhasaḥ
ā tvā gīḥ-bhiḥ mahām urum huve gām-iva bhojase indra somasya pītaye
ā te indra mahimānam harayaḥ deva te mahaḥ rathe vahantu bibhrataḥ
indra gr̥ṇīṣe oṁ iti stuṣe mahān ugraḥ īśāna-kr̥t ā ihi naḥ sutam piba
suta-vantaḥ tvā vayam prayasvantaḥ havāmahe idam naḥ barhi ḥ āsade
yat cit hi śaśvatām asi indra sādhāraṇaḥ tvam tam tvā vayam havāmahe
idam te somyam madhu adhukṣan adri-bhiḥ naraḥ juṣāṇaḥ indra tat pi ba
viśvān aryaḥ vipaḥ-citaḥ ati khyaḥ tūyam ā gahi asme iti dhehi śravaḥ br̥hat
dātā me pr̥ṣatīnām rājā hiraṇya-vīnām mā devāḥ magha-vā riṣat
sahasre pr̥ṣatīnām adhi candram br̥hat pr̥thu śukram hiraṇyam ā dade
napātaḥ duḥ-gahasya me sahasreṇa su-rādhasaḥ śravaḥ deveṣu akrata
taraḥ-bhiḥ vaḥ vidat-vasum indram sa-bādhaḥ ūtaye br̥hat gāyantaḥ suta-some adhvare huve bharam na kāriṇam
na yam dudhrāḥ varante na sthirāḥ muraḥ made su-śipram andhasaḥ yaḥ ādr̥tya śaśamānāya sunvate dātā jaritre ukthyam
yaḥ śakraḥ mr̥kṣaḥ aśvyaḥ yaḥ vā kījaḥ hiraṇyayaḥ saḥ ūrvasya rejayati apa-vr̥tim indraḥ gavyasya vr̥tra-hā
nikhātam cit yaḥ puru-sambhr̥tam vasu ut it vapati dāśuṣe vajrī su-śi praḥ hari-aśvaḥ it karat indraḥ kratvā yathā vaśat
yat vavantha puru-stuta purā cit śūra nr̥ṇām vayam tat te indra sam bharāmasi yajñam uktham turam vacaḥ
sacā someṣu puru-hūta vajri-vaḥ madāya dyukṣa soma-pāḥ tvam it hi brahma-kr̥te kāmyam vasu deṣṭhaḥ sunvate bhuvaḥ
vayam enam idā hyaḥ apīpema iha vajriṇam tasmai oṁ iti adya samanā sutam bhara ā nūnam bhūṣata śrute
vr̥kaḥ cit asya vāraṇaḥ urāmathiḥ ā vayuneṣu bhūṣati saḥ imam naḥ stomam jujuṣāṇaḥ ā gahi indra pra citrayā dhiyā
kat oṁ iti nu asya akr̥tam indrasya asti paiṁsyam keno iti nu kam śromatena na śiśruve januṣaḥ pari vr̥tra-hā
iti mahīḥ adhr̥ṣṭāḥ asya taviṣīḥ kat oṁ iti vr̥tra-ghnaḥ astr̥tam indraḥ viśvān beka-nāṭān ahaḥ-dr̥ṣaḥ uta kratvā paṇīn abhi
vayam gha te apūrvyā indra brahmāṇi vr̥tra-han puru-tamāsaḥ puru-hūta vajri-vaḥ bhr̥tim na pra bharāmasi
pūrvīḥ cit hi tve iti tuvi-kūrmin āśasaḥ havante indra ūtayaḥ tiraḥ cit aryaḥ savanā vaso iti gahi śaviṣṭha śrudhi me havam
vayam gha te tve iti it oṁ iti indra viprāḥ api smasi nahi tvat anyaḥ puru-hūta kaḥ cana magha-van asti marḍitā
tvam naḥ asyāḥ amateḥ uta kṣudhaḥ abhi-śasteḥ ava spr̥dhi tvam naḥ ūtī tava citrayā dhiyā śikṣa śaciṣṭha gātu-vit
somaḥ it vaḥ sutaḥ astu kalayaḥ mā bibhītana apa it eṣaḥ dhvasmā ayati svayam gha eṣaḥ apa ayati
tyān nu kṣatriyān avaḥ ādityān yāciṣāmahe su-mr̥l̥īkān abhiṣṭaye
mitraḥ naḥ ati aṁhatim varuṇaḥ parṣat aryamā ādityāsaḥ yathā viduḥ
teṣām hi citram ukthyam varūtham asti dāśuṣe ādityānām aram-kr̥te
mahi vaḥ mahatām avaḥ varuṇa mitra aryaman avāṁsi ā vr̥ṇīmahe
jīvān naḥ abhi dhetana ādityāsaḥ purā hathāt kat ha stha havana-śrutaḥ
yat vaḥ śrāntāya sunvate varūtham asti yat chardiḥ tena naḥ adhi vocata
asti devāḥ aṁhoḥ uru asti ratnam anāgasaḥ ādityāḥ adbhuta-enasaḥ
mā naḥ setuḥ siset ayam mahe vr̥ṇaktu naḥ pari indraḥ it hi śrutaḥ vaśī
mā naḥ mr̥cā ripūṇām vr̥jinānām aviṣyavaḥ devāḥ abhi pra mr̥kṣata
uta tvām adite mahi aham devi upa bruve su-mr̥l̥īkām abhiṣṭaye
parṣi dīne gabhīre ā ugra-putre jighāṁsataḥ mākiḥ tokasya naḥ riṣat
anehaḥ naḥ uru-vraje urūci vi pra-sartave kr̥dhi tokāya jīvase
ye mūrdhānaḥ kṣitīnām adabdhāsaḥ sva-yaśasaḥ vratā rakṣante adruhaḥ
te naḥ āsnaḥ vr̥kāṇām ādityāsaḥ mumocata stenam baddham-iva adite
apo iti su naḥ iyam śaruḥ ādityāḥ apa duḥ-matiḥ asmat etu ajaghnuṣī
śaśvat hi vaḥ su-dānavaḥ ādityāḥ ūti-bhiḥ vayam purā nūnam bubhujmahe
śaśvantam hi pra-cetasaḥ prati-yantam cit enasaḥ devāḥ kr̥ṇutha jīvase
tat su naḥ navyam sanyase ādityāḥ yat mumocati bandhāt baddham-iva adite
na asmākam asti tat taraḥ ādityāsaḥ ati-skade yūyam asmabhyam mr̥l̥ata
mā naḥ hetiḥ vivasvataḥ ādityāḥ kr̥trimā śaruḥ purā nu jarasaḥ vadhīt
vi su dveṣaḥ vi aṁhatim ādityāsaḥ vi sam-hitam viṣvak vi vr̥hata rapaḥ
ā tvā ratham yathā ūtaye sumnāya vartayāmasi tuvi-kūrmim r̥ti-saham indra śaviṣṭha sat-pate
tuvi-śuṣma tuvikrato itituvi-krato śacī-vaḥ viśvayā mate ā paprātha mahi-tvanā
yasya te mahinā mahaḥ pari jmāyantam īyatuḥ hastā vajram hiraṇyayam
viśvānarasya vaḥ patim anānatasya śavasaḥ evaiḥ ca carṣaṇīnām ūtī huve rathānām
abhiṣṭaye sadāvr̥dham svaḥ-mīl̥heṣu yam naraḥ nānā havante ūtaye
paraḥ-mātram r̥cīṣamam indram ugram su-rādhasam īśānam cit vasūnām
tam-tam it rādhase mahe indram codāmi pītaye yaḥ pūrvyām anu-stut im īśe kr̥ṣṭīnām nr̥tuḥ
na yasya te śavasāna sakhyam ānaṁśa martyaḥ nakiḥ śavāṁsi te naśat
tvāūtāsaḥ tvā yujā ap-su sūrye mahat dhanam jayema pr̥t-su vajri-vaḥ
tam tvā yajñebhiḥ īmahe tam gīḥ-bhiḥ girvaṇaḥ-tama indra yathā cit āvitha vājeṣu puru-māyyam
yasya te svādu sakhyam svādvī pra-nītiḥ adri-vaḥ yajñaḥ vitantasāyyaḥ
uru naḥ tanve tane uru kṣayāya naḥ kr̥dhi uru naḥ yandhi jīvase
urum nr̥-bhyaḥ urum gave urum rathāya panthām deva-vītim manāmahe
upa mā ṣaṭ dvādvā naraḥ somasya harṣyā tiṣṭhanti svādu-rātayaḥ
r̥jrau indrote ā dade harī iti r̥kṣasya sūnavi āśva-medhasya rohitā
su-rathān ātithi-gve su-abhīśūn ārkṣe āśva-medhe su-peśasaḥ
ṣaṭ aśvān ātithi-gve indrote vadhū-mataḥ sacā pūta-kratau sanam
ā eṣu cetat vr̥ṣaṇ-vatī antaḥ r̥jreṣu aruṣī su-abhīśuḥ kaśāvatī
na yuṣme iti vāja-bandhavaḥ ninitsuḥ cana martyaḥ avadyam adhi dīdharat
pra-pra vaḥ tri-stubham iṣam mandat-vīrāya indave dhiyā vaḥ medha-sātaye puram-dhyā ā vivāsati
nadam vaḥ odatīnām nadam yoyuvatīnām patim vaḥ aghnyānām dhenūnām iṣudhyasi
tāḥ asya sūda-dohasaḥ somam śrīṇanti pr̥śnayaḥ janman devānām v iśaḥ triṣu ā rocane divaḥ
abhi pra go--patim girā indram arca yathā vide sūnum satyasya sat-patim
ā harayaḥ sasr̥jrire aruṣīḥ adhi barhiṣi yatra abhi sam-navāmahe
indrāya gāvaḥ āśiram duduhre vajriṇe madhu yat sīm upa-hvare vidat
ut yat bradhnasya viṣṭapam gr̥ham indraḥ ca ganvahi madhvaḥ pītvā sacevahi triḥ sapta sakhyuḥ pade
arcata pra arcata priya-medhāsaḥ arcata arcantu putrakāḥ uta puram na dhr̥ṣṇu arcata
ava svarāti gargaraḥ godhā pari sanisvanat piṅgā pari caniskadat indrāya brahma ut-yatam
ā yat patanti enyaḥ su-dughāḥ anapa-sphuraḥ apa-sphuram gr̥bhāyata somam indrāya pātave
apāt indraḥ apāt agniḥ viśve devāḥ amatsata varuṇaḥ it iha kṣayat tam āpaḥ abhi anūṣata vatsam saṁśiśvarīḥ-iva
su-devaḥ asi varuṇa yasya te sapta sindhavaḥ anu-kṣaranti kākudam sūrmyam suṣirām-iva
yaḥ vyatīn aphāṇayat su-yuktān upa dāśuṣe takvaḥ netā tat it vapuḥ upa-mā yaḥ amucyata
ati it oṁ iti śakraḥ ahate indraḥ viśvāḥ ati dviṣaḥ bhinat kanīnaḥ odanam pacyamānam paraḥ girā
arbhakaḥ na kumārakaḥ adhi tiṣṭhat navam ratham saḥ pakṣat mahiṣam mr̥gam pitre mātre vibhu-kratum
ā tu su-śipra dam-pate ratham tiṣṭha hiraṇyayam adha dyukṣam sacevahi sahasra-pādam aruṣam svasti-gām anehasam
tam gha īm itthā namasvinaḥ upa sva-rājam āsate artham cit asya su-dhitam yat etave āvartayanti dāvane
anu pratnasya okasaḥ priya-medhāsaḥ eṣām pūrvām anu pra-yati m vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ hita-prayasaḥ āśata
yaḥ rājā carṣaṇīnām yātā rathebhiḥ adhri-guḥ viśvāsām tarutā pr̥tanānām jyeṣṭhaḥ yaḥ vr̥tra-hā gr̥ṇe
indram tam śumbha puru-hanman avase yasya dvitā vi-dhartari hastāya vajraḥ prati dhāyi darśataḥ mahaḥ dive na sūryaḥ
nakiḥ tam karmaṇā naśat yaḥ cakāra sadāvr̥dham indram na yajñaiḥ viśva-gūrtam r̥bhvasam adhr̥ṣṭam dhr̥ṣṇu-ojasam
aṣāl̥ham ugram pr̥tanāsu sasahim yasmin mahīḥ uru-jrayaḥ sam dhenavaḥ jāyamāne anonavuḥ dyāvaḥ kṣāmaḥ anonavuḥ
yat dyāvaḥ indra te śatam śatam bhūmīḥ uta syuritisyuḥ na tvā vajr in sahasram sūryāḥ anu na jātam aṣṭa rodasī iti
ā paprātha mahinā vr̥ṣṇyā vr̥ṣan viśvā śaviṣṭha śavasā asmān ava magha-van go--mati vraje vajrin citrābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ
na sīm adevaḥ āpat iṣam dīrghāyo itidīrgha-āyo martyaḥ eta-gvā cit yaḥ etaśā yuyojate harī iti indraḥ yuyojate
tam vaḥ mahaḥ mahāyyam indram dānāya sakṣaṇim yaḥ gādheṣu yaḥ āaraṇeṣu havyaḥ vājeṣu asti havyaḥ
ut oṁ iti su ṇaḥ vaso iti mahe mr̥śasva śūra rādhase ut oṁ iti su mahyai magha-van maghattaye ut indra śravase mahe
tvam naḥ indra r̥ta-yuḥ tvānidaḥ ni tr̥mpasi madhye vasiṣva tuvi-nr̥mṇa ūrvoḥ ni dāsam śiśnathaḥ hathaiḥ
anya-vratam amānuṣam ayajvānam adeva-yum ava svaḥ sakhā dudhuvīta parvataḥ su-ghnāya dasyum parvataḥ
tvam naḥ indra āsām haste śaviṣṭha dāvane dhānānām na sam gr̥bhāya asma-yuḥ dviḥ sam gr̥bhāya asma-yuḥ
sakhāyaḥ kratum icchata kathā rādhāma śarasya upa-stutim bhojaḥ sūriḥ yaḥ ahrayaḥ
bhūri-bhiḥ samaha r̥ṣi-bhiḥ barhiṣmat-bhiḥ staviṣyase yat ittham ekam ekam it śara vatsān parādadaḥ
karṇa-gr̥hya magha-vā śaura-devyaḥ vatsam naḥ tri-bhyaḥ ā anayat ajām sūriḥ na dhātave
tvam naḥ agne mahaḥ-bhiḥ pāhi viśvasyāḥ arāteḥ uta dviṣaḥ martyasya
nahi manyuḥ pauruṣeyaḥ īśe hi vaḥ priya-jāta tvam it asi kṣapāvān
saḥ naḥ viśvebhiḥ devebhiḥ ūrjaḥ napāt bhadra-śoce rayim dehi viśva-vāram
na tam agne arātayaḥ martam yuvanta rāyaḥ yam trāyase dāśvāṁsam
yam tvam vipra medha-sātau agne hinoṣi dhanāya saḥ tava ūtī goṣu gantā
tvam rayim puru-vīram agne dāśuṣe martāya pra naḥ naya vasyaḥ accha
uruṣya ṇaḥ mā parā dāḥ agha-yate jata-vedaḥ duḥ-ādhye martāya
agne mākiḥ te devasya rātim adevaḥ yuyota tvam īśiṣe vasūnām
saḥ naḥ vasvaḥ upa māsi ūrjaḥ napāt māhinasya sakhe vaso iti jaritr̥-bhyaḥ
accha naḥ śīra-śociṣam giraḥ yantu darśatam accha yajñāsaḥ namasā puru-vasum puru-praśastam ūtaye
agnim sūnum sahasaḥ jāta-vedasam dānāya vāryāṇām dvitā yaḥ bhūt amr̥taḥ martyeṣu ā hotā mandra-tamaḥ viśi
agnim vaḥ deva-yajyayā agnim pra-yati adhvare agnim dhīṣu prathamam agnim arvati agnim kṣaitrāya sādhase
agniḥ iṣām sakhye dadātu naḥ īśe yaḥ vāryāṇām agnim toke tanaye śaśvat īmahe vasum santam tanū-pām
agnim īl̥iṣva avase gāthābhiḥ śīra-śociṣam agnim rāye puru-mīl̥ha śrutam naraḥ agnim su-dītaye chardhiḥ
agnim dveṣaḥ yotavai naḥ gr̥ṇīmasi agnim śam yoḥ ca dātave viśvāsu vikṣu avitāiva havyaḥ bhuvat vastuḥ r̥ṣūṇām
haviḥ kr̥ṇudhvam ā gamat adhvaryuḥ vanate punariti vidvān asya pra-śāsanam
ni tigmam abhi aṁśum sīdat hotā manau adhi juṣāṇaḥ asya sakhyam
antaḥ icchanti tam jane rudram paraḥ manīṣayā gr̥bhṇanti jihvayā sasam
jāmi atītape dhanuḥ vayaḥ-dhāḥ aruhat vanam dr̥ṣadam jihvayā ā avadhīt
caran vatsaḥ ruśan iha ni-dātāram na vindate veti stotavr ambyam
uto iti nu asya yat mahat aśva-vat yojanam br̥hat dāmā rathasya dadr̥śe
duhanti sapta ekām upa dvā pañca sr̥jataḥ tīrthe sindhoḥ adhi svare
ā daśa-bhiḥ vivasvataḥ indraḥ kośam acucyavīt khedayā tri-vr̥tā divaḥ
pari tri-dhātuḥ adhvaram jūrṇiḥ eti navīyasī madhvā hotāraḥ añjate
siñcanti namasā avatam uccācakram pari-jmānam nīcīna-bāram akṣitam
abhi-āram it adrayaḥ ni-siktam puṣkare madhu avatasya vi-sarjane
gāvaḥ upa avata avatam mahī iti yajñasya rapsudā ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā
ā sute siñcata śriyam rodasyoḥ abhi-śriyam rasā dadhīta vr̥ṣabham
te jānata svam okyam sam vatsāsaḥ na mātr̥-bhiḥ mithaḥ nasanta jāmi-bhiḥ
upa srakveṣu bapsataḥ kr̥ṇvate dharuṇam divi indre agnā namaḥ svaḥ
adhukṣat pipyuṣīm iṣam ūrjam sapta-padīm ariḥ sūryasya sapta raśmi-bhiḥ
somasya mitrāvaruṇā ut-itā sūre ā dade tat āturasya bheṣajam
iti nu asya yat padam haryatasya ni-dhānyam pari dyām jihvayā atanat
ut īrāthām r̥ta-yate yuñjāthām aśvinā ratham anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
nimiṣaḥ cit javīyasā rathena ā yātam aśvinā anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
upa str̥ṇītam atraye himena gharmam aśvinā anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
kuha sthaḥ kuha jagmathuḥ kuha śyenāiva petathuḥ anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
yat adya karhi karhi cit śuśrūyātam imam havam anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
aśvinā yāma-hūtamā nediṣṭham yāmi āpyam anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
avantam atraye gr̥ham kr̥ṇutam yuvam aśvinā anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
varethe agnim ātapaḥ vadate valgu atraye anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
pra sapta-vadhriḥ āśasā dhārām agneḥ aśāyata anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
iha ā gatam vr̥ṣaṇ-vasūitivr̥ṣaṇ-vasū śr̥ṇutam me imam havam anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
kim idam vām purāṇa-vat jaratoḥ-iva śasyate anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
samānam vām sa-jātyam samānaḥ bandhuḥ aśvinā anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
yaḥ vām rajāṁsi aśvinā rathaḥ vi-yāti rodasī iti anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
ā naḥ gavyebhiḥ aśvyaiḥ sahasraiḥ upa gacchatam anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
mā naḥ gavyebhiḥ aśvyaiḥ sahasrebhiḥ ati khyatam anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
aruṇa-psuḥ uṣāḥ abhūt akaḥ jyotiḥ r̥ta-varī anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
aśvinā su vi-cākaśat vr̥kṣam paraśumān-iva anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
puram na dhr̥ṣṇo iti ā ruja kr̥ṣṇayā bādhitaḥ viśā anti sat bhūtu vām avaḥ
viśaḥ-visaḥ vaḥ atithim vāja-yantaḥ puru-priyam agnim vaḥ duyarm vacaḥ stuṣe śūṣasya manma-bhiḥ
yam janāsaḥ haviṣmantaḥ mitram na sarpiḥ-āsutim pra-śaṁsanti praśasti-bhiḥ
panyāsam jāta-vedasam yaḥ deva-tāti ut-yatā havyāni airayat divi
ā aganma vr̥trahan-tamam jyeṣṭham agnim ānavam yasya śrutarvā br̥han ārkṣaḥ anīke edhate
amr̥tam jāta-vedasam tiraḥ tamāṁsi darśatam ghr̥ta-āhavanam īḍyam
sa-bādhaḥ yam janāḥ ime agnim havyebhiḥ īl̥ate juhvānāsaḥ yata-srucaḥ
iyam te navyasī matiḥ agne adhāyi asmat ā mandra su-jāta sukrato itisu-krato amūra dasma atithe
sā te agne śam-tamā caniṣṭhā bhavatu priyā tayā vardhasva su-stutaḥ
sā dyumnaiḥ dyumninī br̥hat upa-upa śravasi śravaḥ dadhīta vr̥tra-tūrye
aśvam it gām ratha-prām tveṣam indram na sat-patim yasya śravāṁsi tūrvatha panyam-panyam ca kr̥ṣṭayaḥ
yam tvā gopavanaḥ girā caniṣṭhat agne aṅgiraḥ saḥ pāvaka śrudhi havam
yam tvā janāsaḥ īl̥ate sa-bādhaḥ vāja-sātaye saḥ bodhi vr̥tra-tūrye
aham huvānaḥ ārkṣe śrutarvaṇi mada-cyuti śardhāṁsi-iva stukāvinām mr̥kṣā śīrṣā caturṇām
mām catvāraḥ āśavaḥ śaviṣṭhasya dravitnavaḥ su-rathāsaḥ abhi prayaḥ vakṣan vayaḥ na tugryam
satyam it tvā mahe--nadi paruṣṇi ava dediśam na īm āpaḥ aśva-dātaraḥ śaviṣṭhāt asti martyaḥ
yukṣva hi deva-hūtamān aśvān agne rathīḥ-iva ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ
uta naḥ deva devān accha vocaḥ viduḥ-taraḥ śrat viśvā vāryā kr̥dhi
tvam ha yat yaviṣṭhya sahasaḥ sūno iti āhuta r̥ta-vā yajñiyaḥ bhuvaḥ
ayam agniḥ sahasriṇaḥ vājasya śatinaḥ patiḥ mūrdhā kaviḥ rayīṇām
tam nemim r̥bhavaḥ yathā ā namasva sahūti-bhiḥ nedīyaḥ yajñam aṅgiraḥ
tasmai nūnam abhi-dyave vācā vi-rūpa nityayā vr̥ṣṇe codasva su-stuti m
kam oṁ iti svit asya senayā agneḥ apāka-cakṣasaḥ paṇim goṣu starāmahe
mā naḥ devānām viśaḥ prasnātīḥ-iva usrāḥ kr̥śam na hāsuḥ aghnyāḥ
mā naḥ samasya duḥ-dhyaḥ pari-dveṣasaḥ aṁhatiḥ ūrmiḥ na nāvam ā vadhīt
namaḥ te agne ojase gr̥ṇanti deva kr̥ṣṭayaḥ amaiḥ amitram ardaya
kuvit su naḥ go--iṣṭaye agne sam-veṣiṣaḥ rayim uru-kr̥t uru naḥ kr̥dhi
mā naḥ asmin mahādhane parā varka bhāra-bhr̥t yathā sam-vargam sam rayim jaya
anyam asmat bhiyai iyam agne sisaktu ducchunā vardha naḥ ama-vat śavaḥ
yasya ajuṣat namasvinaḥ śamīm aduḥ-makhasya vā tam gha it agniḥ vr̥dhā avati
parasyāḥ adhi sam-vataḥ avarān abhi ā tara yatra aham asmi tān ava
vidma hi te purā vayam agne pituḥ yathā avasaḥ adha te sumnam īmahe
imam nu māyinam huve indram īśānam ojasā marutvantam na vr̥ñjase
ayam indraḥ marut-sakhā vi vr̥trasya abhinat śiraḥ vajreṇa śata-parvaṇā
vavr̥dhānaḥ marut-sakhā indraḥ vi vr̥tram airayat sr̥jan samudriyāḥ apaḥ
ayam ha yena vai idam svaḥ marutvatā jitam indreṇa soma-pītaye
marutvantam r̥jīṣiṇam ojasvantam vi-rapśinam indram gīḥ-bhiḥ havāmahe
indram pratnena manmanā marutvantam havāmahe asya somasya pītaye
marutvān indra mīḍhavaḥ piba somam śatakrato itiśata-krato asmin yajñe puru-stuta
tubhya it indra marutvate sutāḥ somāsaḥ adri-vaḥ hr̥dā hūyante ukthinaḥ
piba it indra marut-sakhā sutam somam diviṣṭiṣu vajram śiśānaḥ ojasā
ut-tiṣṭhan ojasā saha pītvī śipreiti avepayaḥ somam indra camū iti sutam
iti krakṣamāṇam akr̥petām indra yat dasyu-hā abhavaḥ
vācam aṣṭāpadīm aham nava-sraktim r̥ta-spr̥śam indrāt pari tanvam mame
jajñānaḥ nu śata-kratuḥ vi pr̥cchat iti mātaram ke ugrāḥ ke ha śr̥ṇvire
āt īm śavasī abravīt aurṇa-vābham ahīśuvam te putra santu niḥ-turaḥ
sam it tān vr̥tra-hā akhidat khe arān-iva khedayā pra-vr̥ddhaḥ dasyuhā abhavat
ekayā prati-dhā apibat sākam sarāṁsi triṁśatam indraḥ somasya kāṇukā
abhi gandharvam atr̥ṇat abudhneṣu rajaḥ-su ā indraḥ brahma-bhyaḥ it vr̥dhe
niḥ avidhyat giri-bhyaḥ ā dhārayat pakvam odanam indraḥ bundam su-ātatam
śata-bradhnaḥ iṣuḥ tava sahasra-parṇaḥ ekaḥ it yam indra cakr̥ṣe yujam
tena stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara nr̥-bhyaḥ nāri-bhyaḥ attave sadyaḥ jātaḥ r̥bhu-sthira
etā cyautnāni te kr̥tā varṣiṣṭhāni parīṇasā hr̥dā vīl̥u adhārayaḥ
viśvā it tā viṣṇuḥ ā abharat uru-kramaḥ tvāiṣitaḥ śatam mahiṣān kṣīra-pākam odanam varāham indraḥ emuṣam
tuvi-kṣam te su-kr̥tam su-mayam dhanuḥ sādhuḥ bundaḥ hiraṇyayaḥ ubhā te bāhū iti raṇyā su-saṁskr̥tā r̥du-pe cit r̥du-vr̥dhā
purol̥āśam naḥ andhasaḥ indra sahasram ā bhara śatā ca śūra gonām
ā naḥ bhara vi-añjanam gām aśvam abhi-añjanam sacā manā hiraṇyayā
iti ā bhara tvam hi śr̥ṇviṣe vaso iti
nakīm vr̥dhīkaḥ indra te na su-sāḥ na su-dāḥ uta na anyaḥ tvat śūra vāghataḥ
nakīm indraḥ ni-kartave na śakraḥ pari-śaktave viśvam śr̥ṇoti paśyati
saḥ manyum martyānām adabdhaḥ ni cikīṣate purā nidaḥ cikīṣate
kratvaḥ it pūrṇam udaram turasya asti vidhataḥ vr̥tra-ghnaḥ soma-pāvnaḥ
tve iti vasūni sam-gatā viśvā ca soma saubhagā su-dātu apari-hvr̥tā
tvām it yava-yuḥ mama kāmaḥ gavyuḥ hiraṇyayuḥ tvām aśva-yuḥ ā īṣate
tava it indra aham āśasā haste dātram cana ā dade dinasya vā magha-van sam-bhr̥tasya vā pūrdhi yavasya kāśinā
ayam kr̥tnuḥ agr̥bhītaḥ viśva-jit ut-bhit it somaḥ r̥ṣiḥ vipraḥ kāvyena
abhi ūrṇoti yat nagnam bhiṣakti viśvam yat turam pra īm andhaḥ khyat niḥ śroṇaḥ bhūt
tvam soma tanūkr̥t-bhyaḥ dveṣaḥ-bhyaḥ anya-kr̥tebhyaḥ uru yantā asi varūtham
tvam cittī tava dakṣaiḥ divaḥ ā pr̥thivyāḥ r̥jīṣin yāvīḥ aghasya cit dveṣaḥ
arthinaḥ yanti ca it artham gacchān it daduṣaḥ rātim vavr̥jyuḥ tr̥ṣyataḥ kāmam
vidat yat pūrvyam naṣṭam ut īm r̥ta-yum īrayat pra īm āyuḥ tārīt atīrṇam
su-śevaḥ naḥ mr̥l̥ayākuḥ adr̥pta-kratuḥ avātaḥ bhava naḥ soma śam hr̥de
mā naḥ soma sam vīvijaḥ mā vi bībhiṣathā rājan mā naḥ hārdi tviṣā vadhīḥ
ava yat sve sadha-sthe devānām duḥ-matīḥ īkṣe rājan apa dviṣaḥ sedha mīḍhavaḥ apa sridhaḥ sedha
nahi anyam balā akaram marḍitāram śatakrato itiśata-krato tvam naḥ indra mr̥l̥aya
yaḥ naḥ śaśvat purā āvitha amr̥dhraḥ vāja-sātaye saḥ tvam naḥ indra mr̥l̥aya
kim aṅga radhra-codanaḥ sunvānasya avitā it asi kuvit su indra ṇaḥ śakaḥ
indra pra naḥ ratham ava paścāt cit santam adri-vaḥ purastāt enam me kr̥dhi
hanto iti nu kim āsase prathamam naḥ ratham kr̥dhi upa-mam vāja-yu śravaḥ
ava naḥ vāja-yum ratham su-karam te kim it pari asmān su jigyuṣaḥ kr̥dhi
indra dr̥hyasva pūḥ asi bhadrā te eti niḥ-kr̥tam iyam dhīḥ r̥tviya-vatī
mā sīm avadye ā bhāk urvī kāṣṭhā hitam dhanam apa-āvr̥ktāḥ aratnayaḥ
turīyam nāma yajñiyam yadā karaḥ tat uśmasi āt it patiḥ naḥ ohase
avīvr̥dhat vaḥ amr̥tāḥ amandīt eka-dyūḥ devāḥ uta yāḥ ca devīḥ tasmai oṁ iti rādhaḥ kr̥ṇuta pra-śastam prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
ā tu naḥ indra kṣu-mantam citram grābham sam gr̥bhaya mahāhastī dakṣiṇena
vidma hi tvā tuvi-kūrmim tuvi-deṣṇam tuvī-magham tuvi-mātram avaḥ-bhi ḥ
nahi tvā śūra devāḥ na martāsaḥ ditsantam bhīmam na gām vārayante
eto iti nu indram stavāma īśānam vasvaḥ sva-rājam na rādhasā mardhiṣat naḥ
pra stoṣat upa gāsiṣat śravat sāma gīyamānam abhi rādhasā jugurat
ā naḥ bhara dakṣiṇena abhi savyena pra mr̥śa indra mā naḥ vasoḥ niḥ bhāk
upa kramasva ā bhara dhr̥ṣatā dhr̥ṣṇo iti janānām adāśūḥ-tarasya vedaḥ
indra yaḥ oṁ iti nu te asti vājaḥ viprebhiḥ sanitvaḥ asmābhiḥ su tam sanuhi
sadyaḥ-juvaḥ te vājāḥ asmabhyam viśva-candrāḥ vaśaiḥ ca makṣu jarante
ā pra drava parāvataḥ arvāvataḥ ca vr̥tra-han madhvaḥ prati pra-bharmaṇi
tīvrāḥ somāsaḥ ā gahi sutāsaḥ mādayiṣṇavaḥ piba dadhr̥k yathā ociṣe
iṣā mandasva āt oṁ iti te aram varāya manyave bhuvat te indra śam hr̥de
ā tu asatro iti ā gahi ni ukthāni ca hūyasce upa-me rocane divaḥ
tubhya ayam adri-bhiḥ sutaḥ gobhiḥ śrītaḥ madāya kam pra somaḥ indra hūyate
indra śrudhi su me havam asme iti sutasya go--mataḥ vi pītim tr̥ptim aśnuhi
yaḥ indra camaseṣu ā somaḥ camūṣu te sutaḥ piba it asya tvam īśiṣe
yaḥ ap-su candramāḥ-iva somaḥ camūṣu dadr̥śe piba it asya tvam īśiṣe
yam te śyenaḥ padā abharat tiraḥ rajāṁsi aspr̥tam piba it asya tvam īśiṣe
devānām it avaḥ mahat tat ā vr̥ṇīmahe vayam vr̥ṣṇām asmabhyam ūtaye
te naḥ santu yujaḥ sadā varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā vr̥dhāsaḥ ca pra-cetasaḥ
ati naḥ viṣpitā puru naubhiḥ apaḥ na parṣatha yūyam r̥tasya rathyśaḥ
vāmam naḥ astu aryaman vāmam varuṇa śaṁsyam vāmam hi āvr̥ṇīmahe
vāmasya hi pra-cetasaḥ īśānāsaḥ riśādasaḥ na īm ādityāḥ aghasyayat
vayam it vaḥ su-dānavaḥ kṣiyantaḥ yāntaḥ adhvan ā devāḥ vr̥dhāya hūmahe
adhi naḥ indra eṣām viṣṇo iti sa-jātyānām ita marutaḥ aśvinā
pra bhrātr̥t-vam su-dānavaḥ adha dvitā samānyā mātuḥ garbhe bharāmahe
yūyam hi stha su-dānavaḥ indra-jyeṣṭhāḥ abhi-dyavaḥ adha cit vaḥ uta bruve
preṣṭham vaḥ atithim stuṣe mitram-iva priyam agnim ratham na vedyam
kavim-iva pra-cetasam yam devāsaḥ adha dvitā ni martyeṣu ādadhuḥ
tvam yaviṣṭha dāśuṣaḥ nr̥r̥n pāhi śr̥ṇudhi giraḥ rakṣa tokam uta tmanā
kayā te agne aṅgiraḥ ūrjaḥ napāt upa-stutim varāya deva manyave
dāśema kasya manasā yajñasya sahasaḥ yaho iti kat oṁ iti voce idam namaḥ
adha tvam hi naḥ karaḥ viśvāḥ asmabhyam su-kṣitīḥ vāja-draviṇasaḥ giraḥ
kasya nūnam parīṇasaḥ dhiyaḥ jinvasi dam-pate go--sātā yasya te giraḥ
tam marjayanta su-kratum puraḥ-yāvānam ājiṣu sveṣu kṣayeṣu vājinam
kṣeti kṣemebhiḥ sādhu-bhiḥ nakiḥ yam ghnanti hanti yaḥ agne su-vīraḥ edhate
ā me havam nāsatyā aśvinā gacchatam yuvam madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
imam me stomam aśvinā imam me śr̥ṇutam havam madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
ayam vām kr̥ṣṇaḥ aśvinā havate vājinīvasūitivājinī-vasū madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
śr̥ṇutam jarituḥ havam kr̥ṣṇasya stuvataḥ narā madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
chardiḥ yantam adābhyam viprāya stuvate narā madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
gacchatam dāśuṣaḥ gr̥ham itthā stuvataḥ aśvinā madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
yuñjāthām rāsabham rathe vīl̥u-aṅge vr̥ṣaṇvasūitivr̥ṣaṇ-vasū madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
tri-vandhureṇa tri-vr̥tā rathena ā yātam aśvinā madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
nu me giraḥ nāsatyā aśvinā pra avatam yuvam madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
ubhā hi dasrā bhiṣajā mayaḥ-bhuvā ubhā dakṣasya vacasaḥ babhūvathuḥ tā vām viśvakaḥ havate tanū-kr̥the mā naḥ vi yauṣṭam sakhyā mumocatam
kathā nūnam vām vi-manāḥ upa stavat yuvam dhiyam dadathuḥ vasyaḥ-iṣṭaye tā vām viśvakaḥ havate tanū-kr̥the mā naḥ vi yauṣṭam sakhyā mumocatam
yuvam hi sma puru-bhujā imam edhatum viṣṇāpve dadathuḥ vasyaḥ-iṣṭaye tā vām viśvakaḥ havate tanū-kr̥the mā naḥ vi yauṣṭam sakhyā mumocatam
uta tyam vīram dhana-sām r̥jīṣiṇam dūre cit santam avase havāmahe yasya svādiṣṭhā su-matiḥ pituḥ yathā mā naḥ vi yauṣṭam sakhyā mumocatam
r̥tena devaḥ savitā śam-āyate r̥tasya śr̥ṅgam urviyā vi paprathe r̥tam sasāha mahi cit pr̥tanyataḥ mā naḥ vi yauṣṭam sakhyā mumocatam
dyumnī vām stomaḥ aśvinā kriviḥ na seke ā gatam madhvaḥ sutasya saḥ divi priyaḥ narā pātam gaurau-iva iriṇe
pibatam gharmam madhu-mantam aśvinā ā barhiḥ sīdatam narā tā mandasānā manuṣaḥ duroṇe ā ni pācam vedasā vayaḥ
ā vām viśvābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ priya-medhāḥ ahūṣata tā vartiḥ yātam upa vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ juṣṭam yajñam diviṣṭiṣu
pibatam somam madhu-mantam aśvinā ā barhiḥ sīdatam su-mat tā vavr̥dhānau upa su-stutim divaḥ gantam gaurau-iva iriṇam
ā nūnam yātam aśvinā aśvebhiḥ pruṣitapsu-bhiḥ dasrā hiraṇyavartanī itihiraṇya-vartanī śubhaḥ patī iti pātam somam r̥ta-vr̥dhā
vayam hi vām havāmahe vipanyavaḥ viprāsaḥ vāja-sātaye tā valgū iti dasrā puru-daṁsasā dhiyā aśvinā śruṣṭī ā gatam
tam vaḥ dasmam r̥ti-saham vasoḥ mandānam andhasaḥ abhi vatsam na svasareṣu dhenavaḥ indram gīḥ-bhiḥ navāmahe
dyukṣam su-dānum taviṣībhiḥ āvr̥tam girim na puru-bhojasam kṣu-mantam vājam śatinam sahasriṇam makṣu go--mantam īmahe
na tvā br̥hantaḥ adrayaḥ varante indra vīl̥avaḥ yat ditsasi stuvate māvate vasu nakiḥ tat ā mināti te
yoddhā asi kratvā śavasā uta daṁsanā viśvā jātā abhi majmanā ā tvā ayam arkaḥ ūtaye vavartati yam gotamāḥ ajījanan
pra hi ririkṣe ojasā divaḥ antebhyaḥ pari na tvā vivyāca rajaḥ indra pārthivam anu svadhām vavakṣitha
nakiḥ pariṣṭiḥ magha-van maghasya te yat dāśuṣe daśasyasi asmākam bodhi ucathasya coditā maṁhiṣṭhaḥ vāja-sātaye
br̥hat indrāya gāyata marutaḥ vr̥traham-tamam yena jyotiḥ ajanayan r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ devam devāya jāgr̥vi
apa adhamat abhi-śastīḥ aśasti-hā atha indraḥ dyumnī ā abhavat devāḥ te indra sakhyāyayemire br̥hadbhāno itibr̥hat-bhāno marut-gaṇa
pra vaḥ indrāya br̥hate marutaḥ brahma arcata vr̥tram hanati vr̥tra-hā śata-kratuḥ vajreṇa śata-parvaṇā
abhi pra bhara dhr̥ṣatā dhr̥ṣat-manaḥ śravaḥ cit te asat br̥hat arṣantu āpaḥ javasā vi mātaraḥ hanaḥ vr̥tram jaya svaḥ
yat jāyatha apūrvya magha-van vr̥tra-hatyāya tat pr̥thivīm aprathayaḥ tat astabhnāḥ uta dyām
tat te yajñaḥ ajāyata tat arkaḥ uta haskr̥tiḥ tat viśvam abhi-bhūḥ as i yat jātam yat ca jantvam
āmāsu pakvam airayaḥ ā sūryam rohayaḥ divi gharmam na sāman tapata suvr̥kti-bhiḥ juṣṭam girvaṇase br̥hat
ā naḥ viśvāsu havyaḥ indraḥ samat-su bhūṣatu upa brahmāṇi savanāni vr̥tra-hā parama-jyāḥ r̥cīṣamaḥ
tvam dātā prathamaḥ rādhasām asi asi satyaḥ īśāna-kr̥t tuvi-dyumnasya yujyā ā vr̥ṇīmahe putrasya śavasaḥ mahaḥ
brahma te indra girvaṇaḥ kriyante anatidbhutā imā juṣasva hari-aśva yojanā indra yā te amanmahi
tvam hi satyaḥ magha-van anānataḥ vr̥trā bhūri ni-r̥ñjase saḥ tvam śaviṣṭha vajra-hasta dāśuṣe arvāñcam rayim ā kr̥dhi
tvam indra yaśāḥ asi r̥jīṣī śavasaḥ pate tvam vr̥trāṇi haṁsi apratīni ekaḥ it anuttā carṣaṇi-dhr̥tā
tam oṁ iti tvā nūnam asura pra-cetasam rādhaḥ bhāgam-iva īmahe mahī-iva kr̥ttiḥ śaraṇā te indra pra te sumnā naḥ aśnavat
kanyā vāḥ āva-yatī somam api srutā avidat astam bharantī abravīt indrāya sunavai tvā śakrāya sunavai tvā
asau yaḥ eṣi vīrakaḥ gr̥ham-gr̥ham vi-cākaśat imam jambha-sutam piba dhānāvantam karambhiṇam apūpa-vantam ukthinam
ā cana tvā cikitsāmaḥ adhi cana tvā na imasi śanaiḥ-iva śanakaiḥ-iva indrāya indo iti pari srava
kuvit śakat kuvit karat kuvit naḥ vasyasaḥ karat kuvit pati-dviṣaḥ yatīḥ indreṇa sam-gamāmahai
imāni trīṇi viṣṭapā tāni indra vi rohaya śiraḥ tatasya urvarām āt idam me upa udare
asau ca yā naḥ urvarā āt imām tanvam mama atho iti tatasya yat śiraḥ sarvā tā romaśā kr̥dhi
khe rathasya khe anasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato itiśata-krato apālām indra triḥ pūtvī akr̥ṇoḥ sūrya-tvacam
pāntam ā vaḥ andhasaḥ indram abhi pra gāyata viśva-saham śata-kratum maṁhiṣṭham carṣaṇīnām
puru-hūtam puru-stutam gāthānyam sana-śrutam indraḥ iti bravītana
indraḥ it naḥ mahānām datā vājānām nr̥tuḥ mahān abhi-jñu ā yamat
iti śiprī andhasaḥ su-dakṣasya pra-hoṣiṇaḥ indoḥ indraḥ yava-āśiraḥ
tam oṁ iti abhi pra arcata indram somasya pītaye tat it hi asya vardhanam
asya pītvā madānām devaḥ devasya ojasā viśvā abhi bhuvanā bhuvat
tyam oṁ iti vaḥ satrāsaham viśvāsu gīrṣu āyatam ā cyavayasi ūtaye
yudhmam santam anarvāṇam soma-pām anapa-cyutam naram avārya-kratum
śikṣa naḥ indra rāyaḥ ā puru vidvān r̥cīṣama ava naḥ pārye dhane
ataḥ cit indra naḥ upa ā yāhi śata-vājayā iṣā sahasra-vājayā
ayāma dhī-vataḥ dhiyaḥ arvat-bhiḥ śakra go--dare jayema pr̥t-su vajr i-vaḥ
vayam oṁ iti tvā śatakrato itiśata-krato gāvaḥ na yavaseṣu ā uktheṣu raṇayāmasi
viśvā hi martya-tvanā anu-kāmā śatakrato itiśata-krato aganma vajrin āśasaḥ
tve iti su putra śavasaḥ avr̥tran kāma-kātayaḥ na tvām indra ati ricyate
saḥ naḥ vr̥ṣan saniṣṭhayā sam ghorayā dravitnvā dhiyā aviḍḍhi puram-dhyā
yaḥ te nūnam śatakrato itiśata-krato indra dyumni-tamaḥ madaḥ tena nūnam made madeḥ
yaḥ te citraśravaḥ-tamaḥ yaḥ indra vr̥trahan-tamaḥ yaḥ ojaḥ-dātamaḥ madaḥ
vidma hi yaḥ te adri-vaḥ tvādattaḥ satya soma-pāḥ viśvāsu dasma kr̥ṣṭiṣu
indrāya madvane sutam pari stobhantu naḥ giraḥ arkam arcantu kāravaḥ
yasmin viśvāḥ adhi śriyaḥ raṇanti sapta sam-sadaḥ indram sute havāmahe
tri-kadrukeṣu cetanam devāsaḥ yajñam atnata tam it vardhantu naḥ giraḥ
ā tvā viśantu indavaḥ samudram-iva sindhavaḥ na tvām indra ati ricyate
vivyaktha mahinā vr̥ṣan bhakṣam somasya jāgr̥ve yaḥ indra jaṭhareṣu te
aram te indra kukṣaye somaḥ bhavatu vr̥tra-han aram dhāma-bhyaḥ indavaḥ
aram aśvāya gāyati śruta-kakṣaḥ aram gave aram indrasya dhāmne
aram hi sma suteṣu naḥ someṣu indra bhūṣasi aram te śakra dāvane
parākāttāt cit adri-vaḥ tvām nakṣanta naḥ giraḥ aram gamāma te vayam
eva hi asi vīra-yuḥ eva śūraḥ uta sthiraḥ eva te rādhyam manaḥ
eva rātiḥ tuvi-magha viśvebhiḥ dhāyi dhātr̥-bhiḥ adha cit indra me sacā
mo iti su brahmāiva tandrayuḥ bhuvaḥ vājānām pate matsva sutasya go--mataḥ
mā naḥ indra abhi ādiśaḥ sūraḥ aktuṣu ā yaman tvā yujā vanema tat
tvayā it indra yujā vayam prati bruvīmahi spr̥dhaḥ tvam asmākam tava smasi
tvām it hi tvāyavaḥ anu-nonuvataḥ carān sakhāyaḥ indra kāravaḥ
ut gha it abhi śruta-magham vr̥ṣabham narya-apasam astāram eṣi sūyar
nava yaḥ navatim puraḥ bibheda bāhu-ojasā ahim ca vr̥tra-hā avadhīt
saḥ naḥ indraḥ śivaḥ sakhā aśva-vat go--mat yava-mat urudhārāiva dohate
yat adya kat ca vr̥tra-han ut-agāḥ abhi sūrya sarvam tat indra te vaśe
yat vā pra-vr̥ddha sat-pate na marai iti manyase uto iti tat satyam it tava
ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire sarvān tān indra gacchasi
tam indram vājayāmasi mahe vr̥trāya hantave saḥ vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣabhaḥ bhuvat
indraḥ saḥ dāmane kr̥taḥ ojiṣṭhaḥ saḥ made hitaḥ dyumnī ślokī saḥ somyaḥ
girā vajraḥ na sam-bhr̥taḥ sa-balaḥ anapa-cyutaḥ vavakṣe r̥ṣvaḥ astr̥taḥ
duḥ-ge cit naḥ su-gam kr̥dhi gr̥ṇānaḥ indra girvaṇaḥ tvam ca magha-van vaśaḥ
yasya te nu cit ādiśam na minanti sva-rājyam na devaḥ na adhri-guḥ janaḥ
adha te aprati-skutam devī iti śuṣmam saparyataḥ ubhe iti su-śipra rodasiiti
tvam etat adhārayaḥ kr̥ṣṇāsu rohiṇīṣu ca paruṣṇīṣu ruśat payaḥ
vi yat ahe adha tviṣaḥ viśve devāsaḥ akramuḥ vidat mr̥gasya tān amaḥ
āt oṁ iti me ni-varaḥ bhuvat vr̥tra-hā adiṣṭa paiṁsyam ajāta-śatruḥ astr̥taḥ
śrutam vaḥ vr̥trahan-tamam pra śardhañ carṣaṇīnām ā śuṣerādhase mahe
ayā dhiyā ca gavya-yā puru-nāman puru-stuta yat some--some ā abhavaḥ
bodhit-manāḥ it astu naḥ vr̥tra-hā bhūri-āsutiḥ śr̥ṇotu śukraḥ āśiṣam
kayā tvam naḥ ūtyā abhi pra mandase vr̥ṣan kayā stotr̥-bhyaḥ ā bhara
kasya vr̥ṣā sute sacā niyutvān vr̥ṣabhaḥ raṇat vr̥tra-hā soma-pītaye
abhi su naḥ tvam rayim mandasānaḥ sahasriṇam pra-yantā bodhi dāśuṣe
patnī-vantaḥ sutāḥ ime uśantaḥ yanti vītaye apām jagmiḥ ni-cumpuṇaḥ
iṣṭāḥ hotrāḥ asr̥kṣata indram vr̥dhāsaḥ adhvare accha ava-bhr̥tham ojasā
iha tyā sadha-mādyā harī iti hiraṇya-keśyā vol̥hām abhi prayaḥ hitam
tubhyam somāḥ sutāḥ ime stīrṇam barhiḥ vibhāvaso itivibhāvaso stotr̥-bhyaḥ indram ā vaha
ā te dakṣam vi rocanā dadhat ratnā vi dāśuṣe stotr̥-bhyaḥ indram arcata
ā te dadhāmi indriyam ukthā viśvā śatakrato itiśata-krato stotr̥-bhyaḥ indra mr̥l̥aya
bhadram-bhadram naḥ ā bhara iṣam ūrjam śatakrato itiśata-krato yat indra mr̥l̥ayāsi naḥ
saḥ naḥ viśvāni ā bhara suvitāni śatakrato itiśata-krato yat indra mr̥l̥ayāsi naḥ
tvām it vr̥trahan-tama suta-vantaḥ havāmahe yat indra mr̥l̥ayāsi naḥ
upa naḥ hari-bhiḥ sutam yāhi madānām pate upa naḥ hari-bhiḥ sutam
dvitā yaḥ vr̥trahan-tamaḥ vide indraḥ śata-kratuḥ upa naḥ hari-bhiḥ sutam
tvam hi vr̥tra-han eṣām pātā somānām asi upa naḥ hari-bhiḥ sutam
indraḥ iṣe dadātu naḥ r̥bhukṣaṇam r̥bhum rayim vājī dadātu vājinam
gauḥ dhayati marutām śravasyuḥ matā maghonām yuktā vahniḥ rathānām
yasyāḥ devāḥ upa-sthe vratā viśve dhārayante sūryāmāsā dr̥śe kam
tat su naḥ viśve aryaḥ ā sadā gr̥ṇanti kāravaḥ marutaḥ soma-pītaye
asti somaḥ ayam sutaḥ pibanti asya marutaḥ uta sva-rājaḥ aśvinā
pibanti mitraḥ aryamā tanā pūtasya varuṇaḥ tri-sadhasthasya jāvataḥ
uto iti nu asya joṣam ā indraḥ sutasya go--mataḥ prātaḥ hotāiva matsati
kat atviṣanta sūrayaḥ tiraḥ āpaḥ-iva sridhaḥ arṣanti pūta-dakṣasaḥ
kat vaḥ adya mahānām devānām avaḥ vr̥ṇe tmanā ca dasma-varcasām
ā ye viśvā pārthivāni paprathan rocanā divaḥ marutaḥ soma-pītaye
tyān nu pūta-dakṣasaḥ divaḥ vaḥ marutaḥ huve asya somasya pītaye
tyān nu ye vi rodasī iti tastabhuḥ marutaḥ huve asya somasya pītaye
tyam nu mārutam gaṇam giri-sthām vr̥ṣaṇam huve asya somasya pītaye
ā tvā giraḥ rathīḥ-iva asthuḥ suteṣu girvaṇaḥ abhi tvā sam anūṣata indra vatsam na mātaraḥ
ā tvā śukrāḥ acucyavuḥ sutāsaḥ indra girvaṇaḥ piba tu asya andhasaḥ indra viśvāsu te hitam
piba somam madāya kam indra śyena-ābhr̥tam sutam tvam hi śaśvatīnām patiḥ rājā viśām asi
śrudhi havam tiraścyāḥ indra yaḥ tvā saparyati su-vīryasya go--mataḥ rāyaḥ pūrdhi mahān asi
indra yaḥ te navīyasīm giram mandrām ajījanat cikitvit-manasam dh iyam pratnām r̥tasya pipyuṣīm
tam oṁ iti stavāma yam giraḥ indram ukthāni vavr̥dhuḥ purūṇi asya paiṁsyā sisāsantaḥ vanāmahe
eto iti nu indram stavāma śuddham śuddhena sāmnā śuddhaiḥ ukthaiḥ vavr̥dhvāṁsam śuddhaḥ āśīḥ-vān mamattu
indra śuddhaḥ naḥ ā gahi śuddhaḥ śuddhābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ śuddhaḥ rayim ni dhāraya śuddhaḥ mamaddhi somyaḥ
indra śuddhaḥ hi naḥ rayim śuddhaḥ ratnāni dāśuṣe śuddhaḥ vr̥trāṇi jighnase śuddhaḥ vājam sisāsasi
