saḥ īm iti rathaḥ na bhuriṣāṭ ayoji mahaḥ purūṇi sātaye vasūni āt īm iti viśvā nahuṣyāṇi jātā svaḥ-sātā vane ūrdhvā navanta
vāyuḥ na yaḥ niyutvān iṣṭa-yāmā nāsatyā-iva have ā śam-bhaviṣṭhaḥ viśva-vāraḥ draviṇodāḥ-iva tman pūṣā-iva dhī-javanaḥ asi soma
indraḥ na yaḥ mahā karmāṇi cakriḥ hantā vr̥trāṇām asi soma pūḥ-bhit paidvaḥ na hi tvam ahi-nāmnām hantā viśvasya asi soma dasyoḥ
agniḥ na yaḥ vane ā sr̥jyamānaḥ vr̥thā pājāṁsi kr̥ṇute nadīṣu janaḥ na yudhvā mahataḥ upabdiḥ iyarti somaḥ pavamānaḥ ūrmim
ete somāḥ ati vārāṇi avyā divyā na kośāsaḥ abhra-varṣāḥ vr̥thā samudram sindhavaḥ na nīcīḥ sutāsaḥ abhi kalaśān asr̥gran
śuṣmī śardhaḥ na mārutam pavasva anabhi-śastā divyā yathā viṭ āpaḥ na makṣu su-matiḥ bhava naḥ sahasra-apsāḥ pr̥tanāṣāṭ na yajñaḥ
rājñaḥ nu te varuṇasya vratāni br̥hat gabhīram tava soma dhāma śuciḥ tvam asi priyaḥ na mitraḥ dakṣāyyaḥ aryamā-iva asi soma
pro iti syaḥ vahniḥ pathyābhiḥ asyān divaḥ na vr̥ṣṭiḥ pavamānaḥ akṣāḥ sahasra-dhāraḥ asadat ni asme iti mātuḥ upa-sthe vane ā ca somaḥ
rājā sindhūnām avasiṣṭa vāsaḥ r̥tasya nāvam ā aruhat rajiṣṭhām ap-su drapsaḥ vavr̥dhe śyena-jūtaḥ duhe īm pitā duhe īm pituḥ jām
siṁham nasanta madhvaḥ ayāsam harim aruṣam divaḥ asya patim śūraḥ yut-su prathamaḥ pr̥cchate gāḥ asya cakṣasā pari pāti ukṣā
madhu-pr̥ṣṭham ghoram ayāsam aśvam rathe yuñjanti uru-cakre r̥ṣvam svasāraḥ īm jāmayaḥ marjayanti sa-nābhayaḥ vājinam ūrjayanti
catasraḥ īm ghr̥ta-duhaḥ sacante samāne antaḥ dharuṇe ni-sattāḥ tāḥ īm arṣanti namasā punānāḥ tāḥ īm viśvataḥ pari santi pūrvīḥ
viṣṭambhaḥ divaḥ dharuṇaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ viśvāḥ uta kṣitayaḥ haste asya asat te utsaḥ gr̥ṇate niyutvān madhvaḥ aṁśuḥ pavate indriyāya
vanvan avātaḥ abhi deva-vītim indrāya soma vr̥tra-hā pavasva śagdhi mahaḥ puru-candrasya rāyaḥ su-vīryasya patayaḥ syāma
pra hinvānaḥ janitā rodasyoḥ rathaḥ na vājam saniṣyan cayāsīt indram gacchan āyudhā sam-śiśānaḥ viśvā vasu hastayoḥ ādadhānaḥ
abhi tri-pr̥ṣṭham vr̥ṣaṇam vayaḥ-dhām āṅgūṣāṇām avāvaśanta vāṇīḥ vanā vasānaḥ varuṇaḥ na sindhūn vi ratna-dhāḥ dayate vāryāṇi
śūra-grāmaḥ sarva-vīraḥ sahāvān jetā pavasva sanitā dhanāni tigma-āyudhaḥ kṣipra-dhanvā samat-su aṣāl̥haḥ sahvān pr̥tanāsu śatrūn
uru-gavyūtiḥ abhayāni kr̥ṇvan samīcīne itisam-īcīne ā pavasva purandhī itipuram-dhī apaḥ sisāsan uṣasaḥ svaḥ gāḥ sam cikradaḥ mahaḥ asmabhyam vājān
matsi soma varuṇam matsi mitram matsi indram indo iti pavamāna viṣṇum matsi śardhaḥ mārutam matsi devān matsi mahām indram indo iti madāya
eva rājā-iva kratu-mān amena viśvā ghanighnat duḥ-itā pavasva indo iti su-uktāya vacase vayaḥ dhāḥ yūyam pāta svasti-bhiḥ sadā naḥ
asarji vakvā rathye yathā ājau dhiyā manotā prathamaḥ manīṣī daśa svasāraḥ adhi sānau avye ajanti vahnim sadanāni accha
vītī janasya divyasya kavyaiḥ adhi suvānaḥ nahuṣyebhiḥ induḥ pra yaḥ nr̥-bhiḥ amr̥taḥ martyebhiḥ marmr̥jānaḥ avi-bhiḥ gobhiḥ at-bhiḥ
vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣṇe roruvat aṁśuḥ asmai pavamānaḥ ruśat īrte payaḥ goḥ sahasram r̥kvā pathi-bhiḥ vacaḥ-vit adhvasma-bhiḥ sūraḥ aṇvam vi yāti
rujā dr̥l̥hā cit rakṣasaḥ sadāṁsi punānaḥ indo iti ūrṇuhi vi vājān vr̥śca upariṣṭāt tujatā vadhena ye anti dūrāt upa-nāyam eṣām
saḥ pratna-vat navyase viśva-vāra su-uktāya pathaḥ kr̥ṇuhi prācaḥ ye duḥ-sahāsaḥ vanuṣā br̥hantaḥ tān te aśycāma puru-kr̥t purukṣo itipuru-kṣo
eva punānaḥ apaḥ svaḥ gāḥ asmabhyam tokā tanayāni bhūri śam naḥ kṣetram uru jyotīṁṣi soma jyok naḥ sūryam dr̥śaye rirīhi
pari suvānaḥ hariḥ aṁśuḥ pavitre rathaḥ na sarji sanaye hiyānaḥ āpat ślokam indriyam pūyamānaḥ prati devān ajuṣata prayaḥ-bhiḥ
accha nr̥-cakṣāḥ asarat pavitre nāma dadhānaḥ kaviḥ asya yonau sīdan hotā-iva sadane camūṣu upa īm agman r̥ṣayaḥ sapta viprāḥ
pra su-medhāḥ gātu-vit viśva-devaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ sadaḥ eti nityam bhuvat viśveṣu kāvyeṣu rantā anu janān yatate pañca dhīraḥ
tava tye soma pavamāna niṇye viśve devāḥ trayaḥ ekādaśāsaḥ daśa svadhābhiḥ adhi sānau avye mr̥janti tvā nadyaḥ sapta yahvīḥ
tat nu satyam pavamānasya astu yatra viśve kāravaḥ sam-nasanta jyotiḥ yat ahne akr̥ṇot oṁ iti lokam pra āvat manum dasyave kaḥ abhīkam
par sadma-iva paśu-manti hotā rājā na satyaḥ sam-itīḥ iyānaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśān ayāsīt sīdan mr̥gaḥ na mahiṣaḥ vaneṣu
sākam-ukṣaḥ marjayanta svasāraḥ daśa dhīrasya dhītayaḥ dhanutrīḥ hariḥ pari adravat jāḥ sūryasya droṇam nanakṣe atyaḥ na vājī
sam mātr̥-bhiḥ na śiśuḥ vāvaśānaḥ vr̥ṣā dadhanve puru-vāraḥ at-bhiḥ maryaḥ na yoṣām abhi niḥ-kr̥tam yan sam gacchate kalaśe usriyābhiḥ
uta pra pipye ūdhaḥ aghnyāyāḥ induḥ dhārābhiḥ sacate su-medhāḥ mūdhārnam gāvaḥ payasā camūṣu abhi śrīṇanti vasu-bhiḥ na niktaiḥ
saḥ naḥ devebhiḥ pavamāna rada indo iti rayim aśvinam vāvaśānaḥ rathirāyatām uśatī puram-dhiḥ asmadryak ā dāvane vasūnām
nu naḥ rayim upa māsva nr̥-vantam punānaḥ vātāpyam viśva-candram pra vandituḥ indo iti tāri āyuḥ prātaḥ makṣu dhiyāvasuḥ jagamyāt
adhi yat asmin vājini-iva śubhaḥ spardhante dhiyaḥ sūrye na viśaḥ apaḥ vr̥ṇānaḥ pavate kavi-yan vrajam na paśu-vardhanāya manma
dvitā vi-ūrṇvan amr̥tasya dhāma svaḥ-vide bhuvanāni prathanta dhiyaḥ pinvānāḥ svasare na gāvaḥ r̥ta-yantīḥ abhi vavaśre indum
pari yat kaviḥ kāvyā bharate śūraḥ na rathaḥ bhuvanāni viśvā deveṣu yaśaḥ martāya bhūṣan dakṣāya rāyaḥ puru-bhūṣu navyaḥ
śriye jātaḥ śriye ā niḥ iyāya śriyam vayaḥ jaritr̥-bhyaḥ dadhāti śriyam vasānāḥ amr̥ta-tvam āyan bhavanti satyā sam-ithā mita-drau
iṣam ūrjam abhi arṣa aśvam gām uru jyotiḥ kr̥ṇuhi matsi devān viśvāni hi su-sahā tāni tubhyam pavamāna bādhase soma śatrūn
kanikranti hariḥ ā sr̥jyamānaḥ sīdan vanasya jaṭhare punānaḥ nr̥-bhiḥ yataḥ kr̥ṇute niḥ-nijam gāḥ ataḥ matīḥ janayata svadhābhiḥ
hariḥ sr̥jānaḥ pathyām r̥tasya iyarti vācam aritā-iva nāvam devaḥ devānām guhyāni nāma āviḥ kr̥ṇoti barhiṣi pra-vāce
apām-iva it ūrmayaḥ tarturāṇāḥ pra manīṣāḥ īrate somam accha namasyantīḥ upa ca yanti sam ca ā ca viśanti uśatīḥ uśantam
tam marmr̥jānam mahiṣam na sānau aṁśum duhanti ukṣaṇam giri-sthām tam vāvaśānam matayaḥ sacante tritaḥ bibharti varuṇam samudre
iṣyan vācam upavaktā-iva hotuḥ punānaḥ indo iti vi sya manīṣām indraḥ ca yat kṣayathaḥ saubhagāya su-vīryasya patayaḥ syāma
pra senānīḥ śūraḥ agre rathānām gavyan eti harṣate asya senā bhadrān kr̥ṇvan indra-havān sakhi-bhyaḥ ā somaḥ vastrā rabhasāni datte
sam asya harim harayaḥ mr̥janti aśva-hayaiḥ asni-śitam namaḥ-bhiḥ ā tiṣṭhati ratham indrasya sakhā vidvān ena su-matim yāti accha
saḥ naḥ deva deva-tāte pavasva mahe soma psarase indra-pānaḥ kr̥ṇvan apaḥ varṣayan dyām uta imām uroḥ ā naḥ varivasya punānaḥ
ajītaye ahataye pavasva svastaye sarva-tātaye br̥hate tat uśanti viśve ime sakhāyaḥ tat aham vaśmi pavamāna soma
somaḥ pavate janitā matīnām janitā divaḥ janitā pr̥thivyāḥ janitā agneḥ janitā sūryasya janitā indrasya janitā uta viṣṇoḥ
brahmā devānām pada-vīḥ kavīnām r̥ṣiḥ viprāṇām mahiṣaḥ mr̥gāṇām śyenaḥ gr̥dhrāṇām sva-dhitiḥ vanānām somaḥ pavitram ati eti rebhan
pra avīvipat vācaḥ ūrmim na sindhuḥ giraḥ somaḥ pavamānaḥ manīṣāḥ antariti paśyan vr̥janā imā avarāṇi ā tiṣṭhati vr̥ṣabhaḥ goṣu jānan
saḥ matsaraḥ pr̥t-su vanvan avātaḥ sahasra-retāḥ abhi vājam arṣa indrāya indo iti pavamānaḥ manīṣī aṁśoḥ ūrmim īraya gāḥ iṣaṇyan
pari priyaḥ kalaśe deva-vātaḥ indrāya somaḥ raṇyaḥ madāya sahasra-dhāraḥ śata-vājaḥ induḥ vājī na saptiḥ samanā jigāti
saḥ pūrvyaḥ vasu-vit jāyamānaḥ mr̥jānaḥ ap-su duduhānaḥ adrau abhiśasti-pāḥ bhuvanasya rājā vidat gātum brahmaṇe pūyamānaḥ
tvayā hi naḥ pitaraḥ soma pūrve karmāṇi cakruḥ pavamāna dhīrāḥ vanvan avātaḥ pari-dhīn apa ūrṇu vīre-bhiḥ aśvaiḥ magha-vā bhava naḥ
yathā apavathāḥ manave vayaḥ-dhāḥ amitra-hā varivaḥ-vit haviṣmān eva pavasva draviṇam dadhānaḥ indre sam tiṣṭha janaya āyudhāni
pavasva soma madhu-mān r̥ta-vā apaḥ vasānaḥ adhi sānau avye ava droṇāni ghr̥ta-vanti sīda madin-tamaḥ matsaraḥ indra-pānaḥ
vr̥ṣṭim divaḥ śata-dhāraḥ pavasva sahasra-sāḥ vāja-yuḥ deva-vītau sam sindhu-bhiḥ kalaśe vāvaśānaḥ sam usriyābhiḥ pra-tiran naḥ āyuḥ
eṣaḥ syaḥ somaḥ mati-bhiḥ punānaḥ atyaḥ na vājī tarati it arātīḥ payaḥ na dugdham aditeḥ iṣiram uru-iva gātuḥ su-yamaḥ na vol̥hā
su-āyudhaḥ sotr̥-bhiḥ pūyamānaḥ abhi arṣa guhyam cāru nāma abhi vājam saptiḥ-iva śravasyā abhi vāyum abhi gāḥ deva soma
śiśum jajñānam haryatam mr̥janti śumbhanti vahnim marutaḥ gaṇena kaviḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ kāvyena kaviḥ san somaḥ pavitram ati eti rebhan
r̥ṣi-manāḥ yaḥ r̥ṣi-kr̥t svaḥ-sāḥ sahasra-nīthaḥ pada-vīḥ kavīnām tr̥tīyam dhāma mahiṣaḥ sisāsan somaḥ vi-rājam anu rājati stup
camū-sat śyenaḥ śakunaḥ vi-bhr̥tvā go-vinduḥ drapsaḥ āyudhāni bibhrat apām ūrmim sacamānaḥ samudram turīyam dhāma mahiṣaḥ vivakti
maryaḥ na śubhraḥ tanvam mr̥jānaḥ atyaḥ na sr̥tvā sanaye dhanānām vr̥ṣā-iva yūthā pari kośam arṣan kanikradat camvoḥ ā viveśa
pavasva indo iti pavamānaḥ mahaḥ-bhiḥ kanikradat pari vārāṇi arṣa krīl̥an camvoḥ ā viśa pūyamānaḥ indram te rasaḥ madiraḥ mamattu
pra asya dhārāḥ br̥hatīḥ asr̥gran aktaḥ gobhiḥ kalaśān ā viveśa sāma kr̥ṇvan sāmanyaḥ vipaḥ-cit krandan eti abhi sakhyuḥ na jāmim
apa-ghnan eṣi pavamāna śatrūn priyām na jāraḥ abhi-gītaḥ induḥ sīdan vaneṣu śakunaḥ na patvā somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sattā
ā te rucaḥ pavamānasya soma yoṣā-iva yanti su-dughāḥ su-dhārāḥ hariḥ ānītaḥ puru-vāraḥ ap-su acikradat kalaśe deva-yūnām
asya preṣā hemanā pūyamānaḥ devaḥ devebhiḥ sam apr̥kta rasam sutaḥ pavitram pari eti rebhan mitā-iva sadma paśu-manti hotā
bhadrā vastrā samanyā vasānaḥ mahān kaviḥ ni-vacanāni śaṁsan ā vacyasva camvoḥ pūyamānaḥ vi-cakṣaṇaḥ jāgr̥viḥ deva-vītau
sam oṁ iti priyaḥ mr̥jyate sānau avye yaśaḥ-taraḥ yaśasām kṣaitaḥ asme iti abhi svara dhanva pūyamānaḥ yūyam pāta svasti-bhiḥ sadā naḥ
pra gāyata abhi arcāma devān somam hinota mahate dhanāya svāduḥ pavāte ati vāram avyam ā sīdāti kalaśam deva-yuḥ naḥ
induḥ devānām upa sakhyam āyan sahasra-dhāraḥ pavate madāya nr̥-bhiḥ stavānaḥ anu dhāma pūrvam agan indram mahate saubhagāya
stotre rāye hariḥ arṣa punānaḥ indram madaḥ gacchatu te bharāya devaiḥ yāhi sa-ratham rādhaḥ accha yūyam pāta svasti-bhiḥ sadā naḥ
pra kāvyam uśanā-iva bruvāṇaḥ devaḥ devānām janima vivakti mahi-vrataḥ śuci-bandhuḥ pāvakaḥ padā varāhaḥ abhi eti rebhan
pra haṁsāsaḥ tr̥palam manyum accha amāt astam vr̥ṣa-gaṇāḥ ayāsuḥ āṅgūṣyam pavamānam sakhāyaḥ duḥ-marṣam sākam pra vadanti vāṇam
saḥ raṁhate uru-gāyasya jūtim vr̥thā krīl̥antam mimate na gāvaḥ parīṇasam kr̥ṇute tigma-śr̥ṅgaḥ divā hariḥ dadr̥śe naktam r̥jraḥ
induḥ vājī pavate go-nyoghāḥ indre somaḥ saha invan madāya hanti rakṣaḥ bādhate pari arātīḥ varivaḥ kr̥ṇvan vr̥janasya rājā
adha dhārayā madhvā pr̥cānaḥ tiraḥ roma pavate adri-dugdhaḥ induḥ indrasya sakhyam juṣāṇaḥ devaḥ devasya matsaraḥ madāya
abhi priyāṇi pavate punānaḥ devaḥ devān svena rasena pr̥ñcan induḥ dharmāṇi r̥tu-thā vasānaḥ daśa kṣipaḥ avyata sānau avye
vr̥ṣā śoṇaḥ abhi-kanikradat gāḥ nadayan eti pr̥thivīm uta dyām indrasya-iva vagnuḥ ā śr̥ṇve ājau pra-cetayan arṣati vācam ā imām
rasāyyaḥ payasā pinvamānaḥ īrayan eṣi madhu-mantam aṁśum pavamānaḥ sam-tanim eṣi kr̥ṇvan indrāya soma pari-sicyamānaḥ
eva pavasva madiraḥ madāya uda-grābhasya namayan vadha-snaiḥ pari varṇam bharamāṇaḥ ruśantam gavyuḥ naḥ arṣa pari soma siktaḥ
juṣṭavī naḥ indo iti su-pathā su-gāni urau pavasva varivāṁsi kr̥ṇvan ghanā-iva viṣvak duḥ-itāni vi-ghnan adhi snunā dhanva sānau avye
vr̥ṣṭim naḥ arṣa divyām jigatnum il̥āvatīm śam-gayīm jīra-dānum stukā-iva vītā dhanva vi-cinvan bandhūn imān avarān indo iti vāyūn
granthim na vi sya grathitam punānaḥ r̥jum ca gātum vr̥jinam ca soma atyaḥ na kradaḥ hariḥ ā sr̥jānaḥ maryaḥ deva dhanva pastya-vān
juṣṭaḥ madāya deva-tāte indo iti pari snunā dhanva sānau avye sahasra-dhāraḥ su-rabhiḥ adabdhaḥ pari srava vāja-sātau nr̥-sahye
araśmānaḥ ye arathāḥ ayuktāḥ atyāsaḥ na sasr̥jānāsaḥ ājau ete śukrāsaḥ dhanvanti somāḥ devāsaḥ tān upa yāta pibadhyai
eva naḥ indo iti abhi deva-vītim pari srava nabhaḥ arṇaḥ camūṣu somaḥ asmabhyam kāmyam br̥hantam rayim dadātu vīra-vantam ugram
takṣat yadi manasaḥ venataḥ vāk jyeṣṭhasya vā dharmaṇi kṣoḥ anīke āt īm āyan varam ā vāvaśānāḥ juṣṭam patim kalaśe gāvaḥ indum
pra dānu-daḥ divyaḥ dānu-pinvaḥ r̥tam r̥tāya pavate su-medhāḥ dharmā bhuvat vr̥janyasya rājā pra rāsmi-bhiḥ daśa-bhiḥ bhāri bhūma
pavitrebhiḥ pavamānaḥ nr̥-cakṣā rājā devānām uta martyānām dvitā bhuvat rayi-patiḥ rayīṇām r̥tam bharat su-bhr̥tam cāru induḥ
arvān-iva śravase sātim accha indrasya vāyoḥ abhi vītim arṣa saḥ naḥ sahasrā br̥hatīḥ iṣaḥ dāḥ bhava soma draviṇaḥ-vit punānaḥ
deva-avyaḥ naḥ pari-sicyamānāḥ kṣayam su-vīram dhanvantu somāḥ āyajyavaḥ su-matim viśva-vārāḥ hotāraḥ na divi-yajaḥ mandra-tamāḥ
eva deva deva-tāte pavasva mahe soma psarase deva-pānaḥ mahaḥ cit hi smasi hitāḥ sa-marye kr̥dhi su-sthāne rodasī iti punānaḥ
aśvaḥ na kradaḥ vr̥ṣa-bhiḥ yujānaḥ siṁhaḥ na bhīmaḥ manasaḥ javīyān arvācīnaiḥ pathi-bhiḥ ye rajiṣṭhāḥ ā pavasva saumanasam naḥ indo iti
śatam dhārāḥ deva-jātāḥ asr̥gran sahasram enāḥ kavayaḥ mr̥janti indo iti sanitram divaḥ ā pavasva puraḥ-etā asi mahataḥ dhanasya
divaḥ na sargāḥ asasr̥gram ahnām rājā na mitram pra mināti dhīraḥ pituḥ na putraḥ kratu-bhiḥ yatānaḥ ā pavasva viśe asyai ajītim
pra te dhārāḥ madhu-matīḥ asr̥gran vārān yat pūtaḥ ati-eṣi avyān pavamāna pavase dhāma gonām jajñānaḥ sūryam apinvaḥ arkaiḥ
kanikradat anu panthām r̥tasya śukraḥ vi bhāsi amr̥tasya dhāma saḥ indrāya pavase matsara-vān hinvānaḥ vācam mati-bhiḥ kavīnām
divyaḥ su-parṇaḥ ava cakṣi soma pinvan dhārāḥ karmaṇā deva-vītau ā indo iti viśa kalaśam soma-dhānam krandan ihi sūryasya upa raśmim
tisraḥ vācaḥ īrayati pra vahniḥ r̥tasya dhītim brahmaṇaḥ manīṣām gāvaḥ yanti go-patim pr̥cchamānāḥ somam yanti matayaḥ vāvaśānāḥ
nan
eva naḥ soma pari-sicyamānaḥ ā pavasva pūyamānaḥ svasti indram ā viśa br̥hatā raveṇa vardhaya vācam janaya puram-dhim
ā jāgr̥viḥ vipraḥ r̥tā matīnām somaḥ punānaḥ asadat camūṣu sapanti yam mithunāsaḥ ni-kāmāḥ adhvaryavaḥ rathirāsaḥ su-hastāḥ
saḥ punānaḥ upa sūre na dhātā ā ubhe iti aprāḥ rodasī iti vi saḥ āvar ity āvaḥ priyā cit yasya priyasāsaḥ ūtī saḥ tu dhanam kāriṇe na pra yaṁsat
saḥ vardhitā vardhanaḥ pūyamānaḥ somaḥ mīḍhavān abhi naḥ jyotiṣā āvīt yena naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pada-jñāḥ svaḥ-vidaḥ abhi gāḥ adrim uṣṇan
akrān samudraḥ prathame vi-dharman janayan pra-jāḥ bhuvanasya rājā vr̥ṣā pavitre adhi sānau avye br̥hat somaḥ vavr̥dhe suvānaḥ induḥ
mahat tat somaḥ mahiṣaḥ cakāra apām yat garbhaḥ avr̥ṇīta devān adadhāt indre pavamānaḥ ojaḥ ajanayat sūrye jyotiḥ induḥ
matsi vāyum iṣṭaye rādhase ca matsi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ matsi śardhaḥ mārutam matsi devān matsi dyāvāpr̥thivī iti deva soma
r̥juḥ pavasva vr̥jinasya hantā apa amīvām bādhamānaḥ mr̥dhaḥ ca abhi-śrīṇan payaḥ payasā abhi gonām indrasya tvam tava vayam sakhāyaḥ
madhvaḥ sūdam pavasva vasvaḥ utsam vīram ca naḥ ā pavasva bhagam ca svadasva indrāya pavamānaḥ indo iti rayim ca naḥ ā pavasva samudrāt
somaḥ sutaḥ dhārayā atyaḥ na hitvā sindhuḥ na nimnam abhi vājī akṣāriti ā yonim vanyam asadat punānaḥ sam induḥ gobhiḥ asarat sam at-bhiḥ
eṣaḥ syaḥ te pavate indra somaḥ camūṣu dhīraḥ uśate tavasvān svaḥ-cakṣāḥ rathiraḥ satya-śuṣmaḥ kāmaḥ na yaḥ deva-yatām asarji
eṣaḥ pratnena vayasā punānaḥ tiraḥ varpāṁsi duhituḥ dadhānaḥ vasānaḥ śarma tri-varūtham ap-su hotā-iva yāti samaneṣu rebhan
nu naḥ tvam rathiraḥ deva soma pari srava camvoḥ pūyamānaḥ ap-su svādiṣṭhaḥ madhu-mān r̥ta-vā devaḥ na yaḥ savitā satya-manmā
abhi vāyum vītī arṣa gr̥ṇānaḥ abhi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ abhi naram dhī-javanam rathe-sthām abhi indram vr̥ṣaṇam vajra-bāhum
abhi vastrā su-vasanāni arṣa abhi dhenūḥ su-dughāḥ pūyamānaḥ abhi candrā bhartave naḥ hiraṇyā abhi aśvān rathinaḥ deva soma
abhi naḥ arṣa divyā vasūni abhi viśvā pārthivā pūyamānaḥ abhi yena draviṇam aśnavāma abhi ārṣeyam jamadagni-vat naḥ
ayā pavā pavasva enā vasūni māṁścatve indo iti sarasi pra dhanva bradhnaḥ cit atra vātaḥ na jūtaḥ puru-medhaḥ cit takave naram dāt
uta naḥ enā pavayā pavasva adhi śrute śravāyyasya tīrthe ṣaṣṭim sahasrā naigutaḥ vasūni vr̥kṣam na pakvam dhūnavat raṇāya
mahi ime iti asya vr̥ṣanāma śūṣe iti māṁścatve vā pr̥śane vā vadhatreiti asvāpayat ni-gutaḥ snehayat ca apa amitrān apa acitaḥ aca itaḥ
sam trī pavitrā vi-tatāni eṣi anu ekam dhāvasi pūyamānaḥ asi bhagaḥ asi dātrasya dātā asi magha-vā maghavat-bhyaḥ indo iti
eṣaḥ viśva-vit pavate manīṣī somaḥ viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā drapsān īrayan vidatheṣu induḥ vi vāram avyam samayā ati yāti
indum rihanti mahiṣāḥ adabdhāḥ pade rebhanti kavayaḥ na gr̥dhrāḥ hinvanti dhīrāḥ daśa-bhiḥ kṣipābhiḥ sam āñjate rūpam apām rasena
tvayā vayam pavamānena soma bhare kr̥tam vi cinuyāma śaśvat tat naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ mamahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
abhi naḥ vāja-sātamam rayim arṣa puru-spr̥ham indo iti sahasra-bharṇasam tuvi-dyumnam vibhva-saham
pari syaḥ suvānaḥ avyayam rathe na varma avyata induḥ abhi drūṇā hitaḥ hiyānaḥ dhārābhiḥ akṣāriti
pari syaḥ suvānaḥ akṣāriti induḥ avye mada-cyutaḥ dhārā yaḥ ūrdhvaḥ adhvare bhrājā na eti gavya-yuḥ
saḥ hi tvam deva śaśvate vasu martāya dāśuṣe indo iti sahasriṇam rayim śata-ātmānam vivāsasi
vayam te asya vr̥tra-han vaso iti vasvaḥ puru-spr̥haḥ ni nediṣṭha-tamāḥ iṣaḥ syāma sumnasya adhrigo ity adhri-go
dviḥ yam pañca sva-yaśasam svasāraḥ adri-saṁhatam priyam indrasya kāmyam pra-snāpayanti ūrmiṇam
pari tyam haryatam harim babhrum punanti vāreṇa yaḥ devān viśvān it pari madena saha gacchati
asya vaḥ hi avasā pāntaḥ dakṣa-sādhanam yaḥ sūriṣu śravah br̥hat dadhe svaḥ na haryataḥ
saḥ vām yajñeṣu mānavī iti induḥ janiṣṭa rodasī iti devaḥ devī iti giri-sthāḥ asredhan tam tuvi-svani
indrāya soma pātave vr̥tra-ghne pari sicyase nare ca dakṣiṇāvate devāya sadana-sade
te pratnāsaḥ vi-uṣṭiṣu somāḥ pavitre akṣaran apa-prothantaḥ sanutaḥ huraḥ-citaḥ prātariti tān apra-cetasaḥ
tam sakhāyaḥ puraḥ-rucam yūyam vayam ca sūrayaḥ aśyāma vāja-gandhyam sanema vāja-pastyam
ā haryatāya dhr̥ṣṇave dhanuḥ tanvanti paiṁsyam śukrām vayanti asurāya niḥ-nijam vipām agre mahīyuvaḥ
adha kṣapā pari-kr̥taḥ vājān abhi pra gāhate yadi vivasvataḥ dhiyaḥ harim hinvanti yātave
tam asya marjayāmasi madaḥ yaḥ indra-pātamaḥ yam gāvaḥ āsa-bhiḥ dadhuḥ purā nūnam ca sūrayaḥ
tam gāthayā purāṇyā punānam abhi anūṣata uto iti kr̥panta dhītayaḥ devānām nāma bibhratīḥ
tam ukṣamāṇam avyaye vāre punanti dharṇasim dūtam na pūrva-cittaye ā śāsate manīṣiṇaḥ
saḥ punānaḥ madin-tamaḥ somaḥ camūṣu sīdati paśau na retaḥ ādadhat patiḥ vacasyate dhiyaḥ
saḥ mr̥jyate sukarma-bhiḥ devaḥ devebhyaḥ sutaḥ vide yat āsu sam-dadiḥ mahīḥ apaḥ vi gāhate
sutaḥ indo iti pavitre ā nr̥-bhiḥ yataḥ vi nīyase indrāya matsarin-tamaḥ camūṣu ā ni sīdasi
abhi navante adruhaḥ priyam indrasya kāmyam vatsam na pūrve āyuni jātam rihanti mātaraḥ
punānaḥ indo iti ā bhara soma dvi-barhasam rayim tvam vasūni puṣyasi viśvāni dāśuṣaḥ gr̥he
tvam dhiyam manaḥ-yujam sr̥ja vr̥ṣṭim na tanyatuḥ tvam vasūni pārthivā divyā ca soma puṣyasi
pari te jigyuṣaḥ yathā dhārā sutasya dhāvati raṁhamāṇā vi avyayam vāram vājī-iva sānasiḥ
kratve dakṣāya naḥ kave pavasva soma dhārayā indrāya pātave sutaḥ mitrāya varuṇāya ca
pavasva vāja-sātamaḥ pavitre dhārayā sutaḥ indrāya soma viṣṇave devebhyaḥ madhumat-tamaḥ
tvām rihanti mātaraḥ harim pavitre adruhaḥ vatsam jātam na dhenavaḥ pavamāna vi-dharmaṇi
pavamāna mahi śravaḥ citrebhiḥ yāsi raśmi-bhiḥ śardhan tamāṁsi jighnase viśvāni dāśuṣaḥ gr̥he
tvam dyām ca mahi-vrata pr̥thivīm ca ati jabhriṣe prati drāpim amuñcathāḥ pavamāna mahi-tvanās
puraḥ-jitī vaḥ andhasaḥ sutāya mādayitnave apa śvānam śnathiṣṭana sakhāyaḥ dīrgha-jihvyam
yaḥ dhārayā pāvakayā pari-prasyandate sutaḥ induḥ aśvaḥ na kr̥tvyaḥ
tam duroṣam abhi naraḥ somam viśvācyā dhiyā yajñam hinvanti adri-bhiḥ
sutāsaḥ madhumat-tamāḥ somāḥ indrāya mandinaḥ pavitra-vantaḥ akṣaran devān gacchantu vaḥ madāḥ
induḥ indrāya pavate iti devāsaḥ abruvan vācaḥ patiḥ makhasyate viśvasya īśānaḥ ojasā
sahasra-dhāraḥ pavate samudraḥ vācam-īṅkhayaḥ somaḥ patiḥ rayīṇām sakhā indrasya dive-dive
ayam pūṣā rayiḥ bhagaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ arṣati patiḥ viśvasya bhūmanaḥ vi akhyat rodasī iti ubhe iti
sam oṁ iti priyāḥ anūṣata gāvaḥ madāya ghr̥ṣvayaḥ somāsaḥ kr̥ṇvate pathaḥ pavamānāsaḥ indavaḥ
yaḥ ojiṣṭhaḥ tam ā bhara pavamāna śravāyyam yaḥ pañca carṣaṇīḥ abhi rayim yena vanāmahai
somāḥ pavante indavaḥ asmabhyam gātuvit-tamāḥ mitrāḥ suvānāḥ arepasaḥ su-ādhyaḥ svaḥ-vidaḥ
susvāṇāsaḥ vi adri-bhiḥ citānāḥ goḥ adhi tvaci iṣam asmabhyam abhitaḥ sam asvaran vasu-vidaḥ
ete pūtāḥ vipaḥ-citaḥ somāsaḥ dadhi-āśiraḥ sūryāsaḥ na darśatāsaḥ jigatnavaḥ dhruvāḥ ghr̥te
pra sunvānasya andhasaḥ martaḥ na vr̥ta tat vacaḥ apa śvānam arādhasam hata makham na bhr̥gavaḥ
ā jāmiḥ atke avyata bhuje na putraḥ oṇyoḥ sarat jāraḥ na yoṣaṇām varaḥ na yonim āsadam
saḥ vīraḥ dakṣa-sādhanaḥ vi yaḥ tastambha rodasī iti hariḥ pavitre avyata vedhāḥ na yonim āsadam
avyaḥ vārebhiḥ pavate somaḥ gavye adhi tvaci kanikradat vr̥ṣā hariḥ indrasya abhi eti niḥ-kr̥tam
krāṇā śiśuḥ mahīnām hinvan r̥tasya dīdhitim viśvā pari priyā bhuvat adha dvitā
upa tritasya pāṣyoḥ abhakta yat guhā padam yajñasya sapta dhāma-bhiḥ adha priyam
trīṇi tritasya dhārayā pr̥ṣṭheṣu ā īraya rayim mimīte asya yojanā vi su-kratuḥ
jajñānam sapta mātaraḥ vedhām aśāsata śriye ayam dhruvaḥ rayīṇām ciketa yat
asya vrate sa-joṣasaḥ viśve devāsaḥ adruhaḥ spārhāḥ bhavanti rantayaḥ juṣanta yat
yam īm iti garbham r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ dr̥śe cārum ajījanan kavim maṁhiṣṭham adhvare puru-spr̥ham
samīcīne itisam-īcīne abhi tmanā yahvī r̥tasya mātarā tanvānāḥ yajñam ānuṣak yat añjate
kratvā śukrebhiḥ akṣa-bhiḥ r̥ṇoḥ apa vrajam divaḥ hinvan r̥tasya dīditim pra adhvare
pra punānāya vedhase somāya vacaḥ ut-yatam bhr̥tim na bhara mati-bhiḥ jujoṣate
pari vārāṇi avyayā gobhiḥ añjānaḥ arṣati trī sadha-sthā punānaḥ kr̥ṇute hariḥ
pari kośam madhu-ścutam avyaye vāre arṣati abhi vāṇīḥ r̥ṣīṇām sapta nūṣata
pari netā matīnām viśva-devaḥ adābhyaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ camvoḥ viśat hariḥ
pari daivīḥ anu svadhāḥ indreṇa yāhi sa-ratham punānaḥ vāghat vāghat-bhiḥ amartyaḥ
pari saptiḥ na vāja-yuḥ devaḥ devebhyaḥ sutaḥ vi-ānaśiḥ pavamānaḥ vi dhāvati
sakhāyaḥ ā ni sīdata punānāya pra gāyata śiśum na yajñaiḥ pari bhūṣata śriye
sam īm iti vatsam na mātr̥-bhiḥ sr̥jata gaya-sādhanam deva-avyam madam abhi dvi-śavasam
punāta dakṣa-sādhanam yathā śardhāya vītaye yathā mitrāya varuṇāya śam-tamaḥ
asmabhyam tvā vasu-vidam abhi vāṇīḥ anūṣata gobhiḥ te varṇam abhi vāsayāmasi
saḥ naḥ madānām pate indo iti deva-psarāḥ asi sakhā-iva sakhye gātuvit-tamaḥ bhava
sanemi kr̥dhi asmat ā rakṣasam kam cit atriṇam apa adevam dvayum aṁhaḥ yuyodhi naḥ
tam vaḥ sakhāyaḥ madāya punānam abhi gāyata śiśum na yajñaiḥ svadayanta gūrti-bhiḥ
sam vatsaḥ-iva mātr̥-bhiḥ induḥ hinvānaḥ ajyate deva-avīḥ madaḥ mati-bhiḥ pari-kr̥taḥ
ayam dakṣāya sādhanaḥ ayam śardhāya vītaye ayam devebhyaḥ madhumat-tamaḥ sutaḥ
go-mat naḥ indo iti aśva-vat sutaḥ su-dakṣa dhanva śucim te varṇam adhi goṣu dīdharam
saḥ naḥ harīṇām pate indo iti devapsaraḥ-tamaḥ sakhā-iva sakhye naryaḥ ruce bhava
sanemi tvam asmat ā adevam kam cit atriṇam sāhvān indo iti pari bādhaḥ apa dvayum
indram accha sutāḥ ime vr̥ṣaṇam yantu harayaḥ śruṣṭī jātāsaḥ indavaḥ svaḥ-vidaḥ
ayam bharāya sānasiḥ indrāya pavate sutaḥ somaḥ jaitrasya cetati yathā vide
asya it indraḥ madeṣu ā grābham gr̥bhṇīta sānasim vajram ca vr̥ṣaṇam bharat sam apsu-jit
pra dhanva soma jāgr̥viḥ indrāya indo iti pari srava dyu-mantam śuṣmam ā bhara svaḥ-vidam
indrāya vr̥ṣaṇam madam pavasva viśva-darśataḥ sahasra-yāmā pathi-kr̥t vi-cakṣaṇaḥ
asmabhyam gātuvit-tamaḥ devebhyaḥ madhumat-tamaḥ sahasram yāhi pathi-bhiḥ kanikradat
pavasva deva-vītaye indo iti dhārābhiḥ ojasā ā kalaśam madhu-mān soma naḥ sadaḥ
tava drapsāḥ uda-prutaḥ indram madāya vavr̥dhuḥ tvām devāsaḥ amr̥tāya kam papuḥ
ā naḥ sutāsaḥ indavaḥ punānāḥ dhāvata rayim vr̥ṣṭi-dyāvaḥ rīti-āpaḥ svaḥ-vidaḥ
somaḥ punānaḥ ūrmiṇā avyaḥ vāram vi dhāvati agre vācaḥ pavamānaḥ kanikradat
dhībhiḥ hinvanti vājinam vane krīl̥antam ati-avim abhi tri-pr̥ṣṭham matayaḥ sam asvaran
asarji kalaśān abhi mīl̥he saptiḥ na vāja-yuḥ punānaḥ vācam janayan asisyadat
pavate haryataḥ hariḥ ati hvarāṁsi raṁhyā abhi-arṣan stotr̥-bhyaḥ vīra-vat yaśaḥ
ayā pavasva deva-yuḥ madhoḥ dhārāḥ asr̥kṣata rebhan pavitram pari eṣi viśvataḥ
pari itaḥ siñcata sutam somaḥ yaḥ ut-tamam haviḥ dadhanvān yaḥ naryaḥ ap-su antaḥ ā susāva somam adri-bhiḥ
nūnam punānaḥ avi-bhiḥ pari srava adabdhaḥ surabhim-taraḥ sute cit tvā ap-su mādāmaḥ andhasā śrīṇantaḥ gobhiḥ ut-taram
pari suvānaḥ cakṣase deva-mādanaḥ kratuḥ induḥ vi-cakṣaṇaḥ
punānaḥ soma dhārayā apaḥ vasānaḥ arṣasi ā ratna-dhāḥ yonim r̥tasya sīdasi utsaḥ deva hiraṇyayaḥ
duhānaḥ ūdhaḥ divyam madhu priyam pratnam sadha-stham ā asadat āpr̥cchyam dharuṇam vājī arṣati nr̥-bhiḥ dhūtaḥ vi-cakṣaṇaḥ
punānaḥ soma jāgr̥viḥ avyaḥ vāre pari priyaḥ tvam vipraḥ abhavaḥ aṅgiraḥ-tamaḥ madhvā yajñam mimikṣa naḥ
somaḥ mīḍhavān pavate gātuvit-tamaḥ r̥ṣiḥ vipraḥ vi-cakṣaṇaḥ tvam kaviḥ abhavaḥ deva-vītamaḥ ā sūryam rohayaḥ divi
somaḥ oṁ iti suvānaḥ sotr̥-bhiḥ adhi snu-bhiḥ avīnām aśvayā-iva haritā yāti dhārayā mandrayā yāti dhārayā
anūpe go-mān gobhiḥ akṣāriti somaḥ dugdhābhiḥ akṣāriti samudram na sam-varaṇāni agman mandī madāya tośate
ā soma suvānaḥ adri-bhiḥ tiraḥ vārāṇi avyayā janaḥ na puri camvoḥ viśat hariḥ sadaḥ vaneṣu dadhiṣe
saḥ mamr̥je tiraḥ aṇvāni meṣyaḥ mīl̥he saptiḥ na vāja-yuḥ anu-mādyaḥ pavamānaḥ manīṣi-bhiḥ somaḥ viprebhiḥ r̥kva-bhiḥ
pra soma deva-vītaye sindhuḥ na pipye arṇasā aṁśoḥ payasā madi raḥ na jāgr̥viḥ acchā kośam madhu-ścutam
ā haryataḥ arjune atke avyata priyaḥ sūnuḥ na marjyaḥ tam īm hinvanti apasaḥ yathā ratham nadīṣu ā gabhastyoḥ
abhi somāsaḥ āyavaḥ pavante madyam madam samudrasya adhi viṣṭapi manīṣiṇaḥ matsarāsaḥ svaḥ-vidaḥ
tarat samudram pavamānaḥ ūrmiṇā rājā devaḥ r̥tam br̥hat arṣat mitrasya varuṇasya dharmaṇā pra hinvānaḥ r̥tam br̥hat
nr̥-bhiḥ yemānaḥ haryataḥ vi-cakṣaṇaḥ rājā devaḥ samudriyaḥ
indrāya pavate madaḥ somaḥ marutvate sutaḥ sahasra-dhāraḥ ati avyam arṣati tam īm iti mr̥janti āyavaḥ
punānaḥ camū iti janayan matim kaviḥ somaḥ deveṣu raṇyati apaḥ vasānaḥ pari gobhiḥ ut-taraḥ sīdan vaneṣu avyata
tava aham soma raraṇa sakhye indo iti dive-dive purūṇi babhro iti ni caranti mām ava pari-dhīn ati tān ihi
uta aham naktam uta soma te divā sakhyāya babhro iti ūdhani ghr̥ṇā tapantam ati sūryam paraḥ śakunāḥ-iva paptima
mr̥jyamānaḥ su-hastya samudre vācam invasi rayim piśaṅgam bahulam puru-spr̥ham pavamāna abhi arṣasi
mr̥jānaḥ vāre pavamānaḥ avyaye vr̥ṣā ava cakradaḥ vane devānām soma pavamāna niḥ-kr̥tam gobhiḥ añjānaḥ arṣasi
pavasva vāja-sātaye abhi viśvāni kāvyā tvam samudram prathamaḥ vi dhārayaḥ devebhyaḥ soma matsaraḥ
saḥ tu pavasva pari pārthivam rajaḥ divyā ca soma dharma-bhiḥ tvām viprāsaḥ mati-bhiḥ vi-cakṣaṇa śubhram hinvanti dhīti-bhiḥ
pavamānāḥ asr̥kṣata pavitram ati dhārayā marutvantaḥ matsarāḥ indriyāḥ hayāḥ medhām abhi prayāṁsi ca
apaḥ vasānaḥ pari kośam arṣati induḥ hiyānaḥ sotr̥-bhiḥ janayan jyotiḥ mandanāḥ avīvaśat gāḥ kr̥ṇvānaḥ na niḥ-nijam
pavasva madhumat-tamaḥ indrāya soma kratuvit-tamaḥ madaḥ mahi dyukṣa-tamaḥ madaḥ
yasya te pītvā vr̥ṣabhaḥ vr̥ṣa-yate asya pītā svaḥ-vidaḥ saḥ su-praketaḥ abhi akramīt iṣaḥ accha vājam na etaśaḥ
tvam hi aṅga daivyā pavamāna janimāni dyumat-tamaḥ amr̥ta-tvāya ghoṣayaḥ
yena nava-gvaḥ dadhyaṅ apa-ūrṇute yena viprāsaḥ āpire devānām sumne amr̥tasya cāruṇaḥ yena śravāṁsi ānaśuḥ
eṣaḥ syaḥ dhārayā sutaḥ avyaḥ vārebhiḥ pavate madin-tamaḥ krīl̥an ūrmiḥ apām-iva
yaḥ usriyāḥ apyāḥ antaḥ aśmanaḥ niḥ gāḥ akr̥ṇtat ojasā abhi vrajam tatniṣe gavyam aśvyam varmī-iva dhr̥ṣṇo iti ā ruja
ā sota pari siñcata aśvam na stomam ap-turam rajaḥ-turam vana-krakṣam uda-prutam
sahasra-dhāram vr̥ṣabham payaḥ-vr̥dham priyam devāya janmane r̥tena yaḥ r̥ta-jātaḥ vi-vavr̥dhe rājā devaḥ r̥tam br̥hat
abhi dyumnam br̥hat yaśaḥ iṣaḥ pate didīhi deva deva-yuḥ vi kośam madhyamam yuva
ā vacyasva su-dakṣa camvoḥ sutaḥ viśām vahniḥ na viśpatiḥ vr̥ṣṭim divaḥ pavasva rītim apām jinva go-iṣṭaye dhiyaḥ
etam oṁ iti tyam mada-cyutam sahasra-dhāram vr̥ṣabham divaḥ duhuḥ viśvā vasūni bibhratam
vr̥ṣā vi jajñe janayan amartyaḥ pra-tapan jyotiṣā tamaḥ saḥ su-stutaḥ kavi-bhiḥ niḥ-nijam dadhe tri-dhātu asya daṁsasā
saḥ sunve yaḥ vasūnām yaḥ rāyām ānetā yaḥ il̥ānām somaḥ yaḥ su-kṣitīnām
yasya naḥ indraḥ pibāt yasya marutaḥ yasya vā aryamaṇā bhagaḥ ā yena mitrāvaruṇā karāmahe ā indram avase mahe
indrāya soma pātave nr̥-bhiḥ yataḥ su-āyudhaḥ madin-tamaḥ pavasva madhumat-tamaḥ
indrasya hārdi soma-dhānam ā viśa samudram-iva sindhavaḥ juṣṭaḥ mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave divaḥ viṣṭambhaḥ ut-tamaḥ
pari pra dhanva indrāya soma svāduḥ mitrāya pūṣṇe bhagāya
indraḥ te soma sutasya peyāḥ kratve dakṣāya viśve ca devāḥ
eva amr̥tāya mahe kṣayāya saḥ śukraḥ arṣa divyaḥ pīyūṣaḥ
pavasva soma mahān samudraḥ pitā devānām viśvā abhi dhāma
śukraḥ pavasva devebhyaḥ soma dive pr̥thivyai śam ca pra-jāyai
divaḥ dhartā asi śukraḥ pīyūṣaḥ satye vi-dharman vājī pavasva
pavasva soma dyumnī su-dhāraḥ mahām avīnām anu pūrvyaḥ
nr̥-bhiḥ yemānaḥ jajñānaḥ pūtaḥ kṣarat viśvāni mandraḥ svaḥ-vit
induḥ punānaḥ pra-jām urāṇaḥ karat viśvāni draviṇāni naḥ
pavasva soma kratve dakṣāya aśvaḥ na niktaḥ vājī dhanāya
tam te sotāraḥ rasam madāya punanti somam mahe dyumnāya
śiśum jajñānam harim mr̥janti pavitre somam devebhyaḥ indum
induḥ paviṣṭa cāruḥ madāya apām upa-sthe kaviḥ bhagāya
bibharti cāru indrasya nāma yena viśvāni vr̥trā jaghāna
pibanti asya viśve devāsaḥ gobhiḥ śrītasya nr̥-bhiḥ sutasya
pra suvānaḥ akṣāriti sahasra-dhāraḥ tiraḥ pavitram vi vāram avyam
saḥ vājī akṣāriti sahasra-retāḥ at-bhiḥ mr̥jānaḥ gobhiḥ śrīṇānaḥ
pra soma yāhi indrasya kukṣā nr̥-bhiḥ yemānaḥ adri-bhiḥ sutaḥ
asarji vājī tiraḥ pavitram indrāya somaḥ sahasra-dhāraḥ
añjanti enam madhvaḥ rasena indrāya vr̥ṣṇe indum madāya
devebhyaḥ tvā vr̥thā pājase apaḥ vasānam harim mr̥janti
induḥ indrāya tośate ni tośate śrīṇan ugraḥ riṇan apaḥ
pari oṁ iti su pra dhanva vāja-sātaye pari vr̥trāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ dviṣaḥ taradhyai r̥ṇa-yāḥ naḥ īyase
anu hi tvā sutam soma madāmasi mahe samarya-rājye vājān abhi pavamāna pra gāhase
ajījanaḥ hi pavamāna sūryam vi-dhāre śakmanā payaḥ go-jīrayā raṁhamāṇaḥ purandhyā
ajījanaḥ amr̥ta martyeṣu ā r̥tasya dharman amr̥tasya cāruṇaḥ sadā asaraḥ vājam accha sanisyadat
abhi-abhi hi śravasā tatarditha utsam na kam cit jana-pānam akṣitam śaryābhiḥ na bharamāṇaḥ gabhastyoḥ
āt īm ke cit paśyamānāsaḥ āpyam vasu-rucaḥ divyāḥ abhi anūṣata vāram na devaḥ savitā vi ūrṇute
tve iti soma prathamāḥ vr̥kta-barhiṣaḥ mahe vājāya śravase dhiyam dadhuḥ saḥ tvam naḥ vīra vīryāya codaya
divaḥ pīyūṣam pūrvyam yat ukthyam mahaḥ gāhāt divaḥ ā niḥ adhukṣata indram abhi jāyamānam sam asvaran
adha yat ime iti pavamāna rodasī iti imā ca viśvā bhuvanā abhi jajmanā yūthe na niḥ-sthāḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ vi tiṣṭhase
somaḥ punānaḥ avyaye vāre śiśuḥ na krīl̥an pavamānaḥ akṣāriti sahasra-dhāraḥ śata-vājaḥ induḥ
eṣaḥ punānaḥ madhu-mān r̥ta-vā indrāya induḥ pavate svāduḥ ūrmiḥ vāja-saniḥ varivaḥ-vit vayaḥ-dhāḥ
saḥ pavasva sahamānaḥ pr̥tanyūn sedhan rakṣāṁsi apa duḥ-gahāṇi su-āyudhaḥ sasahvān soma śatrūn
ayā rucā hariṇyā punānaḥ viśvā dveṣāṁsi tarati svayugva-bhiḥ sūraḥ na svayugva-bhiḥ dhārā sutasya rocate punānaḥ aruṣaḥ hariḥ viśvā yat rūpā pari-yāti r̥kva-bhiḥ sapta-āsyebhiḥ r̥kva-bhiḥ
tvam tyat paṇīnām vidaḥ vasu sam mātr̥-bhiḥ marjayasi sve ā dame r̥tasya dhīti-bhiḥ dame parāvataḥ na sāma tat yatra raṇanti dhītayaḥ tridhātu-bhiḥ aruṣībhiḥ vayaḥ dadhe rocamānaḥ vayaḥ dadhe
pūrvām anu pra-diśam yāti cekitat sam raśmi-bhiḥ yatate darśataḥ rathaḥ daivyaḥ darśataḥ rathaḥ agman ukthāni paiṁsyā indram jaitrāya harṣayan vajraḥ ca yat bhavathaḥ anapa-cyutā samat-su anapa-cyutā
nānānam vai oṁ iti naḥ dhiyaḥ vi vratāni janānām takṣā riṣṭam rutam bhiṣak brahmā sunvantam icchati indrāya indo iti pari srava
jaratībhiḥ oṣadhībhiḥ parṇebhiḥ śakunānām kārmāraḥ aśma-bhiḥ dyu-bhiḥ hiraṇya-vantam icchati indrāya indo iti pari srava
kāruḥ aham tataḥ bhiṣak upala-prakṣiṇī nanā nānādhiyaḥ vasu-yavaḥ anu gāḥ-iva tasthima indrāya indo iti pari srava
aśvaḥ vol̥hā sukham ratham hasanām upa-mantriṇaḥ śepaḥ romaṇ-vantau bhedau vāḥ it maṇḍūkaḥ icchati indrāya indo iti pari srava
śaryaṇāvati somam indraḥ pibatu vr̥tra-hā balam dadhānaḥ ātmani kariṣyan vīryam mahat indrāya indo iti pari srava
ā pavasva diśām pate ārjīkāt soma mīḍhavaḥ r̥ta-vākena satyena śraddhayā tapasā sutaḥ indrāya indo iti pari srava
parjanya-vr̥ddham mahiṣam tam sūryasya duhitā ā abharat tam gandharvāḥ prati agr̥bhṇan tam some rasam ā dadhuḥ indrāya indo iti pari srava
r̥tam vadan r̥ta-dyumna satyam vadan satya-karman śraddhām vadan soma rājan dhātrā soma pari-kr̥ta indrāya indo iti pari srava
satyam-ugrasya br̥hataḥ sam sravanti sam-sravāḥ sam yanti rasinaḥ rasāḥ punānaḥ brahmaṇā hare indrāya indo iti pari srava
yatra brahmā pavamāna chandasyām vācam vadan grāvṇā some mahīyate somena ānandam janayan indrāya indo iti pari srava
yatra jyotiḥ ajasram yasmin loke svaḥ hitam tasmin mām dhehi pavamāna amr̥te loke akṣite indrāya indo iti pari srava
yatra rājā vaivasvataḥ yatra ava-rodhanam divaḥ yatra amūḥ yahvatīḥ āpaḥ tatra mām amr̥tam kr̥dhi indrāya indo iti pari srava
yatra anu-kāmam caraṇam tri-nāke tri-dive divaḥ lokāḥ yatra jyotiṣmantaḥ tatra mām amr̥tam kr̥dhi indrāya indo iti pari srava
yatra kāmāḥ ni-kāmāḥ ca yatra bradhnasya viṣṭapam svadhā ca yatra tr̥ptiḥ ca tatra mām amr̥tam kr̥dhi indrāya indo iti pari srava
yatra ānandāḥ ca modāḥ ca mudaḥ pra-mudaḥ āsate kāmasya yatra āptāḥ kāmāḥ tatra mām amr̥tam kr̥dhi indrāya indo iti pari srava
yaḥ indoḥ pavamānasya anu dhāmāni akramīt tam āhuḥ su-prajāḥ iti yaḥ te soma avindhat manaḥ indrāya indo iti pari srava
r̥ṣe mantra-kr̥tām stomaiḥ kaśyapa ut-vardhayan giraḥ somam namasya rājānam yaḥ jajñe vīrudhām patiḥ indrāya indo iti pari srava
sapta diśaḥ nānāsūryāḥ sapta hotāraḥ r̥tvijaḥ devāḥ ādityāḥ ye sapta tebhiḥ soma abhi rakṣa naḥ indrāya indo iti pari srava
yat te rājan śr̥tam haviḥ tena soma abhi rakṣa naḥ arāti-vā mā naḥ tārīt mo iti ca naḥ kim cana āmamat indrāya indo iti pari srava
agne br̥han uṣasām ūrdhvaḥ asthāt niḥ-jaganvān tamasaḥ jyotiṣā ā agāt agniḥ bhānunā ruśatā su-aṅgaḥ ā jātaḥ viśvā sadmāni aprāḥ
saḥ jātaḥ garbhaḥ asi rodasyoḥ agne cāruḥ vi-bhr̥taḥ oṣadhīṣu citraḥ śiśuḥ pari tamāṁsi aktūn pra mātr̥-bhyaḥ adhi kanikradat gāḥ
viṣṇuḥ itthā paramam asya vidvān jātaḥ br̥han abhi pāti tr̥tīyam āsā yat asya payaḥ akrata svam sa-cetasaḥ abhi arcanti atra
ataḥ oṁ iti tvā pitu-bhr̥taḥ janitrīḥ anna-vr̥dham prati caranti annaiḥ tāḥ īm prati eṣi punaḥ anya-rūpāḥ asi tvam vikṣu mānuṣīṣu hotā
hotāram citra-ratham adhvarasya yajñasya-yajñasya ketum ruśantam prati-ardhim devasya-devasya mahnā śriyā tvam agnim atithim janānām
saḥ tu vastrāṇi adha peśanāni vasānaḥ agniḥ nābhā pr̥thivyāḥ aruṣaḥ jātaḥ pade il̥āyāḥ puraḥ-hitaḥ rājan yakṣi iha devān
ā hi dyāvāpr̥thivī iti agne ubhe iti sadā putraḥ na mātarā tatantha pra yāhi accha uśataḥ yaviṣṭha atha ā vaha sahasya iha devān
piprīhi devān uśataḥ yaviṣṭha vidvān r̥tūn r̥tu-pate yaja iha ye daivyāḥ r̥tvijaḥ tebhiḥ agne tvam hotr̥r̥r̥ṇām asi āyajiṣṭhaḥ
veṣi hotram uta potram janānām mandhātā asi draviṇaḥ-dāḥ r̥ta-vā svāhā vayam kr̥ṇavāma havīṁṣi devaḥ devān yajatu agniḥ arhan
ā devānām api panthām aganma yat śaknavāma tat anu pra-vol̥hum agniḥ vidvān saḥ yajat saḥ it oṁ iti hotā saḥ adhvarān saḥ r̥tūn kalpayāti
tat vaḥ vayam pra-mināma vratāni viduṣām devāḥ aviduḥ-tarāsaḥ agniḥ tat viśvam ā pr̥ṇāti vidvān yebhiḥ devān r̥tu-bhiḥ kalpayāti
yat pāka-trā manasā dīna-dakṣāḥ na yajñasya manvate martyāsaḥ agniḥ tat hotā kratu-vit vi-jānan yajiṣṭhaḥ devān r̥tu-śaḥ yajāti
viśveṣām hi adhvarāṇām anīkam citram ketum janitā tvā jajāna saḥ ā yajasva nr̥-vatīḥ anu kṣāḥ spārhāḥ iṣaḥ kṣu-matīḥ visva-janyāḥ
yam tvā dyāvāpr̥thivī iti yam tvā āpaḥ tvaṣṭā yam tvā su-jamimā jajāna panthām anu pra-vidvān pitr̥-yānam dyu-mat agne sam-idhānaḥ vi bhāhi
inaḥ rājan aratiḥ sam-iddhaḥ raudraḥ dakṣāya susu-mān adarśi cikit vi bhāti br̥hatā asiknīm eti ruśatīm apa-ajan
kr̥ṣṇām yat enīm abhi varpasā bhūt janayan yoṣām br̥hataḥ pituḥ jām ūrdhvam bhānum sūryasya stabhāyan divaḥ vasu-bhiḥ aratiḥ vi bhāti
bhadraḥ bhadrayā sacamānaḥ ā agāt svasāram jāraḥ abhi eti paścāt su-praketaiḥ dyu-bhiḥ agniḥ vi-tiṣṭhan ruśat-bhiḥ varṇaiḥ abhi rāmam asthāt
asya yāmāsaḥ br̥hataḥ na vagnūn indhānāḥ agneḥ sakhyuḥ śivasya īḍyasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ br̥hataḥ su-āsaḥ bhāmāsaḥ yāman aktavaḥ cikitre
svanāḥ na yasya bhāmāsaḥ pavante rocamānasya br̥hataḥ su-divaḥ jyeṣṭhebhiḥ yaḥ tejiṣṭhaiḥ krīl̥umat-bhiḥ varṣiṣṭhebhiḥ bhānu-bhiḥ nakṣati dyām
asya śuṣmāsaḥ dadr̥śāna-paveḥ jehamānasya svanayan niyut-bhiḥ pratnebhiḥ yaḥ ruśat-bhiḥ deva-tamaḥ vi rebhat-bhiḥ aratiḥ bhāti v i-bhvā
saḥ ā vakṣi mahi naḥ ā ca satsi divaḥpr̥thivyoḥ aratiḥ yuvatyoḥ agniḥ su-tukaḥ sut-ukebhiḥ aśvaiḥ rabhasvat-bhiḥ rabhasvān ā iha gamyāḥ
pra te yakṣi pra te iyarmi manma bhuvaḥ yathā vandyaḥ naḥ haveṣu dhanvan-iva pra-pā asi tvam agne iyakṣave pūrave pratna rājan
yam tvā janāsaḥ abhi sam-caranti gāvaḥ uṣṇam-iva vrajam yaviṣṭha dūtaḥ devānām asi martyānām antaḥ mahān carasi rocanena
śiśum na tvā jenyam vardhayantī mātā bibharti sacanasyamānā dhanoḥ adhi pra-vatā yāsi haryam jagīṣase paśuḥ-iva ava-sr̥ṣṭaḥ
mūrāḥ amūra na vayam cikitvaḥ mahi-tvam agne tvam aṅga vitse śaye vavriḥ carati jihvayā adan rerihyate yuvatim viśpatiḥ san
kū-cit jāyate sanayāsu navyaḥ vane tasthau palitaḥ dhūma-ketuḥ asnātā āpaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ na pra veti sa-cetasaḥ yam pra-nayanta matārḥ
tanūtyajāiva taskarā vanargū iti raśanābhiḥ daśa-bhiḥ abhi adhītām iyam te agne navyasī manīṣā yukṣva ratham na śucayat-bhiḥ aṅgaiḥ
brahma ca te jāta-vedaḥ namaḥ ca iyam ca gīḥ sadam it vardhanī bhūt rakṣa naḥ agne tanayāni tokā rakṣa uta naḥ tanvaḥ apra-yucchan
ekaḥ samudraḥ dharuṇaḥ rayīṇām asmat hr̥daḥ bhūri-janmā vi caṣṭe si sakti ūdhaḥ niṇyoḥ upa-sthe utsasya madhye ni-hitam padam veritiveḥ
samānam nīl̥am vr̥ṣaṇaḥ vasānāḥ sam jagmire mahiṣāḥ arvatībhiḥ r̥tasya padam kavayaḥ ni pānti guhā nāmāni dadhire parāṇi
r̥tayinī ity r̥r̥ta-yinī māyinī iti sam dadhāteiti mitvā śiśum jajñatuḥ vardhayantī iti viśvasya nābhim carataḥ dhruvasya kaveḥ cit tantum manasā vi-yantaḥ
r̥tasya hi vartanayaḥ su-jātam iṣaḥ vājāya pra-divaḥ sacante adhīvāsam rodasī iti vavasāne iti ghr̥taiḥ annaiḥ vavr̥dhāteiti madhūnām
sapta svasr̥r̥r̥ḥ aruṣīḥ vāvaśānaḥ vidvān madhvaḥ ut jabhāra dr̥śe kam antaḥ yeme antarikṣe purājāḥ icchan vavrim avidat pūṣaṇasya
sapta maryādāḥ kavayaḥ tatakṣuḥ tāsām ekām it abhi aṁhuraḥ gāt āyoḥ ha skambhaḥ upa-masya nīl̥e pathām vi-sarge dharuṇeṣu tasthau
asat ca sat ca parame vi-oman dakṣasya janman aditeḥ upa-sthe agniḥ ha naḥ prathama-jāḥ r̥tasya pūrve āyuni vr̥ṣabhaḥ ca dhenuḥ
ayam saḥ yasya śarman avaḥ-bhiḥ agneḥ edhate jaritā abhiṣṭau jyeṣṭhebhiḥ yaḥ bhānu-bhiḥ r̥ṣūṇām pari-eti pari-vītaḥ vibhāvā
yaḥ bhānu-bhiḥ vibhāvā vi-bhāti agniḥ devebhiḥ r̥ta-vā ajasraḥ ā yaḥ vivāya sakhyā sakhi-bhyaḥ pari-hvr̥taḥ atyaḥ na saptiḥ
īśe yaḥ viśvasyāḥ deva-vīteḥ īśe viśva-āyuḥ uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭau ā yasmin manā havīṁṣi agnau ariṣṭa-rathaḥ skabhnāti śūṣaiḥ
śūṣebhiḥ vr̥dhaḥ juṣāṇaḥ arkaiḥ devān accha raghu-patvā jagāti mandraḥ hotā saḥ juhvā yajiṣṭhaḥ sam-miślaḥ agniḥ ā jigharti devān
tam usrām indram na rejamānam agnim gīḥ-bhiḥ namaḥ-bhiḥ ā kr̥ṇudhvam ā yam viprāsaḥ mati-bhiḥ gr̥ṇanti jāta-vedasam juhvam sahānām
sam yasmin viśvā vasūni jagmuḥ vāje na aśvāḥ sapti-vantaḥ evaiḥ asme iti ūtīḥ indravāta-tamāḥ arvācīnāḥ agne ā kr̥ṇuṣva
adha hi agne mahnā ni-sadya sadyaḥ jajñānaḥ havyaḥ babhūtha tam te devāsaḥ anu ketam āyan adha avardhanta prathamāsaḥ ūmāḥ
svasti naḥ divaḥ agne pr̥thivyāḥ viśva-āyuḥ dhehi yajathāya deva sacemahi tava dasma pra-ketaiḥ uruṣya naḥ uru-bhiḥ deva śaṁsaiḥ
imāḥ agne matayaḥ tubhyam jātāḥ gobhiḥ aśvaiḥ abhi gr̥ṇanti rādhaḥ yadā te martaḥ anu bhogam ānaṭ vaso iti dadhānaḥ mati-bhiḥ su-jāta
agnim manye pitaram agnim āpim agnim bhrātaram sadam it sakhāyam agneḥ anīkam br̥hataḥ saparyan divi śukram yajatam sūryasya
sidhrāḥ agne dhiyaḥ asme iti sanutrīḥ yam trāyase dame ā nitya-hotā r̥ta-vā saḥ rohit-aśvaḥ puru-kṣuḥ dyu-bhiḥ asmai aha-bhiḥ vāmam astu
dyu-bhiḥ hitam mitram-iva pra-yogam pratnam r̥tvijam adhvarasya jāram bāhu-bhyām agnim āyavaḥ ajananta vikṣu hotāram ni asādayanta
svayam yajasva divi deva devān kim te pākaḥ kr̥ṇavat apra-cetāḥ yathā ayajaḥ r̥tu-bhiḥ deva devān eva yajasva tanvam su-jāta
bhava naḥ agne avitā uta gopāḥ bhava vayaḥ-kr̥t uta naḥ vayaḥ-dhāḥ rāsva ca naḥ su-mahaḥ havya-dātim trāsva uta naḥ tanvaḥ apra-yucchan
pra ketunā br̥hatā yāti agniḥ ā rodasī iti vr̥ṣabhaḥ roravīti divaḥ cit antān upa-mān ut ānaṭ apām upa-sthe mahiṣaḥ vavardha
mumoda garbhaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ kakut-mān asremā vatsaḥ śimī-vān arāvīt saḥ deva-tāti ut-yatāni kr̥ṇvan sveṣu kṣayeṣu prathamaḥ jigāti
ā yaḥ mūrdhānam pitroḥ arabdha ni adhvare dadhire sūraḥ arṇaḥ asya patman aruṣīḥ aśva-budhnāḥ r̥tasya yonau tanvaḥ juṣanta
uṣaḥ-uṣaḥ hi vaso iti agram eṣi tvam yamayoḥ abhavaḥ vibhāvā r̥tāya sapta dadhiṣe padāni janayan mitram tanve svāyai
bhuvaḥ cakṣuḥ mahaḥ r̥tasya gopāḥ bhuvaḥ varuṇaḥ yat r̥tāya veṣi bhuvaḥ apām napāt jāta-vedaḥ bhuvaḥ dūtaḥ yasya havyam jujoṣaḥ
bhuvaḥ yajñasya rajasaḥ ca netā yatra niyut-bhiḥ sacase śivābhiḥ d ivi mūrdhānam dadhiṣe svaḥ-sām jihvām agne cakr̥ṣe havya-vāham
asya tritaḥ kratunā vavre antaḥ icchan dhītim pituḥ evaiḥ parasya sacasyamānaḥ pitroḥ upa-sthe jāmi bruvāṇaḥ āyudhāni veti
saḥ pitryāṇi āyudhāni vidvān indra-iṣitaḥ āptyaḥ abhi ayudhyat tri-śīrṣāṇam sapta-raśmim jaghanvān tvāṣṭrasya cit niḥ sasr̥je tritaḥ gāḥ
bhūri it indraḥ ut-inakṣantam ojaḥ ava abhinat sat-patiḥ manyamānam tvāṣṭrasya cit viśva-rūpasya gonām ācakrāṇaḥ trīṇi śīrṣā parā varka
āpaḥ hi stha mayaḥ-bhuvaḥ tāḥ naḥ ūrje dadhātana mahe raṇāya cakṣase
yaḥ vaḥ śiva-tamaḥ rasaḥ tasya bhājayata iha naḥ uśatīḥ-iva mātaraḥ
tasmai aram gamāma vaḥ yasya kṣayāya jinvatha āpaḥ janayatha ca naḥ
śam naḥ devīḥ abhiṣṭaye āpaḥ bhavantu pītaye śam yoḥ abhi sravantu naḥ
īśānāḥ vāryāṇām kṣayantīḥ carṣaṇīnām apaḥ yācāmi bheṣajam
ap-su me somaḥ abravīt antaḥ viśvāni bheṣajā agnim ca viśva-śambhuvam
āpaḥ pr̥ṇīta bheṣajam varūtham tanve mama jyok ca sūryam dr̥śe
idam āpaḥ pra vahata yat kim ca duḥ-itam mayi yat vā aham abhi--dudroha yat vā śepe uta anr̥tam
āpaḥ adya anu acāriṣam rasena sam agasmahi payasvān agne ā gahi tam mā sam sr̥ja varcasā
o iti cit sakhāyam sakhyā vavr̥tyām tiraḥ puru cit arṇavam jaganvān pituḥ napātam ā dadhīta vedhāḥ adhi kṣami pra-taram dīdhyānaḥ
na te sakhā sakhyam vaṣti etat sa-lakṣmā yat viṣu-rūpā bhavāti mahaḥ putrāsaḥ asurasya vīrāḥ divaḥ dhartāraḥ urviyā pari khyan
uśanti gha te amr̥tāsaḥ etat ekasya cit tyajasam martyasya ni te manaḥ manasi dhāyi asme iti janyuḥ patiḥ tanvam ā viviśyāḥ
na yat purā cakr̥ma kat ha nūnam r̥tā vadantaḥ anr̥tam rapema gandharvaḥ ap-su apyā ca yoṣā sā naḥ nābhiḥ paramam jāmi tat nau
garbhe nu nau janitā dampatī itidam-patī kaḥ devaḥ tvaṣṭā savitā viśva-rūpaḥ nakiḥ asya pra minanti vratāni veda nau asya pr̥thivī uta dyauḥ
kaḥ asya veda prathamasya ahnaḥ kaḥ īm dr̥rśa kaḥ iha pra vocat br̥hat mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma kat oṁ iti bravaḥ āhanaḥ vīcyā nr̥r̥n
yamasya mā yamyam kāmaḥ ā agan samāne yonau saha-śeyyāya jāyāiva patye tanvam riricyām vi cit vr̥heva rathyāiva cakrā
na tiṣṭhanti na ni miṣanti ete devānām spaśaḥ iha ye caranti anyena mat āhanaḥ yāhi tūyam tena vi vr̥heva rathyāiva cakrā
rātrībhiḥ asmai aha-bhiḥ daśasyet sūryasya cakṣuḥ muhuḥ ut mimīyāt divā pr̥thivyā mithunā sabandhūitisa-bandhū yamīḥ yamasya bibhr̥yāt ajāmi
ā gha tā gacchān ut-tarā yugāni yatra jāmayaḥ kr̥ṇavan ajāmi upa barbr̥hi vr̥ṣabhāya bāhum anyam icchasva su-bhage patim mat
kim bhrātā asat yat anātham bhavāti kim oṁ iti svasā yat niḥ-r̥tiḥ ni-gacchāt kāma-mūtā bahu etat rapāmi tanvā me tanvam sam pipr̥gdhi
na vai oṁ iti te tanvā tanvam sam papr̥cyām pāpam āhuḥ yaḥ svasāram ni-gacchāt anyena mat pra-mudaḥ kalpayasva na te bhrātā su-bhage vaṣṭi etat
bataḥ bata asi yama na eva te manaḥ hr̥dayam ca avidāma anyā k ila tvām kakṣyāiva yuktam pari svajāte libujāiva vr̥kṣam
anyam oṁ iti su tvam yami anyaḥ oṁ iti tvām pari svajāte libujāiva vr̥kṣam tasya vā tvam manaḥ icchā saḥ vā tava adha kr̥ṇuṣva sam-vidam su-bhadrām
vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣṇe duduhe dohasā divaḥ payāṁsi yahvaḥ aditeḥ adābhyaḥ viśvam saḥ veda varuṇaḥ yathā dhiyā saḥ yajñiyaḥ yajatu yajñiyān r̥tūn
rapat gandharvīḥ apyā ca yoṣaṇā nadasya nāde pari pātu me manaḥ iṣṭasya madhye aditiḥ ni dhātu naḥ bhrātā naḥ jyeṣṭhaḥ prathamaḥ v i vocati
so iti cit nu bhadrā kṣu-matī yaśasvatī uṣāḥ uvāsa manave svaḥ-vatī yat īm uśantam uśatām anu r̥tum agnim hotāram vidathāya jījanan
adha tyam drapsam vibhvam vi-cakṣaṇam viḥ ā abharat iṣitaḥ śyenaḥ adhvare yadi viśaḥ vr̥ṇate dasmam āryāḥ agnim hotāram adha dhīḥ ajāyata
sadā asi raṇvaḥ yavasāiva puṣyate hotrābhiḥ agne manuṣaḥ su-adhvaraḥ viprasya vā yat śaśamānaḥ ukthyam vājam sasa-vān upa-yāsi bhūri-bhiḥ
ut īraya pitarā jāraḥ ā bhagam iyakṣati haryataḥ hr̥ttaḥ iṣyati v ivakti vahniḥ su-apasyate makhaḥ taviṣyate asuraḥ vepate matī
yaḥ te agne su-matim martaḥ akṣat sahasaḥ sūno iti ati saḥ pra śr̥ṇve iṣam dadhānaḥ vahamānaḥ aśvaiḥ ā saḥ dyu-mān ama-vān bhūṣati dyūn
yat agne eṣā sam-itiḥ bhavāti devī deveṣu yajatā yajatra ratnā ca yat vi-bhajāsi svadhāvaḥ bhāgam naḥ atra vasu-mantam vītāt
śrudhi naḥ agne sadane sadha-sthe yukṣva ratham amr̥tasya dravitnum ā naḥ vaha rodasī iti devaputreitideva-putre mākiḥ devānām apa bhūḥ iha syāḥ
dyāvā ha kṣāmā prathame iti r̥tena abhi-śrāve bhavataḥ satya-vācā devaḥ yat martān yajathāya kr̥ṇvan sīdat hotā pratyaṅ svam asum yan
devaḥ devān pari-bhūḥ r̥tena vaha naḥ havyam prathamaḥ cikitvān dhūma-ketuḥ sam-idhā bhāḥ-r̥jīkaḥ mandraḥ hotā nityaḥ vācā yajīyān
svāvr̥k devasya amr̥tam yadi goḥ ataḥ jātāsaḥ dhārayante urvī iti viśve devāḥ anu tat te yajuḥ guḥ duhe yat enī divyam ghr̥tam vārit ivāḥ
arcāmi vām vardhāya apaḥ ghr̥tasnūitighr̥ta-snū dyāvābhūmī iti śr̥ṇutam rodasī iti me ahā yat dyāvaḥ asu-nītim ayan madhvā naḥ atra pitarā śiśītām
kim svit naḥ rājā jagr̥he kat asya ati vratam cakr̥ma kaḥ vi veda mi traḥ cit hi sma juhurāṇaḥ devān ślokaḥ na yātām api vājaḥ asti
duḥ-mantu atra amr̥tasya nāma sa-lakṣmā yat viṣu-rūpā bhavāti yamasya yaḥ manavate su-mantu agne tam r̥ṣva pāhi apra-yucchan
yasmin devāḥ vidathe mādayante vivasvataḥ sadane dhārayante sūrye jyotiḥ adadhuḥ māsi aktūn pari dyotanim carataḥ ajasrā
yasmin devāḥ manmani sam-caranti apīcye na vayam asya vidma mitraḥ naḥ atra aditiḥ anāgān savitā devaḥ varuṇāya vocat
śrudhi naḥ agne sadane sadha-sthe yukṣva ratham amr̥tasya dravitnum ā naḥ vaha rodasī iti devaputreitideva-putre mākiḥ devānām apa bhūḥ iha syāḥ
yuje vām brahma pūrvyam namaḥ-bhiḥ vi ślokaḥ etu pathyāiva sūreḥ śr̥ṇvantu viśve amr̥tasya putrāḥ ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ
yame ivetiyame--iva yatamāneiti yat aitam pra vām bharan mānuṣāḥ deva-yantaḥ ā sīdatam svam oṁ iti lokam vidāneiti svāsasthe itisu-āsasthe bhavatam indave naḥ
pañca padāni rupaḥ anu aroham catuḥ-padīm anu emi vratena akṣareṇa prati mime etām r̥tasya nābhau adhi sam punāmi
devebhyaḥ kam avr̥ṇīta mr̥tyum pra-jāyai kam amr̥tam na avr̥ṇīta br̥haspatim yajñam akr̥ṇvata r̥ṣim priyām yamaḥ tanvam pra arirecīt
sapta kṣaranti śiśave marutvate pitre putrāsaḥ api avīvatan r̥tam ubhe iti it asya ubhayasya rājataḥ ubhe iti yateteiti ubhayasya puṣyataḥ
pareyi-vāṁsam pra-vataḥ mahīḥ anu bahu-bhyaḥ panthām anu-paspaśānam vaivasvatam sam-gamanam janānām yamam rājānam haviṣā duvasya
yamaḥ naḥ gātum prathamaḥ viveda na eṣā gavyūtir apa-bhartavai oṁ iti yatra naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ parāīyuḥ enā jajñānāḥ pathyāḥ anu svāḥ
mātalī kavyaiḥ yamaḥ aṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ br̥haspatiḥ r̥kva-bhiḥ vavr̥dhānaḥ yān ca devāḥ vavr̥dhuḥ ye ca devān svāhā anye svadhayā anye madanti
imam yama pra-staram ā hi sīda aṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ pitr̥-bhiḥ sam-vidānaḥ ā tvā mantrāḥ kavi-śastāḥ vahantu enā rājan haviṣā mādayasva
aṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ ā gahi yajñiyebhiḥ yama vairūpaiḥ iha mādayasva vivasvantam huve yaḥ pitā te asmin yajñe barhiṣi ā ni-sadya
aṅgirasaḥ naḥ pitaraḥ nava-gvāḥ atharvāṇaḥ bhr̥gavaḥ somyāsaḥ teṣām vayam su-matau yajñiyānām api bhadre saumanase syāma
pra ihi pra ihi pathi-bhiḥ pūrvyebhiḥ yatra naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ parāīyuḥ ubhā rājānā svadhayā madantā yamam paśyāsi varuṇam ca devam
sam gacchasva pitr̥-bhiḥ sam yamena iṣṭāpūrtena parame vi-oman h itvāya avadyam punaḥ astam ā ihi sam gacchasva tanvā su-varcāḥ
apa ita vi ita vi ca sarpata ataḥ asmai etam pitaraḥ lokam akran ahaḥ-bhiḥ at-bhiḥ aktu-bhiḥ vi-aktam yamaḥ dadāti ava-sānam asmai
ati drava sārameyau śvānau catuḥ-akṣau śabalau sādhunā pathā atha pitr̥r̥n su-vidatrān upa ihi yamena ye sadha-mādam madanti
yau te śvānau yama rakṣitārau catuḥ-akṣau pathirakṣī itipathi-rakṣī nr̥-cakṣasau tābhyām enam pari dehi rājan svasti ca asmai anamīvam ca dhehi
uru-nasau asu-tr̥pau udumbalau yamasya dūtau carataḥ janān anu tau asmabhyam dr̥śaye sūryāya punaḥ dātām asum adya iha bhadram
yamāya somam sunuta yamāya juhuta haviḥ yamam ha yajñaḥ gacchat i agni-dūtaḥ aram-kr̥taḥ
yamāya ghr̥ta-vat haviḥ juhota pra ca tiṣṭhata saḥ naḥ deveṣu ā yamat dīrgham āyuḥ pra jīvase
yamāya madhumat-tamam rājñe havyam juhotana idam namaḥ r̥ṣi-bhyaḥ pūrva-jebhyaḥ pūrvebhyaḥ pathikr̥t-bhyaḥ
tri-kadrukebhiḥ patati ṣaṭ urvīḥ ekam it br̥hat tri-stup gāyatrī chandāṁsi sarvā tā yame āhitā
ut īratām avare ut parāsaḥ ut madhyamāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ asum ye īyuḥ avr̥kāḥ r̥ta-jñāḥ te naḥ avantu pitaraḥ haveṣu
idam pitr̥-bhyaḥ namaḥ astu adya ye pūrvāsaḥ ye uparāsaḥ īyuḥ ye pārthive rajasi ā ni-sattāḥ ye vā nūnam su-vr̥janāsu vikṣu
ā aham pitr̥r̥n su-vidatrān avitsi napātam ca vi-kramaṇam ca viṣṇoḥ barhi-sadaḥ ye svadhayā sutasya bhajanta pitvaḥ te iha āgamiṣṭhāḥ
barhi-sadaḥ pitaraḥ ūtī arvāk imā vaḥ havyā cakr̥ma juṣadhvam te ā gata avasā śam-tamena atha naḥ śam yoḥ arapaḥ dadhāta
upa-hūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ barhiṣyeṣu ni-dhiṣu priyeṣu te ā gamantu te iha śrivantu adhi bruvantu te avantu asmān
ācya jānu dakṣiṇataḥ ni-sadya imam yajñam abhi gr̥ṇīta viśve mā hi ṁsiṣṭa pitaraḥ kena cit naḥ yat vaḥ āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma
āsīnāsaḥ aruṇīnām upa-sthe rayim dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya putrebhyaḥ pitaraḥ tasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata te iha ūrjam dadhāta
ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ anu-ūhire soma-pītham vasiṣṭhāḥ tebhiḥ yamaḥ sam-rarāṇaḥ havīṁṣi uśan eśat-bhiḥ prati-kāmam attu
ye tatr̥ṣuḥ devatrā jehamānāḥ hotrāvidaḥ stoma-taṣṭāsaḥ arkaiḥ ā agne yāhi su-vidatrebhiḥ arvāṅ satyaiḥ kavyaiḥ pitr̥-bhiḥ gharmasat-bhiḥ
ye satyāsaḥ haviḥ-adaḥ haviḥ-pāḥ indreṇa devaiḥ sa-ratham dadhānāḥ ā agne yāhi sahasram deva-vandaiḥ paraiḥ pūrvaiḥ pitr̥-bhiḥ gharmasat-bhiḥ
agni-svāttāḥ pitaraḥ ā iha gacchata sadaḥ-sadaḥ sadata su-pranītayaḥ atta havīṁṣi pra-yatāni barhiṣi atha rayim sarva-vīram dadhātana
tvam agne īl̥itaḥ jāta-vedaḥ avāṭ havyāni surabhīṇi kr̥tvī pra adāḥ p itr̥-bhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣan addhi tvam deva pra-yatā havīṁṣi
ye ca iha pitaraḥ ye ca na iha yān ca vidma yān oṁ iti ca na pra-vidma tvam vettha yati te jāta-vedaḥ svadhābhiḥ yajñam su-kr̥tam juṣasva
ye agni-dagdhāḥ ye anagni-dagdhāḥ madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante tebhiḥ sva-rāṭ asu-nītim etām yathāvaśam tanvam kalpayasva
mā enam agne vi dahaḥ mā abhi śocaḥ mā asya tvacam cikṣipaḥ mā śarīram yadā śr̥tam kr̥ṇavaḥ jāta-vedaḥ atha īm enam pra hiṇutāt pitr̥-bhyaḥ
śr̥tam yadā karasi jāta-vedaḥ atha īm enam pari dattāt pitr̥-bhyaḥ yadā gacchāti asu-nītim etām atha devānām vaśa-nīḥ bhavāti
sūryam cakṣuḥ gacchatu vātam ātmā dyām ca gaccha pr̥thivīm ca dharmaṇā apaḥ vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitam oṣadhīṣu prati tiṣṭha śarīraiḥ
ajaḥ bhāgaḥ tapasā tam tapasva tam te śociḥ tapatu tam te arciḥ yāḥ te śivāḥ tanvaḥ jāta-vedaḥ tābhiḥ vaha enam su-kr̥tām oṁ iti lokam
ava sr̥ja punaḥ agne pitr̥-bhyaḥ yaḥ te āhutaḥ carati svadhābhiḥ āyuḥ vasānaḥ upa vetu śeṣaḥ sam gacchatām tanvā jāta-vedaḥ
yat te kr̥ṣṇaḥ śakunaḥ ātutoda pipīlaḥ sarpaḥ uta vā śvāpadaḥ agniḥ tat viśva-at agadam kr̥ṇotu somaḥ ca yaḥ brāhmaṇān āviveśa
agneḥ varma pari gobhiḥ vyayasva sam pra ūṇuṣva pīvasā medasā ca na it tvā dhr̥ṣṇuḥ harasā jarhr̥ṣāṇaḥ dadhr̥k vi-dhakṣyan pari-aṅkhayāte
imam agne camasam mā vi jihvaraḥ priyaḥ devānām uta somyānām eṣaḥ yaḥ camasaḥ deva-pānaḥ tasmin devāḥ amr̥tāḥ mādayante
kravya-adam agnim pra hiṇomi dūram yama-rājñaḥ gacchatu ripra-vāhaḥ iha eva ayam itaraḥ jāta-vedāḥ devebhyaḥ havyam vahatu pra-jānan
yaḥ agniḥ kravya-at pra-viveśa vaḥ gr̥ham imam paśyan itaram jāta-vedasam tam harāmi pitr̥-yajñāya devam saḥ gharmam invāt parame sadha-sthe
yaḥ agniḥ kravya-vāhanaḥ pitr̥r̥n yakṣat r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ pra it oṁ iti havyāni vocati devebhyaḥ ca pitr̥-bhyaḥ ā
uśantaḥ tvā ni dhīmahi uśantaḥ sam idhīmahi uśan uśataḥ ā vaha pitr̥r̥n haviṣe attave
yam tvam agne sam-adahaḥ tam oṁ iti niḥ vāpaya punariti kiyāmbu atra rohatu pāka-dūrvā vi-alkaśā
śītike śītikāvati hrādike hrādikāvati maṇḍūkyā su sam gamaḥ imam su agnim harṣaya
tvaṣṭā duhitre vahatum kr̥ṇoti iti idam viśvam bhuvanam sam eti yamasya mātā pari-uhyamānā mahaḥ jāyā vivavasvataḥ nanāśa
apa agūhan amr̥tām martyebhyaḥ kr̥tvī sa-varṇām adaduḥ vivasvate uta aśvinau abharat yat tat āsīt ajahāt oṁ iti dvā mithunā saraṇyūḥ
pūṣā tvā itaḥ cyavayatu pra vidvān anaṣṭa-paśuḥ bhuvanasya gopāḥ saḥ tvā etebhyaḥ pari dadat pitr̥-bhyaḥ agniḥ devebhyaḥ su-vidatr iyebhyaḥ
āyuḥ viśva-āyuḥ pari pāsati tvā pūṣā tvā pātu pra-pathe purastāt yatra āsate su-kr̥taḥ yatra te yayuḥ tatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu
pūṣā imāḥ āśāḥ anu veda sarvāḥ saḥ asmān abhaya-tamena neṣat svasti-dāḥ āghr̥ṇiḥ sarva-vīraḥ apra-yucchan puraḥ etu pra-jānan
pra-pathe pathām ajaniṣṭa pūṣā pra-pathe divaḥ pra-pathe pr̥thivyāḥ ubhe iti abhi priya-tame sadha-sthe ā ca parā ca carati pra-jānan
sarasvatīm deva-yantaḥ havante sarasvatīm adhvare tāyamāne sarasvatīm su-kr̥taḥ ahvayanta sarasvatī dāśuṣe vāryam dāt
sarasvati yā sa-ratham yayātha svadhābhiḥ devi pitr̥-bhiḥ madantī āsadya asmin barhiṣi mādayasva anamīvāḥ iṣaḥ ā dhehi asme iti
sarasvatīm yām pitaraḥ havante dakṣiṇā yajñam abhi-nakṣamāṇāḥ sahasra-argham il̥aḥ atra bhāgam rāyaḥ poṣam yajamāneṣu dhehi
āpaḥ asmān mātaraḥ śundhayantu ghr̥tena naḥ ghr̥ta-pvaḥ punantu vi śvam hi ripram pra-vahanti devīḥ ut it ābhyaḥ śuciḥ ā pūtaḥ emi
drapsaḥ caskanda prathamām anu dyūn imam ca yonim anu yaḥ ca pūrvaḥ samānam yonim anu sam-carantam drapsam juhomi anu sapta hotrāḥ
yaḥ te drapsaḥ skandati yaḥ te aṁśuḥ bāhu-cyutaḥ dhiṣaṇāyāḥ upa-sthāt adhvaryoḥ vā pari vā yaḥ pavitrāt tam te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭ-kr̥tam
yaḥ te drapsaḥ skannaḥ yaḥ te aṁśuḥ avaḥ ca yaḥ paraḥ srucā ayam devaḥ br̥haspatiḥ sam tam siñcatu rādhase
payasvatīḥ oṣadhayaḥ payasvat māmakam vacaḥ apām payasvat it payaḥ tena mā saha śundhata
param mr̥tyo iti anu parā ihi panthām yaḥ te svaḥ itaraḥ deva-yānāt cakṣuṣmate śr̥ṇvate te bravīmi mā naḥ pra-jām ririṣaḥ mā uta vīrān
mr̥tyoḥ padam yopayantaḥ yat aita drāghīyaḥ āyuḥ pra-taram dadhānāḥ āpyāyamānāḥ pra-jayā dhanena śuddhāḥ pūtāḥ bhavata yajñiyāsaḥ
ime jīvāḥ vi mr̥taiḥ ā avavr̥tran abhūt bhadrā deva-hūtiḥ naḥ adya prāñcaḥ agāma nr̥taye hasāya drāghīyaḥ āyuḥ pra-taram dadhānāḥ
imam jīvebhyaḥ pari-dhim dādhāmi mā eṣām nu gāt aparaḥ artham etam śatam jīvantu śaradaḥ purūcīḥ antaḥ mr̥tyum dadhatām parvatena
yathā ahāni anu-pūrvam bhavanti yathā r̥tavaḥ r̥tu-bhiḥ yanti sādhu yathā na pūrvam aparaḥ jahāti eva dhātaḥ āyūṁṣi kalpaya eṣām
ā rahata āyuḥ jarasam vr̥ṇānāḥ anu-pūrvam yatamānāḥ yati stha iha tvaṣṭā su-janimā sa-joṣāḥ dīrgham āyuḥ karati jīvase vaḥ
imāḥ nārīḥ avidhavāḥ su-patnīḥ āñjanena sarpiṣā sam viśantu anaśravaḥ anamīvāḥ su-ratnāḥ ā rohantu janayaḥ yonim agre
ut īrṣva nāri abhi jīva-lokam gata-asum etam upa śeṣe ā ihi hasta-grābhasya didhiṣoḥ tava idam patyuḥ jani-tvam abhi sam babhūtha
dhanuḥ hastāt ādadānaḥ mr̥tasya asme iti kṣatrāya varcase balāya atra eva tvam iha vayam su-vīrāḥ viśvāḥ spr̥dhaḥ abhi-mātīḥ jayema
upa sarpa mātaram bhūmim etām uru-vyacasam pr̥thivīm su-śevām ūrṇa-mradāḥ yuvatiḥ dakṣiṇāvate eṣā tvā pātu niḥ-r̥teḥ upa-sthāt
ut śvañcasva pr̥thivi mā ni bādhathāḥ su-upāyanā asmai bhava su-upavañcanā mātā putram yathā sicā abhi enam bhūme ūrṇuhi
ut-śvañcamānā pr̥thivī su tiṣṭhatu sahasram mitaḥ upa hi śrayantām te gr̥hāsaḥ ghr̥ta-ścutaḥ bhavantu viśvāhā asmai śaraṇāḥ santu atra
ut te stabhnāmi pr̥thivīm tvat pari imam logam ni-dadhat mo iti aham riṣam etām sthūṇām pitaraḥ dhārayantu te atra yamaḥ sadanā te minotu
pratīcīne mām ahani iṣvāḥ parṇam-iva ā dadhuḥ pratīcīm jagrabha vācam aśvam raśanayā yathā
ni vartadhvam mā anu gāta asmān sisakta revatīḥ agnīṣomā punarvasūitipunaḥ-vasū asme iti dhārayatam rayim
punaḥ enāḥ ni vartaya punaḥ enāḥ ni ā kuru indra enāḥ ni yacchatu agniḥ enāḥ upa-ājatu
punaḥ etāḥ ni vartantām asmin puṣyantu go--patau iha eva agne ni dhāraya iha tiṣṭhatu yā rayiḥ
yat ni-yānam ni-ayanam sam-jñānam yat parāyanam āvartanan ni-vartanam yaḥ gopāḥ api tam huve
yaḥ ut-ānaṭ vi-ayanam yaḥ ut-ānaṭ parāyanam āvartanam n i-vartanam api gopāḥ ni vartatām
ā ni-varta ni vartaya punaḥ naḥ indra gāḥ dehi jīvābhiḥ bhunajāmahai
pari vaḥ viśvataḥ dadhe ūrjā ghr̥tena payasā ye devāḥ ke ca yajñiyāḥ te rayyā sam sr̥jantu naḥ
ā ni-vartana vartaya ni ni-vartana vartaya bhūmyāḥ catasraḥ pra-diśaḥ tābhyaḥ enāḥ ni vartaya
bhadram naḥ api vātaya manaḥ
agnim īl̥e bhujām yaviṣṭham śāsā mitram duḥ-dharītum yasya dharman svaḥ enīḥ saparyanti mātuḥ ūdhaḥ
yam āsāḥ kr̥pa-nīl̥am bhāsāketum vardhayanti bhrājate śreṇi-dan
aryaḥ viśām gātuḥ eti pra yat ānaṭ divaḥ antān kaviḥ abhram dīdyānaḥ
juṣat havyā mānuṣasya ūrdhvaḥ tasthau r̥bhvā yajñe minvan sadma puraḥ eti
saḥ hi kṣemaḥ haviḥ yajñaḥ śruṣṭī it asya gātuḥ eti agnim devāḥ vāśī-mantam
yajña-saham duvaḥ iṣe agnim pūrvasya śevasya adreḥ sūnum āyum āhuḥ
naraḥ ye ke ca asmat ā viśvā it te vāme ā syuritisyuḥ agnim haviṣā vardhantaḥ
kr̥ṣṇaḥ śvetaḥ aruṣaḥ yāmaḥ asya bradhnaḥ r̥jraḥ uta śoṇaḥ yaśasvān hiraṇya-rūpam janitā jajāna
eva te agne vi-madaḥ manīṣām ūrjaḥ napāt amr̥tebhiḥ sa-joṣāḥ giraḥ ā vakṣat su-matīḥ iyānaḥ iṣam ūrjam su-kṣitim viśvam ā abhār ity abhāḥ
ā agnim na svavr̥kti-bhiḥ hotāram tvā vr̥ṇīmahe yajñāya stīrṇa-barhi ṣe vi vaḥ made śīram pāvaka-śociṣam vivakṣase
tvām oṁ iti te su-ābhuvaḥ śumbhanti aśva-rādhasaḥ veti tvām upa-secanī vi vaḥ made r̥jītiḥ agne āhutiḥ vivakṣase
tve iti dharmāṇaḥ āsate juhūbhiḥ siñcatīḥ-iva kr̥ṣṇā rūpāṇi arjunā vi vaḥ made viśvāḥ adhi śriyaḥ dhiṣe vivakṣase
yam agne manyase rayim sahasāvan amartya tam ā naḥ vāja-sātaye vi vaḥ made yajñeṣu citram ā bhara vivakṣase
agniḥ jātaḥ atharvaṇā vidat viśvāni kāvyā bhuvat dūtaḥ vivasvataḥ v i vaḥ made priyaḥ yamasya kāmyaḥ vivakṣase
tvām yajñeṣu īl̥ate agne pra-yati adhvare tvam vasūni kāmyā vi vaḥ made viśvā dadhāsi dāśuṣe vivakṣase
tvām yajñeṣu r̥tvijam cārum agne ni sedire ghr̥ta-pratīkam manuṣaḥ vi vaḥ made śukam cetiṣṭham akṣa-bhiḥ vivakṣase
agne śukreṇa śociṣā uru prathayase br̥hat abhi-krandan vr̥ṣa-yase vi vaḥ made garbham dadhāsi jāmiṣu vivakṣase
kuha śrutaḥ indraḥ kasmin adya jane mitraḥ na śrūyate r̥ṣīṇām vā yaḥ kṣaye guhā vā carkr̥ṣe girā
iha śrutaḥ indraḥ asme iti adya stave vajrī r̥cīṣamaḥ mitraḥ na yaḥ janeṣu ā yaśaḥ cakre asāmi ā
mahaḥ yaḥ patiḥ śavasaḥ asāmi ā mahaḥ nr̥mṇasya tūtujiḥ bhartā vajrasya dhr̥ṣṇoḥ pitā putram-iva priyam
yujānaḥ aśvā vātasya dhunī iti devaḥ devasya vajri-vaḥ syantā pathā virukmatā sr̥jānaḥ stoṣi adhvanaḥ
tvam tyā cit vātasya aśvā ā agāḥ r̥jrā tmanā vahadhyai yayoḥ devaḥ na martyaḥ yantā nakiḥ vidāyyaḥ
adha gmantā uśanā pr̥cchate vām kat-arthā naḥ ā gr̥ham ā jagmathuḥ parākāt divaḥ ca gmaḥ ca martyam
ā naḥ indra pr̥kṣase asmākam brahma ut-yatam tat tvā yācāmahe avaḥ śuṣṇam yat han amānuṣam
akarmā dasuḥ abhi naḥ amantuḥ anya-vrataḥ amānuṣaḥ tvam tasya amitra-han vadhaḥ dāsasya dambhaya
tvam naḥ indra śūra śūraiḥ uta tvāūtāsaḥ barhanā puru-trā te vi pūrtayaḥ navanta kṣoṇayaḥ yathā
tvam tān vr̥tra-hatye codayaḥ nr̥r̥n kārpāṇe śūra vajri-vaḥ guhā yadi kavīnām viśām nakṣatra-śavasām
makṣu tā te indra dāna-apnasaḥ ākṣāṇe śūra vajri-vaḥ yat ha śuṣṇasya dambhayaḥ jātam viśvam sayāva-bhiḥ
mā akudhryak indra śūra vasvīḥ asme iti bhūvan abhiṣṭayaḥ vayam-vayam te āsām sumne syāma vajri-vaḥ
asme iti tā te indra santu satyā ahiṁsantīḥ upa-spr̥ṣaḥ vidyāma yāsām bhujaḥ dhenūnām na vajri-vaḥ
ahastā yat apadī vardhata kṣāḥ śacībhiḥ vedyānām śuṣṇam pari pra-dakṣiṇit viśva-āyave ni śiśnathaḥ
piba-piba it indra śūra somam mā riṣaṇyaḥ vasavāna vasuḥ san uta trāyasva gr̥ṇataḥ maghonaḥ mahaḥ ca rāyaḥ revataḥ kr̥dhi naḥ
yajāmahe indram vajra-dakṣiṇam harīnām rathyam vi-vratānām pra śmaśru dodhuvat ūrdhva-thā bhūt vi senābhiḥ dayamānaḥ vi rādhasā
harī iti nu asya yā vane vide vasu indraḥ maghaiḥ magha-vā vr̥tra-hā bhuvat r̥bhuḥ vājaḥ r̥bhukṣāḥ patyate śavaḥ ava kṣṇaumi dāsasya nāma c it
yadā vajram hiraṇyam it atha ratham harī iti yam asya vahataḥ vi sūri-bhiḥ ā tiṣṭhati magha-vā sana-śrutaḥ indraḥ vājasya dīrgha-śravasaḥ patiḥ
so iti cit nu vr̥ṣṭiḥ yūthyā svā sacā indraḥ śmaśrūṇi haritā abhi pruṣṇute ava veti su-kṣayam sute madhu ut it dhūnoti vātaḥ yathā vanam
yaḥ vācā vi-vācaḥ mr̥dhra-vācaḥ puru sahasrā asivā jaghāna tat-tat it asya paiṁsyam gr̥ṇīmasi pitāiva yaḥ taviṣīm vavr̥dhe śavaḥ
stomam te indra vi-madāḥ ajījanan apūrvyam puru-tamam su-dānave vidma hi asya bhojanam inasya yat ā paśum na gopāḥ karāmahe
mākiḥ naḥ enā sakhyā vi yauṣuḥ tava ca indra vi-madasya ca r̥ṣeḥ vidma hi te pra-matim deva jāmi-vat asme iti te santu sakhyā śivāni
indra somam imam piba madhu-mantam camū iti sutam asme iti rayim ni dhāraya vi vaḥ made sahasriṇam puruvaso itipuru-vaso vivakṣase
tvām yajñebhiḥ ukthaiḥ upa havyebhiḥ īmahe śacī-pate śacīnam vi vaḥ made śreṣṭham naḥ dhehi vāryam vivakṣase
yaḥ patim vāryāṇām asi radhrasya coditā indra stotr̥r̥ṇām avitā vi vaḥ made dviṣaḥ naḥ pāhi aṁhasaḥ vivakṣase
yuvam śakrā māyāvinā samīcī itisam-īcī niḥ amanthatam vi-madena yat īl̥itā nāsatyā nir- amanthatam
viśve devāḥ akr̥panta sam-īcyoḥ niḥ-patantyoḥ nāsatyau abruvan devāḥ punaḥ ā vahatāt iti
madhu-mat me parāyaṇam madhu-mat punaḥ āyanam tā naḥ devā devatayā yuvam madhu-mataḥ kr̥tam
bhadram naḥ api vātaya manaḥ dakṣam uta kratum adha te sakhye andhasaḥ vi vaḥ made raṇan gāvaḥ na yavase vivakṣase
hr̥di-spr̥śaḥ te āsate viśveṣu soma dhāma-su adha kāmāḥ ime mama vi vaḥ made vi tiṣṭhante vasu-yavaḥ vivakṣase
uta vratāni soma te pra aham mināmi pākyā adha pitāiva sūnave vi vaḥ made mr̥l̥a naḥ abhi cit vadhāt vivakṣase
sam oṁ iti pra yanti dhītayaḥ sargāsaḥ avatān-iva kratum naḥ soma jīvase vi vaḥ made dhāraya camasān-iva vivakṣase
tava tye soma śakti-bhiḥ ni-kāmāsaḥ vi r̥ṇvire gr̥tsasya dhīrāḥ tavasaḥ vi vaḥ made vrajam go--mantam aśvinam vivakṣase
paśum naḥ soma rakṣasi puru-trā vi-sthitam jagat sam-ākr̥ṇoṣi jīvase vi vaḥ made viśvā sam-paśyan bhuvanā vivakṣase
tvam naḥ soma viśvataḥ gopāḥ adābhyaḥ bhava sedha rājan apa sridhaḥ vi vaḥ made mā naḥ duḥ-śaṁsaḥ īśata vivakṣase
tvam naḥ soma su-kratuḥ vayaḥ-dheyāya jāgr̥hi kṣetravit-taraḥ manuṣaḥ vi vaḥ made druhaḥ naḥ pāhi aṁhasaḥ / vivakṣase
tvam naḥ vr̥trahan-tama indrasya indo iti śivaḥ sakhā yat sīm havante sam-ithe vi vaḥ made yudhyamānāḥ toka-sātau vivakṣase
ayam gha saḥ turaḥ madaḥ indrasya vardhata priyaḥ ayam kakṣīvataḥ mahaḥ vi vaḥ made matim viprasya vardhayat vivakṣase
ayam viprāya dāśuṣe vājān iyarti go--mataḥ ayam sapta-bhyaḥ ā varam vi vaḥ made pra andham śroṇam ca tāriṣat vivakṣase
pra hi accha manīṣāḥ spārhāḥ yanti ni-yutaḥ pra dasrā niyut-rathaḥ pūṣā aviṣṭu māhinaḥ
yasya tyat mahi-tvam vātāpyam ayam janaḥ vipraḥ ā vaṁsat dhīti-bhiḥ ciketa su-stutīnām
saḥ veda su-stutīnām induḥ na pūṣā vr̥ṣā abhi psuraḥ pruṣāyati vrajam naḥ ā pruṣāyati
maṁsīmahi tvā vayam asmākam deva pūṣan matīnām ca sādhanam viprāṇām ca ādhavam
prati-ardhiḥ yajñānām aśva-hayaḥ rathānām r̥ṣiḥ saḥ yaḥ manuḥ-h itaḥ viprasya yavayat-sakhaḥ
ādhīṣamāṇāyāḥ patiḥ śucāyāḥ ca śucasya ca vāsaḥ-vāyaḥ avīnām ā vāsāṁsi marmr̥jat
inaḥ vājānām patiḥ inaḥ puṣṭīnām sakhā pra śmaśru haryataḥ dūdhot vi vr̥thā yaḥ adābhyaḥ
ā te rathasya pūṣan ajāḥ dhuram vavr̥tyuḥ viśvasya arthinaḥ sakhā sanaḥ-jāḥ anapa-cyutaḥ
asmākam ūrjā ratham pūṣā aviṣṭu māhinaḥ bhuvat vājānām vr̥dhaḥ imam naḥ śr̥ṇavat havam
asat su me jaritariti saḥ abhi-vegaḥ yat sunvate yajamānāya śikṣam anāśīḥ-dām aham asmi pra-hantā satya-dhvr̥tam vr̥jina-yantam ābhum
yadi it aham yudhaye sam-nayāni adeva-yūn tanvā śūśujānān amā te tumram vr̥ṣabham pacāni tīvram sutam pañca-daśam ni siñcam
na aham tam veda yaḥ iti bravīti adeva-yūn sam-araṇe jaghanvān yadā ava-akhyat sam-araṇam r̥ghāvat āt it ha me vr̥ṣabhā pra bruvant i
yat ajñāteṣu vr̥janeṣu āsam viśve sataḥ magha-vānaḥ me āsan jināmi vā it kṣeme ā santam ābhum pra tam kṣiṇām parvate pāda-gr̥hya
na vai oṁ iti mām vr̥jane vārayante na parvatāsaḥ yat aham manasye mama svanāt kr̥dhu-karṇaḥ bhayāte eva it anu dyūn kiraṇaḥ sam ejāt
darśan nu atra śr̥ta-pān anindrān bāhu-kṣadaḥ śarave patyamānān ghr̥ṣum vā ye niniduḥ sakhāyam adhi oṁ iti nu eṣu pavayaḥ vavr̥tyuḥ
abhūḥ oṁ iti aukṣīḥ vi oṁ iti āyuḥ ānaṭ darṣat nu pūrvaḥ aparaḥ nu darṣat dve iti pavasteiti pari tam na bhūtaḥ yaḥ asya pāre rajasaḥ viveṣa
gāva yavam pra-yutāḥ aryaḥ akṣan tāḥ apaśyam saha-gopāḥ carantīḥ havāḥ it aryaḥ abhitaḥ sam āyan kiyat āsu sva-patiḥ chandayāte
sam yat vayam yavasa-adaḥ janānām aham yava-adaḥ uru-ajre antariti atra yuktaḥ ava-sātāram icchāt atho iti ayuktam yunajat vavanvān
atra it oṁ iti me maṁsase satyam uktam dvi-pāt ca yat catuḥ-pāt sam-sr̥jāni strī-bhiḥ yaḥ atra vr̥ṣaṇam pr̥tanyāt ayuddhaḥ asya vi bhajāni vedaḥ
yasya anakṣā duhitā jātu āsa kaḥ tām vidvān abhi manyāte andhām kataraḥ menim prati tam mucāte yaḥ īm vahāte yaḥ īm vā vare--yāt
kiyatī yoṣā maryataḥ vadhū-yoḥ pari-prītā panyasā vāryeṇa bhadrā vadhūḥ bhavati yat su-peśāḥ svayam sā mitram vanutejanecit
pattaḥ jagāra pratyañcam atti śīrṣṇā śiraḥ prati dadhau varūtham āsīnaḥ ūrdhvām upasi kṣiṇāti nyaṅ uttānām anu eti bhūmim
br̥han acchāyaḥ apalāśaḥ arvā tasthau mātā vi-sitaḥ atti garbhaḥ anyasyāḥ vatsam rihatī mimāya kayā bhuvā ni dadhe dhenuḥ ūdhaḥ
sapta vīrāsaḥ adharāt ut āyan aṣṭa uttarāttāt sam ajagmiran te nava paścātāt sthivi-mantaḥ āyan daśa prāk sānu vi tiranti aśnaḥ
daśānām ekam kapilam samānam tam hinvanti kratave pāryāya gabharm mātā su-dhitam vakṣaṇāsu avenantam tuṣayantī bibharti
pīvānam meṣam apacanta vīrāḥ ni-uptāḥ akṣāḥ anu dīve āsan dvā dhanum br̥hatīm ap-su antariti pavitra-vantā carataḥ punantā
vi krośanāsaḥ viṣvañcaḥ āyan pacāti nemaḥ nahi pakṣat ardhaḥ ayam me devaḥ savitā tat āha dru-annaḥ it vanavat sarpiḥ-annaḥ
apaśyam grāmam vahamānam ārāt acakrayā svadhayā vartamānam sisakti aryaḥ pra yugā janānām sadyaḥ śiśnā pra-minānaḥ navīyān
etau me gāvau pra-marasya yuktau mo iti su pra sedhīḥ muhuḥ it mamandhi āpaḥ cit asya vi naśanti atharm sūraḥ ca markaḥ uparaḥ babhūvān
ayam yaḥ vajraḥ purudhā vi-vr̥ttaḥ avaḥ sūryasya br̥hataḥ purīṣāt śravaḥ it enā paraḥ anyat asti tat avyathī jarimāṇaḥ taranti
vr̥kṣe--vr̥kṣe ni-yatā mīmayat gauḥ tataḥ vayaḥ pra patān puruṣa-adaḥ atha idam viśvam bhuvanam bhayāte indrāya sunvat r̥ṣaye ca śikṣat
devānām māne prathamāḥ atiṣṭhan kr̥ntatrāt eṣām uparāḥ ut āyan trayaḥ tapanti pr̥thivīm anūpāḥ dvā br̥būkam vahataḥ purīṣam
sā te jīvātuḥ uta tasya viddhi mā sma etādr̥k apa gūhaḥ samarye āviḥ svar itisvaḥ kr̥ṇute gūhate busam saḥ pāduḥ asya niḥ-nijaḥ na mucyate
viśvaḥ hi anyaḥ ariḥ ājagāma mama it aha śvaśuraḥ na ā jagāma jakṣīyāt dhānāḥ uta somam papīyāt su-āśitaḥ punaḥ astam jagāyāt
saḥ roruvat vr̥ṣabhaḥ tigma-śr̥ṅgaḥ varṣman tasthau variman ā pr̥thivyāḥ viśveṣu enam vr̥janeṣu pāmi yaḥ me kukṣī iti suta-somaḥ pr̥ṇāti
adriṇā te mandinaḥ indra tūyān sunvanti somān pibasi tvam eṣām pacanti te vr̥ṣabhān atsi teṣām pr̥kṣeṇa yat magha-van hūyamānaḥ
idam su me jaritaḥ ā cikiddhi prati-īpam śāpam nadyaḥ vahanti lopāśaḥ siṁham pratyañcam atsāriti kroṣṭā varāham niḥ atakta kakṣāt
kathā te etat aham ā ciketam gr̥tsasya pākaḥ tavasaḥ manīṣām tvam naḥ vidvān r̥tu-thā vi vocaḥ yam ardham te magha-van kṣemyā dhūḥ
eva hi mām tavasam vardhayanti divaḥ cit me br̥hataḥ ut-tarā dhūḥ puru sahasrā ni śiśāmi sākam aśatrum hi mā janitā jajāna
eva hi mām tavasam jajñuḥ ugram karman-karman vr̥ṣaṇam indra devāḥ vadhīm vr̥tram vajreṇa mandasānaḥ apa vrajam mahinā dāśuṣe vam
devāsaḥ āyan paraśūn abibhran vanā vr̥ścantaḥ abhi viṭ-bhiḥ āyan ni su-dram dadhataḥ vakṣaṇāsu yatra kr̥pīṭam anu tat dahanti
śaśaḥ kṣuram pratyañcam jagāra adrim logena vi abhedam ārāt br̥hantam cit r̥hate randhayāni vayat vatsaḥ vr̥ṣabham śūśuvānaḥ
su-parṇaḥ itthā nakham ā sisāya ava-ruddhaḥ pari-padam na siṁhaḥ ni-ruddhaḥ cit mahiṣaḥ tarṣyāvān godhā tasmai ayatham karṣat etat
tebhyaḥ godhāḥ ayatham karṣat etat ye brahmaṇaḥ prati-pīyanti annaiḥ simaḥ ukṣṇaḥ ava-sr̥ṣṭān adanti svayam balāni tanvaḥ śr̥ṇānāḥ
ete śamībhiḥ su-śamī abhūvan ye hinvire tanvaḥ some ukthaiḥ nr̥-vat vadan upa naḥ māhi vājān divi śravaḥ dadhiṣe nāma vīraḥ
vane na vā yaḥ ni adhāyi cākan śuciḥ vām stomaḥ bhuraṇau ajīgariti yasya it indraḥ puru-dineṣu hotā nr̥ṇām naryaḥ nr̥-tamaḥ kṣapāvān
pra te asyāḥ uṣasaḥ pra aparasyāḥ nr̥tau syāma nr̥-tamasya nr̥ṇām anu tri-śokaḥ śatam ā avahan nr̥r̥n kutsena rathaḥ yaḥ asat sasa-vān
kaḥ te madaḥ indra rantyaḥ bhūt duraḥ giraḥ abhi ugraḥ vi dhāva kat vāhaḥ arvāk upa mā manīṣā ā tvā śakyām upa-mam rādhaḥ annaiḥ
kat oṁ iti dyumnam indra tvāvataḥ nr̥r̥n kayā dhiyā karase kat naḥ ā agan mitraḥ na satyaḥ uru-gāya bhr̥tyai anne samasya yat asan manīṣāḥ
pra īraya sūraḥ artham na pāram ye asya kāmam janidhāḥ-iva gman giraḥ ca ye te tuvi-jāta pūrvīḥ naraḥ indra prati-śikṣanti annaiḥ
mātreiti nu te sumiteitisu-mite indra pūrvī iti dyauḥ majmanā pr̥thivī kāvyena varāya te ghr̥ta-vantaḥ sutāsaḥ svādman bhavantu pītaye madhūni
ā madhvaḥ asmai asican amatram indrāya pūrṇam saḥ hi satya-rādhāḥ saḥ vavr̥dhe variman ā pr̥thivyāḥ abhi kratvā naryaḥ paiṁsyaiḥ ca
vi ānaṭ indraḥ pr̥tanāḥ su-ojāḥ ā asmai yatante sakhyāya pūrvīḥ ā sma ratham na pr̥tanāsu tiṣṭha yam bhadrayā su-matyā codayāse
pra deva-trā brahmaṇe gātuḥ etu apaḥ accha manasaḥ na pra-yukti mahīm mitrasya varuṇasya dhāsim pr̥thu-jrayase rīradha su-vr̥ktim
adhvaryavaḥ haviṣmantaḥ hi bhūta accha apaḥ ita uśatīḥ uśantaḥ ava yāḥ caṣte aruṇaḥ su-parṇaḥ tam ā asyadhvam ūrmim adya su-hastāḥ
adhvaryavaḥ apaḥ ita samudram apām napātam haviṣā yajadhvam saḥ vaḥ dadat ūrmim adya su-pūtam tasmai somam madhu-mantam sunota
yaḥ anidhmaḥ dīdayat ap-su antaḥ yam viprāsaḥ īl̥ate adhvareṣu apām napāt madhu-matīḥ apaḥ dāḥ yābhiḥ indraḥ vavr̥dhe vīryāya
yābhiḥ somaḥ modate harṣate ca kalyāṇībhiḥ yuvati-bhiḥ na maryaḥ tāḥ adhvaryo iti apaḥ accha parā ihi yat āsiñcāḥ oṣadhībhiḥ punītāt
eva it yūne yuvatayaḥ namanta yat īm uśan uṣatīḥ eti accha sam jānate manasā sam cikitre adhvaryavaḥ dhiṣaṇā āpaḥ ca devīḥ
yaḥ vaḥ vr̥tābhyaḥ akr̥ṇot oṁ iti lokam yaḥ vaḥ mahyāḥ abhi-śasteḥ amuñcat tasmai indrāya madhu-mantam ūrmim deva-mādanam pra hiṇotana āpaḥ
pra asmai hinota madhu-mantam ūrmim garbhaḥ yaḥ vaḥ sindhavaḥ madhvaḥ utsaḥ ghr̥ta-pr̥ṣṭham īḍyam adhvareṣu āpaḥ revatīḥ śr̥ṇuta havam me
tam sindhavaḥ matsaram indra-pānam ūrmim pra heta yaḥ ubhe iti iyarti mada-cyutam auśānam nabhaḥ-jām pari tri-tantum vi-carantam utsam
āvarvr̥tatīḥ adha nu dvi-dhārāḥ goṣu-yudhaḥ na ni-yavam carantīḥ r̥ṣe janitrīḥ bhuvanasya patnīḥ apaḥ vandasva sa-vr̥dhaḥ sa-yonīḥ
hinota naḥ adhvaram deva-yajyā hinota brahma sanaye dhanānām r̥tasya yoge vi syadhvam ūdhaḥ śruṣṭī-varīḥ bhūtana asmabhyam āpaḥ
āpaḥ revatīḥ kṣayatha hi vasvaḥ kratum ca bhadram bibhr̥thām r̥tam ca rāyaḥ ca stha su-apatyasya patnīḥ sarasvatī tat gr̥ṇate vayaḥ dhāt
prati yat āpaḥ adr̥śram āyatīḥ ghr̥tam payāṁsi bibhratīḥ madhūni adhvaryu-bhiḥ manasā sam-vidānāḥ indrāya somam su-sutam bharantīḥ
ā imāḥ agman revatīḥ jīva-dhanyāḥ adhvaryavaḥ sādayata sakhāyaḥ ni barhiṣi dhattana somyāsaḥ apām naptrā sam-vidānāsaḥ enāḥ
ā agman āpaḥ uśatīḥ barhiḥ ā idam ni adhvare asadan deva-yantīḥ adhvaryavaḥ sunuta indrāya somam abhūt oṁ iti vaḥ su-śakā deva-yajyā
ā naḥ devānām upa vetu śaṁsaḥ viśvebhiḥ turaiḥ avase yajatraḥ tebh iḥ vayam su-sakhāyaḥ bhavema tarantaḥ viśvā duḥ-itā syāma
pari cit martaḥ draviṇam mamanyāt r̥tasya pathā namasā vivāset uta svena kratunā sam vadeta śreyāṁsam dakṣam manasā jagr̥bhyāt
adhāyi dhītiḥ asasr̥gram aṁśāḥ tīrthe na dasmam upa yanti ūmāḥ abhi ānaśma suvitasya śūṣam navedasaḥ amr̥tānām abhūma
nityaḥ cākanyāt sva-patiḥ damūnāḥ yasmai oṁ iti devaḥ savitā jajāna bhagaḥ vā gobhiḥ aryamā īm anajyāt saḥ asmai cāruḥ chadayat uta syāt
iyam sā bhūyāḥ uṣasām-iva kṣāḥ yat ha kṣu-mantaḥ śavasā sam-āyan asya stutim jarituḥ bhikṣamāṇāḥ ā naḥ śagmāsaḥ upa yantu vājāḥ
asya it eṣā su-matiḥ paprathānā abhavat pūrvyā bhūmanā gauḥ asya sa-nīl̥āḥ asurasya yonau samāne ā bharaṇe bibhramāṇāḥ
kim svit vanam kaḥ oṁ iti saḥ vr̥kṣaḥ āsa yataḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti niḥ-tatakṣuḥ santasthāne itisam-tasthāne ajareiti itaūtī itītaḥ-ūtī ahāni pūrvīḥ uṣasaḥ jaranta
na etāvat enā paraḥ anyat asti ukṣā saḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti bibharti tvacam pavitram kr̥ṇuta svadhāvān yat īm sūryam na haritaḥ vahanti
stegaḥ na kṣam ati eti pr̥thvīm miham na vātaḥ vi ha vāti bhūma mitraḥ yatra varuṇaḥ ajyamānaḥ agniḥ vane na vi asr̥ṣṭa śokam
starīḥ yat sūta sadyaḥ ajyamānā vyathiḥ avyathīḥ kr̥ṇuta sva-gopā putraḥ yat pūrvaḥ pitroḥ janiṣṭa śamyām gauḥ jagāra yat ha pr̥cchān
uta kaṇvam nr̥-sadaḥ putram āhuḥ uta śyāvaḥ dhanam ā adatta vājī pra kr̥ṣṇāya ruśat apinvata ūdhaḥ r̥tam atra nakiḥ asmai apīpet
pra su gmantā dhiyasānasya sakṣaṇi varebhiḥ varān abhi su pra-sīdataḥ asmākam indraḥ ubhayam jujoṣati yat somyasya andhasaḥ bubodhati
vi indra yāsi divyāni rocanā vi pārthivāni rajasā puru-stuta ye tvā vahanti muhuḥ adhvarān upa te su vanvantu vagvanān arādhasaḥ
tat it me chantsat vapuṣaḥ vapuḥ-taram putraḥ yat jānam pitroḥ adhi-iyati jāyā patim vahati vanunā su-mat puṁsaḥ it bhadraḥ vahatuḥ pari-kr̥taḥ
tat it sadha-stham abhi cāru dīdhaya gāvaḥ yat śāsan vahatum na dhenavaḥ mātā yat mantuḥ yūthasya pūrvyā abhi vāṇasya sapta-dhātuḥ it janaḥ
pra vaḥ accha ririce deva-yuḥ padam ekaḥ rudrebhiḥ yāti turvaṇiḥ jarā vā yeṣu amr̥teṣu dāvane pari vaḥ ūmebhyaḥ siñcata madhu
ni-dhīyamānam apa-gūl̥ham ap-su pra me devānām vrata-pāḥ uvāca indraḥ vidvān anu hi tvā cacakṣa tena aham agne anu-śiṣṭaḥ ā agām
akṣetra-vit kṣetra-vidam hi aprāṭ saḥ pra eti kṣetra-vidā anu-śiṣṭaḥ etat vai bhadram anu-śāsanasya uta srutim vindati añjasīnām
adya it oṁ iti pra āṇīt amaman imā ahā api-vr̥taḥ adhayat mātuḥ ūdhaḥ ā īm enam āpa jarimā yuvānam ahel̥an vasuḥ su-manāḥ babhūva
etāni bhadrā kalaśa kriyāma kuru-śravaṇa dadataḥ maghāni dānaḥ it vaḥ magha-vānaḥ saḥ astu ayam ca somaḥ hr̥di yam bibharmi
pra mā yuyujre pra-yujaḥ janānām vahāmi sma pūṣaṇam antareṇa vi śve devāsaḥ adha mām arakṣan duḥ-śāsuḥ ā agāt iti ghoṣaḥ āsīt
sam mā tapanti abhitaḥ sapatnīḥ-iva parśavaḥ ni bādhate amatiḥ nagnatā jasuḥ veḥ na vevīyate matiḥ
mūṣaḥ na śiśnā vi adanti mā ādhyaḥ stotāram te śatakrato itiśata-krato sakr̥t su naḥ magha-van indra mr̥l̥aya adha pitāiva naḥ bhava
kuru-śravaṇam avr̥ṇi rājānam trāsadasyavam maṁhiṣṭham vāghatām r̥ṣiḥ
yasya mā haritaḥ rathe tisraḥ vahanti sādhu-yā stavai sahasra-dakṣiṇe
yasya pra-svādasaḥ giraḥ upama-śravasaḥ pituḥ kṣetram na raṇvam ūcuṣe
adhi putra upama-śravaḥ napāt mitra-atitheḥ ihi pituḥ te asmi vand itā
yat īśīya amr̥tānām uta vā martyānām jīvet it magha-vā mama
na devānām ati vratam śata-ātmā cana jīvati tathā yujā vi vavr̥te
prāvepāḥ mā br̥hataḥ mādayanti pravāte--jāḥ iriṇe varvr̥tānāḥ somasya-iva mauja-vatasya bhakṣaḥ vi-bhīdakaḥ jāgr̥viḥ mahyam acchān
na mā mimetha na jihīl̥e eṣā śivā sakhi-bhyaḥ uta mahyam āsīt akṣasya aham eka-parasya hetoḥ anu-vratām apa jāyām arodham
dveṣṭi śvaśrūḥ apa jāyā ruṇaddhi na nāthitaḥ vindate marḍitāram aśvasya-iva jarataḥ vasnyasya na aham vindāmi kitavasya bhogam
anye jāyām pari mr̥śanti asya yasya agr̥dhat vedane vājī akṣaḥ pitā mātā bhrātaraḥ enam āhuḥ na jānīmaḥ nayata baddham etam
yat ādīdhye na daviṣāṇi ebhiḥ parāyat-bhyaḥ ava hīye sakhi-bhyaḥ ni-uptāḥ ca babhravaḥ vācam akrata emi it eṣām niḥ-kr̥tam jāriṇī-iva
sabhām eti kitavaḥ pr̥cchamānaḥ jeṣyāmi iti tanvā śūśujānaḥ akṣāsaḥ asya vi tiranti kāmam prati-dīvne dadhataḥ ā kr̥tāni
akṣāsaḥ it aṅkuśinaḥ ni-todinaḥ ni-kr̥tvānaḥ tapanāḥ tāpayiṣṇavaḥ kumāra-deṣṇāḥ jayataḥ punaḥ-hanaḥ madhvā sam-pr̥ktāḥ kitavasya barhaṇā
tri-pañcāśaḥ krīl̥ati vrātaḥ eṣām devaḥ-iva savitā satya-dharmā ugrasya cit manyave na namante rājā cit ebhyaḥ namaḥ it kr̥ṇomi
nīcāḥ vartante upari sphuranti ahastāsaḥ hasta-vantam sahante divyāḥ aṅgārāḥ iriṇe ni-uptāḥ śītāḥ santaḥ hr̥dayam niḥ dahanti
jāyā tapyate kitavasya hīnā mātā putrasya carataḥ kva svit r̥ṇa-vā bibhyat dhanam icchamānaḥ anyeṣām astam upa naktam eti
striyam dr̥ṣṭavāya kitavam tatāpa anyeṣām jāyām su-kr̥tam ca yonim pūrvāhṇe aśvān yuyuje hi babhrūn saḥ agneḥ ante vr̥ṣalaḥ papāda
yaḥ vaḥ senānīḥ mahataḥ gaṇasya rājā vrātasya prathamaḥ babhūva tasmai kr̥ṇomi na dhanā ruṇadhmi daśa aham prācīḥ tat r̥tam vadāmi
akṣaiḥ mā dīvyah kr̥ṣim it kr̥ṣasva vitte ramasva bahu manyamānaḥ tattra gāvaḥ kitava tatra jāyā tat me vi caṣṭe savitā ayam aryaḥ
mitram kr̥ṇudhvam khalu mr̥l̥ata naḥ mā naḥ ghoreṇa carata abhi dhr̥ṣṇu ni vaḥ nu manyuḥ viśatām arātiḥ anyaḥ babhrūṇām pra-sitau nu astu
abudhram oṁ iti tye indra-vantaḥ agnayaḥ jyotiḥ bharantaḥ uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭiṣu mahī iti dyāvāpr̥thivī iti cetatām apaḥ adya devānām avaḥ ā vr̥ṇīmahe
divaḥpr̥thivyoḥ avaḥ ā vr̥ṇīmahe mātr̥r̥n sindhūn parvatān śaryaṇāvataḥ anāgāḥ-tvam sūryam uṣasam īmahe bhadram somaḥ suvānaḥ adya kr̥ṇotu naḥ
dyāvā naḥ adya pr̥thivī iti anāgasaḥ mahī iti trāyetām suvitāya mātarā uṣāḥ ucchantī apa bādhatām agham svasti agnim sam-idhānam īmahe
iyam naḥ usrā prathamā su-devyam revat sani-bhyaḥ revatī vi ucchatu āre manyum duḥ-vidatrasya dhīmahi svasti agnim sam-idhānam īmahe
pra yāḥ sisrate sūryasya raśmi-bhiḥ jyotiḥ bharantīḥ uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭiṣu bhadrāḥ naḥ adya śravase vi ucchata svasti agnim sam-idhānam īmahe
anamīvāḥ uṣasaḥ ā carantu naḥ ut agnayaḥ jihatām jyotiṣā br̥hat ayukṣātām aśvinā tūtujim ratham svasti agnim sam-idhānam īmahe
śreṣṭham naḥ adya savitaḥ vareṇyam bhāgam ā suva saḥ hi ratna-dhāḥ asi rāyaḥ janitrīn dhiṣaṇām upa bruve svasti agnim sam-idhānam īmahe
pipartu mā tat r̥tasya pra-vācanam devānām yat manuṣyāḥ amanmahi viśvāḥ it usrāḥ spaṭ ut eti sūryaḥ svasti agnim sam-idhānam īmahe
adveṣaḥ adya barhiṣaḥ starīmaṇi grāvṇām yoge manmanaḥ sādhe īmahe ādityānām śarmaṇi sthāḥ bhuraṇyasi svasti agnim sam-idhānam īmahe
ā naḥ barhiḥ sadha-māde br̥hat divi devān īl̥e sādaya sapta hotr̥r̥r̥n indram mitram varuṇam sātaye bhagam svasti agnim sam-idhānam īmahe
te ādityāḥ ā gata sarvatātaye vr̥dhe naḥ yajñam avata sa-joṣasaḥ br̥haspatim pūṣaṇam aśvinā bhagam svasti agnim sam-idhānam īmahe
tat naḥ devāḥ yacchata su-pravācanam chardiḥ ādityāḥ su-bharam nr̥-pāyyam paśve tokāya tanayāya jīvase svasti agnim sam-idhānam īmahe
viśve adya marutaḥ viśve ūtī viśve bhavantu agnayaḥ sam-iddhāḥ vi śve naḥ devāḥ avasā ā gamantu viśvam astu draviṇam vājaḥ asme iti
yam devāsaḥ avatha vāja-sātau yam trāyadhve yam pipr̥tha ati aṁhaḥ yaḥ vaḥ go--pīthe na bhayasya veda te syāma deva-vītaye turāsaḥ
uṣasānaktā br̥hatī iti su-peśasā dyāvākṣāmā varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā indram huve marutaḥ parvatān apaḥ ādityān dyāvāpr̥thivī iti apaḥ svar iti svaḥ
dyauḥ ca naḥ pr̥thivī ca pra-cetasā r̥tavarī ity r̥ta-varī rakṣatām aṁhasaḥ riṣaḥ mā duḥ-vidatrā nr-r̥tiḥ naḥ īśata tat devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe
viśvasmāt naḥ aditiḥ pātu aṁhasaḥ mātā mitrasya varuṇasya revataḥ svaḥ-vat jyotiḥ avr̥kam naśīmahi tat devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe
grāvā vadan apa rakṣāṁsi sedhatu duḥ-svapnyam niḥ-r̥tim viśvam atriṇam ādityam śarma marutām aśīmahi tat devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe
ā indraḥ barhiḥ sīdatu pinvatām il̥ā br̥haspatiḥ sāma-bhiḥ r̥kvaḥ arcatu su-praketam jīvase manma dhīmahi tat devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe
divi-spr̥śam yajñam asmākam aśvinā jīra-adhvaram kr̥ṇutam sumnam iṣṭaye prācīna-raśmim āhutam ghr̥tena tat devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe
upa hvaye su-havam mārutam gaṇam pāvakam r̥ṣvam sakhyāya śam-bhuvam rāyaḥ poṣam sauśravasāya dhīmahi tat devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe
apām perum jīva-dhanyam bharāmahe deva-avyam su-havam adhvara-śriyam su-raśmim somam indriyam yamīmahi tat devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe
sanema tat su-sanitā sanitva-bhiḥ vayam jīvāḥ jīva-putrāḥ anāgasaḥ brahma-dviṣaḥ viṣvak enaḥ bharerata tat devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe
ye sthāḥ manoḥ yajñiyāḥ te śr̥ṇotana yat vaḥ devāḥ īmahe tat dadātana jaitram kratum rayimat vīra-vat yaśaḥ tat devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe
mahat adya mahatām ā vr̥ṇīmahe avaḥ devānām br̥hatām anarvaṇām yathā vasu vīra-jātam naśāmahai tat devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe
mahaḥ agneḥ sam-idhānasya śarmaṇi anāgāḥ mitre varuṇe svastaye śreṣṭhe syāma savituḥ savīmani tat devānām avaḥ adya vr̥ṇīmahe
ye savituḥ satya-savasya viśve mitrasya vrate varuṇasya devāḥ te saubhagam vīra-vat go--mat apnaḥ dadhātana draviṇam citram asme iti

dyāvā yam agnim pr̥thivī iti janiṣṭām āpaḥ tvaṣṭā bhr̥gavaḥ yam sahaḥ-bhiḥ īl̥enyam prathamam mātariśvā devāḥ tatakṣuḥ manave yajatram
yam tvā devāḥ dadhire havya-vāham puru-spr̥haḥ mānuṣāsaḥ yajatram saḥ yāman agne stuvate vayaḥ dhāḥ pra deva-yan yaśasaḥ sam hi pūrvīḥ
jagr̥bhma te dakṣiṇam indra hastam vasu-yavaḥ vasu-pate vasūnām vidma hi tvā go--patim śūra gonām asmabhyam citram vr̥ṣaṇam rayim dāḥ
