su-āyudham su-avasam su-nītham catuḥ-samudram dharuṇam rayīṇām carkr̥tyam śaṁsyam bhūri-vāram asmabhyam citram vr̥ṣaṇam rayim dāḥ
su-brahmāṇam deva-vantam br̥hantam urum gabhīram pr̥thu-budhnam indra śruta-r̥ṣim ugram abhimāti-saham asmabhyam citram vr̥ṣaṇam rayim dāḥ
sanat-vājam vipra-vīram tarutram dhana-spr̥tam śūśu-vāṁsam su-dakṣam dasyuhanam pūḥ-bhidam indra satyam asmabhyam citram vr̥ṣaṇam rayim dāḥ
aśva-vantam rathinam sahasriṇam śatinam vājam indra bhadra-vrātam vipra-vīram svaḥ-sām asmabhyam citram vr̥ṣaṇam rayim dāḥ
pra sapta-gum r̥ta-dhītim su-medhām br̥haspatim matiḥ accha jigāti yaḥ āṅgirasaḥ namasā upa-sadyaḥ asmabhyam citram vr̥ṣaṇam rayim dāḥ
vanīvānaḥ mama dūtāsaḥ indram somāḥ caranti su-matīḥ iyānāḥ hr̥di-spr̥śaḥ manasā vacyamānāḥ asmabhyam citram vr̥ṣaṇam rayim dāḥ
yat tvā yāmi daddhi tat naḥ indra br̥hantam kṣayam asamam janānām abhi tat dyāvāpr̥thivī iti gr̥ṇītām asmabhyam citram vr̥ṣaṇam rayim dāḥ
aham bhuvam vasunaḥ pūrvyaḥ patiḥ aham dhanāni sam jajāmi śaśvataḥ mām havante pitaram na jantavaḥ aham dāśuṣe vi bhajāmi bhojanam
aham indraḥ rodhaḥ vakṣaḥ atharvaṇaḥ tritāyaḥ gāḥ ajanayam aheḥ adhi aham dasyu-bhyaḥ pari nr̥mṇam ā dade gotrā śikṣan dadhīce mātariśvane
mahyam tvaṣṭā vajram atakṣat āyasam mayi devāsaḥ avr̥jan api kratum mama anīkam sūryasya-iva dustaram mām āryanti kr̥tena kartvena ca
aham etam gavyayam aśvyam paśum purīṣiṇam sāyakena hiraṇyayam puru sahasrā ni śiśāmi dāśuṣe yat mā somāsaḥ ukthinaḥ amandiṣuḥ
aham indraḥ na parā jigye it dhanam na mr̥tyave ava tasthe kadā cana somam it mā sunvantaḥ yācata vasu na me pūravaḥ sakhye ri ṣāthana
aham etān śāśvasataḥ dvādvā indram ye vajram yudhaye akr̥ṇvata āhvayamānān ava hanmanā ahanam dr̥l̥hā vadan anamasyuḥ namasvinaḥ
abhi idam ekam ekaḥ asmi niṣṣāṭ abhi dvā kim oṁ iti trayaḥ karanti khale na parṣān prati hanmi bhūri kim mā nindantiśatravo--nindrāḥ
aham guṅgu-bhyaḥ atithi-gvam iṣkaram iṣam na vr̥tra-turam vikṣu dhārayam yat parṇaya-ghne uta vā karañja-he pra aham mahe vr̥tra-hatye aśuśravi
pra me namī sāpyaḥ iṣe bhuje bhūt gavām eṣe sakhyā kr̥ṇuta dvitā didyum yat asya samitheṣu maṁhayam āt it enam śaṁsyam ukthyam karam
pra nemasmin dadr̥śe somaḥ antaḥ gopāḥ nemam āviḥ asthā kr̥ṇoti saḥ tigma-śr̥ṅgam vr̥ṣabham yuyutsan druhaḥ tasthau bahule baddhaḥ antariti
ādityānām vasūnām rudriyāṇām devaḥ devānām na mināmi dhāma te mā bhadrāya śavase tatakṣuḥ aparājitam astr̥tam aṣāl̥ham
aham dām gr̥ṇate pūrvyam vasu aham brahma kr̥ṇavam mahyam vadharnam aham bhuvam yajamānasya coditā ayajvanaḥ sākṣi viśvasmin bhare
mām dhuḥ indram nāma devatā divaḥ ca gmaḥ ca apām ca jantavaḥ aham harī iti vr̥ṣaṇā vi-vratā raghū iti aham vajram śavase dhr̥ṣṇu ā dade
aham atkam kavaye śiśnatham hathaiḥ aham kutsam āvam ābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ aham śuṣṇasya śnathitā vadhaḥ yamam na yaḥ rare āryam nāma dasyave
aham pitāiva vetasūn abhiṣṭaye tugram kutsāya smat-ibham ca randhayam aham bhuvam yajamānasya rājani pra yat bhare tujaye na priyā ādhr̥ṣe
aham radhayam mr̥gayam śrutarvaṇe yat mā ajihīta vayunā cana ānuṣak aham veśam namram āyave akaram aham savyāya paṭ-gr̥bhim arandhayam
aham saḥ yaḥ nava-vāstvam br̥hat-ratham sam vr̥trāiva dāsam vr̥tra-hā arujam yat vardhayantam prathayantam ānuṣak dūre pāre rajasaḥ rocanā akaram
aham sūryasya pari yāmi āśu-bhiḥ pra etaśebhiḥ vahamānaḥ ojasā yat mā sāvaḥ manuṣaḥ āha niḥ-nije r̥dhak kr̥ṣe dāsam kr̥tvyam hathaiḥ
aham sapta-hā nahuṣaḥ nahuḥ-taraḥ pra aśravayam śavasā turvaśam yadum aham ni anyam sahasā sahaḥ karam nava vrādhataḥ navatim ca vakṣayam
aham sapta sravataḥ dhārayam vr̥ṣā dravitnvaḥ pr̥thivyām sīrāḥ adhi aham arṇāṁsi vi tirāmi su-kratuḥ yudhā vidam manave gātum iṣṭaye
aham tat āsu dhārayam yat āsu na devaḥ cana tvaṣṭā adhārayat ruśat spārham gavām ūdhaḥ-su vakṣaṇāsu ā madhoḥ madhu śvātryam somam āśiram
eva devān indraḥ vivye nr̥r̥n pra cyautnena magha-vā satya-rādhāḥ v iśvā it tā te hari-vaḥ śacī-vaḥ abhi turāsaḥ sva-yaśaḥ gr̥ṇanti
pra vaḥ mahe mandamānāya andhasaḥ arca viśvānarāya viśva-bhuve indrasya yasya su-makham sahaḥ mahi śravaḥ nr̥mṇam ca rodasī iti saparyataḥ
saḥ cit nu sakhyā naryaḥ inaḥ stutaḥ carkr̥tyaḥ indraḥ māvate nare viśvāsu dhūḥ-su vāja-kr̥tyeṣu sat-pate vr̥tre vā ap-su abhi śūra mandase
ke te naraḥ indra ye te iṣe ye te sumnam sa-dhanyam iyakṣān ke te vājāya asuryāya hinvire ke ap-su svāsu urvarāsu paiṁsye
bhuvaḥ tvam indra brahmaṇā mahān bhuvaḥ viśveṣu savaneṣu yajñiyaḥ bhuvaḥ nr̥r̥n cyautnaḥ viśvasmin bhare jyeṣṭhaḥ ca mantraḥ viśva-carṣaṇe
ava nu kam jyāyān yajña-vanasaḥ mahīm te omātrām kr̥ṣṭayaḥ viduḥ asaḥ nu kam ajaraḥ vardhāḥ ca viśvā it etā savanā tūtumā kr̥ṣe
etā viśvā savanā tūtumā kr̥ṣe svayam sūno iti sahasaḥ yāni dadhiṣe varāya te pātram dharmaṇe tanā yajñaḥ mantraḥ brahma ut-yatam vacaḥ
ye te vipra brahma-kr̥taḥ sute sacā vasūnām ca vasunaḥ ca dāvane pra te sumnasya manasā pathā bhuvan made sutasya somyasya andhasaḥ
mahat tat ulbam sthaviram tat āsīt yena āviṣṭitaḥ pra-viveśitha apaḥ viśvāḥ apaśyat bahudhā te agne jāta-vedaḥ tanvaḥ devaḥ ekaḥ
kaḥ mā dr̥rśa katamaḥ saḥ devaḥ yaḥ me tanvaḥ bahudhā pari-apaśyat kva aha mitrāvaruṇā kṣiyanti agneḥ viśvāḥ sam-idhaḥ deva-yānīḥ
aicchāma tvā bahudhā jāta-vedaḥ pra-viṣṭam agne ap-su oṣadhīṣu tam tvā yamaḥ acciket citrabhāno iticitra-bhāno daśa-antaruṣyāt ati-rocamānam
hotrāt aham varuṇa bibhyat āyam na it eva mā yunajan atra devāḥ tasya me tanvaḥ bahudhā ni-viṣṭāḥ etam artham na ciketa aham agni ḥ
ehi manuḥ deva-yuḥ yajña-kāmaḥ aram-kr̥tya tamasi kṣeṣi agne su-gān pathaḥ kr̥ṇuhi deva-yānān vaha havyāni su-manasyamānaḥ
agneḥ pūrve bhrātaraḥ artham etam rathī-iva adhvānam anu ā avarīvuriti tasmāt bhiyā varuṇa dūram āyam gauraḥ na kṣepnoḥ āvije jyāyāḥ
kurmaḥ te āyuḥ ajaram yat agne yathā yuktaḥ jāta-vedaḥ na riṣyāḥ atha vahāsi su-manasyamānaḥ bhāgam devebhyaḥ haviṣaḥ su-jāta
pra-yājān me anu-yājān ca kevalān ūrjasvantam haviṣaḥ datta bhāgam ghr̥tam ca apām puruṣam ca oṣadhīnām agneḥ ca dīrgham āyuḥ astu devāḥ
tava pra-yājāḥ anu-yājāḥ ca kevale ūrjasvantaḥ haviṣaḥ santu bhāgāḥ tava agne yajñaḥ ayam astu sarvaḥ tubhyam namantām pra-d iśaḥ catasraḥ
viśve devāḥ śāstana mā yathā iha hotā vr̥taḥ manavai yat ni-sadya pra me brūta bhāga-dheyam yathā vaḥ yena pathā havyam ā vaḥ vahāni
aham hotā ni asīdam yajīyān viśve devāḥ marutaḥ mā junanti ahaḥ-ahaḥ aśvinā ādhvaryavam vām brahmā sam-it bhavati sā āhutiḥ vām
ayam yaḥ hotā kiḥ oṁ iti saḥ yamasya kam api ūhe yat sam-añjanti devāḥ ahaḥ-ahaḥ jāyate māsi-māsi atha devāḥ dadhire havya-vāham
mām devāḥ dadhire havya-vāham apa-mluktam bahu kr̥cchrā carantam agniḥ vidvān yajñam naḥ kalpayāti pañca-yāmam tri-vr̥tam sapta-tantum
ā vaḥ yakṣi amr̥ta-tvam su-vīram yathā vaḥ devāḥ varivaḥ karāṇi ā bāhvoḥ vajram indrasya dheyām atha imāḥ viśvāḥ pr̥tanāḥ jayāti
trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇi agnim triṁśat ca devāḥ nava ca asaparyan aukṣan ghr̥taiḥ astr̥ṇan barhiḥ asmai āt it hotāram ni asādayanta
yam aicchāma manasā saḥ ayam ā agāt yajñasya vidvān paruṣaḥ ciki tvān saḥ naḥ yakṣat deva-tātā yajīyān ni hi satsat antaraḥ pūrvaḥ asmat
arādhi hotā ni-sadā yajīyān abhi prayāṁsi su-dhitāni hi khyat yajāmahai yajñiyān hanta devān īl̥āmahai īḍyān ājyena
sādhvīm akaḥ deva-vītim naḥ adya yajñasya jihvām avidāma guhyām saḥ āyuḥ ā agāt surabhiḥ vasānaḥ bhadrām akaḥ deva-hūtim naḥ adya
tat adya vāca prathamam masīya yena asurān abhi devāḥ asāma ūrja-adaḥ uta yajñiyāsaḥ pañca janāḥ mama hotram juṣadhvam
pañca janāḥ mama hotram juṣantām go--jātāḥ uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ pr̥thivī naḥ pārthivāt pātu aṁhasaḥ antarikṣam divyāt pātu asmān
tantum tanvan rajasaḥ bhānum anu ihi jyotiṣmataḥ pathaḥ rakṣa dhi yā kr̥tān anulbaṇam vayata joguvām apaḥ manuḥ bhava janaya daivyam janam
akṣa-nahaḥ nahyatana uta somyāḥ iṣkr̥ṇudhvam raśanāḥ ā uta piṁ śata aṣṭāvandhuram vahata abhitaḥ ratham yena devāsaḥ anayan abhi priyam
aśman-vatī rīyate sam rabhadhvam ut tiṣṭhata pra tarata sakhāyaḥ atra jahāma ye asan aśevāḥ śivān vayam ut tarema abhi vājān
tvaṣṭā māyā vet apasām apaḥ-tamaḥ bibhrat pātrā deva-pānāni śam-tamā śiśīte nūnam paraśum su-āyasam yena vr̥ścāt etaśaḥ brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ
sataḥ nūnam kavayaḥ sam śiśīta vāśībhiḥ yābhiḥ amr̥tāya takṣatha vidvāṁsaḥ padā guhyāni kartana yena devāsaḥ amr̥ta-tvam ānaśuḥ
garbhe yoṣām adadhuḥ vatsam āsani apīcyena manasā uta jihvayā saḥ viśvāhā su-manāḥ yogyāḥ abhi sasāsaniḥ vanate kāraḥ it jitim
tām su te kīrtim magha-van mahi-tvā yat tvā bhīte iti rodasī iti ahvayetām pra āvaḥ devān ā atiraḥ dāsam ojaḥ pra-jāyai tvasyai yat aśikṣaḥ indra
yat acaraḥ tanvā vavr̥dhānaḥ balāni indra pra-bruvāṇaḥ janeṣu māyā it sā te yāni yuddhāni āhuḥ na adya śatrum nanu purā vivitse
ke oṁ iti nu te mahimanaḥ samasya asmat pūrve r̥ṣayaḥ antam āpuḥ yat mātaram ca pitaram ca sākam ajanayathāḥ tanvaḥ svāyāḥ
catvāri te asuryāṇi nāma adābhyāni mahiṣasya santi tvam aṅga tāni v iśvāni vitse yebhiḥ karmāṇi magha-van cakartha
tvam viśvā dadhiṣe kevalāni yāni āviḥ yā ca guhā vasūni kāmam it me magha-van mā vi tārīḥ tvam ājñātā tvam indra asi dātā
yaḥ adadhāt jyotiṣi jyotiḥ antaḥ yaḥ asr̥jat madhunā sam madhūni adha priyam śūṣam indrāya manma brahma-kr̥taḥ br̥hat-ukthāt avāci
dūre tat nāma guhyam parācaiḥ yat tvā bhīte iti ahvayetām vayaḥ-dhai ut astabhnāḥ pr̥thivīm dyām abhīke bhrātuḥ putrān magha-van titviṣāṇaḥ
mahat tat nāma guhyam puru-spr̥k yena bhūtam janayaḥ yena bhavyam pratnam jātam jyotiḥ yat asya priyam priyāḥ sam aviśanta pañca
ā rodasī iti apr̥ṇāt ā uta madhyam pañca devān r̥tu-śaḥ sapta-sapta catuḥ-tri ṁśatā purudhā vi caṣṭe sa-rūpeṇa jyotiṣā vi-vratena
yat uṣaḥ aucchaḥ prathamā vi-bhānām ajanayaḥ yena puṣṭasya puṣṭam yat te jāmi-tvam avaram parasyāḥ mahat mahatyāḥ asura-tvam ekam
vidhum dadrāṇam samane bahūnām yuvānam santam palitaḥ jagāra devasya paśya kāvyam mahi-tvā adya mamāra saḥ hyaḥ sam āna
śākmanā śākaḥ aruṇaḥ su-parṇaḥ ā yaḥ mahaḥ śūraḥ sanāt anīl̥aḥ yat ciketa satyam it tat na mogham vasu spārham uta jetā uta dātā
ā ebhiḥ dade vr̥ṣṇyā paiṁsyāni yebhiḥ aukṣat vr̥tra-hatyāya vajrī ye karmaṇaḥ kriyamāṇasya mahnā r̥te--karmam ut-ajāyanta devāḥ
yujā karmāṇi janayan viśvāojāḥ aśasti-hā viśva-manāḥ turāṣāṭ pītvī somasya divaḥ ā vr̥dhānaḥ śūraḥ niḥ yudhā adhamat dasyūn
idam te ekam paraḥ oṁ iti te ekam tr̥tīyena jyotiṣā sam viśasva sam-veśane tanvaḥ cāruḥ edhi priyaḥ devānām parame janitre
tanūḥ te vājin tanvam nayantī vāmam asmabhyam dhātu śarma tubhyam ahrutaḥ mahaḥ dharuṇāya devān divi-iva jyotiḥ svam ā mimīyāḥ
vājī asi vājinena su-venīḥ suvitaḥ stomam suvitaḥ divam gāḥ suvitaḥ dharma prathamā anu satyā suvitaḥ devān suvitaḥ anu patma
mahimnaḥ eṣām pitaraḥ cana īśire devāḥ deveṣu adadhuḥ api kratum sam avivyacuḥ uta yāni atviṣuḥ ā eṣām tanūṣu ni viviśuḥ punarit i
sahaḥ-bhiḥ viśvam pari cakramuḥ rajaḥ pūrvā dhāmāni amitā mimānāḥ tanūṣu viśvā bhuvanā ni yemire pra asārayanta purudha pra-jāḥ anu
dvidhā sūnavaḥ asuram svaḥ-vidam ā asthāpayanta tr̥tīyena karmaṇā svām pra-jām pitaraḥ pitryam sahaḥ ā avareṣu adadhuḥ tantum ātatam
nāvā na kṣodaḥ pra-diśaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ svasti-bhiḥ ati duḥ-gāni viśvā svām pra-jām br̥hat-ukthaḥ mahi-tvā avareṣu adadhāt ā pareṣu
mā pra gāma pathaḥ vayam mā yajñāt indra sominaḥ mā antariti sthuḥ naḥ arātayaḥ
yaḥ yajñasya pra-sādhanaḥ tantuḥ deveṣu ātataḥ tam āhutam naśīmahi
manaḥ nu ā huvāmahe nārāśaṁsena somena pitr̥r̥ṇām ca manma-bhiḥ
ā te etu manaḥ punariti kratve dakṣāya jīvase jyok ca sūryam dr̥śe
punaḥ naḥ pitaraḥ manaḥ dadātu daivyaḥ janaḥ jīvam vrātam sacemahi
vayam soma vrate tava manaḥ tanūṣu bibhrataḥ prajāvantaḥ sacemahi
yat te yamam vaivasvatam manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmasi iha kṣayāya jīvase
yat te divam yat pr̥thivīm manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmasi iha kṣayāya jīvase
yat te bhūmim catuḥ-bhr̥ṣṭim manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmas i iha kṣayāya jīvase
yat te catasraḥ pra-diśaḥ manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmasi iha kṣayāya jīvase
yat te samudram arṇavam manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmas i iha kṣayāya jīvase
yat te marīcīḥ pra-vataḥ manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmasi iha kṣayāya jīvase
yat te apaḥ yat oṣadhīḥ manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmas i iha kṣayāya jīvase
yat te sūryam yat uṣasam manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmasi iha kṣayāya jīvase
yat te parvatān br̥hataḥ manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmasi iha kṣayāya jīvase
yat te viśvam idam jagat manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmas i iha kṣayāya jīvase
yat te parāḥ parāvataḥ manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmasi iha kṣayāya jīvase
yat te bhūtam ca bhavyam ca manaḥ jagāma dūrakam tat te ā vartayāmasi iha kṣayāya jīvase
pra tāri āyuḥ pra-taram navīyaḥ sthātārāiva kratu-matā rathasya adha cyavānaḥ ut tavīti artham parātaram su niḥ-r̥tiḥ jihītām
sāman nu rāye nidhi-mat nu annam karāmahe su purudha śravāṁsi tā naḥ viśvāni jaritā mamattu parātaram su niḥ-r̥tiḥ jihītām
abhi su aryaḥ paiṁsyaiḥ bhavema dyauḥ na bhūmim girayaḥ na ajrān tā naḥ viśvāni jaritā ciketa parātaram su niḥ-r̥tiḥ jihītām
mo iti su ṇaḥ soma mr̥tyave parā dāḥ paśyema nu sūryam ut-carantam dyu-bhiḥ hitaḥ jarimā su naḥ astu parātaram su niḥ-r̥tiḥ jihītām
asu-nīte manaḥ asmāsu dhāraya jīvātave su pra tira naḥ āyuḥ rarandhi naḥ sūryasya sam-dr̥śi ghr̥tena tvam tanvam vardhayasva
asu-nīte punaḥ asmāsu cakṣuḥ punariti prāṇam iha naḥ dhehi bhogam jyok paśyema sūryam ut-carantam anu-mate mr̥l̥aya naḥ svasti
punaḥ naḥ asum pr̥thivī dadātu punaḥ dyauḥ devī punaḥ antarikṣam punaḥ naḥ somaḥ tanvam dadātu punariti pūṣā pathyām yā svastiḥ
śam rodasī iti su-bandhave yahvī iti r̥tasya mātarā bharatām apa yat rapaḥ dyauḥ pr̥thivi kṣamā rapaḥ mo iti su te kim cana āmamat
ava dvake iti ava trikā divaḥ caranti bheṣajā kṣamā cariṣṇuekakam bharatām apa yat rapaḥ dyauḥ pr̥thivi kṣamā rapaḥ mo iti su te kim cana āmamat
sam indra īraya gām anaḍavaḍhabadabadrahṇāham yaḥ ā svahat uśīnarāṇyāḥ anaḥ bharatām apa yat rapaḥ dyauḥ pr̥thivi kṣamā rapaḥ mo iti su te kim cana āmamat
ā janam tveṣa-sandr̥śam māhīnānām upa-stutam aganma bibhrataḥ namaḥ
asamātim ni-tośanam tveṣam ni-yayinam ratham bhaje--rathasya sat-patim
yaḥ janān mahiṣān-iva ati-tasthau pavīravān uta apavīravān yudhā
yasya ikṣvākuḥ upa vrate revān marāyī edhate divi-iva pañca kr̥ṣṭayaḥ
indra kṣatrā asamātiṣu ratha-proṣṭheṣu dhāraya divi-iva sūryam dr̥śe
agastyasya nat-bhyaḥ saptī iti yunakṣi rohitā paṇīn ni akramīḥ abhi viśvān rājan arādhasaḥ
ayam mātā ayam pitā ayam jīvātuḥ ā agamat idam tava pra-sarpaṇam subandho itisu-bandho ā ihi niḥ ihi
yathā yugam varatrayā nahyanti dharuṇāya kam eva dādhāra te manaḥ jīvātave na mr̥tyave atho iti ariṣṭa-tātaye
yathā iyam pr̥thivī mahī dādhāra imān vanaspatīn eva dādhāra te manaḥ jīvātave na mr̥tyave atho iti ariṣṭa-tātaye
yamāt aham vaivasvatāt su-bandhoḥ manaḥ ā abharam jīvātave na mr̥tyave atho iti ariṣṭa-tātaye
nyak vātaḥ ava vāti nyak tapati sūryaḥ nīcīnam aghnyā duhe nyak bhavatu te rapaḥ
ayam me hastaḥ bhaga-vān ayam me bhagavat-taraḥ ayam me viśva-bheṣajaḥ ayam śiva-abhimarśanaḥ
idam itthā raudram gūrta-vacāḥ brahma kratvā śacyām antaḥ ājau krāṇā yat asya pitarā maṁhane--sthāḥ parṣat pakthe ahan ā sapta hotār̥n
saḥ it dānāya dabhyāya vanvan cyavānaḥ sūdaiḥ amimīta vedim tūvaryāṇaḥ gūrtavacaḥ-tamaḥ kṣodaḥ na retaḥ itaḥ-ūti siñcat
manaḥ na yeṣu havaneṣu tigmam vipaḥ śacyā vanuthaḥ dravantā ā yaḥ śaryābhiḥ tuvi-nr̥mṇaḥ asya aśrīṇīta ādiśam gabhastau
kr̥ṣṇā yat goṣu aruṇīṣu sīdat divaḥ napātā aśvinā huve vām vītam me yajñam ā gatam me annam vavanvāṁsā na iṣam asmr̥tadhrūity asmr̥ta-dhrū
prathiṣṭa yasya vīra-karmam iṣṇat anu-sthitam nu naryaḥ apa auhat punariti tat ā vr̥hati yat kanāyāḥ duhituḥ āḥ anu-bhr̥tam anarvā
madhyā yat kartvam abhavat abhīke kāmam kr̥ṇvāne pitari yuvatyām manānak retaḥ jahatuḥ vi-yantā sānau ni-siktam su-kr̥tasya yonau
pitā yat svām duhitaram adhi-skan kṣmayā retaḥ sam-jagmānaḥ ni s iñcat su-ādhyaḥ ajanayan brahma devāḥ vāstoḥ patim vrata-pām ni ḥ atakṣan
saḥ īm vr̥ṣā na phenam asyat ājau smat ā parā ait apa dabhra-cetāḥ sarat padā na dakṣiṇā parāvr̥k na tāḥ nu me pr̥śanyaḥ jagr̥bhre
makṣu na vahniḥ pra-jāyāḥ upabdiḥ agnim na nagnaḥ upa sīdat ūdhaḥ sanitā idhmam sanitā uta vājam saḥ dhartā jajñe sahasā yav i-yut
makṣu kanāyāḥ sakhyam nava-gvāḥ r̥tam vadantaḥ r̥ta-yuktim agman dvi-barhasaḥ ye upa gopam ā aguḥ adakṣiṇāsaḥ acyutā dudukṣan
makṣu kanāyāḥ sakhyam navīyaḥ rādhaḥ na retaḥ r̥tam it turaṇyan śuci yat te rekṇaḥ ā ayajanta sabaḥ-dughāyāḥ payaḥ usriyāyāḥ
paśvā yat paścā vi-yutā bdhanta iti bravīti vaktari rarāṇaḥ vasoḥ vasu-tvā kāravaḥ anehā viśvam viveṣṭi draviṇam upa kṣu
tat it nu asya pari-sadvānaḥ agman puru sadantaḥ nārsadam bibh itsan vi śuṣṇasya sam-grathitam anarvā vidat puru-prajātasya guhā yat
bhargaḥ ha nāma uta yasya devāḥ svaḥ na ye tri-sadhasthe ni-seduḥ agniḥ ha nāma uta jāta-vedāḥ śrudhi naḥ hotaḥ r̥tasya hotā adhruk
uta tyā me raudrau arci-mantā nāsatyau indra gr̥taye yajadhyai manuṣvat vr̥kta-barhiṣe rarāṇā mandū iti hita-prayasā vikṣu yajyūiti
ayam stutaḥ rājā vandi vedhāḥ apaḥ ca vipraḥ tarati sva-setuḥ saḥ kakṣīvantam rejayat saḥ agnim nemim na cakram arvataḥ raghu-dru
saḥ dvi-bandhuḥ vaitaraṇaḥ yaṣṭā sabaḥ-dhum dhenum asvam duhadhyai sam yat mitrāvaruṇā vr̥ñje ukthaiḥ jyeṣṭhebhiḥ aryamaṇam varūthaiḥ
tat-bandhuḥ sūriḥ divi te dhiyam-dhāḥ nābhānediṣṭhaḥ rapati pra venan sā naḥ nābhiḥ paramā asya vā gha aham tat paścā katithaḥ cit āsa
iyam me nābhiḥ iha me sadha-stham ime me devāḥ ayam asmi sarvaḥ dvi-jāḥ aha prathama-jāḥ r̥tasya idam dhenuḥ aduhat jāyamānā
adha āsu mandraḥ aratiḥ vibhāvā ava syati dvi-vartaniḥ vaneṣāṭ ūrdhvā yat śreṇiḥ na śiśuḥ dan makṣu sthiram śe--vr̥dham sūta mātā
adha gāvaḥ upa-mātim kanāyāḥ anu śvāntasya kasya cit parā īyuḥ śrudhi tvam su-draviṇaḥ naḥ tvam yāṭ āśva-ghnasya vavr̥dhe sūnr̥tābhiḥ
adha tvam indra viddhi asmān mahaḥ rāye nr̥-pate vajra-bāhuḥ rakṣa ca naḥ maghonaḥ pāhi sūrīn anehasaḥ te hari-vaḥ abhiṣṭau
adha yat rājānā go--iṣṭau sarat saraṇyuḥ kārave jaraṇyuḥ vipraḥ preṣṭhaḥ saḥ hi eṣām babhūva parā ca vakṣat uta parṣat enān
adha nu asya jenyasya puṣṭau vr̥thā rebhantaḥ īmahe tat oṁ iti nu saraṇyuḥ asya sūnuḥ aśvaḥ vipraḥ ca asi śravasaḥ ca sātau
yuvoḥ yadi sakhyāya asme iti śardhāya stomam jujuṣe namasvān viśvatra yasmin ā giraḥ sam-īcīḥ pūrvī-iva gātuḥ dāśat sūnr̥tāyai
saḥ gr̥ṇānaḥ at-bhiḥ deva-vān iti su-bandhuḥ namasā su-uktaiḥ vardhat ukthaiḥ vacaḥ-bhiḥ ā hi nūnam vi adhvā eti payasaḥ usriyāyāḥ
te oṁ iti su naḥ mahaḥ yajatrāḥ bhūta devāsaḥ ūtaye sa-joṣāḥ ye vājān anayata vi-yantaḥ ye stha ni-cetāraḥ amūrāḥ
ye yajñena dakṣiṇayā sam-aktāḥ indrasya sakhyam amr̥ta-tvam ānaśa tebhyaḥ bhadram aṅgirasaḥ vaḥ astu prati gr̥bhṇīta mānavam su-medhasaḥ
ye ut-ājan pitaraḥ go--mayam vasu r̥tena abhindan pari-vatsare valam dīrghāyu-tvam aṅgirasaḥ vaḥ astu prati gr̥bhṇīta mānavam su-medhasaḥ
ye r̥tena sūryam ā arohayan divi aprathayan pr̥thivīm mātaram vi suprajāḥ-tvam aṅgirasaḥ vaḥ astu prati gr̥bhṇīta mānavam su-medhasaḥ
ayam nābhā vadati valgu vaḥ gr̥he deva-putrāḥ r̥ṣayaḥ tat śr̥ṇotana su-brahmaṇyam aṅgirasaḥ vaḥ astu prati gr̥bhṇīta mānavam su-medhasaḥ
vi-rūpāsaḥ it r̥ṣayaḥ te it gambhīra-vepasaḥ te aṅgirasaḥ sūnavaḥ te agneḥ pari jajñire
ye agneḥ pari jajñire vi-rūpāsaḥ divaḥ pari nava-gvaḥ nu daśa-gvaḥ aṅgiraḥ-tamaḥ sacā deveṣu maṁhate
indreṇa yujā niḥ sr̥janta vāghataḥ vrajam go--mantam aśvinam sahasram me dadataḥ aṣṭa-karṇyaḥ śravaḥ deveṣu akrata
pra nūnam jāyatām ayam manuḥ tokma-iva rohatu yaḥ sahasram śata-aśvam sadyaḥ dānāya maṁhate
na tam aśnoti kaḥ cana divaḥ-iva sānu ārabham sāvarṇyasya dakṣiṇā vi sindhuḥ-iva paprathe
uta dāsā pari-viṣe smaddiṣṭī itismat-diṣṭī go--parīṇasā yaduḥ turvaḥ ca māmahe
sahasra-dāḥ grāma-nīḥ mā riṣat manuḥ sūryeṇa asya yatamānā etu dakṣiṇā sāvarṇeḥ devāḥ pra tirantu āyuḥ yasmin asrāntāḥ asanāma vājam
parāvataḥ ye didhiṣante āpyam manu-prītāsaḥ janima vivasvataḥ yayāteḥ ye nahuṣyasya barhiṣi devāḥ āsate te adhi bruvantu naḥ
viśvā hi vaḥ namasyāni vandyā nāmāni devāḥ uta yajñiyāni vaḥ ye stha jātāḥ aditeḥ at-bhyaḥ pari ye pr̥thivyāḥ te me iha śruta havam
yebhyaḥ mātā madhu-mat pinvate payaḥ pīyūṣam dyauḥ aditiḥ adri-barhāḥ uktha-śuṣmān vr̥ṣa-bharān svapnasaḥ tān ādityān anu mada svastaye
nr̥-cakṣasaḥ ani-miṣantaḥ arhaṇā br̥hat devāsaḥ amr̥ta-tvam ānaśuḥ jyotiḥ-rathāḥ ahi-māyāḥ anāgasaḥ divaḥ varṣmāṇam vasate svastaye
sam-rājaḥ ye su-vr̥dhaḥ yajñam āyayuḥ apari-hvr̥tāḥ dadhire divi kṣayam tān ā vivāsa namasā suvr̥kti-bhiḥ mahaḥ ādityān aditim svastaye
kaḥ vaḥ stomam rādhati yam jujoṣatha viśve devāsaḥ manuṣaḥ yati sthana kaḥ vaḥ adhvaram tuvi-jātāḥ aram karat yaḥ naḥ parṣat at i aṁhaḥ svastaye
yebhyaḥ hotrām prathamām āyeje manuḥ samiddha-agniḥ manasā sapta hotr̥-bhiḥ te ādityāḥ abhayam śarma yacchata su-gā naḥ karta su-pathā svastaye
ye īśire bhuvanasya pra-cetasaḥ viśvasya sthātuḥ jagataḥ ca mantavaḥ te naḥ kr̥tāt akr̥tāt enasaḥ pari adya devāsaḥ pipr̥ta svastaye
bhareṣu indram su-havam havāmahe aṁhaḥ-mucam su-kr̥tam daivyam janam agnim mitram varuṇam sātaye bhagam dyāvāpr̥thivī iti marutaḥ svastaye
su-trāmāṇam pr̥thivīm dyām anehasam su-śarmāṇam aditim su-pranītim daivīm nāvam su-aritrām anāgasam asravantīm ā ruhema svastaye
viśve yajatrāḥ adhi vocata ūtaye trāyadhvam naḥ duḥ-evāyāḥ abhi-hrutaḥ satyayā vaḥ deva-hūtyā huvema śr̥ṇvataḥ devāḥ avase svastaye
apa amīvām apa viśvām anāhutim apa arātim duḥ-vidatrām agha-yataḥ āre devāḥ dveṣaḥ asmat yuyotana uru naḥ śarma yacchata svastaye
ariṣṭaḥ saḥ martaḥ viśvaḥ edhate pra pra-jābhiḥ jāyate dharmaṇaḥ pari yam ādityāsaḥ nayatha sunīti-bhiḥ ati viśvāni duḥ-itā svastaye
yam devāsaḥ avatha vāja-sātau yam śūra-sātā marutaḥ hite dhane prātaḥ-yāvānam ratham indra sānasim ariṣyantam ā ruhema svastaye
svasti naḥ pathyāsu dhanva-su svasti ap-su vr̥jane svaḥ-vati svasti naḥ putra-kr̥theṣu yoniṣu svasti rāye marutaḥ dadhātana
svastiḥ it hi pra-pathe śreṣṭhā rekṇasvatī abhi yā vāmam eti sā naḥ amā so iti araṇe ni pātu su-āveśā bhavatu deva-gopā
eva plateḥ sūnuḥ avīvr̥dhat vaḥ viśve ādityāḥ adite manīṣī īśānāsaḥ naraḥ amartyena astāvi janaḥ divyaḥ gayena
kathā devānām katamasya yāmani su-mantu nāma śr̥ṇvatām manāmahe kaḥ mr̥l̥āti katamaḥ naḥ mayaḥ karat katamaḥ ūtī abhi ā vavartati
r̥tu-yanti kratavaḥ hr̥t-su dhītayaḥ venanti venāḥ patayanti ā diśaḥ na marḍitā vidyate anyaḥ ebhyaḥ deveṣu me adhi kāmāḥ ayaṁsata
narāśaṁsam vā pūṣaṇam agohyam agnim deva-iddham abhi arcase girā sūryāmāsā candramasā yamam divi tritam vātam uṣasam aktum aśvinā
kathā kaviḥ tuvi-ravān kayā girā br̥haspatiḥ vavr̥dhate suvr̥kti-bhiḥ ajaḥ eka-pāt su-havebhiḥ r̥kva-bhiḥ ahiḥ śr̥ṇotu budhnyaḥ havīmani
dakṣasya vā adite janmani vrate rājānā mitrāvaruṇā vivāsasi atūrta-panthāḥ puru-rathaḥ aryamā sapta-hotā viṣu-rūpeṣu janma-su
te naḥ arvantaḥ havana-śrutaḥ havam viśve śr̥ṇvantu vājinaḥ mi ta-dravaḥ sahasra-sāḥ medhasātau-iva tmanā mahaḥ ye dhanam sam-itheṣu jabhrire
pra vaḥ vāyum ratha-yujam puram-dhim stomaiḥ kr̥ṇudhvam sakhyāya pūṣaṇam te hi devasya savituḥ savīmani kratum sacante sa-citaḥ sa-cetasaḥ
triḥ sapta sasrāḥ nadyaḥ mahīḥ apaḥ vanaspatīn parvatān agnim ūtaye kr̥śānum astr̥r̥r̥n tiṣyam sadha-sthe ā rudram rudreṣu rudriyam havāmahe
sarasvatī sarayuḥ sindhuḥ ūrmi-bhiḥ mahaḥ mahīḥ avasā yantu vakṣaṇīḥ devīḥ āpaḥ mātaraḥ sūdayitnvaḥ ghr̥ta-vat payaḥ madhu-mat naḥ arcata
uta mātā br̥hat-divā śr̥ṇotu naḥ tvaṣṭā devebhiḥ jani-bhiḥ pitā vacaḥ r̥bhukṣāḥ vājaḥ rathaḥ-patiḥ bhagaḥ raṇvaḥ śaṁsaḥ śaśamānasya pātu naḥ
raṇvaḥ sam-dr̥ṣṭau pitumān-iva kṣayaḥ bhadrā rudrāṇām marutām upa-stutiḥ gobhiḥ syāma yaśasaḥ janeṣu ā sadā devāsaḥ il̥ayā sacemahi
yam me dhiyam marutaḥ indra devāḥ adadāta varuṇa mitra yūyam tām pīpayata payasāiva dhenum kuvit giraḥ adhi rathe vahātha
kuvit aṅga prati yathā cit asya naḥ sa-jātyasya marutaḥ bubodhatha nābhā yatra prathamam sam-nasāmahe tatra jāmi-tvam aditiḥ dadhātu naḥ
te hi dyāvāpr̥thivī iti mātarā mahī devī devān janmanā yajñiyeiti itaḥ ubhe iti bibhr̥taḥ ubhayam bharīma-bhiḥ puru retāṁsi pitr̥-bhiḥ ca siñcataḥ
vi sā hotrā viśvam aśnoti vāryam br̥haspatiḥ aramatiḥ panīyasī grāvā yatra madhu-sut ucyate br̥hat avīvaśanta mati-bhiḥ manīṣiṇaḥ
eva kaviḥ tuvi-ravān r̥ta-jñāḥ draviṇasyuḥ draviṇasaḥ cakānaḥ ukthebhiḥ atra mati-bhiḥ ca vipraḥ apīpayat gayaḥ divyāni janma
eva plateḥ sūnuḥ avīvr̥dhat vaḥ viśve ādityāḥ adite manīṣī īśānāsaḥ naraḥ amartyena astāvi janaḥ divyaḥ gayena
agniḥ indraḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ āryamā vāyuḥ pūṣā sarasvatī sa-joṣasaḥ ādityāḥ viṣṇuḥ marutaḥ svaḥ br̥hat somaḥ rudraḥ aditiḥ brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ
indrāgnī iti vr̥tra-hatyeṣu satpatī itisat-patī mithaḥ hinvānā tanvā sam-okasā antarikṣam mahi ā papruḥ ojasā somaḥ ghr̥ta-śrīḥ mahimānam īrayan
teṣām hi mahnā māhatām anarvaṇām stomān iyarmi r̥ta-jñāḥ r̥ta-vr̥dhām ye apsavam arṇavam citra-rādhasaḥ te naḥ rāsantām mahaye su-mitryāḥ
svaḥ-naram antarikṣāṇi rocanā dyāvābhūmī iti pr̥thivīm skambhuḥ ojasā pr̥kṣāḥ-iva mahayantaḥ su-rātayaḥ devāḥ stavante manuṣāya sūrayaḥ
iti nādhasī iti vr̥tau
yā gauḥ vartanim pari-eti niḥ-kr̥tam payaḥ duhānā vrata-nīḥ avārataḥ sā pra-bruvāṇā varuṇāya dāśuṣe devebhyaḥ dāśat haviṣā vivasvate
divakṣasaḥ agni-jihvāḥ r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ r̥tasya yonim vi-mr̥śantaḥ āsate dyām skabhitvī apaḥ ā cakruḥ ojasā yajñam janitvī tanvi ni mamr̥juḥ
pari-kṣitā pitarā pūrvajāvarī itipūrva-jāvarī r̥tasya yonā kṣayataḥ sam-okasā dyāvāpr̥thivī iti varuṇāya savrateitisa-vrate ghr̥ta-vat payaḥ mahiṣāya pinvataḥ
parjanyāvātā vr̥ṣabhā purīṣiṇā indravāyū iti varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā devān ādityān aditim havāmahe ye pārthivāsaḥ divyāsaḥ ap-su ye
tvaṣṭāram vāyum r̥bhavaḥ yaḥ ohate daivyā hotārau uṣasam svastaye br̥haspatim vr̥tra-khādam su-medhasam indriyam somam dhana-sāḥ oṁ iti īmahe
brahma gām aśvam janayantaḥ oṣadhīḥ vanaspatīn pr̥thivīm parvatān apaḥ sūrya divi rohayantaḥ su-dānavaḥ āryā vratā vi-sr̥jantaḥ adhi kṣami
bhujyum aṁhasaḥ pipr̥thaḥ niḥ aśvinā śyāvam putram vadhri-matyāḥ ajinvatam kama-dyuvam vi-madāya ūhathuḥ yuvam viṣṇāpvam viśvakāya ava sr̥jathaḥ
pāvīravī tanyatuḥ eka-pāt ajaḥ divaḥ dhartā sindhuḥ āpaḥ samudriyaḥ viśve devāsaḥ śr̥ṇavan vacāṁsi me sarasvatī saha dhībhiḥ puram-dhyā
viśve devāḥ saha dhībhiḥ puram-dhyā manoḥ yajatrāḥ amr̥tāḥ r̥ta-jñāḥ rāti-sācaḥ abhi-sācaḥ svaḥ-vidaḥ svaḥ giraḥ brahma su-uktam juṣerata
devān vasiṣṭhaḥ amr̥tān vavande ye viśvā bhuvanā abhi pra-tasthuḥ te naḥ rāsantām uru-gāyam adya yūyam pāta svasti-bhiḥ sadā naḥ
devān huve br̥hat-śravasaḥ svastaye jyotiḥ-kr̥taḥ adhvarasya pra-cetasaḥ ye vavr̥dhuḥ pra-taram viśva-vedasaḥ indra-jyeṣṭhāsaḥ amr̥tāḥ r̥ta-vr̥dhaḥ
indra-prasūtāḥ varuṇa-praśiṣṭāḥ ye sūryasya jyotiṣaḥ bhāgam ānaśuḥ marut-gaṇe vr̥jane manma dhīmahi māghone yajñam janayanta sūrayaḥ
indraḥ vasu-bhiḥ pari pātu naḥ gayam ādityaiḥ naḥ aditiḥ śarma yacchatu rudraḥ rudrebhiḥ devaḥ mr̥l̥ayāti naḥ tvaṣṭā naḥ gnābhiḥ suvitāya jinvatu
aditiḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti r̥tam mahat indrāviṣṇūiti marutaḥ svaḥ br̥hat devān ādityān avase havāmahe vasūn rudrān savitāram su-daṁsasam
sarasvān dhībhiḥ varuṇaḥ dhr̥ta-vrataḥ pūṣā viṣṇuḥ mahimā vāyuḥ aśvinā brahma-kr̥taḥ amr̥tāḥ viśva-vedasaḥ śarma naḥ yaṁsan tri-varūtham aṁhasaḥ
vr̥ṣā yajñaḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ santu yajñiyāḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ devāḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ haviḥ-kr̥taḥ vr̥ṣaṇā dyāvāpr̥thivī iti r̥ta-varī ity r̥ta-varī vr̥ṣā parjanyaḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ vr̥ṣa-stubhaḥ
agnīṣomā vr̥ṣaṇā vāja-sātaye puru-praśastā vr̥ṣaṇau upa bruve yau ījire vr̥ṣaṇaḥ deva-yajyayā tā naḥ śarma tri-varūtham vi yāṁsataḥ
dhr̥ta-vratāḥ kṣatriyāḥ yajñaniḥ-kr̥taḥ br̥hat-divāḥ adhvarāṇām abhi-śri yaḥ agni-hāotāraḥ r̥ta-sāpaḥ adruhaḥ apaḥ asr̥jan anu vr̥tra-tūyer
dyāvāpr̥thivī iti janayan abhi vratā āpaḥ oṣadhīḥ vanināni yajñiyā antarikṣam svaḥ ā papruḥ ūtaye vaśam devāsaḥ tanvi ni mamr̥juḥ
dhartāraḥ divaḥ r̥bhavaḥ su-hastāḥ vātāparjanyā mahiṣasya tanyatoḥ āpaḥ oṣadhīḥ pra tirantu naḥ giraḥ bhagaḥ rātiḥ vājinaḥ yantu me havam
samudraḥ sindhuḥ rajaḥ antarikṣam ajaḥ eka-pāt tanayitnuḥ arṇavaḥ ahiḥ budhnyaḥ śr̥ṇavat vacāṁsi me viśve devāsaḥ uta sūrayaḥ mama
syāma vaḥ manavaḥ deva-vītaye prāñcam naḥ yajñam pra nayata sādhu-yā ādītyāḥ rudrāḥ vasavaḥ su-dānavaḥ imā brahma śasyamānāni jinvata
daivyāḥ hotārā prathamā puraḥ-hitā r̥tasya panthām anu emi sādhu-yā kṣetrasya patim prati-veśam īmahe viśvān devān amr̥tān apra-yucchataḥ
vasiṣṭhāsaḥ pitr̥-vat vācam akrata devān īl̥ānāḥ r̥ṣi-vat svastaye prītāḥ-iva jñātayaḥ kāmam āitya asme iti devāsaḥ ava dhūnuta vasu
devān vasiṣṭhaḥ amr̥tān vavande ye viśvā bhuvanā abhi pra-tasthuḥ te naḥ rāsantām uru-gāyam adya yūyam pāta svasti-bhiḥ sadā naḥ
imām dhiyam sapta-śīrṣṇīm pitā naḥ r̥ta-prajātām br̥hatīm avindat turīyam svit janayat viśva-janyaḥ ayāsyaḥ uktham indrāya śaṁsan
r̥tam śaṁsantaḥ r̥ju dīdhyānāḥ divaḥ putrāsaḥ asurasya vīrāḥ vipram padam aṅgirasaḥ dadhānāḥ yajñasya dhāma prathamam mananta
haṁsaiḥ-iva sakhi-bhiḥ vāvadat-bhiḥ aśman-mayāni nahanā vi-asyan br̥haspatiḥ abhi-kanikradat gāḥ uta pra astaut ut ca vidvān agāyat
avaḥ dvābhyām paraḥ ekayā gāḥ guhā tiṣṭhantīḥ anr̥tasya setau br̥haspatiḥ tamasi jyotiḥ icchan ut usrāḥ ā akaḥ vi hi tiśraḥ āvar ity āvaḥ
vi-bhidya puram śayathā īm apācīm niḥ trīṇi sākam uda-dheḥ akr̥ntat br̥haspatiḥ uṣasam sūryam gām arkam viveda stanayan-iva dyauḥ
indraḥ valam rakṣitāram dughānām kareṇa-iva vi cakarta raveṇa svedāñji-bhiḥ āśiram icchamānaḥ arodayat paṇim ā gāḥ amuṣṇāt
saḥ īm satyebhiḥ sakhi-bhiḥ śucat-bhiḥ go--dhāyasam vi dhana-saiḥ adardar ity adardaḥ brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ vr̥ṣa-bhiḥ varāhaiḥ gharma-svedebhiḥ draviṇam vi ānaṭ
te satyena manasā go--patim gāḥ iyānāsaḥ iṣaṇayanta dhībhiḥ br̥haspatiḥ mithaḥ-avadyapebhiḥ ut usriyāḥ asr̥jata svayuk-bhiḥ
tam vardhayantaḥ mati-bhiḥ śivābhiḥ siṁham-iva nānadatam sadha-sthe br̥haspatim vr̥ṣaṇam śūra-sātau bhare--bhare anu madema jiṣṇum
yadā vājam asanat viśva-rūpam ā dyām arukṣat ut-tarāṇi sadma br̥haspatim vr̥ṣaṇam vardhayantaḥ nānā santaḥ bibhrataḥ jyotiḥ āsā
satyām āśiṣam kr̥ṇuta vayaḥ-dhai kīrim cit hi avatha svebhiḥ evaiḥ paścā mr̥dhaḥ apa bhavantu viśvāḥ tat rodasī iti śr̥ṇutam viśvaminve itiviśvam-inve
indraḥ mahnā mahataḥ arṇavasya vi mūrdhānam abhinat arbudasya ahan ahim ariṇāt sapta sindhūn devaiḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti pra avatam naḥ
uda-prutaḥ na vayaḥ rakṣamāṇāḥ vāvadataḥ abhriyasya-iva ghoṣāḥ giri-bhrajaḥ na ūrmayaḥ madantaḥ br̥haspatim abhi arkāḥ anāvan
sam gobhiḥ āṅgirasaḥ nakṣamāṇaḥ bhagaḥ-iva it aryamaṇam nināya jane mitraḥ na dampatī itidam-patī anakti br̥haspate vājaya āśūn-iva ājau
sādhu-aryāḥ atithinīḥ iṣirāḥ spārhāḥ su-varṇāḥ anavadya-rūpāḥ br̥haspatiḥ parvatebhyaḥ vi-tūrya niḥ gāḥ ūpe yavam-iva sthivi-bhyaḥ
āpruṣāyan madhunā r̥tasya yonim ava-kṣipan arkaḥ ulkām-iva dyoḥ br̥haspatiḥ uddharan aśmanaḥ gāḥ bhūmyāḥ udnāiva vi tvacam bibheda
apa jyotiṣā tamaḥ antarikṣāt udnaḥ śīpālam-iva vātaḥ ājat br̥haspatiḥ anu-mr̥śya valasya abhram-iva vātaḥ ā cakre ā gāḥ
yadā valasya pīyataḥ jasum bhet br̥haspatiḥ agnitapaḥ-bhiḥ arkaiḥ dat-bhiḥ na jihvā pari-viṣṭam ādat āviḥ nidhīn akr̥ṇot usriyāṇām
br̥haspatiḥ amata hi tyat āsām nāma svarīṇām sadane guhā yat āṇḍāiva bhittvā śakunasya garbham ut usriyāḥ parvatasya tmanā ājat
aśnā api-naddham madhu pari apaśyat matsyam na dīne udani kṣiyantam niḥ tat jabhāra camasam na vr̥kṣāt br̥haspatiḥ vi-raveṇa vi-kr̥tya
saḥ uṣām avindat saḥ svar iti svaḥ saḥ agnim saḥ arkeṇa vi babādhe tamāṁsi br̥haspatiḥ go--vapuṣaḥ valasya niḥ majjānam na parvaṇaḥ jabhāra
himāiva parṇā muṣitā vanāni br̥haspatinā akr̥payat valaḥ gāḥ ananu-kr̥tyam apunariti cakāra yāt sūryāmāsā mithaḥ ut-carātaḥ
abhi śyāvam na kr̥śanebhiḥ aśvam nakṣatrebhiḥ pitaraḥ dyām apiṁśan rātryām tamaḥ adadhuḥ jyotiḥ ahan br̥haspatiḥ bhinat adrim vidat gāḥ
idam akarma namaḥ abhriyāya yaḥ pūrvīḥ anu ānonavīti br̥haspatiḥ saḥ hi gobhiḥ saḥ aśvaḥ saḥ vīrebhiḥ saḥ nr̥-bhiḥ naḥ vayaḥ dhāt
bhadrāḥ agneḥ vadhri-aśvasya sam-dr̥śaḥ vāmī pra-ṇītiḥ su-raṇāḥ upa-itayaḥ yat īm su-mitrāḥ viśaḥ agre indhate ghr̥tena āhutaḥ jarate davidyutat
ghr̥tam agneḥ vadhri-aśvasya vardhanam ghr̥tam annam ghr̥tam oṁ iti asya bhedanam ghr̥tena āhutaḥ urviyā vi paprathe sūryaḥ-iva rocate sarpiḥ-āsutiḥ
yat te manuḥ yat anīkam su-mitraḥ sam-īdhe agne tat idam navīyaḥ saḥ revat śoca saḥ giraḥ juṣasva saḥ vājam darṣi saḥ iha śravaḥ dhāḥ
yam tvā pūrvam īl̥itaḥ vadhri-aśvaḥ sam-īdhe agne saḥ idam juṣasva saḥ naḥ sti-pāḥ uta bhava tanū-pāḥ dātram rakṣasva yat idam te asme iti
bhava dyumnī vādhri-aśva uta gopāḥ mā tvā tārīt abhi-mātiḥ janānām śūraḥ-iva ghr̥ṣṇuḥ cyavanaḥ su-mitraḥ pra nu vocam vādhri-aśvasya nāma
sam ajryā parvatyā vasūni dāsā vr̥trāṇi āryā jigetha śūraḥ-iva ghr̥ṣṇuḥ cyavanaḥ janānām tvam agne pr̥tanāyūn abhi syāḥ
dīrgha-tantuḥ br̥hat-ukṣā ayam agniḥ sahasra-starīḥ śata-nīthaḥ r̥bhvā dyu-mān dyumat-su nr̥-bhiḥ mr̥jyamānaḥ su-mitreṣu dīdayaḥ devayat-su
tve iti dhenuḥ su-dughā jātavedaḥ asaścatāiva samanā sabaḥ-dhuk tvam nr̥-bhiḥ dakṣiṇāvat-bhiḥ agne su-mitrebhiḥ idhyase devayat-bhiḥ
devāḥ cit te amr̥tāḥ jāta-vedaḥ mahimānam vādhi-aśva pra vocan yat sam-pr̥ccham mānuṣīḥ viśaḥ āyan tvam nr̥-bhiḥ ajayaḥ tvāvr̥dhebhiḥ
pitāiva putram abhibhaḥ upa-sthe tvām agne vadhri-aśvaḥ saparyan juṣāṇaḥ asya sam-idham yaviṣṭha uta pūrvān avanoḥ vrādhataḥ cit
śaśvat agniḥ vadhri-aśvasya śatrūn nr̥-bhiḥ jigāya sutasomavat-bhiḥ samanam cit adahaḥ citrabhāno iticitra-bhāno ava vrādhantam abhinat vr̥dhaḥ cit
ayam agniḥ vadhri-aśvasya vr̥tra-hā sanakāt pra-iddhaḥ namasā upa-vākyaḥ saḥ naḥ ajāmīn uta vā vi-jāmīn abhi tiṣṭha śardhataḥ vādhri-aśva
imām me agne sam-idham juṣasva il̥aḥ pade prati harya ghr̥tācīm varṣman pr̥thivyāḥ sudina-tve ahnām ūrdhvaḥ bhava sukrato itisu-krato deva-yajyā
ā devānām agra-yāvā iha yātu narāśaṁsaḥ viśva-rūpebhiḥ aśvaiḥ r̥tasya pathā namasā miyedhaḥ devebhyaḥ deva-tamaḥ susūdat
śaśvat-tamam īl̥ate dūtyāya haviṣmantaḥ manuṣyāsaḥ agnim vahiṣṭhaiḥ aśvaiḥ su-vr̥tā rathena ā devān vakṣi ni sada iha hotā
vi prathatām deva-juṣṭam tiraścā dīrgham drāghmā surabhi bhūtu asme iti ahel̥ata manasā deva barhiḥ indra-jyeṣṭhān uśataḥ yakṣi devān
divaḥ vā sānu spr̥śata varīyaḥ pr̥thivyā vā mātrayā vi śrayadhvam uśatīḥ dvāraḥ mahinā mahat-bhiḥ devam ratham ratha-yuḥ dhārayadhvam
devī iti divaḥ duhitarā suśilpe itisu-śilpe uṣasānaktā sadatām ni yonau ā vām devāsaḥ uśatī iti uśantaḥ urau sīdantu subhageitisu-bhage upa-sthe
ūrdhvaḥ grāvā br̥hat agniḥ sam-iddhaḥ priyā dhāmāni aditeḥ upa-sthe puraḥ-hitau r̥tvijā yajñe asmin viduḥ-tarā draviṇam ā yajethām
tisraḥ devīḥ barhiḥ idam varīyaḥ ā sīdata cakr̥ma vaḥ syonam manuṣvat yajñam su-dhitā havīṁṣi il̥ā devī ghr̥ta-padī juṣanta
deva tvaṣṭaḥ yat ha cāru-tvam ānaṭ yat aṅgirasām abhavaḥ sacābhūḥ saḥ devānām pāthaḥ upa pra vidvān uśan yakṣi draviṇaḥ-daḥ su-ratnaḥ
vanaspate raśanayā ni-yūya devānām pāthaḥ upa vakṣi vidvān svadāti devaḥ kr̥ṇavat havīṁṣi avatām dyāvāpr̥thivī iti havam me
ā agne vaha varuṇam iṣṭaye naḥ indram divaḥ marutaḥ antarikṣāt sīdantu barhiḥ viśve ā yajatrāḥ svāhā devāḥ amr̥tāḥ mādayantām
br̥haspate prathamam vācaḥ agram yat pra airata nāma-dheyam dadhānāḥ yat eṣām śreṣṭham yat aripram āsīt preṇā tat eṣām ni-hitam guhā āviḥ
saktum-iva tita-unā punantaḥ yatra dhīrāḥ manasā vācam akrata atra sakhāyaḥ sakhyāni jānate bhadrā eṣām lakṣmīḥ nihitā adhi vāci
yajñena vācaḥ pada-vīyam āyan tām anu avindan r̥ṣiṣu pra-viṣṭām tām ābhr̥tya vi adadhuḥ puru-trā tām sapta rebhāḥ abhi sam navante
uta tvaḥ paśyan na dadarśa vācam uta tvaḥ śr̥ṇvan na śr̥ṇoti enām uto iti tvasmai tanvam vi sasre jāyāiva patye uśatī su-vāsāḥ
uta tvam sakhye sthira-pītam āhuḥ na enam hinvanti api vājineṣu adhenvā carati māyayā eṣaḥ vācam śuśru-vān aphalām āpuṣpām
yaḥ tityāja saci-vidam sakhāyam na tasya vāci api bhāgaḥ asti yat īm śr̥ṇoti alakam śr̥ṇoti nahi pra-veda su-kr̥tasya panthām
akṣaṇ-vantaḥ karṇa-vantaḥ sakhāyaḥ manaḥ-javeṣu asamāḥ babhūvuḥ ādaghnāsaḥ upa-kakṣāsaḥ oṁ iti tve hradāḥ-iva snātvāḥ oṁ iti tve dadr̥śre
hr̥dā taṣṭeṣu manasaḥ javeṣu yat brāhmaṇāḥ sam-yajante sakhāyaḥ atra aha tvam vi jahuḥ vedyābhiḥ oha-brahmāṇaḥ vi caranti oṁ iti tve
ime ye na arvāk na paraḥ caranti na brāhmaṇāsaḥ na sute--karāsaḥ te ete vācam abhi-padya pāpayā sirīḥ tantram tanvate apra-jajñayaḥ
sarve nandanti yaśasā āgatena sabhāsāhena sakhyā sakhāyaḥ kilbiṣa-spr̥t pitu-saṇiḥ hi eṣām aram hitaḥ bhavati vājināya
r̥cām tvaḥ poṣam āste pupuṣvān gāyatram tvaḥ gāyati śakvarīṣu brahmā tvaḥ vadati jāta-vidyām yajñasya mātrām vi mimīte oṁ iti tvaḥ
devānām nu vayam jānā pra vocāma vipanyayā uktheṣu śasyamāneṣu yaḥ paśyāt ut-tare yuge
brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ etā sam karmāraḥ-iva adhamat devānām pūrvye yuge asataḥ sat ajāyata
devānām pūrvye yuge asataḥ sat ajāyata tat āśāḥ anu ajāyanta tat uttāna-padaḥ pari
bhūḥ jajñe uttāna-padaḥ bhuvaḥ āśāḥ ajāyanta aditeḥ dakṣaḥ ajāyata dakṣāt oṁ iti aditiḥ pari
aditiḥ hi ajaniṣṭa dakṣa yā duhitā tava tām devāḥ anu ajāyanta bhadrāḥ amr̥ta-bandhavaḥ
yat devāḥ adaḥ salile su-saṁrabdhāḥ atiṣṭhata atra vaḥ nr̥tyatām-iva tīvraḥ reṇuḥ apa āyata
yat devāḥ yatayaḥ yathā bhuvanāni apinvata atra samudre ā gūl̥ham ā sūryam ajabhartana
aṣṭau putrāsaḥ aditeḥ ye jātāḥ tanvaḥ pari devān upa pra ait sapta-bhiḥ parā mārtāṇḍam āsyat
sapta-bhiḥ putraiḥ aditiḥ upa pra ait pūrvyam yugam pra-jāyai mr̥tyave tvat punaḥ mārtāṇḍam ā abharat
janiṣṭhāḥ ugraḥ sahase turāya mandraḥ ojiṣṭhaḥ bahula-abhimānaḥ avardhan indram marutaḥ cit atra mātā yat vīram dadhanat dhaniṣṭhā
druhaḥ ni-sattā pr̥śanī cit evaiḥ puru śaṁsena vavr̥dhuḥ te indram abhivr̥tāiva tā mahāpadena dhvāntāt pra-pitvāt ut aranta garbhāḥ
r̥ṣvā te pādā pra yat jigāsi avardhan vājāḥ uta ye cit atra tvam indra sālāvr̥kān sahasram āsan dadhiṣe aśvinā ā vavr̥tyāḥ
samanā tūrṇiḥ upa yāsi yajñam ā nāsatyā sakhyāya vakṣi vasāvyām indra dhārayaḥ sahasrā aśvinā śūra dadatuḥ maghāni
mandamānaḥ r̥tāt adhi pra-jāyai sakhi-bhiḥ indraḥ iṣirebhiḥ artham ābhiḥ hi māyāḥ upa dasyum ā agāt mihaḥ pra tamrāḥ avapat tamāṁsi
sa-nāmānā cit dhvasayaḥ ni asmai ava ahan indraḥ uṣasaḥ yathā anaḥ r̥ṣvaiḥ agacchaḥ sakhi-bhiḥ ni-kāmaiḥ sākam prati-sthā hr̥dyā jaghantha
tvam jāghantha namucim makhasyum dāsam kr̥ṇvānaḥ r̥ṣaye vi-māyam tvam cakartha manave syonān pathaḥ deva-trā añjasāiva yānān
tvam etāni papriṣe vi nāma īśānaḥ indra dadhiṣe gabhastau anu tvā devāḥ śavasā madanti upari-budhnān vaninaḥ cakartha
cakram yat asya ap-su ā ni-sattam uto iti tat asmai madhu it cacchadyāt pr̥thivyām ati-sitam yat ūdhaḥ payaḥ goṣu adadhāḥ oṣadhīṣu
aśvāt iyāya iti yat vadanti ojasaḥ jātam uta manye enam manyoḥ iyāya harmyeṣu tasthau yataḥ pra-jajñe indraḥ asya veda
vayaḥ su-parṇāḥ upa seduḥ indram priya-medhāḥ r̥ṣayaḥ nādhamānāḥ apa dhvāntam ūrṇuhi pūrdhi cakṣuḥ mumugdhi asmān nidhayāiva baddhān
vasūnām vā carkr̥ṣe iyakṣan dhiyā vā yajñaiḥ vā rodasyoḥ arvantaḥ vā ye rayi-mantaḥ sātau vanum vā ye su-śruṇam su-śrutaḥ dhuritidhuḥ
havaḥ eṣām asuraḥ nakṣata dyām śravasyatā manasā niṁsata kṣām cakṣāṇāḥ yatra suvitāya devāḥ dyauḥ na vārebhiḥ kr̥ṇavanta svaiḥ
iyam eṣām amr̥tānām gīḥ sarva-tātā ye kr̥paṇanta ratnam dhiyam ca yajñam ca sādhantaḥ te naḥ dhāntu vasavyam asāmi
ā tat te indra āyavaḥ pananta abhi ye ūrvam go--mantam titr̥tsān sakr̥t-svam ye puru-putrām mahīm sahasra-dhārām br̥hatīm dudhukṣan
śacī-vaḥ indram avase kr̥ṇudhvam anānatam damayantam pr̥tanyūn r̥bhukṣaṇam magha-vānam su-vr̥ktim bhartā yaḥ vajram naryam puru-kṣuḥ
yat vavāna puru-tamam purāṣāṭ ā vr̥tra-hā indraḥ nāmāni aprāḥ aceti pra-sahaḥ patiḥ tuviṣmān yat īm uśmasi kartave karat tat
pra su vaḥ āpaḥ mahimānam ut-tamam kāruḥ vocāti sadane vivasvataḥ pra sapta-sapta tredhā hi cakramuḥ pra sr̥tvarīṇām ati sindhuḥ ojasā
pra te aradat varuṇaḥ yātave pathaḥ sindho iti yat vājān abhi adravaḥ tvam bhūmyāḥ adhi pra-vatā yāsi sānunā yat eṣām agram jagatām irajyasi
divi svanaḥ yatate bhūmyā upari anantam śuṣmam ut iyarti bhānunā abhrāt-iva pra stanayanti vr̥ṣṭayaḥ sindhuḥ yat eti vr̥ṣabhaḥ na roruvat
abhi tvā sindho iti śiśum it na mātaraḥ vāśrāḥ arṣanti payasāiva dhenavaḥ rājāiva yudhvā nayasi tvam it sicau yat āsām agram pra-vatām inakṣasi
imam me gaṅge yamune sarasvati śutudri stomam sacata paruṣṇi ā asiknyā marut-vr̥dhe vitastayā ājrjīkīye śr̥ṇuhi ā su-somayā
tr̥ṣṭa-amayā prathamam yātave sa-jūḥ su-sartvā rasayā śvetyā tyā tvam sindho iti kubhayā go--matīm krumum mehatnvā sa-ratham yābhiḥ īyase
r̥jītī enī ruśatī mahi-tvā pari jrayāṁsi bharate rajāṁsi adabdhā sindhuḥ apasām apaḥ-tamā aśvā na citrā vapuṣī-iva darśatā
su-aśvā sindhuḥ su-rathā su-vāsāḥ hiraṇyayī su-kr̥tā vājinī-vatī ūrṇāvatī yuvatiḥ sīlamāvatī uta adhi vaste su-bhagā madhu-vr̥dham
sukham ratham yuyuje sindhuḥ aśvinam tena vājam saniṣat asmin ājau mahān hi asya mahimā panasyate adabdhasya sva-yaśasaḥ vi-rapśinaḥ
ā vaḥ r̥ñjase ūrjām vi-uṣṭiṣu indram marutaḥ rodasī iti anaktana ubhe iti yathā naḥ ahanī iti sacābhuvā sadaḥ-sadaḥ varivasyātaḥ ut-bhidā
tat oṁ iti śreṣṭham savanam sunotana atyaḥ na hasta-yataḥ adriḥ sotar i vidat hi aryaḥ abhi-bhūti paiṁsyam mahaḥ rāye cit tarute yat arvataḥ
tat it hi asya savanam viveḥ apaḥ yathā purā manave gātum aśret go--arṇasi tvāṣṭre aśva-nirniji pra īm adhvareṣu adhvarān aśiśrayuḥ
apa hata rakṣasaḥ bhaṅgura-vataḥ skabhāyata niḥ-r̥tim sedhata amatim ā naḥ rayim sarva-vīram sunotana deva-avyam bharata ślokam adrayaḥ
divaḥ cit ā vaḥ amavat-tarebhyaḥ vi-bhvanā cit āśvapaḥ-tarebhyaḥ vāyoḥ cit ā somarabhaḥ-tarebhyaḥ agneḥ cit arca pitukr̥t-tarebhyaḥ
bhurantu naḥ yaśasaḥ sotu andhasaḥ grāvāṇaḥ vācā divitā divitmatā naraḥ yatra duhate kāmyam madhu āghoṣayantaḥ abhitaḥ mithaḥ-turaḥ
sunvanti somam rathirāsaḥ adrayaḥ niḥ asya rasam go--iṣaḥ duhanti te duhanti ūdhaḥ upa-secanāya kam naraḥ havyā na marjayante āsa-bhiḥ
ete naraḥ su-apasaḥ abhūtana ye indrāya sunutha somam adrayaḥ vāmam-vāmam vaḥ divyāya dhāmne vasu-vasu vaḥ pārthivāya sunvate
abhra-pruṣaḥ na vācā pruṣa vasu haviṣmantaḥ na yajñāḥ vi-jānuṣaḥ su-mārutam na brahmāṇam arhase gaṇam astoṣi eṣām na śobhase
śriye maryāsaḥ añjīn akr̥ṇvata su-mārutam na pūrvīḥ ati kṣapaḥ di vaḥ putrāsaḥ etāḥ na yetire ādityāsaḥ te akrāḥ na vavr̥dhuḥ
pra ye divaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ na barhaṇā tmanā riricre abhrāt na sūryaḥ pājasvantaḥ na vīrāḥ panasyavaḥ riśādasaḥ na maryāḥ abhi-dyavaḥ
yuṣmākam budhne apām na yāmani vithuryati na mahī śratharyati viśva-psuḥ yajñaḥ arvāk ayam su vaḥ prayasvantaḥ na satrācaḥ ā gata
yūyam dhūḥ-su pra-yujaḥ na raśmi-bhiḥ jyotiṣmantaḥ na bhāsā vi-uṣṭiṣu śyenāsaḥ na sva-yaśasaḥ riśādasaḥ pravāsaḥ na pra-sitāsaḥ pari-pruṣaḥ
pra yat vahadhve marutaḥ parākāt yūyam mahaḥ sam-varaṇasya vasvaḥ vidānāsaḥ vasavaḥ rādhyasya ārāt cit dveṣaḥ sanutaḥ yuyota
yaḥ ut-r̥ci yajñe adhvare--sthāḥ marut-bhyaḥ na mānuṣaḥ dadāśat revat saḥ vayaḥ dadhate su-vīram saḥ devānām api go--pīthe astu
te hi yajñeṣu yajñiyāsaḥ ūmāḥ ādityena nāmnā śam-bhaviṣṭhāḥ te naḥ avantu ratha-tūḥ manīṣām mahaḥ ca yāman adhvare cakānāḥ
viprāsaḥ na manma-bhiḥ su-ādhyaḥ deva-avyaḥ na yajñaiḥ su-apnasaḥ rājānaḥ na citrāḥ su-sandr̥śaḥ kṣitīnām na maryāḥ arepasaḥ
agniḥ na ye bhrājasā rukma-vakṣasaḥ vātāsaḥ na sva-yujaḥ sadyaḥ-ūtayaḥ pra-jñātāraḥ na jyeṣṭhāḥ su-nītayaḥ su-śarmāṇaḥ na somāḥ r̥tam yate
vātāsaḥ na ye dhunayaḥ jigatnavaḥ agnīnām na jihvāḥ vi-rokiṇaḥ varmaṇ-vantaḥ na yodhāḥ śimī-vantaḥ pitr̥r̥ṇām na śaṁsāḥ su-rātayaḥ
rathānām na ye arāḥ sa-nābhayaḥ jigīvāṁsaḥ na śūrāḥ abhi-dyavaḥ vare--yavaḥ na maryāḥ ghr̥ta-pruṣaḥ abhi-svartāraḥ arkam na su-stubhaḥ
aśvāsaḥ na ye jyeṣṭhāsaḥ āśavaḥ didhiṣavaḥ na rathyaḥ su-dānavaḥ āpaḥ na nimnaiḥ uda-bhiḥ jigatnavaḥ viśva-rūpāḥ aṅgirasaḥ na sāma-bhiḥ
grāvāṇaḥ na sūrayaḥ sindhu-mātaraḥ ādardirāsaḥ adrayaḥ na viśvahā śiśūlāḥ na krīl̥ayaḥ su-mātaraḥ mahāgrāmaḥ na yāman uta tv iṣā
uṣasām na ketavaḥ adhvara-śriyaḥ śubham-yavaḥ na añji-bhiḥ vi aśvitan sindhavaḥ na yayiyaḥ bhrājat-r̥ṣṭayaḥ parāvataḥ na yojanāni mamire
su-bhāgān naḥ devāḥ kr̥ṇuta su-ratnān asmān stotr̥r̥n marutaḥ vavr̥dhānāḥ adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gāta sanāt hi vaḥ ratna-dheyāni santi
apaśyam asya mahataḥ mahi-tvam amartyasya martyāsu vikṣu nānā hanūiti vibhr̥teitivi-bhr̥te sam bhareteiti asinvatī iti bapsatī iti bhūri attaḥ
guhā śiraḥ ni-hitam r̥dhak akṣī iti asinvan atti jihvayā vanāni atrāṇi asmai paṭ-bhiḥ sam bharanti uttāna-hastāḥ namasā adhi vikṣu
pra mātuḥ pra-taram guhyam icchan kumāraḥ na vīrudhaḥ sarpat urvīḥ samam na pakvam avidat śucantam ririhvāṁsam ripaḥ upa-sthe antariti
tat vām r̥tam rodasī iti pra bravīmi jāyamānaḥ mātarā garbhaḥ atti na aham devasya martyaḥ ciketa agniḥ aṅga vi-cetāḥ saḥ pra-cetāḥ
yaḥ asmai annamḥtr̥ṣuḥādadhātiḥājyaiḥḥghr̥taiḥḥjuhotiḥpuṣyatiḥtasmaiḥsahasramḥakṣa-bhiḥḥviḥcakṣeḥagneḥviśvataḥḥpratyaṅḥasiḥtvam
kim deveṣu tyajaḥ enaḥ cakartha agne pr̥cchāmi nu tvām avidvān akrīl̥an krīl̥an hariḥ attave adan vi parva-śaḥ cakarta gām-iva asiḥ
viṣūcaḥ aśvān yuyuje vane--jāḥ r̥jīti-bhiḥ raśanābhiḥ gr̥bhītān cakṣade m itraḥ vasu-bhiḥ su-jātaḥ sam ānr̥dhe parva-bhiḥ vavr̥dhānaḥ
agniḥ saptim vājam-bharam dadāti agniḥ vīram śrutyam karmaniḥ-sthām agniḥ rodasī iti vi carat sam-añjan agniḥ nārīm vīra-kukṣim puram-dhim
agneḥ apnasaḥ sam-it astu bhadrā agniḥ mahī iti rodasī iti ā viveśa agniḥ ekam codayat samat-su agniḥ vr̥trāṇi dayate purūṇ i
agniḥ ha tyam jarataḥ karṇam āva agniḥ at-bhyaḥ niḥ adahat jarūtham agniḥ atrim gharme uruṣyat antaḥ agniḥ nr̥-medham pra-jayā asr̥jat sam
agniḥ dāt draviṇam vīra-peśāḥ agniḥ r̥ṣim yaḥ sahasrā sanoti agniḥ divi havyam ā tatāna agneḥ dhāmāni vi-bhr̥tā puru-trā
agnim ukthaiḥ r̥ṣayaḥ vi hvayante agnim naraḥ yāmani bādhitāsaḥ agnim vayaḥ antarikṣe patantaḥ agniḥ sahasrā pari yāti gonām
agnim viśaḥ īl̥ate mānuṣīḥ yāḥ agnim manuṣaḥ nahuṣaḥ vi jātāḥ agn iḥ gāndharvīm pathyām r̥tasya agneḥ gavyūtiḥ ghr̥te ā ni-sattā
agnaye brahma r̥bhavaḥ tatakṣuḥ agnim mahām avocāma su-vr̥ktim agne pra ava jaritāram yaviṣṭha agne mahi draviṇam ā yajasva
yaḥ imā viśvā bhuvanāni juhvat r̥ṣiḥ hotā ni asīdat pitā naḥ saḥ āśiṣā draviṇam icchamānaḥ prathama-cchat avarān ā viveśa
kim svit āsīt adhi-sthānam ārambhaṇam katamat svit kathā āsīt yataḥ bhūmim janayan viśva-karmā vi dyām aurṇot mahinā viśva-cakṣāḥ
viśvataḥ-cakṣuḥ uta viśvataḥ-mukhaḥ viśvataḥ-bāhuḥ uta viśvataḥ-pāt sam bāhu-bhyām dhamati sam patatraiḥ dyāvābhūmī iti janayan devaḥ ekaḥ
kim svit vanam kaḥ oṁ iti saḥ vr̥kṣaḥ āsa yataḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti niḥ-tatakṣuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ manasā pr̥cchata it oṁ iti tat yat adhi-atiṣṭhat bhuvanāni dhārayan
yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yā avamā yā madhyamā viśva-karman uta imā śikṣa sakhi-bhyaḥ haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayam yajasva tanvam vr̥dhānaḥ
viśva-karman haviṣā vavr̥dhānaḥ svayam yajasva pr̥thivīm uta dyām muhyantu anye abhitaḥ janāsaḥ iha asmākam magha-vā sūriḥ astu
vācaḥ patim viśva-karmāṇam ūtaye manaḥ-juvam vāje adya huvema saḥ naḥ viśvāni havanāni joṣat viśva-śambhūḥ avase sādhu-karmā
cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīraḥ ghr̥tam ene ajanat namnamāneiti yadā it antāḥ adadr̥hanta pūrve āt it dyāvāpr̥thivī iti aprathetām
viśva-karmā vi-manāḥ āt vi-hāyāḥ dhātā vi-dhātā paramā uta sam-dr̥k teṣām iṣṭāni sam iṣā madanti yatra sapta-r̥ṣīn paraḥ ekam āhuḥ
yaḥ naḥ pitā janitā yaḥ vi-dhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā yaḥ devānām nāma-dhāḥ ekaḥ eva tam sam-praśnam bhuvanā yanti anyā
te ā ayajanta draviṇam sam asmai r̥ṣayaḥ pūrve jaritāraḥ na bhūnā asūrte sūrte rajasi ni-satte ye bhūtāni sam-akr̥ṇvan imāni
paraḥ divā paraḥ enā pr̥thivyā paraḥ devebhiḥ asuraiḥ yat asti kam svit garbham prathamam dadhre āpaḥ yatra devāḥ sam-apaśyanta v iśve
tam it garbham prathamam dadhre āpaḥ yatra devāḥ sam-agacchanta vi śve ajasya nābhau adhi ekam arpitam yasmin viśvāni bhuvanāni tasthuḥ
na tam vidātha yaḥ imā jajāna anyat yuṣmākam antaram babhūva nīhāreṇa prāvr̥tāḥ jalpyā ca asu-tr̥paḥ uktha-śāsaḥ caranti
yaḥ te manyo iti avidhat vajra sāyaka sahaḥ ojaḥ puṣyati viśvam ānuṣak sāhyāma dāsam āryam tvayā yujā sahaḥ-kr̥tena sahasā sahasvatā
manyuḥ indraḥ manyuḥ eva āsa devaḥ manyuḥ hotā varuṇaḥ jāta-vedāḥ manyum viśaḥ īl̥ate mānuṣīḥ yāḥ pāhi naḥ manyo iti tapasā sa-joṣāḥ
abhi ihi manyo iti tavasaḥ tavīyān tapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn amitra-hā vr̥tra-hā dasyu-hā ca viśvā vasūni ā bhara tvam naḥ
iti abhibhūti-ojāḥ svayam-bhūḥ bhāmaḥ abhimāti-sahaḥ viśva-carṣaṇiḥ sahuriḥ sahāvān asmāsu ojaḥ pr̥tanāsu dhehi
abhāgaḥ san apa parāitaḥ asmi tava kratvā taviṣasya pracetait ipra-cetaḥ tam tvā manyo iti akratuḥ jihīl̥a aham svā tanūḥ bala-deyāya mā ā ihi
ayam te asmi upa mā ā ihi arvāṅ pratīcīnaḥ sahure viśva-dhāyaḥ manyo iti vajrin abhi mām ā vavr̥tsva hanāva dasyūn uta bodhi āpeḥ
abhi pra ihi dakṣiṇataḥ bhava me adha vr̥trāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri juhomi te dharuṇam madhvaḥ agram ubhau upa-aṁśu prathamā pibāva
tvayā manyo iti sa-ratham ārujantaḥ harṣamānāsaḥ dhr̥ṣitāḥ marutvaḥ tigma-iṣavaḥ āyudhā sam-śiśānāḥ abhi pra yantu naraḥ agni-rūpāḥ
agniḥ-iva manyo iti tviṣitaḥ sahasva senānīḥ naḥ sahure hūtaḥ edhi hatvāya śatrūn vi bhajasva vedaḥ ojaḥ mimānaḥ vi mr̥dhaḥ nudasva
sahasva manyo iti abhi-mātim asme iti rujan mr̥ṇan pra-mr̥ṇan pra ihi śatrūn ugram te pājaḥ nanu ā rurudhre vaśī vaśam nayase eka-ja tvam
ekaḥ bahūnām asi manyo iti īl̥itaḥ viśam-viśam yudhaye sam śiśādhi akr̥tta-ruk tvayā yujā vayam dyu-mantam ghoṣam vi-jayāya kr̥ṇmahe
vijeṣa-kr̥t indraḥ-iva anava-bravaḥ asmākam manyo iti adhi-pāḥ bhava iha priyam te nāma sahure gr̥ṇīmasi vidma tam utsam yataḥ ābabhūtha
ābhūtyā saha-jāḥ vajra sāyaka sahaḥ bibharṣi abhi-bhūte ut-taram kratvā naḥ manyo iti saha medī edhi mahādhanasya puru-hūta sam-sr̥ji
sam-sr̥ṣṭam dhanam ubhayam sam-ākr̥tam asmabhyam dattām varuṇaḥ ca manyuḥ bhiyam dadhānāḥ hr̥dayeṣu śatravaḥ parājitāsaḥ apa ni layantām
satyena uttabhitā bhūmiḥ sūryeṇa uttabhitā dyauḥ r̥tena ādityāḥ tiṣṭhanti d ivi somaḥ adhi śritaḥ
somena ādityāḥ balinaḥ somena pr̥thivī mahī atho iti nakṣatrāṇām eṣām upa-sthe somaḥ āhitaḥ
somam manyate papi-vān yat sam-piṁṣanti oṣadhim somam yam brahmāṇaḥ viduḥ na tasya aśnāti kaḥ cana
ācchat-vidhānaiḥ gupitaḥ bārhataiḥ soma rakṣitaḥ grāvṇām it śr̥ṇvan tiṣṭhasi na te aśnāti pārthivaḥ
yat tvā deva pra-pibanti tataḥ ā pyāyase punariti vāyuḥ somasya rakṣitā samānām māsaḥ ākr̥tiḥ
raibhī āsīt anu-deyī nārāśaṁsī ni-ocanī sūryāyāḥ bhadram it vāsaḥ gāthayā eti pari-kr̥tam
cittiḥ āḥ upa-barhaṇam cakṣuḥ āḥ abhi-añjanam dyauḥ bhūmiḥ kośaḥ āsīt yat ayāt sūryā patim
stomāḥ āsan prati-dhayaḥ kurīram chandaḥ opaśaḥ sūryāyāḥ aśvinā varā agniḥ āsīt puraḥ-gavaḥ
somaḥ vadhū-yuḥ abhavat aśvinā āstām ubhā varā sūryām yat patye śaṁsantīm manasā savitā adadāt
manaḥ asyāḥ anaḥ āsīt dyauḥ āsīt uta chadiḥ śukrau anaḍavaḍhabadabadrahṇāhau āstām yat ayāt sūryā gr̥ham
r̥k-sāmābhyām abhi-hitau gāvau te sāmanau itaḥ śrotram te cakre iti āstām divi panthāḥ carācaraḥ
śucī te cakre iti yātyāḥ vi-ānaḥ akṣaḥ āhataḥ anaḥ manasmayam sūryā ā arohat pra-yatī patim
sūryāyāḥ vahatuḥ pra agāt savitā yam ava-asr̥jat aghāsu hanyante gāvaḥ arjunyoḥ pari uhyate
yat aśvinā pr̥cchamānau ayātam tri-cakreṇa vahatum sūryāyāḥ viśve devāḥ anu tat vām ajānan putraḥ pitarau avr̥ṇīta pūṣā
yat ayātam śubhaḥ patī iti vare--yam sūryām upa kva ekam cakram vām āsīt kva deṣṭrāya tasthathuḥ
dve iti te cakre iti sūrye brahmāṇaḥ r̥tu-thā viduḥ atha ekam cakram yat guhā tat addhātayaḥ it viduḥ
sūryāyai devebhyaḥ mitrāya varuṇāya ca ye bhūtasya pra-cetasaḥ idam tebhyaḥ akaram namaḥ
pūrva-aparam carataḥ māyayā etau śiśūiti krīl̥antau pari yātaḥ adhvaram viśvāni anyaḥ bhuvanā abhi-caṣṭe r̥tūn anyaḥ vi-dadhat jāyate punariti
navaḥ-navaḥ bhavati jāyamānaḥ ahnām ketuḥ uṣasām eti agram bhāgam devebhyaḥ vi dadhāti āyan pra candramāḥ tirate dīrgham āyuḥ
su-kiṁśukam śalmalim viśva-rūpam hiraṇya-varṇam su-vr̥tam su-cakram ā roha sūrye amr̥tasya lokam syonam patye vahatum kr̥ṇuṣva
ut īrṣva ataḥ pati-vatī hi eṣā viśva-vasum namasā gīḥ-bhiḥ īl̥e anyām iccha pitr̥-sadam vi-aktām saḥ te bhāgaḥ januṣā tasya viddhi
ut īrṣva ataḥ viśvavaso itiviśva-vaso namasā īl̥āmahe tvā anyām iccha pra-pharvyam sam jāyām patyā sr̥ja
anr̥kṣarāḥ r̥javaḥ santu panthāḥ yebhiḥ sakhāyaḥ yanti naḥ vare--yam sam aryamā sam bhagaḥ naḥ ninīyāt sam jāḥ-patyam su-yamam astu devāḥ
pra tvā muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt yena tvā abadhnāt savitā su-śevaḥ r̥tasya yonau su-kr̥tasya loke ariṣṭām tvā saha patyā dadhāmi
pra itaḥ muñcāmi na amutaḥ su-baddhām amutaḥ karam yathā iyam indra mīḍhavaḥ su-putrā su-bhagā asati
pūṣā tvā itaḥ nayatu hasta-gr̥hya aśvinā tvā pra vahatām rathena gr̥hān gaccha gr̥ha-patnī yathā asaḥ vaśinī tvam vidatham ā vadāsi
iha priyam pra-jayā te sam r̥dhyatām asmin gr̥he gārha-patyāya jāgr̥hi enā patyā tanvam sam sr̥jasva adha jivrī iti vidatham ā vadāthaḥ
nīla-lohitam bhavati kr̥tyā āsaktiḥ vyajyate edhante asyāḥ jñātayaḥ patiḥ bandheṣu badhyate
parā dehi śāmulyam brahma-bhyaḥ vi bhaja vasu kr̥tyā eṣā pat-vatī bhūtvī ā jāyā viśate patim
aśrīrā tanūḥ bhavati ruśatī pāpayā amuyā patiḥ yat vadhvaḥ vāsasā svam aṅgam abhi-dhitsate
ye vadhvaḥ candram vahatum yakṣmāḥ yanti janāt anu punariti tān yajñiyāḥ devāḥ nayantu yataḥ āgatāḥ
mā vidan pari-panthinaḥ ye āsīt anti dampatī itidam-patī su-gebhiḥ duḥ-gam ati itām apa drāntu arātayaḥ
su-maṅgalīḥ iyam vadhūḥ imām sam-eta paśyata saubhāgyam asyai dattvāya atha astam vi parā itana
tr̥ṣṭam etat kaṭukam etat apāṣṭha-vat viṣa-vat na etat attave sūryām yaḥ brahmā vidyāt saḥ it vādhū-yam arhati
āśasanam vi-śasanam atho iti adhi-vikartanam sūryāyāḥ paśya rūpāṇi tāni brahmā tu śundhati
gr̥bhṇāmi te saubhaga-tvāya hastam mayā patyā jarat-aṣṭiḥ yathā asaḥ bhagaḥ aryamā savitā puram-dhiḥ mahyam tvā aduḥ gārha-patyāya devāḥ
tām pūṣan śiva-tamām ā īrayasva yasyām bījam manuṣyāḥ vapanti yā naḥ ūrū iti uśatī vi-śrayāte yasyām uśantaḥ pra-harāmaḥśepam
tubhyam agre pari avahan sūryām vahatunā saha punariti pati-bhyaḥ jāyām dāḥ agne pra-jayā saha
punariti patnīm agniḥ adāt āyuṣā saha varcasā dīrgha-āyuḥ asyāḥ yaḥ patiḥ jīvāti śaradaḥ śatam
somaḥ prathamaḥ vivide gandharvaḥ vivide ut-taraḥ tr̥tīyaḥ agniḥ te patiḥ turīyaḥ te manuṣya-jāḥ
somaḥ dadat gandharvāya gandharvaḥ dadat agnaye rayim ca putrān ca adāt agniḥ mahyam atho iti imām
iha eva stam mā vi yauṣṭam viśvam āyuḥ vi aśnutam krīl̥antau putraiḥ naptr̥-bhiḥ modamānau sve gr̥he
ā naḥ pra-jām janayatu prajāpatiḥ ājarasāya sam anaktu aryamā aduḥ-maṅgalīḥ pati-lokam ā viśa śam naḥ bhava dvi-pade śam catuḥ-pade
aghora-cakṣuḥ apati-ghnī edhi śivā paśu-bhyaḥ su-manāḥ su-varcāḥ vīra-sūḥ deva-kāmā syonā śam naḥ bhava dvi-pade śam catuḥ-pade
imām tvam indra mīḍhavaḥ su-putrām su-bhagām kr̥ṇu daśa asyām putrān ā dhehi patim ekādaśam kr̥dhi
sam-rājñī śvaśure bhava sam-rājñī śvaśrvām bhava nanāndari sam-rājñī bhava sam-rājñī adhi devr̥ṣu
sam añjantu viśve devāḥ sam āpaḥ hr̥dayāni nau sam mātariśvā sam dhātā sam oṁ iti deṣṭrī dadhātu nau
vi hi sotoḥ asr̥kṣata na indram devam amaṁsata yatra amadat vr̥ṣākapiḥ aryaḥ puṣṭeṣu mat-sakhā viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
parā hi indra dhāvasi vr̥ṣākapeḥ ati vyathiḥ naḥ aha pra vindasi anyatra soma-pītaye viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
kim ayam tvām vr̥ṣākapiḥ cakāra haritaḥ mr̥gaḥ yasmai irasyasi it oṁ iti nu aryaḥ vā puṣṭi-mat vasu viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
yam imam tvam vr̥ṣākapim priyam indra abhi-rakasi śvā nu asya jambhiṣat api karṇe varāha-yuḥ viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
priyā taṣṭāni me kapiḥ vi-aktā vi adūduṣat śiraḥ nu asya rāviṣam na su-gam duḥ-kr̥te bhuvam viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
na mat strī subhasat-tarā na suyāśu-tarā bhuvat na mat prati-cyavīyasī na sakthi ut-yamīyasī viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
suve amba sulābhike yathāiva aṅga bhaviṣyati bhasat me amba sakthi me śiraḥ me vi-iva hr̥ṣyati viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
kim subāho itisu-bāho su-aṅgure pr̥thusto itipr̥thu-sto pr̥thu-jaghane kim śūra-patni naḥ tvam abhi amīṣi vr̥ṣākapim viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
avīrām-iva mām ayam śarāruḥ abhi manyate uta aham asmi vīriṇī indra-patnī marut-sakhā viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
sam-hotram sma purā nārī samanam vā ava gacchati vedhāḥ r̥tasya vīriṇī indra-patnī mahīyate viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
indrāṇīm āsu nāriṣu su-bhagām aham aśravam nahi asyāḥ aparam cana jarasā marate patiḥ viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
na aham indrāṇi raraṇa sakhyuḥ vr̥ṣākapeḥ r̥te yasya idam apyam haviḥ priyam deveṣu gacchati viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
vr̥ṣākapāyi revati su-putre āt oṁ iti su-snuṣe ghasat te indraḥ ukṣaṇaḥ priyam kācit-karam haviḥ vi śvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
ukṣṇaḥ hi me pañca-daśa sākam pacanti viṁśatim uta aham admi pīvaḥ it ubhā kukṣī iti pr̥ṇanti me viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
vr̥ṣabhaḥ na tigma-śr̥ṅgaḥ antaḥ yūtheṣu roruvat manthaḥ te indra śam hr̥de yam te sunoti bhāvayuḥ viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
na saḥ īśe yasya rambate antarā sakthyā kapr̥t saḥ it īśe yasya romaśam ni-seduṣaḥ vi-jr̥mbhate viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
na saḥ īśe yasya romaśam ni-seduṣaḥ vi-jr̥mbhate saḥ it īśe yasya rambate antarā sakthyā kapr̥t viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
ayam indra vr̥ṣākapiḥ parasvantam hatam vidat asim sūnām navam carum āt edhasya anaḥ ācitam viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
ayam emi vi-cākaśat vi-cinvan dāsam āryam pibāmi pāka-sutvanaḥ abhi dhīram acākaśam viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
dhanva ca yat kr̥ntatram ca kati svit tā vi yojanā nedīyasaḥ vr̥ṣākape astam ā ihi gr̥hān upa viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
punaḥ ā ihi vr̥ṣākape suvitā kalpayāvahai yaḥ eṣaḥ svapna-naṁśanaḥ astam eṣi pathā punaḥ viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
yat udañcaḥ vr̥ṣākape gr̥ham indra ajagantana kva syaḥ pulvaghaḥ mr̥gaḥ kam agan jana-yopanaḥ viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
paśuḥ ha nāma mānavī sākam sasūva viṁśatim bhadram bhala tyasyai abhūt yasyāḥ udaram āmayat viśvasmāt indraḥ ut-taraḥ
rakṣaḥ-hanam vājinam ā jigharmi mitram prathiṣṭham upa yāmi śarma śiśānaḥ agniḥ kratu-bhiḥ sam-iddhaḥ saḥ naḥ divā saḥ riṣaḥ pātu naktam
ayaḥ-daṁṣṭraḥ arciṣā yātu-dhānān upa spr̥śa jāta-vedaḥ sam-iddhaḥ ā jihvayā mūra-devān rabhasva kravya-adaḥ vr̥ktvī api dhatsva āsan
ubhā ubhayāvin upa dhehi daṁṣṭrā hiṁsraḥ śiśānaḥ avaram param ca uta antarikṣe pari yāhi rājan jambhaiḥ sam dhehi abhi yātu-dhānān
yajñaiḥ iṣūḥ sam-namamānaḥ agne vācā śalyān aśani-bhiḥ dihānaḥ tābhiḥ vidhya hr̥daye yātu-dhānān pratīcaḥ bāhūn prati bhaṅdhi eṣām
agne tvacam yātu-dhānasya bhindhi hiṁsrā aśaniḥ harasā hantu enam pra parvāṇi jāta-vedaḥ śr̥ṇīhi kravyāt kraviṣṇuḥ vi cinotu vr̥kṇam
yatra idānīm paśyasi jāta-vedaḥ tiṣṭhantam agne uta vā carantam yat vā antarikṣe pathi-bhiḥ patantam tam astā vidhya śarvā śiśānaḥ
uta ālabdham spr̥ṇuhi jāta-vedaḥ ālebhānāt r̥ṣṭi-bhiḥ yātu-dhānāt agne pūrvaḥ ni jahi śośucānaḥ āma-adaḥ kṣviṅkāḥ tam adantu enīḥ
iha pra brūhi yatamaḥ saḥ agne yaḥ yātu-dhānaḥ yaḥ idam kr̥ṇoti tam ā rabhasva sam-idhā yaviṣṭha nr̥-cakṣasaḥ cakṣuṣe randhaya enam
tīkṣṇena agne cakṣuṣā rakṣa yajñam prāñcam vasu-bhyaḥ pra naya pra-cetaḥ hiṁsram rakṣāṁsi abhi śośucānam mā tvā dabhan yātu-dhānāḥ nr̥-cakṣaḥ
nr̥-cakṣāḥ rakṣaḥ pari paśya vikṣu tasya trīṇi prati śr̥ṇīhi agrā tasya agne pr̥ṣṭīḥ harasā śr̥ṇīhi tredhā mūlam yātu-dhānasya vr̥śca
triḥ yātu-dhānaḥ pra-sitim te etu r̥tam yaḥ agne anr̥tena hanti tam arciṣā sphūrjayan jāta-vedaḥ sam-akṣam enam gr̥ṇate ni vr̥ṅdhi
tat agne cakṣuḥ prati dhehi rebhe śapha-ārujam yena paśyasi yātu-dhānam atharva-vat jyotiṣā daivyena satyam dhūrvantam acitam ni oṣa
yat agne adya mithunā śapātaḥ yat vācaḥ tr̥ṣṭam janayanta rebhāḥ manyoḥ manasaḥ śaravyā jāyate yā tayā vidhya hr̥daye yātu-dhānān
parā śr̥ṇīhi tapasā yātu-dhānān parā agne rakṣaḥ harasā śr̥ṇīhi parā arciṣā mūra-devān śr̥ṇīhi parā asu-tr̥paḥ abhi śośucānaḥ
parā adya devāḥ vr̥jinam śr̥ṇantu pratyak enam śapathāḥ yantu tr̥ṣṭāḥ vācāstenam śaravaḥ r̥cchantu marman viśvasya etu pra-sitim yātu-dhānaḥ
yaḥ pauruṣeyeṇa kraviṣā sam-aṅkte yaḥ aśvyena paśunā yātu-dhānaḥ yaḥ aghnyāyāḥ bharati kṣīram agne teṣām śīrṣāṇi harasā api vr̥śca
saṁvatsarīṇam payaḥ usriyāyāḥ tasya mā aśīt yātu-dhānaḥ nr̥-cakṣaḥ pīyūṣam agne yatamaḥ titr̥psāt tam pratyañcam arciṣā vidhya marman
viṣam gavām yātu-dhānāḥ pibantu ā vr̥ścyantām aditaye duḥ-evāḥ parā enān devaḥ savitā dadātu parā bhāgam oṣadhīnām jayantām
sanāt agne mr̥ṇasi yātu-dhānān na tvā rakṣāṁsi pr̥tanāsu jigyuḥ anu daha saha-mūrān kravya-adaḥ mā te hetyāḥ mukṣata daivyāyāḥ
tvam naḥ agne adharāt udaktāt tvam paścāt uta rakṣa purastāt prati te te ajarāsaḥ tapiṣṭhāḥ agha-śaṁsam śośucataḥ dahantu
paścāt purastāt adharāt udaktāt kaviḥ kāvyena pari pāhi rājan sakhe sakhāyam ajaraḥ jarimṇe agne martān amartyaḥ tvam naḥ
pari tvā agne puram vayam vipram sahasya dhīmahi dhr̥ṣat-varṇam dive--dive hantāram bhaṅgura-vatām
viṣeṇa bhaṅgura-vataḥ prati sma rakṣasaḥ daha agne tigmena śociṣā tapuḥ-agrābhiḥ r̥ṣṭi-bhiḥ
prati agne mithunā daha yātu-dhānā kimīdinā sam tvā śiśāmi jāgr̥hi adabdham vipra manma-bhiḥ
prati agne harasā haraḥ śr̥ṇīhi viśvataḥ prati yātu-dhānasya rakṣasaḥ balam vi ruja vīryam
haviḥ pāntam ajaram svaḥ-vidi divi-spr̥śi āhutam juṣṭam agnau tasya bharmaṇe bhuvanāya devāḥ dharmaṇe kam svadhayā paprathanta
gīrṇam bhuvanam tamasā apa-gūl̥ham āviḥ svaḥ abhavat jāte agnau tasya devāḥ pr̥thivī dyauḥ uta āpaḥ araṇayan oṣadhīḥ sakhye asya
devebhiḥ nu iṣitaḥ yajñiyebhiḥ agnim stoṣāṇi ajaram br̥hantam yaḥ bhānunā pr̥thivīm dyām uta imām ātatāna rodasī iti antarikṣam
yaḥ hotā āsīt prathamaḥ deva-juṣṭaḥ yam sam-āñjan ājyena vr̥ṇānāḥ saḥ patatri itvaram sthāḥ jagat yat śvātram agniḥ akr̥ṇot jāta-vedāḥ
yat jāta-vedaḥ bhuvanasya mūrdhan atiṣṭhaḥ agne saha rocanena tam tvā ahema mati-bhiḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ ukthaiḥ saḥ yajñiyaḥ abhavaḥ rodasi-prāḥ
mūrdhā bhuvaḥ bhavati naktam agniḥ tataḥ sūryaḥ jāyate prātaḥ ut-yan māyām oṁ iti tu yajñiyānām etām apaḥ yat tūrṇiḥ carati pra-jānan
dr̥śenyaḥ yaḥ mahinā sam-iddhaḥ arocata divi-yoniḥ vibhāvā tasmi n agnau sūkta-vākena devāḥ haviḥ viśve ā ajuhavuḥ tanū-pāḥ
sūkta-vākam prathamam āt it agnim āt it haviḥ ajanayanta devāḥ saḥ eṣām yajñaḥ abhavat tanū-pāḥ tam dyauḥ veda tam pr̥thivī tam āpaḥ
yam devāsaḥ ajanayanta agnim yasmin ā ajuhavuḥ bhuvanāni viśvā saḥ arciṣā pr̥thivīm dyām uta imām r̥ju-yamānaḥ atapat mahi-tvā
stomena hi divi devāsaḥ agnim ajījanan śakti-bhiḥ rodasi-prām tam oṁ iti akr̥ṇvan tredhā bhuve kam saḥ oṣadhīḥ pacati viśva-rūpāḥ
yadā it enam adadhuḥ yajñiyāsaḥ divi devāḥ sūryam āditeyam yadā cariṣṇū iti mithunau abhūtām āt it pra apaśyan bhuvanāni viśvā
viśvasmai agnim bhuvanāya devāḥ vaiśvānaram ketum ahnām akr̥ṇvan ā yaḥ tatāna uṣasaḥ vi-bhātīḥ apo iti ūrṇoti tamaḥ arciṣā yan
vaiśvānaram kavayaḥ yajñiyāḥ agnim devāḥ ajanayan arjuryam nakṣatram pratnam aminat cariṣṇu yakṣasya adhi-akṣam taviṣam br̥hantam
vaiśvānaram viśvahā dīdi-vāṁsam mantraiḥ agnim kavim accha vadāmaḥ yaḥ mahimnā pari-babhūva urvī iti uta avastāt uta devaḥ parastāt
dve iti srutī iti aśr̥ṇavam pitr̥r̥ṇām aham devānām uta martyānām tābhyām idam viśvam ejat sam eti yat antarā pitaram mātaram ca
dve iti samīcī itisam-īcī bibhr̥taḥ carantam śīrṣataḥ jātam manasā vi-mr̥ṣṭam saḥ pratyaṅ viśvā bhuvanāni tasthau apra-yucchan taraṇiḥ bhrājamānaḥ
yatra vadeteiti avaraḥ paraḥ ca yajña-nyoḥ kataraḥ nau vi veda ā śekuḥ it sadha-mādam sakhāyaḥ nakṣanta yajñam kaḥ idam vi vocat
kati agnayaḥ kati sūryāsaḥ kati uṣasaḥ kati oṁ iti svit āpaḥ na upa-spijam vaḥ pitaraḥ vadāmi pr̥cchāmi vaḥ kavayaḥ vidmane kam
yāvat-mātram uṣasaḥ na pratīkam su-parṇyaḥ vasate mātariśvaḥ tāvat dadhāti upa yajñam āyan brāhmaṇaḥ hotuḥ avaraḥ ni-sīdan
indram stava nr̥-tamam yasya mahnā vi-babādhe rocanā vi jmaḥ antān ā yaḥ paprau carṣaṇi-dhr̥t varaḥ-bhiḥ pra sindhu-bhyaḥ riricānaḥ mahi-tvā
saḥ sūryaḥ pari uru varāṁsi ā indraḥ vavr̥tyāt rathyāiva cakrā atiṣṭhantam apasyam na sargam kr̥ṣṇā tamāṁsi tviṣyā jaghāna
samānam asmai anapa-vr̥t arca kṣmayā divaḥ asamam brahma navyam vi yaḥ pr̥ṣṭhāiva janimāni aryaḥ indraḥ cikāya na sakhāyam īṣe
indrāya giraḥ aniśita-sargāḥ apaḥ pra īrayam sagarasya budhnāt yaḥ akṣeṇa-iva cakriyā śacībhiḥ viṣvak tastambha pr̥thivīm uta dyām
āpānta-manyuḥ tr̥pala-prabharmā dhuniḥ śimī-vān śaru-mān r̥jīṣī somaḥ viśvāni atasā vanāni na arvāk indram prati-mānāni debhuḥ
na yasya dyāvāpr̥thivī iti na dhanva na antarikṣam na adrayaḥ somaḥ akṣāriti yat asya manyuḥ adhi-nīyamānaḥ śr̥ṇāti vīl̥u rujati sthirāṇi
jaghāna vr̥tram sva-dhitiḥ vanāiva ruroja puraḥ aradat na sindhūn bibheda girim navam it na kumbham ā gāḥ indraḥ akr̥ṇuta svayuk-bhiḥ
tvam ha tyat r̥ṇa-yāḥ indra dhīraḥ asiḥ na parva vr̥jinā śr̥ṇāsi pra ye mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma yujam na janāḥ minanti mitram
pra ye mitram pra aryamaṇam duḥ-evāḥ pra sam-giraḥ pra varuṇam minanti ni amitreṣu vadham indra tumram vr̥ṣan vr̥ṣāṇam aruṣam śiśīhi
indraḥ divaḥ indraḥ īśe pr̥thivyāḥ indraḥ apām indraḥ it parvatānām indraḥ vr̥dhām indraḥ it medhirāṇām indraḥ kṣeme yoge havyaḥ indraḥ
pra aktu-bhyaḥ indraḥ pra vr̥dhaḥ aha-bhyaḥ pra antarikṣāt pra samudrasya dhāseḥ pra vātasya prathasaḥ pra jmaḥ antāt pra sindhu-bhyaḥ ririce pra kṣiti-bhyaḥ
pra śośucatyāḥ uṣasaḥ na ketuḥ asinvā te vartatām indra hetiḥ aśmāiva vidhya divaḥ ā sr̥jānaḥ tapiṣṭhena heṣasā drogha-mitrān
anu aha māsāḥ anu it vanāni anu oṣadhīḥ anu parvatāsaḥ anu indram rodasī iti vāvaśāne iti anu āpaḥ ajihata jāyamānam
karhi svit sā te indra cetyā asat aghasya yat bhinadaḥ rakṣaḥ āīṣat mitra-kruvaḥ yat śasane na gāvaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ āpr̥k amuyā śayante
śatru-yantaḥ abhi ye naḥ tatasre mahi vrādhantaḥ ogaṇāsaḥ indra andhena amitrāḥ tamasā sacantām su-jyotiṣaḥ aktavaḥ tān abhi syuri tisyuḥ
purūṇi hi tvā savanā janānām brahmāṇi mandan gr̥ṇatām r̥ṣīṇām imām āghoṣan avasā sa-hūtim tiraḥ viśvān arcataḥ yāhi arvāṅ
eva te vayam indra bhuñjatīnām vidyāma su-matīnām navānām vidyāma vastoḥ avasā gr̥ṇantaḥ viśvāmitrāḥ uta te indra nūnam
śunam huvema magha-vānam indram asmin bhare nr̥-tamam vāja-sātau śr̥ṇvantam ugram ūtaye samat-su ghnantam vr̥trāṇi sam-jitam dhanānām
sahasra-śīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasra-akṣaḥ sahasra-pāt saḥ bhūmim viśvataḥ vr̥tvā ati atiṣṭhat daśa-aṅgulam
puruṣaḥ eva idam sarvam yat bhūtam yat ca bhavyam uta amr̥ta-tvasya īśānaḥ yat annena ati-rohati
etāvān asya mahimā ataḥ jyāyān ca puruṣaḥ pādaḥ asya viśvā bhūtāni tri-pāt asya amr̥tam divi
tri-pāt ūrdhva ut ait puruṣaḥ pādaḥ asya iha abhavat punariti tataḥ viṣvaṅ vi akrāmat sāśanānaśane iti abhi
tasmāt virāṭ ajāyata vi-rājaḥ adhi puruṣaḥ saḥ jātaḥ ati aricyata paścāt bhūmim atho iti puraḥ
yat puruṣeṇa haviṣā devāḥ yajñam atanvata vasantaḥ asya āsīt ājyam grīṣmaḥ idmaḥ śarat haviḥ
tam yajñam barhiṣi pra aukṣan puruṣam jātam agrataḥ tena devāḥ ayajanta sādhyāḥ r̥ṣayaḥ ca ye
tasmāt yajñāt sarva-hutaḥ sam-bhr̥tam pr̥ṣat-ājyam paśūn tān cakre vāyavyān āraṇyān grāmyāḥ ca ye
tasmāt yajñāt sarva-hutaḥ r̥caḥ sāmāni jajñire chandāṁsi jajñire tasmāt yajuḥ tasmāt ajāyata
tasmāt aśvāḥ ajāyanta ye ke ca ubhayādataḥ gāvaḥ ha jajñire tasmāt tasmāt jātāḥ ajāvayaḥ
yat puruṣam vi adadhuḥ katidhā vi akalpayan mukham kim asya kau bāhū iti kau ūrū iti pādau ucyeteiti
brāhmaṇaḥ asya mukham āsīt bāhū iti rājanyaḥ kr̥taḥ ūrū iti tat asya yat vaiśyaḥ pat-bhyām śūdraḥ ajāyata
candramā manasaḥ jātaḥ cakṣoḥ sūryaḥ ajāyata mukhāt indraḥ ca agni ḥ ca prāṇāt vāyuḥ ajāyata
nābhyāḥ āsīt antarikṣam śīrṣṇaḥ dyauḥ sam avartata pat-bhyām bhūmiḥ diśaḥ śrotrāt tathā lokān akalpayan
sapta asya āsan pari-dhayaḥ triḥ sapta sam-idhaḥ kr̥tāḥ devāḥ yat yajñam tanvānāḥ abadhnan puruṣam paśum
yajñena yajñam ayajanta devāḥ tāni dharmāṇi prathamāni āsan te ha nākam mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ
sam jāgr̥vat-bhiḥ jaramāṇaḥ idyate dame damūnāḥ iṣayan il̥aḥ pade v iśvasya hotā haviṣaḥ vareṇyaḥ vi-bhuḥ vibhāvā su-sakhā sakhi-yate
saḥ darśata-śrīḥ atithiḥ gr̥he--gr̥he vane--vane śiśriye takvavīḥ-iva janam-janam janyaḥ na ati manyate viśaḥ ā kṣeti viśyaḥ viśam-viśam
su-dakṣaḥ dakṣaḥ kratunā asi su-kratuḥ agne kaviḥ kāvyena asi viśva-vit vasuḥ vasūnām kṣayasi tvam ekaḥ it dyāvā ca yāni pr̥thivī iti ca puṣyataḥ
pra-jānan agne tava yonim r̥tviyam il̥āyāḥ pade ghr̥ta-vantam ā asadaḥ ā te cikitre uṣasām-iva etayaḥ arepasaḥ sūryasya-iva raśmayaḥ
tava śriyaḥ varṣyasya-iva vi-dyutaḥ citrāḥ cikitre uṣasām na ketavaḥ yat oṣadhīḥ abhi-sr̥ṣṭaḥ vanāni ca pari svayam cinuṣe annam āsye
tam oṣadhīḥ dadhire garbham r̥tviyam tam āpaḥ agnim janayanta mātaraḥ tam it samānam vaninaḥ ca vīrudhaḥ antaḥ-vatīḥ ca suvate ca viśvahā
vāta-upadhūtaḥ iṣitaḥ vaśān anu tr̥ṣu yat annā veviṣat v-tiṣṭhase ā te yatante rathyāḥ yathā pr̥thak śardhāṁsi agne ajarāṇi dhakṣataḥ
medhākāram vidathasya pra-sādhanam agnim hotāram pari-bhūtamam matim tam it arbhe haviṣi ā samānam it tam it mahe vr̥ṇate na anyam tvat
tvām it atra vr̥ṇate tvāyavaḥ hotāram agne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ yat deva-yantaḥ dadhati prayāṁsi te haviṣmantaḥ manavaḥ vr̥kta-barh iṣaḥ
tava agne hotram tava potram r̥tviyam tava neṣṭram tvam agnid r̥ta-yataḥ tava pra-śāstram tvam adhvari-yasi brahmā ca asi gr̥ha-patiḥ ca naḥ dame
yaḥ tubhyam agne amr̥tāya martyaḥ sam-idhā dāśat uta vā haviḥ-kr̥ti tasya hotā bhavasi yāsi dūtyam upa brūṣe yajasi adhvari-yasi
imāḥ asmai matayaḥ vācaḥ asmat ā r̥caḥ giraḥ su-stutayaḥ sam agmata vasu-yavaḥ vasave jāta-vedaḥ vr̥ddhāsu cit vardhanaḥ yāsu cākanat
imām pratnāya su-stutim navīyasīm voceyam asmai uśate śr̥ṇotu naḥ bhūyāḥ antarā hr̥di asya ni-spr̥śe jāyāiva patye uśatī su-vāsāḥ
yasmin aśvāsaḥ r̥ṣabhāsaḥ ukṣaṇaḥ vaśāḥ meṣāḥ ava-sr̥ṣṭāsaḥ āhutāḥ kīlāla-pe soma-pr̥ṣṭhāya vedhase hr̥dā matim janaye cārum agnaye
ahāvi agne haviḥ āsye te sruci-iva ghr̥tam camvi-iva somaḥ vāja-sanim rayim asme iti su-vīram pra-śastam dhehi yaśasam br̥hantam
<b>(r̥V_10,92)yajñasya vaḥ rathyam viśpatim viśām hotāram aktoḥ atithim vibhāvasum śocan śuṣkāsu hariṇīṣu jarbhurat vr̥ṣā ketuḥ yajataḥ dyām aśāyata
imam añjaḥ-pām ubhaye akr̥ṇvata dharmāṇam agnim vidathasya sādhanam aktum na yahvam uṣasaḥ puraḥ-hitam tanū-napātam aruṣasya niṁsate
baṭ asya nīthā vi paṇeḥ ca manmahe vayāḥ asya pra-hutāḥ āsuḥ attave yadā ghorāsaḥ amr̥ta-tvam āśata āt it janasya daivyasya carkiran
r̥tasya hi pra-sitiḥ dyauḥ uru vyacaḥ namaḥ mahī aramatiḥ panāyasī indraḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ sam cikitrire atho iti bhagaḥ savitā pūta-dakṣasaḥ
pra rudreṇa yayinā yanti sindhavaḥ tiraḥ mahīm aramatim dadhanvire yebhiḥ pari-jmā pari-yan uru jrayaḥ vi roruvat jaṭhare viśvam ukṣate
krāṇāḥ rudrāḥ marutaḥ viśva-kr̥ṣṭayaḥ divaḥ śyenāsaḥ asurasya nīl̥ayaḥ tebhiḥ caṣṭe varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā indraḥ devebhiḥ arvaśebhiḥ arvaśaḥ
indre bhujam śaśamānāsaḥ āśata sūraḥ dr̥śīke vr̥ṣaṇaḥ ca paiṁsye pra ye nu asya arhaṇā tatakṣire yujam vajram nr̥-sadaneṣu kāravaḥ
sūraḥ cit ā haritaḥ asya rīramat indrāt ā kaḥ cit bhayate tavīyasaḥ bhīmasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ jaṭharāt abhi-śvasaḥ dive--dive sahuriḥ stan abādhitaḥ
stomam vaḥ adya rudrāya śikvase kṣayat-vīrāya namasā didiṣṭana yebhiḥ śivaḥ sva-vān evayāva-bhiḥ divaḥ sisakti sva-yaśāḥ nikāma-bhiḥ
te hi pra-jāyāḥ abharanta vi śravaḥ br̥haspatiḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ soma-jāmayaḥ yajñaiḥ atharvā prathamaḥ vi dhārayat devāḥ dakṣaiḥ bhr̥gavaḥ sam cikitrire
te hi dyāvāpr̥thivī iti bhūri-retasā narāśaṁsaḥ catuḥ-aṅgaḥ yamaḥ aditiḥ devaḥ tvaṣṭā draviṇaḥ-dāḥ r̥bhukṣaṇaḥ pra rodasī iti marutaḥ viṣṇuḥ arhire
uta syaḥ naḥ uśijām urviyā kaviḥ ahiḥ śr̥ṇotu budhnyaḥ havīmani sūryāmāsā vi-carantā divi-kṣitā dhiyā śamīnahuṣī iti asya bodhatam
pra naḥ pūṣā caratham viśva-devyaḥ apām napāt avatu vāyuḥ iṣṭaye ātmānam vasyaḥ abhi vātam arcata tat aśvinā su-havā yāmani śrutam
viśām āsām abhayānām adhi-kṣitam gīḥ-bhiḥ oṁ iti sva-yaśasam gr̥ṇīmasi gnābhiḥ viśvābhiḥ aditim anarvaṇam aktoḥ yuvānam nr̥-manāḥ / adha patim
rebhat atra januṣā pūrvaḥ aṅgirāḥ grāvāṇaḥ ūrdhvāḥ abhi cakṣuḥ adhvaram yebhiḥ vi-hāyāḥ abhavat vi-cakṣaṇaḥ pāthaḥ su-mekam sva-dhitiḥ vanan-vati
mahi dyāvāpr̥thivī iti bhūtam urvī iti nārī iti yahvī iti na rodasī iti sadam naḥ tebhiḥ naḥ pātam sahyasaḥ ebhiḥ naḥ pātam śūṣaṇi
yajñe--yajñe saḥ martyaḥ devān saparyati yaḥ sumnaiḥ dīrghaśrut-tamaḥ āvivāsāti enān
viśveṣām irajyavaḥ devānām vāḥ mahaḥ viśve hi viśva-mahasaḥ viśve yajñeṣu yajñiyāḥ
te gha rājānaḥ amr̥tasya mandrāḥ aryamā mitraḥ varuṇaḥ pari-jmā kat rudraḥ nr̥ṇām stutaḥ marutaḥ pūṣaṇaḥ bhagaḥ
uta naḥ naktam apām vr̥ṣaṇvasūitivr̥ṣaṇ-vasū sūryāmāsā sadanāya sa-dhanyā sacā yat sādi eṣām ahiḥ budhneṣu budhnyaḥ
uta naḥ devau aśvinā śubhaḥ patī iti dhāma-bhiḥ mitrāvaruṇau uruṣyatām mahaḥ saḥ rāyaḥ ā īṣate ati dhanvāiva duḥ-itā
uta naḥ rudrā cit mr̥l̥atām aśvinā viśve devāsaḥ rathaḥpatiḥ bhagaḥ r̥bhuḥ vājaḥ r̥bhukṣaṇaḥ pari-jmā viśva-vedasaḥ
r̥bhuḥ r̥bhukṣāḥ r̥bhuḥ vidhataḥ madaḥ ā te harī iti jūjuvānasya vājinā dustaram yasya sāma cit r̥dhak yajñaḥ na mānuṣaḥ
kr̥dhi naḥ ahrayaḥ deva savitariti saḥ ca stuṣe maghonām sahaḥ naḥ indraḥ vahni-bhiḥ ni eṣām carṣaṇīnām cakram raśmim na yoyuve
ā eṣu dyāvāpr̥thivī iti dhātam mahat asme iti vīreṣu viśva-carṣaṇi śravaḥ pr̥kṣam vājasya sātaye pr̥kṣam rāyā uta turvaṇe
etam śaṁsam indra asma-yuḥ tvam kū-cit santam sahasāvan abhi ṣṭaye sadā pāhi abhiṣṭaye medatām vedatā vaso iti
etam me stomam tanā na sūrye dyutat-yāmānam vavr̥dhanta nr̥ṇām sam-vananam na asvyam taṣṭāiva anapa-cyutam
vavarta yeṣām rāyā yuktā eṣām hiraṇyayī nema-dhitā na paiṁsyā vr̥thāiva viṣṭa-antā
pra tat duḥ-śīme pr̥thavāne vene pra rāme vocam asure maghavat-su ye yuktvāya pañca śatā asma-yu pathā vi-śrāvi eṣām
adhiit nu atra saptatim ca sapta ca sadyaḥ didiṣṭa tānvaḥ sadyaḥ didiṣṭa pārthyaḥ sadyaḥ didiṣṭa māyavaḥ
pra ete vadantu pra vayam vadāma grāva-bhyaḥ vācam vadata vadat-bhyaḥ yat adrayaḥ parvatāḥ sākam āśavaḥ ślokam ghoṣam bharatha indrāya sominaḥ
ete vadanti śata-vat sahasra-vat abhi krandanti haritebhiḥ āsa-bhi ḥ viṣṭavī grāvāṇaḥ su-kr̥taḥ su-kr̥tyayā hotuḥ cit pūrve haviḥ-adyam āśata
ete vadanti avidan anā madhu ni ūṅkhayante adhi pakve āmiṣi vr̥kṣasya śākhām aruṇasya bapsataḥ te sūbharvāḥ vr̥ṣabhāḥ pra īm arāviṣuḥ
br̥hat vadanti madireṇa mandinā indram krośantaḥ avidan anā madhu sam-rabhya dhīrāḥ svasr̥-bhiḥ anartiṣuḥ āghoṣayantaḥ pr̥thivīm upabdi-bhiḥ
su-parṇāḥ vācam akrata upa dyavi ākhare kr̥ṣṇāḥ iṣirāḥ anartiṣuḥ nyak ni yanti uparasya niḥ-kr̥tam puru retaḥ dadhire sūrya-śvitaḥ
ugrāḥ-iva pra-vahantaḥ sam-āyamuḥ sākam yuktāḥ vr̥ṣaṇaḥ bibhrataḥ dhuraḥ yad śvasantaḥ jagrasānāḥ arāviṣuḥ śr̥ṇve eṣām prothathaḥ arvatām-iva
daśāvani-bhyaḥ daśakakṣyebhyaḥ daśa-yoktrebhyaḥ daśa-yojanebhyaḥ daśābhīśu-bhyaḥ arcata ajarebhyaḥ daśa dhuraḥ daśa yuktāḥ vahat-bhyaḥ
te adrayaḥ daśa-yantrāsaḥ āśavaḥ teṣām ādhānam pari eti haryatam te oṁ iti sutasya somyasya andhasaḥ aṁśoḥ pīyūṣam prathamasya bhejire
te soma-adaḥ harī iti indrasya niṁsate aṁśum duhantaḥ adhi āsate gavi tebhiḥ dugdham papi-vān somyam madhu indraḥ vardhate prathate vr̥ṣa-yate
vr̥ṣā vaḥ aṁśuḥ na kila riṣāthana il̥āvantaḥ sadam it sthana āśi tāḥ raivatyāiva mahasā cāravaḥ sthana yasya grāvāṇaḥ ajuṣadhvam adhvaram
tr̥dilāḥ atr̥dilāsaḥ adrayaḥ aśramaṇāḥ aśr̥thitāḥ amr̥tyavaḥ anāturāḥ ajarāḥ stha amaviṣṇavaḥ su-pīvasaḥ atr̥ṣitāḥ atr̥ṣṇa-jaḥ
dhruvāḥ eva vaḥ pitaraḥ yuge--yuge kṣema-kāmāsaḥ sadasaḥ na yuñjate ajuryāsaḥ hari-sācaḥ haridravaḥ ā dyām raveṇa pr̥thivīm aśuśravuḥ
tat it vadanti adrayaḥ vi-mocane yāman añjaḥpāḥ-iva gha it upabdi--bhiḥ vapantaḥ bījam-iva dhānya-kr̥taḥ pr̥ñcanti somam na minanti bapsataḥ
sute adhvare adhi vācam akrata / ā krīl̥ayaḥ na mātaram tudantaḥ vi su muñca susu-vuṣaḥ manīṣām v i vartantām adrayaḥ cāyamānāḥ
haye jāye manasā tiṣṭha ghore vacāṁsi miśrā kr̥ṇavāvahai nu na nau mantrāḥ anuditāsaḥ ete mayaḥ karan para-tare cana ahan
kim etā vācā kr̥ṇava tava aham pra akramiṣam uṣasām agriyāiva purūravaḥ punaḥ astam parā ihi duḥ-āpanā vātaḥ-iva aham asmi
iṣuḥ na śr̥iye iṣu-dheḥ asanā go--sāḥ śatasā na raṁhiḥ avīre kratau vi davidyutat na urā na māyum citayanta dhunayaḥ
sā vasu dadhatī śvaśurāya vayaḥ uṣaḥ yadi vaṣṭi anti-gr̥hāt astam nanakṣe yasmim cākan divā naktam śnathitā vaitasena
triḥ sma māhnaḥ śnathayaḥ vaitasena uta sma me avyatyai pr̥ṇāsi purūravaḥ anu te ketam āyam rājā me vīra tanvaḥ tat āsīḥ
yā su-jūrṇiḥ śreṇiḥ sumne--āpiḥ hrade--cakṣuḥ na granthināī caraṇyuḥ tāḥ añjayaḥ aruṇayaḥ na sasruḥ śriye gāvaḥ na dhenavaḥ anavanta
sam asmin jāyamāne āsata gnāḥ uta īm avardhan nadyaḥ sva-gūrtāḥ mahe yat tvā purūravaḥ raṇāya avardhayan dasyu-hatyāya devāḥ
sacā yat āsu jahatīṣu atkam amānuṣīṣu mānuṣaḥ ni-seve apa sma mat tarasantī na bhujyuḥ tāḥ atrasan ratha-spr̥śaḥ na aśvāḥ
yat āsu martaḥ amr̥tāsu ni-spr̥k sam kṣoṇībhiḥ kratu-bhiḥ na pr̥ṅkte tāḥ ātayaḥ na tanvaḥ śumbhata svāḥ aśvāsaḥ na krīl̥ayaḥ dandaśānāḥ
vi-dyut na yā patantī davidyot bharantī me apyā kāmyāni janiṣṭo iti apaḥ naryaḥ su-jātaḥ pra urvaśī tirata dīrgham āyuḥ
jajñiṣe itthā go--pīthyāya hi dadhātha tat purūravaḥ me ojaḥ aśāsam tvā viduṣī sasmin ahan na me ā aśr̥ṇoḥ kim abhuk vadāsi
kadā sūnuḥ pitaram jātaḥ icchāt cakran na aśru vartayat vi-jānan kaḥ dampatī itidam-patī sa-manasā vi yūyot adha yat agniḥ śvaśureṣu dīdayat
prati bravāṇi vartayate aśru cakran na krandat ādhye śivāyai pra tat te hinava yat te asme iti parā ihi astam nahi mūra mā āpaḥ
su-devaḥ adya pra-patet anāvr̥t parāvatam paramām gantavai oṁ iti adha śayīta niḥ-r̥teḥ upa-sthe adha enam vr̥kāḥ rabhasāsaḥ adyuḥ
purūravaḥ mā mr̥thāḥ mā pra paptaḥ mā tvā vr̥kāsaḥ aśivāsaḥ oṁ iti kṣan na vai straiṇāni sakhyāni santi sālāvr̥kāṇām hr̥dayāni etā
yat vi-rūpā acaram martyeṣu avasam rātrīḥ śaradaḥ catasraḥ ghr̥tasya stokam sakr̥t ahnaḥ āśnām tāt eva idam tatr̥pāṇā carāmi
antarikṣa-prām rajasaḥ vi-mānīm upa śikṣāmi urvaśīm vasiṣṭhaḥ upa tvā rātiḥ su-kr̥tasya tiṣṭhāt ni vartasva hr̥dayam tapyate me
iti tvā devāḥ ime āhuḥ ail̥a yathā īm etat bhavasi mr̥tyu-bandhuḥ pra-jā te devān haviṣā yajāti svaḥ-ge oṁ iti tvam api mādayāse
pra te mahe vidatheśamsiṣam harī iti pra te vanve vanuṣaḥ haryatam madam ghr̥tam na yaḥ hari-bhi ḥ cāru secata ā tvā viśantu hari-varpasam giraḥ
harim hi yonim abhi ye sam-asvaran hinvantaḥ harī iti divyam yathā sadaḥ ā yam pr̥ṇanti hari-bhiḥ na dhenavaḥ indrāya śūṣam hari-vantam arcata
saḥ asya vajraḥ haritaḥ yaḥ āyasaḥ hariḥ ni-kāmaḥ hariḥ ā gabhastyoḥ dyumnī su-śipraḥ harimanyu-sāyakaḥ indre ni rūpā har itā mimikṣire
divi na ketuḥ adhi dhāyi haryataḥ vivyacat vajraḥ haritaḥ na raṁhyā tudat ahim hari-śipraḥ yaḥ āyasaḥ sahasra-śokāḥ abhavat harim-bharaḥ
tvam-tvam aharyathāḥ upa-stutaḥ pūrvebhiḥ indra hari-keśa yajva-bhiḥ tvam haryasi tava viśvam ukthyam asāmi rādhaḥ hari-jāta haryatam
tā vajriṇam mandinam stomyam made indram rathe vahataḥ haryatā harī iti purūṇi asmai savanāni haryate indrāya somāḥ harayaḥ dadhanvire
aram kāmāya harayaḥ dadhanvire sthirāya hinvan harayaḥ harī iti turā arvat-bhiḥ yaḥ hari-bhiḥ joṣam īyate saḥ asya kāmam har i-vantam ānaśe
hari-śmaśāruḥ hari-keśaḥ āyasaḥ turaḥ-peye yaḥ hari-pāḥ avadharta arvat-bhiḥ yaḥ hari-bhiḥ vājinī-vasuḥ ati viśvā duḥ-itā pāriṣat harī iti
sruvāiva yasya hariṇī iti vi-petatuḥ śipreiti vājāya hariṇī iti davidhvataḥ pra yat kr̥te camase marmr̥jat harī iti pītvā madasya haryatasya andhasaḥ
uta sma sadma haryatasya pastyoḥ atyaḥ na vājam hari-vān ac ikradat mahī cit hi dhiṣaṇā aharyat ojasā br̥hat vayaḥ dadhiṣe hayartaḥ cit ā
ā rodasī iti haryamāṇaḥ mahi-tvā navyam-navyam haryasi manma nu priyam pra pastyam asura haryatam goḥ āviḥ kr̥dhi haraye sūryāya
ā tvā haryantam pra-yujaḥ janānām rathe vahantu hari-śipram indra piba yathā prati-bhr̥tasya madhvaḥ haryan yajñam sadha-māde daśa-oṇim
apāḥ pūrveṣām hari-vaḥ sutānām atho iti idam savanam kevalam te mamaddhi somam madhu-mantam indra satrā vr̥ṣan jaṭhare ā vr̥ṣasva
yāḥ oṣadhīḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyaḥ tri-yugam purā manai nu babhrūṇām aham śatam dhāmāni sapta ca
śatam vaḥ amba dhāmāni sahasram uta vaḥ ruhaḥ adha śata-kratvaḥ yūyam imam me agadam kr̥ta
oṣadhīḥ prati modadhvam puṣpa-vatīḥ pra-sūvarīḥ aśvāḥ-iva sa-jitvarīḥ vīrudhaḥ pārayiṣṇvaḥ
oṣadhīḥ iti mātaraḥ tat vaḥ devīḥ upa bruve saneyam aśvam gām vāsaḥ ātmānam tava puruṣa
aśvatthe vaḥ ni-sadanam parṇe vaḥ vasatiḥ kr̥tā go--bhājaḥ it kila asatha yat sanavatha puruṣam
yatra oṣadhīḥ sam-agmata rājānaḥ samitau-iva / vipraḥ saḥ ucyate bhiṣak rakṣaḥ-hā amīva-cātanaḥ
aśva-vatīm sama-vatīm ūrjayantīm ut-ojasam ā avitsi sarvāḥ oṣadhīḥ asmai ariṣṭa-tātaye
ut śuṣmāḥ oṣadhīnām gāvaḥ goṣṭhāt-iva īrate dhanam saniṣyantīnām ātmānam tava puruṣa
iṣkr̥tiḥ nāma vaḥ mātā atho iti yūyam stha niḥ-kr̥tīḥ sīrāḥ patatriṇīḥ sthana yat āmayati niḥ kr̥tha
ati viśvāḥ pari-sthāḥ stenaḥ-iva vrajam akramuḥ oṣadhīḥ pra acucyavuḥ yat kim ca tanvaḥ rapaḥ
yat imāḥ vājayan aham oṣadhīḥ haste ādadhe ātmā yakṣmasya naśyati purā jīva-gr̥bhaḥ yathā
yasya oṣadhīḥ pra-sarpatha aṅgam-aṅgam paruḥ-paruḥ tataḥ yakṣmam vi bādhadhve ugraḥ madhyamaśīḥ-iva
sākam yakṣma pra pata cāṣeṇa kikidīvinā sākam vātasya dhrājyā sākam naśya ni-hākayā
anyā vaḥ anyām avatu anyā anyasyāḥ upa avata tāḥ sarvāḥ sam-vidānāḥ idam me pra avata vacaḥ
yāḥ phalinīḥ yāḥ aphalāḥ apuṣpāḥ yāḥ ca puṣpiṇīḥ br̥haspati-prasūtāḥ tāḥ naḥ muñcantu aṁhasaḥ
muñcantu mā śapathyāt atho iti varuṇyāt uta atho iti yamasya paḍabaḍhabadabadrahṇīśāt sarvasmāt deva-kilbiṣāt
ava-patantīḥ avadan divaḥ oṣadhayaḥ pari yam jīvam aśnavāmahai na saḥ riṣyāti puruṣaḥ
yāḥ oṣadhīḥ soma-rājñīḥ bahvīḥ śata-vicakṣaṇāḥ tāsām tvam asi ut-tamā aram kāmāya śam hr̥de
yāḥ oṣadhīḥ soma-rājñīḥ vi-sthitāḥ pr̥thivīm anu br̥haspati-prasūtāḥ asyai sam datta vīryam
mā vaḥ riṣat khanitā yasmai ca aham khanāmi vaḥ dvi-pat catuḥ-pat asmākam sarvam astu anāturam
yāḥ ca idam upa-śr̥ṇvanti yāḥ ca dūram parāgatāḥ sarvāḥ sam-gatya vīrudhaḥ asyai sam datta vīryam
oṣadhayaḥ sam vadante somena saha rājñā yasmai kr̥ṇoti brāhmaṇaḥ tam rājan pārayāmasi
tvam ut-tamā asi oṣadhe tava vr̥kṣāḥ upastayaḥ upastiḥ astu saḥ asmākam yaḥ asmān abhi-dāsati
br̥haspate prati me devatām ihi mitraḥ vā yat varuṇaḥ vā asi pūṣā ādityaiḥ vā yat vasu-bhiḥ marutvān saḥ parjanyam śam-tanave vr̥ṣaya
ā devaḥ dūtaḥ ajiraḥ cikitvān tvat deva-āpe abhi mām agacchat pratīcīnaḥ prati mām ā vavr̥tsva dadhāmi te dyu-matīm vācam āsan
