asme iti dhehi dyu-matīm vācam āsan br̥haspate anamīvām iṣirām yayā vr̥ṣṭim śam-tanave vanāva divaḥ drapsaḥ madhu-mān ā viveśa
ā naḥ drapsāḥ madhu-mantaḥ viśantu indra dehi adhi-ratham sahasram ni sīda hotram r̥tu-thā yajasva devān deva-āpe haviṣā sapayar
ārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ hotram r̥ṣiḥ ni-sīdan deva-āpiḥ deva-sumatim cikitvān saḥ ut-tarasmāt adharam samudram apaḥ divyāḥ asr̥jat varṣyāḥ abhi
asmin samudre adhi ut-tarasmin āpaḥ devebhiḥ ni-vr̥tāḥ atiṣṭhan tāḥ adravan ār̥ṣṭiṣeṇena sr̥ṣṭāḥ deva-āpinā pra-iṣitāḥ mr̥kṣiṇīṣu
yat deva-āpiḥ śam-tanave puraḥ-hitaḥ hotrāya vr̥taḥ kr̥payan adīdhet deva-śrutam vr̥ṣṭi-vanim rarāṇaḥ br̥haspatiḥ vācam asmai ayacchat
yam tvā deva-āpiḥ śuśucānaḥ agne ārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ manuṣyaḥ sam-īdhe vi śvebhiḥ devaiḥ anu-madyamānaḥ pra parjanyam īraya vr̥ṣṭi-mantam
tvām pūrve r̥ṣayaḥ gīḥ-bhiḥ āyan tvām adhvareṣu puru-hūta viśve sahasrāṇi adhi-rathāni asme iti ā naḥ yajñam rihit-aśvā upa yāhi
etāni agne navatiḥ nava tve iti āhutāni adhi-rathā sahasrā tebhiḥ vardhasva tanvaḥ śūra pūrvīḥ divaḥ naḥ vr̥ṣṭim iṣitaḥ rirīhi
etāni agne navatim sahasrā sam pra yaccha vr̥ṣṇe indrāya bhāgam vi dvān pathaḥ r̥tu-śaḥ deva-yānān api aulānam divi deveṣu dhehi
agne bādhasva vi mr̥dhaḥ vi duḥ-gahā apa amīvām apa rakṣāṁsi sedha asmāt samudrāt br̥hataḥ divaḥ naḥ apām bhūmānam upa naḥ sr̥ja iha
kam naḥ citram iṣaṇyasi cikitvān pr̥thu-gmānam vāśram vavr̥dhadhyai kat tasya dātu śavasaḥ vi-uṣṭau takṣat vajram vr̥tra-turam apinvat
saḥ hi dyutā vi-dyutā veti sāma pr̥thum yonim asura-tvā sasāda saḥ sa-nīl̥ebhiḥ pra-sahānaḥ asya bhrātuḥ na r̥te saptathasya māyāḥ
saḥ vājam yātā apaduḥ-padā yan svaḥ-sātā pari sadat saniṣyan anarvā yat śata-durasya vedaḥ ghnan śiśna-devān abhi varpasā bhūt
saḥ yahvyaḥ avanīḥ goṣu arvā ā juhoti pra-dhanyāsu sasriḥ apādaḥ yatra yujyāsaḥ arathāḥ droṇi-aśvāsaḥ īrate ghr̥tam vāḥ
saḥ rudrebhiḥ aśasta-vāraḥ r̥bhvā hitvī gayam āre--avadyaḥ ā agāt vamrasya manye mithunā vivavrī itivi-vavrī annam abhi-itya arodayat muṣāyan
saḥ it dāsam tuvi-ravam patiḥ dan ṣaṭ--akṣam tri-śīrṣāṇam damanyat asya tritaḥ nu ojasā vr̥dhānaḥ vipā varāham ayaḥ-agrayā hannitihan
saḥ druhvaṇe manuṣe ūrdhvasānaḥ ā sāviṣat arśasānāya śarum saḥ nr̥-tamaḥ nahuṣaḥ asmat su-jātaḥ puraḥ abhinat arhan dasyu-hatye
saḥ abhriyaḥ na yavase udanyan kṣayāya gātum vidat naḥ asme iti upa yat sīdat indum śarīraiḥ śyenaḥ ayaḥ-apāṣṭiḥ hanti dasyūn
saḥ vrādhataḥ śavasānebhiḥ asya kutsāya śuṣṇam kr̥paṇe parā adāt ayam kavim anayat śasyamānam atkam yaḥ asya sanitā uta nr̥ṇām
ayam daśasyan naryebhiḥ asya dasmaḥ devebhiḥ varuṇaḥ na māyī ayam kanīnaḥ r̥tu-pāḥ avedi amimīta ararum yaḥ catuḥ-pāt
asya stomebhiḥ auśijaḥ r̥jiśvā vrajam darayat vr̥ṣabheṇa piproḥ sutvā yat yajataḥ dīdayat gīḥ puraḥ iyānaḥ abhi varpasā bhūt
eva mahaḥ asura vakṣathāya vamrakaḥ paṭ-bhiḥ upa sarpat indram saḥ iyānaḥ karati svastim asmai iṣam ūrjam su-kṣitim viśvam ā abhār ity abhāḥ
indra dr̥hya magha-van tvāvat it bhuje iha stutaḥ suta-pāḥ bodhi naḥ vr̥dhe devebhiḥ naḥ savitā pra avatu śrutam ā sarva-tātim adi tim vr̥ṇīmahe
bharāya su bharata bhāgam r̥tviyam pra vāyave śuci-pe krandat-iṣṭaye gaurasya yaḥ payasaḥ pītim ānaśe ā sarva-tātim aditim vr̥ṇīmahe
ā naḥ devaḥ savitā sāviṣat vayaḥ r̥ju-yate yajamānāya sunvate yathā devān prati-bhūṣema pāka-vat ā sarva-tātim aditim vr̥ṇīmahe
indraḥ asme iti su-manāḥ astu viśvahā rājā somaḥ suvitasya adhi etu naḥ yathāyathā mitra-dhitāni sam-dadhuḥ ā sarva-tātim aditim vr̥ṇīmahe
indraḥ ukthena śavasā paruḥ dadhe br̥haspate pra-tarītā asi āyuṣaḥ yajñaḥ manuḥ pra-matiḥ naḥ pitā hi kam ā sarva-tātim aditim vr̥ṇīmahe
indrasya nu su-kr̥tam daivyam sahaḥ agniḥ gr̥he jaritā medhiraḥ kavi ḥ yajñaḥ ca bhūt vidathe cāruḥ antamaḥ ā sarva-tātim aditim vr̥ṇīmahe
na vaḥ guhā cakr̥ma bhūri duḥ-kr̥tam na āviḥ-tyam vasavaḥ deva-hel̥anam mākiḥ naḥ devāḥ anr̥tasya varpasaḥ ā sarva-tātim aditim vr̥ṇīmahe
apa amīvām savitā sāviṣat nyak varīyaḥ it apa sedhantu adrayaḥ grāvā yatramadhu-sut ucyate br̥hat ā sarva-tātim aditim vr̥ṇīmahe
ūrdhvaḥ grāvā vasavaḥ astu sotari viśvā dveṣāṁsi sanutaḥ yuyota saḥ naḥ devaḥ savitā pāyuḥ īḍyaḥ ā sarva-tātim aditim vr̥ṇīmahe
ūrjam gāvaḥ yavase pīvaḥ attana r̥tasya yāḥ sadane kośe aṅdhve tanūḥ eva tanvaḥ astu bheṣajam ā sarva-tātim aditim vr̥ṇīmahe
kratu-prāvā jaritā śaśvatām avaḥ indraḥ it bhadrā pra-matiḥ suta-vatām pūrṇam ūdhaḥ divyam yasya siktaye ā sarva-tātim aditim vr̥ṇīmahe
citraḥ te bhānuḥ kratu-prāḥ abhiṣṭiḥ santi spr̥dhaḥ jaraṇi-prāḥ adhr̥ṣṭāḥ rajiṣṭayā rajyā paśvaḥ ā goḥ tūtūrṣati pari agram duvasyuḥ
ut budhyadhvam sa-manasaḥ sakhāyaḥ sam agnim indhvam bahavaḥ sa-nīl̥āḥ dadhi-kr̥ām agnim uṣasam ca devīm indra-vataḥ avase ni hvaye vaḥ
mandrā kr̥ṇudhvam dhiyaḥ ā tanudhvam nāvam aritra-paraṇīm kr̥ṇudhvam iṣkr̥ṇudhvam āyudhā aram kr̥ṇudhvam prāñcam yajñam pra nayata sakhāyaḥ
yunakta sīrā vi yugā tanudhvam kr̥te yonau vapata iha bījam girā ca śruṣṭiḥ sa-bharāḥ asat naḥ nedīyaḥ it sr̥ṇyaḥ pakvam ā iyāt
sīrā yuñjanti kavayaḥ yugā vi tanvate pr̥thak dhīrāḥ deveṣu sumna-yā
niḥ āhāvān kr̥ṇotana sam varatrāḥ dadhātana siñcāmahai avatam udriṇam vayam su-sekam anupa-kṣitam
iṣkr̥ta-āhāvam avatam su-varatram su-secanam udriṇam siñce akṣitam
prīṇīta aśvān hitam jayātha svasti-vāham ratham it kr̥ṇudhvam droṇa-āhāvam avatam aśma-cakram aṁsatra-kośam siñcata nr̥-pānam
vrajam kr̥ṇudhvam saḥ hi vaḥ nr̥-pānaḥ varma sīvyadhvam bahulā pr̥thūni puraḥ kr̥ṇudhvam āyasīḥ adhr̥ṣṭāḥ mā vaḥ susrot camasaḥ dr̥ṁhata tam
ā vaḥ dhiyam yajñiyām varte ūtaye devāḥ devīm yajatām yajñiyām iha sā naḥ duhīyat yavasāiva gatvī sahasra-dhārā payasā mahī gauḥ
ā tu siñca harim īm droḥ upa-sthe vāśībhiḥ takṣata aśman-mayībhiḥ pari svajadhvam daśa kakṣyābhiḥ ubhe iti dhurau prati vahnim yunakta
ubhe iti dhurau vahniḥ āpibdamānaḥ antaḥ yonāiva carati dvi-jāniḥ vanaspatim vane ā asthāpayadhvam ni su dadhidhvam akhanantaḥ utsam
kapr̥t naraḥ kapr̥tham ut dadhātana codayata khudata vāja-sātaye niṣṭigryaḥ putram ā cyāvaya ūtaye indram sa-bādhaḥ iha soma-pītaye
pra te ratham mithu-kr̥tam indraḥ avatu dhr̥ṣṇu-yā asmin ājau puru-hūta śravāyye dhana-bhakṣeṣu naḥ ava
ut sma vātaḥ vahati vāsaḥ asyāḥ adhi-ratham yat ajayat sahasram rathīḥ abhūt mudgalānī gaviṣṭau bhare kr̥tam vi acet indra-senā
antaḥ yaccha jighāṁsataḥ vajram indra abhi-dāsataḥ dāsasya vā magha-van āryasya vā sanutaḥ yavaya vadham
udnaḥ hradam apibat jarhr̥ṣāṇaḥ kūṭam sma tr̥ṁhat abhi-mātim eti pra muṣka-bhāraḥ śravaḥ icchamānaḥ ajiram bāhū iti abharat sisāsan
ni akrandayan upa-yantaḥ enam amehayan vr̥ṣabham madhye ājeḥ tena sūbharvam śata-vat sahasram gavām mudgalaḥ pra-dhane jigāya
karka-deve vr̥ṣabhaḥ āsīt avāvacīt sārathiḥ asya keśī dudheḥ yuktasya dravataḥ saha anasā r̥cchanti sma niḥ-padaḥ mudgalānīm
uta pra-dhim ut ahan asya vidvān upa ayunak vaṁsagam atra śikṣan indraḥ ut āvat patim aghnyānām araṁhata padyābhiḥ kakut-mān
śunam aṣṭrāvī acarat kapardī varatrāyām dāru ānahyamānaḥ nr̥mnāni kr̥ṇvan bahave janāya gāḥ paspaśānaḥ taviṣīḥ adhatta
imam tam paśya vr̥ṣabhasya yuñjam kāṣṭhāyāḥ madhye dru-ghaṇam śayānam yena jigāya sata-vat sahasram gavām mudgalaḥ pr̥tanājyeṣu
āre aghā kaḥ nu itthā dadarśa yam yuñjanti tam oṁ iti ā sthāpayanti na asmai tr̥ṇam na udakam ā bharanti ut-taraḥ dhuraḥ vahati pra-dediśat
parivr̥ktāiva pati-vidyam ānaṭ pīpyānā kūcakreṇa-iva siñcan eṣa-eṣyā cit rathyā jayema su-maṅgalam sina-vat astu sātam
tvam viśvasya jagataḥ cakṣuḥ indra asi cakṣuṣaḥ vr̥ṣā yat ājim vr̥ṣaṇā sisāsasi codayan vadhriṇā yujā
āśuḥ śiśānaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ na bhīmaḥ ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaḥ carṣaṇīnām sam-krandanaḥ ani-miṣaḥ eka-vīraḥ śatam senāḥ ajayat sākam indraḥ
sam-krandanena ani-miṣeṇa jiṣṇunā yut-kāreṇa duḥ-cyavanena dhr̥ṣṇunā tat indreṇa jayata tat sahadhvam yudhaḥ naraḥ iṣu-hastena vr̥ṣṇā
saḥ iṣu-hastaiḥ saḥ niṣaṅgi-bhiḥ vaśī sam-sraṣṭā saḥ yudhaḥ indraḥ gaṇena saṁsr̥ṣṭa-jit soma-pāḥ bāhu-śardhī ugra-dhanvā prati-hitābhiḥ astā
br̥haspate pari dīya rathena rakṣaḥ-hā amitrān apa-bādhamānaḥ pra-bhañjan senāḥ pra-mr̥ṇaḥ yudhā jayan asmākam edhi avitā rathānām
bala-vijñāyaḥ sthaviraḥ pra-vīraḥ sahasvān vājī sahamānaḥ ugraḥ abhi-vīraḥ abhi-satvā sahaḥ-jāḥ jaitram indra ratham ā tiṣṭha go--vit
gotra-bhidam go--vidam vajra-bāhum jayantam ajma pra-mr̥ṇantam ojasā imam sa-jātāḥ anu vīrayadhvam indram sakhāyaḥ anu sam rabhadhvam
abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamānaḥ adayaḥ vīraḥ śata-manyuḥ indraḥ duḥ-cyavanaḥ pr̥tanāṣāṭ ayudhyaḥ asmākam senāḥ avatu pra yut-su
indraḥ āsām netā br̥haspatiḥ dakṣiṇā yajñaḥ puraḥ etu somaḥ deva-senānām abhi-bhañjatīnām jayantīnām marutaḥ yantu agram
indrasya vr̥ṣṇaḥ varuṇasya rājñaḥ ādityānām marutām śardhaḥ ugram mahāmanasām bhuvana-cyavānām ghoṣaḥ devānām jayatām ut asthāt
ut harṣaya magha-van āyudhāni ut satvanām māmakānām manāṁsi ut vr̥tra-han vājinām vājināni ut rathānām jayatām yantu ghoṣāḥ
asmākam indraḥ sam-r̥teṣu dhvajeṣu asmākam yāḥ iṣavaḥ tāḥ jayantu asmākam vīrāḥ ut-tare bhavantu asmān oṁ iti devāḥ avata haveṣu
amīṣām cittam prati-lobhayantī gr̥hāṇa aṅgāni apve parā ihi abhi pra ihi niḥ daha hr̥t-su śokaiḥ andhena amitrāḥ tamasā sacantām
pra ita jayata naraḥ indraḥ vaḥ śarma yacchatu ugrāḥ vaḥ santu bāhavaḥ anādhr̥ṣyāḥ yathā asatha
asāvi somaḥ puru-hūta tubhyam hari-bhyām yajñam upa yāhi tūyam tubhyam giraḥ vipra-vīrāḥ iyānāḥ dadhanvire indra piba sutasya
ap-su dhūtasya hari-vaḥ piba iha nr̥-bhiḥ sutasya jaṭharam pr̥ṇasva mimikṣuḥ yam adrayaḥ indra tubhyam tebhiḥ vardhasva madam uktha-vāhaḥ
pra ugrām pītim vr̥ṣṇe iyarmi satyām pra-yai sutasya hari-aśva tubhyam indra dhenābhiḥ iha mādayasva dhībhiḥ viśvābhiḥ śacyā gr̥ṇānaḥ
ūtī śacī-vaḥ tava vīryeṇa vayaḥ dadhānāḥ uśijaḥ r̥ta-jñāḥ prajāvat indra manuṣaḥ duroṇe tasthuḥ gr̥ṇantaḥ sadha-mādyāsaḥ
pranīti-bhiḥ te hari-aśva su-stoḥ susumnasya puru-rucaḥ janāsaḥ maṁhiṣṭhām ūtim vi-tire dadhānāḥ stotāraḥ indra tava sūnr̥tābhiḥ
upa brahmāṇi hari-vaḥ hari-bhyām somasya yāhi pītaye sutasya indra tvā yajñaḥ kṣamamāṇam ānaṭ dāśvān asi adhvarasya pra-ketaḥ
sahasra-vājam abhimāti-saham sute--raṇam magha-vānam su-vr̥ktim upa bhūṣanti giraḥ aprati-itam indram namasyāḥ jarituḥ pananta
sapta āpaḥ devīḥ su-raṇāḥ amr̥ktāḥ yābhiḥ sindhum ataraḥ indra pūḥ-bhit navatim srotyāḥ nava ca sravantīḥ devebhyaḥ gātum manuṣe ca vindaḥ
apaḥ mahīḥ abhi-śasteḥ amuñcaḥ ajāgaḥ āsu adhi devaḥ ekaḥ indra yāḥ tvam vr̥tra-tūrye cakartha tābhiḥ viśva-āyuḥ tanvam pupuṣyāḥ
vīreṇyaḥ kratuḥ indraḥ su-śastiḥ uta api dhenā puru-hūtam īṭe ādaryat vr̥tram akr̥ṇot oṁ iti lokam sasahe śakraḥ pr̥tanāḥ abhiṣṭiḥ
śunam huvema magha-vānam indram asmin bhare nr̥-tamam vāja-sātau śr̥ṇvantam ugram ūtaye samat-su ghnantam vr̥trāṇi sam-jitam dhanānām
kadā vaso iti stotram haryate ā ava śmaśā rudhat vāritivāḥ dīrgham sutam vātāpyāya
harī iti yasya su-yujā vi-vratā veḥ arvantā anu śepā ubhā rajī iti na keśinā patiḥ dan
apa yoḥ indraḥ pāpaje ā martaḥ na śaśramāṇaḥ bibhīvān śubhe yat yuyuje taviṣī-vān
sacā āyoḥ indraḥ carkr̥ṣe ā upānasaḥ saparyan nadayoḥ vi-vratayoḥ śūraḥ indraḥ
adhi yaḥ tasthau keṣa-vantā vyacasvantā na puṣṭyai vanoti śiprābhyām śipriṇī-vān
pra astaut r̥ṣva-ojāḥ r̥ṣvebhiḥ tatakṣa śūraḥ śavasā r̥bhuḥ na kratu-bhiḥ mātariśvā
vajram yaḥ cakre su-hanāya dasyave hirīmaśaḥ harīmān aruta-hanuḥ adbhutam na rajaḥ
ava naḥ vr̥jinā śiśīhi r̥cā vanema anr̥caḥ na abrahmā yajñaḥ r̥dhak joṣati tve iti
ūrdhvā yat te tretinī bhūt yajñasya dhūḥ-su sadman sa-jūḥ nāvam sva-yaśasam sacā āyoḥ
śriye te pr̥śniḥ upa-secanī bhūt śriye darviḥ arepāḥ yayā sve pātre siñcase ut
śatam vā yat asurya prati tvā su-mitraḥ itthā astaut duḥ-mitraḥ itthā astaut āvaḥ yat dasyu-hatye kutsa-putram pra āvaḥ yat dasyu-hatye kutsa-vatsam
ubhau oṁ iti nūnam tat it arthayetheiti vi tanvātheiti dhiyaḥ vastrā apasāiva sadhrīcīnā yātave pra īm ajīgaḥ sudināiva pr̥kṣaḥ ā taṁsayetheiti
uṣṭārāiva pharvareṣu śrayetheiti prāyogāiva śvātryā śāsuḥ ā ithaḥ dūtāiva hi sthaḥ yaśasā janeṣu mā apa sthātam mahiṣāiva ava-pānāt
sākam-yujā śakunasya-iva pakṣā paśvāiva citrā yajuḥ ā gamiṣṭam agniḥ-iva deva-yoḥ dīdi-vāṁsā parijmānāiva yajathaḥ puru-trā
āpī iti vaḥ asme iti pitarāiva putrā ugrāiva rucā nr̥patīivetinr̥patī-iva turyai iryāiva puṣṭyai kiraṇāiva bhujyai śruṣṭīvānāiva havam ā gamiṣṭam
vaṁsagāiva pūṣaryā śimbātā mitrāiva r̥tā śatarā śātapantā vājāiva uccā vayasā gharmye--sthā meṣāiva iṣā saparyā purīṣā
sr̥ṇyāiva jarbharī iti turpharītūiti naitośāiva turpharī iti parpharīkā udanyajāiva jemanā maderū iti tā me jarāyu ajaram marāyu
pajrāiva carcaram jāram marāyu kṣadma-iva artheṣu tartarīthaḥ ugrā r̥bhū iti na āpat kharamajrā khara-jruḥ vāyuḥ na parpharat kṣayat rayīṇām
gharmāiva madhu jaṭhare sanerūiti bhage--avitā turpharī iti phārivā aram patarāiva cacarā candra-nirnik manaḥ-r̥ṅgā mananyā na jagmī iti
br̥hantāiva gambhareṣu prati-sthām pādāiva gādham tarate vidāthaḥ karṇāiva śāsuḥ anu hi smarāthaḥ aṁśāiva naḥ bhajatam citram apnaḥ
āraṅgarāiva madhu ā īrayetheiti sāraghāiva gavi nīcīna-bāre kīnārāiva svedam āsisvidānā kṣāma-iva ūrjā suyavasa-at sacetheitis
r̥dhyāma stomam sanuyāma vājam ā naḥ mantram sa-rathā iha upa yātam yaśaḥ na pakvam madhu goṣu antaḥ ā bhūta-aṁśaḥ aśvinoḥ kāmam aprāḥ
āviḥ abhūt mahi māghonam eṣām viśvam jīvam tamasaḥ niḥ amoci mahi jyotiḥ pitr̥-bhiḥ dattam ā agāt uruḥ panthāḥ dakṣiṇāyāḥ adarśi
uccā divi dakṣiṇāvantaḥ asthuḥ ye aśva-dāḥ saha te sūryeṇa hiraṇya-dāḥ amr̥ta-tvam bhajante vāsaḥ-dāḥ soma pra tirante āyuḥ
daivī pūrtiḥ dakṣiṇā deva-yajyā na kava-aribhyaḥ nahi te pr̥ṇanti atha naraḥ prayata-dakṣiṇāsaḥ avadya-bhiyā bahavaḥ pr̥ṇanti
śata-dhāram vāyum arkam svaḥ-vidam nr̥-cakṣasaḥ te abhi cakṣate haviḥ ye pr̥ṇanti pra ca yacchanti sam-game te dakṣiṇām duhate sapta-mātaram
dakṣiṇāvān prathamaḥ hūtaḥ eti dakṣiṇāvān grāma-nīḥ agram eti tam eva manye nr̥-patim janānām yaḥ prathamaḥ dakṣiṇām āvivāya
tam eva r̥ṣim tam oṁ iti brahmāṇam āhuḥ yajña-nyam sāma-gām uktha-śāsam saḥ śukrasya tanvaḥ veda tisraḥ yaḥ prathamaḥ dakṣiṇayā rarādha
dakṣiṇā aśvam dakṣiṇā gām dadāti dakṣiṇā candram uta yat hiraṇyam dakṣi ṇā annam vanute yaḥ naḥ ātmā dakṣiṇām varma kr̥ṇute vi-jānan
na bhojāḥ mamruḥ na ni-artham īyuḥ na riṣyanti na vyathante ha bhojāḥ idam yat viśvam bhuvanam svaḥ ca etat sarvam dakṣiṇā ebhyaḥ dadāti
bhojāḥ jigyuḥ surabhim yonim agre bhojāḥ jigyuḥ vadhvam yā su-vāsāḥ bhojāḥ jigyuḥ antaḥ-peyam surāyāḥ bhojāḥ jigyuḥ ye ahūtāḥ pra-yanti
bhojāya aśvam sam mr̥janti āśum bhojāya āste kanyā śumbhamānā bhojasya idam puṣkariṇī-iva veśma pari-kr̥tam devamānāiva citram
bhojam aśvāḥ suṣṭhu-vāhaḥ vahanti su-vr̥t rathaḥ vartate dakṣiṇāyāḥ bhojam devāsaḥ avata bhareṣu bhojaḥ śatrūn sam-anīkeṣu jetā
kim icchantī saramā pra idam ānaṭ dūre hi adhvā jaguriḥ parācaiḥ kā asme--hitiḥ kā pari-takmyā āsīt katham rasāyāḥ ataraḥ payāṁsi
indrasya dūtīḥ iṣitā carāmi mahaḥ icchantī paṇayaḥ ni-dhīn vaḥ ati-skadaḥ bhiyasā tam naḥ āvat tathā rasāyāḥ ataram payāṁsi
kīdr̥k indraḥ sarame kā dr̥śīkā yasya idam dūtīḥ asaraḥ parākāt ā ca gacchāt mitram ena dadhāma atha gavām go--patiḥ naḥ bhavāti
na aham tam veda dabhyam dabhat saḥ yasya idam dūtīḥ asaram parākāt na tam gūhanti sravataḥ gabhīrāḥ hatāḥ indreṇa paṇayaḥ śayadhve
imāḥ gāvaḥ sarame yāḥ aicchaḥ pari divaḥ antān su-bhage patantī kaḥ te enāḥ ava sr̥jāt ayudhvī uta asmākam āyudhā santi tigmā
asenyāḥ vaḥ paṇayaḥ vacāṁmsi aniṣavyāḥ tanvaḥ santu pāpīḥ adhr̥ṣṭaḥ vaḥ etavai astu panthāḥ br̥haspatiḥ vaḥ ubhayā na mr̥l̥āt
ayam ni-dhiḥ sarame adri-budhnaḥ gobhiḥ aśvebhiḥ vasu-bhiḥ ni-r̥ṣṭaḥ rakṣanti tam paṇayaḥ ye su-gopāḥ reku padam alakam ā jagantha
ā iha gāman r̥ṣayaḥ soma-śitāḥ ayāsyaḥ aṅgirasaḥ nava-gvāḥ te etam ūrvam vi bhajanta gonām atha etat vacaḥ paṇayaḥ vaman it
eva ca tvam sarame ājagantha pra-bādhitā sahasā daivyena svasāram tvā kr̥ṇavai mā punaḥ gāḥ apa te gavām su-bhage bhajāma
na aham veda bhrātr̥-tvam no iti svasr̥-tvam indraḥ viduḥ aṅgirasaḥ ca ghorāḥ go--kāmāḥ me acchadayan yat āyam apa ataḥ ita paṇayaḥ varīyaḥ
dūram ita paṇayaḥ varīyaḥ ut gāvaḥ yantu minatīḥ r̥tena br̥haspatiḥ yāḥ avindat ni-gūl̥hāḥ somaḥ grāvānaḥ r̥ṣayaḥ ca viprāḥ
te avadan prathamāḥ brahma-kilbiṣe akūpāraḥ salilaḥ mātariśvā vīl̥u-harāḥ tapaḥ ugraḥ mayaḥ-bhūḥ āpaḥ devīḥ prathama-jāḥ r̥tena
somaḥ rājā prathamaḥ brahma-jāyām punariti pra ayacchat ahr̥ṇīyamānaḥ anu-artitā varuṇaḥ mitraḥ āsīt agniḥ hotā hasta-gr̥hya ā nināya
hastena eva grāhyaḥ ādhiḥ asyāḥ brahma-jāyā iyam iti ca it avocat na dūtāya pra-hye tasthe eṣā tathā rāṣṭram gupitam kṣatriyasya
devāḥ etasyām avadanta pūrve sapta-r̥ṣayaḥ tapase ye ni-seduḥ bhīmā jāyā brāhmaṇasya upa-nītā duḥ-dhām dadhāti parame vi-oman
brahma-cārī carati veviṣat viṣaḥ saḥ devānām bhavati ekam aṅgam tena jāyām anu avindat br̥haspatiḥ somena nītām juhvam na devāḥ
punaḥ vai devāḥ adaduḥ punaḥ manuṣyāḥ uta rājānaḥ satyam kr̥ṇvānāḥ brahma-jāyām punaḥ daduḥ
punaḥ-dāya brahma-jāyām kr̥tvī devaiḥ ni-kilbiṣam ūrjam pr̥thivyāḥ bhaktvāya uru-gāyam upa āsate
sam-iddhaḥ adya manuṣaḥ duroṇe devaḥ devān yajasi jāta-vedaḥ ā ca vaha mitra-mahaḥ cikitvān tvam dūtaḥ kaviḥ asi pra-cetāḥ
tanū-napāt pathaḥ r̥tasya yānān madhvā sam-añjan svadaya su-jihva manmāni dhībhiḥ uta yajñam r̥ndhan deva-trā ca kr̥ṇuhi adhvaram naḥ
ājuhvānaḥ īḍyaḥ vandyaḥ ca ā yāhi agne vasu-bhiḥ sa-joṣāḥ tvam devānām asi yahva hotā saḥ etān yakṣi iṣitaḥ yajīyān
prācīnam barhiḥ pra-diśā pr̥thivyāḥ vastoḥ asyāḥ vr̥jyate agre ahnām vi oṁ iti prathate vi-taram varīyaḥ devebhyaḥ aditaye syonam
vyacasvatīḥ urviyā vi śrayantām pati-bhyaḥ na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ devīḥ dvāraḥ br̥hatīḥ viśvam-invāḥ devebhyaḥ bhavata supra-ayaṇāḥ
ā susvayantī iti yajate iti upāke iti uṣasānaktā sadatām ni yonau divye yoṣaṇeiti br̥hatī iti surukme itisu-rukme adhi śriyam śukra-piśam dadhāne
daivyā hotārā prathamā su-vācā mimānā yajñam manuṣaḥ yajadhyai pra-codayantā vidatheṣu kārū iti prācīnam jyotiḥ pra-diśā diśantā
ā naḥ yajñam bhāratī tūyam etu il̥ā manuṣvat iha cetayantī tisraḥ devīḥ barhiḥ ā idam syonam sarasvatī su-apasaḥ sadantu
yaḥ ime iti dyāvāpr̥thivī iti janitrī iti rūpaiḥ apiṁśat bhuvanāni viśvā tam adya hotaḥ iṣitaḥ yajīyān devam tvaṣṭāram iha yakṣi vidvān
upa-avasr̥ja tmanyā sam-añjan devānām pāthaḥ r̥tu-thā havīṁṣi vanaspatiḥ śamitā devaḥ agniḥ svadantu havyam madhunā ghr̥tena
sadyaḥ jātaḥ vi amimīta yajñam agniḥ devānām abhavat puraḥ-gāḥ asya hotuḥ pra-diśi r̥tasya vāci svāhākr̥tam haviḥ adantu devāḥ
manīṣiṇaḥ pra bharadhvam manīṣām yathāyathā matayaḥ santi nr̥ṇām indram satyaiḥ ā īrayāma kr̥tebhiḥ saḥ hi vīraḥ girvaṇasyuḥ vidānaḥ
r̥tasya hi sadasaḥ dhītiḥ adyaut sam gār̥ṣṭeyaḥ vr̥ṣabhaḥ gobhiḥ ānaṭ ut atiṣṭhat taviṣeṇa raveṇa mahānti cit sam vivyāca rajāṁsi
indraḥ kila śrutyai asya veda saḥ hi jiṣṇuḥ pathi-kr̥t sūryāya āt menām kr̥ṇvan acyutaḥ bhuvat goḥ patiḥ divaḥ sana-jāḥ aprati-itaḥ
indraḥ mahnā mahataḥ arṇavasya vratā amināt aṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ gr̥ṇānaḥ purūṇi cit ni tatāna rajāṁsi dādhāra yaḥ dharuṇam satya-tātā
indraḥ divaḥ prati-mānam pr̥thivyāḥ viśvā veda savanā hanti śuṣṇam mahīm cit dyām ā atanot sūryeṇa cāskambha cit kambhanena skabhīyān
vajreṇa hi vr̥tra-hā vr̥tram astaḥ adevasya śūśuvānasya māyāḥ vi dhr̥ṣṇo iti atra dhr̥ṣatā jaghantha atha abhavaḥ magha-van bāhvu-ojāḥ
sacanta yat uṣasaḥ sūryeṇa citrām asya ketavaḥ rām avindan ā yat nakṣatram dadr̥śe divaḥ na punaḥ yataḥ nakiḥ addhā nu veda
dūram kila prathamāḥ jagmuḥ āsām indrasya yāḥ pra-save sasruḥ āpaḥ kva svit agram kva budhnaḥ āsām āpaḥ madhyam kva vaḥ nūnam antaḥ
sr̥jaḥ sindhūn ahinā jagrasānān āt it etāḥ pra vivijre javena mumukṣamāṇāḥ uta yāḥ mumucre adha it etāḥ na ramante ni-tiktāḥ
sadhrīcīḥ sindhum uśatīḥ-iva āyan sanāt jāraḥ āritaḥ pūḥ-bhit āsām astam ā te pārthivā vasūni asme iti jagmuḥ sūnr̥tāḥ indra pūrvīḥ
indra piba prati-kāmam sutasya prātaḥ-sāvaḥ tava hi pūrva-pītiḥ harṣasva hantave śūra śatrūn ukthebhiḥ te vīryā pra bravāma
yaḥ te rathaḥ manasaḥ javīyān ā indra tena soma-peyāya yāhi tūyam ā te harayaḥ pra dravantu yebhiḥ yāsi vr̥ṣa-bhiḥ mandamānaḥ
haritvatā varcasā sūryasya śreṣṭhaiḥ rūpaiḥ tanvam sparśayasva asmābhiḥ indra sakhi-bhiḥ huvānaḥ sadhrīcīnaḥ mādayasva ni-sadya
yasya tyat te mahimānam madeṣu ime iti mahī iti rodasī iti na aviviktām tat okaḥ ā hari-bhiḥ indra yuktaiḥ priyebhiḥ yāhi pr iyam annam accha
yasya śaśvat papi-vān indra śatrūn ananu-kr̥tyā raṇyā cakartha saḥ te puram-dhim taviṣīm iyarti saḥ te madāya sutaḥ indra somaḥ
idam te pātram sana-vittam indra piba somam enā śatakrato itiśata-krato pūrṇaḥ āhāvaḥ madirasya madhvaḥ yam viśve it abhi--haryanti devāḥ
vi hi tvām indra purudhā janāsaḥ hita-prayasaḥ vr̥ṣabha hvayante asmākam te madhumat-tamāni imā bhuvan savanā teṣu harya
pra te indra pūrvyāṇi pra nūnam vīryā vocam prathamā kr̥tāni satīna-manyuḥ aśrathayaḥ adrim su-vedanām akr̥ṇoḥ brahmaṇe gām
ni su sīda gaṇa-pate gaṇeṣu tvām āhuḥ vipra-tamam kavīnām na r̥te tvat kriyate kim cana āre mahām arkam magha-van citram arca
abhi-khyā naḥ magha-van nādhamānān sakhe bodhi vasu-pate sakhīnām raṇam kr̥dhi raṇa-kr̥t satya-śuṣma abhakte cit ā bhaja rāye asmān
tam asya dyāvāpr̥thivī iti sa-cetasā viśvebhiḥ devaiḥ anu śuṣmam āvatām yat ait kr̥ṇvānaḥ mahimānam indriyam pītvī somasya kratu-mān avardhata
tam asya viṣṇuḥ mahimānam ojasā aṁśum dadhanvān madhunaḥ vi rapśate devebhiḥ indraḥ magha-vā sayāva-bhiḥ vr̥tram jaghanvān abhavat vareṇyaḥ
vr̥treṇa yat ahinā bibhrat āyudhā sam-asthithāḥ yudhaye śaṁsam āvide viśve te atra marutaḥ saha tmanā avardhan ugra mahimānam indriyam
jajñānaḥ eva vi abādhata spr̥dhaḥ pra apaśyat vīraḥ abhi paiṁsyam raṇam avr̥ścat adrim ava sa-syadaḥ sr̥jat astabhnāt nākam su-apasyayā pr̥thum
āt indraḥ satrā taviṣīḥ apatyata varīyaḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti abādhata ava abharat dhr̥ṣitaḥ vajram āyasam śevam mitrāya varuṇāya dāśuṣe
indrasya atra taviṣībhyaḥ vi-rapśinaḥ r̥ghāyataḥ araṁhayanta manyave vr̥tram yat ugraḥ vi avr̥ścat ojasā apaḥ bibhratam tamasā pari-vr̥tam
yā vīryāṇi prathamāni kartvā mahi-tvebhiḥ yatamānau sam-īyatuḥ dhvāntam tamaḥ ava dadhvase hataḥ indraḥ mahnā pūrva-hūtau apatyata
viśve devāsaḥ adha vr̥ṣṇyāni te avardhayan soma-vatyā vacasyayā raddham vr̥tram ahim indrasya hanmanā agniḥ na jambhaiḥ tr̥ṣu annam āvayat
bhūri dakṣebhiḥ vacanebhiḥ r̥kva-bhiḥ sakhyebhiḥ sakhyāni pra vocata indraḥ dhunim ca cumurim ca dambhayan śraddhāmanasyā śr̥ṇute dabhītaye
tvam purūṇi ā bhara su-aśvyā yebhiḥ maṁsai ni-vacanāni śaṁsan su-gebhiḥ viśvā duḥ-itā tarema vidaḥ su naḥ urviyā gādham adya
gharmā sam-antā tri-vr̥tam vi āpatuḥ tayoḥ juṣṭim mātariśvā jagāma di vaḥ payaḥ didhiṣāṇāḥ aveṣan viduḥ devāḥ saha-sāmānam arkam
tisraḥ deṣṭrāya niḥ-r̥tīḥ upa āsate dīrgha-śrutaḥ vi hi jānanti vahnayaḥ tāsām ni cikyuḥ kavayaḥ ni-dānam pareṣu yāḥ guhyeṣu vrateṣu
catuḥ-kapardā yuvatiḥ su-peśāḥ ghr̥ta-pratīkā vayunāni vaste tasyām su-parṇā vr̥ṣaṇā ni sedatuḥ yatra devāḥ dadhire bhāga-dheyam
ekaḥ su-parṇaḥ saḥ samudram ā viveśa saḥ idam viśvam bhuvanam vi caṣṭe tam pākena manasā apaśyam antitaḥ tam mātā rel̥hi saḥ oṁ iti rel̥hi mātaram
su-parṇam viprā kavayaḥ vacaḥ-bhiḥ ekam santam bahudhā kalpayanti chandāṁsi ca dadhataḥ adhvareṣu grahān somasya mimate dvādaśa
ṣaṭ-triṁśān ca caturaḥ kalpayantaḥ chandāṁsi ca dadhataḥ ādvādaśam yajñam vi-māya kavayaḥ manīṣā r̥k-sāmābhyām pra ratham vartayanti
catuḥ-daśa anye mahimānaḥ asya tam dhīrāḥ vācā pra nayanti sapta āpnānam tīrtham kaḥ iha pra vocat yena pathā pra-pibante sutasya
sahasradhā pañca-daśāni ukthā yāvat dyāvāpr̥thivī iti tāvat it tat sahasradhā mahimānaḥ sahasram yāvat brahma vi--sthitam tāvatī vāk
kaḥ chandasām yogam ā veda dhīraḥ kaḥ dhiṣṇyām prati vācam papāda kam r̥tvijām aṣṭamam śūram āhuḥ harī iti indrasya ni cikāya kaḥ svit
bhūmyāḥ antam pari eke caranti rathasya dhūḥ-su yuktāsaḥ asthuḥ śramasya dāyam vi bhajanti ebhyaḥ yadā yamaḥ bhavati harmye hitaḥ
citraḥ it śiśoḥ taruṇasya vakṣathaḥ na yaḥ mātarau api-eti dhātave anūdhāḥ yadi jījanat adhā ca nu vavakṣa sadyaḥ mahi dūtyam caran
agniḥ ha nāma dhāyi dan apaḥ-tamaḥ sam yaḥ vanā yuvate bhasmanā datā abhi-pramurā juhvā su-adhvaraḥ inaḥ na prothamānaḥ yavase vr̥ṣā
tam vaḥ vim na dru-sadam devam andhasaḥ indum prothantam pra-vapantam arṇavam āsā vahnim na śociṣā vi-rapśinam mahi-vratam na sarajantam adhvanaḥ
vi yasya te jrayasānasya ajara dhakṣoḥ na vātāḥ pari santi acyutāḥ ā raṇvāsaḥ yuyudhayaḥ na satvanam tritam naśanta pra śiṣantaḥ iṣṭaye
saḥ it agniḥ kaṇva-tamaḥ kaṇva-sakhā aryaḥ parasya antarasya taruṣaḥ agniḥ pātu gr̥ṇataḥ agniḥ sūrīn agniḥ dadātu teṣām avaḥ naḥ
vājin-tamāya sahyase su-pitrya tr̥ṣu cyavānaḥ anu jāta-vedase anudre cit yaḥ dhr̥ṣatā varam sate mahin-tamāya dhanvanā it aviṣyate
eva agniḥ martaiḥ saha sūri-bhiḥ vasuḥ stave sahasaḥ sūnaraḥ nr̥-bhiḥ mitrāsaḥ na ye su-dhitāḥ r̥ta-yavaḥ dyāvaḥ na dyumnaiḥ abhi santi mānuṣān
ūrjaḥ napāt sahasāvan iti tvā upa-stutasya vandate vr̥ṣā vāk tvām stoṣāma tvayā su-vīrāḥ drāghīyaḥ āyuḥ pra-taram dadhānāḥ
iti tvā agne vr̥ṣṭi-havyasya putrāḥ upa-stutāsaḥ r̥ṣayaḥ avocan tān ca pāhi gr̥ṇataḥ ca sūrīn vaṣaṭ vaṣaṭ iti ūrdhvāsaḥ anakṣan namaḥ namaḥ iti ūrdhvāsaḥ anakṣan
piba somam mahate indriyāya piba vr̥trāya hantave śaviṣṭha piba rāye śavase hūyamānaḥ piba madhvaḥ tr̥pat indra ā vr̥ṣasva
asya piba kṣu-mataḥ pra-sthitasya indra somasya varam ā sutasya svasti-dāḥ manasā mādayasva arvācīnaḥ revate saubhagāya
mamattu tvā divyaḥ somaḥ indra mamattu yaḥ sūyate pārthiveṣu mamattu yena vari-vaḥ cakartha mamattu yena ni-riṇāsi śatrūn
ā dvi-barhāḥ aminaḥ yātu indraḥ vr̥ṣā hari-bhyām pari-siktam andhaḥ gavi ā sutasya pra-bhr̥tasya madhvaḥ satrā khedām aruśa-hā vr̥ṣasva
ni tigmāni bhrāśayan bhrāśyāni ava sthirā tanuhi yātu-jūnām ugrāya te sahaḥ balam dadāmi prati-itya śatrūn vi-gadeṣu vr̥śca
vi aryaḥ indra tanuhi śravāṁsi ojaḥ sthirāiva dhanvanaḥ abhi-mātīḥ asmadryak vavr̥dhānaḥ sahaḥ-bhiḥ ani-bhr̥ṣṭaḥ tanvam vavr̥dhasva
idam haviḥ magha-van tubhyam rātam prati sam-rāṭ ahr̥ṇānaḥ gr̥bhāya tubhyam sutaḥ magha-van tubhyam pakvaḥ addhi indra piba ca pra-sth itasya
addhi indra pra-sthitā imā havīṁṣi canaḥ dadhiṣva pacatā uta somam prayasvantaḥ prati haryāmasi tvā satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ
pra indrāgni-bhyām su-vacasyām iyarmi sindhau-iva pra īrayam nāvam arkaiḥ ayāḥ-iva pari caranti devāḥ ye asmabhyam dhana-dāḥ ut-bhidaḥ ca
na vai oṁ iti devāḥ kṣudham it vadham daduḥ uta āśitam upa gacchanti mr̥tyavaḥ uto iti rayiḥ pr̥ṇataḥ na upa dasyati uta apr̥ṇan marḍitāram na vindate
yaḥ ādhrāya cakamānāya pitvaḥ anna-vān san raphitāya upa-jagmuṣe sthiram manaḥ kr̥ṇute sevate purā uto iti cit saḥ marḍitāram na vindate
saḥ it bhojaḥ yaḥ gr̥have dadāti anna-kāmāya carate kr̥śāya aram asmai bhavati yāma-hūtau uta aparīṣu kr̥ṇute sakhāyam
na saḥ sakhā yaḥ na dadāti sakhye sacābhuve sacamānāya pitvaḥ apa asmāt pra iyāt na tat okaḥ asti pr̥ṇantam anyam araṇam cit icchet
pr̥ṇīyāt it nādhamānāya tavyān drāghīyāṁsam anu paśyeta panthām o iti hi vartante rathyāiva cakrā anyam-anyam upa tiṣṭhanta rāyaḥ
mogham annam vindate apra-cetāḥ satyam bravīmi vadhaḥ it saḥ tasya na aryamaṇam puṣyati no iti sakhāyam kevala-aghaḥ bhavati kevala-ādī
kr̥ṣan it phālaḥ āśitam kr̥ṇoti yan adhvānam apa vr̥ṅkte caritraiḥ vadan brahmā avadataḥ vanīyān pr̥ṇan āpiḥ apr̥ṇantam abhi syāt
eka-pāt bhūyaḥ dvi-padaḥ vi cakrame dvi-pāt tri-pādam abhi eti paścāt catuḥ-pāt eti dvi-padām abhi-svare sam-paśyan paṅktīḥ upa-tiṣṭhamānaḥ
samau cit hastau na samam viviṣṭaḥ sam-mātarā cit na samam duhāteiti yamayoḥ cit na samā vīryāṇi jñātī iti cit santau na samam pr̥ṇītaḥ
agne haṁsi ni atriṇam dīdyat martyeṣu ā sve kṣaye śuci-vrata
ut tiṣṭhasi su-āhutaḥ ghr̥tāni prati modase yat tvā srucaḥ sam-asthiran
saḥ āhutaḥ vi rocate agniḥ īl̥enyaḥ girā srucā pratīkam ajyate
ghr̥tena agniḥ sam ajyate madhu-pratīkaḥ āhutaḥ rocamānaḥ vibhāvasuḥ
jaramāṇaḥ sam idhyase devebhyaḥ havya-vāhana tam tvā havanta martyāḥ
tam martāḥ amartyam ghr̥tena agnim saparyata adābhyam gr̥ha-patim
adābhyena śociṣā agne rakṣaḥ tvam daha gopāḥ r̥tasya dīdihi
saḥ tvam agne pratīkena prati oṣa yātu-dhānyaḥ uru-kṣayeṣu dīdyat
tam tvā gīḥ-bhiḥ uru-kṣayāḥ havya-vāham sam īdhire yajiṣṭham mānuṣe jane
iti vai iti me manaḥ gām aśvam sanuyām iti kuvit somasya apām iti
pra vātāḥ-iva dodhataḥ ut mā pītāḥ ayaṁsata kuvit somasya apām iti
ut mā pītāḥ ayaṁsata ratham aśvāḥ-iva āśavaḥ kuvit somasya apām iti
upa mā matiḥ asthita vāśrā putram-iva priyam kuvit somasya apām iti
aham taṣṭāiva vandhuram pari acāmi hr̥dā matim kuvit somasya apām iti
nahi me akṣipat cana acchāntsuḥ pañca kr̥ṣṭayaḥ kuvit somasya apām iti
nahi me rodasī iti ubhe iti anyam pakṣam cana prati kuvit somasya apām iti
abhi dyām mahinā bhuvam abhi imām pr̥thivīm mahīm kuvit somasya apām iti

divi me anyaḥ pakṣaḥ adhaḥ anyam acīkr̥ṣam kuvit somasya apām iti
aham asmi mahāmahaḥ / abhi-nabhyam ut-āṣitaḥ kuvit somasya apām iti
gr̥haḥ yāmi aram-kr̥taḥ devebhyaḥ havya-vāhanaḥ kuvit somasya apām iti
tat it āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham yataḥ jajñe ugraḥ tveṣa-nr̥mṇaḥ sadyaḥ jajñānaḥ ni riṇāti śatrūn anu yam viśve madanti ūmāḥ
vavr̥dhānaḥ śavasā bhūri-ojāḥ śatruḥ dāsāya bhiyasam dadhāti avi-anat ca vi-anat ca sasni sam te navanta pra-bhr̥tā madeṣu

iti cit hi tvā dhanā jayantam made--made anu-madanti viprāḥ ojīyaḥ dhr̥ṣṇo iti sthiram ā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhan yātu-dhānāḥ duḥ-evāḥ

stuṣeyyam puru-varpasam r̥bhvam ina-tamam āptyam āptyānām ā darṣate śavasā sapta dānūn pra sākṣate prati-mānāni bhūri

imā brahma br̥hat-divaḥ vivakti indrāya śūṣam agriyaḥ svaḥ-sāḥ mahaḥ gotrasya kṣayati sva-rājaḥ duraḥ ca viśvāḥ avr̥ṇot apa svāḥ
eva mahān br̥hat-divaḥ atharvā avocat svām tanvam indram eva svasāraḥ mātaribhvarīḥ ariprāḥ hinvanti ca śavasā vardhayanti ca
hiraṇya-garbhaḥ sam avartata agre bhūtasya jātaḥ patiḥ ekaḥ āsīt saḥ dādhāra pr̥thivīm dyām uta imām kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
yaḥ ātma-dāḥ bala-dāḥ yasya viśve upa-āsate pra-śiṣam yasya devāḥ yasya chāyām r̥tam yasya mr̥tyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
yaḥ prāṇataḥ ni-miṣataḥ mahi-tvā ekaḥ it rājā jagataḥ babhūva yaḥ īśe asya dvi-padaḥ catuḥ-padaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
yasya ime hima-vantaḥ mahi-tvā yasya samudram rasayā saha āhuḥ yasya imāḥ pra-diśaḥ yasya bāhū iti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
yena dyauḥ ugrā pr̥thivī ca dr̥l̥hā yena svar iti svaḥ stabhitam yena nākaḥ yaḥ antarikṣe rajasaḥ vi-mānaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
yam krandasī iti avasā tastabhāne iti abhi aikṣetām manasā rejamāne yatra adhi sūraḥ ut-itaḥ vi-bhāti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
āpaḥ ha yat br̥hatīḥ viśvam āyan garbham dadhānāḥ janayantīḥ agn im tataḥ devānām sam avartata asuḥ ekaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
yaḥ cit āpaḥ mahinā pari-apaśyat dakṣam dadhānāḥ janayantīḥ yajñam yaḥ deveṣu adhi devaḥ ekaḥ āsīt kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
mā naḥ hiṁsīt janitā yaḥ pr̥thivyāḥ yaḥ vā divam satya-dharmā jajāna yaḥ ca apaḥ candrāḥ br̥hatīḥ jajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
prajāpatena tvad etāny anyo viśvājatāniparitā babhūva yatkāmās te juhumas tan noastu vayaṁ syāmapatayo rayīṇām

tvām it asyāḥ uṣasaḥ vi-uṣṭiṣu dūtam kr̥ṇvānāḥ ayajanta mānuṣāḥ tvām devāḥ mahayāyyāya vavr̥dhuḥ ājyam agne ni-mr̥jantaḥ adhvare
ni tvā vasiṣṭhāḥ ahvanta vājinam gr̥ṇantaḥ agne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ rāyaḥ poṣam yajamāneṣu dhāraya yūyam pāta svasti-bhiḥ sadā naḥ

samānam pūrvīḥ abhi vavaśānāḥ tiṣṭhan vatsasya mātaraḥ sa-nīl̥āḥ r̥tasya sānau adhi cakramāṇāḥ rihanti madhvaḥ amr̥tasya vāṇīḥ

adevāt devaḥ pra-catā guhā yan pra-paśyamānaḥ amr̥ta-tvam emi śi vam yat santam aśivaḥ jahāmi svāt sakhyāt araṇīm nābhim emi

na tam aṁhaḥ na duḥ-itam devāsaḥ aṣṭa martyam sa-joṣasaḥ yam aryamā mitraḥ nayanti varuṇaḥ ati dviṣaḥ

kaḥ addhā veda kaḥ iha pra vocat kutaḥ ājātā kutaḥ iyam vi-sr̥ṣṭiḥ arvāk devāḥ asya vi-sarjanena atha kaḥ veda yataḥ ābabhūva
iyam vi-sr̥ṣṭiḥ yataḥ ābabhūva yadi vā dadhe yadi vā na yaḥ asya adhi-akṣaḥ parame vi-oman saḥ aṅga veda yadi vā na veda
yaḥ yajñaḥ viśvataḥ tantu-bhiḥ tataḥ eka-śatam deva-karmebhiḥ āyataḥ ime vayanti pitaraḥ ye āyayuḥ pra vaya apa vaya iti āsate tate
pumān enam tanute ut kr̥ṇatti pumān vi tatne adhi nāke asmin ime mayūkhāḥ upa seduḥ oṁ iti sadaḥ sāmāni cakruḥ tasarāṇi otave
kā āsīt pra-mā prati-mā kim ni-dānam ājyam kim āsīt pari-dhiḥ kaḥ āsīt chandaḥ kim āsīt praugam kim uktham yat devāḥ devam ayajanta viśve
agneḥ gāyatrī abhavat sa-yugvā uṣṇihayā savitā sam babhūva anu-stubhā somaḥ ukthaiḥ mahasvān br̥haspateḥ br̥hatī vācam āvat
virāṭ mitrāvaruṇayoḥ abhi-śrīḥ indrasya tri-stup iha bhāgaḥ ahnaḥ viśvān devān jagatī ā viveśa tena cākl̥pre r̥ṣayaḥ manuṣyāḥ
cākepre tena r̥ṣayaḥ manuṣyāḥ yajñe jāte pitaraḥ naḥ purāṇe paśyan manye manasā cakṣasā tān ye imam yajñam ayajanta pūrve
saha-stomāḥ saha-chandasaḥ āvr̥taḥ saha-pramāḥ r̥ṣayaḥ sapta daivyāḥ pūrveṣām panthām anu-dr̥śya dhīrāḥ anu-ālebhire rathyaḥ na raśmīn
apa prācaḥ indra viśvān amitrān apa apācaḥ abhi-bhūte nudasva apa udīcaḥ apa śūra adharācaḥ urau yathā tava śarman madema
kuvit aṅga yava-mantaḥ yavam cit yathā dānti anu-pūrvam vi-yūya iha-iha eṣām kr̥ṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣaḥ namaḥ-vr̥ktim na jagmuḥ
nahi sthūri r̥tu-thā yātam asti na uta śravaḥ vivide sam-gameṣu gavyantaḥ indram sakhyāya viprāḥ aśva-yantaḥ vr̥ṣaṇam vāja-yantaḥ
yuvam surāmam aśvinā namucau āsure sacā vi-pipānā śubhaḥ patī iti indram karma-su āvatam
putram-iva pitarau aśvinā ubhā indra āvathuḥ kāvyaiḥ daṁsanābhiḥ yat surāmam vi apibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā magha-van abhiṣṇak
indraḥ su-trāmā sva-vān avaḥ-bhiḥ su-mr̥l̥īkaḥ bhavatu viśva-vedāḥ bādhatām dveṣaḥ abhayam kr̥ṇotu su-vīryasya patayaḥ syāma
tasya vayam su-matau yajñiyasya api bhadre saumanase syāma saḥ sutrāmā sva-vān indraḥ asme iti ārāt cit dveṣaḥ sanuta yuyotu
ījānam it dyauḥ gūrta-vasuḥ ījānam bhūmiḥ abhi pra-bhūṣaṇi ījānam devau aśvinau abhi sumnaiḥ avardhatām
tā vām mitrāvaruṇā dhārayatkṣitī itidhārayat-kṣitī su-sumnā iṣitatvatā yajāmasi yuvoḥ krāṇāya sakhyaiḥ abhi syāma rakṣasaḥ
adha cit nu yat dadhiṣāmahe vām abhi priyam rekṇaḥ patyamānāḥ dadvān vā yat puṣyati rekṇaḥ sam oṁ iti āran nakiḥ asya maghāni
asau anyaḥ asura sūyata dyauḥ tvam viśveṣām varuṇa asi rājā mūrdhā rathasya cākan na etāvatā enasā antaka-dhruk
asmin su etat śaka-pūte enaḥ hite mitre ni-gatān hanti vīrān avoḥ vā yat dhāt tanūṣu avaḥ priyāsuyajñiyāsv arvā
yuvoḥ hi mātā aditiḥ vi-cetasā dyauḥ na bhūmiḥ payasā pupūtani ava priyā didiṣṭana sūraḥ ninikta raśmi-bhiḥ
yuvam hi apna-rājau asīdatam tiṣṭhat ratham na dhūḥ-sadam vana-sadam tāḥ naḥ kaṇūka-yantīḥ nr̥-medhaḥ tatre aṁhasaḥ su-medhaḥ tatre aṁhasaḥ
pro iti su asmai puraḥ-ratham indrāya śūṣam arcata abhīke cit oṁ iti loka-kr̥t sam-ge samat-su vr̥tra-hā asmākam bodhi coditā nabhantām anyakeṣām jyākāḥ adhi dhanva-su
tvam sindhūn ava asr̥jaḥ adharācaḥ ahan ahim aśatruḥ indra jajñiṣe viśvam puṣyasi vāryam tam tvā pari svajāmahe nabhantām anyakeṣām jyākāḥ adhi dhanva-su
vi su viśvā arātayaḥ aryaḥ naśanta naḥ dhiyaḥ astā asi śatrave vadham yaḥ naḥ indra jighāṁsati yā te rātiḥ dadiḥ vasu nabhantām anyakeṣām jyākāḥ adhi dhanva-su
yaḥ naḥ indra abhitaḥ janaḥ vr̥ka-yuḥ ādideśati adhaḥ-padam tam īm kr̥dhi vi-bādhaḥ asi sasahiḥ nabhantām anyakeṣām jyākāḥ adhi dhanva-su
yaḥ naḥ indra abhi-dāsati sa-nābhiḥ yaḥ ca niṣṭyaḥ ava tasya balam tira mahī-iva dyauḥ adha tmanā nabhantām anyakeṣām jyākāḥ adhi dhanva-su
vayam indra tvāyavaḥ sakhi-tvam ā rabhāmahe r̥tasya naḥ pathā nayāti viśvāni duḥ-itā nabhantām anyakeṣām jyākāḥ adhi dhanva-su
asmabhyam su tvam indra tām śikṣa yā dohate prati varam jaritre acch idra-ūghnī pīpayat yathā naḥ sahasra-dhārā payasā mahī gauḥ
iti āpaprātha uṣāḥ-iva mahāntam tvā mahīnām sam-rājam carṣaṇīnām devī janitrī ajījanat bhadrā janitrī ajījanat
ava sma duḥ-hanāyataḥ martasya tanuhi sthiram adhaḥ-padam tam īm kr̥dhi yaḥ asmān ādideśati devī janitrī ajījanat bhadrā janitrī ajījanat
ava tyāḥ br̥hatīḥ iṣaḥ viśva-candrāḥ amitra-han śacībhiḥ śakra dhūnuhi indra viśvābhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ devī janitrī ajījanat bhadrā janitrī ajījanat
itiśata-krato indra viśvāni dhūnuṣe rayam ni sunvate sacā sahasriṇībhiḥ ūti-bhiḥ devī janitrī ajījanat bhadrā janitrī ajījanat
ava svedāḥ-iva abhitaḥ viṣvak patantu didyavaḥ dūrvāyāḥ-iva tantavaḥ vi asmat etu duḥ-matiḥ devī janitrī ajījanat bhadrā janitrī ajījanat
dīrgham hi aṅkuśam yathā śaktim bibharṣi mantu-maḥ pūrveṇa magha-van padā ajaḥ vayām yathā yamaḥ devī janitrī ajījanat bhadrā janitrī ajījanat
nakiḥ devāḥ minīmasi nakiḥ ā yopayāmasi mantra-śrutyam carāmasi pakṣebhiḥ apikakṣebhiḥ atra abhi sam rabhāmahe
yasmin vr̥kṣe su-palāśe devaiḥ sam-pibate yamaḥ atra naḥ viśpat iḥ pitā purāṇān anu venati
purāṇān anu-venantam carantam pāpayā amuyā asūyan abhi acākaśam tasmai aspr̥hayam punariti
yam kumāra navam ratham acakram manasā akr̥ṇoḥ eka-īṣam viśvataḥ prāñcam apaśyan adhi tiṣṭhasi
yam kumāra pra avartayaḥ ratham viprebhyaḥ pari tam sāma anu pra avartata sam itaḥ nāvi āhitam
kaḥ kumāram ajanayat ratham kaḥ niḥ avartayat kaḥ svit tat adya naḥ brūyāt anu-deyī yathā abhavat
yathā abhavat anu-deyī tataḥ agram ajāyata purastāt budhnaḥ ātataḥ paścāt niḥ-ayanam kr̥tam
idam yamasya sadanam deva-mānam yat ucyate iyam asya dhamyate nāl̥īḥ ayam gīḥ-bhiḥ pari-kr̥taḥ
keśī agnim keśī viṣam keśī bibharti rodasī iti keśī viśvam svaḥ dr̥śe keśī idam jyotiḥ ucyate
munayaḥ vāta-raśaṇāḥ piśaṅgāḥ vasate malā vātasya ana dhrājim yanti yat devāsaḥ avikṣata
ut-maditā mauneyena vātān ā tasthima vayam śarīrā it asmākam yūyam martāsaḥ abhi paśyatha
antarikṣeṇa patati viśvā rūpā ava-cākaśat muniḥ devasya-devasya saukr̥tyāya sakhā hitaḥ
vātasy a aśvaḥ vāyoḥ sakhā atho iti deva-iṣitaḥ muniḥ ubhau samudrau ā kṣeti yaḥ ca pūrvaḥ uta aparaḥ
apsarasām gandharvāṇām mr̥gāṇām caraṇe caran keśī ketasya vidvān sakhā svāduḥ madin-tamaḥ
vāyur asmai upa amanthat pinaṣṭi sma kunannamā keśī viṣasya pātreṇa yat rudreṇa apibat saha
uta devāḥ ava-hitam devāḥ ut nayatha punariti uta āgaḥ cakruṣam devaḥ devāḥ jīvayatha punariti
dvau imau vātau vātaḥ ā sindhoḥ ā parāvataḥ dakṣam te anyaḥ ā vātu parā anyaḥ vātu yat rapaḥ
ā vāta vāhi bheṣajam vi vāta vāhi yat rapaḥ tvam hi viśva-bheṣajaḥ devānām dūtaḥ īyase
ā tvā agamam śantāti-bhiḥ atho iti ariṣṭatāti-bhiḥ dakṣam te bhadram ā abharṣam parā yakṣmam suvām ite
trāyantām iha devāḥ trāyatām marutām gaṇaḥ trāyantām viśvā bhūtāni yathā ayam arapāḥ asat
āpaḥ it vā oṁ iti bheṣajīḥ āpaḥ amīva-cātanīḥ āpaḥ sarvasya bheṣajīḥ tāḥ te kr̥ṇvantu bheṣajam
hastābhyām daśa-śākhābhyām jihvā vācaḥ puraḥ-gavī anāmayitnu-bhyām tvā tābhyām tvā upa spr̥śāmasi
tava tye indra sakhyeṣu vahnayaḥ r̥tam manvānāḥ vi adardiruḥ valam yatra daśasyan uṣasaḥ riṇan āpaḥ kutsāya manman ahyaḥ ca daṁsayaḥ
ava asr̥jaḥ pra-svaḥ śvañcayaḥ girīn ut ājaḥ usrāḥ apibaḥ madhu priyam avardhayaḥ vaninaḥ asya daṁsasā śuśoca sūryaḥ r̥ta-jātayā girā
vi sūryaḥ madhye amucat ratham divaḥ vidat dāsāya prati-mānam āyarḥ dr̥l̥hāni piproḥ asurasya māyinaḥ indraḥ vi āsyat cakr̥-vān r̥jiśvanā
anādhr̥ṣṭāni dhr̥ṣitaḥ vi āsyat ni-dhīn adevān amr̥ṇat ayāsyaḥ māsāiva sūryaḥ vasu puryam ā dade gr̥ṇānaḥ śatrūn aśr̥ṇāt vi-rukmatā
ayuddha-senaḥ vi-bhvā vi-bhindatā dāśat vr̥tra-hā tujyāni tejate indrasya vajrāt abibhet abhi-śnathaḥ pra akrāmat śundhyūḥ ajahāt uṣāḥ anaḥ
etā tyā te śrutyāni kevalā yat ekaḥ ekam akr̥ṇoḥ ayajñam māsām vi-dhānam adadhāḥ adhi dyavi tvayā vi-bhinnam bharati pra-ghim pitā
sūrya-raśmiḥ hari-keśaḥ purastāt savitā jyotiḥ ut ayān ajasram tasya pūṣā pra-save yāti vidvān sam-paśyan viśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ
nr̥-cakṣāḥ eṣaḥ divaḥ madhye āste āpapri-vān rodasī iti antarikṣam saḥ viśvācīḥ abhi caṣṭi ghr̥tācīḥ antarā pūrvam aparam ca ketum
rāyaḥ budhnaḥ sam-gamanaḥ vasūnām viśvā rūpā abhi caṣṭe śacībhiḥ devaḥ-iva savitā satya-dharmā indraḥ na tasthau sam-are dhanānām
viśva-vasum soma gandharvam āpaḥ dadr̥śuṣīḥ tat r̥tena vi āyan tat anu-avait indraḥ rarahāṇaḥ āsām pari sūryasya pari-dhīn apaśyat
viśva-vasuḥ abhi tat naḥ gr̥ṇātu divyaḥ gandharvaḥ rajasaḥ vi-mānaḥ yat vā gha satyam uta yat na vidma dhiyaḥ hinvānaḥ dhiyaḥ it naḥ avyāḥ
sasnim avindat caraṇe nadīnām apa avr̥ṇot duraḥ aśma-vrajānām pra āsām gandharvaḥ amr̥tāni vocat indraḥ dakṣam pari jānāt ahīnām
agne tava śravaḥ vayaḥ mahi bhrājante arcayaḥ vibhāvaso itivibhāvaso br̥hadbhāno itibr̥hat-bhāno śavasā vājam ukthyr̥am dadhāsi dāśuṣe kave
pāvaka-varcāḥ śukra-varcāḥ anūna-varcāḥ ut iyarṣi bhānunā putraḥ mātarā vi-caran upa avasi pr̥ṇakṣi rodasī iti ubhe iti
ūrjaḥ napāt jāta-vedaḥ suśasti-bhiḥ mandasva dhīti-bhiḥ hitaḥ tve iti iṣaḥ sam dadhuḥ bhūri-varpasaḥ citra-ūtayaḥ vāma-jātāḥ
irajyan agne prathayasva jantu-bhiḥ asme iti rāyaḥ amartya saḥ darśatasya vapuṣaḥ vi rājasi pr̥ṇakṣi sānasim kratum
iṣkartāram adhvarasya pra-cetasam kṣayantam rādhasaḥ mahaḥ rātim vāmasya su-bhagām mahīm iṣam dadhāsi sānasim rayim
r̥ta-vānam mahiṣam viśva-darśatam agnim sumnāya dadhire puraḥ janāḥ śrut-karṇam saprathaḥ-tamam tvā girā daivyam mānuṣā yugā
agne accha vada iha naḥ pratyaṅ naḥ su-manāḥ bhava pra naḥ yaccha viśaḥ pate dhana-dāḥ asi naḥ tvam
pra naḥ yacchatu aryamā pra bhagaḥ pra br̥haspatiḥ pra devāḥ pra uta sūnr̥tā rāyaḥ devī dadātu naḥ
somam rājānam avase agnim gīḥ-bhiḥ havāmahe ādityān viṣṇum sūryam brahmāṇam ca br̥haspatim
indravāyū iti br̥haspatim su-havā iha havāmahe yathā naḥ sarvaḥ it janaḥ sam-gatyām su-manāḥ asat
aryamaṇam br̥haspatim indram dānāya codaya vātam viṣṇum sarasvatīm savitāram ca vājinam
tvam naḥ agne agni-bhiḥ brahma yajñam ca vardhaya tvam naḥ deva-tātaye rāyaḥ dānāya codaya
ayam agne jaritā tve iti abhūt api sahasaḥ sūno iti nahi anyat asti āpyam bhadram hi śarma tri-varāūtham asti te āre hiṁsānām apa didyum ā kr̥dhi
pra-vat te agne janima pitu-yataḥ sācī-iva viśvā bhuvanā ni r̥ñjase pra saptayaḥ pra saniṣanta naḥ dhiyaḥ puraḥ caranti paśu-pāḥ-iva tmanā
uta vā oṁ iti pari vr̥ṇakṣi bapsat bahoḥ agne ulapasya svadhāvaḥ uta khilyāḥ urvarāṇām bhavanti mā te hetim taviṣīm cukrudhāma
yat ut-vataḥ ni-vataḥ yāsi bapsat pr̥thak eṣi pragardhinī-iva senā yadā te vātaḥ anu-vāti śociḥ vaptāiva śmaśru vapasi pra bhūma
prati asya śreṇayaḥ dadr̥śre ekam ni-yānam bahavaḥ rathāsaḥ bāhū iti yat agne anu-marmr̥jānaḥ nyaṅ attānām anu-eṣi bhūmim
ut te śuṣmāḥ jihatām ut te agne śaśamānasya vājāḥ ut śvañcasva ni namaḥ vardhamānaḥ ā tvā adya viśve vasavaḥ sadantu
apām idam ni-ayanam samudrasya ni-veśanam anyaṅm kr̥ṇuṣva itaḥ panthām tena yāhi vaśān anu
āyane te parāyane dūrvāḥ rohantu puṣpiṇīḥ hradāḥ ca puṇḍarīkāṇi samudrasya gr̥hāḥ ime
tyam cit atrim r̥ta-juram artham aśvam na yātave kakṣīvantam yadi punariti ratham na kr̥ṇuthaḥ navam
tyam cit aśvam na vājinam areṇavaḥ yam atnata dr̥l̥ham granthim na vi syatam atrim yaviṣṭham ā rajaḥ
narā daṁsiṣṭhau atraye śubhrā sisāsatam dhiyaḥ atha hi vām divaḥ narā punariti stomaḥ na viśase
cite tat vām su-rādhasā rātiḥ su-matiḥ aśvinā ā yat naḥ sadane pr̥thau samane parṣathaḥ narā
yuvam bhujyum samudre ā rajasaḥ pāre īṅkhitam yātam accha patatri-bhiḥ nāsatyā sātaye kr̥tam
ā vām sumnaiḥ śaṁyūivetiśaṁyū-iva maṁhiṣṭhā viśva-vedasā sam asme iti bhūṣatam narā utsam na pipyuṣīḥ iṣaḥ
ayam hi te amartyaḥ induḥ atyaḥ na patyate dakṣaḥ viśva-āyuḥ vedhase
ayam asmāsu kāvyaḥ r̥bhuḥ vajraḥ dāsvate ayam bibharti ūrdhva-kr̥śanam madam r̥bhuḥ na kr̥tvyam madam
ghr̥ṣuḥ śyenāya kr̥tvane āsu svāsu vaṁsagaḥ ava dīdhet ahīśuvaḥ
yam su-parṇaḥ parāvataḥ śyenasya putraḥ ā abharat śata-cakram yaḥ ahyaḥ vartaniḥ
yam te śyenaḥ cārum avr̥kam padā ā abharat aruṇam mānam andhasaḥ enā vayaḥ vi tāri āyuḥ jīvase enā jāgāra bandhutā
eva tat indraḥ indunā deveṣu cit dhārayāte mahi tyajaḥ kratvā vayaḥ vi tāri āyuḥ sukrato itisu-krato kratvā ayam asmat ā sutaḥ
imām khanāmi oṣadhim vīrudham balavat-tamām yayā sa-patnīm bādhate yayā sam-vindate patim
uttāna-parṇe su-bhage deva-jūte sahasvati sa-patnīm me parā dhama patim me kevalam kuru
ut-tarā aham ut-tare ut-tarā it ut-tarābhyaḥ atha sa-patnī yā mama adharā sā adharābhyaḥ
nahi asyāḥ nāma gr̥bhṇāmi no iti asmin ramate jane parām eva parāvatam sa-patnīm gamayāmasi
aham asmi sahamānā atha tvam asi sasahiḥ ubhe iti sahasvatī iti bhūtvī sa-ptnīm me sahāvahai
upa te adhām sahamānām abhi tvā adhām sahīyasā mām anu pra te manaḥ vatsam gauḥ-iva dhāvatu pathā vāḥ-iva dhāvatu
araṇyāni araṇyānyi asau yā pra-iva naśyasi kathā grāmam na pr̥cchasi na tvā bhīḥ-iva vindataiṁśn
vr̥ṣāravāya vadate yat upa-avati ciccikaḥ āghāṭibhiḥ-iva dhāvayan araṇyāniḥ mahīyate
uta gāvaḥ-iva adanti uta veśma-ivadr̥śyate uto iti araṇyāniḥ sāyam śakaṭīḥ-iva sarjati
gām aṅga eṣaḥ ā hvayati dāru aṅga eṣaḥ apa avadhīt vasan araṇyānyām sāyam akrukṣat iti manyate
na vai araṇyāniḥ hanti anyaḥ ca it na abhi-gacchati svādoḥ phalasya jagdhvāya yathākāmam ni padyate
āñjana-gandhim surabhim bahu-annām akr̥ṣi-valām pra aham mr̥gāṇām mātaram araṇyānim aśaṁsiṣam
śrat te dadhāmi prathamāya manyave ahan yat vr̥tram naryam viveḥ apaḥ ubhe iti yat tvā bhavataḥ rodasī iti anu rejate śuṣmāt pr̥thivī cit adri-vaḥ
tvam māyābhiḥ anavadya māyinam śravasyatā manasā vr̥tram ardaya tvām it naraḥ vr̥ṇate gaviṣṭiṣu tvām viśvāsu havyāsu iṣṭiṣu
ā eṣu cākandhi puru-hūta sūriṣu vr̥dhāsaḥ ye magha-van ānaśuḥ magham arcanti toke tanaye pariṣṭiṣu medha-sātā vājinam ahvaye dhane
saḥ it nu rāyaḥ su-bhr̥tasya cākanat madam yaḥ asya raṁhyam ciketati tvāvr̥dhaḥ magha-van dāśu-adhvaraḥ makṣu saḥ vājam bharate dhanā nr̥-bhiḥ
tvam śardhāya mahinā gr̥ṇānaḥ uru kr̥dhi magha-van śagdhi rāyaḥ tvam naḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ na māyī pitvaḥ na dasma dayase vi-bhaktā
susvānāsaḥ indra stumasi tvā sasa-vāṁsaḥ ca tuvi-nr̥mṇa vājam ā naḥ bhara suvitam yasya cākan tmanā tanā sanuyāma tvāūtāḥ
r̥ṣvaḥ tvam indra śūra jātaḥ dāsīḥ viśaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ guhā hitam guhyam gūl̥ham ap-su bibhr̥masi pra-sravaṇe na somam
aryaḥ vā giraḥ abhi arca vidvān r̥ṣīṇām vipraḥ su-matim cakānaḥ te syāma ye raṇayanta somaiḥ enā uta tubhyam ratha-ol̥ha bhakṣaiḥ
imā brahma indra tubhyam śaṁsi dāḥ nr̥-bhyaḥ nr̥ṇām śūra śavaḥ tebhi ḥ bhava sa-kratuḥ yeṣu cākan uta trāyasva gr̥ṇataḥ uta stīn
śrudhi havam indra śūra pr̥thyāḥ uta stavate venyasya arkaiḥ ā yaḥ te yonim ghr̥ta-vantam asvāḥ ūrmiḥ na nimnaiḥ dravayanta vakvāḥ
savitā yantraiḥ pr̥thivīm aramṇāt askambhane savitā dyām adr̥ṁhat aśvam-iva adhukṣat dhunim antarikṣam atūrte baddham savitā samudram
yatra samudraḥ skabhitaḥ vi aunat apām napāt savitā tasya veda ataḥ bhūḥ ataḥ āḥ utthitam rajaḥ ataḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti aprathetām
paścā idam anyat abhavat yajatram amartyasya bhuvanasya bhūnā su-parṇaḥ aṅga savituḥ garutmān pūrvaḥ jātaḥ saḥ oṁ iti asya anu dharma
gāvaḥ-iva grāmam yūyudhiḥ-iva aśvān vāśrāiva vatsam su-manāḥ duhānā patiḥ-iva jāyām abhi naḥ ni etu dhartā divaḥ savitā viśva-vāraḥ
hiraṇya-stūpaḥ savitaḥ yathā tvā āṅgirasaḥ juhve vāje asmin eva tvā arcan avase vandamānaḥ somasya-iva aṁśum prati jāgara aham
sam-iddhaḥ cit sam idhyase devebhyaḥ havya-vāhan ādityaiḥ rudraiḥ vasu-bhiḥ naḥ ā gahi mr̥l̥īkāya naḥ ā gahi
imam yajñam idam vacaḥ jujuṣāṇaḥ upa-āgahi martāsaḥ tvā sam-idhāna havāmahe mr̥l̥īkāya havāmahe
tvām oṁ iti jāta-vedasam viśva-vāram gr̥ṇe dhiyā agne devān ā vaha naḥ priya-vratān mr̥l̥īkāya priya-vratān
agniḥ devaḥ devānām abhavat puraḥ-hitaḥ agnim manuṣyāḥ r̥ṣayaḥ sam īdhire agnim mahaḥ dhana-sātau aham huve mr̥l̥īkam dhana-sātaye
agniḥ atrim bharat-vājam gaviṣṭhiram pra āvat naḥ kaṇvam trasadasyum āhave agnim vasiṣṭhaḥ havate puraḥ-hitaḥ mr̥l̥īkāya puraḥ-hitaḥ
śraddhayā agniḥ sam idhyate śraddhayā hūyate haviḥ śraddhām bhagasya mūrdhani vacasā ā vedayāmasi
priyam śraddhe dadataḥ priyam śraddhe didāsataḥ priyam bhojeṣu yajvasu idam me uditam kr̥dhi
yathā devāḥ asureṣu śraddhām ugreṣu cakrire evam bhojeṣu yajva-su asmākam uditam kr̥dhi
śraddhām devāḥ yajamānāḥ vāyu-gopāḥ upa āsate śraddhām hr̥dayyayā ākūtyā śraddhayā vindate vasu
śraddhām prātaḥ havāmahe śraddhām madhyandinam pari śraddhām sūryasya ni-mruci śraddhe śrat dhāpaya iha naḥ
śāsaḥ itthā mahān asi amitra-khādaḥ adbhutaḥ na yasya hanyate sakhā na jīyate kadā cana
svasti-dāḥ viśaḥ patiḥ vr̥tra-hā vi-mr̥dhaḥ vaśī vr̥ṣā indraḥ puraḥ etu naḥ soma-pāḥ abhayam-karaḥ
vi rakṣaḥ vi mr̥dhaḥ jahi vi vr̥trasya hanūiti ruja vi manyum indra vr̥tra-han amitrasya abhi-dāsataḥ
vi naḥ indra mr̥dhaḥ jahi nīcā yaccha pr̥tanyataḥ yaḥ asmān abhi-dāsati adharam gamaya tamaḥ
apa indra dviṣataḥ manaḥ apa jijyāsataḥ vadham vi manyoḥ śarma yaccha varīyaḥ yavaya vadham
īṅkhayantīḥ apasyuvaḥ indram jātam upa āsate bhejānāsaḥ su-vīryam
tvam indra balāt adhi sahasaḥ jātaḥ ojasaḥ tvavm vr̥ṣan vr̥ṣā it asi
tvam indra asi vr̥tra-hā vi antarikṣam atiraḥ ut dyām astabhnāḥ ojasā
tvam indra sa-joṣasam arkam bibharṣi bāhvoḥ vajram śiśānaḥ ojasā
tvam indra abhi-bhūḥ asi viśvā jātāni ojasā saḥ viśvā bhuvaḥ ā abhavaḥ
somaḥ ekebhyaḥ pavate ghr̥tam eke upa āsate yebhyaḥ madhu pra-dhāvati tān cit eva api gacchatāt
tapasā ye ānādhr̥ṣyāḥ tapasā ye svaḥ yayuḥ tapaḥ ye cakrire mahaḥ tān cit eva api gacchatāt
ye yudhyante pra-dhaneṣu śūrāsaḥ ye tanū-tyajaḥ ye vā sahasra-dakṣiṇāḥ tān cit eva api gacchatāt
ye cit pūrve r̥ta-sāpaḥ r̥ta-vānaḥ r̥tā-vr̥dhaḥ pitr̥r̥n tapasvataḥ yama tān cit eva api gacchatāt
sahasra-nīthāḥ kavayaḥ ye gopāyanti sūryam r̥ṣīn tapasvataḥ yama tapaḥ-jān api gacchatāt
arāyi kāṇe vi-kaṭe girim gaccha sadānve śirimbiṭhasya satva-bhiḥ tebhiḥ tvā cātayāmasi
catto iti itaḥ cattā amutaḥ sarvā bhrūṇānyi āruṣī arāyyam brahmaṇaḥ pate tīkṣṇa-śr̥ṅga ut-r̥ṣan ihi
adaḥ yat dāru plavate sindhoḥ pāre apuruṣam tat ā rabhasva durhano itiduḥ-hano tena gaccha paraḥ-taram
yat ha prācīḥ ajaganta uraḥ maṇḍūra-dhāṇikīḥ hatāḥ indrasya śatravaḥ sarve budbuda-yāśavaḥ
pari ime gām aneṣata pari agnim ahr̥ṣata deveṣu akrata śravaḥ kaḥ imān ā dadharṣati
agnim hinvantu naḥ dhiyaḥ saptim āśum-iva ājiṣu tena jeṣma dhanam-dhanam
yayā gāḥ ākarāmahe senayā agne tava ūtyā tām naḥ hinva maghattaye
ā agne sthūram rayim bhara pr̥thum go--mantam aśvinam aṅdhi kham vartaya paṇim
agne nakṣatram ajaram ā sūryam rohayaḥ divi dadhat jyotiḥ janebhyaḥ
agne ketuḥ viśām asi preṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ upastha-sat bodha stotre vayaḥ dadhat
imā nu kam bhuvanā sīsadhāma indraḥ ca viśve ca devāḥ
yajñam ca naḥ tanvam ca pra-jām ca ādityaiḥ indraḥ saha cīkl̥pāti
ādityaiḥ indraḥ sa-gaṇaḥ marut-bhiḥ asmākam bhūtu avitā tanūnām
hatvāya devāḥ asurān yat āyan devāḥ deva-tvam abhi-rakṣamāṇāḥ
pratyañcam arkam anayan śacībhiḥ āt it svadhām iṣirām pari apaśyan
sūryaḥ naḥ divaḥ pātu vātaḥ antarikṣāt agniḥ naḥ pārthivebhyaḥ
joṣa savitaḥ yasya te haraḥ śatam savān arhati pāhi naḥ didyutaḥ patantyāḥ
cakṣuḥ naḥ devaḥ savitā cakṣuḥ naḥ uta parvataḥ cakṣuḥ dhātā dadhātu naḥ
cakṣuḥ naḥ dhehi cakṣuṣe cakṣuḥ vi-khyai tanūbhyaḥ sam ca idam vi ca paśyema
su-sandr̥śam tvā vayam prati paśyema sūrya vi paśyema nr̥-cakṣasaḥ
ut asau sūryaḥ agāt ut ayam māmakaḥ bhagaḥ aham tat vidvalā patim abhi āsākṣi vi-sasahiḥ
aham ketuḥ aham mūrdhā aham ugrā vi-vācanī mama it anu kratum patiḥ sehānāyāḥ upa-ācaret
mama putrāḥ śatru-hanaḥ atho iti me duhitā virāṭ uta aham asmi sam-jayā patyau me ślokaḥ ut-tamaḥ
yena indraḥ haviṣā kr̥tvī abhavat dyumnī ut-tamaḥ idanm tat akri devāḥ asapatnā kila abhuvam
asapatnā sapatna-ghnī jayantī abhi-bhūvarī ā avr̥kṣam anyāsām vacarḥ rādhaḥ astheyasām-iva
sam ajaiṣam imāḥ aham sa-patnīḥ abhi-bhūvarī yathā aham asya vīrasya vi-rājāni janasya ca
tīvrasya abhi-vayasaḥ asya pāhi sarva-rathā vi harī iti iha muñca indra mā tvā yajamānāsaḥ anye ni rīraman tubhyam ime sutāsaḥ
tubhyam sutāḥ tubhyam oṁ iti sotvāsaḥ tvām giraḥ śvātryāḥ ā hvayanti indra idam adya savanam juṣāṇaḥ viśvasya vidvān iha pāhi somam
yaḥ uśatā manasā somam asmai sarva-hr̥dā deva-kāmaḥ sunoti na gāḥ indraḥ tasya parā dadāti pra-śastam it cārum asmai kr̥ṇoti
anu-spaṣṭaḥ bhavati eṣaḥ asya yaḥ asmai revān na sunoti somam niḥ aratnau magha-vā tam dadhāti brahma-dviṣaḥ hanti ananu-diṣṭaḥ
aśvayantaḥ gavyantaḥ vājayantaḥ havāmahe tvā upa-gantavai oṁ iti ābhūṣantaḥ te su-matau navāyām vayam indra tvā śunam huvema
muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya kam ajñāta-yakṣmāt uta rāja-yakṣmāt grāhi ḥ jagrāha yadi vā etat enam tasyāḥ indrāgnī iti pra mumuktam enam
yadi kṣita-āyuḥ yadi vā parāitaḥ yadi mr̥tyoḥ antikam ni-itaḥ eva tam ā harāmi niḥ-r̥teḥ upa-sthāt aspārṣam enam śata-śāradāya
sahasra-akṣeṇa śata-śāradena śata-āyuṣā haviṣā ā ahārṣam enam śatam yathā imam śaradaḥ nayāti indraḥ viśvasya duḥ-itasya pāram
śatam jīva śaradaḥ vardhamānaḥ śatam hemantān śatam oṁ iti vasantān śatam indrāgnī iti savitā br̥haspatiḥ śata-āyuṣā haviṣā imam punaḥ duḥ
ā ahārṣam tvā avidam tvā punaḥ ā agāḥ punaḥ-nava sarva-aṅga sarvam te cakṣuḥ sarvam āyuḥ ca te avidam
brahmaṇā agniḥ sām-vidānaḥ rakṣaḥ-hā bādhatām itaḥ amīvā yaḥ te garbham duḥ-nāmā yonim āśaye
yaḥ te garbham amīvā duḥ-nāmā yonim āśaye agniḥ tam brahmaṇā saha niḥ kravya-adam anīnaśat
yaḥ te hanti patayantam ni-satsnum yaḥ sarīsr̥pam jātam yaḥ te jighāṁsati tam itaḥ nāśayāmasi
yaḥ te ūrū iti vi-harati antarā dampatī itidam-patī śaye yonim yaḥ antaḥ ārel̥hi tam itaḥ nāśayāmasi
yaḥ tvā bhrātā patiḥ bhūtvā jāraḥ bhūtvā ni-padyate pra-jām yaḥ te j ighāṁsati tam itaḥ nāśayāmasi
yaḥ tvā svapnena tamasā mohayitvā ni-padyate pra-jām yaḥ te ji ghāṁsati tam itaḥ nāśayāmasi
akṣībhyām te nāsikābhyām karṇābhyām chubukāt adhi yakṣmam śīrṣaṇyam mastiṣkāt jihvāyāḥ vi vr̥hāmi te
grīvābhyaḥ te uṣṇihābhyaḥ kīkasābhyaḥ anūkyāt yakṣmam doṣaṇyam aṁsābhyām bāhu-bhyām vi vr̥hāmi te
āntrebhyaḥ te gudābhyaḥ vaniṣṭhoḥ hr̥dayāt adhi yakṣmam matasnābhyām yaknaḥ plāśi-bhyaḥ vi vr̥hāmi te
ūru-bhyām te aṣṭhīvat-bhyām pārṣṇi-bhyām pra-padābhyām yakṣmam śroṇi-bhym bhāsadāt bhaṁsasaḥ vi vr̥hāmi te
mehanāt vanam-karaṇāt loma-bhyaḥ te nakhebhyaḥ yakṣmam sarvasmāt ātmanaḥ tam idam vi vr̥hāmi te
aṅgāt-aṅgāt lomnaḥ-lomnaḥ jātam parvaṇi-parvaṇi yakṣmam sarvasmāt ātmanaḥ tam idam vi vr̥hāmi te
apa ihi manasaḥ pate apa krāma paraḥ cara paraḥ niḥ-r̥tyai ā cakṣva bahudhā jīvataḥ manaḥ
bhadram vai varam vr̥ṇate bhadram yuñjanti dakṣiṇam bhadram vaivasvate cakṣuḥ bahu-trā jīvataḥ manaḥ
yat āśasā niḥ-śasā abhi-śasā upa-ārima jāgrataḥ yat svapantaḥ agniḥ viśvāni apa duḥ-kr̥tāni ajuṣṭāni āre asmat dādhātu
yat indra brahmaṇaḥ pate abhi-droham carāmasi pra-cetāḥ naḥ āṅgirasaḥ dviṣatām pātu aṁhasaḥ
ajaiṣma adya asanāma ca abhūma anāgasaḥ vayam jāgrat-svapnaḥ sam-kalpaḥ pāpaḥ yam dviṣmaḥ tam saḥ r̥cchatu yaḥ naḥ dveṣṭi tam r̥cchatu
devāḥ kapotaḥ iṣitaḥ yat icchan dūtaḥ niḥ-r̥tyāḥ idam ājagāma tasmai arcāma kr̥ṇavāma niḥ-kr̥tim śam naḥ astu dvi-pade śam catuḥ-pade
śivaḥ kapotaḥ iṣitaḥ naḥ astu anāgāḥ devāḥ śakunaḥ gr̥heṣu agniḥ hi vipraḥ juṣatām haviḥ naḥ pari hetiḥ pakṣiṇī naḥ vr̥ṇaktu
hetiḥ pakṣiṇī na dabhāti asmān āṣṭryām padam kr̥ṇute agni-dhāne śam naḥ gobhyaḥ ca puruṣebhyaḥ ca astu mā naḥ hiṁsīt iha devāḥ kapotaḥ
yat ulūkaḥ vadati mogham etat yat kapotaḥ padam agnau kr̥ṇoti yasya dūtaḥ pra-hitaḥ eṣaḥ etat tasmai yamāya namaḥ astu mr̥tyave
r̥cā kapotam nudata pra-nodam iṣam madantaḥ pari gām nayadhvam sam-yopayantaḥ duḥ-itāni viśvā hitvā naḥ ūrjam pra patāt patiṣṭhaḥ
r̥ṣabham mā samānānām sa-patnānām vi-sasahim hantāram śatrūṇām kr̥dhi vi-rājam go--patim gavām
aham asmi sapatna-hā indraḥ-iva ariṣṭaḥ akṣataḥ adhaḥ sa-patnāḥ me padoḥ ime sarve abhi-sthitāḥ
atra eva vaḥ api nahyāmi ubhe iti ātnīrivetyātnīr-iva jyayā vācaḥ pate ni sedha imān yathā mat adharam vadān
abhi-bhūḥ aham ā agamam viśva-karmeṇa dhāmnā ā vaḥ cittam ā vaḥ vratam ā vaḥ aham sam-itim dade
yoga-kṣemam vaḥ ādāya aham bhūyāsam ut-tamaḥ ā vaḥ mūrdhānam akramīm adhaḥ-padāt me ut vadata maṇḍūkāḥ-iva udakāt maṇḍūkāḥ udakāt-iva
tubhya idam indra pari sicyate madhu tvam sutasya kalaśasya rājas i tvam rayim puru-vīrām oṁ iti naḥ kr̥dhi tvam tapaḥ pari-tapya ajayaḥ [svar iti]svaḥ
svaḥ-jitam mahi mandānam andhasaḥ havāmahe pari śakram sutān upa imam naḥ yajñam iha bodhi ā gahi spr̥dhaḥ jayantam magha-vānam īmahe
somasya rājñaḥ varuṇasya dharmaṇi br̥haspateḥ anu-matyāḥ oṁ iti śarmaṇi tava aham adya magha-van upa-stutau dhātaḥ vi-dhātariti vi-dhātaḥ kalaśān abhakṣayam
pra-sūtaḥ bhakṣam akaram carau api stomam ca imam prathamaḥ sūriḥ ut mr̥je sute sātena yadi ā agamam vām prati viśvāmitrajamadagnī iti dame
vātasya nu mahimānam rathasya rujan eti stanayan asya ghoṣaḥ di vi-spr̥k yāti aruṇāni kr̥ṇvan uto iti eti pr̥thivyā reṇum asyan
sam pra īrate anu vātasya vi-sthāḥ ā enam gacchanti samanam na yoṣāḥ tābhiḥ sa-yuk sa-ratham devaḥ īyate asya viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā
antarikṣe pathi-bhiḥ īyamānaḥ na ni viśate katamat cana ahariti apām sakhā prathama-jāḥ r̥ta-vā kva svit jātaḥ kutaḥ ā babhūva
ātmā devānām bhuvanasya garbhaḥ yathāvaśam carati devaḥ eṣaḥ ghoṣāḥ it asya śr̥ṇvire na rūpam tasmai vātāya haviṣā vidhema
mayaḥ-bhūḥ vātaḥ abhi vātu usrāḥ ūrjasvatīḥ oṣadhīḥ ā riśantām pīvasvatīḥ jīva-dhanyāḥ pibantu avasāya pat-vate rudra mr̥l̥a
yāḥ sa-rūpāḥ vi-rūpāḥ eka-rūpāḥ yāsām agniḥ iṣṭyā nāmāni veda yāḥ aṅgirasaḥ tapasā iha cakruḥ tābhyaḥ parjanya mahi śarma yaccha
yāḥ deveṣu tanvam airayanta yāsām somaḥ viśvā rūpāṇi veda tāḥ asmabhyam payasā pinvamānāḥ prajāvatīḥ indra go--sthe rirīhi
prajāpatiḥ mahyam etāḥ rarāṇaḥ viśvaiḥ devaiḥ pitr̥-bhiḥ sam-vidānaḥ śivāḥ satīḥ upa naḥ go--stham ā akar ity akaḥ tāsām vayam pra-jayā sam sadema
vi-bhrāṭ br̥hat pibatu somyam madhu āyuḥ dadhat yajña-patau avi-hutam vāta-jūtaḥ yaḥ abhi-rakṣati tmanā pra-jāḥ pupoṣa purudhā vi rājat i
vi-bhrāṭ br̥hat su-bhr̥tam vāja-sātamam dharmam divaḥ dharuṇe satyam arpitam amitra-hā vr̥tra-hā dasyuhan-tamam jyotiḥ jajñe asura-hā sapatna-hā
idam śreṣṭham jyotiṣām jyotiḥ ut-tamam viśva-jit dhana-jit ucyate br̥hat viśva-bhrāṭ bhrājaḥ mahi sūryaḥ dr̥śe uru paprathe sahaḥ ojaḥ acyutam
vi-bhrājam jyotiṣā svaḥ agacchaḥ rocanam divaḥ yena imā viśvā bhuvanāni ābhr̥tā viśva-karmaṇā viśvadevya-vatā
tvam tyam iṭataḥ ratham indra pra āvaḥ suta-vataḥ aśr̥ṇoḥ somina havam
tvam makhasya dodhataḥ śiraḥ ava tvacaḥ bharaḥ agacchaḥ sominaḥ gr̥ham
tvam tyam indra martyam āstra-budhnāya venyam muhuḥ śrathnāḥ manasyave
tvam tyam indra sūryam paścā santam puraḥ kr̥dhi devānām cit tiraḥ vaśam
ā yāhi vanasā saha gāvaḥ sacanta vartanim yat ūdha-bhiḥ
ā yāhi vasvyā dhiyā maṁhiṣṭhaḥ jārayat-makhaḥ sudānu-bhiḥ
pitu-bhr̥taḥ na tantum it su-dānavaḥ prati dadhmaḥ yajāmasi
uṣāḥ apa svasuḥ tamaḥ sam vartayati vartanim su-jātatā
ā tvā ahārṣam antaḥ edhi dhruvaḥ tiṣṭha avi-cācaliḥ viśaḥ tvā sarvāḥ vāñchantu mā tvat rāṣṭram adhi bhraśat
iha eva edhi mā apa cyoṣṭhāḥ parvataḥ-iva avi-cācaliḥ indra-iva iha dhruvaḥ tiṣṭha iha rāṣṭram oṁ iti dhāraya
imam indraḥ adīdharat dhruvam dhruveṇa haviṣā tasmai somaḥ adhi bravat tasmai oṁ iti brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ
dhruvā dyauḥ dhruvā pr̥thivī dhruvāsaḥ parvatāḥ ime dhruvam viśvam idam jagat dhruvaḥ rājā viśām ayam
dhruvam te rājā varuṇaḥ dhruvam devaḥ br̥haspatiḥ dhruvam te indraḥ ca agniḥ ca rāṣṭram dhārayatām dhruvam
dhruvam dhruveṇa haviṣā abhi somam mr̥śāmasi atho iti te indraḥ kevalīḥ viśaḥ bali-hr̥taḥ karat
abhi-vartena haviṣā yena indraḥ abhi-vavr̥te tena asmān brahmaṇaḥ pate abhi rāṣṭrāya vartaya
abhi-vr̥tya sa-patnān abhi yāḥ naḥ arātayaḥ abhi pr̥tanyantam tiṣṭha abhi yaḥ naḥ irasyati
abhi tvā devaḥ savitā abhi somaḥ avīvr̥tat abhi tvā viśvā bhūtāni abhi-vartaḥ yathā asasi
yena indraḥ haviṣā kr̥tvī abhavat dyumnī ut-tamaḥ idam tat akri devāḥ asapatnaḥ kila abhuvam
asapatnaḥ sapatna-hā abhi-rāṣṭraḥ vi-sasahiḥ yathā aham eṣām bhūtānām vi-rājāni janasya ca
pra vaḥ grāvāṇaḥ savitā devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā dhūḥ-su yujyadhvam sunuta
grāvāṇaḥ apa ducchunām apa sedhata duḥ-matim usrāḥ kartana bheṣajam
grāvāṇaḥ upareṣu ā mahīyante sa-joṣasaḥ vr̥ṣṇe dadhataḥ vr̥ṣṇyam
grāvāṇaḥ savitā nu vaḥ devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā yajamānāya sunvate
pra sūnavaḥ r̥bhūṇām br̥hat navanta vr̥janā kṣāma ye viśva-dhāyasaḥ aśnan dhenum na mātaram
pra devam devyā dhiyā bharata jāta-vedasam havyā naḥ vakṣat ānuṣak
ayam oṁ iti syaḥ pra deva-yuḥ hotā yajñāya nīyate rathaḥ na yoḥ abhi-vr̥taḥ ghr̥ṇi-vān cetati tmanā
ayam agniḥ uruṣyati amr̥tāt-iva janmanaḥ sahasaḥ cit sahīyān devaḥ jīvātave kr̥taḥ
pataṅgam aktam asurasya māyayā hr̥dā paśyanti manasā vipaḥ-citaḥ samudre antariti kavayaḥ vi cakṣate marīcīnām padam icchanti vedhasaḥ
pataṅgaḥ vācam manasā bibharti tān gandharvaḥ avadat garbhe antar iti tām dyotamānām svaryam manīṣām r̥tasya pade kavayaḥ ni pānti
apaśyam gopām ani-padyamānam ā ca parā ca pathi-bhiḥ carantam saḥ sadhrīcīḥ saḥ viṣūcīḥ vasānaḥ ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣu antariti
tyam oṁ iti su vājinam deva-jūtam saha-vānam taru-tāram rathānām ariṣṭa-nemim pr̥tanājam āśum svastaye tārkṣyam iha huvema
indrasya-iva rātim ājohuvānāḥ svastaye nāvam-iva ā ruhema urvī iti na pr̥thvī iti bahuleiti gabhīreiti mā vām āitau mā parāitau riṣāma
sadyaḥ cit yaḥ śavasā pañca kr̥ṣṭīḥ sūryaḥ-iva jyotiṣā apaḥ tatāna sahasra-sāḥ śata-sāḥ asya raṁhiḥ na sma varante yuvatim na śaryām
ut tiṣṭhata ava paśyata indrasya bhāgam r̥tviyam yadi śrātaḥ juhotana yadi aśrātaḥ mamattana
śr̥ātam haviḥ o iti su indra pra yāhi jagāma sūraḥ adhvanaḥ vi-madhyam pari tvā āsate nidhi-bhiḥ sakhāyaḥ kula-pāḥ na vrāja-patim carantam
śrātam manye ūdhani śrātam agnau su-śrātam manye tat r̥tam navīyaḥ mādhyandinasya savanasya dadhnaḥ piba indra vajrin puru-kr̥t juṣāṇaḥ
pra sasahiṣe puru-hūta śatrūn jyeṣṭhaḥ te śuṣmaḥ iha rātiḥ astu indra ā bhara dakṣiṇena vasūni patiḥ sindhūnām asi revatīnām
mr̥gaḥ na bhīmaḥ kucaraḥ giri-sthāḥ parāvataḥ ā jagantha parasyāḥ sr̥kam sam-śāya pavim indra tigmam vi śatrūn tāl̥hi vi mr̥dhaḥ nudasva
indra kṣatram abhi vāmam ojaḥ ajāyathāḥ vr̥ṣabha carṣaṇīnām apa anudaḥ janam amitra-yantam urum devebhyaḥ akr̥ṇoḥ oṁ iti lokam
prathaḥ ca yasya sa-prathaḥ ca nāma ānu-stubhasya haviṣaḥ hav iḥ yat dhātuḥ dyutānāt savituḥ ca viṣṇoḥ ratham-taram ā jabhāra vasiṣṭhaḥ
avindan te ati-hitam yat āsīt yajñasya dhāma paramam guhā yat dhātuḥ dyutānāt savituḥ ca viṣṇoḥ bharat-vājaḥ br̥hat ā cakre agneḥ
te avindan manasā dīdhyānāḥ yajuḥ skannam prathamam deva-yānam dhātuḥ dyutānāt savituḥ ca viṣṇoḥ ā sūryāt abharan gharmam ete
br̥haspatiḥ nayatu duḥ-gahā tiraḥ punaḥ neṣat agha-śaṁsāya manma kṣipat aśastim apa duḥ-matim han atha karat yajamānāya śam yoḥ
narāśaṁsaḥ naḥ avatu pra-yāje śam naḥ astu anu-yājaḥ haveṣu kṣipat aśastim apa duḥ-matim han atha karat yajamānāya śam yoḥ
tapuḥ-mūrdhā tapatu rakṣasaḥ ye brahma-dviṣaḥ śarave hantavai oṁ iti kṣipat aśastim apa duḥ-matim han atha karat yajamānāya śam yoḥ
apaśyam tvā manasā cekitānam tapasaḥ jātam tapasaḥ vi-bhūtam iha pra-jām iha rayim rarāṇaḥ pra jāyasva pra-jayā putra-kāma
apaśyam tvā manasā dīdhyānām svāyām tanū iti r̥tvye nādhamānām upa mām uccā yuvatiḥ babhūyāḥ pra jāyasva pra-jayā putra-kāma
aham garbham adadhām oṣadhīṣu aham viśveṣu bhuvaneṣu antariti aham pra-jāḥ ajanayam pr̥thivyām aham jani-bhyaḥ aparīṣuputrān
viṣṇuḥ yonim kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṁśatu ā siñcatu prajāpatiḥ dhātā garbham dadhātu te
garbham dhehi sinīvāli garbham dhehi sarasvati garbham te aśvinau devau ā dhattām puṣkara-srajā
hiraṇyayī iti araṇī iti yam niḥ-manthataḥ aśvinā tam te garbham havāmahe daśame māsi sūtave
mahi trīṇām avaḥ astu dyukṣam mitrasya aryamṇaḥ duḥ-ādharṣam varuṇasya
nahi teṣām amā cana na adhva-su vāraṇeṣu īśe ripuḥ agha-śaṁsaḥ
yasmai putrāsaḥ aditeḥ pra jīvase martyāya jyotiḥ yacchanti ajasram
vātaḥ ā vātu bheṣajam śam-bhu māyaḥ-bhu naḥ hr̥de pra naḥ āyūṁṣi tāriṣat
uta vāta pitā asi naḥ uta bhrātā uta naḥ sakhā saḥ naḥ jīvātave kr̥dhi
yat adaḥ vāta te gr̥he amr̥tasya nidhiḥ hitaḥ tataḥ naḥ dehi jīvase
pra agnaye vācam īraya vr̥ṣabhāya kṣitīnām saḥ naḥ parṣat ati dv iṣaḥ
yaḥ parasyāḥ parāvataḥ tiraḥ dhanva ati-rocate saḥ naḥ paṣart ati dviṣaḥ
yaḥ rakṣāṁsi ni-jūrvati vr̥ṣā śukreṇa śociṣā saḥ naḥ parṣat ati dvi ṣaḥ
yaḥ viśvā abhi vi-paśyati bhuvanā sam ca paśyati saḥ naḥ paṣart ati dviṣaḥ
yaḥ asya pāre rajasaḥ śukraḥ agniḥ ajāyata saḥ naḥ parṣat at i dviṣaḥ
pra nūnam jāta-vedasam aśvam hinota vājinam idam naḥ barhiḥ āsade
asya pra jāta-vedasaḥ vipra-vīrasya mīl̥huṣaḥ mahīm iyarmi su-stutim
yāḥ rucaḥ jāta-vedasaḥ deva-trā havya-vāhanīḥ tābhiḥ naḥ yajñam invatu
ā ayam gauḥ pr̥śniḥ akramīt asadat mātaram puraḥ pitaram ca pra-yan [svar iti]svaḥ
antariti carati rocanā asya prāṇāt apa-anatī vi akhyat mahiṣaḥ divam
triṁśat dhāma vi rājati vāk pataṅgāya dhīyate prati vastoḥ aha dyu-bh iḥ
r̥tam ca satyam ca abhīddhāt tapasaḥ adhi ajāyata tataḥ rātrī ajāyata tataḥ samudraḥ arṇavaḥ
samudrāt arṇavāt adhi savvaṁtsaraḥ ajāyata ahorātrāṇi vi-dadhat viśvasya miṣataḥ vaśī
sūryācandramasau dhātā yathāpūrvam akalpayat divam ca pr̥thivīm ca antarikṣam atho svaḥ
sam-sam it yuvase vr̥ṣan agne viśvāni aryaḥ ā il̥aḥ pade sam idhyase saḥ naḥ vasūni ā bhara
sam gacchadhvam sam vadadhvam sam vaḥ manāṁsi jānatām devāḥ bhāgam yathā pūrve sam-jānānāḥ upa-āsate
samānaḥ mantraḥ sam-itiḥ samānī samānam manaḥ saha cittam eṣām samānam mantram
samānī vaḥ ākūtiḥ samānā hr̥dayāni vaḥ samānam astu vaḥ manaḥ yathā vaḥ su-saha asati
